docs.title: §10 operator directive of 2026-08-25, two fixtures, full text — archived 2026-09-30
docs.text:
OPERATOR DIRECTIVE 2026-08-25 (interactive session) — two fixtures, and the fixture-scale finding behind it. FOR THE 2026-08-30 WEEKLY REVIEW: this is the disposition of the N ≤ 25 question the 08-23 review deferred to you, and it must be answered in that review's §10 pass. The weekly review owns the final scoping; the operator has stated the intent and the reasoning below is the interactive session's, offered as a recommendation, not as a decision.

The finding. birdcage_port_domain's default ring_radius = 0.07 m is a 14 cm-diameter, 14 cm-long coil around a 6 cm phantom. That is a bench-scale fixture, not a human coil — the operator's actual target is "rather large, it had to fit a human, like 30 cm diameter and length." No entry in this plan has ever justified 0.07 m; it is an unexamined inheritance from an early coarse fixture, and every downstream constraint derived from it inherits that. In particular the N ≤ 25 ceiling is just arithmetic on the wrong radius: 2π(0.07)/17.5 mm = 25.1. At ring_radius = 0.15 the same 17.5 mm clearance floor admits 53 legs (32 legs give 29.5 mm spacing), so the 32-port directive has no geometry problem at human scale and needs neither a bigger clearance rule nor narrower boxes.

Why this is a physics finding and not a bookkeeping one. At 64 MHz the wavelength in tissue (εᵣ ≈ 80) is ≈ 0.52 m; at 128 MHz ≈ 0.26 m. A 30 cm coil is a substantial fraction of a wavelength — that is why this project needs a full-wave solve rather than a quasi-static one (§1). A 14 cm coil around a 6 cm phantom is electrically far smaller and will systematically understate exactly the effects Phase 5/6 exist to capture: B1+ inhomogeneity, dielectric/wavelength behaviour, and the SAR distribution. Those come out qualitatively wrong, not merely imprecise. For the 10 MHz gating work done so far this was harmless — at 30 m wavelength nothing is scale-sensitive — which is why it has gone unnoticed for the whole port lineage.

The directive. Maintain two fixtures, not one: * (F-small) the gate fixture — today's ring_radius = 0.07 m parameters, unchanged. It keeps every existing record valid (116 085 cells, PORT-9's S-matrix, the GEO-18/19/20 identities, EX-28/EX-31), stays cheap enough to run in an ordinary slot, and remains the home of the CAD-identity and reciprocity/passivity gates. Its records must not move for this. * (F-human) the production fixture — a human-scale high-pass birdcage: ring_radius ≈ 0.15 m, coil_length ≈ 0.30 m, phantom scaled to match (a 6 cm phantom in a 30 cm coil is not a load), the high-pass ring-gap topology GEO-20 already builds, at the directive's 32 ports. This is the fixture the Phase 5/6 deliverables run on — B1+ maps, coil-driven SAR, mode spectrum, tuning.

Keeping them separate is the point: it buys the right physics for the deliverables without a mass re-record of the validation lineage, and F-small stays useful precisely because it is cheap.

What the weekly review must decide (not pre-empted here). 1. Cost, first and blocking. Volume goes as r³: 0.07 → 0.15 m is ≈ 10× at fixed resolution. GEO-19 step C measured 16 legs at 307 296 cells / 74.18 s on F-small; F-human at 32 ports plausibly lands at 3–4 M cells, and TH-11 step 5 measured 2.81 M as an OOM — at the old 64 GiB ceiling. The ceiling is now 128 GiB (§5.1, operator directive 2026-08-24), so this is the first real test of that raise and is exactly the re-pricing the TH-11/TH-12/OPS-17 memory-premise caveats were left open for. A cost probe comes before any dated commitment — §5.1's "a tier is a measurement, not an intention", and the §10 epitaph's own lesson (a target needs its finest rung priced before it is named). 2. Whether F-human is a new parameter set on birdcage_port_domain or a separate constructor, and which gates transfer to it. The CAD-identity families should transfer unchanged — they are scale-free. 3. Whether GEO-19 step C's parked C16 terminal-equality band question should be settled on F-small first (it is a C4 band applied to C16, independent of scale) so that F-human does not inherit an open ruling. 4. Sequencing against Phase 5 subgoal 4: the first B1+ chunk was to be scoped "the day PORT-9 closes" (2026-08-25) on the loaded F-small birdcage at 10 MHz. That should still happen — it is the cheap way to gate the B1+ machinery — with the human-scale map following on F-human. Do not block subgoal 4 on F-human.

What this directive does not do: it does not re-record anything, does not change a default, does not commission a chunk, and does not move the 32-port target. GEO-19/GEO-20 continue as scoped on F-small.

docs.title: §10 Phase 6 goal paragraph with its assessments of 2026-08-09, 08-16 and 08-23 — archived 2026-09-30
docs.text: Phase 6 — tuning. Mode spectrum of the birdcage (the TH-9 eigensolver machinery on the birdcage mesh), lumped capacitors at the gap/port level, and a circuit co-simulation loop: S-parameters from the EM solve, tuning and matching in a circuit layer — the HFSS + Circuit split. Validation targets, named now: birdcage mode frequencies against the lumped-element ladder-network closed form; tuned S11/capacitor values against an AED HFSS + Circuit benchmark case. Hard parts unchanged: near-resonance solves are §2.1's ill-conditioning trap by construction, and the phase is PORT-1-blocked until gap-voltage ports gate. Assessment 2026-08-09: earliest meaningful start ≈ end of August (when subgoal-2 ports land); no completion date — no circuit co-simulation work of any kind exists in the repo, so there is no measured pace to extrapolate from, and inventing one is what this section exists to prevent. First date next review after its first steps land. Assessment 2026-08-16: unchanged — ports are ≈ 1 week out, so "earliest meaningful start ≈ end of August" still holds and still awaits PORT-9; no circuit co-simulation work exists yet, so still no completion date. Assessment 2026-08-23: the physics start still waits on PORT-9/PORT-11 (the scaffolding rule — a mode spectrum on a port model that has not gated at 64 MHz would be the ⚠️ backlog again), so "earliest meaningful physics start ≈ 2026-09-01" follows from subgoal 2b's arithmetic above. What can start now, and is scoped this review, is the directive's mesh half, because its gates are CAD identities with no physics dependency: GEO-19 (item (a), 16 legs, the first measured cost rung above 4 legs) and GEO-20 (item (b), the high-pass ring-gap port layout, 4 legs first). Items (c) (C4 → C_N gate generalization) and (d) (the AED HFSS + Circuit case at 16 legs) stay unscoped until GEO-19 reports whether 16 legs fit the box at all — a cost rung, not a hope, is what dates this phase. Still no completion date, for the same reason as the last two weeks.

docs.title: §10 superseded weekly blocks of 2026-09-26 — archived 2026-09-30
docs.text:
Pace ledger, interval 2026-09-19 21:17 → 09-26 21:00 CDT (6.99 days, measured from 3dc8b82; sources: 101 commits, the attempts journal, 20260927T020102Z_WEEKLY-COUNTS.log). 22 items reached §4-✅: three physics chunks — PORT-20, PORT-22, WF-7; nine OPS chunks (-50, -55, -56, -57, -58, -59, -60, -62, -63); two examples (EX-61, EX-62); eight gated steps outside them (TH-17 1c, PORT-21 step 1, PORT-23 step 1, ANS-6 runnable half, steps 2 and 2b, GEO-34 1a and 1b′). 22 / 6.99 = 3.15/day (09-19: 3.40); physics chunks 3 / 6.99 = 0.43/day (09-19: 0.77). Chain steps: 10 of the 17 enumerated on 09-19 landed (T5′, T9, F1, F2, F3, H1–H5), eight of them slot-executable, all by 09-25 04:43 — 8 / 5.1 d = 1.57/day while fed, 0 in the 1.9 days after. 8 of 20 implementer sessions drew only EX-57 figures. Attribution: Phase 0 nine chunks; Phase 4 one chunk (PORT-20) and two steps; Phase 5 one chunk (WF-7, human scale); Phase 6 one chunk (PORT-22) and four steps; CAD input (GEO-34, operator directive 09-20) two steps. Known-issues 2 opened / 3 retired. Progress against cost: docs/status/weekly-progress.md § 2026-09-26.

The 09-19 forecast, audited. It gave the 11 slot-executable steps "between 2026-09-30 and 2026-11-19", the width being the starved rate. Eight landed in 5.1 days: the fed rate was the true one and the starved rate was never a throughput. The watch condition is met — T5′ (PORT-22 ✅) landed 09-20, so "tuned" keeps its definition and TH-17 is not dropped. What the forecast missed: enumerating three steps ahead per chain is about five days of work at four slots a day, not seven.

Rulings, 2026-09-26 (protocol step 5 and the readouts owed to this review; every AED figure is in the gitignored docs/private/ans6-ans4-ans2-adjudication-2026-09-26.md; relative agreement levels are public by the operator ruling of 2026-09-24). The private arithmetic is this session's and was calibrated against two figures of the 09-19 file; it has not been re-derived by a second reader.

  • ANS-6 — AGREE on the loss partition and on the conductor's contribution; absolute S at degree 1 INCONCLUSIVE; the conductor interior is cleared. P_coil/(P_coil + P_phantom) on copper is within 0.4 % of AED at 10 MHz and within 4.2 % at 128 MHz at both AED orders, ours lower throughout — the first external check of the Leontovich loss model (TH-14). |S(Cu) − S(PEC)| agrees with the order-matched column to 0.4 % at 10 MHz and within 9 % at 128 MHz; AED's own two orders differ by more than that on this row, so its low-order column is not a reference for it. The three S classes sit 1–3 % from AED's low-order column at degree 1, which is below our own degree 1 → 2 move on this mesh (7.4 / 4.1 / 4.1 % at 64 MHz, step 2) — not ruled either way until an order-matched rung exists. The copper and PEC columns carry the same gap to two decimals, so ANS-4's self-class gap is not the resolved σ = 800 interior: it is the port model and/or our discretisation (chain F5 answered).
  • Chain F2 (xl 3e, 3g) — the 10 / 64 MHz self-class "DISAGREE" is re-read as unconverged on our side, heading toward AED. At both frequencies the degree-2 sequence moves monotonically toward the order-matched AED column on all three classes, in one direction in the complex plane. The finest-rung gaps stand at 5.7 / 1.8 / 1.5 % (10 MHz) and 2.5 / 1.5 / 1.1 % (64 MHz), each only ≈ 1.6× its ladder's last step (3.6 % and 1.5 % on S₁₁), so neither is established as a model difference. The 128 MHz AGREE stands (1.1 %).
  • The "ratio ≳ 1.5" criterion was mis-posed; it is withdrawn in both directions and replaced. The rungs' steps are unequal (h 0.015 → 0.0075 → 0.005): an O(h^p) error gives a successive-change ratio of 3.0 at p = 1 and 1.71 as p → 0, so the measured 1.6–1.9 is no asymptotic rate in the nominal h. Cause, read in the module: the ladder refines the global resolution with conductor_resolution pinned (cells grow 2.43× and 2.10×, not 8× and 3.4×) — the port neighbourhood, where a self term is decided, is never refined. 3e's "converged by the letter" at 64 MHz is therefore not banked. Criterion from here on: a ladder is read as converged when the last successive change is ≥ 3× below the quantity it is compared with, on rungs that refine the region the quantity lives in. No Richardson limit is licensed on this family.
  • Production element order (T6, TH-19 step 4) — not flipped. The pre-registered condition needed both ladders converged; 10 MHz is not, by the rule's own letter (last change above the smallest class move on S₁₁ and S₃₁). Degree 2 stays the target (operator). Standing, for quoting: no lumped-sheet S is quoted at degree 1 on the ×1 mesh without its order move beside it — the 10 MHz degree-1 figure is 2.5 % from AED by cancellation while degree 2 on the same cells is 14.9 % out. Re-tested when F7 and F8 exist.
  • PORT-21 step 2 (F4) — read. Variant (a), the κ-corrected sheet width, has the gap's frequency shape (3.4 : 1.6 : 0.6 % against 5.7 : 2.5 : 1.1 %) and points toward AED; transferred to the finest rung it would remove ≈ 60 % of the self-class gap at 10 and 64 MHz. A hypothesis: the transfer across order and mesh is unmeasured — F6 / F7 measure it. The gap is, on present evidence, two terms that are ours and already named (truncation still falling; PORT-14's κ) and no third.
  • TH-17 gate (a) — re-posed, band unchanged. C_tuned was chosen for P1's series resonance with three capacitors; the eigenproblem carries four, so its modes satisfy Im z_k(f) = 1/(ωC) on the circulant reduction and the 129.6 MHz floor is not a miss. The identity the gate wanted is T5a / T5b below, at the imported κ band.
  • WF-7 0d — the ≈ 1 % degree-2 terminal residual is on every column; POST-7 commissioned (H7): PORT-16's exact discrete identity at degree 2 on F-human. Green ⇒ κ-class, a record; red ⇒ a degree-2 accounting defect with a known-issues entry. No band moves.
  • ANS-2 step 4 — branch (a) ratified, its wording corrected. 4.5 % is our own C4 scatter, not the distance to AED: on the refined rung pointwise SAR sits within 6.3 % of the order-matched AED column, 4.3 % on the drive average (ours higher) — the feed-level gap of the integral.
  • GEO-33 (H6) and the strip-conductor note — reconciled. The 32-leg rung carries strips, so its step 0 is the two-sided Leontovich sheet on an interior facet, gated on a closed form before any 32-leg mesh (H6a).
  • B1 (TH-5, radiation boundary) — not opened. A body birdcage sits in an RF shield; the PEC box is the right first model and an open boundary is on no chain. Revisit when a chain needs it.
  • OPS-61 (Palace) — commissioned. A second reference whose numbers can sit in tracked files and gates. Step 0 needs an image the sandbox cannot pull: operator (dashboard). OPS-54 — queue it; it is the right use of a drained slot. ARCH-1 — embargoed to 10-17, untouched.
  • The launcher's two gaps — OPS-64 opened. Every ANS-4 window since 09-20 reads "orphans: not established" because the check lives in the command, not in xl-run.sh; and a window's declared outputs are not staged, so an untracked file stops the next window and the next slot (the 09-25 daily caught one and disarmed a second). Both belong to the launcher. Entries 14 and 16–21 carry the orphan check in their own command; 12, 13 and 15 do not and are not edited after QUEUED.
  • WF-7's mirror identity — not re-opened; carried into WF-10. The hotspot lies on the mirror plane, so (iii) compared cw with ccw at one point. WF-7 stays ✅ on its Done-when as written; WF-10 step 2 asserts the mirror identity on a lattice that includes off-plane points, which is where it discriminates.
  • The 09-23 service outage — cause unknown, nothing to rule; it stays the operator's (dashboard).

Live chains — open steps numbered, each with its validation target and serial prerequisites (§9 rule (4)). Landed and removed: T5′, T9, F1, F3, F5, H1–H5 (archive, 09-19 block).

Chain T — the tuned F-small birdcage, on copper.

  • T5a. TH-17 step 2 — the four-capacitor spectrum against the circuit layer. A driven 4×4 Z(f) bracket around the 129.6 MHz floor (factor reuse), the circulant reduction z_k(f), the zero of Im z_k − 1/(ωC) per symmetry class. Asserted: the k = 1 pair of step 1b (ii)'s spectrum equals the prediction within PORT-14's imported κ band, the pair degenerate within the imported C4 band; negative control 0.5 C. Target: circuit ↔ eigen identity. Serial on nothing.
  • T5b. TH-17 step 3 — tune by the eigen route: C_mode from T5a's reduction at 64 MHz, the eigen solve at C_mode lands at 64 MHz within the same band; mode ordering asserted against (C5), values printed. Serial on T5a.
  • T7. PORT-22 step 2 — the driven-sweep resonance on the copper coil (hole mesh, TH-14's Leontovich route) at the fixed C = 15.57 pF of ANS-7's SPEC. Asserted: circuit = field within REDUCTION_BAND at every grid frequency, exactly one sign change of Im Z_in, ≥ 5 grid points inside the half-power band the circuit layer predicts, negative control 0.5 C; Cu and PEC columns. Printed: f₀, R_in(f₀), loaded Q. Serial on nothing. Heavy.
  • T10. ANS-7 runnable half — LANDED 2026-09-29 (Route B §9 item 69, 2203cf07; Route A + the band + the private writer §9 item 68, 09:30 slot: all 102 S11_bare A − B residuals ≤ REDUCTION_BAND, worst 9.250e-05, 20260929T100040Z_ANS-7-item68-W3-A.log). T10b (adjudication) is the weekly's. — ans:7 from the SPEC commissioned today, importing T7's module; COMPARISON.md with AED columns blank. Serial on T7. Re-targeted 2026-09-28 by operator directive (SPEC v2): the SPEC now puts C = 66.29 pF (TH-17 step 3's C_mode) on every gap with the drive across C₁ — the parallel k = 1 resonance a birdcage is built for, not v1's three-capacitor series resonance (v1 withdrawn before any AED result; T7 / item 50's measurement stays a v1 record). T10 is now: our side of both SPEC routes — Route A in-model (bare port + PORT-14 sheets on gaps 2–4, C₁ added across the port) and Route B (_build_ladder four-port through PORT-15, all gaps terminated, C₁ across the drive) — rows on Y_in over the 62–67 MHz / 0.1 MHz window, Route B's k = ±1 gap-current share at f₀, and the imported circuit = field band between the routes. Serial on nothing (T7's v1 anchor is not needed). First route landed 2026-09-29 (§9 item 69): Route B, degree 1, the fine window, committed with metrics.json / COMPARISON.md; Route A, the band and the private writer remain (§9 item 68).
  • T10b. Operator replication, then adjudication at a stated relative level — it does not wait for chain F.
  • T9b. xl entry 14 (09-29) prices the hole mesh at degree 2; entries 16–18 pre-registered on it.
  • T6. Serial on F7 and F8; not queueable.

Chain F — the feed model (it gates every absolute S₁₁).

  • F2′. xl entries 12, 13, 15 (3h, 3i, 3j) — the ladders on the congruent cut, read under the replaced criterion. Cron.
  • F6. PORT-21 step 3 — degree and resolution knobs on the feed-sensitivity module, unset run digit-identical at the imported reproduction band; variant (a) and control′ priced at degree 2 on the ×1 cut. Target: identities + the knob control. Serial on nothing.
  • F6b. ANS-6 step 3 — a private-mode comparison writer for ans:6 (ANS-4's reader on the ANS-6 key layout); tracked output carries no AED value, asserted by the leak check. Serial on nothing.
  • F7. xl entry 19 — variant (a) at degree 2 on the finest congruent rung, 10 then 64 MHz. Serial on F6.
  • F8. ANS-4 step 4 — the conductor factor on the RUNGSPEC path (unset digit-identical), then xl entry 20: the first degree-2 rungs that refine the port neighbourhood. Slot half serial on nothing.
  • F9. This review reads F7 / F8 privately.
  • F10. OPS-61 — step 0 the operator's; step 1 (the ANS-4 fixture in Palace, results public) slot-executable after it.

Chain H — human scale (F-human, 32 ports).

  • H7. POST-7 — the exact discrete power identity at degree 2 on F-human: slot half a degree knob on WF-7 step 1's module with the degree-1 control reproducing H3; then xl entry 21. Serial on nothing.
  • H8. WF-10 step 1 — tune F-human in the circuit layer. From H3's 32×32 at 64 MHz: two quadrature feed ports kept, 30 ring gaps terminated in C, C_tuned by PORT-15's sweep. Asserted: the reduced 2×2 equals one in-model solve with capacitor sheets on the 30 gaps within REDUCTION_BAND; negative control 0.5 C. Printed: the k = 1 share of the ring-gap currents, feed isolation. Target: circuit ↔ field identity. Serial on nothing.
  • H8′. WF-10 step 1b — tune F-human by mode, in the k = 1 block (operator ruling 2026-09-28, interactive session; replaces H8's choice of C_tuned, keeps H8's identity). H8 landed its circuit ↔ field identity (6.99e-4) but chose C_tuned as the first zero of Im Z_in, and at that zero (19.7327 pF) the k = ±1 share of the ring-gap currents is 0.084 / 0.025 — not the imaging mode. The field's standard is EM/circuit co-simulation with the capacitor chosen for a mode (docs/references/birdcage-tuning-literature.md); on a C16-symmetric coil the 32×32 splits exactly by azimuthal harmonic, so the mode is selected by construction — the route TH-17 T5a/T5b took on F-small and confirmed against a true eigensolve. Four parts, one slot item for (1)–(3): (1) C_mode from the k = 1 block. DFT H3's 32×32 (degree 1, 64 MHz, κ-corrected as H8) over the 16 slots into 2×2 blocks Ẑ_k (top / bottom ring); take the eigenvalue λ₁ of Ẑ₁ whose eigenvector carries leg current (the ring-antisymmetric combination — identified by printing both, asserted by (2)); C_mode = 1 / (ω Im λ₁) with every ring gap carrying C. If Im λ₁ ≤ 0 at 64 MHz, the k = 1 mode cannot be reached by ring capacitors on this fixture — that is the finding, recorded, and H9 does not run. Printed: C_mode beside H8's 19.7327 pF and the per-k values 1 / (ω Im λ_k) for k = 0…8 (the mode spectrum in C). (2) Field check. One in-model solve with PORT-14 capacitor sheets at C_mode on the 30 non-feed gaps and the two quadrature feeds of H8: asserted, the circuit-reduced 2×2 equals it within the imported REDUCTION_BAND (H8's identity, re-run at C_mode), and the k = ±1 share of the ring-gap currents ≥ 0.9 on the feed ring (pre-registered band, operator 2026-09-28 — the co-simulation papers' current-pattern check). (3) Negative control, asserted: the same construction on the k = 2 block gives a C differing from C_mode by more than 10 % and a k = ±1 share < 0.5 at its zero. (4) Optional, later (xl): a full-wave eigensolve at C_mode confirming a k = 1 pair near 64 MHz, as TH-17 did on F-small — independent confirmation, not a gate on H9. Serial on H8 (landed). Target: mode-selected tuning + circuit ↔ field identity. Not claimed: homogeneity, a match, compliance. Operator ruling 2026-09-30 (interactive session) on item 62's two reds (identity 3.4865e-3 > 1e-3; feed-ring share 0.7898 < 0.9, circuit 0.7882, other ring 0.95): both bars stay as numbers; the fixture is re-posed. (a) The 0.9 share floor applies to the configuration a real birdcage uses: C on all 32 gaps, the two feed gaps included, each quadrature drive across its gap's C (parallel drive — ANS-7 v2's arrangement), not a bare 50 Ω port in place of the capacitor. The reds are read as the two resistive feeds breaking C16 on the feed ring (the cause the item pre-named), not a tuning failure. (b) REDUCTION_BAND 1e-3 is unchanged; before any band argument, a diagnostic C-sweep 19.7 → 113 pF on the held 32×32, the identity residual printed per point (known-issues 2026-09-28 entry), separates a smooth C trend (sheet / κ) from a spike at C_mode (near-resonance amplification of (Z_tt + Z_C)⁻¹). A band change, if any, is argued from that sweep, never from item 62's reading. The weekly writes the re-posed H8′ and the sweep as numbered chain H steps.
  • H-Cu. F-human on copper — operator directive 2026-09-30 (interactive session), for the weekly to number and place. Every human-scale fixture so far (WF-7, EX-62 / mri:4, H3's 32×32, H8, H8′) solves the coil as the σ = 800 S/m resolved volume (SIGMA_WIRE_S_PER_M), a conductor whose coil-loss share is wrong by construction (the ANS-6 rationale). Shapes (the |B₁⁺| pattern, the hotspot location, C16 / mirror identities) are largely conductor-independent, but every per-power figure — SAR per accepted watt, |B₁⁺| per √W, a tuned Q / bandwidth — is not, and H9 is the first step that produces exactly those. Step: the F-human fixture as a hole mesh (birdcage_port_domain(as_hole=True), TH-15) with TH-14's Leontovich copper (σ = 5.8e7) on the conductor wall, the 32 ring-gap ports unchanged; cost probe first (hole-mesh cell count and memory at F-human scale are unmeasured; tier by measurement). Gates (identities and imported bands only): 32×32 reciprocity / passivity at the imported bands; C16 class spreads within the imported C4_COVARIANCE_BAND; TH-14's exact power partition per drive (P_src = P_phantom + P_surf); a PEC column on the same hole mesh with the ANS-6-style Cu ≠ PEC control. Printed, not gated: the coil-loss share beside σ = 800's, and the |B₁⁺| / SAR-hotspot shape change between the two conductors. Placement (the weekly's call): H9's per-power readings should run on copper; H8′'s re-pose and C-sweep answer mode / identity questions that are largely conductor-independent and may proceed on σ = 800 in parallel, with C_mode re-derived on copper before H9. Not claimed: absolute loss against AED at human scale (that is ANS-8). Eventual target — strip sheets (operator 2026-09-30): a built coil's legs and rings are copper tape, whose inductance and current crowding differ from round wire, and the operator models coils in AEDT as 2D sheets; so the F-human conductor's end state is zero-thickness copper strips, not round solids. That needs a two-sided sheet loss model — a single-valued resistive sheet misrepresents copper many skin depths thick (09-27 daily: a septum at an E-node reads lossless) — i.e. decoupled lips, H6a / GEO-33 step 0 (closed form Q_sep/Q₀ = 0.771914). H-Cu on the round hole mesh is the near-term step; the strip version follows H6a, gated against H-Cu's round-conductor records only where the geometry change is stated.
  • H9. WF-10 step 2 — tuned quadrature |B₁⁺| and the 10 g SAR hotspot by superposition with the circuit layer's port currents (POST-6), gated on reproducing H8′'s in-model field at C_mode and on C16 invariance; printed beside WF-7's untuned table. Serial on H8′ (operator ruling 2026-09-28; was H8, whose C_tuned is not the k = 1 mode). The first tuned human-scale safety quantity; one phantom, no compliance claim.
  • H6a. GEO-33 step 0 — the two-sided Leontovich sheet, gated on a closed form: TH-14 step 1's cavity with a copper septum on the mid-plane normal to E, which leaves TE₁₀₁ unperturbed (the field does not vary along E), so the septum's two faces each dissipate what one of the two walls normal to E does — Q against Pozar's wall-loss integrals with that pair counted twice. Negative control: the one-sided form misses by the predicted amount. Serial on nothing.
  • H6. GEO-33 step 1 — the 32-leg strip cost rung. Serial on H6a, H8.
  • H10. ANS-8 (human scale) — commissioned by the weekly that reads H9.
  • H11 (future, undated; operator directive 2026-09-28). WF-11 — the 32-leg / 64-port high-pass body coil tuned at 128 MHz (3 T), |B₁⁺| and 10 g SAR. Serial on H6 (GEO-33) and H9 (WF-10 step 2). Not enumerated into steps until GEO-33 step 1 has a price; the 16-leg F-human at 64 MHz stays the lead.

Phase 6 date, with the arithmetic. Slot-executable open steps: T5a, T5b, T7, T10, F6, F6b, F8 (slot half), H7 (slot half), H8, H9, H6a = 11, plus OPS-54 and F10 step 1. At the fed rate 11 / 1.57 = 7.0 days; at the interval rate 8 / 6.99 = 1.14/day, 9.6 days ⇒ 2026-10-04 … 10-07, i.e. the queue is again exhausted near the next weekly — consistent with the recommendation to drop a slot. F-small terminal claim (tuned resonance against AED, T10b): adjudication at the 10-10 weekly if T7 and T10 land by 09-30 and the operator's turnaround stays at its measured ≤ 2 days (ANS-2, ANS-3, ANS-6); the 10-03 weekly if it is one day. Human scale: no date — ring-gap capacitor sheets have never been solved, so H8 has no rate. Watch condition for 10-03: if T7 has not landed, the copper capacitor-sheet route is not "one more step" and T10 re-scopes to the σ = 800 fixture with that stated.

Agent value, fifth measurement. (a) Auditor: 15 reports across the five dailies; 13 PASS, 2 DEMOTE (OPS-56, OPS-60), both overruled by the daily with its reasons written — zero demotions stood, against one that mattered last interval. One more interval at zero and the auditor drops to closures of physics chunks only. (b) Pathologist: seven window readings, all countable; two partial OVERRULED (3e's failure count; ANS-2 step 4's builder labels) — it is finding label traps, keep. (c) Reviews 5 / 5 ok. (d) Navigator: not measured. (e) Example-runner: nested-agent anomalies twice (09-23 mat:1, ≈ 40 stray logs); batching since 09-25; the agent-file fix is the operator's (dashboard). (f) This review's own sweep agent nested two sub-agents against its brief — same class. Footers: six at 2026-08-31 (26 days), implementer.md 09-13 — all cross 30 days before the next weekly; re-verify then.

XL and XXL slots, 2026-09-26 (protocol step 3b). Seven windows ran and every one is ruled above or by the dailies (ledger). Entries 12–15 kept. Pre-registered today: 16 (ANS-6 degree 2 at h = 0.0075, READY), 17 / 18 (ANS-6 matched rungs at 10 / 128 MHz, pending entry 14 inside its brackets), 19 (F7), 20 (F8), 21 (H7) — each pending its slot half. xxl, 10-03: not spent.   • Item 157 ratified: "digit-identical" at 1e-14 was a round-off residual (HEAD prints 5.41e-14). Briefs name a record ≥ 1e-11, never a round-off residual, as "digit-identical".
  • Any brief's container timeout is ≤ 590 s (the 660 s foreground window). Item 160's 900 s cost the 21:00 slot its third item.
  • xl entry 24 needs item 173 (a five-node Cu-only assembly path). Implementers mark it READY on landing and never edit its command. Entries 25 and 26 (entry 20 at 64 / 128 MHz) are queued for 10-06 and 10-07.
  • Ruled 18:00, awaiting the 10-03 weekly (carried): WF-12 (iii) at 5e-5; the MAT-15 centroid bar at 1e-5·a.
  • Records parked on a branch land by path (logs) and by hand (test-results.md rows); never path-checkout a record file (carried). Items 165 and 168 carry branch logs.
  • Item 133 (H8b): WF-10 step 1 is at three of four; no slot re-runs it. F14 is the weekly's (carried).
  • ans:1–ans:3 do not honour FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE: do not run them. Every ans: run sets it. No slot opens docs/private/ or aed_results/. No absolute S₁₁ / Z_in at 10 or 64 MHz, and no tuned f₀ / Q claim (carried).
  • On the lumped-sheet route z_matrix is the terminated transimpedance; take network Z from z_from_s. Records tighter than ≈ 5e-11 at -n 2 drift run to run (carried).
  • A regenerated tracked example artifact is committed only if it agrees with the tracked copy to 1e-6 relative, or the commit names the ✅ chunk that moved it (carried).
  • Executors: timeout: 660000 on every window call; never delete a log; harness calls bare and whole; foreground, never nested. If the service is down: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh SERVICE-START "docker compose up -d fem-em-solver" once, bare; never build (carried).

MAT-18 step 2 is split into 2(a) / 2(b) for slot size, with bands unchanged. Every item: - The harness call is the whole Bash command — bare, repo-relative, nothing chained or piped (bash_guard rule 3 denies the rest). A slot that spawns an executor puts that sentence in the spawn prompt verbatim. - An executor that loses the docker socket mid-item stops and reports. The slot re-runs the same command strings itself and journals the denial. - No edit to a script or test after its last window (rule (i)). The slot checks file times against the log's start before committing. - Every Bash call that runs a window passes timeout: 660000. Run pytest with -s. Never delete a log. - An item that parks marks itself BLOCKED in the same commit (rule (d)). - A window killed at its tier ceiling is not a result. Follow the item's stated fallback; never lengthen the timeout. After a kill, run pgrep -c python3 in the container first. - No slot opens docs/private/ or aed_results/. No AED value goes in any tracked file.

docs.text:
Pace ledger, interval 2026-09-26 21:23 → 09-30 21:00 CDT (3.98 days, measured from 3cb1cb5; sources: 158 commits, the attempts journal, 20261001T020024Z_WEEKLY-COUNTS.log, a delegated ledger with a commit on every row). 74 §9 items executed (50–122, 125): 63 complete with a quantitative assertion (seven reproduction-only, three tooling), three figure / docs, seven blocked on a negative, one parked. 32 chunks reached §4-✅ — 32 / 3.98 = 8.0/day; physics chunks 22 / 3.98 = 5.5/day (09-26: 0.43). Phase 6: zero chunks, twelve gated steps. Of the 13 steps the 09-26 block listed as slot-executable, 10 landed (T5a, T5b, T7 as a v1 record, T10, F6, F6b, the F8 and H7 slot halves, H8, F10 step 1a), all by 09-29 06:08 CDT — 10 / 2.37 d = 4.2/day while fed, 0 in the 1.6 days after. Slots: 36 sessions (4/day to 09-28 12:15, 12/day after); 11 found the queue empty, six drained mid-slot, one met a dirty tree; 74 items / 24 working sessions = 3.1 per working session at 5–15 measured minutes each. Attribution: Phase 2 six chunks, Phase 3 two, Phase 4 five, Phase 5 one, Phase 8 six, meshing two, Phase 0 two, examples eight; Phase 7 one step. Known-issues 8 opened / 11 retired. Progress against cost: docs/status/weekly-progress.md § 2026-09-30.

The 09-26 forecast, audited. It dated the 11 slot-executable steps "2026-10-04 … 10-07" and read the queue's exhaustion as "consistent with the recommendation to drop a slot". Ten landed by 09-29: at twelve slots a day the list lasted 2.4 days, and the operator's 09-28 directive reversed the recommendation — the constraint was supply. The F-small watch condition was overtaken (SPEC v2 withdrew T7's configuration) and T10b was adjudicated tonight, one weekly earlier than forecast, with a verdict that is not the terminal claim.

Rulings, 2026-09-30 (every AED figure is in the gitignored docs/private/ans7-ans6-adjudication-2026-09-30.md; relative levels are public by the operator ruling of 2026-09-24; the private arithmetic is this session's and has not been re-derived by a second reader).

  • ANS-7 (T10b) — AGREE on the mode, the routes and the copper contribution; the absolute rows are INCONCLUSIVE at degree 1, with a named finding. Both codes find one k = ±1 parallel resonance in the window (share ≥ 0.9999). The conductor's part of 1/Q agrees to 5 % (ours higher), Q_Cu/Q_PEC to 1.1–2.4 %, the Cu − PEC shift of f₀ to 5 % of AED's First Order — the second external check of TH-14, the first on a resonance. Our f₀ is 1.2–1.4 % above the order-matched columns and 1.9 % above First Order (capacitor equivalent 2.5–3.9 %; 14–19 linewidths at Q ≈ 1000), the same on Cu and PEC; Q is 6–10 % and R_in 7–11 % low, most of it in the phantom's part of 1/Q (8–11 % high; the hypothesis on the row — gap-voltage E-field loss in the phantom — is consistent with that and stays a hypothesis). AED's own order move on f₀ is 0.5 %, away from ours. Not DISAGREE: our side is one degree-1 rung, and the 09-19 epitaph and the 09-26 quoting rule both apply. Not AGREE: a miss of 19 linewidths is not a tuning claim. Known-issues 2026-09-30; the rung is T11 / T12.
  • ANS-6 step 2c (xl 09-29) — row (c) sharpens, row (a) waits one night. On the order-matched hole rung at 64 MHz, |S(Cu) − S(PEC)| agrees with AED First Order to 0.5 % on every class (3–5 % at degree 1); the 4.008e-04 that "missed" the step's ≤ 1e-4 prediction is what AED reads too — the prediction was wrong. The absolute classes sit 3.1 / 1.8 / 1.5 % out, identically on Cu and PEC; entry 16 (10-01) supplies the middle rung and its pre-registered rule decides row (a).
  • F2′ (xl 3h, 3i, 3j) — the cut is not a term in the h-statement at any frequency, and no ladder of this family converges against its gap. Last changes on S₁₁ 3.56 / 1.49 / 0.63 % (10 / 64 / 128 MHz) against gaps of 5.7 / 2.5 / 1.1 %: ratios 1.6–1.8, short of the criterion's 3, on rungs that never refine the port region. Each window reproduced its cut-off twin. The family is closed to further windows.
  • The κ reading (F6's degree-2 window, read against the private column tonight). At degree 2 on the ×1 congruent cut at 10 MHz the in-run κ is 5.21 % (1.06 % at degree 1) and the κ-corrected sheet width — variant (a), an internal correction with no AED input — takes the self-class miss against AED First Order from 15.0 % to 0.8 %; the move is collinear with the gap (cosine 0.99997) and 1.05× its size (20260927T110931Z_PORT-21-step3-W3.log:2396,2914,2942). The couplings move by 4.9 / 4.6 % against gaps of 4.4 / 4.3 %; their direction is not on record (the JSON keeps (a)'s move, not its class means). One frequency, one mesh, a 4-digit print: a strong hypothesis, not a verdict. If it holds, the "unconverged, heading toward AED" ladders were κ shrinking with h, and degree 2 on the ×1 mesh with the corrected width is the production recipe at ≈ 100 s a sweep. F11, F12 and F7 test it; entries 17 and 18 (uncorrected fine rungs at 10 / 128 MHz) are superseded and revived only if those reject it.
  • Production order (T6) — not flipped; the rule for the weekly that holds F11, F12 and F7. Degree 2 with the κ-corrected width becomes the order for lumped-sheet S when (i) the corrected sequence's successive change on the self class between 0.015:2 and 0.0075:2 is ≤ ⅓ of the uncorrected one on the same rungs (6.96 % at 10 MHz, 2.81 % at 64 MHz), and (ii) the private reading puts the corrected ×1 degree-2 classes within 2 % of the order-matched column at 10, 64 and 128 MHz. docs.text:

By phase: Phase 6 one chunk (TH-17) plus WF-5 (chain T, §6's Phase 5 row); Phase 7 five (IMP-1, IMP-2, IMP-3, IMP-4, GEO-36); Phase 8 three (MAT-15, MAT-17, MAT-18); lane 1 eight (TH-2, PORT-3, PORT-23, GEO-1, GEO-2, GEO-4, GEO-6, GEO-7); Phase 9 none. Six slots journaled a drained queue (09-30: 17). Known-issues 1 opened / 4 retired. Progress against cost: docs/status/weekly-progress.md § 2026-10-03.

The 09-30 forecast, audited. It predicted the enumerated list would drain "about Friday morning" with a ≈ 9 slot-hour shortfall: the first drain was journaled the same night (10-01 03:48Z), and rule (6) (10-02) then held the count to six drained slots in three days — the dailies' provisional steps, not the weekly's list, carried the interval. It dated Phase 6's earliest exit "the 10-10 weekly, if H8b is green first time" and named the watch: "if H8b is red, human scale has no date again." H8b went red on 10-01 (identity 2.40e-3 against 1e-3) — the watch fired. Against that, T13 was read tonight, a week before T12's rung was due, because the order-matched ×1 records answered it.

Rulings, 2026-10-03 (every AED figure is in the gitignored docs/private/f9-t13-ans8-adjudication-2026-10-03.md; relative levels are public by the operator ruling of 2026-09-24; the private arithmetic is this session's, calibrated on three public prints and not re-derived by a second reader).

  • F9 — ANS-4 on exact SPEC rectangles (item 192): AGREE at degree 2, one mesh. With κ off, on the 117 206-cell ×1 mesh, ours at degree 2 is within 0.73 / 0.44 / 0.34 % (self class; 10 / 64 / 128 MHz) of AED First Order and within 0.55 % on every coupling class. Palace reads the same mesh to 0.0000 % of ours at matched order (F17). The same self-class miss was 15.0 % on the ragged sheet at degree 2 and 0.8 % with the κ correction: the exact rectangle does what the correction did, with no correction. Degree 1 on this mesh is 2.1–6.0 % out on the self class — inside its own order move (2.0 / 6.7 / 5.8 %) — and is not a quotable absolute S. Not yet an h-statement: xl 10-02 (ANS-4 4b) moved the ragged degree-2 self class by +1.92 % at 10 MHz under conductor-grading halving, 2.6× tonight's gap. F18 owes both axes on exact rectangles.
  • F16 — ANS-6 on exact rectangles, degree 1 (item 193): against the order-matched column the self class is 0.7 / 2.7 / 1.9 % out (ragged: 3.1 / 3.2 / 2.1), Cu and PEC identical to 0.02 pp. The 10 MHz gap was the sheet; the 64 / 128 MHz ones are degree-1 error. Row (a) is re-read on F19 (degree 2).
  • T13 — ANS-7 at degree 2 on exact rectangles (item 196): AGREE on the order-matched ×1 mesh; the 09-30 finding was our degree-1 discretisation. f₀ sits 0.11 % below AED First Order on both columns (1.1 / 1.9 linewidths, Cu / PEC); Q is within 1.9 % / 0.3 %, R_in within 1.6 % / 0.1 %. Our order move on f₀ is −1.985 %; exact against ragged (κ-corrected) rectangles moves it 0.005 %. So the directive's common-cause hypothesis holds for S₁₁ at degree 2 and fails for f₀ — that one was element order. The phantom's part of 1/Q, 8–11 % high on 09-30, is within 0.3 % at degree 2: the gap-voltage-loss hypothesis on the row is dead. The conductor's part stays 4.4 % high at both orders — a stable level inside the 5 % already quoted, not order error, and not chased before T12′. Entry 24's pre-registered rule (within 0.5 % of First Order ⇒ discretisation) is met at ×1; the row stays 🟡 for the h-rung (T12′), because 1–2 linewidths on one mesh is an agreement, not a tuning claim.
  • T6 — the production convention, re-posed on the operator's 10-02 ruling. Degree 2 on exact rectangles, κ off, is the convention for every quoted lumped-sheet S and resonance figure when (i′) the degree-2 self class's successive change between the ×1 and h = 0.0075 exact rungs is ≤ ⅓ of the ragged uncorrected step on the same rungs (≤ 2.32 % at 10 MHz, ≤ 0.94 % at 64 MHz — the 09-30 thresholds, unmoved), (i″) the conductor-halved exact rung stays inside clause (ii), and (ii) the classes are within 2 % of the order-matched column at 10 / 64 / 128 MHz — met tonight at ≤ 0.73 %. (i′) is F18b, (i″) is F18a. Until both: degree 2 on exact rectangles is quoted with "one mesh"; degree 1 is quoted nowhere without its order move (the 09-26 rule, kept).
  • ANS-8 — adjudicated on the operator's v1 + v2 columns (10-01). Mode content: AGREE within 0.6 %, blind on the First Order column — feed-ring k = ±1 share +0.4 %, k = 0 leak −0.6 %, each code at its own k = 1 resonance; the opposite-pair and four-port controls agree to 0.1 %. The v1 fixed-C row disagrees by the detuning its own C_mode gap predicts; that SPEC flaw was ours and v2 fixed it before First Order was read. C_mode / f₀: INCONCLUSIVE at degree 1 — our f₀ is 1.3 % / 1.9 % above the Zero / First Order σ = 800 columns, the F-small degree-1 signature at human scale; T13 says what that is on F-small and H15 tests it here. Copper rows: unread until our copper 32×32 goes through ring_mode_rows_v2 (H12c). The ≈ 0.79 share is the lossy σ = 800 coil's under a two-port drive — the leak follows leak/share ≈ 2·(R₁/|λ₀ + jX_C|)² (measured coefficient 1.94 on ours) — so on copper the same drive is predicted above 0.99 and a heavily loaded coil brings the leak back.

Asserted: for each of the four port drives the adjoint TF folded with the lead-free field equals the direct with-lead tip response at DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL; the 1-D path fold ∫TF(z)·E_tan(z) dz reproduces it within 5 % on every drive (step 0 measured 0.97 % at N = 24; ISO 10974's own budgets are several times that); the lead-free Born fold misses. ⇒ ✅ as a fixture. docs.text:
Pace ledger, interval 2026-10-03 21:15 → 10-05 21:00 CDT (1.99 days, measured from 04ef144c; sources: 62 commits, the attempts journal, 20261006T020117Z_WEEKLY-COUNTS.log, the §7 glyphs as the plan index reads them). 50 §9 items executed (209–258) in 23 implementer sessions (22 ok, one launch lost to an API 529): 2.2 per session, 669 / 50 = 13.4 measured wall-minutes per item (10-03: 12.2). 18 rows reached ✅ — 18 / 1.99 = 9.0/day; without the four examples, 14 / 1.99 = 7.0/day (10-03: 6.0). By phase: Phase 9 seven (WF-13, WF-14, GEO-37, WF-15, WF-16, WF-1, WF-17); Phase 8 one (MAT-19); Phase 7 two (WF-9 as a fixture, IMP-5); lane 1 four (POST-10, POST-1, PORT-18, PORT-2); examples four (EX-87 … EX-90); Phase 6 none at chunk grain — its progress is in steps: chain steps landed as gates or records: F 6 (+ the xl F18b), T 4 (two of them pre-registered reds landed as records), H 3 (one xl), P 5, I 5, U 7 = 30 slot steps + 2 windows in 1.99 days = 15.1 slot steps/day (10-03: 9.7). Five first attempts blocked (MAT-5 3, WF-15 1, MAT-19 2, WF-7 0e twice); every one landed on its next attempt. Two slots journaled a drained queue (10-03: six). Known-issues 1 opened / 2 retired, plus one retired tonight. Progress against cost: docs/status/weekly-progress.md § 2026-10-05.

The 10-03 forecast, audited. It said "T6 and T13 decided at the 10-10 weekly if neither rung moves a degree-2 figure by more than the gap it closed": F18b ran 10-05 and moved the self class 0.22–0.25 %, under every gap — T6 is decided tonight, five days early; T13 still waits on T12′ (xl 10-08). It named the 10-05 watch "H14's κ": the sheets turned out exact and κ_Cu was 4.5e-3 — the branch rule had no case for that, so the watch fired on its premise, not its number. It priced the supply at 81 % of 23 slots and expected rule (6) to cover four slots: the dailies wrote five provisional steps, two slots drained, and the package class it called "most likely to be wrong" (11 min) measured 17 — the chain-solve median rose 9 → 17 on the package and Palace order-2 steps. "Phase 9 — no date" now has a first measured rate (below).

Rulings, 2026-10-05 (every AED figure is in the gitignored docs/private/f18-adjudication-2026-10-05.md; relative levels are public by the operator ruling of 2026-09-24; the private arithmetic is this session's, by f18b_read_2026-10-05.py re-using the 10-03 reader, not re-derived by a second reader).

  • T6 — decided. Degree 2 on exact CAD rectangles, κ off, is the production convention for every quoted lumped-sheet S figure. Clause (ii) held at ×1 (≤ 0.73 %, 10-03). Clause (i′): the h = 0.0075 exact rung (xl entry 27, 10-05) moves the self class 0.25 / 0.23 / 0.22 % at 10 / 64 / 128 MHz against the ⅓-of-ragged thresholds 2.32 / 0.94 % — and sits within 0.97 % of AED First Order on every class. Clause (i″): the conductor-halved rung (items 212 / 225) sits within 0.77 % on every class. Both inside the 2 % column clause. The licence therefore reads: our degree-2 F-small 4×4 on exact rectangles is within 1 % of AED First Order on every class at 10 / 64 / 128 MHz on three meshes (×1, h = 0.0075, conductor ×0.5), and equals Palace at matched order. What it is not: an h-converged value — two h-rungs, and at 10 MHz the self class moves away from the column (signed +0.73 → +0.97 %) while at 128 MHz it moves toward it, so the h → 0 self class at 10 MHz is probably ≈ 1 %, not 0.7 %. The three-rung statement is F25 (entry 30, h = 0.005). §2.2's licence sentence is rewritten tonight (F20); PORT-21 ✅; known-issues 2026-09-19 retires. Degree 1 is still quoted nowhere without its order move.
  • OPS-61 — reading (a), ✅. Ours and Palace agree at matched order to 0.0000 % per class on the exact strip mesh at both orders and three frequencies, and both sit within 1 % of AED First Order: the two FEM codes share the port model and the residual against AED is discretisation (AED's adaptive mesh against our fixed one), not a port-model difference. Its Done-when (Palace's 4×4 at 64 MHz through the imported identity bands) was met by item 194 on 10-03; the audit stamp is the 03:00 daily's. Steps 2a / 2b (the hole mesh, PEC and copper) stand as records on the row.
  • POST-7 — §4.2 on a cron window, ruled. A window whose command is pre-registered verbatim in xl-pending.md, whose log carries the executed assertion lines and whose ledger row was filled from a log-pathologist reading is verification "executed by the agent" in §4's sense — the agent is the project's automation, and the record is more durable than a slot's. POST-7 closes when the identity-green branch's record registration lands (H7′, lane 1: the degree-1 and degree-2 terminal residuals as records in the WF-7 module, no band, reproduced from 20260926T070009Z_WF-7-step0d.log and 20261004T070008Z_POST-7-step2.log); the ✅ is then the implementer's, audited as any other.
  • T21 / T22 — "tuned" means the in-model zero; the 1e-6 band was an identity band on a frequency target. Both records fired their pre-registered red through the route gap r = f₀,A / f₀,B − 1 ≈ −2.3 … −2.5e-6, flat in f: a degree-2 floor on this mesh that no choice of C removes. Re-posed as T21′ / T22′: C_in is the in-model root (Route A — the quantity a bench and AED's FineWindow report); asserted, the in-model zero of Im Y_in at C_in sits at 64.000 / 127.74 MHz within the sparse grid's own frequency resolution, measured from T21's / T22's node residuals and pre-registered in the brief before the run (it must exceed r; the 10-04 windows put it near 1e-5), never 1e-6; circuit = field at REDUCTION_BAND at C_in; printed, c = C_mode / C_in − 1 (the construction residual) and r. Known-issues 2026-10-04 retires when T21′ lands. Not a loosened band: the quantity changed from a construction's prediction to the root it predicts, and the band from an identity's to a resolution's.
  • H14 — withdrawn by the 10-04 daily, ratified, with the finding written. F-human's 32 ring-gap sheets are exact to 2.2e-15 at STRIP_BAND and κ_Cu = 4.53e-3 on the same mesh. H14's rule (κ ≤ 1e-4 ⇒ exact) assumed κ measured sheet geometry; on exact sheets it measures something else — the copper wall's current distribution beside the sheet is the candidate, undiagnosed. κ stays a diagnostic (operator ruling), and H12c proceeds κ off, serial on nothing. The record goes to WF-12's row.
  • I13 — the tip ratio is not p-stable at 1 %; the question is now discretisation, and both codes agree on it. η_rod(T1) moves −4.961 % from order 1 to 2 in ours and in Palace alike on item 235's exact-rectangle rod mesh. ANS-10's question (the tip-SAR ratio's accuracy) is re-posed on our side as I14 (the 1 g rung at degree 2, p-move printed) and I15 (a near-tip h-ladder, priced by I14, xl if it needs it); item 235's exact-rectangle rod fixture is IMP-3's fixture of record from here (binding ruling (i)) and the ragged one stays as the record it is.
  • P8 and the ANS-9 SPEC. The 5 mm ball average sits within 1.9 % of the point value at probes A–E and moves 0.44 % per 0.1 mm at B: the SPEC's 10 % pointwise readout is safe against probe volume and placement. The SPEC gains a probe-volume note under its row 4 tonight (weekly-owned) — the operator reads row 4 as a point value or as a ≤ 5 mm ball, either inside the readout; no new row, no new AED request. docs.text:
Pace ledger, interval 2026-10-07 21:25 → 10-10 21:00 CDT (2.98 days, measured from 732f960b; sources: 98 commits, the attempts journal, 20261011T020032Z_WEEKLY-COUNTS.log, the §7 glyphs). 51 §9 items DONE (305, 309–362 less 308 / 335 / 349) in 31 ok implementer sessions: 1.65 per session, 678 / 51 = 13.3 measured wall-minutes per item (10-07: 10.1). 11 rows reached ✅ — 11 / 2.98 = 3.7/day; without the seven examples, 4 / 2.98 = 1.3/day (10-07: 7.6 / 1.5). At chunk grain: lanes 1–2 four (TH-5, OPS-70, WF-8, WF-2), examples seven (EX-103 … EX-109), Phases 6–9 none — their progress is steps: F 2 (F29, F30), T 1 + 1 xl (T28; T12′), H 7 + 1 xl (H12d, H16a, H17 parts 1–2, H9′ parts 1–2, H13b 2a; H15b), P 6 (P10′, P13, P14's closed-form half, P15, P16, P17), I 5 (I15 parts 2 / 3a, I18a, I18b, I19), U 15 (U12a, U21 2a / 2b-i ×2, U22–U24, U26–U30, U32–U34), lanes 6 (TH-5 2c, OPS-70 ×3, OPS-69, WF-2) = 42 slot steps + 2 xl windows in 2.98 days = 14.1 slot steps/day (10-07: 10.1). Three first attempts blocked: OPS-70 step 1 (a stale pin; landed on the re-run), T25 (its pre-registered red; ruled tonight), OPS-70 step 2 (the box-speed gate; the split landed). Nine journal entries record a drained or draining slot (10-07: nine); six sessions lost to the weekly usage cap (accepted, 2026-10-09). Known-issues 1 opened / 3 retired. Progress against cost: docs/status/weekly-progress.md § 2026-10-10.

The 10-07 forecast, audited. It dated human scale "not before the 10-17 weekly, and only when H17 part 2 is on the ledger with a root": H17 part 2 ran on the heavy tier on 10-10 (the daily re-tiered it by measurement; ratified) and H9′ landed the same day — the route was right, the xl detour was not needed, and the tuned copper F-human has its first gated readings a week early. It priced the supply at "≈ 465 of 1 020–1 400 minutes, short fourteen to twenty-three slots": 678 minutes were used, nine entries record a drained queue and six slots fell to the usage cap — the demand figure held, the enumerated supply ran out on the Friday and Saturday afternoons as predicted. It left xxl 10-10 unspent: correct, nothing needed it. It said U21–U30 land "by ≈ 10-10": nine of ten did (U25 open).

Rulings, 2026-10-10 (AED figures were read tonight for T13, T29, entry 29 and ANS-9; the numeric readings are in the gitignored docs/private/t13-t29-ans9-adjudication-2026-10-10.md; only verdicts and relative levels appear here).

  • T13 / T24 — ANS-7's f₀ is AGREE, with its h-statement. On exact rectangles at degree 2 the Cu f₀ sits 0.11 % from AED First Order at ×1 and 0.03 % at h = 0.005 (0.3 linewidths), the h-move toward it; the ×1 → 0.01 (step 6) and 0.01 → 0.005 (T12′) moves are equal to 3 %, first order in h, so the extrapolated gap is ≈ 0.01 %. Entry 28's rule fires on its AGREE branch (the gap closes with h; it was not a cancellation). R_in and Q are not an agreement: both fall 1.2 % on the rung, away from AED (gaps −1.6 → −2.7 % and −1.9 → −3.1 %) — the Leontovich loss is not h-converged at 0.005 and Q stays a stated level inside the 5 % the copper contribution is quoted at. ANS-7 holds 🟡 on the Q clause; ✅ when T30 / F31 write Q's h-statement. The daily edits the row (flag 2) and §2.1 gains "f₀ within 0.03 % of AED First Order at h = 0.005, converging first order in h; Q −3.1 %, unconverged".
  • T29 — the tuned-capacitor h-statement, written as a record. C_in moves +0.083 % at h = 0.01 (T28) and, inferred from T12′'s +0.0809 % f₀ move at fixed C, ≈ +0.16 % at h = 0.005; first-order extrapolation puts C_in(h → 0) ≈ 0.25 % above the ×1 value. One measured rung and one inferred — labelled so on the row; no third C_in rung is bought (T12′'s node JSONs are at fixed C and cannot be re-tuned without new solves).
  • T25 (PORT-24 step 1, item 308) — the "bitwise" clause is re-stated, not loosened. np.linalg.eig(A + rI) has no bitwise contract with eig(A); the identity is Im λ(r) = Im λ(0) in exact arithmetic. The Done-when's "Im λ_k and C_mode bitwise unchanged" becomes "within 1e-12 relative" (the Re clause's own band); the planted-control and Re clauses stand. T25′ lands the parked branch with that one edit, the 2.889e-15 reading asserted under it and the PREDICTED RED line removed ⇒ PORT-24 ✅ (step 2 is green).

No gate is touched either way; C16 (entry 49) runs as queued. The 3 T C_mode(k = 1) = 43.9719 pF is entry 49's grid centre.

Status 0, 1 452 s, 48.49 GiB, every gate green ((P50) 1.414e-12, NEG 162.3×, (Z50) 1.36e-13, (P_RC) ≤ 5.5e-13 at all four nodes); Im Y_in(P33, (1, +1j)) −, −, −, + over 193.00 / 193.25 / 193.50 / 193.75 pF, one crossing, 193.599624 pF — the log is held by the private-leak guard on an input-echo line (logs/leak-held/, the operator's to land; the ledger row cites it). ⇒ C_in(F-clinical-1.5T, d1) = 193.5996 pF at 0.25 pF resolution is the record; entry 46's two-point 193.5178 pF sat 0.042 % low because Im Y_in is convex across [192.5, 194.0] (segment slopes 5.76e-3 → 9.90e-3 S/pF, review arithmetic from the node JSONs) — the bracketing pair's interpolation is the reading, never a multi-point linear fit, on every root grid from now on. Status 0, 6 315 s, 472.42 GiB memory.peak; (A0) rel 0, census 64, (Deg) 7 885 674 = 2E + 2F exact, (P50) 1.946e-12, NEG 153.4×, (P_RC) 5.329e-14 (20261031T070008Z_GEO-38-C5a.log:12142–12148, :12363–12364, :12584); (Z50) is printed only at degree 2 (the entry's Readout mis-listed it, as entry 39's once did — corrected on the entry). Entries 53 (C5b, three nodes 184.5 / 185.75 / 187 pF, xl 11-04) and 54 (C5d, the degree-2 64×64, xxl 11-07) are kept as the daily wrote them — 53 is the root grid's first bracket and the degree-2 slope, 54 answers reciprocity / passivity at the production order, C_mode(d2) beside the root, and the class-spread order move that known-issues 2026-10-27 now waits on. Not a loosening: no band, no gate value, the same statement in a form the file's presence cannot fail.

Each landed against a record or an imported band with no band set or moved; the ones that re-posed a BLOCKED item changed the daily's own gate detail, never a target (the rulings in MAT-21.md 2026-10-27 18:00 / 10-28 10:30, IMP-7.md, GEO-38.md 10-28 18:00 / 10-30 18:00, WF-16.md 10-28 03:00 — all ratified). I45's (IC) / (Slope) as truncation convergence — ratified, no new bar (the N^−1.5 fall is the record); its root ladder corrected — with Neumann at a the n-th root → nπ/(b − a) for every l, the 10-26 brief's (n + l/2)π/(b − a) was wrong for this family. P48b in the 1D-reduced box — ratified (the reduction is exact; audit PASS). I36b's (K2) — ratified (a missing node knob raises before gmsh). U90b's F-human block solved, not loaded — ratified (item 685 lifted the four-port limit afterwards). I46's S2_BAND = MAT-21 step 1's 1e-4 — ratified. Item 697's two clauses (_parse_tune admits f_clinical_birdcage; the refusal's condition gains "and no load_result") — ratified: "move nothing" meant do not relocate the refusal, and the refusal now fires on exactly the files it must (rc 2 asserted, W0-r2). R1′ read 3.101935e-02 under the owner rule against 3.111508e-02 without it (cd7d2222, band 2.5 %): the owner rule moves the padding estimator by 0.3 %, so the 3.1 % is the estimator's own bias (PORT-1's disposition (ii), as the entry says), and the padding route has had no consumer since the lumped-sheet route landed. The entry is re-headed OBSERVATION with the strict xfail as its record and retires when the padding module is deleted or a consumer reappears (epitaph below). attempt/PORT-1-R1-20261025T171120Z may be deleted by the daily.

docs.text:
Live chains and lanes — open steps numbered, each with its validation target and serial prerequisites (§9 rules (4), (5), (6)). Landed and removed since 10-26: I44–I48b, I36b–I36d, C15, C6a′ / C6a″ / C6a‴, C5c, P47a–P50a, U94, U90b, U95, U96, U99–U105, R1′, OPS-72; entries 47, 50, 51 read (archive, 10-26 block, with every slot outcome). Every step names its successor; every chain is enumerated at least eight deep so a lost review or a lost weekly leaves the dailies something to queue.

Chain T — ANS-7 ✅ (T41); what remains is the external reading of Q.

  • T48 (operator, dashboard W7). As written 10-17: the existing ans:7 AED project's adaptive-pass history of f₀, R_in and Q at 64 MHz, read privately; public verdict toward / away. No new AED design.
  • T46 (heavy, -n 8; serial on T48 reading "flat or away"). As written 10-14 — the Leontovich loss density by sheet and by strip-edge band on the ×1 and h = 0.01 meshes at the ESR-tuned node; Σ = P_surf at DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL, the edge-band fraction's h-move printed.

Chain H — Phase 6 exited; no open slot step; W2 is the operator's.

  • W2 (operator): ANS-8 step 2 at the root is READY since H29; adjudicated when the column lands. H12d — a record from H25; not posed. H6, H11 — as before (archive, 09-26 block).

Chain I — Phase 7. I32a → entry 55 and I49 → I50 are serial pairs; the rest are independent.

  • I36 = entry 48 (xl Monday 11-02, -n 8, QUEUED; node 193.5996 pF ratified above). Its rule: every assertion green ⇒ I36 lands as a record (the tip 1 g Q and η_rod(T1) at degree 1 beside IMP-3's 3.48–3.56, the rod's power share, Im Y_in at the node), I32 is posed at its price.
  • I32a (chain step, no solve, smoke, -n 2; serial on nothing; next: entry 55). The clinical implant-heating body, composed and stub-run (items 701 / 702's pattern), in tests/validation/test_geo36_rod_f_clinical_heating.py (knob FEM_EM_GEO36_S8_HEAT = 1, the node knob as I36b's): arm M's field from _run_drive's route, its σ|E|²/ρ on the gel (tags 3; the rod is a PEC hole, no source; tag 403 is the rod, excluded) as the DG0 source of MAT-15's thermal route on the same mesh — Robin h = MAT-21's on the six box faces, CN to t* with step 1's Δt rule. Gates (imported, unmoved): the scheme's discrete energy identity ≤ E_BAND; the calorimetric initial slope dT/dt|₀ = SAR/c at MAT-15's band on the tip 1 g ball and on the gel; (S0) census; the EM gates of I36b unchanged. Printed: θ at the tip 1 g ball centre and at six box probe points (P37's) at t*, the tip θ ratio arm M / arm R beside I41's F-small record (1.10), per-phase time. Anchor for the slot: on a small create_box with _drive stubbed to a constant-curl field, the source equals σ|E|²/ρ pointwise ≤ DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL, the energy identity ≤ E_BAND, the slope identity exact on a uniform source, a perturbed source named (control). Build-only not needed (the mesh is entry 45's). Landing ⇒ entry 55 READY once entry 48 is green.
  • I32 = entry 55 (xl Friday 11-06, -n 8; PENDING on entry 48 green and I32a; priced in xl-pending.md from entry 48's window plus entry 42's thermal phase scaled by cells — the clerk copies the figures). The first clinical-scale implant-heating figure, degree 1, a record: no tissue, no published comparand until (7c).
  • I48c (chain step, heavy, real, -n 4; serial on nothing; next: I49). IMP-7 step 9 — the FEM-vs-series dose gap on I47's CN history at LADDER[1] and at half Δt on LADDER[0], the four gaps printed in one table with I48b's; (T) at INTERIOR_BAND on each run; no dose band, no rate claimed — the record that separates h from Δt.
  • I49 (lane 3 → chain step, smoke, numpy; serial on nothing; next: I50). IMP-7 step 10 — P39′'s (Bd) sensitivity bound on the hollow-sphere duty series: the dose at the pole and at r = (a + b)/2 under D = 1, 0.5, 0.25 (period 0.5 t*), the six-minute window's headroom per duty, the bound asserted on every cell of the matrix at DOSE_BAR / AVG_BAR; the R swap and the β = 0 source miss. 🟡 record, I50's comparand.
  • I50 (chain step, heavy, real, -n 4; serial on I49; next: an imp: example). IMP-7 step 11 — I48b's FEM dose under D = 0.25 on LADDER[0] against I49: (T) ≤ INTERIOR_BAND at 4 t*, (E) ≤ E_BAND, (S0) census, the dose gap printed beside I48b's D = 0.5 gap; the continuous series misses.
  • I51 (chain step, heavy, real, -n 4; serial on nothing) (daily, 2026-11-01 — provisional). IMP-7 step 12 — the fourth corner of I48c's table: LADDER[1] at half Δt, (T) ≤ INTERIOR_BAND, (E), (S0), (Grid); the gap printed beside item 700's and I48c's two runs, no dose band and no rate. Brief: IMP-7.md "§9 item 725".
  • I52 (chain step, standard, real, -n 4; serial on nothing) (daily, 2026-11-01 — provisional). IMP-7 step 13 — the FEM at D = 1 on LADDER[0], the third point of I50's M_p-against-cap trend: (T), (E), (Q-hd), (Win-hd); M_p, its time and the headroom printed. Tests I50's reading that the cap, not the error, moves. Brief: IMP-7.md "§9 item 726".
  • I53 (lane 3 → chain step, standard, numpy; serial on nothing) (daily, 2026-11-01 — provisional). IMP-7 step 14 — the comparand's own floor: the duty series at 200, 400, 800 modes, (Q-hd), (Win-hd), (Self) at B1_BAND; the change at the pole printed beside item 725's gap. Brief: IMP-7.md "§9 item 741". Re-posed 2026-11-02 03:00 (attempt 2 of 4, no new cap count): the control at n = 8; item 752.
  • I54 (chain step, heavy, real, -n 4; serial on nothing) (daily, 2026-11-01 — provisional). IMP-7 step 15 — LADDER[0] at DT / 4, (T), (E), (S0), (Grid); the three-row Δt table, no band and no rate. Brief: IMP-7.md "§9 item 745".

Chain C — F-clinical, the production fixture for new human-scale work. It outranks chain U for a slot. C17 and C20 are slot steps; the rest are windows or serial on one.

  • C16 = entry 49 (xl Sunday 11-01, -n 16, QUEUED) — the 3 T degree-1 root on the eight-node grid around 43.9719 pF; its rule as written (one crossing ⇒ C_in(F-clinical-3T, d1) exists; none ⇒ one re-centre from the measured slopes).

  • C5d = entry 54 (xxl Saturday 11-07, -n 16, QUEUED, kept) — the degree-2 64×64; its rule as written, plus the known-issues 2026-10-27 reading above.
  • C17 (lane 1 / chain step, no solve, smoke, -n 2; serial on nothing; next: C20). The stale build asserts, as ruled above: (S) "(size, mtime_ns) or absence identical before and after" in both matrix modules' build branches in place of not exists(); C11's module refuses FEM_EM_GEO38_C3_DEGREE set; coding tests on a tmp save path present and absent; C11's and C4a's bodies otherwise byte-identical. The ASTM box inside F-clinical-3T: GEO-36 step 8's generator at the 3 T geometry (C11's radius / rung length / shield, 128 MHz, the provisional gel), the rod placed as I33 placed it; identities (D-rod) G1 / G2 / G4 / G7, census 64, U₁ printed and registered, the box strictly inside the bore asserted; build-only, ≤ 450 s gmsh rule as I35's. Its window is priced from entry 45 by the weekly.
  • C18 (lane 1, standard -n 1, no solve; serial on entry 54 green; next: C5e). C10's reader on c3-cu-s64-d2.npz: C_mode(k = 1) at degree 2 printed beside C10's 195.0265 pF and the degree-2 root (53 / 56); reciprocity / σ_max re-read at the imported bands; C13's anatomy at degree 2 beside degree 1 — the known-issues 2026-10-27 reading (the ≥ 2× clause above), printed and ruled by the weekly; JSON written.

A 3 T degree-2 save path and knob on C11's module (FEM_EM_GEO38_C11_DEGREE, c11-cu-s64-d2-128mhz.npz), (Deg) U₂(3 T) = 2E + 2F exact at build, C3's module untouched.

Chain P — Phase 8, gel first. P51 → P52 and P53 → P54 are serial pairs; P50b is independent.

MAT-21 step 23 — MAT-20's dose and six-minute window on P49b's walled-box CN history (item 688's run inside the module, the 1D-reduced geometry) at the gel centre, near the wall and at the interface, against P50a: (T) interior ≤ INTERIOR_BAND at 4 t*, (E) ≤ E_BAND, the FEM-vs-series dose gap printed at each point; the massless-wall series misses. The walled-box dose's FEM half.

MAT-21 step 24 — the pre-equilibration bias as a function of the wait: θ(t; t_w) = θ_drift(t + t_w) + θ_sourced(t) in closed form (P47a + step 0's series), the bias at P37's six probe points at t* relative to the sourced rise for t_w ∈ {0, 0.5, 1, 2} / λ₁, the slowest-mode decay asserted (bias ratio ∝ e^{−λ₁ t_w} at B1_BAND for t_w ≥ 1/λ₁), the superposition exact; the Dirichlet-z control misses. 🟡 record — what F2182's equilibrium clause buys, in numbers.

Brief: MAT-21.md "§9 item 727".

(Rate) [1.95, 2.05] is ratified: the N-point midpoint sum of point sources is a second-order quadrature of a smooth integrand, and 2.0047 is its slope. The Done-when's "each with a control that fires" is narrowed to the gates that have content at finite t: Φ₂ at finite t has no gate in the closed form alone, and (Sym) is near-tautological — its first gate is the FEM (I56 below), which is the FEM half the daily left to this session.   • EX-175 ✅ ratified; EX-177 ratified, and the refresh is a standing lane-1 supply from tonight. docrefs' stale rule is a 336 h mtime limit on every referenced artifact (OPS-42, 2026-09-09), so every example goes stale a fortnight after its last run whether or not anything moved: 146 stale lines across 79 examples tonight (20261103T030233Z_WEEKLY-DOCREFS.log:186), eleven more crossing the limit by 11-03 21:35Z. Rule: while the census reads stale > 0 the daily keeps one refresh batch in the queue (≈ 6 examples, the oldest first, ≤ 480 s each, mri: / ports: / mesh: / ans: before the rest — the groups round one never touched), under EX-177's Done-when (no script, guide, gate or band edited; a red or a kill filed, nothing fixed in passing). (iii) A guide edited after its closing window: prose and derived numbers are admitted only when every digit is in the closing log or is arithmetic on digits that are, and the sentence says so ("by arithmetic from the log"); a phrase with no log behind it is removed or marked "a reading, not measured". docs.title: ANS-1 — Loop over a lossy slab at 10 MHz: runnable half of the first AED benchmark
docs.text: Loop over a lossy slab at 10 MHz: runnable half of the first AED benchmark | ✅ (example path restored 2026-08-31 by EX-37 and re-run green, 63 s; the 08-09 record stands. AED half replicated 2026-09-01 by the operator — Maxwell 3D 2026.1.0 AC Magnetic, low-order pair, adaptive to well under the 0.5% energy-error target. The numbers are held privately and are never committed (operator directive 2026-09-02: Ansys licence terms restrict disclosure of benchmark results) — they live in the gitignored aed_results/ + COMPARISON_private.md, which the example writes from the results JSON so the private table survives regeneration (20260902T…_ANS-1-private.log). Methodology finding, public: Maxwell 3D AC Magnetic does not support higher-order shape functions with a winding excitation and falls back silently, so the ANS-5 order-sensitivity column does not exist for eddy-current cases — run the low-order pair only (ANS-3 take note). Adjudicated 2026-09-02 weekly review — AGREE. Both FEM codes bracket the Dodd–Deeds ΔR closed form on opposite sides, each inside MAT-6's band; on ΔX both sit below the infinite-half-space value by the amount MAT-6 step 9's box-truncation reading predicts for the SPEC's cube, so the truncation reading is confirmed by an independent solver and ΔX stays reported-never-gated. No disagreement to diagnose; no absolute-accuracy claim outside the eddy-current regime follows. Consequences: MAT-6 step 8's slab-refined fixture may be promoted (MAT-6 step 11, below); the filament-vs-finite-wire term is the closed form's unquantified floor for any sub-0.5% claim (MAT-8); ANS-3/ANS-4 run the low-order pair only. Numeric ruling in the gitignored docs/private/ans1-adjudication-2026-09-01.md) Record rule (2026-09-10 03:00 review, on OPS-44's recurrence hypothesis): any ans: case that commits its own metrics.json adds that path to COMMITTED_EXAMPLE_ARTIFACTS in tests/unit/test_doc_reference_exit_codes.py in the same commit, with a dated provenance line — the pin stays a pinned path set (18:00 ruling (3)), and the declaration belongs to the chunk that widens the exemption, not to whichever later slot trips over the red (it has gone stale silently twice: EX-29 → OPS-44).

docs.text:

Pure functions, added beside the existing ones. No src/ edit, no SPEC edit, no edit to C6's, I36b's, C18's or WF-10's module. 1. read_c19(c_pf="185.7629", c6_dir=None, i36_dir=None). Anything else raises ValueError naming the file and the key. 2. degree2_cells(c19). Returns {row label: cell string} for the degree-2 column, with every cell "" when c19["c6"] is None. The mapping, from the C6 JSON keys :742–755: - S₁₁, S₁₂ = S₂₁, S₂₂ ← s2; - Y_in ccw P33 / P41 ← y_in["ccw"]; - the 18-point lattice mean and its value per √P_acc ← the mean of lattice[*]["b_plus_ccw"], and p_acc; - c* ← star_label; SAR10g(c*) and its value per P_acc ← sar_star, p_acc; the cw ball ← sar_star_cw; - the box-wide 10 g maximum ← grid["star_label"] / grid["sar_star"] when "grid" is present; - the 400-centroid mean and its value per √P_acc ← mean_b_plus["ccw"]; - P_box / P_src / P_acc; gel fraction P_box / P_acc; - sense ← mean_b_plus["ccw"] / mean_b_minus["ccw"]. One correction of route, not of target (binding ruling, §9 digest: "every new step's reader of a pending window parses its tracked log, not the host JSON … the host JSON, where present, is only a custody check"). The weekly wrote "from entry 62's JSONs" before that ruling. The JSONs are gitignored (/workspace/logs/geo38/c6-node-185.7629-d2.json, /workspace/logs/geo36/i36-node-185.7629-d2.json), so a COMPARISON.md rendered from them cannot regenerate on a clone. Facts verified for this brief (10:30 review, by grep on the tracked log). - Every _SINGLETONS line of the page prints exactly once in entry 62's log, all in call 1 (call 1 ends at [C19] call 1 … rc1=0, :12703; call 2's lines carry other tags): (Z) node 185.7629 pF :12160; kinds … S2 :12379; Y_in ccw :12383; Y_in cw :12384; mean |B1+|_ccw :12387; c* :12406; normalisers :12410; wrote …c6-node-185.7629-d2.json :12411; price :12412. So parse_c6_log(C19_LOG) reads entry 62 unedited — its own duplicate check is the "exactly one distinct match" rule (10:30 11-12 ruling). - The box-wide grid's result is one line, :12407: [GEO-38 C6a] (C6b) grid n 90 (72 new balls, 18 lattice values reused); g* x+157.5mm y+0.0mm dz+0.0mm (0.157500, 0.000000, 0.000000) m: SAR10g <F> W/kg (ccw), (1,+1j) ball <F> W/kg; beside c* …. Its label form (x… y… dz…, one decimal) is not _LABEL's; it needs its own regex. :12162 is the grid's census line (n 90 of 91 candidates kept …). - The (Z) node line ends … failures none (ASSERTED); _SINGLETONS["node"] uses re.search, so the suffix does not matter. - Entry 62 is green on every asserted gate (log-pathologist reading, ledger row 2026-11-14): Status 0, rc1=0 :12703, rc2=0 :25454, 16 / 16 rank summaries per call, FAILED / ERROR 0. The log prints no degree-1 comparand, so every move is computed by this step from entry 52's tracked log (the page's SOURCE_LOG), never read from entry 62. Code: the ans:11 page script and tests/unit/test_ans11_record_page.py; the page window regenerates ans:11's metrics.json and COMPARISON.md. C19_LOG_BASENAME = "20261114T080009Z_GEO-38-C19.log", C19_LOG beside SOURCE_LOG (read through _read_log, so a gzipped copy still reads). 2. parse_c19_grid(path) — one new regex for :12407's form; returns {"line", "n", "label", "x_m", "y_m", "z_m", "sar10g", "sar10g_cw"} as printed strings; raises ValueError on zero or more than one match. 3. degree2_block(path=C19_LOG) — p2 = parse_c6_log(path), d2 = derived(p2), g = parse_c19_grid(path); asserts p2["node"]["c_pf"] == C19_NODE_PF; returns {"source_log": C19_LOG_BASENAME, "parsed": p2, "derived": <the same derived-key dictbuild_metricswrites, from d2>, "grid": g, "moves": …, "order_rule": …}. - moves: for each row with a degree-1 and a degree-2 number — S₁₁ / S₂₂ magnitude, |Y_in| ccw P33 / P41, the lattice mean and its per-√P_acc value, SAR10g(c*) and per P_acc, the cw ball, the centroid mean and its per-√P_acc value, P_box / P_src / P_acc, the gel fraction, the sense — f"{x2 / x1 - 1:+.3e}" (≤ 4 significant digits; a ratio, never an AED figure). - order_rule: the 10-24 exit's rule applied to the per-watt rows (lattice mean per √P_acc, SAR10g(c*) per P_acc, centroid mean per √P_acc, gel fraction P_box / P_acc): the list of rows whose |move| > 2 %, and the sentence "clinical figures quoted at degree 2 only" if that list is non-empty, else "the 2 % order rule does not fire". docs.title: ANS-2 — Coil-driven SAR in the loaded four-leg birdcage at 10 MHz: pointwise SAR, whole-phantom power, mass-averaged SAR
docs.text: Coil-driven SAR in the loaded four-leg birdcage at 10 MHz: pointwise SAR, whole-phantom power, mass-averaged SAR — the first benchmark that can attack the absolute SAR claim (every coil-driven SAR number we hold is a C4 symmetry identity, and a SAR wrong by a constant factor passes one exactly). Commissioned 2026-09-09 02:15 weekly review on §10's reserved trigger ("subgoal 4", fired by MAT-4 steps 4 and 5b); authoritative spec examples/ansys_benchmarks/ans2_birdcage_coil_driven_sar_10MHz/SPEC.md. Geometry, materials, ports and boundary condition are byte-for-byte ANS-4's — one AED session replicates it. Three scoping judgements are the weekly's, in the spec: the shape-free rows (pointwise SAR, whole-phantom power) adjudicate; the mass-averaged rows carry a pre-registered sphere-vs-cube systematic (ours averages over a sphere of equal mass, IEC 62704-1 and hence HFSS over a cube) so a rows-4–6 miss cannot read as a false disagreement; normalisation is carried explicitly, never matched (ours 5.0e-03 W incident, HFSS's default 1 W — the one error mode that passes every self-check on both sides). Step 1 — the runnable half at SPEC rows 1–3, 7 and 8, scoped and queued by the 2026-09-09 03:00 daily review (§9 item 4): example script + same-stem guide through ./run_examples.sh, combined-XDMF, metrics.json, and a COMPARISON.md regenerated by the script with the AED columns blank (ANS-1's rule — a benchmark cannot drift from the gate), asserting only bands and records imported from MAT-4's gate modules (the 1 g and 10 g C4 pairs at the unmoved 5% C4_COVARIANCE_BAND, the whole-phantom coverage identity, the rung's 199 920 / 58 866 cell records at 1%), with the mis-paired 1 g control at 87.01–87.06% as the asserted negative control (≈ 17× separation, 20260908T200629Z_MAT-4-step5b.log:1990–1993). Step 2 — SPEC rows 4–6 (mass-averaged and peak-over-phantom), held until rows 1–3 have adjudicated, per the spec. Step 3 — the operator's AED replication; the case reaches the dashboard's Waiting-on-you when step 1 closes and not before (sending a spec whose runnable half does not exist wastes an AED session). Numbers private, verdict public, as every other case. Step 1 EXECUTED GREEN 2026-09-09 09:00 slot (20260909T140558Z_ANS-2-step1.log, Status: 0 :1929, Elapsed (s): 233 :1930, -n 4, heavy by ceiling): examples/ansys_benchmarks/ans2_birdcage_coil_driven_sar_10MHz/02_birdcage_coil_driven_sar_10MHz.py + same-stem guide, emitted by ./scripts/run_examples.sh -e ans:2 -n 4 -t 560 --dry-run and run through the harness; metrics.json, COMPARISON.md (AED columns verbatim blank) and combined XDMF regenerated by the script. Readings — row 1 pointwise SAR 4×4 at :1902–1905 (diagonal 5.878191741e-07 / 5.079232898e-07 / 5.287007744e-07 / 5.763100136e-07 W/kg); rows 2–3 whole-phantom power 5.503204729e-08 … 5.496862019e-08 W and average SAR 2.435069030e-07 … 2.432262495e-07 W/kg at :1907–1910; row 7 excitation at :1911–1915 — incident 5.0000000e-03 W printed explicitly against HFSS's 1 W, carried never matched, accepted Re P ≈ 2.1052e-03 W, |Im P|/Re P ≈ 0.337 printed and never gated; row 8 metadata at :1916 (199 920 cells / 58 866 tag-3, four drives 18.15 + 17.59 + 17.06 + 17.41 s). Anchors at :1918–1923, every band and record imported from MAT-4's gate modules and none restated or moved: the four 10 g C4 pairs 0.0309 / 0.0060 / 0.0394 / 0.0644% and the four 1 g pairs 0.0957 / 0.1199 / 0.1305 / 0.1065% — reproducing MAT-4 step 5b (20260908T200629Z_MAT-4-step5b.log:1990–1993) to the digit — asserted ≤ the unmoved 5% C4_COVARIANCE_BAND; the coverage identity power 7.771561e-14 / mass 5.284662e-14 asserted ≤ 1e-10; the two mesh records 199 920 / 58 866 at ratio 1.000000 asserted inside 1% CELL_COUNT_BAND; negative control, the mis-paired 1 g reading 87.0143 / 87.0546 / 87.0506 / 87.0592%, asserted ≥ 10× the band (≈ 17× measured). No imported gate went red, so the negative-result clause did not fire. Docrefs census dead=0 guide=0 stale=87 exit=2 (20260909T141114Z_ANS-2-step1-census.log:126), the informational stale-only code — stale=87 is OPS-42's business. One executor judgement, disclosed: the control is asserted as a floor (10 × the imported band, i.e. ≥ 50%) rather than against step 5b's measured 87.0x%, because an example must not re-record a gate digit (ANS-1's rule); the measured value is printed, in metrics.json and in COMPARISON.md with its provenance. Nothing absolute is licensed: §2's absolute-SAR clause does not move, the row stays 🟡 pending step 2 (SPEC rows 4–6) and step 3 (the operator's AED replication), and the case now qualifies for the dashboard's Waiting-on-you. | 🟡 (spec written 2026-09-09; step 1 runnable half executed green 2026-09-09; steps 2–3 open)
