docs.title: ANS-4 — Gapped four-leg birdcage, phantom-loaded, four lumped ports: 4×4 S-matrix at 10 / 64 / 128 MHz
docs.text:
Gapped four-leg birdcage, phantom-loaded, four lumped ports: 4×4 S-matrix at 10 / 64 / 128 MHz — runnable half (commissioned 2026-08-30 02:15 weekly review; authoritative spec examples/ansys_benchmarks/ans4_birdcage_four_port_10_64_128MHz/SPEC.md; the first independent absolute check of the coil-fed port model at a Larmor frequency) | ✅ runnable half 2026-08-30 (20260830T213415Z_ANS-4-run1.log, Status 0, 125 s at -n 2) — all three gates on all three rungs of one 116 085-cell mesh (ratio 1.000000, reused_mesh); 10 MHz reproduces leg (d)'s 4×4 to 1.158e-10 (band 1e-6) and leg (d0)'s column to 2.568e-10 (band 1e-9); 64 / 128 MHz reproduce PORT-11 steps 2/3 to worst 1.075e-03 / 6.755e-04 (band 1e-2); control separation 1.585460 vs 2e-3. AED half replicated 2026-09-04 by the operator — HFSS 2026 R1 Driven Modal via PyAEDT (untracked aed/ script), lumped ports on the gap sheets, one adaptive setup per frequency, both ANS-5 orders. Qualitative record (numbers private, aed_results/ + COMPARISON_private.md + docs/private/ans4-operator-notes-2026-09-04.md): (a) Zero Order stopped at its pass cap above the 0.002 ΔS target on all three frequencies — a lumped-port re-triangulation plateau, not divergence — while First Order converged in a few passes on a far smaller mesh; (b) HFSS's matrix sizes confirm the 6 / 20 unknowns-per-tet correspondence (ANS-5's open question, closed — README updated); (c) the Z₁₁ rows are different definitions — AED's Z(P1,P1) is the open-circuit Z-matrix entry, ours the terminated-drive quantity — so the review compares Z_in derived from S instead; (d) HFSS warned that the port touches no conductor because 800 S/m is below its conductor threshold (contact verified in the GUI; expected, and one more reason for ANS-6). Private-mode run 20260905T041254Z_ANS-4-private.log, Status 0, 128 s at -n 2, tracked table blank, private table filled. Adjudicated 2026-09-06 (weekly review, run interactively; numeric ruling in gitignored docs/private/ans4-adjudication-2026-09-06.md): AGREE at 10 MHz — couplings, self term and the S-derived terminated-drive Z_in all agree to the few-percent level AED's own converged order pair brackets, so the 4-leg port model is not wrong by a constant factor; INCONCLUSIVE at 64 / 128 MHz — a miss that grows with frequency and is several times larger than AED's Zero-vs-First-Order shift, so element order is excluded as the cause; our fixed, unconverged 116 085-cell mesh is the first suspect (the sign is consistent with AED resolving more conductor loss in the 800 S/m legs), a Larmor feed-model systematic the second; no disagreement banked, no promotion at Larmor (known-issues entry 2026-09-06). Step 2 — the discriminator, xl (commissioned 2026-09-06 weekly, the first XL slot, §5.1): on _four_port_rung at 128 MHz only, one harness window against fem-em-solver-xl at -n 16: degree-1 rungs at conductor_resolution ×1 (the record), ×0.75, ×0.6, ×0.45 (cells ≈ 116 k / 162 k / 210 k / ≈ 330 k by PORT-14 step 1b's measured 116 085 / 161 695 / 209 604), plus one degree-2 solve on the ×1 mesh (priced by TH-12 step 2 at 61.94 GiB on a 138 k-cell fixture — inside 512 GiB; nothing else in the window exceeds 15 GiB). Public readout, pre-registered: the three C4 class entries S₁₁/S₂₁/S₃₁ at 128 MHz on every rung, printed with their relative move from the ×1 record, the C4 spread and σ_max on every rung asserted at the imported PORT-11 bands (unmoved), and a Richardson h→0 estimate of the three classes from the three finest degree-1 rungs printed. Private readout (the ruling, docs/private/): the h→0 estimate and the degree-2 value against the AED First Order column. Decision rule, written before the run: closes ≥ 50 % of the private gap → discretisation, the Larmor verdict becomes AGREE-pending-convergence and the F-small production mesh is re-priced (a GEO chunk); < 25 % → feed model, a birdcage-sheet Larmor systematics chunk opens (PORT-1's ladder pattern); between → one more rung in the next XL slot. Cost estimate from priced rungs: PORT-13 step 1 measured 27.96 s/solve on 270 k cells at -n 8, so four degree-1 rungs ≈ 4 × (mesh ≤ 112 s + 4 drives × ≤ 30 s) ≈ 15 min; the degree-2 solve is the unknown and is why this is an XL item — stop rule 7 200 s with timeout -k 60. Done-when: the window footered Status 0, the ledger row filled, all pre-registered prints present, no band moved, the public §7 cell carries the relative moves and the verdict word only. Step 2 SPLIT 2026-09-09 (02:15 weekly review, §5.1 step 3b) — the readout and the decision rule above are unchanged and are not restated or loosened by the split. Priced from our own smaller rungs, the four degree-1 rungs are not XL work (≈ 21 GiB at ×0.45 by TH-12's own p = 1.271 floor exponent; four drives ≈ 36 s at ×1 scaling superlinearly to ≈ 230 s at ×0.45) and become step 2a — two ordinary heavy windows at -n 4, headless, implementer-runnable, queued as §9 item 1 by the 03:00 daily review; only the single degree-2 solve on the ×1 mesh is genuinely XL on memory before time (≳ 49 GiB, ≈ 1 100–1 300 s for four drives) and becomes step 2b, this week's XL slot, held for an operator-interactive session because a 1 100 s window cannot fit a 660 s foreground slot (§9 item 6). 2b must pre-register TH-12 step 2's degree-2 complex-power identity red as expected, COIL-SPECIFIC and common-mode — the band is not to be loosened. The measurement module landed on main 2026-09-09 at d6cd0fb (tests/validation/test_ans4_resolution_ladder.py, plus additive conductor_resolution / degree keywords on _build and _four_port_rung), written by an interactive session and committed unexecuted by the 03:00 daily review's step-2 tree disposition — no harness log exists for it and nothing it contains has closed anything. Known trap for 2a, named by that review: the module builds the degree-2 solve unconditionally whenever the ×1 factor is in the ladder, and FEM_EM_ANS4_STEP2_RUNGS does not suppress it — 2a's first edit is a second additive knob, FEM_EM_ANS4_STEP2_DEGREE2. Honest caveat the weekly recorded: splitting lands the Richardson estimate before the degree-2 control, so if 2a alone closes ≥ 50% of the private gap the Larmor verdict is decidable without 2b and the 2026-09-13 weekly may re-commission the slot. Step 2a EXECUTED 2026-09-09, 04:30 implementer slot — NEGATIVE RESULT, the ladder does not exist as specified. Standing-rule-(c) re-run first and green: 20260909T093128Z_ANS-4-step2a.log, -n 2, complex build, tests/environment + tests/mesh/test_birdcage_leg_offset.py + tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_leg_offset_sweep.py, 22 passed in 202.74 s, Status: 0, elapsed 205 s — d6cd0fb's additive conductor_resolution / degree keywords are behaviour-preserving at their defaults by measurement, not only by inspection. The one edit landed: FEM_EM_ANS4_STEP2_DEGREE2 (default on, 0 for the degree-1 windows), test module only. Collect-only smoke 20260909T093524Z_ANS-4-step2a.log, 4 tests, Status: 0, 3 s. Window 1 (FEM_EM_ANS4_STEP2_RUNGS="1.0 0.75", -n 4, timeout -k 30 560): 20260909T093534Z_ANS-4-step2a.log, 1 failed / 14 passed in 130.88 s, Status: 1, elapsed 132 s. Anchor (i) green — ×1 meshed 116 085 cells, ratio 1.000000 inside 2e-2. The refinement negative control green — ×0.75 meshed 161 695 cells, +39.3%, reproducing PORT-14 step 1b to the digit, so the keyword refines. (ii) green on both rungs: reciprocity 9.194053e-16 / 2.271834e-15 against 1e-3. (iii) green on both: σ_max 0.998974779044 / 0.998823907170. (iv) FAILS on ×0.75: Z class spreads move from 0.1012 / 0.0916 / 0.0654% at ×1 to 0.5390 / 0.4591 / 1.6886%, against the imported, unmoved ADJACENT_SPREAD_BAND = 0.5% — refining conductor_resolution breaks the fixture's C4 symmetry, which is the GEO-26 step 2 class of defect (a non-C_N-covariant refinement), not a broken solve (reciprocity and passivity are untouched at 1e-15 / 0.9988). Per the item's own negative-result clause the slot stopped: the second window ("0.6 0.45") was not run, nothing was fixed in-slot, no band moved. Printed readout for the record (asserted nowhere), 128 MHz: ×1 S₁₁ = +4.753451182e-01 +5.808054918e-01j, S₂₁ = +2.276311790e-01 −2.671367065e-01j, S₃₁ = +5.270667676e-02 −2.216416825e-01j; ×0.75 S₁₁ = +4.794845596e-01 +5.733351073e-01j (move from ×1 1.1379%), S₂₁ = +2.257202657e-01 −2.647272728e-01j (0.8762%), S₃₁ = +5.318210974e-02 −2.178860589e-01j (1.6616%); S-class spreads at ×0.75 0.4433 / 0.0549 / 2.0731%. Richardson not attempted (needs three rungs finer than ×1; one exists). Costs measured: mesh 21.6 / 29.9 s, four drives 18.5 / 28.6 s at -n 4. Consequence: ANS-4's Larmor verdict stays INCONCLUSIVE and is not decidable from a one-point ladder; the single ×0.75 move of 0.9–1.7% is a reading, not a convergence estimate. Known-issues entry 2026-09-09; the discriminator the next review must commission is per-leg congruence (cell counts / gap-sheet areas per leg at ×1 and ×0.75, no solve) before any further rung is priced, and 2b's degree-2 control now rides on a fixture whose C4 symmetry is only demonstrated at ×1. Step 2b EXECUTED 2026-09-09 by an operator-interactive session — the degree-2 solve landed, and it should not have been an XL item. Why: what the sheets are today. - The SPEC (examples/ansys_benchmarks/ans4_birdcage_four_port_10_64_128MHz/SPEC.md:85–96) defines each port as a planar rectangle: the interior half (f = 0.5) of the 0.014 × 0.008 box mid-plane, width 0.007 centred on the leg axis, height 0.008. P1 is x ∈ [0.0665, 0.0735], z ∈ [−0.004, 0.004] in y = 0, and the other three are its C4 images. Its area is 5.6e-5 m². - _four_port_rung (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_leg_offset_sweep.py:199) meshes the whole sheet F_i as one CAD face, then keeps the facets whose midpoints lie within f·w/2 of the centre (_narrowed_radial, :323–333). Every ANS-4 record (LEG_D_S_MATRIX_10MHZ, PORT11_S_64MHZ_RECORD, metrics.json) sits on that ragged set, as does every AED comparison read so far. - The exact option already exists on this builder. birdcage_port_domain(leg_sheet_strip_fraction=0.5) (item 148) is forwarded by _build (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_leg_offset.py:112,143–144) and by _four_port_rung(leg_sheet_strip_fraction=…) (item 159, :209,282–283). - So far it has been solved only at 64 MHz (items 159 / 166). When it is unset every test skips (the PORT-22 / OPS-61 precedent). Any other value raises ValueError. - Fixture. docs.title: §9 item 212 — 2026-10-04 (chain F18a)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-04 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §10 chain F18a as the 2026-10-03 weekly wrote it (PROJECT_PLAN §10, "Chain F"). The target, the bands and the T6 clause (i″) reading are the weekly's and are not restated or moved here. The sheets-and-κ ruling (§9, 2026-10-02) binds: exact CAD rectangles, κ off on every gated rung, κ printed only as a diagnostic.

ANS-4 step 6a: two mesh knobs on the exact-strip module, the unset path digit-identical to item 192, then the conductor-halved ×1 rung at degree 2, one frequency first as the price. - Executor: implementer. Tests only (tests/validation/test_ans4_exact_strip_records.py); no src/, no helper edit. - Tier: heavy. W0 at -n 2, W0b at -n 4, W1–W3 at -n 8 (fallback -n 12, below). Complex build. - Class: chain step (solve). Time: ≈ 18 measured / ≈ 50 predicted min (≈ 15 code + ≈ 24 of windows + ≈ 10 fixed). - Depends on: nothing.

The contract with xl entry 27. docs/testing/xl-pending.md entry 27 (F18b) is PENDING PREREQUISITE on exactly two names: FEM_EM_ANS4_EXACT_RESOLUTION and FEM_EM_ANS4_EXACT_CONDUCTOR_FACTOR. Spell them exactly so. Entry 27 runs all three frequencies with neither the frequency selector below nor the conductor factor set, so neither may change the all-frequencies path. - The implementer that lands this item green marks entry 27 READY in the same commit. Change only its **Status:** line: "READY (date, §9 item 212): knobs present, unset digit-identical (W0 log), resolution knob reaches the mesh (W0b log, cells)". Do not write, issue, edit or queue its command, and do not touch its price or readout. The review issues the command. - If any window is red, entry 27 stays PENDING PREREQUISITE, untouched. The review decides whether a ×0.5 red bears on an h-rung.

Why one frequency first. The heavy tier is 1200 s, but a slot's foreground Bash call is capped at 660 s, so each container timeout is ≤ 590 s. All three frequencies plus the degree-2 κ diagnostic do not fit one such window on this mesh. The arithmetic below uses measured prices only: - Mesh: ≈ 56 s for the ×0.5 conductor grading (20261002T070008Z_ANS-4-step4b.log:2288, :4522, 55.3 / 56.2 s on the congruent cut; step 4 W2 measured 50.7 s). The exact cut differs only at the port boxes (×1: 23.90 s exact against 24.0 s congruent). - Four degree-2 drives per frequency: 103.5 s at -n 16 on 259 543 cells / 1 658 680 dofs (…step4b.log:4523, :4843). Rank scaling on the ×1 degree-2 rung: 48.9 / 51.8 s at -n 16 (20260927T070008Z_ANS-4-step3h.log:4802, 20260930T070008Z_ANS-4-step3j.log:4803) against 70.70 / 64.14 / 73.26 s at -n 8 (20261003T094036Z_ANS-4-item192-W3-p2.log:2031, :2080, :2129). That is a ratio of ≈ 1.38, so ≈ 143 s per frequency at -n 8 (bracket 120–190 s) and ≈ 120 s at -n 12. - Fixed overhead: ≈ 122 s (item 192 W3: 426.4 s of pytest against 303.9 s of mesh + sweeps). - The degree-2 κ diagnostic runs at 128 MHz only, ≈ one more sweep (71.88 s at ×1, …item192-W3-p2.log:2178). - So: three frequencies + κ ≈ 56 + 4 × 143 + 122 ≈ 750 s at -n 8, and ≈ 660 s at -n 12. Neither fits 590 s, so the item runs one window per frequency. Per window at -n 8: 10 or 64 MHz ≈ 56 + 143 + 122 ≈ 320 s (bracket 280–420 s); 128 MHz with κ ≈ 465 s (bracket 400–560 s). - Memory: memory.peak 39.78 GiB at -n 16 (summed ru_maxrss 41.74 GiB, …step4b.log:4862). Predicted 35–45 GiB at -n 8, inside the ordinary service's 128 G. Not xl.

Code (tests only; every addition additive; unset ⇒ the identical calls in the identical order): 1. FEM_EM_ANS4_EXACT_RESOLUTION (m, float > 0). When set, the base rung passes resolution=<value>. Unset passes nothing (_build's RESOLUTION 0.015 default, tests/mesh/test_birdcage_leg_offset.py:160). 2. FEM_EM_ANS4_EXACT_CONDUCTOR_FACTOR (float in (0, 1]). When set, the base rung passes conductor_resolution = factor × CONDUCTOR_RESOLUTION. That is the ladder module's convention (test_ans4_resolution_ladder.py:466–468; import CONDUCTOR_RESOLUTION from tests.mesh.test_birdcage_leg_offset, 1.6e-3 m, printed as h_c in the mesher line). Unset passes nothing. - No C4 guard is possible here. The strip route refuses c4_congruent_sheets (src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py:4253–4256), so the rung runs on the cut-off mesh with exact CAD sheets. That is a measured risk (trap 1), not a reason to add a flag. 3. FEM_EM_ANS4_EXACT_MHZ (a space- or comma-separated subset of 10 64 128; precedent FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_MHZ). This is the frequency selector "one frequency first" needs. Unset ⇒ all three, so entry 27's command is unaffected. Any other token raises ValueError on every rank before any mesh. - Fixture restructure. The base rung is the first selected key, built with leg_sheet_strip_fraction=GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION and the knobs. Every other selected key reuses it (reuse=_reuse_of(base)). - The κ keys become the intersection of today's set with the selection: degree 1 {10, 128}, degree 2 {128}. - readings are built only for keys present. With the selector unset the call sequence is exactly item 192's (10 built, then 64, then 128, then κ). 4. Tests under knobs. "Knobbed" means either mesh knob is set; the selector alone is not a knob. - (F): unset, the 117 206 record within CELL_COUNT_BAND, as now. Knobbed: assert cells > ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_CELL_RECORD × 1.02 instead (step 4's _conductor_factor_unrefined pattern), and print cells against the predicted bracket. Every SPEC-rectangle identity (area, w = A/h, radial span, h, centre, F/dxdz) stays asserted at STRIP_BAND / SHEET_AREA_BAND on every mesh: it is a CAD identity, not a mesh one. - (G): parametrized over the frequencies; skip a key that was not selected. - (R) and (X): skip when knobbed, as well as for an unselected key. - (N): skip without 64 MHz. 5. Printed comparand (no new gate). Add ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_S_P2_X1, item 192's degree-2 κ-off 4×4 at 10 / 64 / 128 MHz, restated at 10 digits from 20261003T094036Z_ANS-4-item192-W3-p2.log:2199–2216, with a version-tag comment ("complex 0.11 image, -n 8; printed comparand only, never asserted"). - Under knobs, print the class-mean move of each selected frequency against item 192's ×1 at the same degree (ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_S_P1_RECORDS at degree 1, the new constant at degree 2), with _class_means / _relative_move. This is the target's "class moves printed against item 192". - Under knobs, suppress p2_vs_p1, which would mix mesh and order. 6. Output and memory. - Unset, the JSON path is ans4_exact_p{d}.json, exactly as now. Knobbed or selected, it becomes ans4_exact_p{d}_r<res|x>_c<cf|x>_f<keys>.json, so item 192's files are never overwritten. - Echo one line before the fixture: [ANS-4 step6a] knobs: resolution …, conductor factor …, h_c …, frequencies …. - Call report_peak_rss(comm, label=…) after the base rung, on every rank (OPS-43 (c), as the ladder module does at :375–377).

Anchors (asserted; bands imported, never restated): - (G) PORT-11's gates (i), (ii), (iii′) on every selected frequency of the knobbed rung, exactly as test_g_port11_gates_on_the_exact_rectangles asserts them. This is the target's identity. - (F) The SPEC rectangle by CAD identity on the refined mesh, at STRIP_BAND. - The unset path (W0): (F) at 117 206 cells and (R) at STEP3A_RECORD_RTOL on all three frequencies at -n 2. Item 192 W2 reproduced at 6.6e-11 / 9.6e-11 / 9.4e-11 (20261003T093753Z_ANS-4-item192-W2-p1.log). Predicted ≤ 1e-10, printed beside it.

Negative controls (rule (e)): - (F′) The knob reaches the mesh: asserted (cells > 1.02 × 117 206). This is step 4's guard on the same knob. A misspelt or ignored variable reproduces 117 206 exactly, so the guard catches it. - Predicted, printed: W1–W3 [255 000, 270 000] (×0.5 congruent 259 543 plus the strip's ≈ +1 100); W0b [281 000, 287 000] (0.0075 global 281 728 / 281 731 plus the strip). - Class move against item 192's ×1 at degree 2: predicted, printed. Self 0.5–3.5 %, couplings 0.2–1.5 % at 10 MHz; 64 / 128 MHz unbracketed. The basis is entry 20 on the congruent cut, 10 MHz: |S₁₁| +1.92 / +0.47 / +0.61 %, a different cut and a magnitude statistic, so not a same-fixture backing. Never asserted. - Unset reproduction: asserted through (R), backed by item 192 W2 on the same fixture, same width.

Windows. Each harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, foreground, Bash timeout: 660000. Every window runs -s with tests/environment first. W1–W3 use §5.1's durable capture verbatim, trailing ; exit \$rc included. - W0: unset control (degree 1, -n 2, ≈ 143 s, item 192 W2's command relabelled). Licence. - §10 F33 (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4641–4644). - The weekly's rulings F27 (:4523–4531) and F26 / F19 (:4532–4540). - The §7 ANS-4 / ANS-6 row edits are the review's, not the slot's. The 2026-10-13 03:00 review has already written them (PROJECT_PLAN.md:3518, :3521). §2.1 was rewritten by the weekly. - The slot edits no §7 row and no §2 sentence. - No band, tolerance, Done-when or target is set or moved.

What. Each of ans:4 / ans:6's tracked COMPARISON.md gains one section, ## Verdict (public; adjudicated by the weekly review). - The section is written by the script's tracked writer: 04_birdcage_four_port_10_64_128MHz.py:255 and 06_copper_birdcage_four_port_10_64_128MHz.py:462, both _write_comparison. - The file is rendered from the committed metrics.json. This is render-only, as in item 400; neither case is re-run. - The scope paragraph's stale clause is re-pointed to the new section. The clause reads "adjudication is the next weekly review's, after the AED numbers land" (ans4…/COMPARISON.md:26–28) or "Adjudication is a future weekly review's" (ans6…/COMPARISON.md:22–23). - Nothing else changes: - no table; - not ans:4's ANS-5 Zero-Order paragraph (:15–20; the verdict states the pairing that was adjudicated instead); - no stage logic; - not metrics.json. - The private mode renders the same verdict text, but the slot never calls it.

Verdict content. It holds our figures and relative levels only. Every figure is already public in PROJECT_PLAN.md; cite its plan line in a code comment beside the string. - ans:4: - What was adjudicated. Our degree-2 four-port on the exact SPEC rectangles with κ off (tests/validation/test_ans4_exact_strip_records.py; operator ruling 2026-10-02), against AED First Order (order rule 2026-10-01). The degree-1 ragged-sheet tables in this file are records, not the adjudicated pairing. Say this in the first sentence. - At ×1 (117 206 cells): AGREE within 0.73 % on every class at 10 / 64 / 128 MHz (2026-10-03 weekly). - h-statement (F27, 2026-10-12 weekly): - rungs ×1 / h = 0.0075 / 0.005 (117 206 / 282 198 / 593 478 cells); - h-converged to ≤ 0.1 %, with the self-class change from 0.0075 to 0.005 at 0.014 / 0.057 / 0.066 % at 10 / 64 / 128 MHz; - within 1 % of AED First Order on every class on the h = 0.005 rung; - the 10 MHz self class is the worst (≈ 1 %) and is flat with h: a level, not a resolution effect. - Logs (ours): 20261003T094036Z_ANS-4-item192-W3-p2.log, 20261005T070009Z_ANS-4-step6b.log, 20261011T070008Z_ANS-4-step6c.log. - Not claimed: any AED value; f₀, Q or tuning (ANS-7); human scale; κ-on figures. - ans:6: - What was adjudicated. Our degree-2 exact rectangles on the hole route, Cu (Leontovich) and PEC (tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py), against AED First Order's Finite-Conductivity / PEC columns. - Levels: - AGREE within 0.33 % on every class at ×1 at 10 / 64 / 128 MHz; - within 0.21 % on the h = 0.0075 rung at 64 MHz (226 904 cells); - our Cu − PEC class gap on that rung is within 3.2 % of ×1 (20261012T070009Z_ANS-6-step5b.log:4595); - the copper loss partition AGREES within 0.4–4.2 % (2026-09-26 weekly). - Not claimed: the loss partition's h-sequence (F31, xl entry 34, a record); tuning or Q; any AED value. - Palace (OPS-61) may be cited as matched-order agreement with ours. Never set a Palace number against an AED one.

Executor and cost. - Executor: implementer. - Tier: standard (container timeout -k 30 180), no MPI (-n 1), complex build (the scripts import dolfinx). - Class: lane 1 (median 6). - Cost: ≈ 6 measured / ≈ 35 predicted min: 15 fixed + ≈ 12 for two writers and a test + ≈ 4 for windows + spare. The comparable is item 400, one writer, measured 3 / predicted 15. - Depends on nothing. - Shares 04_…py's writer and ans:4's COMPARISON.md with item 417. Whichever lands second re-runs the first's test module in its W1 (rule (c)). Each item's (R) asserts the whole file, so both stay true together.

Anchors (asserted). They go in a new tests/unit/test_ans4_ans6_verdict_sections.py, built on item 400's shape (tests/unit/test_ans7_comparison_writer.py). Everything runs on tmp copies. - (Pre4) / (Pre6): the premise that the committed file is the writer's output. The pinned pre-change writer, run on the committed metrics.json, reproduces the pre-edit COMPARISON.md byte for byte. - The ans:4 script changed on 09-28 (5d966d96), after its COMPARISON.md was written (09-27). So this premise is unverified until (Pre4) runs. - (R4) / (R6): byte-for-byte regeneration. The edited writer on the committed metrics.json reproduces the committed COMPARISON.md byte for byte. The verdict heading appears exactly once. - tests/unit/test_ans6_private_comparison.py:225–227 already asserts (R6) and re-runs in W1. - (Δ): the edit stays in scope. A line-level difflib between the pre-edit and the new committed files touches only the scope-paragraph lines and the verdict section. - (V): the verdict carries the levels. The ans:4 verdict contains the strings "0.73 %", "1 %", "0.1 %" and "0.014 / 0.057 / 0.066 %". The ans:6 verdict contains "0.33 %" and "0.21 %". Each appears inside the verdict section, exactly once there. - Docrefs dead = 0.

Negative controls (rule (e); asserted, by construction). - (N-digit): a tmp copy of each committed file with one verdict digit changed must differ from the render: - ans:4: "0.73 %" → "0.74 %"; - ans:6: "0.33 %" → "0.34 %". - (N-old): the pinned writers' renders have verdict-heading count 0 and differ from the committed files.

Windows. Foreground, bare, repo-relative, Bash timeout: 660000, -s. 1. Host pins, before any edit (plain git show, not harness calls): - the two scripts at 5d966d96 / 69fa0777. These are their last commits at drafting; the slot re-reads git log -1 --format=%h -- <script> and types the result as a literal. - Copy them to logs/f33_pin/<repo-relative path>, mirrored depth. - Copy both COMPARISON.md at the slot's starting HEAD to the same tree. 2. Edits. 3. W-regen. The gitignored helper logs/f33_regen_comparisons.py (Write tool) calls each script's _write_comparison(m) with private=False on its committed metrics.json: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-4-item416-regen "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1 PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 60 python3 logs/f33_regen_comparisons.py'" Then host git diff --stat must show both COMPARISON.md changed and no metrics.json changed. 4. W1: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-4-item416-W1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1 PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 180 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/unit/test_ans4_ans6_verdict_sections.py tests/unit/test_ans6_private_comparison.py -s -v --tb=short'" If item 417 has landed, add tests/unit/test_ans4_h_table.py to the path list. 5. Wdoc: gate dead = 0, exit ≠ 1 (20261012T170143Z_ANS-7-item400-docrefs.log:12, :130): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-4-item416-docrefs "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && timeout -k 30 60 python3 scripts/testing/check_example_doc_references.py'" 6. Commit: the two scripts, the test, both COMPARISON.md and the logs. The pre-commit leak hook must print clean:; SKIPPED is not a pass, so report it.

Traps already paid for. - Which tables the verdict covers. The tables in these files are degree 1: ragged at 116 085 cells (ans:4, 09-27) and degree 1 (ans:6, 09-20). The verdict concerns the degree-2 exact pairing. Never let the text imply the tables were adjudicated. - Never run ans:4 / ans:6. A run solves and rewrites metrics.json with a new generated_utc. Never hand-edit a generated COMPARISON.md; ans:4's is owned by nobody anyway. - The private side is never touched. _write_comparison(private=True) is never called. aed_results/ and COMPARISON_private.md are never opened. - 06_…py:470–471's docstring ("byte-identical to the pre-step-3 writer") becomes stale. Amend that sentence only. - Pinned controls: the pin sha is a literal, never HEAD: (OPS-43). Mirror the depth (item 400's IndexError: 3). - Palace: never set against AED. - Formatting: ≈, never a tilde. No -k, no pipe, never delete a log, no edit after W1 (rule (i)).

Scope. Two public verdict sections and two re-pointed clauses.

Not claimed: - the h-table (item 417); - any table re-run; - any AED value; - a §7, §2 or dashboard edit; - a known-issues change.

Negative result. Report and stop. Park on attempt/ANS-4-item416-* and mark item 416 BLOCKED in the same commit (rule (d)). - (Pre4) or (Pre6) red: the committed file is already out of step with its writer. Print the first differing line. Do not regenerate; the review rules whether a render-only refresh is licensed. - (Δ) red: a coding error. Fix in-slot, then re-run W-regen and W1. - test_ans6_private_comparison.py red after the edit: the tracked / private coupling broke. Fix the verdict code in-slot if it is the cause; otherwise park. - Leak-hook refusal: unstage and park. Report the location only.

No PREDICTED RED: line.

Status it can move. No glyph. ANS-4 ✅ and ANS-6 ✅ have their Done-whens met (PROJECT_PLAN.md:3518, :3521), so rule (j) does not bind. - §10 F33 → DONE (the review marks it). The rows' "Next: F33" pointer is the review's to retire. - Known-issues: none.

Spawn line: "Use the implementer agent to execute ANS-4 §9 item 416 per docs/planning/chunks/ANS-4.md (read the latest Review ruling paragraph first). The harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, repo-relative, nothing chained or piped. Run every window in the foreground with timeout: 660000, pytest with -s, container timeout -k 30. Never run ans:4 / ans:6, never hand-edit a COMPARISON.md, never call _write_comparison(private=True); no §7 or §2 edit (the review's); never open aed_results/, COMPARISON_private.md or docs/private/."

Outcome (2026-10-13, 06:00 slot, take-next, implementer): DONE. Both writers gained a module-level VERDICT_SECTION (plan lines cited in a comment) rendered after the re-pointed scope clause; 06_…py's stale docstring sentence amended; nothing else changed. A first precheck run (20261013T112320Z_ANS-4-item416-precheck.log, exit 1) failed loading the pinned 04_…py from logs/f33_pin/ (its parents[3] resolved there, FileNotFoundError on examples/ports/05_…py); the pinned source is now executed with __file__ set to the live path, and the re-run (…112334Z_…-precheck.log) read (Pre4) / (Pre6) byte-identical. W-regen (…112513Z_…-regen.log) rewrote both COMPARISON.md, no metrics.json changed. W1 (…112521Z_ANS-4-item416-W1.log, 82 s, 16 passed): (Pre4)/(Pre6) 11 373 / 9 292 B identical; (R4)/(R6) 12 650 / 10 169 B identical, heading count 1; (Δ) 2 removed / 25 and 19 added lines, no stray; (V) all levels once ("1 %" counted with no digit or dot before it, so "0.1 %" does not count); (N-digit) and (N-old) caught; test_ans6_private_comparison.py green. Wdoc (…112648Z_…-docrefs.log): dead = 0, exit 2 (stale = 90, report severity, as at item 400).

docs.title: §9 item 417 — 2026-10-13 (§10 chain F35; lane 1, no solve)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-13 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it.

Licence. - §10 F35 (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4653–4658). - The F27 ruling (:4523–4531). - xl entry 30: its decision rule (docs/testing/xl-pending.md:1609) and its READ status (:1601, which carries the weekly's four-digit figures). - No band, tolerance, Done-when or target is set or moved.

ANS-4 step 7: the public h-table. A new section of ans:4's COMPARISON.md holds our self / adjacent / opposite class means at ×1, h = 0.0075 and h = 0.005 for 10 / 64 / 128 MHz, with the successive changes and their ratios. - The tracked writer renders it from a committed numbers file extracted from the three logs' 10-digit S lines. - A unit test regenerates the section byte for byte and reproduces the weekly's public figures. - The table carries ours only. The AED relative level lives in item 416's verdict.

Inputs (tracked). The S lines are the 10-digit prints of test_ans4_exact_strip_records.py:508–514. - ×1 (117 206 cells, item 192, -n 8): docs/testing/logs/20261003T094036Z_ANS-4-item192-W3-p2.log.gz, already gzipped by rotation. Headers at :2199 / :2205 / :2211. The same matrix is committed as ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_S_P2_X1 (test_ans4_exact_strip_records.py:233, citing :2199–2216). - h = 0.0075 (xl entry 27, 10-05): docs/testing/logs/20261005T070009Z_ANS-4-step6b.log. Cells line :3701 (282 198); headers :3702 / :3708 / :3714. - h = 0.005 (xl entry 30, 10-11): docs/testing/logs/20261011T070008Z_ANS-4-step6c.log. Cells line :3814 (593 478); headers :3815 / :3821 / :3829. - Rung spacing: 0.015 : 0.0075 : 0.005 on the global resolution knob, per entry 30's rule (xl-pending.md:1609). The slot reads the ×1 value from the code; it is never assumed.

Code. - In 04_birdcage_four_port_10_64_128MHz.py, pure functions (no dolfinx call at render time): - parse_h_table_logs(paths) -> dict. It opens .log or .log.gz. It anchors on the header line [ANS-4 step5] <f> MHz kappa-off S (10 digits): and takes the next four lines that re.search S_(\d)k = with four complex tokens. It keeps each token string and its line number. - h_table_lines(numbers) -> list[str]. - _write_comparison appends the section. - Class means and moves come from _class_means and _relative_move (tests/validation/test_port21_feed_sensitivity.py:287, :304). The convention is the module's, as in its printed moves (test_ans4_exact_strip_records.py:491–494): |m_fine − m_coarse| / |m_coarse|. - Numbers file: examples/ansys_benchmarks/ans4_birdcage_four_port_10_64_128MHz/h_table_s.json, written json.dumps(indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n". Per rung it holds the log basename, cells and the cells line; per frequency, the header line and the four rows as the printed token strings. - Declare it in LISTED_EXAMPLE_ARTIFACTS (tests/unit/test_doc_reference_exit_codes.py:469–479), with a provenance comment, in the same commit (the ANS-7 / ANS-8 precedent, :453–458). Otherwise that pin goes red on main: OPS-42 / OPS-59 history, :438–452. - Section ## h-sequence of the adjudicated pairing (ours; degree 2, exact rectangles, κ off). For each frequency × class it holds: - the three class means (+.7e, the file's format); - Δ₁ = move(×1 → 0.0075) and Δ₂ = move(0.0075 → 0.005), in % to 4 dp; - the ratio Δ₂ / Δ₁ to 3 dp. - One line gives the predicted ratios computed from the rung h's: p = 2 gives (0.0075² − 0.005²) / (0.015² − 0.0075²) = 0.185; p = 1 gives 0.333. - One sentence states entry 30's first branch (max self Δ₂ ≤ 0.10 % ⇒ "h-converged to ≤ 0.1 % on three rungs"). - The three log basenames, and "no AED value".

Anchors (asserted). They go in a new tests/unit/test_ans4_h_table.py. - (X) Extraction. - parse_h_table_logs on the three tracked logs equals the committed h_table_s.json, string for string. - The ×1 rows equal ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_S_P2_X1 as complex values exactly. - The cells read 117 206 / 282 198 / 593 478, and ×1 equals ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_CELL_RECORD (tests/validation/test_ops61_exact_strip_ports.py). - (L) The convention, against the logs' own prints. The test parses the printed strings at those lines; it never retypes them. Tolerance is the printed digits: |x − printed| ≤ 5e-5 %-points. - Δ(×1 → 0.0075) reproduces …step6b.log:3726–3728: self 0.2527 / 0.2345 / 0.2204 %, adjacent 0.0447 / 0.0950 / 0.1590 %, opposite 0.1375 / 0.2098 / 0.2863 %. - Δ(×1 → 0.005) reproduces …step6c.log:3840–3842: 0.2519 / 0.2868 / 0.2866; 0.0377 / 0.1144 / 0.2058; 0.1528 / 0.2699 / 0.3970 %. - (W) The weekly's public figures (xl-pending.md:1601, PROJECT_PLAN.md:4525), typed as cited comparands, the only typed numbers: - Δ₂ self 0.0144 / 0.0569 / 0.0662 %, adjacent 0.0088 / 0.0235 / 0.0472 %, opposite 0.0161 / 0.0611 / 0.1110 % (≤ 5e-5 %-points); - ratios self 0.057 / 0.243 / 0.301 (≤ 5e-4); - the p = 2 prediction 0.185 (≤ 5e-4); - entry 30's branch: max self Δ₂ ≤ F27_SELF_CHANGE_CEILING = 1e-3, citing xl-pending.md:1609. This is the rule's own threshold, used to reproduce the weekly's reading, not a new band. Its _CEILING name lets item 433's validation page render it. - Drafter's hand check (unlogged): 10 MHz self Δ₂ = 0.01440 %; 64 MHz self Δ₂ = 3.4908e-4 / 0.61362 = 0.05689 %. - (R) Byte-for-byte regeneration. The tracked writer, given the committed metrics.json and the committed h_table_s.json, produces bytes equal to the committed COMPARISON.md. The section appears exactly once; item 416's verdict is part of the render if that item has landed. - (R0) The test leaves the committed files unchanged.

Negative controls (rule (e); asserted). - (N-digit-doc): a tmp copy of COMPARISON.md with one h-table digit changed ("0.0569" → "0.0579") differs from the render. - (N-digit-data): a tmp copy of h_table_s.json with one digit changed: the 64 MHz h = 0.005 S₁₁ real part, +7.347852893e-02 → +7.357852893e-02, which moves the self mean by 2.5e-5. - (X) misses, by string inequality. - (W)'s 64 MHz self Δ₂ leaves 0.0569 by more than 5e-5 %-points. The value is predicted at ≈ 0.0528 %, printed and not asserted; the assert is only "outside the tolerance".

Executor and cost. - Executor: implementer. - Tier: standard (container timeout -k 30 180), no MPI (-n 1), complex (the import of test_port21_feed_sensitivity pulls in dolfinx / mpi4py). - Class: lane 1 (median 6). - Cost: ≈ 6 measured / ≈ 45 predicted min: 15 fixed + ≈ 22 for the parser, section and test + ≈ 3 for windows + spare. Comparables: item 400 (render-only writer) and item 366 (record constants cited line by line). - Depends on nothing (§10: serial on nothing). It shares ans:4's writer with item 416; see item 416's note.

Windows. Foreground, bare, repo-relative, Bash timeout: 660000, -s. 1. Pin (host git show): the pre-change script, for the (N-old)-style check that the section is new: count 0 in the pinned writer's render. Use the same pin rules as item 416. 2. Code. 3. W-regen. The gitignored helper logs/f35_regen.py writes h_table_s.json from parse_h_table_logs, then COMPARISON.md from _write_comparison(m) with private=False: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-4-step7-regen "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1 PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 60 python3 logs/f35_regen.py'" metrics.json must stay untouched. 4. W1: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-4-step7-W1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1 PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 180 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/unit/test_ans4_h_table.py tests/unit/test_doc_reference_exit_codes.py -s -v --tb=short'" Add tests/unit/test_ans4_ans6_verdict_sections.py if item 416 has landed (rule (c)). 5. Wdoc: as item 416's, label ANS-4-step7-docrefs, dead = 0. 6. Commit: script, numbers file, both tests, COMPARISON.md and the logs. The leak hook must print clean:.

Traps already paid for. - Interleaved pytest output on the S lines: PASSED… and node-ID prefixes sit on step6b.log:3703, :3705, :3709 and step6c.log:3816, :3825, :3827. Use re.search, never a startswith. - A second, κ-on 128 MHz S block is printed earlier in step 6c (:3805–3808, different values). Anchor on the 10-digit header only. - Rotation gzips logs. The ×1 log is already .log.gz. Read either suffix, and cite the base name. - The reference is the coarser rung, the module's convention. Never re-define the move to make (W) pass. - Import only _-helpers and constants; never a test_* name. - The LISTED_EXAMPLE_ARTIFACTS declaration goes in the same commit. - Never run ans:4; never hand-edit COMPARISON.md (owned by nobody); never call the private writer. - No AED value or AED-relative figure in this section. - Formatting: ≈, never a tilde. No -k, no pipe, never delete a log, no edit after W1 (rule (i)).

Scope. Arithmetic on three printed rungs of one fixture: degree 2, exact rectangles, κ off.

Not claimed: - a Richardson extrapolate or an observed order: there are two changes only, and the ratios are printed beside the p = 1 / p = 2 predictions; - copper or the loss partition (F31); - f₀, Q or tuning; - any AED value.

Negative result. Report and stop. Park on attempt/ANS-4-step7-* and mark item 417 BLOCKED in the same commit (rule (d)). - (X) red: the parser or a log moved. Print the first mismatch. - (L) red with (X) green: the convention differs from the module's. Stop. Never retune the convention. - (W) red with (X) and (L) green: the weekly's public arithmetic does not reproduce from the logs. This is a finding for the review: BLOCKED "review re-reads F27's arithmetic". Never edit the comparands. §2.1's figure stands until the review rules. - (R) red: a writer or regeneration mismatch. Fix in-slot, then re-run W-regen and W1.

No PREDICTED RED: line.

Outcome (2026-10-13, 06:00 slot, implementer): DONE. parse_h_table_logs / h_table_values / h_table_lines added to 04_…py (pure); _write_comparison appends the section from the module-level H_TABLE_JSON (an h_table= override for tests), so item 416's render-only test needed no copy of it. Format departure: the class means print at 7 significant digits (+.6e), not +.7e — the first commit was refused by the private-leak hook (an 8-digit mean on the 128 MHz adjacent row prefix-collided with a reference figure; check_private_leak.py, MIN_SIGNIFICANT_DIGITS = 8); the first regen log, which printed the 8-digit means, is kept untracked in the gitignored logs/ans4_item417_quarantine/. W-regen (20261013T113443Z_ANS-4-step7-regen2.log) wrote h_table_s.json and COMPARISON.md, metrics.json unchanged. W1 (…113514Z_ANS-4-step7-W1b.log, 94 s, 35 passed; the 8-digit run …113120Z_ANS-4-step7-W1.log read the same): (X) string-equal, ×1 = ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_S_P2_X1 exactly, cells 117 206 / 282 198 / 593 478; (L) the 18 printed moves within 4.5e-5 %-points; (W) self Δ₂ 0.014396 / 0.056889 / 0.066233 %, adjacent 0.008810 / 0.023530 / 0.047183 %, opposite 0.016138 / 0.061127 / 0.111023 %, self ratios 0.05698 / 0.24262 / 0.30056, p = 2 0.185185, max self Δ₂ 6.62e-4 ≤ 1e-3; (R) 14 870 B identical; (N-digit-doc), (N-digit-data, 64 MHz self Δ₂ → 0.052846 %), (N-old, pinned c7b1b682 render) caught. Cross-item note: item 416's (Δ4) counts any line outside its verdict section as stray, so the appended h-section would have turned it red; per ruling (2) its (Δ) now cuts the committed text at the h-section heading (asserted present once) before classifying — nothing else exempted; (Pre4)/(R4)/(V4) unchanged and green. Baseline before the edit: …112859Z_ANS-4-step7-W0.log (2 passed). Wdoc (…113653Z_ANS-4-step7-docrefs2.log; first …113301Z_…-docrefs.log): dead = 0, exit 2 (stale = 90, report severity).

Status it can move. No glyph. ANS-4 is ✅ and its Done-when is met, so rule (j) does not bind. - §10 F35 → DONE (the review marks it). The review retires the §7 row's "Next: … F35" pointer. - No §2 or known-issues change, unless (W) is red.

Spawn line: "Use the implementer agent to execute ANS-4 §9 item 417 per docs/planning/chunks/ANS-4.md (read the latest Review ruling paragraph first). The harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, repo-relative, nothing chained or piped. Run every window in the foreground with timeout: 660000, pytest with -s, container timeout -k 30. Never run ans:4, never hand-edit COMPARISON.md, never edit a (W) comparand to make it pass; declare h_table_s.json in LISTED_EXAMPLE_ARTIFACTS in the same commit; never open aed_results/, COMPARISON_private.md or docs/private/."

docs.title: Review ruling 2026-10-13 03:00 (daily) on the item 416 / 417 drafts
docs.text: Both queued as drafted. docs.title: §9 item 193 — 2026-10-03 (chain F, F16 — daily provisional, rule (6))
docs.text:
Outcome (2026-10-03, 04:30 CDT slot): complete. src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py: as_hole removed from leg_sheet_strip_fraction's refused set (rule (c), disclosed; error text and docstring updated, no other line). W1 (-n 1, 99 s): the strip hole mesh builds, 80 798 cells (predicted [80 600, 81 800], met; ratio 1.007695), (M1)–(M6) green, cavity CAD 40 surfaces, area equal flag on/off within EXACT; (N1) flag-off N_i miss +4.202e-2 on every port (predicted ≈ +4e-2) (20261003T095457Z_ANS-6-item193-W1-mesh.log:1740–1765). W2 (-n 2, 201 s, 31 passed / 3 (R) skipped): 111 946 unknowns, ladder 103.9 s; identity residual 1.597e-12 / 8.018e-13 / 9.354e-13; P_coil/P_in 0.9287082 / 0.4478617 / 0.2182683 (−0.014 / −0.113 / −0.186 % vs ragged, predicted ±2 %, met); PEC-limit max|dS| 2.4–4.3e-6 (≤ 1e-4, met); (c) 10 MHz bracket against ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_S_P1_RECORDS["10"] green (copper self 2.405e-4 vs exact solid-800 9.976e-2); (N2) 64 MHz Cu move vs the tracked ragged metrics.json 1.651 / 0.930 / 0.829 % (self inside the predicted 0.5–2 %, couplings smaller, as predicted); 10 / 128 MHz moves printed 3.165 / 1.055 / 1.051 % and 0.683 / 0.686 / 0.492 % (20261003T095650Z_ANS-6-item193-W2-solve.log:3089–3120). Printed miss: κ pooled 1.61e-7 at 10 MHz sits below its predicted [5e-6, 5e-5] (64 / 128 MHz 6.58e-6 / 2.64e-5, inside) — a diagnostic, never gated. W3 closing window with both records registered (M7, (R) asserted): 34 passed, 210 s (20261003T100029Z_ANS-6-item193-W3-solve.log:3189). Heavy tier; ≈ 13 min of compute. Rule (j) proposed Done-when sentence for the review: "Step 4 is done when the hole-route exact rectangle passes (M1)–(M7) and the TH-14 gates at 10 / 64 / 128 MHz with κ off, class means registered."

Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-03 03:00 daily review; the review reviewed it. Licence: rule (6), toward chain F's F10a / F10b target and the operator directive 2026-10-03 (a). The sheets-and-κ ruling (§9, 2026-10-02, items (i)–(iii)) applies. No band, tolerance, Done-when or validation target moves.

ANS-6 step 4: exact SPEC port rectangles on the hole / copper route, then the copper four-port re-recorded at 10 / 64 / 128 MHz. - Executor: implementer. One src/ validator line (rule (c), disclosed), two additive helper keywords (rule (a)) and a new module. - Tier: heavy. W0, W2 and W3 at -n 2; W1 at -n 1. Complex build. - Class: chain step (solve). - Time: ≈ 14 measured / ≈ 40 predicted min. - Depends on: nothing. Item 195 (T17) and item 196 (T18) depend on this one.

Why: what the sheets are today. - The fixture. ANS-6 and ANS-7 share it. It is TH-14's hole mesh: tests/mesh/test_birdcage_port_sheets._build(True, as_hole=True), 80 181 cells, built inside tests/validation/test_th14_birdcage_copper._build_ladder (:263–303). Its ports come from _build_ports (:185–226), which does the same thing ANS-4 does: one whole F_i face, narrowed by _narrowed_radial at GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION. That gives a ragged sub-sheet triangulated out of the box. The SPEC sheet is the same 0.007 × 0.008 rectangle (examples/ansys_benchmarks/ans6_copper_birdcage_four_port_10_64_128MHz/SPEC.md:76). - The blocker. The exact option exists only on the solid builder. birdcage_port_domain refuses leg_sheet_strip_fraction together with as_hole (src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py:3948–3953; docstring :3716–3723), and the hole builder _build has no such keyword. - Why the refusal can go. It is conservative, not structural: - the strip block (:4553–4568) only fragments the sheet before placement and appends every piece to sheet_tags; - under as_hole, sheet_tags enter the cut-air fragment as dim-2 tools exactly like the whole sheet (:4783–4786); - the half-box labelling (:4882–4901) and the cavity read (a face that bounds one meshed volume, :4925–4953) do not depend on how many faces a sheet has.

The refusal's own message gives the one-surface-per-sheet need as its reason. That need belongs to c4_congruent_sheets (item 148's brief: it binds one sheet surface per port) and to symmetry_quadrant, and both of those stay refused.

Code. 1. src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py (rule (c), disclosed): - In the validator at :3948, remove as_hole from the refused set. Keep c4_congruent_sheets and symmetry_quadrant. - Update the error text and the docstring sentence at :3721–3722. - No other line changes. With leg_sheet_strip_fraction=None, no new line executes. - Pre-check: run git log --oneline 341fe583..HEAD -- src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py. If anything since then touches lines 3936–3953 or 4537–4573, stop and report. 2. tests/mesh/test_birdcage_port_sheets._build: add the keyword leg_sheet_strip_fraction=None, forwarded only when it is not None (the precedent at tests/mesh/test_birdcage_leg_offset.py:143–144). Add a docstring paragraph. 3. tests/validation/test_th14_birdcage_copper._build_ladder: add the keyword leg_sheet_strip_fraction=None, forwarded to _sheets_build only when it is not None. Add a docstring paragraph. - _build_ports is unchanged. Its κ default is None, and the midpoint filter selects exactly the centre rectangle once the strip edges are CAD edges (item 148, A2). 4. New tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py, @complex_only, opt-in through FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6 ∈ {mesh, solve}. When it is unset every test skips; any other value raises. - Not FEM_EM_ANS6_*. ans:7's main() refuses every such variable (07_…py:849–851). - Mesh fixture (both modes). Build the strip hole mesh (leg_sheet_strip_fraction=GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION) and the default hole mesh. Measure them with _sheet_areas, _narrowed_radial, _projected_extents and _tag_volume, the way test_ops61_exact_strip_ports._rung does (:79–143), and also read diag["conductor_cavity_cad"]. - Solve fixture (solve only). lad = th14._build_ladder(leg_sheet_strip_fraction=GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION, measure_kappa=True). Every other argument stays at its default: degree 1, the full σ ladder, the PEC column, the P1 field solve, and 10 / 64 / 128 MHz through TH14_STEP2_FREQS_MHZ unset. κ is therefore off on every sweep, and measure_kappa only reads the terminal-form deficit from the P1 field already being solved. - Rank 0 writes logs/ans6_exact/ans6_exact_p1.json (gitignored): the S matrices per column per frequency, κ, the power records and the census. - Two record constants, registered in turn, each with a version-tag comment and the (1*) note as in item 192: - ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_HOLE_CELL_RECORD, from W1; - ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_CLASS_MEANS_P1, from W2: {"10" | "64" | "128": {"cu" | "pec": {"self" | "adjacent" | "opposite": complex}}} at 10 digits.

Anchors (asserted; bands imported, never restated).

Mesh, at W1 and again inside W2 and W3: - (M1) Every F_i equals dx·dz within SHEET_AREA_BAND. - (M2) For P1–P4, each of the following matches within STRIP_BAND. This is the SPEC rectangle. - N_i area against 5.6e-5; - w = A/h against 7.0e-3; - radial span against 7.0e-3; - h against 8.0e-3; - centre radius against RING_RADIUS. - (M3) F_i ∖ N_i = 5.6e-5 within STRIP_BAND, and N_i ⊂ F_i. - (M4) The box halves partition the box within EXACT (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_conductor_hole.py:117). - (M5) The cavity CAD area with the flag on equals the area with the flag off within EXACT. The strip must not touch the coil wall. - (M6) Flag-off hole cells equal the n_cells 80 181 in ans:7's tracked metrics.json within CELL_COUNT_BAND. This shows the default path is unchanged. - (M7) Flag-on cells equal ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_HOLE_CELL_RECORD within CELL_COUNT_BAND. Skipped while the record is None.

Solve, per frequency, as TH-14 asserts them: - (G) For the Cu and PEC columns: reciprocity ≤ RECIPROCITY_BAND, σ_max ≤ 1 + PASSIVITY_SIGMA_TOLERANCE, and Z-class spreads ≤ ADJACENT_SPREAD_BAND. - (b) The copper identity residual ≤ DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL. - (σ) The σ-ladder per-class max|S_σ − S_PEC| is strictly decreasing. - (c) The 10 MHz bracket. If item 192 has landed, assert it against ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_S_P1_RECORDS["10"]: the σ = 800 S/m solid on the same exact rectangles, and the only like-for-like S_800. Otherwise print it against the ragged LEG_D_S_MATRIX_10MHZ, labelled "port-width confounded, not asserted". - (R) At -n 2 only, skipped while the record is None: every class mean matches ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_CLASS_MEANS_P1 within STEP3A_RECORD_RTOL.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (N1) Mesh — predicted, printed. The flag-off hole N_i misses 5.6e-5 by more than NEGATIVE_CONTROL_FLOOR, predicted ≈ +4e-2. The hole route's ragged N_i area has never been logged as such; the solid route read +4.202e-2. - (N2) Solve — floor asserted, size predicted (item 159 (K)'s pattern). The 64 MHz Cu class means on the strip mesh move from the tracked ragged ans:6 metrics.json rungs["64 MHz"]["cu"]["s_matrix"] by more than KNOB_REACHES_THE_SOLVE in every class. - A no-op keyword reproduces those leaves to ≈ 1e-14 (1.395e-14, 20260921T095749Z_ANS-6-step2-control-check.log:34). - The size is predicted at 0.5–2 % on the self class, with the couplings moving less. On the solid sibling the move was 1.539 / 0.858 / 0.713 %.

Predictions (printed): - Strip hole cells in [80 600, 81 800]. The solid route gained 1 121 cells, ratio 1.009657. - κ pooled in [5e-6, 5e-5] at each frequency. The ragged value was 1.06e-2. - Copper identity residual ≲ 1e-11. - P_coil/P_in within ±2 % of the ragged 0.9288392 / 0.4483664 / 0.2186740. - The PEC-limit control (σ = 5.8e11) still ≤ PREDICTED_PEC_LIMIT_MAX_ABS_DS. - The exact-vs-ragged class moves are printed for both columns at all three frequencies.

Windows (bare, whole, foreground, Bash timeout: 660000, -s, tests/environment first). - W0 (the rule (a)/(c) re-gate on the default path, after the code edits; ≈ 200–300 s). - Reference timings: TH-14 83 s (20260923T094319Z_ANS-6-step2b-ruleA-TH-14.log:1378), the exact-strip module 57 s (20261001T220051Z_OPS-61-F10a-W2.log), and the conductor-hole module (two builds, ≈ 60 s, predicted). - It must reproduce TH-14's pass set and OPS-61 1b's 8 passed.

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-6-item193-W0-regate "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_th14_birdcage_copper.py tests/mesh/test_birdcage_conductor_hole.py tests/validation/test_ops61_exact_strip_ports.py -v -s --tb=short'" - W1 (the first strip hole build; mesh only; -n 1; ≈ 60–90 s, two hole builds of ≈ 20 s each):

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-6-item193-W1-mesh "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6=mesh timeout -k 30 300 mpiexec -n 1 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py -v -s --tb=short'"

Then register ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_HOLE_CELL_RECORD. - W2 (solve, -n 2, ≈ 160–240 s). ans:6's runnable half ran the same ladder in 167 s at -n 2 (20260920T124620Z_ANS-6.log), plus one extra hole build here. Command: W1's, with FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6=solve, timeout -k 30 590 and mpiexec -n 2, labelled ANS-6-item193-W2-solve. Then register ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_CLASS_MEANS_P1. - W3: W2 relabelled ANS-6-item193-W3-solve. This is the closing window (rule (i)), and (R) and (M7) are asserted.

Traps. - The as_hole + strip combination has never been built. Build it at -n 1 first: a gmsh failure deadlocks wider runs (item 148's trap). A meshing failure is a GEO-21-class finding: record it verbatim, revert, BLOCKED. - Keep pec_column and field_solve at their defaults. pec_column=False together with field_solve=True raises a rank-0-only KeyError (ANS-7 item 157's trap). - Never pass a float κ, and never "in_run". _build_ports casts float(…) (:192–193). - Set no FEM_EM_ANS6_* variable. Never run ans:6 or ans:7, and leave their metrics.json / COMPARISON.md untouched. No aed_results/, COMPARISON_private.md or docs/private/. - Areas, facet counts and cell_tags.values are rank-local: reduce before asserting. - No edit after W3. A module edit after any window re-runs W3 (rule (i)). - On Status 124: run pgrep -c python3, then the cache sweep; report. Never lengthen the timeout.

Scope. Covered: the hole-route exact rectangle (opt-in, default digit-identical) and ANS-6's degree-1 copper / PEC four-port re-recorded at three frequencies. Not covered: - degree 2. The h = 0.015 price is 183.9 s per frequency at -n 8 for three factorisations (20260921T100022Z_ANS-6-step2-degree2-64MHz.log:942), so three frequencies are a next step for the weekly; - the adjudication and the self-class offset re-read against the private columns (the weekly's); - Palace's copper column (OPS-61 step 2); - any κ correction or band; - the examples' tracked artefacts.
