Negative result. - W0 red: the default path moved. Revert src/ and both helpers, then stop, BLOCKED. - W1 build fails: park on attempt/*, with a known-issues entry naming the gmsh message, BLOCKED. Items 195 and 196 stay blocked. - (M2) red with (M1) green: the strip edges did not reach the hole mesh. Report spans and facets, park. - (M5) or (M6) red: stop, BLOCKED. - (G), (b) or (σ) red on the strip mesh: the ragged gates are green, so open a known-issues entry ("exact-rectangle hole mesh fails <gate>") and park. Never widen. - (c) red against item 192's record: report the per-class numbers, then stop. - No PREDICTED RED: line. Any red stops the slot.

docs.title: §9 item 216 — 2026-10-04 (chain F19)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-04 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §10 chain F19 as the 2026-10-03 weekly wrote it ("the exact hole route at degree 2, Cu and PEC, 10 / 64 / 128 MHz, κ off: TH-14's gates and the copper identity at the imported bands, class means registered under (1*)"). The target, the bands and the private row (a) reading are the weekly's and are not restated or moved here. The sheets-and-κ ruling (§9, 2026-10-02) binds: exact CAD rectangles, κ off on every sweep, κ printed only.

ANS-6 step 5: item 193's exact-rectangle hole route at degree 2, both columns, three frequencies, one window per frequency. - Executor: implementer. Tests only (tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py). No src/ change and no helper edit: th14._build_ladder already takes degree and reads its frequency selector. - Tier: heavy. W0 at -n 2; W1–W4 at -n 8 (fallback -n 12, below). Complex build. - Class: chain step (solve). Time: ≈ 18 measured / ≈ 55 predicted min (≈ 12 code + ≈ 27 of windows + ≈ 5 registration + ≈ 10 fixed). - Depends on: nothing. Item 193's module, records and hole route are on main.

Price, and why one window per frequency. All figures are measured on this mesh (80 798 cells, exact rectangles, degree 2, -n 8). Item 196 W2 measured them (20261003T124111Z_ANS-7-item196-W2-p2.log:2025, :2030, :2955, :2960): - PEC sweep 53.1 / 56.0 s; - σ = 5.8e7 sweep 49.9 / 41.6 s; - P1 copper field solve 40.4 / 39.9 s.

Item 196 swept Cu only. TH-14's σ-monotone gate needs the full ladder (5.8e7, 5.8e9, 5.8e11), so per frequency the cost is PEC ≈ 55 + three sweeps × ≈ 46 + P1 ≈ 40 ≈ 233 s. - Fixed cost. Solve mode builds three hole meshes (meshes on and off, plus _build_ladder's own). With environment and JIT, item 193 W2 measured 201 s at -n 2 against a 103.9 s ladder, so ≈ 100 s fixed. Add ≈ 20 s of degree-2 JIT. - Three frequencies in one window ≈ 3 × 233 + 120 ≈ 820 s at -n 8, and ≈ 690 s at -n 12 (≈ 0.8× on the solves). Neither fits the ≤ 590 s container timeout that a 660 s foreground call allows. The 1200 s heavy ceiling is not the binding limit; the slot's tool cap is. So the item runs one window per frequency: ≈ 233 + 120 ≈ 355 s at -n 8 (bracket 300–480 s). - Memory. Summed ru_maxrss was 13.78 GiB at degree 2, -n 8, on the 80 181-cell ragged hole mesh with three factorisations (20260921T100022Z_ANS-6-step2-degree2-64MHz.log:942). Predicted 14–20 GiB, far inside 128 G. Not xl. The xl rows ANS-6-step2c / 2d (h = 0.005 / 0.0075, 523 816 cells, 267 GiB) are a different mesh and price nothing here. - Unknowns. Predicted [505 000, 530 000] (6.39–6.40 × cells on ANS-4's two degree-2 meshes). Printed by lad["unknowns"], never asserted.

Code (tests only; additive; with FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6_DEGREE and TH14_STEP2_FREQS_MHZ unset, ladder makes the identical call): 1. FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6_DEGREE ∈ {1, 2}, read in the solve fixture. Unset passes no degree (_build_ladder's default 1). Any other value raises ValueError on every rank before any mesh. - Not FEM_EM_ANS6_*. ans:7's main() refuses that prefix (item 193's trap), and the ans:6 script owns FEM_EM_ANS6_DEGREE. - Parse it only inside the fixture or a helper, never at import. tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py imports ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_HOLE_CELL_RECORD from this module, so an import-time raise would break it. 2. The frequency selector already exists. _build_ladder loops _selected_keys(), which reads TH14_STEP2_FREQS_MHZ (comma list ⊂ {10, 64, 128}; test_th14_birdcage_copper.py:120–126). Pass nothing new. In this module: - the parametrized (G) / (b) / (σ) / (R) tests skip a key absent from ladder["freqs"]; - (c) skips without "10"; (N2) skips without "64"; - moves loops only lad["freqs"], as now. 3. Degree-2 records. Add ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_CLASS_MEANS_P2 = None, then register it from W1–W3's cu / pec "class means (10 digits)" prints, keyed like _P1. - Add ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_P2_RECORD_RANK_WIDTH = 8, with a version-tag comment: "complex 0.11 image, -n 8, <log>:<lines> per frequency; (1*) licence — re-record on an image change, never re-band". - test_r_class_mean_records picks the record and width by degree, and skips while the record is None or at another width. 4. (N3), degree 2 only. Every class mean of each present frequency and column moves from ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_CLASS_MEANS_P1 by more than KNOB_REACHES_THE_SOLVE. Print the moves. 5. Output. With both variables unset, the JSON path stays logs/ans6_exact/ans6_exact_p1.json. Otherwise it is ans6_exact_p{d}_f{keys}.json, so the per-frequency windows and item 193's file are never overwritten. Print the degree in the solve header line. 6. Everything else as item 193: leg_sheet_strip_fraction=GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION, measure_kappa=True, the full σ ladder, pec_column / field_solve at their defaults, and κ never passed.

Anchors (asserted; bands imported, never restated). These are TH-14's gates, per present frequency, at degree 2: - (G) For the Cu and PEC columns: reciprocity ≤ RECIPROCITY_BAND, σ_max ≤ 1 + PASSIVITY_SIGMA_TOLERANCE, and Z-class spreads ≤ ADJACENT_SPREAD_BAND. - (b) The copper identity. The residual is ≤ DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL with P_surf > 0. Degree 2 measured 7.812e-13 at h = 0.015 (ragged) and 6.772e-13 at h = 0.005 (20260929T070008Z_ANS-6-step2c.log:1034). Predicted ≲ 1e-11. - (σ) The σ-ladder per-class max|S_σ − S_PEC| is strictly decreasing. It has never been run at degree 2: step 2 and xl 2c swept Cu only. Predicted ≈ 10× per 100× σ, as at degree 1. - (c) The 10 MHz bracket against ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_S_P1_RECORDS["10"], as committed. The order is mismatched: that S_800 is degree 1 and S_PEC is degree 2, and the print says so. - Predicted: copper 1.5e-4 – 5e-4 per class, against solid ≥ 6e-2. The degree-1 values were 2.405e-4 against 9.976e-2, and the PEC column's own order move at 10 MHz is a few e-2. - The bracket's margin (≈ 300×) survives the mismatch. It stays asserted as TH-14's gate. - (M1)–(M7) on the mesh, unchanged, every window. - (R) At degree 1 / -n 2 (W0): the item 193 records, all three frequencies. At degree 2 / -n 8 (W4): the new _P2 record on W4's frequency.

Negative controls (rule (e)): - (N3) The degree knob reaches the solve: floor asserted, size predicted (item 193 (N2)'s pattern). The same comparison (degree 2 against degree 1, both columns) on this route with ragged sheets read 7.40e-2 / 4.06e-2 / 4.13e-2 at 64 MHz (20260921T100022Z_ANS-6-step2-degree2-64MHz.log:924–942), and xl 2c read 4.48 / 2.00 / 2.95 % at h = 0.005. A no-op knob reads ≈ 1e-14. - Size predicted, printed: 64 MHz self 5–9 %, couplings 2–6 %; 10 MHz self 1–4 %; 128 MHz self 4–9 %. The basis is ANS-4's exact p2-vs-p1 moves of 1.98 / 6.67 / 5.85 % on the self class (item 192 outcome) and the ragged hole route's 7.40 %. - (N2) stays as committed: floor asserted against the ragged degree-1 metrics.json at 64 MHz. At degree 2 it measures order plus sheet; the print is labelled so. - The PEC-limit control (σ = 5.8e11, ≤ 1e-4) stays predicted and printed, as in TH-14.

Predictions (printed, never asserted): - Z-class spreads ≤ 0.1 % (ragged degree 2 at h = 0.015: ≤ 0.0202 %). - σ_max within 1e-3 of 1. - κ pooled in [1e-7, 1e-4] (degree 1 on this route: 1.61e-7 / 6.58e-6 / 2.64e-5; ANS-4 exact degree 2 at 128 MHz: 4.55e-5). - P_coil/P_in 0–4 % above item 193's degree-1 0.9287082 / 0.4478617 / 0.2182683 (xl 2c degree 2 at 64 MHz: +2.0 % on the ragged degree-1 figure). - Cu and PEC class means within 0.05 pp of each other on every class (F16: 0.02 pp at degree 1).

Windows. Each harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, foreground, Bash timeout: 660000. Every window runs -s with tests/environment first. W1–W4 use §5.1's durable capture verbatim, trailing ; exit \$rc included. Order (rule (i)): code, then W1–W3 (records None, (R) skips), then register _P2, then W0 and W4 on the module as committed. Nothing is edited after W0. - W1 (degree 2, 10 MHz, -n 8, ≈ 355 s, bracket 300–480 s):

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-6-item216-W1-p2-10 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && mkdir -p /workspace/logs && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6=solve FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6_DEGREE=2 TH14_STEP2_FREQS_MHZ=10 timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 8 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py -v -s --tb=short > /workspace/logs/ans6-item216-w1-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/ans6-item216-w1-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/ans6-item216-w1-raw.log; exit \$rc'" - The price gate, before W2: read W1's PEC / σ / P1 sweep times and the window's elapsed time. - Window ≤ 480 s ⇒ W2 / W3 at -n 8. - Window in (480, 560] s ⇒ W2 / W3 at -n 12. - Window over 560 s, or a kill ⇒ stop after W1. The other two frequencies become the review's to re-queue from W1's measured price. - W2: W1's command with TH14_STEP2_FREQS_MHZ=64, raw file ans6-item216-w2-raw.log, labelled ANS-6-item216-W2-p2-64. - W3: with TH14_STEP2_FREQS_MHZ=128, raw file ans6-item216-w3-raw.log, labelled ANS-6-item216-W3-p2-128. - Register ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_CLASS_MEANS_P2 from W1–W3's prints, then make no further edit. - W0 (the unset control on the module as committed; degree 1, all three frequencies, -n 2). It is item 193 W3 relabelled (34 passed, 210 s). test_ans7_exact_strip.py is added: with no FEM_EM_ANS7_* set every test skips, which proves the import still works.

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-6-item216-W0-p1-unset "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6=solve timeout -k 30 450 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py -v -s --tb=short'"

(R) and (M7) are asserted at degree 1, as item 193 W3. - W4: the degree-2 closing window (W2's command relabelled ANS-6-item216-W4-p2-64-close, raw file ans6-item216-w4-raw.log). (R) at degree 2 is asserted on 64 MHz. The 10 / 128 MHz _P2 entries are registered from W1 / W3 and first asserted by a later run. The row says so (rule (i)'s disclosure clause). - Clock rule. If the slot is past minute 40 when W3 would start, skip W3. Register 10 / 64 only, run W0 and W4, and journal 128 MHz as owed. The review re-queues it. Never shorten a timeout to make a window fit.

Traps. 1. κ at degree 2 on this route is unmeasured. Item 196 ran _build_ladder at degree 2 with measure_kappa=False; ANS-4's in-run κ at degree 2 ran on the solid route (20261003T094036Z_ANS-4-item192-W3-p2.log:2217). - If W1 raises inside terminal_form_deficit, κ is a diagnostic and feeds no gate, so the slot may pass measure_kappa=(degree == 1), disclose it, and re-run W1. Any other exception stops the slot. 2. Do not drop σ rungs to save time. (σ) is TH-14's gate, and item 196's Cu-only price is not this item's. 3. Keep pec_column and field_solve at their defaults. pec_column=False with field_solve=True raises a rank-0-only KeyError (item 157). Never pass a float κ or "in_run". 4. TH14_STEP2_FREQS_MHZ takes the keys 10 / 64 / 128, not Hz. Anything else raises RuntimeError in _selected_keys(), which is pure env logic, so every rank raises and nothing hangs. 5. Never overwrite logs/ans6_exact/ans6_exact_p1.json. Do not run ans:6 or ans:7, and do not touch their metrics.json / COMPARISON.md. Set no FEM_EM_ANS6_* variable. 6. Register degree-2 records at -n 8 only. Degree 2 at -n 2 is ≈ 3× slower and is a different record width. 7. Copying 10-digit prints. Interleaved PASSED prefixes from other ranks can land mid-line (item 192 W3:2214). Copy the values only, and spot-check one per column per frequency. 8. Rank-local quantities. Areas, facet counts and cell_tags.values are rank-local and reduced before asserting (the module does this). There must be no ordering comparison or sqrt on complex operands. 9. Status 124. Run pgrep -c python3 in the container, then the rubric's cache sweep as one bare harness call; report. Never lengthen a timeout. A W2 / W3 kill does not void W1. 10. Private data. No aed_results/, COMPARISON_private.md or docs/private/. The journal and the row carry identities, records and relative moves only, and no absolute S₁₁ or Z_in at 10 / 64 MHz (known-issues 2026-09-19).

Scope. Covered: - the exact hole route at degree 2 on the ×1 mesh, Cu and PEC, at 10 / 64 / 128 MHz (or as many as the price gate and clock allow); - TH-14's gates and the copper identity; - degree-2 class means registered under (1*); - the degree-1 path proved unchanged.

Not covered: - the private row (a) re-read (the weekly's); - any h-rung of the hole route at degree 2 (the xl 2c / 2d family is ragged and h-refined); - Palace (F22, which takes order 2 after this item); - ANS-7; - the examples' tracked artefacts; - any κ correction or band.

What a negative result means. - W0 red: the unset path moved. Revert the module, stop, BLOCKED (rule (d)). - W0 red on test_ans7_exact_strip.py collection: the import contract broke. Revert, stop. - (G), (b) or (σ) red at degree 2: the degree-1 gates are green on this mesh, so the order changed the fixture's identities. Open a known-issues entry ("exact hole route fails <gate> at degree 2"), park on attempt/*, BLOCKED. Never widen. A (σ) red in particular is the first degree-2 σ-ladder measurement on any mesh. Print the ladder per class; it is a finding about the Leontovich-vs-PEC limit at degree 2, not about the band. - (c) red: report per class, with the order mismatch named; stop. The review rules whether an order-matched S_800 is owed. - (N3) red: the degree knob did not reach the solve. Park. - W1 over its price gate: stop as written. That is a price, not a failure. - No PREDICTED RED: line. Any red stops the slot.

Status it can move. - The ANS-6 row gains a "step 5" record sentence: the gates per frequency, the identity residuals, the degree-2 class means registered, and the order moves. No glyph change; 🟡 stays until the weekly adjudicates. - It supplies the weekly's private F16 / row (a) re-read at matched order (F16: "Row (a) is re-read on F19"). - F22's order-2 leg ("order 2 after F19") becomes runnable. - Rule (j): the row carries no step-5 Done-when. Proposed: "Step 5 is done when the exact-rectangle hole route at degree 2 passes TH-14's gates and the copper identity at 10 / 64 / 128 MHz with κ off for both columns, class means registered under (1*)."

Outcome (2026-10-04 07:30 slot): BLOCKED at the price gate. W1 (degree 2, 10 MHz, -n 8, 20261004T123147Z_ANS-6-item216-W1-p2-10.log) hit Status 124 at 590 s with no traceback on any rank (both PETSc signal-15 blocks are the timeout; pgrep -c python3 0 afterwards). It had built the three meshes (42.9 / 41.3 / 42.1 s) and finished the PEC, 5.8e7 and 5.8e9 sweeps, and died inside the 5.8e11 sweep before the P1 field solve; the ladder prints its sweep timings only after P1, so no per-sweep price was read. The box ran ≈ 1.7× slow: W0, the same command as item 193 W3 (210 s, ladder 103.9 s), took 356 s with ladder 169.9 s (20261004T124227Z_ANS-6-item216-W0-p1-unset.log, 34 passed / 14 skipped; (R) reproduces item 193's records to 10 digits at all three frequencies; test_ans7_exact_strip.py collects and skips). Cache sweep 20261004T124212Z_ANS-6-item216-cache-sweep.log removed one 0-byte FFCx stub. Code (the FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6_DEGREE knob, frequency skips, (N3), _P2 = None, per-degree (R), per-key JSON path) parked on attempt/ANS-6-step5-20261004T1249Z; its added cu-vs-PEC gap print is labelled "pp" but computes a relative % — fix the label before re-running W0. Next: at today's speed even -n 12 predicts ≈ 500 s per frequency, close to the cap; re-queue on a quieter box, or split each frequency's ladder (PEC + σ sweeps in one window, P1 in another) — never a longer timeout.

docs.title: §9 item 226 — 2026-10-04 (chain F19, re-pose of item 216, attempt 2 of 4)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-04 10:30 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §10 chain F19 as the 2026-10-03 weekly wrote it ("the exact hole route at degree 2, Cu and PEC, 10 / 64 / 128 MHz, κ off: TH-14's gates and the copper identity at the imported bands, class means registered under (1*)"). This re-poses item 216, BLOCKED at its price gate (attempts.md, 2026-10-04 12:49 UTC). The target is unchanged: every quantity item 216 gated stays gated; only the window plan changes. Attempt 2 of the step-5 family (cap four). The sheets-and-κ ruling (§9, 2026-10-02) binds.

ANS-6 step 5: land item 216's parked module, fix one label, split each frequency into a sweeps window and an identity window, and drop the two extra mesh builds from the split windows. - Executor: implementer. Tests only (tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py). No src/ change and no edit to test_th14_birdcage_copper.py: _build_ladder already takes sigmas, field_solve and pec_column. - Tier: heavy. P at -n 1; W1a–W3b at -n 8; W0 at -n 2. Complex build. - Class: chain step (solve). Time: ≈ 18 measured / ≈ 60 predicted min (≈ 15 code + ≈ 30 of windows at normal speed + ≈ 5 registration + ≈ 10 fixed). The clock rule sheds 128 MHz before the slot overruns. - Depends on: nothing. Branch attempt/ANS-6-step5-20261004T1249Z (e4909c28) is based on c2f352ea, still the last main commit to touch the module: git diff main...attempt/… names only this file (+103 / −11), checked 2026-10-04 10:30.

What item 216's W1 measured (20261004T123147Z_ANS-6-item216-W1-p2-10.log, degree 2, 10 MHz, -n 8): - Three hole meshes, mesh wall 37.02 / 36.79 / 36.69 s (:1064, :1892, :2821), against 19.8 / 19.4 s on the same mesh at -n 8 at normal speed (20261003T124111Z_ANS-7-item196-W2-p2.log:1963, :2889). The box ran ≈ 1.87× slow. - Ladder progress: the PEC sweep (:2844–2852, column power 1.000), 5.8e7 (:2873–2881) and 5.8e9 (:2902–2910) completed; the 5.8e11 sweep had finished drive P1 and was printing drive P2 at the kill (:2911–2919). No P1 field solve, no κ. - No sweep timings, because the field-solve branch of _build_ladder prints them only after P1 (test_th14_birdcage_copper.py:410–419). The field_solve=False branch prints the PEC and every σ sweep time as soon as the sweeps finish (:362–368); the sweeps windows below use it, so W1a gives the first per-σ degree-2 price on this mesh. - Projection of item 216's whole per-frequency window at normal speed: - fixed ≈ 60 s for environment, import and JIT (item 196 W2: 409 s less 327.6 s of two ladders less one 23 s mesh; ANS-4 item 212 W1: ≈ 67 s); - the meshes fixture's two extra builds plus the M-tests ≈ 50 s; - ladder mesh 23 s, PEC 55 s, three σ sweeps 3 × 46 s, P1 40 s; - total ≈ 365 s. At 1.87× that is ≈ 680 s. The kill at 590 s came ≈ 307 normal-seconds in, which is consistent with ≈ 1.9×. - W0 (unset, degree 1, -n 2): 356 s against item 193 W3's 210 s, ladder 169.9 against 107.2 s, mesh 32.7 against 19.6 s, so ≈ 1.6–1.7× at -n 2 (20261004T124227Z_ANS-6-item216-W0-p1-unset.log:932, :3082, :3292). The same box read ≈ 1.1× slower at -n 8 than at -n 2.

The re-pose. - -n 12: rejected by measurement. ANS-4 item 212 W2 at -n 12 swept no faster than -n 8 (183.12 against 186.93 s, a mesh with 3× the unknowns of this one) and doubled the mesh and fixed cost (101.97 against 55.74 s; ≈ 129 against ≈ 67 s). - Fewer σ points: rejected. (σ) is TH-14's gate and needs PEC and all three rungs in one record (test_sigma_ladder_monotone). - The whole window on a quiet box: 365 s fits only to ≈ 1.55× (≤ 560 s). Not chosen; the split costs ≈ 10 min of code and survives ≈ 1.9×. - Chosen: split each frequency into a sweeps part (PEC + 5.8e7 + 5.8e9 + 5.8e11, field_solve=False) and an identity part (PEC + 5.8e7 + P1, sigmas=(COPPER_SIGMA,)), and run neither with the meshes fixture. - PEC stays in the identity part because pec_column=False with field_solve=True raises a rank-0-only KeyError at test_th14_birdcage_copper.py:412 (item 157). It costs ≈ 55 s and buys the cross-window (R) check below. - Sweeps ≈ 60 + 23 + 55 + 3 × 46 ≈ 276 s at normal speed (bracket 240–330 s); ≈ 515 s at 1.87×. - Identity ≈ 60 + 23 + 55 + 46 + 40 + ≈ 5 (κ deficit, powers) ≈ 229 s (bracket 200–280 s); ≈ 430 s at 1.87×, fits to ≈ 2.3×. - Every gated quantity keeps a window: (G), (σ), (c), (N2), (N3) in the sweeps part; (b), (G), (c), (N3) and (R) at degree 2 in the identity part.

Code (tests only; additive; with every new variable unset the module makes the branch's calls, which are item 193's, in the same order): 0. Land the branch module by path: git checkout attempt/ANS-6-step5-20261004T1249Z -- tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py. First confirm git log -1 --format=%h main -- tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py still reads c2f352ea. If main has moved, merge by hand: a path checkout would drop main's change. (This is code, not an append-only record, so the path checkout is the right tool.) 1. Fix the mislabelled print (branch :405). It computes |S̄_cu − S̄_PEC| / |S̄_PEC| in %, not pp. Relabel it cu vs pec class-mean relative gap |cu-pec|/|pec| (printed; degree 1 read <= 0.0642 %, item 216 W0). - Degree 1 read 0.0475 / 0.0125 / 0.0235 % at 10 MHz, 0.0642 / 0.0281 / 0.0486 % at 64 MHz, 0.0397 / 0.0305 / 0.0457 % at 128 MHz (…124227Z…:3089, :3094, :3099). - Predicted at degree 2: ≤ 0.1 % on every class. Printed only. 2. FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6_PART ∈ {unset, sweeps, identity}. Not FEM_EM_ANS6_*: ans:7's main() refuses that prefix. - Validate it inside the ladder fixture: a bad value raises ValueError on every rank before any mesh. Never raise at import, because test_ans7_exact_strip.py imports this module. - sweeps ⇒ _build_ladder(..., field_solve=False); identity ⇒ _build_ladder(..., sigmas=(th14.COPPER_SIGMA,)). Both keep leg_sheet_strip_fraction=GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION, measure_kappa=True, the degree forward, and pec_column / field_solve otherwise at their defaults. Unset ⇒ the branch's call. - Drop meshes from the split windows. Change ladder(meshes) to ladder(request), calling request.getfixturevalue("meshes") first when the part is unset; the M-tests have already built it by then, so the order is unchanged. Give M1–M7 and N1 a skipif marker that reads the variable without raising (bool(os.environ.get(PART_ENV, "").strip())), reason "asserted in window P and W0". This saves ≈ 50 s at normal speed and ≈ 95 s at 1.9×. - Rank-0 guards in the fixture's print and JSON blocks. rec["power"] and rec["kappa"] exist only with the field solve, and rec["sigma"][th14.SIGMA_LADDER[-1]] only under sweeps. Print what exists; write the JSON with .get. An unguarded access is a rank-0-only KeyError, so the other ranks wait in the next collective until Status 124, which looks like a price overrun (item 157's class). - Tests: (b) skips under sweeps, and (σ) skips under identity. Everything else runs as on the branch. - (P′) the part reaches the ladder: asserted. One small test, parametrized by key, skips when the part is unset or the key absent. Under sweeps, set(rec["sigma"]) == set(th14.SIGMA_LADDER) and "power" not in rec. Under identity, set(rec["sigma"]) == {th14.COPPER_SIGMA} and "power" in rec. - JSON path: with a part set, ans6_exact_p{d}_f{keys}_{part}.json. The unset paths stay the branch's. 3. Report the relative gaps and stop. Never re-register from the identity windows. - (c) red: report per class, with the order mismatch named; stop. - (N3) or (P′) red: a knob did not reach the solve; park. - A kill that gate 2 allowed: a price, not a failure; journal it. - No PREDICTED RED: line. W3a and W3b use §5.1's durable capture verbatim, trailing ; exit \$rc included. Order (rule (i)): W3a (module as on main) → gate → register (the only edit) → W3b → W0. Nothing is edited after the registration. W3a ran before the 128 entry existed; the row says so, as item 226's did for W1a / W2a. - W3a: sweeps, 128 MHz (-n 8; ≈ 293 s, bracket 270–330 s):

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-6-item232-W3a-p2-128-sweeps "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && mkdir -p /workspace/logs && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6=solve FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6_DEGREE=2 FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6_PART=sweeps TH14_STEP2_FREQS_MHZ=128 timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 8 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py -v -s --tb=short > /workspace/logs/ans6-item232-w3a-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/ans6-item232-w3a-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/ans6-item232-w3a-raw.log; exit \$rc'" - Gate (above). - Register "128" in ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_CLASS_MEANS_P2 from W3a's cu / pec "class means (10 digits)" lines, keyed and formatted like "64". - In the version-tag comment, replace "128 MHz owed (W3a shed by the slot clock)" with 20261004T…Z_ANS-6-item232-W3a-p2-128-sweeps.log:<lines>, the "registered by §9 item 226" clause gaining "and item 232 (128 MHz)". - Spot-check one value per column against the log. - Record the module's mtime; it must precede W3b's start. - W3b: identity, 128 MHz, re-run (-n 8; ≈ 244 s, bracket 220–280 s). (R) at 128 is asserted here.

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-6-item232-W3b-p2-128-identity "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && mkdir -p /workspace/logs && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6=solve FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6_DEGREE=2 FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6_PART=identity TH14_STEP2_FREQS_MHZ=128 timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 8 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py -v -s --tb=short > /workspace/logs/ans6-item232-w3b-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/ans6-item232-w3b-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/ans6-item232-w3b-raw.log; exit \$rc'" - W0: the unset control on the module as committed (degree 1, all three frequencies, -n 2; ≈ 216 s, bracket 200–260 s):

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-6-item232-W0-p1-unset "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6=solve timeout -k 30 450 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py -v -s --tb=short'" - If W3b is green and the clock dies before W0, which the gate should prevent: the edit is uncommitted with one closing window. Commit nothing from the module. Journal W3b as a green reading on an uncommitted entry, park the edit and both logs on attempt/ANS-6-step5-128-<UTC>, and mark the item BLOCKED. The next slot re-runs W0 then lands. Never commit the edit without W0.

Traps. 1. Register from W3a only, never from an identity window (item 226's rule). The identity windows reproduce the record; they do not source it. Item 226's W3b prints are a cross-check, not a source. 2. Interleaved rank prefixes land mid-line: item 226 W3b :1209 reads SKIPPED cu class means …. Copy the values only, and spot-check. 3. Width 8. W3a and W3b run at -n 8. At any other width (R) skips, and that is not a pass. 4. TH14_STEP2_FREQS_MHZ=128, the key, not Hz. 5. No -k deselection. The part markers skip; -k a or b splits into stray argv inside the quoted container command. 6. Durable capture verbatim (; exit \$rc last). Item 216's lesson stands: a window near 590 s on a slow box is a price; never lengthen. 7. Status 124 or a kill: run pgrep -c python3 in the container first, then the rubric's cache sweep as one bare harness call. A Status 124 that ends after a complete sweep with no traceback is the rank-0-only KeyError class until shown otherwise (item 226 trap 2); the guards are on main, but read them before calling it a price. 8. The identity window's "negative control … NOT met" line is the cosmetic 5.8e7 read (item 226). Disclose it; never read it. 9. Never overwrite logs/ans6_exact/ans6_exact_p1.json except through W0's unset path. Do not run ans:6 or ans:7, and set no FEM_EM_ANS6_* variable. W3b's re-run overwrites the gitignored ans6_exact_p2_f128_identity.json; that is expected. 10. Shared working tree. The 18:00 review's landing of item 228 touches test_ans7_exact_strip.py, which W0 collects. If that landing is not yet committed when the slot starts, the tree is dirty and the slot follows its dirty-tree rule. Never stash or check out that file. 11. Private data. No aed_results/, COMPARISON_private.md or docs/private/. The journal and the row carry identities, records and relative moves only, with no absolute S₁₁ or Z_in (known-issues 2026-09-19). No AED number anywhere.

Scope. Covered: - (σ) at 128 MHz at degree 2; - _P2["128"] registered under (1*); - (R) at 128 across the sweeps and identity windows; - (G), (b) and (N3) re-asserted at 128; - the degree-1 path re-proved on the module as committed.

With item 226, this completes F19's target at 10 / 64 / 128 MHz.

Not covered: - the private row (a) re-read: the weekly's, done in the gitignored files, never here; - any h-rung at degree 2; - Palace (F22); - ANS-7; - the examples' tracked artefacts; - any κ correction or band.

ANS-6 stays 🟡.

What a negative result means. - (σ) red at 128: a non-monotone degree-2 ladder at 128 after green 10 / 64. Print the ladder per class and open a known-issues entry ("exact hole route fails (σ) at degree 2, 128 MHz"). Register nothing, park W3a's log on attempt/ANS-6-step5-128-<UTC>, BLOCKED. Never widen and never drop a rung. It is a finding about the Leontovich-vs-PEC limit at 128, not about the band. - (G) or (N3) or (P′) red in W3a: item 226's W3b was green on the same fixture, so a red here means the sweeps path differs from the identity path at 128. Report, park, BLOCKED. - Cross-check or (R) red: W3a and W3b are not one fixture, or the sweep is not deterministic at -n 8. Report the relative gaps per class and column and stop. Never re-register from W3b, and never move STEP3A_RECORD_RTOL. Park, BLOCKED. - W0 red: the registration moved the unset path, which a dict entry should not do. Revert the module, stop, BLOCKED (rule (d)). - A gate stop or a kill: a price, not a failure (above). - No PREDICTED RED: line. Any red stops the slot. Never move a band to land the item.

Status it can move. - §10 F19 completes at 10 / 64 / 128 MHz. Item 226's "128 owed" is discharged, and the review strikes it from the item 226 line. - The ANS-6 row's "Step 5 record" sentence covers 128 MHz. Replace "the σ-ladder strictly monotone at 10 / 64 MHz … registered at 10 / 64 … 128 MHz sweeps (σ, registration) owed" with three-frequency wording: (σ) at 128 with its self-class ladder, _P2 at 10 / 64 / 128 reproduced across windows, and the item 232 logs cited. Keep the rule (i) disclosure: the sweeps windows ran before their record entries existed. - No glyph change. The row carries no Done-when of its own; rule (j) has only item 216's proposed step-level line ("Step 5 is done when the exact-rectangle hole route at degree 2 passes TH-14's gates and the copper identity at 10 / 64 / 128 MHz with κ off for both columns, class means registered under (1*)"). This item meets that step line. The row's own text keeps 🟡 "because the weekly's adjudication is still open", and nothing here adjudicates. The review may adopt the proposed line as the row's step-5 Done-when (rule (j)), marked met. - It supplies the weekly's private row (a) re-read at matched order at all three frequencies (F16: "Row (a) is re-read on F19").

docs.title: §9 item 266 — 2026-10-06 (chain F24)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-06 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: PROJECT_PLAN §10 chain F, step F24 as the 2026-10-05 weekly wrote it (grep "F24. `ANS-6` step 5b′"): "a resolution knob on the exact hole module (FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6_RESOLUTION, beside _PART / _DEGREE / _MODE), unset digit-identical to F19's records (items 226 / 232) at the imported reproduction band; the knob reaches the mesh (cell count printed at h = 0.0075). No solve beyond the reproduction. Target: identity." The contract is docs/testing/xl-pending.md entry 31 (F26). No band, tolerance, Done-when or validation target is set or moved. The sheets-and-κ ruling (§9, 2026-10-02) binds: exact CAD rectangles, κ off, κ printed only.

ANS-6 step 5b′: one mesh knob on tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py, the unset path reproduced, the knob shown to reach the mesh. No solve at h = 0.0075. - Executor: implementer. Tests only. No src/ change. No edit to test_th14_birdcage_copper.py: _build_ladder already takes resolution and forwards it verbatim to _sheets_build (test_th14_birdcage_copper.py:263, :313–314; ANS-6 step 2b). _hole_rung already takes resolution (test_ans6_exact_strip.py:228–238; item 214). The knob only has to read one variable and pass it to both. - Tier: heavy for every window (WK ≈ 175 s and W0 ≈ 219 s sit at or over the 180 s standard ceiling; W1 / W2 are one degree-2 identity window each, as items 226 / 232 ran them). Every container timeout is ≤ 590 s, and the ceiling is 12 ranks. WK at -n 2, W1 / W2 at -n 8 (the _P2 record width), W0 at -n 2 (the _P1 record width). Complex build. - Class: chain step (code plus reproduction). Time: ≈ 17 measured / ≈ 45 predicted min: ≈ 10 fixed, ≈ 12 code, windows ≈ 14.5 at normal speed (WK ≈ 3 + W1 ≈ 3.8 + W0 ≈ 3.7 + W2 ≈ 4.1), ≈ 6 bookkeeping. - Depends on: nothing. Before editing, confirm git log -1 --format=%h main -- tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py still names item 232's registration commit. If main has moved the module since, read that diff first. test_ans7_exact_strip.py imports this module (its _hole_rung, records and constants), so nothing new may raise at import.

The contract with xl entry 31. Entry 31 is PENDING PREREQUISITE on exactly one new name: FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6_RESOLUTION. Spell it that way. The weekly's entry text runs it with FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6_DEGREE=2, TH14_STEP2_FREQS_MHZ=64, -n 16 and no _PART. That means the meshes fixture runs too, and it must work under the knob (code step 3). - The implementer that lands this item green marks entry 31 READY in the same commit. Change only its **Status:** line to: "READY (2026-10-06, §9 item 266): knob present, unset digit-identical (W0 / W1 / W2 logs), resolution knob reaches the mesh (WK log, cells)". Do not write, issue, edit or queue its command, and do not touch its price, readout or decision rule. The review issues the command. - If any window is red, entry 31 stays PENDING PREREQUISITE, untouched.

Code (tests only; every addition additive; with the knob unset, the module makes the same calls in the same order, with the same arguments): 1. RESOLUTION_ENV = "FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6_RESOLUTION" beside DEGREE_ENV / PART_ENV (:170–175). Add _resolution() in the _degree() pattern (:195–204). Unset or blank ⇒ None. Otherwise float(raw), which must be finite and > 0; anything else raises ValueError naming the variable. Also add _resolution_set(), a non-raising read for skip markers, in the _part_set() pattern. - Parse it in fixtures only, never at import. Call it first in both meshes (beside _degree() at :281) and ladder (beside _degree() / _part() at :411–412), so a bad value raises on every rank before any mesh. - Do not name it FEM_EM_ANS6_*: ans:7's main() refuses that prefix. FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_RESOLUTION is a different module's knob. Leave it alone. 2. Forward it. - meshes: _hole_rung(GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION, resolution=res) and _hole_rung(None, resolution=res). res is None forwards nothing, so _hole_rung is byte-identical to before (its own docstring). - ladder: when res is not None, set extra["resolution"] = res. Unset adds no key, so the _build_ladder call is item 232's. - Rank 0 echoes one line before the ladder call: [ANS-6 step5b′] knobs: resolution <res|unset>, degree <d|unset>, part <p|unset>, frequencies <TH14_STEP2_FREQS_MHZ|all>. Read it first in every window. - When the knob is set, call report_peak_rss(comm, label="ANS-6 step5b′ after ladder") on every rank after _build_ladder (import from fem_em_solver.utils.instrumentation, as test_ans4_exact_strip_records.py:74, :449 does). Entry 31's readout needs the memory figure. Do not add it to the unset path. 3. Tests under the knob. "Knobbed" means _resolution() is not None. - M1–M5 (CAD identities: F/dxdz, the SPEC rectangle at STRIP_BAND, the complement, the box-halves partition, the cavity) stay asserted unchanged on the refined mesh. They are CAD identities, not mesh ones (item 212 code step 4's rule). - M6 and M7 become (F′) when knobbed (item 212's pattern, test_ans4_exact_strip_records.py:119–120, :640–673). Import KNOB_CELL_FACTOR (1.02) from tests.validation.test_ans4_exact_strip_records; the module already imports from it at :52. Knobbed M7: assert cells > KNOB_CELL_FACTOR × ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_HOLE_CELL_RECORD. Knobbed M6: assert flag-off cells > KNOB_CELL_FACTOR × tracked. Print each count against its predicted bracket (below), marked "printed". Unset: both tests exactly as now. - N1 (printed only) runs unchanged. - New test_f_prime_resolution_reaches_the_ladder(ladder) (needs_solve). It skips when unset; knobbed, it asserts ladder["cells"] > KNOB_CELL_FACTOR × ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_HOLE_CELL_RECORD. It is first asserted in entry 31's own window, and skips in every window of this item. - (R) (test_r_class_mean_records): add a skip when knobbed, reason "(R) records are ×1 (h = 0.015); not asserted under FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6_RESOLUTION". The skip goes before the width check. - (N3) (test_n3_…, and order_moves in the fixture): when knobbed, suppress it. Leave order_moves empty and skip the test with reason "(N3) would mix h and order". This is item 212's suppression of p2_vs_p1. - Printed h-move (entry 31's readout, no gate). Knobbed, rank 0 prints per frequency and per column the class-mean move against the ×1 record at the same degree (_P2 at degree 2, _P1 at degree 1), using _relative_move. It also prints the Cu − PEC gap per class on the rung beside the same gap computed from the ×1 record. Label the lines "printed, never asserted". - (c) and (N2) keep their assertions. When knobbed, their print gains a tag such as [MESH MISMATCHED: comparand is ×1], in the style of (c)'s existing order-mismatch tag (:579–580). - (G), (b), (σ), (P′) are unchanged. 4. JSON path. Unset: exactly as now. Knobbed: ans6_exact_p{d}_r{res:g}_f{keys}[_{part}].json, so F19's ans6_exact_p2_f* files and ans6_exact_p1.json are never overwritten. 5. Docstring. Document the knob under the module's existing knob notes, with "§9 item 266, ANS-6 step 5b′, xl entry 31's contract".

Anchors (asserted; bands imported, never restated): - (R) the unset path reproduces F19's records at STEP3A_RECORD_RTOL (tests/validation/test_ans4_resolution_ladder.py:198, imported at test_ans6_exact_strip.py:58). - W1: ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_CLASS_MEANS_P2["64"] (item 226), at width ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_P2_RECORD_RANK_WIDTH = 8. - W2: _P2["128"] (item 232). - W0: ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_CLASS_MEANS_P1 at 10 / 64 / 128, at width 2. - Backing, same fixture and width: item 226 W2b reproduced _P2["64"] to 10 digits (20261004T185732Z_ANS-6-item226-W2b-p2-64-identity.log:1339); item 232 W3b reproduced _P2["128"] to 10 digits (20261005T004626Z_ANS-6-item232-W3b-p2-128-identity.log:1324); item 232 W0 passed _P1 (20261005T005047Z_ANS-6-item232-W0-p1-unset.log:3243). Predicted ≤ 1e-10. - M7 / M6 unset: 80 798 / 80 181 cells within CELL_COUNT_BAND (W0). - (G), (b) at degree 2 in W1 / W2, as items 226 / 232 asserted them. M1–M5 on the h = 0.0075 mesh (WK).

Negative controls (rule (e)): - (F′) the knob reaches the mesh: asserted in WK on both hole meshes (cells > 1.02 × the ×1 count). An ignored or misspelt knob reproduces 80 798 / 80 181 exactly, as it does in every unset window (20261004T184052Z_ANS-6-item226-P-mesh.log:1740, :1746; …item232-W0…:1762, :1768). Predicted separation ≈ 2.8× against the 1.02 floor. - Predicted, printed: flag-off 226 642 exactly. It is the same generator call (_sheets_build(True, as_hole=True, resolution=0.0075)) that ANS-6 step 2b measured (20260923T093956Z_ANS-6-step2b-b-h0p0075-d1-64MHz.log:950). Flag-on in [226 642, 232 000]: the ×1 strip ratio 1.007695 gives ≈ 228 400. - A flag-off count that differs from 226 642 is an image or mesher drift. Print it and disclose it; it is not a red. - The ladder-level (F′) is armed but skips here (no solve at 0.0075). It reads the same _resolution() as meshes through one keyword, so check that by reading the code. Entry 31's window asserts it first. - Unset reproduction: asserted through (R), backed above. - The echo line shows a misspelt knob before anything else.

Predictions (printed, never asserted): - Pass counts (tests/environment contributes 12 in every window). A changed pass count is a red; a changed skip count is not. - WK: 20 passed (item 226 P's count, …184052Z…:1847). - W1: 18 passed (item 226 W2b, …185732Z…:1417). - W2: 17 passed (item 232 W3b, …004626Z…:1417). - W0: 34 passed (…005047Z…:3243). - Skips: each window's prior count + 1 for the new ladder (F′) test. Read the pass count, not the skips. - WK mesh walls 50–65 s each at normal speed. Basis: the ragged 0.0075 hole mesh 46.9 s (step 2b); the exact 0.01 hole rung 53.6–55.4 s on a ≈ 1.4× box (item 214, ANS-7.md item 214 outcome); the ×1 exact mesh 23.30 s against ragged 22.49 s.

Windows. Each harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, foreground, Bash timeout: 660000. Every window runs -s with tests/environment first. W1 / W2 use §5.1's durable capture verbatim, trailing ; exit \$rc included. Order (rule (i)): code steps 1–5 → WK → W1 → W0 → W2. No edit to the module after WK starts. If anything is edited later, every window re-runs. - WK: the knob reaches the mesh (mesh mode, degree unset, -n 2; no solve). ≈ 175 s, bracket 150–260 s: item 226 P's 105 s less its 45.8 s of mesh, plus 2 × 50–65 s.

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-6-item266-WK-r0p0075-mesh "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6=mesh FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6_RESOLUTION=0.0075 timeout -k 30 400 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py -v -s --tb=short'" - W1: unset reproduction at degree 2, 64 MHz (identity part, -n 8). This is item 226 W2b relabelled: 227 s (…185732Z…:1877), bracket 210–280 s.

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-6-item266-W1-p2-64-identity "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && mkdir -p /workspace/logs && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6=solve FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6_DEGREE=2 FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6_PART=identity TH14_STEP2_FREQS_MHZ=64 timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 8 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py -v -s --tb=short > /workspace/logs/ans6-item266-w1-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/ans6-item266-w1-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/ans6-item266-w1-raw.log; exit \$rc'" - W0: unset control at degree 1, all three frequencies (-n 2). This is item 232 W0 relabelled: 219 s (…005047Z…:3312), bracket 200–260 s. test_ans7_exact_strip.py collects and skips. It also proves the import-time rule.

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-6-item266-W0-p1-unset "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_EXACT_ANS6=solve timeout -k 30 450 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py -v -s --tb=short'" - W2: unset reproduction at degree 2, 128 MHz (identity part, -n 8). This is item 232 W3b relabelled: 248 s (…004626Z…:1877), bracket 220–290 s. It is W1's command with TH14_STEP2_FREQS_MHZ=128, raw file ans6-item266-w2-raw.log, and label ANS-6-item266-W2-p2-128-identity. - Clock rule. Start W2 only if the slot minute + 5 + 6 ≤ 60 (the window plus bookkeeping). Otherwise shed it. W0 and W1 already carry the unset path at all three frequencies (degree 1) and at degree 2 on entry 31's frequency. Journal "W2 shed (item 232's _P2["128"] not re-reproduced)". The READY mark still stands, because the forwarding code does not depend on frequency. Never shorten a timeout to make a window fit. - Box speed. The Status 0 baselines above were measured at s ≈ 1.0–1.1. At ≈ 2× slow, W1 / W2 still fit 590 s (≈ 455 / 500 s) and W0 its 450 s only to ≈ 2.05×. A kill is a price (below).

Traps. 1. Nothing may raise at import. test_ans7_exact_strip.py imports this module. A raising _resolution() at module level reds every ANS-7 window (item 226's _part rule). W0 collects ans:7 and proves it. 2. An unset path must forward no key. Passing resolution=None explicitly to _build_ladder is equivalent there (its default is None). Do not "normalise" it to 0.015: _sheets_build's RESOLUTION default is the record's mesh, and an explicit float may not take the identical gmsh path. Forward nothing when unset. 3. M6 / M7 under the knob are the trap entry 31 would otherwise buy. Unhandled, they red at 0.0075 in an xl window (the cell-record band against ≈ 2.8× the cells). Code step 3 is that guard. WK is where it is proven. 4. The rank-0-only KeyError class (item 226 trap 2). The new prints read only what exists (_P2 / _P1 keys for the frequencies present). A Status 124 with no traceback after a complete ladder is this trap until shown otherwise. 5. TH14_STEP2_FREQS_MHZ takes 10 / 64 / 128, not Hz. 6. No -k deselection. A -k a or b splits into stray argv inside the quoted container command. 7. Width. (R) at degree 2 is a width-8 record and skips at any other -n. That is not a pass. W1 / W2 run at -n 8 only. 8. Durable capture verbatim in W1 / W2 (; exit \$rc last). 9. Status 124 or a kill: run pgrep -c python3 in the container, then the rubric's cache sweep as one bare harness call. A later kill does not void earlier green windows. 10. Never overwrite logs/ans6_exact/ans6_exact_p1.json except through W0's unset path. Do not run ans:6 or ans:7. Set no FEM_EM_ANS6_* variable. W1 / W2 overwrite the gitignored ans6_exact_p2_f64_identity.json / …_f128_identity.json; that is expected. 11. Rank-local quantities are reduced before asserting. _hole_rung's counts are already size_global / allreduced. No ordering comparison or sqrt on complex operands. 12. Private data. No aed_results/, COMPARISON_private.md or docs/private/. The journal and the row carry identities, records and cell counts only, with no absolute S₁₁ or Z_in (known-issues 2026-09-19).

Scope. Covered: - the knob, its validation and its forwarding to both fixtures; - (F′) asserted on both hole meshes at h = 0.0075, with the CAD identities M1–M5 on that mesh; - F19's records reproduced on the edited module (degree 1 at 10 / 64 / 128; degree 2 at 64 and, clock permitting, 128); - entry 31 made READY.

Not covered: - any solve at h = 0.0075 (that is entry 31); - the h-statement and the Cu − PEC h-move (F26 / F27, the 10-14 weekly); - entry 31's command, price or decision rule; - the private row (a); - Palace; ANS-7; κ; any band.

ANS-6 stays 🟡.

What a negative result means. - WK (F′) red: the knob did not reach _hole_rung's mesh. Park on attempt/ANS-6-step5b-prime-<UTC>, BLOCKED. Entry 31 stays PENDING. - WK M1–M5 red at 0.0075: the exact rectangles are not exact on the refined hole mesh. That is a finding about the generator, not the knob. docs.text:

The review adopted the drafter's memory guard (doubt 3) and confirmed W0a's identity wording, which is consistent with the item-157 ruling.

  • Why. Entry 24 at seven nodes × two columns plus the κ pass is 17 factorisations, ≈ 22 000 s. Seven Cu nodes is ≈ 14 440 s at the top of the range. Both exceed the 14 400 s cap. The module also cannot assemble a Cu-only run today:
  • in_run refuses cu (:330–332).
  • Node JSON is written only for both columns (:387).
  • Assembly needs 67.0 MHz, both columns and all seven JSONs (:587–594).
  • _subset, _loo and _kin_rows_report hard-code ("cu","pec").
  • Code (tests/validation/test_ans7_sparse_route_b.py only; nothing imports it; no src/, no TH-14 edit).
  • ASSEMBLY5_NODES_MHZ = (62.0, 63.2, 64.5, 65.8, 67.0): five of the seven defaults, keeping both window ends and 64.5 MHz, so CONTROL_NODES_MHZ ⊂ it. SUBSET5_NODES_MHZ stays untouched: its 62.7 / 66.3 MHz nodes are solved nowhere.
  • Knob FEM_EM_ANS7_SPARSE_ASSEMBLY.
    • Unset: today's behaviour.
    • solved: a new test_assemble_solved assembles this run's own nodes and columns in memory. 62.0 and 67.0 MHz are required, otherwise ValueError. test_assemble_from_node_json skips.
    • Anything else: ValueError.
  • Under solved only:
    • The guard at :330 becomes "pec" not in columns and field_solve. That combination is exactly the rank-0 KeyError trap, and it still raises.
    • The κ pass is unchanged: uncorrected, with its PEC sweep and field solve.
    • Rank 0 writes Cu-only node JSON with a _kin_cu suffix, then a barrier.
    • After the κ pass, del klad and gc.collect() inside _kappa_in_run, before the grid factorises. Otherwise a held κ-pass factor plus the grid's would peak at ≈ 530 GiB against the 512 GiB limit. No number changes.
  • _subset, _loo and _kin_rows_report take columns=("cu","pec") as the default, so the unset path is byte-identical. The 1/Q-split lines print only when PEC is present.

  • test_assemble_solved asserts exactly one − → + crossing and k-share > K_SHARE_FLOOR per column. It prints:

    • _kin_rows_report;
    • Im Y_in(62.0);

Step 3 completed 2026-10-01 as records (the 7-node sparse Route B licensed at degree 1 and degree 2, plus the degree-2 rows), and the row stays open until T11/T12 supply the order- and h-matched rung for the weekly's T13 re-read. Steps 5 / 5b (T17 / T18, exact port and capacitor rectangles, κ off, records) are queued as §9 items 195 / 196 (daily provisional, 2026-10-03). Step 5 record (T17, §9 item 195, 2026-10-03): exact port and capacitor rectangles on the 80 798-cell hole mesh, degree 1, κ off — Route A = Route B to ≤ 3.11e-5 at all 102 points (band REDUCTION_BAND), the ragged κ-off control misses by 16.57 × band; Route B rows registered under (1*), f₀ −0.019 % against the ragged κ-corrected rows in both columns (20261003T113037Z_ANS-7-item195-W2-routeA.log, 20261003T113959Z_ANS-7-item195-W3-routeB.log). A record, no glyph. Step 5b record (T18, §9 item 196, 2026-10-03): the same exact rectangles at degree 2, κ off, 7-node Route B at -n 8 — the loss identity (L) at 64.5 MHz closes to 1.274e-5 ≤ REDUCTION_BAND with no correction (the ragged degree-2 κ applied to the exact sheets misses by 1.067e-1, printed control); one − → + zero per column, k-share ≥ 0.999995, ΔOO ≤ 1.64e inside BANDS; degree-2 rows Cu f₀ 62.701082 MHz / Rin 18 441.75 Ω / Q 977.2, PEC 62.714807 MHz / 32 123.93 Ω / 1 701.73 (−0.005 % f₀ against item 157's ragged in-run degree-2 rows; order move p2 − p1 f₀ −1.985 %, R_in +9.1 % / +14.4 %, Q +7.1 % / +12.2 %), printed, no constant registered (20261003T124111Z_ANS-7-item196-W2-p2.log, 20261003T124814Z_ANS-7-item196-W3-p2.log). A record, no glyph. Done-when: The row stays 🟡 until §10 T11 / T12 supply the order- and h-matched rung and the weekly re-reads (T13). History: docs/planning/chunks/ANS-7.md.

docs.title: §9 item 214 — 2026-10-04 (chain T19)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-04 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §10 chain T19 (weekly 2026-10-03), whose target is quoted, not changed: "FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_RESOLUTION on the exact-strip module, unset digit-identical to item 196's rows; one intermediate rung, sized by a one-node cost probe so the five-node Cu grid fits one heavy window, at degree 2: the h-move of f₀, Q, R_in printed. Target: T11's identity on each rung." It is also the prerequisite contract of xl entry 28 (docs/testing/xl-pending.md, § 28): the knob and "a Cu-only five-node path". The 2026-10-02 sheets-and-κ ruling binds: exact rectangles, κ off. No band, tolerance, Done-when or validation target moves.

ANS-7 step 6: a resolution knob and a Cu-only five-node path on the exact-strip module; the ×1 rows reproduced through them; one intermediate rung at degree 2. - Executor: implementer. Tests only, plus one additive keyword on a test helper (disclosed). - Tier: heavy; -n 8 (W0), -n 1 (W0b), -n 12 (W1–W3); complex build. - Class: chain step (solve). Time: ≈ 18 measured / 60 predicted min. - Depends on nothing. It shares tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py with item 217. Whichever lands second rebases onto the first and runs its own windows on the module as committed (rule (i)).

What "T11's identity" means here. T11 (step 3 (i)/(ii), items 127 / 132) licensed the sparse Route B with five checks, and those are the anchor on every rung: - per-node reciprocity ≤ RECIPROCITY_BAND and σ_max ≤ 1 + PASSIVITY_SIGMA_TOLERANCE; - exactly one − → + zero of Im Y_in per column; - k = ±1 share > K_SHARE_FLOOR; - Δ_LOO on f₀ / R_in / Q ≤ BANDS (1e-6, frozen from item 127's W1, never moved).

"Each rung" means two rungs. The ×1 rung (h = 0.015) is checked on item 196's stored seven degree-2 JSONs for the Cu-only five-node subset, a pure test. The intermediate rung is solved here.

Code (tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py, plus one additive keyword in tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py; no src/, no TH-14 edit, no ans:7 edit): 1. Knobs. These two names, plus the existing _ROUTE, _DEGREE and _MHZ, are entry 28's contract: - FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_RESOLUTION: a float in metres. Unset ⇒ None ⇒ nothing is forwarded. - FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_COLUMNS: unset ⇒ ("cu", "pec"); cu ⇒ Cu only. Any other value raises ValueError. 2. Forwarding. - route_b and p2_nodes call _build_ladder(..., resolution=res). With None this is today's call. - _fixture_tie(res) calls _hole_rung(GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION, resolution=res). - In _hole_rung, add a resolution=None keyword and pass it to _sheets_build only when it is not None. The default stays byte-identical. Rule (a): the ANS-6 exact module's mesh tests are re-run green in W0b. 3. The Cu-only path (in p2_nodes): - Set pec_column = "pec" in cols and field = (LOSS_NODE_MHZ in nodes) and pec_column. This keeps out item 157's rank-0 KeyError trap (pec_column=False with field_solve=True). - HELDKAPPA=1 together with COLUMNS=cu raises ValueError. So does the whole-grid route_b fixture with COLUMNS=cu. - Every per-node loop and test iterates over cols, never a hard-coded ("cu", "pec"). That covers node anchors, the window-edge guard, the Im Y_in print and the JSON write. 4. JSON names. - Unset resolution with both columns keeps node_<mhz>_p<deg>.json, item 196's names. - Otherwise: node_<mhz>_p<deg>[_h<res:g>][_cu].json. - New keys "resolution" and "columns" are added. When they are absent, as on item 196's files, they read as None and both columns. - Rank 0 writes, then a barrier. 5. Assembly (test_p2_assembly, generalised): - Required node set: DEFAULT_NODES_MHZ for both columns. For cu it is ASSEMBLY5_NODES_MHZ = (62.0, 63.2, 64.5, 65.8, 67.0), imported from test_ans7_sparse_route_b (entry 24's set, licensed at the ragged mesh by item 173). - It reads only JSONs at this run's (degree, resolution, columns). It asserts one degree, one cell count, κ None and one resolution. - _loo takes columns=("cu", "pec") as its default, so the unset path is byte-identical. sparse_rows is called with columns=cols. - Asserts: one − → + zero per column, k-share > K_SHARE_FLOOR, and Δ_LOO ≤ BANDS. With five nodes there are three interior drops, so the interpolants have four nodes. - Prints: - the rows; - B₅ = ceil_1sf(max(3·Δ_LOO, 1e-6)); - Im Y_in at every node; - the 3-node control (CONTROL_NODES_MHZ) against the set; - the per-node solve time; - summed ru_maxrss (the 06_…py:300 idiom); - when res is set, the h-move (rung − ×1)/×1 of f₀ / R_in / Q, against ANS7_EXACT_STRIP_ROUTE_B_ROWS_P2["cu"] and against the ×1 five-node Cu rows from the stored JSONs. 6. (F) at a resolution. - Unset: today's (F), unchanged. - Set: - all four N_i = SPEC_AREA_M2 and w = SPEC_WIDTH_M within STRIP_BAND (CAD rectangles, independent of h; asserted); - the tie's cells equal the ladder's cells exactly (asserted: the tie measured the mesh the ladder solved); - cells differ from ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_HOLE_CELL_RECORD by more than CELL_COUNT_BAND (asserted: (N-wire) below). 7. Record constant, registered before W0. ANS7_EXACT_STRIP_ROUTE_B_ROWS_P2 comes from item 196 W3 (20261003T124814Z_ANS-7-item196-W3-p2.log:2189,2193, full repr): - Cu: f₀ 62701081.93936459 Hz, R_in 18441.754600739256 Ω, Q 977.2613699232847; - PEC: 62714806.5966287 Hz, 32123.932870177392 Ω, 1701.733130785279.

It carries a version-tag comment (complex 0.11 image, -n 8) and the (1*) note. If item 217 landed first, reuse its constant of the same name.

New test_r2_p2_rows_record: at degree 2, resolution unset, both columns, once the assembly has run, rows vs record ≤ NODE_S_RTOL (1e-9; item 173's solved-vs-JSON precedent measured 3.4e-11). This is the "unset digit-identical" assertion. The relative differences are printed. 8. The Cu-only five-node licence at ×1. New pure test_p2_cu5_subset_anchor, which needs ROUTE=B and runs no solve. When the seven ×1 two-column p2 JSONs exist (else skip): - the five-node Cu rows vs the seven-node Cu rows ≤ BANDS (asserted); - the five-node Δ_LOO ≤ BANDS (asserted), with B₅ printed; - the 3-node control, printed.

Anchors (asserted; every band imported, none restated): - (F); - per node (B); - the assembly's identity on the rung; - (R2) at ×1; - (S5), the ×1 Cu-5 licence.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (N-wire): asserted, structural, no factor. Rung cells ≠ the ×1 record beyond CELL_COUNT_BAND. A knob that never reaches the mesh reproduces 80 798 cells and item 196's rows. The same generator path moved 80 181 → 226 642 cells at h = 0.0075 on the ragged sibling (20260923T093956Z_ANS-6-step2b-b-h0p0075-d1-64MHz.log:950). - (N3): predicted, printed. The 3-node Cu control misses B on R_in or Q at ×1 (exact p2) and on the rung. - It is backed only on other sets: ragged p2_kin 3.474e-6 / 2.240e-6 (20261002T111756Z_ANS-7-item173-W1.log), so the thin side is 2.2×. - It has never been measured on exact sheets, so it is not asserted. - It is an interpolation error, not a saturating fraction, so no ceiling applies.

Predictions (written first, printed): - (R2): relative ≤ 1e-11. W0 runs at item 196's -n 8; one node is re-solved and six are read. - (S5) at ×1: |row₅ − row₇|/|row₇| ≈ 1e-12 / 1e-10 / 3e-10 (item 173's ragged p2_kin: 1.233e-12 / 1.267e-10 / 2.780e-10). Five-node Δ_LOO ≈ 1e-9 / 4e-8 / 3e-8 (item 173 W3: 6.5e-10 / 3.6e-8 / 2.8e-8). - Rung h = 0.01 price (scaled from the measured ×1 and h = 0.005 points, below): - cells in [135 000, 175 000]; - degree-2 unknowns ≈ 6.6 × cells; - Cu sweep per node at -n 12 in [95, 175] s; - mesh 30–40 s; - summed ru_maxrss in [30, 60] GiB. - h-move against ×1 (degree 2, Cu): f₀ in [−0.5 %, +0.5 %]; R_in and Q in [−10 %, +10 %]; k-share ≥ 0.9999; Im Y_in(62.0 MHz) < 0; one crossing. Rung Δ_LOO(5) ≤ 1e-7.

Price, measured. - ×1, degree 2, -n 8, 80 798 cells: - PEC sweep 52.9–62.2 s and Cu sweep 44.3–50.0 s per node; - mesh 22–23 s; - fixed cost ≈ 78 s per window (418.7 s total − 340.6 s solve, 20261003T123356Z_ANS-7-item196-W1-p2.log:2025–2156,2255); - summed ru_maxrss 13.78 GiB for three degree-2 factorisations (20260921T100022Z_ANS-6-step2-degree2-64MHz.log:942). - h = 0.005, degree 2, -n 16: 523 816 cells, 3 466 952 unknowns, Cu sweep 1 302.3 s, memory.peak 286.5 GB (20260929T070008Z_ANS-6-step2c.log:961,1026,1037,1045). - Ragged hole mesh at h = 0.0075: 226 642 cells, mesh 46.9 s. - Scaling between the two degree-2 points: wall ∝ N^≈1.9, memory ∝ N^≈1.6. - Consequence for h = 0.0075: unknowns ≈ 1.5 M; a Cu node ≈ 300–400 s at -n 12 and ≈ 75 GiB. Five Cu nodes come to ≈ 1 700–2 100 s, over the 1 200 s heavy ceiling. So 0.0075 fails the sizing criterion on prediction, and the probe starts at 0.01.

Windows (bare, whole, foreground; Bash timeout: 660000; -s; tests/environment first; FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1; every window ≤ 590 s, so §5.1 durable capture is not needed). The five-node Cu grid does not fit one ≤ 590 s foreground window at the predicted price: 5 × (95–175) s plus ≈ 150 s fixed exceeds 590 s. "Fits one heavy window" is therefore read against the 1 200 s tier ceiling, and the nodes are run in split windows.

Before W0, on the host, back up the stored set: cp -a logs/ans7_exact logs/ans7_exact.item196. The path is gitignored. W0 overwrites node_62.0_p2.json with its reproduction; on a red, restore it from the copy. - W0, the ×1 reproduction (-n 8, knob unset, ≈ 200–260 s): node 62.0 MHz, both columns. The assembly then runs on the seven JSONs, and (R2), (S5) and the window-edge guard are checked.

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-7-item214-W0-x1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1 FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_ROUTE=B FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_DEGREE=2 FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_MHZ=62.0 timeout -k 30 400 mpiexec -n 8 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py -v -s --tb=short'" - W0b, rule (a) for _hole_rung (≈ 100 s): item 193 W1's command verbatim (20261003T095457Z_ANS-6-item193-W1-mesh.log:12; 19 passed, 15 skipped, 97 s), labelled ANS-7-item214-W0b-ans6mesh. The pass set must be the same. - W1, the cost probe (-n 12, h = 0.01, Cu, node 62.0, ≈ 200–330 s):

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-7-item214-W1-probe "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1 FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_ROUTE=B FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_DEGREE=2 FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_RESOLUTION=0.01 FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_COLUMNS=cu FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_MHZ=62.0 timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 12 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py -v -s --tb=short'"

Rung rule. t is the Cu sweep wall time at 62.0 MHz, from TH-14's "sweep … s" line. The chosen h is written into the outcome before W2. - t ≤ 85 s: 0.0075 is predicted to fit (≈ 2.35× per node). Run W1b, W1 at RESOLUTION=0.0075, labelled …-W1b-probe. Take 0.0075 if its t ≤ 200 s; otherwise keep 0.01. - 85 s < t ≤ 200 s: h = 0.01 is the rung. 5 × 200 s + 2 meshes + ≈ 80 s fixed ≤ 1 200 s, so the five-node Cu grid fits one heavy window. - t > 200 s: run W1b at 0.0125. If that is still > 200 s, stop: BLOCKED, with both prices. - Summed ru_maxrss > 100 GiB at any probe: stop, BLOCKED (128 G container). - The window-edge guard is red (Im Y_in(62.0) ≥ 0): stop. The rung's f₀ has left the window below 62 MHz, and that bound is the finding (the review re-poses the grid; entry 28 stays PENDING). - The probe's node JSON is the rung's 62.0 MHz node. It is never re-solved. - W2 (≈ 2t + 150 s): W1's command at the chosen h with FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_MHZ=63.2,64.5, labelled ANS-7-item214-W2-rung. - W3 (≈ 2t + 160 s): MHZ=65.8,67.0, labelled ANS-7-item214-W3-rung. The assembly runs here. - If the chosen h has t > 210 s (possible only on the 0.0075 branch), run one node per window (W2a/W2b/W3a/W3b), still with no edit. - No edit to the module after W0 (rule (i)). The rung is chosen by the knob value only. - If the slot reaches minute 50 before W3: park per rule (d) — the node JSONs stand, and the §9 line says which nodes remain. The next slot runs only the remaining windows, with no edit.

Traps already paid for. - Item 157's rank-0 KeyError (pec_column=False with field_solve=True): guarded by code step 3. - κ stays None on every spec; no ans:7 _stage_* / _assemble / _write_outputs call. - Write only under logs/ans7_exact/, never logs/ans7/ or logs/ans7_sparse/ (entry 24's files). - Item 196's seven JSONs are the ×1 comparand and T21's (item 217's) input. Never delete them, and never let a rung run write the unsuffixed names. - cell_tags.values and assemble_scalar are rank-local. Rows are computed on every rank; rank 0 writes. - No ordering comparison or sqrt on complex operands. - A window killed at its timeout is not a result. Run pgrep -c python3 in the container first, then report; never lengthen the timeout. Run the orphan-.c sweep only when that count reads 0. - Harness calls are bare and whole. No -k selection inside the quoted command. - No slot writes or edits an xl command.

Scope. Covered: one intermediate rung, degree 2, Cu, five nodes, κ off, exact rectangles; plus the ×1 reproduction and the ×1 five-node licence. Not covered: - the PEC column on the rung; - (L) on the rung (it needs the field solve, hence the PEC column); - Route A on the rung; - h = 0.005, which is entry 28's; - a record constant for the rung's rows (a follow-up for the review, to avoid an edit after the last window); - the T13 / T6 re-read and any private comparison (the weekly's); - any band; - any claim about the absolute f₀, Q or R_in, or about convergence. Two rungs are not an h-statement.

Status it can move. - The ANS-7 row gains a "step 6" record sentence (no glyph; the row's Done-when is the weekly's T13 re-read after T12′). - xl entry 28 PENDING PREREQUISITE → READY. The implementer landing this item green marks entry 28 READY in the same commit, naming the knobs (FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_ROUTE=B, _DEGREE=2, _RESOLUTION=0.005, _COLUMNS=cu, _MHZ=62.0,63.2,64.5,65.8,67.0) and the rung's measured per-node price. It does not issue, write or edit entry 28's command; the next review issues it. READY by the 2026-10-07 18:00 review ⇒ entry 28 takes entry 24's night (10-08). - Rule (j): the review adds a step-6 Done-when sentence to the row.

Negative result. - (R2) red: the knob changed the unset path. Restore the JSON backup, revert, BLOCKED. - (S5) red: the Cu-only five-node path is unlicensed at ×1 on exact sheets. BLOCKED, and entry 28 stays PENDING. The review picks six or seven Cu nodes (entry 24's own fallback). - (F) or (N-wire) red: BLOCKED. - Rung (B) red, crossings ≠ 1, or the rung's Δ_LOO above BANDS: print the rows as unlicensed and stop, BLOCKED. Entry 28 stays PENDING, and the review re-poses the grid. - h-move outside its predicted ranges with every assertion green: a record, not a red. Report it, and the weekly reads it. - No PREDICTED RED: line.

Outcome (2026-10-04 06:00 slot): DONE, green. W0 ×1 reproduction 18 passed (R2 ≤ 2.15e-12 vs record; seven-node Δ_LOO 6.3e-13 / 1.6e-9 / 1.6e-9); W0b ANS-6 exact mesh 20 passed / 14 skipped (item 193's set plus M7, now running against its since-registered record); (S5) five- vs seven-node Cu ≤ 2.2e-12 / 9.2e-10 / 6.6e-10, five-node Δ_LOO 6.5e-10 / 3.5e-8 / 2.7e-8, B₅ = 1e-6. W1 probe t = 155.4 s ⇒ rung h = 0.01 (W1b not run): 140 270 cells, 968 016 unknowns, (N-wire) cell ratio 1.736, sheets exact to 8.9e-16; Cu sweep 143.5–159.8 s per node at -n 12, mesh 53.6–55.4 s (over the predicted 30–40 s), summed ru_maxrss 32.8–36.5 GiB. Rung Cu rows f₀ 62 726 846.660 Hz, R_in 18 313.602 Ω, Q 970.439, k-share 0.99999176, one crossing (Im Y_in −1.22e-3 S at 62.0 → +8.03e-4 S at 63.2), Δ_LOO 6.5e-10 / 3.8e-8 / 3.1e-8. h-move vs ×1: f₀ +0.0411 %, R_in −0.6949 %, Q −0.6981 % (inside predictions). (N3) missed as predicted (printed). The box ran ≈ 1.4× slow (W0 Cu sweep 70.9 s vs 44–50 s); W2 used 536 s of 590. Logs 20261004T110446Z_ANS-7-item214-W0-x1.log, …111046Z_…-W0b-ans6mesh.log, …111415Z_…-W1-probe.log, …112040Z_…-W2-rung.log, …112945Z_…-W3-rung.log. xl entry 28 → READY (Status line only).

docs.title: §9 item 217 — 2026-10-04 (chain T21)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-04 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §10 chain T21 (weekly 2026-10-03), whose target is quoted, not changed: "the capacitor that puts the k = 1 mode at 64.000 MHz, from the k = 1 block of the degree-2 exact 4×4 (PORT-22's C_mode construction), then the in-model sweep with that C: the zero of Im Y_in within the sparse grid's own band of 64 MHz and circuit = field at REDUCTION_BAND. Target: circuit ↔ field identity." The ruling binds: exact rectangles, κ off. No band, tolerance, Done-when or validation target moves.

ANS-7 step 7: tune the exact-sheet F-small birdcage to 64.000 MHz at degree 2 on the ×1 mesh, then check the tuning in-model. - Executor: implementer. Tests only, plus two additive keywords (disclosed). - Tier: heavy, -n 8, complex build. - Class: chain step (solve). Time: ≈ 18 measured / 45 predicted min. - Depends on nothing. It shares the module with item 214; whichever lands second rebases onto the first.

Where the pieces live (verified 2026-10-04). - The C_mode construction. It is TH-17 step 3's, at tests/validation/test_th17_birdcage_eigenmodes.py:1093–1100 (repeated in examples/ports/20_birdcage_eigenmodes.py:191–200): zk, off = _modal_z(Z) (:846, diag of F Z Fᴴ with the 4-point DFT), z₁ = ½(zk[1] + zk[3]), assert Im z₁ > 0, then C_mode = 1/(ω₆₄ · Im z₁). It is the capacitance that zeroes the k = 1 loop reactance z₁ + 1/(jωC) at 64 MHz. The SPEC's 66.29 pF is that number at degree 1, rounded (SPEC.md:80–83). - tests/validation/test_port22_driven_sweep_resonance.py contains no C_mode; its C is PORT-15's C_tuned (build_c_tuned, :189). The chain's attribution to PORT-22 refers to this construction, and the brief uses TH-17's lines (imported _modal_z; the two formula lines restated with that cite). - ports/ring_modes.k_blocks is the 32-port version and does not apply to four ports. - REDUCTION_BAND = 1e-3 is defined at tests/validation/test_port_lumped_rlc_termination.py:88 (PORT-14's pre-stated band). The exact module imports it through test_port_circuit_layer_field. - BANDS = 1e-6 on f₀ / R_in / Q is defined at tests/validation/test_ans7_sparse_route_b.py:93. This is "the sparse grid's own band": |f₀/64 MHz − 1| ≤ 1e-6, i.e. 64 Hz. - The degree-2 exact 4×4 is persisted at seven nodes, not at 64.0 MHz. - Location: logs/ans7_exact/node_{62.0,62.3,63.2,64.5,65.8,66.7,67.0}_p2.json (gitignored, on disk, written 2026-10-03 07:40–07:54 CDT by item 196 W1–W3). - Contents: cells 80 798, the tie, S and Z for both columns, κ null. On disk, route_a_p1.json / route_b_p1.json (item 195) are there too. - No 64.0 MHz node exists. TH-17's construction uses a 4×4 solved at 64 MHz, so W1 solves it: one degree-2 node, both columns, ≈ 112 s at -n 8. - The network Z does not depend on C (only the circuit does), so the seven stored nodes serve any C. If they are absent, stop: re-running item 196 costs ≈ 21 min.

Code (tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py; two additive keywords, both defaults byte-identical; no src/, no TH-14 edit): 1. The additive keywords. - c_f=C_F on sparse_rows (test_ans7_sparse_route_b.py:321), forwarded to route_b_z. - degree=1 on ans:7's _route_a_solve (07_…py:515, which today hard-codes degree=1 at :540), forwarded to run_lumped_sheet_port_case. ans:7 itself is not run. - metrics.json and COMPARISON.md stay untouched (git diff --stat). - Each keyword is covered by a wiring control: (N1) for c_f and (W) for degree. 2. Knob FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE ∈ {cmode, inmodel}. Unset ⇒ the new tests skip; anything else raises ValueError. It uses FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_DEGREE (2 here), and ROUTE is left unset in both windows. Constants: - TUNE_TARGET_HZ = 64.0e6; - TUNE_MHZ = (63.9, 64.0, 64.1), three GRID_MHZ points, so Route A and Route B are read on the same 0.1 MHz bracket. 3. ANS7_EXACT_STRIP_ROUTE_B_ROWS_P2: item 196's rows at full repr, as in item 214's brief, code step 7. Reuse it if item 214 landed first. 4. tune_cmode fixture (W1). - Fail if the seven ×1 p2 JSONs are absent or inconsistent (degree, cells, κ). - Run _fixture_tie(), then th14._build_ladder(2, sigmas=(th14.COPPER_SIGMA,), frequencies_hz=[64.0e6], width_correction_kappa=None, measure_kappa=False, pec_column=True, field_solve=False, leg_sheet_strip_fraction=GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION). Per column, Z64 = z_from_s(S). - Apply the construction to Cu (the tuned coil's capacitor) and to PEC (printed). Print off, |z₁ − z₃|/|z₁|, all z_k and C_mode. - Printed beside it: the entrywise max |Z64_interp − Z64|/|Z64|, where Z64_interp = bary_interp of the seven stored nodes at 64.0 MHz. - Printed diagnostic: C_in, the C that zeroes Im Y_in(64.0 MHz) on the full solved Cu 4×4, i.e. the root of g(C) = Im[1/route_b_z(Z64, 64e6, C)[0]]. It is found by secant from C_mode on a real-valued g, to |g| ≤ 1e-15 S in ≤ 20 iterations. Print (C_mode − C_in)/C_in: the k = 1-block construction's own offset, against the full network. - Route B at C_mode: sparse_rows(DEFAULT_NODES_MHZ, z_nodes, columns=("cu", "pec"), c_f=C_mode_cu) on the stored nodes; Δ_LOO via _loo with c_f. - Rank 0 writes logs/ans7_exact/tune_p2.json: C_mode per column, C_in, z_k, Z64 per column, the rows at C_mode, cells, degree. Then a barrier. 5. tune_inmodel fixture (W2). - Read tune_p2.json and fail if it is absent or its degree differs. C_mode is read from the JSON, never recomputed. - Build geo as route_a's _geo(GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION), plus _fixture_tie(). - (W) first: _route_a_solve(th14, geo, specs, 64.0e6, "cu") (defaults: degree 1, C_F). Compare its residual against stored Route B (route_b_p1.json, at 64.0 MHz) and against route_a_p1.json["residual"]["cu"][j64] (item 195 W2 printed 1.409e-5 there). - Then, for each g in TUNE_MHZ: s_a, _ = _route_a_solve(th14, geo, specs, g*1e6, "cu", c_f=C_mode, degree=2). - The Route B comparand is _s11_from_z(route_b_z(bary_interp(xn, z_nodes_cu, g − 64.5), g*1e6, C_mode)[1]). At 64.0 MHz the comparand from the solved Z64 is printed beside it. - Z_in,A = add_c1(_z_from_s11(s_a), ω, C_mode). - Read f₀,A, R_in,A and Q,A from parallel_rows(TUNE_MHZ·1e6, Z_in,A). - (N2) is pure circuit: _s11_from_z(route_b_z(Z64_cu, 64e6, 0.5·C_mode)[1]) against the 64.0 MHz in-model S11 at C_mode. - Rank 0 writes tune_inmodel_p2.json.

Anchors (asserted; bands imported): - (C): Im z₁(64.0 MHz) > 0 (TH-17's assert); per-column reciprocity ≤ RECIPROCITY_BAND and σ_max ≤ 1 + PASSIVITY_SIGMA_TOLERANCE at 64.0 MHz. - (T1) Route B at C_mode, both columns: exactly one − → + zero, k-share > K_SHARE_FLOOR, Δ_LOO ≤ BANDS. This is the grid's licence at the new C. Also printed: |f₀,B/64 MHz − 1| for Cu, plus R_in, Q and k-share at C_mode. - (AB) circuit = field, degree 2, Cu: |S11_A − S11_B|/|S11_B| ≤ REDUCTION_BAND at all three TUNE_MHZ points. This is the chain's stated target identity, and it has never been measured at degree 2. Item 195's degree-1 measurement on exact sheets was 9.9e-6 … 3.11e-5. - (T2) the in-model zero: exactly one − → + crossing of Im Y_in,A in (63.9, 64.1) MHz, and |f₀,A/64 MHz − 1| ≤ BANDS["f0_hz"].

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (N1): asserted, backed by item 196 W3 :2189 (same fixture, same comparison). - At C = C_F (66.29 pF) the stored-node rows reproduce ANS7_EXACT_STRIP_ROUTE_B_ROWS_P2 within NODE_S_RTOL; this is the wiring of c_f. - |f₀(C_F)/64 MHz − 1| = 2.03e-2 > N_FACTOR × BANDS["f0_hz"]. Without the tuning the zero sits ≈ 2 × 10⁴ bands from 64 MHz, so (T2) is not vacuous. - (W): asserted, |Δresidual| ≤ NODE_S_RTOL (absolute) against item 195's stored 64.0 MHz Cu point. It is a deterministic re-solve on the same mesh, with rank-count round-off ≈ 1e-13. A changed default degree or C would move the residual by ≥ 1e-4. - (N2): predicted, printed. The circuit at 0.5·C_mode against the in-model at C_mode, 64.0 MHz Cu, is ≥ 10× REDUCTION_BAND. ans:7's control (i) measured 483.6× at degree 1 on ragged sheets (20260929T100040Z_ANS-7-item68-W3-A.log), a different degree and sheet, hence predicted. The ceiling is |ΔS|/|S| ≲ 2, i.e. 2 000× the band, so no saturation.

Predictions (written first, printed): - C_mode,Cu in [63.4, 63.8] pF. This is C_F·(62.701082/64)² = 63.62 pF, less the ≈ 6e-4 L_eff dispersion that TH-17 step 3 noted. (C_mode,PEC − C_mode,Cu)/C_mode,Cu ≈ +4e-4. Off-diagonal ≤ 1e-6; interpolated-vs-solved Z64 ≤ 1e-8. - (C_mode − C_in)/C_in in [1e-7, 5e-5]. The estimate G²X_bg/(ωC) + 1/(2Q²) gives ≈ 3e-7 – 1e-6 (G ≈ 1/(2 R_in) ≈ 2.7e-5 S; X_bg is the k = 0 / 2 background, of order 10–100 Ω). The degree-1 pair (TH-17's 66.2877 pF → ans:7 PEC f₀ 63.997103 MHz at 66.29 pF) reads ≈ 2.8e-5 after rounding, but on sheets that are not matched. - |f₀,B/64 MHz − 1| in [1e-7, 5e-5], printed only. Tuned rows at C_mode: R_in and Q within ±10 % of item 196's (18 441.75 Ω / 977.26); k-share ≥ 0.9999. - (AB) in [5e-6, 3e-4] at every point. - f₀,A − f₀,B ≈ −3e-6 relative: item 195 measured Route A 63.970953 MHz against Route B 63.971138 MHz on exact sheets at degree 1 (W2 / W3), the same fixture and the same identity. - Pre-registered negative. The in-model zero is expected to miss the 64 Hz band by the A–B gap plus the construction's offset:

PREDICTED RED: (T2) |f₀,A/64 MHz − 1| ≤ BANDS["f0_hz"] range [1e-6, 5e-5]

The one-crossing half of (T2) is predicted green.

Windows (-n 8; bare, whole, foreground; Bash timeout: 660000; -s; tests/environment first; FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1; no ROUTE; each window < 10 min). - Price: - degree-2 PEC / Cu sweeps 52.9–62.2 / 44.3–50.0 s per node at -n 8 (20261003T123356Z_ANS-7-item196-W1-p2.log:2025–2148); - one degree-2 in-model drive (run_lumped_sheet_port_case, the Route A call), costed as the degree-2 P1 field solve, 44.9 s (20260921T100022Z_ANS-6-step2-degree2-64MHz.log:924); - mesh 22–23 s; - fixed ≈ 78 s. - W1 (≈ 180–240 s): the 64.0 MHz node (PEC + Cu ≈ 112 s), two meshes, C_mode, C_in, (C), (T1), (N1).

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-7-item217-W1-cmode "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1 FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_DEGREE=2 FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE=cmode timeout -k 30 400 mpiexec -n 8 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py -v -s --tb=short'" - W2 (≈ 230–320 s): three degree-2 drives plus one degree-1 drive for (W), two meshes; then (AB), (T2), (W), (N2).

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-7-item217-W2-inmodel "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1 FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_DEGREE=2 FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE=inmodel timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 8 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py -v -s --tb=short'" - No edit after W1 (rule (i)).
