Traps already paid for. - Items 195 / 196's traps all apply: - item 157's rank-0 KeyError (W1 runs pec_column=True, field_solve=False); - κ None everywhere; - no ans:7 _stage_* / _assemble / _write_outputs call, and ans:7 is not run; - logs/ans7_exact/ only. - _route_a_solve's Cu column builds its own Leontovich term on outer_tags. Pass degree through and change nothing else in it. - Item 69's drafting error: never feed the sweep's z_matrix (the terminated transimpedance) to the Z route. Use z_from_s(S) only. - The secant for C_in runs on the real scalar g. No ordering comparison or sqrt on complex operands. - Never write to item 196's seven node files; this item only reads them. - Rows are computed on every rank; rank 0 writes, then a barrier. - A killed window is not a result: pgrep -c python3, report, never lengthen the timeout. - Harness calls are bare and whole. -s on every window.

Scope. Covered: the ×1 exact-sheet mesh (h = 0.015), degree 2, κ off, the Cu column tuned (PEC printed at Cu's C_mode), Route B on the stored seven-node grid, and Route A at three FineWindow points around 64 MHz. What T21 does not claim: - no absolute tuned f₀, Q, R_in or C. T6 and T13 stay open, and the h-rung (T12′, entry 28) has not landed. The tuned C is a ×1-mesh, degree-2 number, and its h-move is unmeasured; - not the 51-point degree-2 Route A (102 drives, xl-class); - not the eigen route (TH-17's pencil at C_mode is not run); - not 127.74 MHz (T22); - no change to the SPEC's C, which stays 66.29 pF for the AED side; - no AED or Palace comparison.

Status it can move. - The ANS-7 row gains a "step 7" record sentence: C_mode at degree 2 on exact sheets, the first degree-2 Route A = Route B, and the in-model zero's offset from 64 MHz. No glyph; the row's Done-when is the weekly's T13 re-read after T12′. - T22 (127.74 MHz) becomes queueable, using either C_mode or C_in per the review's reading of (T2). - Rule (j): the review adds a step-7 Done-when sentence.

Negative result. - (C) red (Im z₁ ≤ 0), or (N1) / (W) red: BLOCKED. For (W), revert the keyword. - (T1) red (≠ 1 crossing at C_mode, or Δ_LOO above BANDS): BLOCKED, and the review re-poses the grid around 64 MHz. - (AB) red with (W) green: the degree-2 in-model and circuit routes disagree on exact sheets at κ = 0. Print the three residuals, open a known-issues entry ("degree-2 exact-rectangle Route A ≠ Route B"), park on attempt/*, BLOCKED. Never apply κ to rescue it. - (T2)'s band half red inside [1e-6, 5e-5] with everything else green: the pre-registered negative. It is a record: the k = 1-block C_mode puts the in-model zero within x of 64 MHz, with C_in and f₀,A − f₀,B printed beside it so the offset is split into construction and route parts. The slot continues and commits DONE (a record). The review decides what T22 tunes with. - (T2) red outside the range, or no crossing in (63.9, 64.1) MHz: the construction does not tune this fixture. Report the measurement and stop, BLOCKED.

Outcome (2026-10-04, 09:00 CDT slot): BLOCKED, predicted red, inside range (the pre-registered negative). The brief says to commit this as DONE (a record), but implementer-run.md step 2 parks a pre-registered negative like an incomplete item. The slot followed the protocol. Code is on attempt/ANS-7-step7-20261004T1413Z (84da27b7). The logs and test-results rows are on main. If the review rules it a record, it lands the branch as is. - Logs. W1 20261004T140347Z_ANS-7-item217-W1-cmode.log: 15 passed, 16 skipped, 215 s. W2 20261004T140738Z_ANS-7-item217-W2-inmodel.log: 14 passed, 16 skipped, 1 failed, 261 s. Both at -n 8, with no kill. The box ran at normal speed (Cu sweep 46.8 s). No edit after W1 (modules 14:03:21Z, W1 start 14:03:47Z). - (C) green. Im z₁ is +39.107 Ω (Cu) and +39.090 Ω (PEC). Reciprocity ≤ 1.94e-15, σ_max 0.999901 / 0.999917, 80 798 cells. - (T1) green. Cu has one crossing at 64 000 470.55 Hz and PEC one at 64 014 337.03 Hz. k-share 0.9999949 / 0.9999974. Δ_LOO ≤ 1.92e-9. - (AB) green. 1.237e-5 / 1.258e-5 / 1.287e-5 at 63.9 / 64.0 / 64.1 MHz. This is the first degree-2 circuit = field reading. - (N1) green. The rows at C_F are within 2.2e-12, and untuned |f₀/64 − 1| = 2.0296e-2. - (W) green. Δresidual = 2.77e-14. - (T2). One crossing (green) at f₀,A = 64 000 308.55 Hz. |f₀,A/64 MHz − 1| = 4.821e-6 is red, inside the predicted [1e-6, 5e-5]. - Records. C_mode,Cu = 63.589141 pF (prediction met). (PEC − Cu)/Cu = +4.406e-4. C_in = 63.590091 pF, so (C_mode − C_in)/C_in = −1.495e-5: inside the range, but well above the 3e-7 – 1e-6 estimate. |f₀,B/64 − 1| = 7.352e-6. Rows at C_mode: R_in 18 668.70 Ω (+1.23 %), Q 969.21 (−0.82 %). Route A: R_in 18 739.36 Ω, Q 972.90. f₀,A − f₀,B = −2.53e-6 relative. (N2) 0.4938, which is 494× the band. - Offset split. The construction alone puts the circuit zero at +7.35e-6. The route gap of −2.53e-6 brings the in-model zero back to +4.82e-6. C_in is the candidate that tunes the full network. - Prediction missed (printed only). The k-block off-diagonal is 4.56e-6, against the predicted ≤ 1e-6.

Review disposition of item 217 (2026-10-04 10:30 daily). Landed as a record. The three code files were checked out by path from 84da27b7 (test_ans7_exact_strip.py, test_ans7_sparse_route_b.py, the ans:7 script). main had not touched them since the branch point. docs.title: §9 item 228 — 2026-10-04 (chain T22)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-04 10:30 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §10 chain T22 (weekly 2026-10-03), quoted, not changed: "T21 at 127.74 MHz (3 T). Serial on T21." T21's construction and target therefore carry over verbatim with 64.000 → 127.74 MHz: the capacitor from the k = 1 block of the degree-2 exact 4×4 (TH-17 step 3's C_mode), Route B at that C, the in-model sweep with that C, the zero of Im Y_in within BANDS of the target and circuit = field at REDUCTION_BAND. Target: circuit ↔ field identity. The sheets-and-κ ruling binds (exact rectangles, κ off). No band, tolerance, Done-when or validation target moves; C_in is a printed record and never a substitute target.

ANS-7 step 8: T21's tuning construction at 127.74 MHz on the ×1 exact-sheet mesh at degree 2, then the in-model check. - Executor: implementer. Tests only (tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py), plus one additive keyword on a helper of the same module (disclosed). No src/, no ans:7 edit, no TH-14 edit. - Tier: heavy, -n 8 (the record width of T21 and item 196), complex build. - Class: chain step (solve). Time: ≈ 18 measured / 50 predicted min. - Depends on item 217's T21 section being on main (the 2026-10-04 10:30 review lands attempt/ANS-7-step7-20261004T1413Z). If TUNE_TARGET_HZ is not in the module on main, stop and take the next item.

What T21 measured, and why (T2) is pre-registered red (item 217's outcome above; 20261004T140347Z_ANS-7-item217-W1-cmode.log:2084–2095, 20261004T140738Z_ANS-7-item217-W2-inmodel.log:2046–2052). - The in-model zero sat at |f₀,A/64 MHz − 1| = 4.821e-6 against the 1e-6 band (64 Hz). It has two parts: - construction (c): the k = 1-block C_mode puts the Route B zero at +7.352e-6, i.e. −½ (C_mode − C_in)/C_in with (C_mode − C_in)/C_in = −1.495e-5; - route gap (r): f₀,A − f₀,B = −2.531e-6 (degree 1 on the same exact sheets: −2.9e-6, item 195 W2 / W3). - C_in does not rescue (T2) on its own. C_in zeroes Im Y_in on the circuit at the target by construction, so f₀,B(C_in) sits on the target to interpolation error (≈ 1e-10). The in-model zero then sits at the route gap r alone: at 64 MHz that reads ≈ −2.5e-6, which is still outside the 1e-6 band. The slot's hypothesis ("C_in tunes the full network") is right for the circuit and wrong for the in-model zero. This item measures that (a printed record, code step 6) and never swaps C_in in for C_mode. - How c and r scale to 127.74 MHz. Two hypotheses, printed and discriminated by the reading: - c flat. The absolute k-block coupling over Im z₁ is flat 64 → 128 MHz on ans:6's tracked degree-1 4×4 (≈ 3.9e-4 at both; z_from_s + 4-point DFT on ans6_…/metrics.json "rungs", computed for this brief). Then c ≈ +7.4e-6. - c tracks the printed off-diagonal. That metric grows ×2.47 64 → 128 MHz on ANS-4's degree-2 exact records (ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_S_P2_X1: 8.0e-6 → 2.0e-5) and ×4.2 on ans:6's degree-1 records (1.27e-5 → 5.35e-5). Then c ≈ +1.8e-5 … +3.1e-5. - r is allowed ×1–4 growth with f: [−1e-5, −2.5e-6]. The degree-1 exact (AB) residual grew ×3.1 across the 62–67 MHz window alone (item 195 W2). - So |c + r| lies in ≈ [0, 4.9e-6] if c is flat and ≈ [0.8e-5, 2.9e-5] if c tracks. A cancellation below 1e-6 is possible under the flat hypothesis. That is green, not red, and is reported as such.

The capacitor, and its priors (computed for this brief from tracked, public records — our numbers only). - ans:6 degree-1 ragged 4×4 (metrics.json "rungs", Cu): C_mode 66.258 pF at 64 MHz (TH-17's 66.2877 pF, consistent) and 15.811 pF at 128 MHz. Ratio 0.23863, so L₁ grows +4.8 %. - ANS-4 exact records (σ = 800 S/m solid fixture, not the copper hole; a prior only): - the 128/64 C_mode ratio is 0.24544 at degree 1 and 0.24310 at degree 2, so the degree factor on the ratio is ×0.9905; - the order move on C_mode grows from −6.0 % (64 MHz) to −6.9 % (128 MHz). - Prediction: 63.589 pF × 0.23863 × 0.9905 × (128/127.74)² ≈ 15.09 pF from the same fixture. The ANS-4 degree-2 ratio alone gives 15.52 pF. C_mode,Cu(127.74) in [14.8, 15.6] pF, so Im z₁ is in [79.8, 84.2] Ω. - Inside the capacitor range the fixture has used. SPEC v1's 15.57 pF on three gaps (item 50, degree 1, ragged, bare feed: a different circuit, which put a series zero at 66.3 MHz) and v2's 66.29 pF bracket it. C enters only the circuit layer (Route B) and the sheet impedance Z_C (Route A). |Z_C| ≈ 82 Ω at 127.74 MHz against ≈ 39 Ω at 64 MHz, on a 50 Ω reference, so this is no new conditioning regime. - No mode crowding. k = 2 with C ≈ 15.1 pF resonates near 161 MHz (Im z₂ ≈ 51.5 Ω at 128 MHz on ans:6), +26 % against +22 % at 64 MHz. k = 0 is capacitive (z₀ ≈ −567j Ω). k-share ≥ 0.9999 is predicted.

Code (tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py only; with the knob unset, every T21 code path and object is used as is, byte-identical): 1. Knob FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE_MHZ ∈ {unset, 127.74}. Any other value raises ValueError; it is not a free frequency. - Unset ⇒ T21's objects verbatim: TUNE_TARGET_HZ, TUNE_MHZ, DEFAULT_NODES_MHZ, GRID_MHZ, both columns, and the files logs/ans7_exact/tune_p2.json / tune_inmodel_p2.json / item 196's node_*_p2.json. Do not recompute them from offsets: 64.0 + (62.3 − 64.0) is not guaranteed to be 62.3 in floating point. - 127.74 ⇒ literal constants, registered before W1: - TUNE128_TARGET_HZ = 127.74e6; - TUNE128_MHZ = (127.64, 127.74, 127.84); - TUNE128_NODES_MHZ = (125.74, 126.04, 126.94, 128.24, 129.54, 130.44, 130.74). This is DEFAULT_NODES_MHZ + 63.74: the same offsets from the target as T21's nodes from 64.0, a 5 MHz window with the target 2.0 MHz above its low edge; - TUNE128_GRID_MHZ = tuple(round(125.74 + 0.1 * k, 6) for k in range(51)), which contains the three TUNE128_MHZ points (k = 19, 20, 21). - An active-set helper returns (target, tune points, nodes, grid, out dir) for the knob. 2. New tune mode FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE=nodes (so _tune() accepts cmode, inmodel, nodes). It requires TUNE_MHZ=127.74 and raises otherwise, so item 196's 64 MHz node files are never re-solved or re-written. - Knob FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE_NODES: a comma list ⊂ TUNE128_NODES_MHZ, validated after round(…, 6). - Fixture tune_nodes: _fixture_tie(), then th14._build_ladder(2, sigmas=(th14.COPPER_SIGMA,), frequencies_hz=[m*1e6 …], width_correction_kappa=None, measure_kappa=False, pec_column=("pec" in _cols()), field_solve=False, leg_sheet_strip_fraction=GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION). The field solve is always off, so COLUMNS=cu is safe from item 157's trap. - Per node, rank 0 writes logs/ans7_exact/t127.74/node_<mhz:.2f>_p2[_cu].json, using .2f because .1f would round 125.74 to "125.7". The keys are p2_nodes' keys plus "target_mhz": 127.74. Then a barrier. - Asserted: reciprocity ≤ RECIPROCITY_BAND, σ_max ≤ 1 + PASSIVITY_SIGMA_TOLERANCE, and the tie equal to the ×1 record. - Printed: Im Y_in at C_F (predicted > 0 at every node, above the C_F resonance), the Cu sweep time and the summed ru_maxrss. 3. Additive keyword grid_mhz=GRID_MHZ on _loo, forwarded to both sparse_rows calls. The default is byte-identical. Without it, _loo on the 128 MHz nodes silently evaluates on 62–67 MHz, an extrapolation 60 MHz off the nodes. 4. tune_cmode / tune_inmodel read the active set. Replace every 64-specific literal with the active value: - _stored_x1_p2() → load the active node set: item 196's at unset; at 127.74, the t127.74/ files at _cols(), checked for degree 2, κ None, resolution None, one cell count = ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_HOLE_CELL_RECORD, and target_mhz; - assert abs(rec["f_hz"] − TUNE_TARGET_HZ) < 1.0 → the active target; - _loo(…, c_f=c_cu) / sparse_rows → grid_mhz= the active grid; - Route B rows and (T1) over _cols(); - the (T2) bracket 63.9e6 < f₀ < 64.1e6 → (tune points[0], tune points[−1]); - the prediction prints → a dict keyed by target. The 64 MHz entries are T21's text unchanged; the 127.74 entries are this brief's. - Rank 0 writes tune_p2.json / tune_inmodel_p2.json under the active out dir. T21's two JSONs are never overwritten. - The cmode window still solves the target node with both columns (pec_column=True), as T21 did: (C) on both columns and C_mode,PEC printed. - bary_interp keeps its − 64.5 centring. The barycentric weights depend only on node differences and the grid points hit nodes exactly after the same round(…, 6), so no edit is needed. 5. Controls. - (N1) is unchanged and still asserted: c_f=C_F on item 196's stored 64 MHz nodes reproduces ANS7_EXACT_STRIP_ROUTE_B_ROWS_P2. It is pure and costs milliseconds, and it is the c_f wiring at either target. - (N0) is new, at 127.74, predicted and printed: at C_F the 127.74 MHz Cu grid has no − → + zero of Im Y_in. The k = 1 zero is at 62.7 MHz and the k = 2 zero near 76 MHz. Without the tuning there is no resonance in the window. - Printed: the sensitivity |f₀,B(C_mode·(1 + 1e-5))/f₀,B(C_mode) − 1| (≈ 5e-6), so the band is shown to be resolvable. 6. C_in record in W4 (printed, never asserted, never a target). - One extra degree-2 drive at the target with c_f = C_in (read from the active tune_p2.json). - Print Im Y_in,A(target; C_in) and the estimated in-model offset δf/f ≈ −Im Y_in,A / (f · dbdf_s_per_hz), the slope taken from the C_mode rows' bracket. Label it "estimate (one drive + slope)". - Also print |S11_A(C_in) − S11_B(C_in)|/|S11_B| on the solved target 4×4. - The (W) control stays exactly as in T21: the degree-1 default drive at 64.0 MHz against item 195's stored residual.

Anchors (asserted; every band imported, none restated): T21's, at the active target. - (C): Im z₁(127.74) > 0. Per column, reciprocity ≤ RECIPROCITY_BAND and σ_max ≤ 1 + PASSIVITY_SIGMA_TOLERANCE at the target. Cells equal the stored nodes' cells. - Per node (W1, W2): reciprocity, passivity, and the (F) tie. - (T1) Route B at C_mode,Cu on the 127.74 MHz Cu grid: exactly one − → + zero, k-share > K_SHARE_FLOOR, Δ_LOO ≤ BANDS. This is the new grid's licence. - (AB) circuit = field at degree 2, Cu: |S11_A − S11_B|/|S11_B| ≤ REDUCTION_BAND at all three TUNE128_MHZ points. This is the chain's target identity and has never been measured at 3 T. - (T2) exactly one − → + crossing of Im Y_in,A in (127.64, 127.84) MHz, and |f₀,A/127.74 MHz − 1| ≤ BANDS["f0_hz"]. - (N1) and (W), as in T21.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (N1): asserted, backed by item 217 W1 :2096–2100 (≤ 4.4e-13). - (W): asserted, backed by item 217 W2 :2045 (2.77e-14). - (N0): predicted, printed. It is unmeasured at 3 T, so it is not asserted. - (N2): predicted, printed. The circuit at 0.5·C_mode against the in-model at C_mode at 127.74 MHz is ≥ 10× REDUCTION_BAND. T21 measured 494×; the ceiling |ΔS|/|S| ≲ 2 is 2 000× the band, so there is no saturation.

Predictions (written first, printed): - C_mode,Cu in [14.8, 15.6] pF. (C_mode,PEC − C_mode,Cu)/C_mode,Cu in [+1e-4, +1e-3] (T21: +4.4e-4). - k-block off-diagonal in [5e-6, 3e-5]. Interpolated-vs-solved Z at the target ≤ 1e-8. - (C_mode − C_in)/C_in: negative, |·| in [3e-6, 1e-4]. - |f₀,B/127.74 MHz − 1| in [3e-6, 5e-5], printed with its sign. - (T1): Δ_LOO ≤ 1e-9 (half T21's relative span); k-share ≥ 0.9999. Q at C_mode in [400, 2 500], printed with R_in. - (AB) in [5e-6, 3e-4] at every point. - f₀,A − f₀,B relative in [−1.5e-5, −1e-6]. - C_in record: |δf/f| in [1e-7, 2e-5]. PREDICTED RED: (T2) |f₀,A/127.74 MHz − 1| ≤ BANDS["f0_hz"] range [1e-6, 5e-5]

The one-crossing half of (T2) is predicted green. A reading ≤ 1e-6 (cancellation of c and r) is green, a record, and not a contradiction.

Windows (-n 8; bare, whole, foreground; Bash timeout: 660000; -s; tests/environment first; FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1; ROUTE unset; FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_COLUMNS=cu on all four, so the node files and their readers agree). - Price (measured at -n 8, ×1, 80 798 cells; the 4×4 factorisation cost does not depend on f): - Cu sweep 44.3–50.0 s and PEC sweep 52.9–62.2 s per node (20261003T123356Z_ANS-7-item196-W1-p2.log:2025–2148); ladder mesh 22–23 s; - window overhead ≈ 86 s (item 217 W1: 215 s total, 128.6 s solve); - one degree-2 drive 41.8–50.3 s (item 217 W2 :2052). - A ×1.4 slow box (item 214) is inside every window's 590 s. - W1 (≈ 300 s; ≈ 415 s on a slow box): nodes 125.74, 126.04, 126.94, 128.24.

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-7-item228-W1-nodes "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1 FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_DEGREE=2 FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_COLUMNS=cu FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE=nodes FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE_MHZ=127.74 FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE_NODES=125.74,126.04,126.94,128.24 timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 8 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py -v -s --tb=short'" - W2 (≈ 250 s): W1's command with TUNE_NODES=129.54,130.44,130.74, labelled ANS-7-item228-W2-nodes. - W3 (≈ 215 s, item 217 W1's measured price): TUNE=cmode, with TUNE_NODES dropped, labelled ANS-7-item228-W3-cmode. It runs (C), (T1), (N1), (N0), C_in and the predictions. - W4 (≈ 310 s; ≈ 435 s on a slow box): TUNE=inmodel, labelled ANS-7-item228-W4-inmodel. It runs (W), three C_mode drives, one C_in drive, (AB), (T2) and (N2). This is the closing window. - Totals: ≈ 1 075 s of windows (≈ 18 min). - No edit after W1 (rule (i)). If the slot reaches minute 50 before W4, park per rule (d): the node JSONs and tune_p2.json stand, and the next slot runs only the remaining windows, with no edit. - Review option: for the PEC grid at 3 T, drop COLUMNS=cu and split the nodes 2 + 2 + 2 + 1. That is +≈ 420 s and one more window. It is not the default here because (T1)'s PEC half is not the target.

Traps already paid for. - All of item 217's traps: - κ None; - no ans:7 _stage_* / _assemble / _write_outputs call, and ans:7 is not run; - z_from_s(S), never the sweep's z_matrix; - the C_in secant on the real scalar g; - rows computed on every rank, rank 0 writes, then a barrier; - a killed window is not a result: pgrep -c python3, report, never lengthen the timeout; - bare, whole harness calls, no -k selection. - New here: - Never write T21's tune_p2.json / tune_inmodel_p2.json or item 196's node_*_p2.json. All 127.74 MHz output goes under logs/ans7_exact/t127.74/. - Don't route the 127.74 nodes through ROUTE=B / FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_MHZ. _nodes_env validates against DEFAULT_NODES_MHZ, and p2_asm / (R2) would assemble the 127.74 MHz nodes at C_F, find no crossing and go red. - The _loo default grid, code step 3. - The hard-coded 64 MHz literals, code step 4. A missed one shows up as a (T2) bracket or f_hz assert failing on a correct measurement. - Item 217's reconciliation: a (T2) red inside the range parks per implementer-run.md step 2 (journaled blocked, "predicted red, inside range"), and the slot continues. Covered: the ×1 exact-sheet mesh (h = 0.015), degree 2, κ off, the Cu column tuned at 127.74 MHz (PEC printed at the target node), Route B on a new seven-node Cu grid, and Route A at three points. Not covered: - any absolute tuned f₀, Q, R_in or C at 3 T; - any h-statement (T12′ is 64 MHz only); - the PEC grid at 3 T; - (L) at 127.74 MHz; - the 51-point Route A; - the eigen route; - any SPEC change (the SPEC is a 64 MHz AED case, and no 3 T AED or Palace case exists, so there is no private reading); - any choice of construction for later steps (C_mode / C_in / an in-model C), which is the weekly's.

Park, BLOCKED. Never apply κ. - (T2)'s band half red inside [1e-6, 5e-5], everything else green: the pre-registered negative. The pre-registered negative fired: (T2) = 1.390e-6, inside [1e-6, 5e-5], every other anchor green (20261004T202814Z_ANS-7-item228-W1-nodes.log, …203339Z…-W2-nodes.log, …203817Z…-W3-cmode.log, …204206Z…-W4-inmodel.log). c = +3.653e-6, r = −2.263e-6 (flat in f against −2.53e-6 at 64 MHz). C_mode − C_in = −7.754e-6 of C_in. (AB) 1.589 / 1.601 / 1.616e-5 at 127.64 / 127.74 / 127.84 MHz, the first 3 T circuit = field reading at degree 2. The review took test_ans7_exact_strip.py and the four logs by path from attempt/ANS-7-step8-20261004T2049Z (22de12f4; main had not touched the module since the branch point a0d675c5), added the four test-results rows by hand, and deleted the branch. docs.title: §9 item 230 — 2026-10-04 (chain T20; example-runner)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-04 10:30 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §10 chain T20 (weekly 2026-10-03), quoted, not changed: "ans:7 re-issued at degree 2 on exact rectangles — the example, its metrics.json and guide carry the degree-2 rows; the degree-1 rows are labelled superseded. example-runner. Serial on nothing." The sheets-and-κ ruling binds. No band, tolerance, Done-when or validation target moves. The SPEC (SPEC.md, C = 66.29 pF, the operator's AED case definition) is not edited.

ANS-7 step 9: the ans:7 example gains degree-2 exact-rectangle stages. Its tracked metrics.json, COMPARISON.md and guide carry the degree-2 rows, and the degree-1 ragged κ-corrected rows stay in place, labelled superseded. - Executor: example-runner. Example script, same-stem guide, metrics.json, COMPARISON.md. No test, src/ or SPEC edit. - Tier: heavy, -n 8 (the width of the imported record), complex build. - Class: example re-issue (solve). Time: ≈ 16 measured / 50 predicted min. - Depends on nothing in the queue. It is independent of item 228: different files, C_F around 62.7 MHz against C_mode at 127.74 MHz, and no shared output path. It uses item 217's additive _route_a_solve(degree=) and the _exact_geo helper, landed on main by this review. If they are absent, stop.

What the degree-2 exact rows are and where they came from. - Route B, degree 2, exact rectangles, κ off, seven nodes (DEFAULT_NODES_MHZ), assembled by sparse_rows on the 51-point GRID_MHZ. These are item 196's W1–W3 at -n 8 (20261003T123356Z_…-W1-p2.log, …124111Z_…-W2-p2.log, …124814Z_…-W3-p2.log). - The record is ANS7_EXACT_STRIP_ROUTE_B_ROWS_P2 (tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py; item 196 W3 :2189,2193; version tag complex 0.11 image, -n 8; the (1*) licence). It was reproduced by item 214's (R2) at ≤ 2.15e-12 and by item 217's (N1) at ≤ 4.4e-13. - The loss identity (L) at 64.5 MHz, κ off: 1.274e-5 ≤ REDUCTION_BAND (item 196 W2). - Degree-2 Route A = Route B was measured once, at C_mode around 64 MHz (item 217 W2: 1.237e-5 … 1.287e-5). It is an identity at an imported band, not a registered record. At the SPEC's C_F it has not been measured; this item measures it at three points.

Code (examples/ansys_benchmarks/ans7_tuned_copper_birdcage_driven_sweep/07_tuned_copper_birdcage_driven_sweep.py; additive stages, with B1 / B2 / A unchanged except code step 5): 1. New stages FEM_EM_ANS7_STAGE ∈ {X1, X2, X3, X4, XA}, beside B1 / B2 / A. - Stage files go to /workspace/logs/ans7_p2/ (gitignored), with the FEM_EM_ANS7_RESULTS_DIR override honoured. They never go to logs/ans7/ (the B stages' files), logs/ans7_exact/ (the tests' files) or logs/ans7_sparse/ (xl files). - An X stage raises if any FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_* or FEM_EM_ANS7_SPARSE_* variable is set, as the existing FEM_EM_ANS6_* guard does. - Imports are lazy, inside the X-stage functions. test_ans7_sparse_route_b re-executes this script's module body on import (_load(SCRIPT, "ans7_for_sparse")), so a module-level import makes a partially initialised cycle. Imported, never restated: - from test_ans7_exact_strip: ANS7_EXACT_STRIP_ROUTE_B_ROWS_P2, _fixture_tie, _assert_tie, _exact_geo, _loo; - from test_ans7_sparse_route_b: DEFAULT_NODES_MHZ, GRID_MHZ, BANDS, NODE_S_RTOL, N_FACTOR, K_SHARE_FLOOR, sparse_rows, bary_interp, _loss_pair, _p_inc_w; - GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION, RECIPROCITY_BAND, PASSIVITY_SIGMA_TOLERANCE, REDUCTION_BAND, DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL. 2. X1–X4: node solves. - X1 = {62.0, 62.3} plus (F) via _fixture_tie(); X2 = {63.2, 64.5}; X3 = {65.8, 66.7}; X4 = {67.0} plus the assembly. - Each is item 196's call: th14._build_ladder(2, sigmas=(th14.COPPER_SIGMA,), frequencies_hz=[…], width_correction_kappa=None, measure_kappa=False, pec_column=True, field_solve=(64.5 in nodes), leg_sheet_strip_fraction=GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION). - Per node, rank 0 writes node_<mhz:.1f>.json (S, z_from_s Z, reciprocity, σ_max, cells; at 64.5 MHz also the power and identity residual), then a barrier. - Per node, asserted: reciprocity, passivity, and at 64.5 MHz the copper identity residual and (L) |L_S − L_F| ≤ REDUCTION_BAND. 3. X4: the assembly. - It reads all seven node files (stop if any is absent, naming the missing stage) and asserts one cell count = ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_HOLE_CELL_RECORD within CELL_COUNT_BAND. - _loo(DEFAULT_NODES_MHZ, z_nodes) (C_F default) gives the rows per column and Δ_LOO. - Asserted: one − → + zero per column, k-share > K_SHARE_FLOOR, Δ_LOO ≤ BANDS, and (R2x). - It then writes metrics.json additively. It loads the tracked file and snapshots json.dumps(v, sort_keys=True) for every pre-existing top-level key. It adds: - "degree2_exact": degree 2, κ null, sheets "exact CAD rectangles (operator ruling 2026-10-02)", cells, unknowns, mpi_ranks, nodes, grid, rows per column (f₀, R_in, Q, k-share, crossings, bracket), Δ_LOO, the (R2x) relative differences, (L), and per-stage seconds; - "superseded": names the degree-1 keys (rows, rows_route_a, points, kappa, kappa_per_sheet, n_cells, degree, band, controls, route_comparison_a_minus_b), says they are superseded by degree2_exact (§10 T20), and records that they are kept in place for their readers (test_ans7_sparse_route_b, test_wf5_q_two_ways, test_ans6_exact_strip, test_port23_skrf_route_b). - It asserts (K): every pre-existing key re-serialises identically. - It regenerates COMPARISON.md from metrics.json. The degree-2 table comes first: Ours Cu (B), Ours PEC (B), Ours Cu (A) (blank until XA), AED blank. Below it sits "Superseded — degree 1, ragged sheets, κ-corrected (stage B2, 2026-09-29)", the existing table's numbers read from metrics.json and not restated in code. "Not claimed" is unchanged. 4. XA: Route A at degree 2, Cu, at C_F. - The geometry is _exact_geo(th14, comm, GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION). The drives are _route_a_solve(th14, geo, specs, f, "cu", degree=2) at 62.6, 62.7, 62.8 MHz, three GRID_MHZ points bracketing the degree-2 Cu f₀ of 62.701 MHz. - The comparand is _s11_from_z(route_b_z(bary_interp(xn, z_cu_nodes, g − 64.5), f, C_F)[1]) on the X node files. - Asserted: (AB) at every point, exactly one − → + crossing of Im Y_in,A in (62.6, 62.8) MHz, and (K). - Rows A come from parallel_rows and are printed. Control (i) is printed. - It writes degree2_exact["route_a"] (points, S11_A, S11_B, residuals, rows A) and regenerates COMPARISON.md. 5. Stage B2's _write_outputs carries over the degree2_exact / superseded keys if present (additive, two lines). Re-running B2 would otherwise silently drop the degree-2 block. B2 is not run here. 6. Docs. - The script docstring gets an X-stage paragraph. - The guide gets a new first section, "Degree 2 on exact rectangles (current; §10 T20)": the stages, commands and anchors. - §§2–3's degree-1 text moves under "Superseded: degree 1, ragged sheets, κ-corrected (kept as the record)". - "Not claimed" gains "no h-statement (T12′); no absolute f₀ / Q / R_in". - Setup figure: no re-render, since no X stage calls write_setup_figure.

Anchors (asserted; every gate record and band imported, none restated): - (R2x): the example's seven-node degree-2 rows reproduce ANS7_EXACT_STRIP_ROUTE_B_ROWS_P2 (Cu and PEC; f₀, R_in, Q) within NODE_S_RTOL, at -n 8. At any other width it prints and does not assert (the EX-56 rule). - (F) in X1. - Per node (B) in X1–X4. - (L) in X2. - The assembly in X4: one crossing per column, k-share > floor, Δ_LOO ≤ BANDS. - (AB) plus the Route A crossing in XA. - (K) in X4 and XA.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (N-deg): asserted. |f₀,X(Cu)/f₀,superseded(Cu) − 1| > N_FACTOR × BANDS["f0_hz"] (1e-5), where the superseded value is metrics.json rows.cu.f0_hz, the ragged degree-1 63.983031 MHz. - Backed by item 196's −2.0 % against the ragged rows (−1.985 % against the exact degree 1). - A stage that silently ran degree 1 or ragged sheets would sit within 0.02 % (item 195's exact-vs-ragged degree-1 move). The separation is ≈ 2 000×, and no ceiling applies. - (K): structural, asserted. A writer that rewrites metrics.json wholesale, as _write_outputs does, fails it. - Control (i): predicted, printed. The circuit at 0.5·C_F against the in-model at C_F at 62.7 MHz, Cu, is ≥ 10× REDUCTION_BAND. The measured analogue is item 217's (N2) at 494×; the ceiling is 2 000×.

Predictions (written first, printed): - (R2x): ≤ 1e-11 (item 214's W0: 2.15e-12). - Δ_LOO: ≈ 6.3e-13 / 1.6e-9 / 1.6e-9. - (L): in [1e-6, 1e-4] (item 196: 1.274e-5). - (AB): in [5e-6, 3e-4] (item 217: 1.24–1.29e-5 at C_mode). - f₀,A − f₀,B relative: in [−1e-5, −1e-6] (item 217: −2.53e-6). - Route A Cu: R_in and Q within ±2 % of the Route B rows.

Price (ans:7 run history and the degree-2 node prices). - ans:7 at degree 1, -n 4: - B1 353 s, B2 331 s, A 367 s (20260929T093403Z_ANS-7-item69-W1-B1.log, …094009Z_…-W2-B2.log, …100040Z_ANS-7-item68-W3-A.log); - item 79's re-run: B2 375 s, A 427 s (20260929T172027Z, …172651Z); - the pin test 9 s (…173423Z_ANS-7-item79-W3-pin.log); the census 1 s. - Degree-2 ×1, -n 8: - PEC 52.9–62.2 s plus Cu 44.3–50.0 s per node; ladder mesh 22–23 s; - a degree-2 P1 field solve ≈ 45 s; - one degree-2 drive 41.8–50.3 s (item 217 W2 :2052); - item 196's three-node windows ran 405–421 s. - Stages: X1 ≈ 300 s, X2 ≈ 365 s, X3 ≈ 280 s, X4 ≈ 170 s, XA ≈ 200 s. Each is under 590 s on a ×1.4 slow box (X2 ≈ 510 s). Total ≈ 1 315 s (≈ 22 min).

Windows (-n 8; bare, whole, foreground; Bash timeout: 660000; FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1; no FEM_EM_ANS6_* / FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_* / FEM_EM_ANS7_SPARSE_*; spawn and run foreground, per the 2026-09-01 rule). 1. Censuses before: docrefs and setup-figure (check_example_doc_references.py, check_example_setup_figures.py --next 3). Predicted unchanged by this item. 2. X1:

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-7-item230-X1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1 FEM_EM_ANS7_STAGE=X1 timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 8 python3 examples/ansys_benchmarks/ans7_tuned_copper_birdcage_driven_sweep/07_tuned_copper_birdcage_driven_sweep.py'" 3. X2, X3, X4, XA: the same command with the stage swapped, labelled ANS-7-item230-X2 … -XA. No edit after X1 (rule (i)). 4. Pin and unit tests, run on the committed metrics.json. The path is already in LISTED_EXAMPLE_ARTIFACTS, so the ANS-1 note is satisfied with no list edit. The rule is still that the commit that changes metrics.json carries the green pin run. No other new tracked file under examples/ is allowed; if one appears, it must be listed in the same commit. - The pin test is tests/unit/test_doc_reference_exit_codes.py (predicted 20 passed). - tests/unit/test_ans7_private_comparison.py runs because the metrics.json shape changed (predicted 4 passed). - Both go through the harness at -n 1, timeout -k 30 60, labelled ANS-7-item230-pin / -unit. 5. Censuses after: predicted equal to the before readings. 6. Commit the code, guide, metrics.json, COMPARISON.md, logs and test-results rows together. Check git diff --stat shows no COMPARISON_private.md, aed_results/ or SPEC change.

Traps already paid for. - Lazy imports, code step 1. - The write path: _write_outputs rewrites metrics.json wholesale. Code step 5 and (K) guard against that. - The degree-1 key set has readers. kappa, n_cells, points and rows are read by four test modules. They are never renamed or moved; they are labelled. - The ragged degree-1 XDMF and figure paths stay untouched. - Never run B1 / B2 / A here. They would re-solve degree 1 for ≈ 18 min and rewrite the degree-1 keys. - Item 157's rank-0 KeyError: X2 runs field_solve=True with pec_column=True. - Item 69's drafting error: z_from_s(S), never the sweep's z_matrix. - κ None on every spec. - AED values never enter a tracked file; FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1 on every window. - A killed window is not a result: pgrep -c python3, report, never lengthen the timeout. The node files from finished stages stand; the next slot resumes at the missing stage with no edit. - Harness calls are bare and whole; no pipe.

Scope. Covered: the example re-issued at degree 2 on exact rectangles, κ off, ×1 mesh, SPEC C = 66.29 pF, Route B seven-node on both columns, Route A at three Cu points. docs.title: §9 item 310 — 2026-10-08 (chain T28)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-08 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §10 chain T28 (PROJECT_PLAN.md :4595–4601), quoted, not changed: "T21′'s construction (FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE_C=cin) on step 6's h = 0.01 degree-2 mesh: the in-model zero within that grid's own measured resolution (pre-registered from the rung's node residuals), circuit = field at REDUCTION_BAND; printed: C_in(h = 0.01)/C_in(×1) − 1 beside step 6's f₀ +0.041 %. Target: identity; the first h-move of C_in. Serial on nothing. Heavy." Exact rectangles, κ off (ruling 2026-10-02). Lossless C: the ESR ruling (§9 :3749) scopes r to new steps, and T28 is enumerated lossless, so it is labelled lossless. No band, tolerance, Done-when or target is set or moved.

ANS-7 step 12: on item 214's h = 0.01 rung (140 270 cells, 968 016 unknowns, degree 2), compute C_in(h). C_in(h) is the root of Im Y_in(64.0 MHz) on a solved h = 0.01 Cu 4×4, found by _c_in (tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py:1199, unchanged). Then drive Route A at C_in(h) at T21′'s three points 63.9 / 64.0 / 64.1 MHz and read the in-model zero. - Executor: implementer. Tests only (tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py). No src/, ans:7, TH-14 or test_ans7_sparse_route_b.py edit. - Tier: heavy, -n 12 (item 214's rung width), complex build. Class: chain step (solve). - Time: ≈ 0 measured (no Route A drive has run on this rung) / ≈ 80 predicted min (15 fixed + ≈ 15 code + six windows ≈ 25–30, W0 included + ≈ 15 spare). On a slow box this runs past the 60-min timebox. The per-window split below makes it parkable partway through. - Depends on nothing. Inputs on disk (checked 2026-10-08): - item 214's five logs/ans7_exact/node_<mhz>_p2_h0.01_cu.json (62.0 / 63.2 / 64.5 / 65.8 / 67.0 MHz; resolution 0.01, ranks 12, field_solve false, cells 140 270); - the ×1 tune_p2.json (C_in(×1) = 6.359009101426113e-11 F). - Never write the ×1 tune_*.json files or the h = 0.01 node files.

Code (every knob-unset path stays byte-identical; item 262 / 283's cin paths stay behaviourally identical). 1. The h = 0.01 combination becomes legal. FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_RESOLUTION=0.01 (_resolution(), :159) is accepted with FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE ∈ {cmode, inmodel}, at 64 MHz only (TUNE_MHZ unset) and Cu only (COLUMNS=cu). Any other combination raises ValueError. 2. _active() / _stored_active() (:954 / :1066) gain the h = 0.01 set: the five _h0.01_cu nodes, Cu only, with the tie checked by _assert_tie(..., res=0.01). Output files are suffixed tune_p2_h0.01.json and tune_inmodel_cin_p2_h0.01.json. 3. tune_cmode (:1218) under the h set runs with pec_column=False, field_solve=False and resolution=0.01 passed to _build_ladder, as item 214 did. It writes C_mode(h), C_in(h) and z64. Item 157's trap forbids pec_column=False only together with field_solve=True; Q3 asks the review to confirm. 4. tune_inmodel (:1404): - a per-point knob FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE_POINT ∈ {unset, 63.9, 64.0, 64.1, assemble}. Unset gives the existing behaviour (ruling 310-Q2), and W0 shows it digit-identical; - a numeric value runs one Route A drive per window, and rank 0 writes tune_inmodel_cin_p2_h0.01_<mhz>.json; - assemble is a pure path: it reads the three point files and asserts. Any other value raises ValueError; - the (W) degree-1 ×1 wiring drive runs in the 64.0 window only.

Anchors (asserted; bands imported by name). - (AB‴) circuit = field at C_in(h): |S11_A − S11_B|/|S11_B| ≤ REDUCTION_BAND at all three points. The band is 1e-3, tests/validation/test_port_lumped_rlc_termination.py:88, imported through test_port_circuit_layer_field. Route B is the five-node h = 0.01 grid, interpolated with bary_interp. - (T2‴) the in-model zero exists inside the bracket (review ruling 310-Q1): Im Y_in,A changes sign, − → +, exactly once between the bracketing points 63.9 and 64.1 MHz. Asserted. - The zero's offset is printed, never asserted. |f₀,A/64 MHz − 1| is printed with T21P_ZERO_RESOLUTION (1.287e-5, test_ans7_exact_strip.py:1001) beside it, for scale only. No band is transplanted. - Why T28's "within that grid's own measured resolution" could not be pre-registered. T21′'s band came from T21's (AB) node residuals at C_mode (20261004T140738Z_ANS-7-item217-W2-inmodel.log:2046–2048). The rung's node files carry no identity residuals (field_solve false, identity_residual null), so there is nothing to register it from. This gap is named for the 10-10 weekly. - (W) unchanged: ≤ NODE_S_RTOL against item 195's stored point.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (W): asserted. Backed by item 262 W1 (4.034e-14) and item 283 (1.127e-14 / 1.470e-13): same fixture, same comparison. - (N1‴) untuned zero: predicted, printed. |f₀,B(C_F)/64 MHz − 1| on the h = 0.01 Cu grid is ≥ 10 × T21P_ZERO_RESOLUTION. - It is not asserted: the comparison has run on the ×1 grid (2.029559e-2) but never on this grid. - Step 6's rung f₀ at C_F is 62.726847 MHz (≈ −1.99e-2), so a ratio of ≈ 1 500× is expected. - (N2‴): predicted, printed. The circuit at 0.5·C_in(h) against the in-model at C_in(h) is ≥ 10 × REDUCTION_BAND (×1 measured 493.78×). - (N-h): predicted, printed. C_in(h)/C_in(×1) − 1 is nonzero, by at least 10 × the secant tolerance. The h-move is the step's reading, so it is not gated.

Predictions (written first, printed). - C_in(h)/C_in(×1) − 1 in [−1.5e-3, −0.3e-3]. Step 6 moved f₀ by +0.0411 % at fixed C. Since f ∝ C^(−1/2) at first order, the expected move is ≈ −8.2e-4. - (AB‴) in [5e-6, 3e-5]. ×1 read 1.237–1.287e-5; the h-trend is unmeasured. - r(h) = f₀,A/f₀,B(C_in(h)) − 1 in [−5e-6, −1e-6]. ×1 is flat at −2.5e-6 / −2.3e-6. - R_in and Q at C_in(h) within 1 % of step 6's rung rows (18 313.602 Ω / 970.439). Printed only; item 262 missed a tighter Q prediction.

Windows (-n 12; each bare, whole and foreground; Bash timeout: 660000; -s; tests/environment first; FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1; ROUTE unset; no edit after W1 starts, rule (i)). - Orphan check first: docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 must read 0. - The trap check comes before any window (ruling 310-Q3). Quote item 157's trap text and confirm that pec_column=False with field_solve=False lies outside it. If the executor cannot confirm this, it stops and reports. - Each window is under 10 min, so the §5.1 capture idiom is not required. - W0 (the knob-unset path, digit-identical; ruling 310-Q2): item 262's W1 command verbatim, label ANS-7-item310-W0-cin64, -n 8, 257 s (measured, item 262; reproduced by item 283 W1 at 258 s). It must reproduce, to the printed digits: - (T2′) −2.535844e-6; - (AB′) 1.237e-5 / 1.258e-5 / 1.287e-5; - r −2.535846e-6. - Red ⇒ revert, BLOCKED. - Price (nearest measurement). Item 214 W1–W3 at h = 0.01, -n 12, on a box running ≈ 1.4× slow: mesh 53.6–55.4 s; one Cu 4×4 at 143.5–159.8 s; ru_maxrss 32.8–36.5 GiB; W2 used 536 s of 590 for its node set. - A Route A drive is one factorisation of the same operator, so ≈ 150 s is predicted. - W1 ≈ 220–280 s; each point window ≈ 230–300 s; W5 takes seconds. - W1 (C_in(h)):

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-7-item310-W1-cin-h001 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1 FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_DEGREE=2 FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_COLUMNS=cu FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_RESOLUTION=0.01 FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE=cmode timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 12 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py -v -s --tb=short'" - W2 / W3 / W4 (one drive each): W1's command with FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE=inmodel FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE_C=cin FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE_POINT=63.9 (then 64.0, then 64.1). Labels ANS-7-item310-W2-p63.9 / -W3-p64.0 / -W4-p64.1. Run them serially, never concurrently (≈ 36 GiB each). - W5 (assembly, closing): FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE=inmodel FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE_C=cin FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE_POINT=assemble, -n 2, timeout -k 30 180, label ANS-7-item310-W5-assemble.

Traps already paid for. - Items 217 / 228 / 262 / 283's lists, whole: - κ None; - no ans:7 call; - z_from_s(S), never z_matrix; - a real-scalar secant; - rank 0 writes, then a barrier; - a killed window is not a result: run pgrep -c python3, report, never lengthen the timeout; - never route through ROUTE=B / FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_MHZ (_nodes_env validates against the ×1 nodes). - The h = 0.01 nodes are _cu-suffixed, so COLUMNS=cu is required. - A missed ×1 literal (cells 80 798, the seven-node grid, tune_p2.json) shows up as a tie or grid failure on a correct measurement. - Price on the measured mesh time. Item 214's mesh ran over its 30–40 s prediction (54 s).

Scope. Covered: h = 0.01, degree 2, κ off, Cu, 64.000 MHz, lossless C. Not claimed: - any absolute tuned C, f₀, R_in or Q; - an h-statement: this is one rung, and T29 / T13 read it beside T12′; - 127.74 MHz; - ESR; - any AED or Palace comparison.

Status it can move. - No glyph. The §7 row's Done-when is the weekly's T13 re-read (PROJECT_PLAN.md :3444), so ANS-7 stays 🟡. - The row gains a "step 12 (T28)" record clause: C_in(h)/C_in(×1) − 1, (AB‴) and the zero. - The 10-10 weekly can read T29. - Rule (j): declined, as for items 228 / 262 / 283 / 288. No glyph moves.

Negative result. - (W) red: BLOCKED (wiring). - (AB‴) red with (W) green: circuit and field disagree on the rung. Print the three residuals, open a known-issues entry, park and mark BLOCKED. Never apply κ. - No crossing in (63.9, 64.1): BLOCKED. Report the Im Y_in triple. With C_in(h) taken from the rung's own grid, this would contradict r's flat record. - A point window killed: commit nothing for that point. The next slot reruns that point alone, with no edit. - No PREDICTED RED: line.

Review rulings (2026-10-08 03:00 daily review). The rulings below are applied to the text above. - (310-Q1) Neither (b), three C_mode(h) drives first, nor (c), an imported T21P_ZERO_RESOLUTION. T28's asserted anchors are the ones that can be asserted without a new band: - Im Y_in changes sign inside the bracket, so the in-model zero exists there; - circuit = field at REDUCTION_BAND at C_in(h). - The zero's offset is printed with T21P_ZERO_RESOLUTION beside it for scale, and never asserted. "Within that grid's own measured resolution" could not be pre-registered, because the rung's node files carry no identity residuals. It is named for the 10-10 weekly. No band is transplanted. - (310-Q2) The per-point split and the new FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE_POINT knob are accepted. Unset gives the existing behaviour, shown digit-identical by an existing window (W0). Never one long window. - (310-Q3) The executor confirms the trap from item 157's trap text before the first window. If it cannot, it stops and reports.

Outcome (2026-10-08 06:00 CDT slot): GREEN, all six windows. Trap check (310-Q3), from item 157's text (:86): "pec_column=False together with field_solve=True raises KeyError on rank 0 only (rec["pec"] …)". In _build_ladder the rec["pec"] access (test_th14_birdcage_copper.py:412) comes after the if not field_solve: … continue at :362–370, and the class_ds path is gated by if pec_column: (:357). So pec_column=False with field_solve=False is outside the trap, which is the combination item 214 ran on this rung. Orphan check 0 before W0 and after W5. Module mtime 11:05:15Z precedes W1's start at 11:10:45Z (rule (i)). - W0 (20261008T110604Z_ANS-7-item310-W0-cin64.log, -n 8, 262 s): reproduces to the printed digits: (T2′) −2.535844e-6 (0.197 bands), (AB′) 1.237e-5 / 1.258e-5 / 1.287e-5, r −2.535846e-6. The ×1 tune_inmodel_cin_p2.json it rewrites differs from the stored copy only at the 4e-8 relative level in the residuals. - W1 (…111045Z…-W1-cin-h001.log, -n 12, 252 s; ladder 144.8 s; 140 270 cells; 15 passed): C_mode(h) 63.643437 pF; C_in(h) = 6.364316664701229e-11 F (|g| 1.0e-16 S after 2 iterations). C_in(h)/C_in(×1) − 1 = +8.346526e-4. The predicted range [−1.5e-3, −0.3e-3] is NOT met on sign; the magnitude matches the brief's 8.2e-4. The brief's sign was wrong: f₀ rose +0.0411 % at fixed C, and f ∝ C^(−1/2), so tuning back down to 64 MHz needs more C. The drafter wrote the f₀ move, not the C move needed to undo it. (N-h) 8.35e-4 is far above 10 × the secant tolerance (3.9e-13). (T1) on the five h nodes at C_mode(h): Δ_LOO 3.3e-10 / 1.9e-8 / 4.4e-8; interpolated-vs-solved Z64 4.3e-9. (N1) ×1 wiring ≤ 2.2e-12. - W2 / W3 / W4 (…111513Z…-W2-p63.9.log 216 s, …111904Z…-W3-p64.0.log 236 s, …112308Z…-W4-p64.1.log 214 s; mesh 32.7–34.0 s, drive 98.2–105.7 s): (AB‴) 1.239e-5 / 1.262e-5 / 1.289e-5, inside the predicted [5e-6, 3e-5]. Im Y_in,A −1.618360e-4 / +2.640932e-7 / +1.626669e-4 S. (W) 1.720e-13 (×1 degree-1 drive, 28.0 s, 64.0 window). - W5 (…112649Z…-W5-assemble.log, -n 2, 70 s, 15 passed): (T2‴) one − → + change and no + → − change in (63.9, 64.1). f₀,A 63 999 837.080 Hz, so |f₀,A/64 − 1| = 2.545621e-6 = 0.198 × T21P_ZERO_RESOLUTION; this is printed, never asserted. f₀,B(C_in(h)) / 64 − 1 = −5.7e-13. r(h) −2.545621e-6, inside the predicted [−5e-6, −1e-6]. R_in 18 592.58 Ω is +1.52 % against the step 6 rung row, which misses the printed 1 % prediction; Q 964.43 is −0.62 %, which meets it. The comparand is step 6's rows at C_F, a different C, so the miss is on the comparand, not a gate. (N1‴) 1.989302e-2 = 1 545.7 × (predicted ≈ 1 500×). (N2‴) 493.62 × REDUCTION_BAND. - No glyph. ANS-7 stays 🟡, and the §7 row gains the step 12 clause. The gap is named for the 10-10 weekly: the rung has no registered "own resolution" (310-Q1).

docs.title: §9 item 311 — 2026-10-08 (chain T26)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-08 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it. The 03:00 review's rulings 311-Q4 to Q6 are applied to the text below.

Licence. §10 T26 (PROJECT_PLAN.md :4586–4592), quoted, not changed: "the in-model zero of Im Y_in at C_in(r) at 64.000 MHz within T21P_ZERO_RESOLUTION, circuit = field at REDUCTION_BAND at C_in(r); printed: Q(r)/Q(0) against the closed-form 1/Q = 1/Q_0 + 1/Q_C with Q_C = 1/(ωC_in r), C_in(r)/C_in(0) − 1. Target: identities. Serial on T25 and PORT-24 step 2. Heavy (257 s class)." The ESR ruling (§9 :3735–3754) sets r = 0.2 Ω on both sides at once; lossless records stay, labelled lossless.

Depends on items 308 and 309. If item 308 (PORT-24 step 1, esr_ohm in the circuit layer) or item 309 (PORT-24 step 2, the series-RC sheet) did not land, skip this item and leave it ⬜. Their Done-when is imported from the PORT-24 row (PROJECT_PLAN.md :2716), not restated. Lossless records stay valid and are labelled lossless. r never re-reads a lossless reading (ruling, §9 :3749–3750).

ANS-7 step 11: tune the exact-sheet F-small birdcage on C_in with r = 0.2 Ω on both sides. The work is on the ×1 mesh (h = 0.015, 80 798 cells), degree 2, κ off, Cu, at 64.000 MHz. - Circuit prediction (ruling 311-Q4): C_in(r) comes from the stored ×1 z64 in tune_p2.json through the circuit layer with esr_ohm = 0.2. It is pure and takes seconds. - The check: the in-model solve with series-RC sheets at (r, C_in(r)). - Executor: implementer. Tests only (tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py). No src/ edit beyond what items 308 / 309 landed; no ans:7 edit (T27 does that). - Tier: heavy, -n 8 (T21′'s record width), complex build. Class: chain step (solve). - Time: ≈ 9 measured (W1 + W2 ≈ 257 s each; item 262, item 283 W1) / ≈ 45 predicted min (15 fixed + ≈ 15 code + ≈ 9 windows + ≈ 6 spare).

Code (every knob-unset path byte-identical; item 262 / 283 / 310's paths behaviourally identical). 1. Knob FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_ESR_OHM ∈ {unset, 0.2}. Anything else raises ValueError. The knob requires: - TUNE=inmodel, TUNE_C=cin, TUNE_MHZ unset; - RESOLUTION unset; - TUNE_POINT unset. 2. C_in(r), pure. _c_in (:1199) finds the root of Im[1/Z_in] at 64.0 MHz on the stored z64 (Cu) from tune_p2.json. Every gap termination is item 308's esr_ohm-carrying termination, Z = r + 1/(jωC), and the feed is driven across its gap's (r + C) branch (ruling 311-Q5; ESR ruling (i)). - Use item 308's landed API by name, with no local re-implementation of the termination. If route_b_z does not take esr_ohm, thread it through as a keyword whose default is 0. - The secant start is c_in (lossless). - Rank 0 writes tune_p2_esr0.2.json, holding c_in_r, c_in_0, esr_ohm and f_hz. It never overwrites tune_p2.json. 3. Route A at (r, C_in(r)). _route_a_solve(…, c_f=c_in_r, degree=2) places item 309's series-RC sheet, series_rlc_impedance(R=r, L=0, C), on the three non-feed gaps. - Z_in,A adds the feed gap's (r + 1/(jωC_in(r))) branch in parallel, in place of add_c1's pure C. - Route B is route_b_z(bary_interp(xn, z_nodes_cu, g − 64.5), f, c_in_r, esr_ohm=r) at the three T21′ points 63.9 / 64.0 / 64.1 MHz. - Rank 0 writes tune_inmodel_cin_esr0.2_p2.json. 4. Tests (skip unless the ESR knob is set): test_t26_ab_circuit_equals_field_esr, test_t26_inmodel_zero_esr, test_t26_n_lossless_separates.

Anchors (asserted; bands imported by name). - (AB-r) circuit = field at C_in(r): |S11_A − S11_B|/|S11_B| ≤ REDUCTION_BAND (1e-3, tests/validation/test_port_lumped_rlc_termination.py:88) at all three points. - (T2-r) the in-model zero: exactly one − → + crossing of Im Y_in,A in (63.9, 64.1) MHz, and |f₀,A/64 MHz − 1| ≤ T21P_ZERO_RESOLUTION (1.287e-5, test_ans7_exact_strip.py:1001). This is the band T26 names, imported, not chosen. - (W) unchanged: ≤ NODE_S_RTOL against item 195's stored point.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (W): asserted. Backed by item 262 W1 (4.034e-14) and item 283 W1 (1.127e-14): same fixture, same comparison. - (N-L) the band separates ESR from lossless: predicted, printed. The lossless circuit (r = 0 at C_in(0)) against the in-model at (r, C_in(r)) at 64.0 MHz is ≥ 10 × REDUCTION_BAND. - Not asserted: no ESR comparison has run on this fixture. - Expected large: with R_in falling by roughly Q(r)/Q(0), S11 at the zero moves by O(1). - (N-r0) r = 0 reproduces C_in: predicted, printed. _c_in with esr_ohm = 0 on the same z64 equals tune_p2.json's c_in bit for bit. Not asserted: the comparison has never run through item 308's path. - (N2-r): predicted, printed. The circuit at 0.5·C_in(r) against the in-model at C_in(r) is ≥ 10 × REDUCTION_BAND (lossless 493.78×).

Printed, never asserted (ruling 311-Q6). - C_in(r)/C_in(0) − 1. Predicted in [−1e-3, +1e-3], magnitude O(1/Q_C²) ≈ 3e-5. ESR ruling (i) says uniform r leaves C_mode unchanged, but the C_in root of Im Y_in may move at second order. - Q(r)/Q(0) beside the closed form 1/Q = 1/Q_0 + 1/Q_C, with Q_C = 1/(ωC_in r) per capacitor, as the weekly wrote it (Q_0 is the lossless-capacitor coil's loaded Q, Q(0); renamed from "Q_Cu" by the 2026-10-10 weekly). - At C_in = 63.59 pF and 64 MHz, Q_C ≈ 195.5. - With Q(0) = 971.07 (item 262), the closed form gives Q(r) ≈ 163 and Q(r)/Q(0) ≈ 0.168. Predicted, labelled predicted in the print. - R_in(r), f₀,B(C_in(r))/64 MHz − 1 (predicted within ±1e-9, by construction), and r_AB = f₀,A/f₀,B − 1 (predicted in [−5e-6, −1e-6]; lossless −2.536e-6). - (AB-r) predicted in [5e-6, 3e-5] (lossless 1.237–1.287e-5). docs.title: §9 item 364 — 2026-10-11 (T30 — ANS-7: the three-rung R_in / Q sequence from logged data; lane-1 revalidation)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-11 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §10 chain T, step T30 (grep "T30 (lane 1, no solve). The three-rung"), quoted, not changed: "Pull Cu R_in and Q at h = 0.01 from step 6's rows (ANS-7.md, its log) beside ×1 (18 441.75 Ω / 977.26) and h = 0.005 (18 223.23 Ω / 965.55, T12′); print the two successive changes and their ratio; if the second change is at most half the first, write Q's bracket as a record on the row, else 'unconverged at h = 0.005' and F31 is the next rung. Target: a record from logged data. Serial on nothing." The T13 ruling (§10 rulings, 2026-10-10) binds: R_in and Q are not an agreement, and ANS-7 holds 🟡 on the Q clause until T30 / F31 write Q's h-statement. No band, tolerance, Done-when or target is set or moved. The 0.5 test is the weekly's rule; the only band used is NODE_S_RTOL, imported.

Why a window at all. The record is arithmetic on three logged rows, but host python3 is denied, and a record "from logged data" should assert that the data are what the logs say. So the item is one smoke window running a new pure module. It re-derives each rung's Cu rows from the stored node JSONs through the production sparse_rows path and asserts that they reproduce the logged digits. The successive changes and their ratio are then printed from the reproduced values.

  • Executor: implementer. Class: lane-1 revalidation (no solve). Tier: smoke, -n 1.
  • Cost: ≈ 10 s compute, priced from item 214's import smoke of test_ans7_exact_strip.py (7 s, 20261004T110430Z_ANS-7-item214-import-smoke.log, "13 skipped in 4.02s") plus three sparse_rows calls on five nodes over the 51-point grid. Predicted ≈ 30 min: 10 fixed, 15 code, 1 window, 4 records. Depends on nothing.
  • Inputs (gitignored, checked on the host 2026-10-11):
  • logs/ans7_exact/node_{62.0,62.3,63.2,64.5,65.8,66.7,67.0}_p2.json (×1, item 196);
  • node_{62.0,63.2,64.5,65.8,67.0}_p2_h0.01_cu.json (item 214);
  • node_{62.0,63.2,64.5,65.8,67.0}_p2_h0.005_cu.json (T12′, xl entry, 20261008T070008Z_ANS-7-step4p.log).
  • If any is absent, mark BLOCKED. Never re-solve one; the h = 0.005 rung is an xl window.

The logged rows (Cu, degree 2, κ off, 5-node Route B at C_F, full repr). These are the comparands, entered as module constants with their citations:

Rung Cells f₀ [Hz] R_in [Ω] Q Log ×1 (h = 0.015) 80 798 62701081.939501435 18441.75458382276 977.2613692833095 20261004T112945Z_ANS-7-item214-W3-rung.log:2259–2261 ((S5) 5-node; also 20261008T070008Z_ANS-7-step4p.log:4171–4173) h = 0.01 140 270 62726846.66023456 18313.602153804146 970.4389973340836 …item214-W3-rung.log:2218 h = 0.005 523 880 62751784.313079365 18223.232609192608 965.5456118046693 …step4p.log:4128
  • The ×1 comparand is the 5-node row, which matches the rungs' 5-node assembly. The 7-node record ANS7_EXACT_STRIP_ROUTE_B_ROWS_P2 (test_ans7_exact_strip.py:151–156) differs by 9.2e-10 / 6.6e-10 ((S5), :2260–2261) and is printed beside it, not used.
  • §10's "18 441.75 / 977.26" and "18 223.23 / 965.55" are these values rounded. Step 6's printed comparand STEP6_RUNG_ROWS (test_ans7_exact_strip.py:1057, 18 313.602 / 970.439) is the h = 0.01 row rounded.
  • The ×1 resolution 0.015 is the module's own label (test_ans7_exact_strip.py:147–150, "×1 (h = 0.015)"). It is used only for a printed order estimate.

Code. One new pure module, tests/validation/test_ans7_t30_rin_q_sequence.py, @complex_only. No edit to any existing file. - Imports, by name, none restated: - from tests.validation.test_ans7_exact_strip: _x1_cu5_rows (:768, the ×1 five-node Cu rows from item 196's seven JSONs; it returns (rows, recs), and the rows are rows["cu"]["rows"]), _load_nodes (:719), _uj, _assert_tie, _tie_from_json, ROWS, ANS7_EXACT_STRIP_ROUTE_B_ROWS_P2, STEP6_RUNG_ROWS; - from tests.validation.test_ans7_sparse_route_b: ASSEMBLY5_NODES_MHZ, NODE_S_RTOL (1e-9, :87, "backing 5.042e-14"), sparse_rows. - Rung rows: recs, missing = _load_nodes(ASSEMBLY5_NODES_MHZ, 2, res, ("cu",)) for res ∈ {0.01, 0.005}, then sparse_rows(ASSEMBLY5_NODES_MHZ, {"cu": [_uj(r["z"]["cu"]) for r in recs]}, columns=("cu",))["cu"]["rows"]. This is exactly the call _loo makes for full (:268–272, defaults GRID_MHZ, C_F), so the logged rows came from it. The ×1 row comes from _x1_cu5_rows(). - Record literals (provenance comments citing the table's log lines; records, not bands): T30_LOGGED_ROWS (the nine values above), T30_CELLS (80 798 / 140 270 / 523 880; the h = 0.005 count from step4p.log and docs/testing/xl-ledger.md row "ANS-7-step4p"), and T30_H_M = (0.015, 0.01, 0.005). - Tests: - test_t30_inputs: (F); - test_t30_reproduces_logged_rows: (R-rep); - test_t30_rung_swap_control: (N-swap); - test_t30_sequence_record: prints only, plus the arithmetic identity in (A).

Anchors (asserted). - (F) inputs are the logged rungs. For each rung's JSONs: - degree == 2, kappa is None, resolution equal to the rung's (None at ×1), and columns == ["cu"] on the h rungs; - one cell count, equal to T30_CELLS exactly; - _assert_tie(cells, _tie_from_json(r["tie"]), res) per file, as test_p2_assembly does (:795); - f_hz within 1 Hz of its node. - (R-rep) reproduction of the logged rows. For each of the nine (rung, quantity) pairs, |recomputed/logged − 1| ≤ NODE_S_RTOL, the project's "unset digit-identical" reproduction band. It is applied as (R2) applies it (:856–875). Predicted: exactly 0, the same function on the same bytes. Printed with !r. - (A) the sequence arithmetic. For R_in and Q, Δ₁ = v(0.01) − v(×1) and Δ₂ = v(0.005) − v(0.01) are computed from the reproduced values. Asserted: Δ₁ + Δ₂ = v(0.005) − v(×1) to ≤ NODE_S_RTOL relative. This is a bookkeeping guard on the pulled numbers, not a physics claim.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (N-swap): asserted. Each rung's recomputed R_in and Q against the other two rungs' logged values gives |rel| > 100 × NODE_S_RTOL. That is the factor item 288's (N-C) used, an existing precedent. It is backed by the same comparison on the same data: the logged h-moves (h = 0.01 − ×1)/×1 of −0.6949 % / −0.6981 % (…item214-W3-rung.log:2234–2235) and (h = 0.005 − ×1)/×1 of −1.1849 % / −1.1988 % (…step4p.log:4146–4147). Their difference, the smallest separation (h = 0.01 vs h = 0.005), is ≈ 4.9e-3 ≈ 4.9e6 × NODE_S_RTOL. A loader that read one rung's files under another's name fails here. - Printed only: the 7-node ×1 record's R_in / Q against the 5-node ×1 row (predicted 9.2e-10 / 6.6e-10, as (S5)).

Printed record (the step's reading; never asserted): - Δ₁, Δ₂ and ρ = Δ₂/Δ₁ for R_in and Q, and for f₀ for comparison with the T13 ruling's "equal to 3 %". - The §10 branch, evaluated per quantity: |Δ₂| ≤ 0.5·|Δ₁|. If it holds for Q (and R_in), print the bracket. Otherwise print "unconverged at h = 0.005 — F31 is the next rung". - The order implied by unequal spacing: p solving (h₁ᵖ − h₂ᵖ)/(h₀ᵖ − h₁ᵖ) = ρ on T30_H_M, by bisection on [0.1, 6]. It is labelled "printed; not the §10 rule". At this spacing, ρ = 0.5 corresponds to p ≈ 2.3, and first order gives ρ = 1. - Predictions, by the drafter, from the logged digits: - R_in: Δ₁ = −128.152430 Ω, Δ₂ = −90.369545 Ω, ρ = 0.70517. - Q: Δ₁ = −6.822372, Δ₂ = −4.893386, ρ = 0.71726. - f₀: Δ₁ = +25 764.72 Hz, Δ₂ = +24 937.65 Hz, ρ = 0.96790. - Branch: unconverged at h = 0.005 (both ρ > 0.5). - p: R_in ≈ 1.68, Q ≈ 1.64, f₀ ≈ 1.06, the last consistent with the T13 ruling's "first order in h".

Harness (one window). The Bash call's timeout is 660000. The harness call is the whole Bash command: bare and repo-relative, with nothing chained or piped.

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-7-item364-T30 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1 timeout -k 30 30 mpiexec -n 1 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_ans7_t30_rin_q_sequence.py -v -s --tb=short'"

Every FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_* knob stays unset: importing test_ans7_exact_strip with one set can raise at fixture time.

Traps already paid for. - A missed literal shows as a tie failure on a correct measurement (item 228). Pass res and ("cu",) to _load_nodes for the h rungs, and None / both columns at ×1 (via _x1_cu5_rows). - Never ROUTE=B / FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_MHZ. This module calls no fixture of test_ans7_exact_strip; it only imports helpers. - Rows are at C_F, untuned and lossless. They are not the tuned R_in / Q at C_in (item 310's 18 592.58 / 964.43) and not AED's. Never mix the two in the sequence. - pytest -s; harness foreground; no pipe; rule (i): no edit after the window. - No AED value enters the module or the record. The −1.6 → −2.7 % / −1.9 → −3.1 % gaps in the T13 ruling are relative levels already public there, and this item does not compute them.

Scope boundary. Covered: the h-sequence of the Cu R_in / Q / f₀ rows at C_F over three logged rungs (degree 2, κ off, exact rectangles, F-small, 64 MHz band). Not claimed: any h-converged R_in or Q; any AED agreement (T13's verdict stands); the tuned rows; the copper-loss partition (F31's); 128 MHz.

What a negative result means. - (F) or (R-rep) red: the stored JSONs are not what the logs printed. A file was rewritten since, or the path is wrong. Report the per-value residuals and stop, BLOCKED. Never re-solve, and never re-register a logged value. - (N-swap) red: wiring (the wrong files were read). BLOCKED. - ρ ≤ 0.5 against the prediction: the bracket branch fires. Record the bracket on the row, hold 🟡, and flag it for the review and auditor. Whether a bracket from this rule is "Q's h-statement" (T13's ✅ condition) is the review's call, not the slot's. - No PREDICTED RED: line.

Status it can move. The ANS-7 row gains a "T30 (item 364)" record clause: "Cu R_in / Q at C_F, ×1 → 0.01 → 0.005: successive-change ratios <ρ_R> / <ρ_Q>; <branch>." On the predicted branch, F31 (xl entry 34, 10-15) is named as the next rung. No glyph on the predicted branch. Rule (j): the ANS-7 Done-when must first carry the T13 ruling (weekly flag 2); see the row amendment recommended with this brief. Against that text, the unconverged branch moves nothing.

Questions for the review. - (364-Q1) The §10 text does not define "Q's bracket". On the ρ ≤ 0.5 branch (predicted not to fire) the brief would print the geometric tail, Q∞ ∈ [v₂ + Δ₂·ρ/(1 − ρ), v₂], ordered. The review confirms that formula or strikes the branch's print.

Branch: unconverged at h = 0.005 — F31 is the next rung (R_in and Q). Printed only: 7-node ×1 record vs 5-node 9.173e-10 / 6.549e-10 (as (S5)). "Within the grid's own resolution": the same gap as 310-Q1 (365-Q1 below). Predictions (written first, printed). - C_in(h)/C_in(×1) − 1 at 127.74 in [+2e-4, +2e-3], sign positive. It is printed beside 64 MHz's +8.346526e-4. Print the residuals, open a known-issues entry, park and mark BLOCKED. Never apply κ. - No crossing in (127.64, 127.84): BLOCKED. Report the Im Y_in triple and C_in(h). - No PREDICTED RED: line.

The harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, repo-relative, nothing chained or piped. Run every harness window foreground with Bash timeout: 660000. Never run ans:1–ans:3, never run B1 / B2 / A / X1–X4 / XA / XT64 / XT128, and never use ./scripts/run_examples.sh -e ans." - Edits: the example script, its same-stem guide, metrics.json and COMPARISON.md only. Code (examples/ansys_benchmarks/ans7_tuned_copper_birdcage_driven_sweep/07_tuned_copper_birdcage_driven_sweep.py; additive; every existing stage byte-unchanged in behaviour). 1. docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-11 18:00 daily review; the review reviews it.

Licence. §9 rule (6) (PROJECT_PLAN.md :3812–3822): T36 is a provisional next step of live chain T, tagged (daily, 2026-10-11 — provisional), and the weekly ratifies or reverts. T36 is T27's sibling at 127.74 MHz. T27 (§10 chain T, PROJECT_PLAN.md :4656–4657, quoted, not changed) reads: "ans:7 gains the ESR rows (T26 at 64 MHz; lossless rows stay, labelled). example-runner. Serial on T26." So ans:7 gains the 127.74 MHz ESR rows from item 387's (T35's) stored run. The ESR ruling (§9, :3791–3810) and the sheets / κ ruling (:3789) apply. No band, tolerance, Done-when, SPEC or validation target is set or moved; every band is imported by name.

Housing. Housing follows item 378: no EX chunk owns ans:7, so the case re-issues as an ANS-7 step. T36 is ANS-7 step 13b, beside step 13 (T27, item 378).

Depends on items 387 and 378 — skip if either did not land, and leave 391 ⬜. - Item 378 lands esr_ohm on z_cap / add_c1 / route_b_z / _route_a_solve, the 64 MHz stage XT64R, and degree2_exact["tuned_larmor_esr"]["64.0"]. Neither exists today (checked 2026-10-11 18:00). If either is absent when the slot opens, stop and take the next item. Never re-create one; that is the test module's job.

ANS-7 step 13b: ans:7 gains one additive stage, XT128R. It re-drives Route A at degree 2 on the ×1 exact-sheet mesh at (r = 0.2 Ω, C_in(r)) at 127.64 / 127.74 / 127.84 MHz, with item 378's series-RC terminations. It re-asserts T35's gates through the example and writes degree2_exact["tuned_larmor_esr"]["127.74"] and a 127.74 MHz column in COMPARISON.md's ESR section. The lossless tuned_larmor rows and the 64 MHz ESR rows stay byte-identical. - Executor: example-runner. Spawn prompt: "Use the example-runner agent to execute ANS-7 step 13b (§9 item 391) per docs/planning/chunks/ANS-7.md § '§9 item 391'. The harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, repo-relative, nothing chained or piped. Run every harness window foreground with Bash timeout: 660000. Never background a window or end your turn while one is running. Set FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1 on every window that runs the ans:7 script. Never run ans:1–ans:3, never run B1 / B2 / A / X1–X4 / XA / XT64 / XT128, run XT64R only as the brief's W-reg window when its condition holds, and never use ./scripts/run_examples.sh -e ans. Never open docs/private/, any aed_results/ or COMPARISON_private.md." - Edits: the example script, its same-stem guide, metrics.json and COMPARISON.md only. No src/, test-module, SPEC or aed/ edit. - Standing rule (a): this item does not edit the gate-imported helpers (z_cap, add_c1, route_b_z, _route_a_solve), because item 378 already keyworded them. If the executor finds it must, item 378's W-gate (item 310's W5 verbatim) runs in the same slot and the diff is disclosed. - Tier: heavy, -n 8 (T35's record width), complex build. Class: example. - Cost: ≈ 8 measured (example class median) / ≈ 40 predicted min: 15 fixed, ≈ 12 code and guide, XT128R ≈ 3, ≈ 3 census and pin, ≈ 7 spare. - Price: item 288's XT128, 165 s (20261007T003522Z_ANS-7-item288-XT128.log), which has the same drive count. Predicted 150–280 s, ≈ 390 s on a ×1.4-slow box, inside 590. - If W-reg is needed, add ≈ 3 min (item 378's XT64R, same class).

Code (examples/ansys_benchmarks/ans7_tuned_copper_birdcage_driven_sweep/07_tuned_copper_birdcage_driven_sweep.py; additive). 1. Stage XT128R is added to main()'s accepted set (:1503, as item 378 left it) and the error message. It starts with X, so _x_guard() applies: every FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_* knob, FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_ESR_OHM included, must be unset. The field set is chosen by stage name alone (item 288's knob-free trap). 2. A 127.74 branch by stage name inside item 378's ESR stage, mirroring _xt_stage's is64 split (:1301–1316): - key "127.74", target TUNE128_TARGET_HZ, tune TUNE128_MHZ; - nodes TUNE128_NODES_MHZ, read as the seven ×1 _node128_json(m, ("cu",)) files with _xt_stage's consistency checks (:1331–1340); - grid TUNE128_GRID_MHZ, out TUNE128_OUT_DIR; - band T22P_ZERO_RESOLUTION, named "T22P_ZERO_RESOLUTION"; - the tag strings T35 / (AB-r′) / (T2-r′); - .2f point formats. - Everything is imported lazily from tests.validation.test_ans7_exact_strip (item 230's cycle trap), never restated. Preferred shape: every line XT64R executes stays byte-unchanged, with the new branch reached only by the new stage name. Then no XT64R re-run is needed, and (K) proves its entry unchanged. 3. Inputs. - TUNE128_OUT_DIR / "tune_p2_esr0.2.json": c_in_r, c_in_0, esr_ohm (assert it equals 0.2, the ruling's value, never a band), and f_hz within 1 Hz of 127.74 MHz. C_in(r) is never recomputed. - TUNE128_OUT_DIR / "tune_inmodel_cin_esr0.2_p2.json" is the (R-T-r′) comparand. - Q_0 is the lossless degree2_exact["tuned_larmor"]["127.74"] rows_a.q_loaded (item 288's XT128 row; the coil's loaded Q with lossless capacitors). 4. Drives and rows: item 378's loop at the 127.74 tune points. f₀,B comes from the Route B Im Y_in over TUNE128_GRID_MHZ through the keyworded route_b_z, as item 378 forms it at 64 MHz. Printed, never asserted: Q(r)/Q_0 against 1/Q = 1/Q_0 + 1/Q_C with Q_C = 1/(ωC_in(r)·r), and C_in(r)/C_in(0) − 1 beside the 64 MHz tuned_larmor_esr["64.0"] value. 5. Write (rank 0, then a barrier). Snapshot every top-level key and every degree2_exact key, including tuned_larmor and tuned_larmor_esr["64.0"]. Set degree2_exact["tuned_larmor_esr"]["127.74"] with item 378's field list, with lossless_comparand: "tuned_larmor['127.74']" and source naming item 387's W2 log. Assert (K), and revert metrics.json on a miss. 6. COMPARISON.md. Item 378's section "Tuned with capacitor ESR (r = 0.2 Ω on every capacitor; §10 T26 / T27)" gains a 127.74 MHz column, the same rows, and "/ T35 / T36" in its heading. That is the only change to existing text, and it is disclosed in the commit. There is no AED column. No AED ESR case exists. 7. Docs. - The docstring's XT64R paragraph names XT128R. - The guide's "Capacitor ESR" section gains the XT128R command and anchors. - Any 64-MHz-only clause item 378 wrote in "Not claimed" is narrowed to the two frequencies (disclosed). - Stored inputs are named as "the gitignored logs/ans7_exact/ stage files" (item 273's docrefs trap). Write ≈, never a tilde. No setup figure or XDMF.

Anchors (asserted in-stage; every band imported): - (AB-r′) |S11_A − S11_B|/|S11_B| ≤ REDUCTION_BAND at 127.64 / 127.74 / 127.84 MHz. - (T2-r′) Exactly one − → + crossing of Im Y_in,A in (127.64, 127.84), and |f₀,A/127.74 MHz − 1| ≤ T22P_ZERO_RESOLUTION. These are T35's anchors as item 387 asserts them. - (R-T-r′) reproduction of item 387's registered run against t127.74/tune_inmodel_cin_esr0.2_p2.json, applied as item 378's (R-T-r): - |f₀,A,ex/f₀,A,stored − 1| ≤ NODE_S_RTOL; - max |res_ex − res_stored| ≤ NODE_S_RTOL; - max |S11_A,ex − S11_A,stored|/|S11_A,stored| ≤ NODE_S_RTOL; - the stored ranks == 8 and degree == 2. - At any other width it prints and does not assert (the EX-56 rule). - (K) Every pre-existing metrics.json key, tuned_larmor and tuned_larmor_esr["64.0"] included, is byte-identical. - (R0′) The r = 0 branch is bitwise at 127.74: z_cap, add_c1 and route_b_z with esr_ohm=0.0 equal the unkeyworded call, bit for bit, on the stored ×1 t127.74/tune_p2.json z64["cu"] at 127.74 MHz. This is item 378's (R0) at the second frequency; it is pure and takes milliseconds.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (N-C-S′) the comparator separates ESR from lossless: asserted only if backed. max |S11_A,ex(r) − S11_A,stored,lossless|/|S11_A,stored,lossless| > 100 × NODE_S_RTOL, against t127.74/tune_inmodel_cin_p2.json s11_a. - It is asserted only if the two stored JSONs (item 387's s11_a and the lossless s11_a) differ by > 1e-7 relative at every point. - Before the window the executor computes that with a pure read, cites it in the commit, and labels the control. Otherwise it is printed. - Predicted O(1e-3) at every point. - (N-C-r′) the f₀ form of item 378's (N-C-r): predicted, printed. |f₀,A,ex(r)/f₀,A,stored(lossless) − 1| > 100 × NODE_S_RTOL. It is asserted only under item 378's condition: item 387's outcome records f₀,A(r) and f₀,A(0) differing by > 1e-7. That difference is predicted ≈ 1e-8 to 5e-8 (64 MHz: 4.7e-8), so it is expected to be printed. - (N-L′): predicted, printed. It is asserted only if item 387's reading met the ≥ 10× bar, and item 387 predicts it will not.

Predictions (printed). (R-T-r′) ≤ 1e-12 (item 288 reproduced item 262 to 9.97e-13 at -n 8). Every other reading is item 387's, to the printed digits.

Windows (-n 8; each bare, whole and foreground; Bash timeout: 660000; no edit after XT128R starts, rule (i)). Each window is under 10 min, so §5.1 capture is not required. 0. Orphan check: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 must read 0. 1. Censuses before, labels ANS-7-item391-pre-figures / -pre-docrefs: item 378's / 288's commands (check_example_setup_figures.py, check_example_doc_references.py, timeout -k 30 60). 1b. W-reg, only if the edit changed any line XT64R executes. Run item 378's XT64R command verbatim, label ANS-7-item391-W-reg-XT64R. - The rewritten tuned_larmor_esr["64.0"] must equal the committed entry in every field except t_mesh_s / t_drive_s (pure JSON compare, printed). - Any other difference ⇒ revert, BLOCKED. - If the preferred shape held, skip W-reg and say so in the commit. 2. XT128R:

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh ANS-7-item391-XT128R "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1 FEM_EM_ANS7_STAGE=XT128R timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 8 python3 examples/ansys_benchmarks/ans7_tuned_copper_birdcage_driven_sweep/07_tuned_copper_birdcage_driven_sweep.py'" 3. Pin and unit tests on the committed metrics.json, -n 1, label ANS-7-item391-pin: item 378's command (tests/unit/test_doc_reference_exit_codes.py tests/unit/test_ans7_private_comparison.py, -s). The tracked-output guard must stay green with the new key. 4. Censuses after, labels -post-figures / -post-docrefs. Predicted equal to the before readings (broken=0; docrefs dead=0, guide=0, exit ≠ 1). 5. Commit the script, guide, metrics.json, COMPARISON.md, logs and test-results rows (appended by hand) together. git diff --stat must show no COMPARISON_private.md, aed_results/, SPEC.md or test-module change.

Traps already paid for. - Items 230 / 288 / 378's lists, whole: - lazy imports; - never run B2 (_write_outputs rewrites wholesale); - never rename or move the degree-1 keys; - z_from_s(S); - κ None; - AED values never enter a tracked file; - a killed window is not a result; - bare harness calls; - knob-free selection: setting FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_ESR_OHM or FEM_EM_ANS7_EXACT_TUNE_MHZ trips _x_guard; - FEM_EM_ANS_SKIP_PRIVATE=1 on every window that runs the script; - the r = 0 path is a branch, not arithmetic (item 308); - never enter 0.2 Ω as a parallel R; - the feed's branch carries r too. - A 64 MHz literal on the 127.74 branch (64.5 is the interpolation origin at both fields and stays, as in XT128; anything else is a defect). The known candidates are T21P_ZERO_RESOLUTION, the GRID_MHZ f₀,B grid, .1f formats and the Q_0 key "64.0". - (N-L′) / (N-C-r′) conditions are "measured and met", not "measured". Asserting a control that item 387 recorded as missed turns a recorded negative into a red window.

Scope. Covered: the example re-asserting T35 at (r, C_in(r)) on the ×1 exact-sheet mesh, degree 2, κ off, Cu, 127.74 MHz, and recording the ESR rows beside the labelled lossless rows. Not claimed: - a measured ESR or its frequency dependence; - any absolute tuned C, f₀, R_in or Q; - any h-statement; - any AED or Palace comparison; - the private writer's rows.

Status it can move. - §10 T36 is recorded DONE (provisional; the weekly ratifies). - The ANS-7 row gains a "step 13b (T36)" clause: ans:7's tracked outputs carry the ESR rows at both fields, with (AB-r′), (T2-r′) and (R-T-r′) re-asserted through the example. - No glyph. Rule (j): declined, as for items 288 / 378.

What a negative result means. - (R-T-r′) red at -n 8 with the bands green: the example's 127.74 ESR path is not item 387's. Print the differences, revert metrics.json / COMPARISON.md (those two paths only), park on attempt/ANS-7-step13b-<UTC> and mark BLOCKED. Never re-register. - (R0′) red: revert, BLOCKED. - (AB-r′) / (T2-r′) red: this contradicts item 387's green. Report it, open a known-issues entry if it reproduces, and mark BLOCKED. Never re-band or adjust r. - (K) red, or W-reg red: revert both tracked outputs, BLOCKED. - No PREDICTED RED: line.

Outcome 2026-10-12 (00:00 CDT slot, example-runner): BLOCKED (W-reg). The 127.74 MHz column was rendered by editing _write_comparison, which XT64R executes, so the preferred shape did not hold and W-reg ran (20261012T051318Z_ANS-7-item391-W-reg-XT64R.log, -n 8, 177 s; mesh 27.5 s, drives 50.2 / 51.8 / 45.4 s). Every in-stage assertion was green: (R0) bitwise, (AB-r) 1.233e-5 / 1.258e-5 / 1.283e-5, (T2-r) −2.583111e-6 (0.201 bands), (R-T-r) 7.96e-14 / 2.57e-13 / 3.14e-13, (K) yes. The pure JSON compare of the rewritten tuned_larmor_esr["64.0"] against the committed entry differs in 12 fields beyond t_mesh_s / t_drive_s: s11_a 3.07e-12 rel (s11_b bitwise), f₀,A 7.5e-14 rel, f₀,A-derived fields (rows_a, f0a_rel_target, bands_fraction, r_ab, q_ratio) ≤ 1.75e-10, rt re-measured. By the brief's letter ("any other difference ⇒ revert, BLOCKED") the item stops; metrics.json / COMPARISON.md reverted, XT128R not run. Pure reads before the window: (N-C-S′) item 387's s11_a vs lossless differ 2.169e-3 / 2.182e-3 / 2.197e-3 > 1e-7 at every point ⇒ assertable; (N-C-r′) separation 3.718e-8 < 1e-7 ⇒ printed; (N-L′) 387 read 2.17× ⇒ printed. Code (_xt_esr128_stage, two-column ESR writer, guide section; f₀,B by item 378's three-point construction; row label "f₀,A/64 MHz − 1" → "f₀,A/target − 1") parked on attempt/ANS-7-step13b-20261012T0517Z. For the review: W-reg's equality criterion cannot hold across two solves (run-to-run round-off, as item 387 noted); either re-read it as equality at NODE_S_RTOL for solve-derived fields, or re-pose with a separate XT128R comparison writer so no XT64R line changes and W-reg is skipped.
