docs.title: EX-126 — mri:27, two femem runs of one study file: the output bundle and its diff — deterministic keys bitwise, S within L0_BAND, and the three plants each layer catches
docs.text:
Item briefs and execution history (operator directive 2026-10-01). The §7 row is the status of record.

EX-126 (mri:27) is opened 2026-10-16 by the 18:00 daily review under daily-review.md step 5. It is the §5.4 ramp from WF-2 (✅ 2026-10-09, 00:00 slot, §9 item 346; re-pose ratified by the 2026-10-10 weekly; audit PASS 2026-10-11 03:00 review). - Base. tests/package/test_wf2_bundle_reproducible.py (the item-346 gate module). The code under demonstration is run_study_file (src/fem_em_solver/study_yaml.py:1125–1272), which writes summary.json (schema femem, source, sha256 of the file's bytes at :1148, family, degree, frequency_hz, ranks, cells, s_matrix, z_matrix, touchstone, elapsed_s) plus <stem>.s4p for a port study (:1197–1204), and cli.main(["run", …]), which calls it. - Runs of record. - docs/testing/logs/20261009T053110Z_WF-2-W2-four-port.log (heavy by ceiling, -n 2, 5 passed in 75.06 s at :3699, Elapsed 77 s at :3706). It reads: run_a (cli.main) 36.8 s, run_b (run_study_file) 36.8 s, cells 117 206 (:3686); (F) per-rank keys [[], ['elapsed_s']] (:3687); (D) flags [], key sets equal, sha256 7820a305a7b06c10ba6d5a03df95668bc769001ea631031f846199b2d67fa4f7 = recomputed (:3688); (F) True (:3689); (R) 5.010e-16 (:3690); (X) 9.557e-11 on both runs (:3691); Z printed 5.628e-16, cond(I − S_a) 1.928e+01 (:3692); (T) 5 / 5 header lines bitwise, generated_utc lines (1, 1), no PLACEHOLDER, parsed rel 5.521e-14 (:3693); (c1) flags ['degree'], S miss 0.0495 (:3694); (c2) 0.2492 (:3695); (c5) 1.000e-08 (:3696). - docs/testing/logs/20261009T053015Z_WF-2-W1-sphere.log (standard, -n 2, 6 passed in 46.84 s at :291, Elapsed 48 s at :298). It reads: (c3) cells+1 ['cells']; sha256 digit ['sha256']; ranks deleted ['<keyset>']; elapsed_s changed [] (:64); sphere (D) / (F) / (R) 1.453e-12 / (X) 6.222e-11 (:208–214); (c1) 3.3757 % (:215); (c4) flags ['sha256', 'source'], SAR rel 7.566e-12 (:287–288).

Fixture (decided: the F-small four-port file, tests/package/wf1/f_small_four_port.yaml, used in place). - Why the four-port, not the sphere. It is the stronger demonstration, and it costs ≈ 1 min more. - (i) It is the whole bundle. A port study writes summary.json and the .s4p. The diff therefore covers the Touchstone header layer (T) as well as the summary. The .s4p is the file a user hands to a circuit tool. The sphere bundle is summary.json alone. - (ii) The P1↔P2 swap exists only on S. The sphere has no S matrix, so its bundle cannot carry the swap plant at all. On the four-port, the degree plant (c1) and the swap (c2) are both backed on this fixture, at this width, with this comparator (W2 :3694–3695). The one-ULP σ plant (c4) becomes a new control here: its hash half is asserted and its float half is printed (see (2)). - (iii) It has headroom against the band. The four-port's run-to-run S drift is 5.010e-16 (:3690), ≈ 2 × 10⁶ below L0_BAND. The sphere's is 1.453e-12 (W1 :213), ≈ 700× below. "Reproduces" reads cleanly on the four-port. - Cost. The sphere is cheaper: three ≈ 15 s solves (W1 :208, :287), ≈ 48 s in all. The four-port is three ≈ 37 s solves (W2 :3686), ≈ 115 s plus outputs. Both fit one heavy-by-ceiling window at -t 420, so the ≈ 65 s difference does not change the tier. - The file is used in place, as mri:21 uses its tune file (examples/mri/21_femem_run_tune_section.py:7–9). It is never copied. This keeps the deterministic layer comparable with a bundle written by an earlier process: sha256 equals W2 :3688 character for character, and cells equals ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_CELL_RECORD. The file is unchanged since c8d3a532 (git log -- tests/package/wf1/f_small_four_port.yaml). W2 asserted sha256 only against the hash recomputed in-process, so this cross-process check of the deterministic layer is new.

Gap (grep at drafting: manifest, bundle, run_study_file, sha256, summary.json, cli.main over examples/mri/01, 09, 13, 15, 21, 22 and examples/ports/04, 05). - mri:1 (01_coil_phantom_fields.py:209–267) writes mri_01_coil_phantom_manifest.json. That manifest holds existence flags, parameters and E / B means. It has no S and no SAR, and no run of it is ever compared with another run (WF-2.md, reason (a)). - mri:9 (EX-93) runs each of WF-1's two files once through cli.main and reads summary.json against the records (09_study_from_yaml.py:131–157). No two bundles are compared. - mri:13 (EX-97) compares cli.main's temperature block with run_study_file's at L0_BAND (13_temperature_from_yaml.py:24–25). That is the floating half of (R) on a thermal summary. It has no deterministic-key layer, no hash plant and no Touchstone. - mri:21 (EX-115) shows file equals memory, bitwise, for the tune block only ((I=), 21_femem_run_tune_section.py:13–14). That is (F) on one block of one run. - mri:15 prints the sha256 of its input records (15_figures_from_records.py:49, :268). It does not hash or diff a run's bundle. - mri:22 runs presets and reads one summary (22_presets_priced_then_run.py:169–186). - ports:4 and ports:5 contain no manifest, sha256 or run_study_file (grep empty). - The angle (output quantity: the bundle manifest and its diff). This is the first example that writes two bundles of one study file and diffs them key by key at two layers: - the deterministic layer, bitwise: summary keys, Touchstone header lines and the key set; - the floating layer, at L0_BAND: S, and the parsed Touchstone.

It then plants a changed degree, a P1↔P2 swap and a one-ULP σ config, and shows which layer catches each one. In particular, the hash catches a config change that the floats cannot see. The diff itself is the example's output, written as a CSV table beside the XDMF.

docs.title: §9 item 504 — 2026-10-16 (example, §5.4 ramp; example-runner)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-16 18:00 daily review; the review reviews it. This brief sets and moves no band, tolerance, record, Done-when of another chunk or validation target. Every band and comparator is imported from the item-346 gate module, which imports them from tests/validation/.

Executor: example-runner; it does not spawn agents. Class: example. EX-126 (mri:27; the runner selects mri:<n> with the %02d_*.py glob in scripts/run_examples.sh:206–210; mri: sources the complex build; no runner edit) adds four tracked files and edits nothing else: - examples/mri/27_femem_run_bundle_reproducible.py; - examples/mri/27_femem_run_bundle_reproducible_sigma_ulp.yaml, the (c4) control. It is tests/package/wf1/f_small_four_port.yaml byte for byte except for two lines: the comment line (# EX-126 (mri:27): control (c4), f_small_four_port.yaml with the phantom sigma one ULP up.) and sigma: 0.5000000000000001 (= repr(np.nextafter(0.5, 1.0))). It sits beside the script, as mri:9 / mri:13 keep their YAMLs; - the same-stem guide examples/mri/27_femem_run_bundle_reproducible.md, with ## 1. What this demonstrates, ## Setup figure, ## 2. How to run it, ## 3. How to analyze it, step by step and ## Related (mri:21's order, 21_femem_run_tune_section.md:6, :85, :96, :110, :180); - examples/mri/figures/mri_27_femem_run_bundle_reproducible_setup.png, ≤ 600 KiB (mri:8's F-small figure is 410 KiB).

Collision check (the executor repeats it before writing). ls examples/mri/27_* is empty. No §7 row or chunk file other than this one names EX-126 or mri:27 (checked at drafting; mri:24 is the highest file on main). If 25_ / 26_ are absent when the slot starts, the gap is harmless (the runner selects by number). If 27_ is taken, stop and report. Never renumber in-slot.

Output location (gitignored). Every bundle goes under examples/mri/paraview_output/ (.gitignore:63 paraview_output/), in fresh directories mri_27_run_a, mri_27_run_b and mri_27_run_c (mri:21's RUN_DIR form, 21_femem_run_tune_section.py:77). Every cli.main call passes --output-dir. Never write under logs/wf2/: those are the gate's bundles. Never omit --output-dir: the default ./femem_out/<stem> (study_yaml.py:1143–1147) is not gitignored and would dirty the tree at the repo root.

Imports (never restated). - import tests.package.test_wf2_bundle_reproducible as g and use: _same (:65–75), _bitwise_flags (:78–87), DETERMINISTIC (:54), KEYSET (:55), GENERATED_PREFIX (:56), _s / _z (:90–95), _load (:102–104), and its re-exports L0_BAND, _record, _rel, BIRDCAGE_FILE, _fresh_dir, _rc_all, ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_RECORD_RANK_WIDTH, cli, run_study_file, load_touchstone. - Never call g._two_runs (:107–129): it hard-codes logs/wf2. Never call g._assert_d_and_f (:132–157), or any test_* name. - The Touchstone header filter _hdr is a closure inside the gate's test (:296–297). Copy its two lines with a provenance comment. It excludes by the exact prefix g.GENERATED_PREFIX, never by "all comment lines". - from tests.package.test_wf1_study_yaml import _spec_diff (:145–154); from fem_em_solver import load_study. - ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_CELL_RECORD from tests.validation.test_ops61_exact_strip_ports (:64), as mri:8 imports it (08_study_four_port_birdcage.py:83–84). - Assert g.L0_BAND is tests.validation.test_mat5_em_coupled_sphere.L0_BAND and g._record is tests.package.test_wf16_study_four_port._record. - From src: write_setup_figure, write_xdmf_with_tags, adopt_host_ownership, report_peak_rss (fem_em_solver.utils.instrumentation:92). - Insert _REPO_ROOT into sys.path. Raise if default_scalar_type is not complex. - Record digits go only into an example-local REC dict, each entry commented with its log:line.

Structural asserts at start-up (parse only, no mesh). - comm.size == g.ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_RECORD_RANK_WIDTH. - base = load_study(g.BIRDCAGE_FILE) with base.degree == 1 and base.conductor is None. - ctrl = load_study(CONTROL_YAML) with _spec_diff(ctrl, base) == ["material.sigma"] and ctrl.material.sigma == float(np.nextafter(base.material.sigma, 1.0)). This is WF-1 (c1)'s parse-half form (tests/package/test_wf1_study_yaml.py:216–222), here on the four-port file. - CONTROL_YAML.read_bytes() != g.BIRDCAGE_FILE.read_bytes(), and the two files' line lists differ at exactly two indices (the comment and sigma:).

Record checks (the 2026-10-14 10:30 ruling's form, as EX-120 adopted it). - Exact (deterministic, cross-process): - run_a's sha256 = REC["sha256"] = 7820a305…a4f7 (W2 :3688), the full 64-character string in REC; - cells == ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_CELL_RECORD (117 206, W2 :3686); - the Touchstone header (bar generated_utc) has 5 lines (:3693), with exactly one generated_utc line per file. - At a relative 10^-(d−2), d = printed significant digits: - (c1) 0.0495 (:3694), d = 3 ⇒ 1e-1; - (c2) 0.2492 (:3695), d = 4 ⇒ 1e-2; - cond(I − S_a) 1.928e+01 (:3692), d = 4 ⇒ 1e-2. - Excluded (round-off readings, asserted at their band only and printed beside their line): (R) 5.010e-16 (:3690), (X) 9.557e-11 (:3691), (T) parsed 5.521e-14 (:3693), and Z 5.628e-16 (:3692, printed only, as in the gate). A record off by more than its tolerance stops the item.

(1) Anchor (item 346's gate on this file, imported comparator). Use t_start = time.time(). g._fresh_dir each of run_a and run_b (assert the two paths are distinct). Then: - run_a: rc = g.cli.main(["run", str(g.BIRDCAGE_FILE), "--output-dir", str(DIR_A)]) with g._rc_all(rc, comm) == (0, 0); - run_b: run_b = g.run_study_file(g.BIRDCAGE_FILE, output_dir=DIR_B, comm=comm), as the gate splits them (:115–119), so that run_b's in-memory summary exists; - assert each summary.json's mtime > t_start; - read a = g._load(DIR_A / "summary.json") and b = …, on every rank, after the call returns.

Then assert: - (D) Deterministic layer, bitwise. g._bitwise_flags(a, b) == set() (covers DETERMINISTIC + touchstone); set(a) == set(b); a["sha256"] == b["sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(g.BIRDCAGE_FILE.read_bytes()).hexdigest(); a["ranks"] == g.ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_RECORD_RANK_WIDTH, a["degree"] == 1, a["touchstone"] == "f_small_four_port.s4p". Plus the exact records above. - (F) File equals memory, bitwise. writer = comm.bcast(run_b.summary if comm.rank == 0 else None, root=0), then g._same(b, writer), the gate's fixed form (:142–143). Print the per-rank keys where the local run_b.summary differs from the file (predicted [[], ['elapsed_s']], :3687). - (R) Floating layer. g._rel(g._s(b), g._s(a)) ≤ g.L0_BAND. Predicted ≈ 1e-15 (backing 5.010e-16, :3690). - (X) Against the earlier process's record. g._rel(g._s(a), g._record(1)) ≤ g.L0_BAND, and the same for b. Predicted 9.557e-11 on both (:3691). - (T) Touchstone. Use DIR_A / a["touchstone"] and DIR_B / …: - header lines bar GENERATED_PREFIX bitwise equal, with len > 0; - one generated_utc line each; - no PLACEHOLDER in either file; - the two load_touchstone matrices within g.L0_BAND; - example-side, the parsed run_a matrix against g._s(a) within g.L0_BAND. Predicted ≈ 5e-14, the file's print precision; the gate's (T) parsed rel read 5.521e-14 between two files (:3693). - Printed only: both elapsed_s and wall times; Z rel(b, a) beside cond(I − S_a) (the gate's ruling (4)); every reading ÷ L0_BAND.

(2) Negative controls (rule (e) labels). - (c1) Degree plant, asserted, backed. plant = copy.deepcopy(b), set plant["degree"] = 2 and plant["s_matrix"] = [[[z.real, z.imag] for z in row] for row in g._record(2)] (the gate's :321–325). Assert g._bitwise_flags(a, plant) == {"degree"} and g._rel(g._s(plant), g._s(a)) > g.L0_BAND. Backing: 0.0495 = 4.95 × 10⁷ × the band (:3694), same comparison, fixture and width. - (c2) P1↔P2 swap, asserted, backed. perm = [1, 0, 2, 3]; g._rel(g._s(b)[np.ix_(perm, perm)], g._s(a)) > g.L0_BAND. Backing: 0.2492 (:3695). The bitwise layer is blind to this plant by construction: the swap edits no deterministic key. Print g._bitwise_flags(a, swapped_summary) == set() and say so in the guide. That is why the bundle needs both layers. - (c4) One-ULP σ config, one extra solve. g._fresh_dir(DIR_C); rc = g.cli.main(["run", str(CONTROL_YAML), "--output-dir", str(DIR_C)]); (0, 0); mtime > t_start; c = g._load(…). - Asserted, true by construction (the gate's (c4) form, :259–260, adapted): c["sha256"] != a["sha256"]; c["sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(CONTROL_YAML.read_bytes()).hexdigest(); g._bitwise_flags(a, c) == {"source", "sha256", "touchstone"}. - Why three keys, not the gate's two. _bitwise_flags compares touchstone whenever both summaries carry it (:83–86). The .s4p is named after the study file's stem (study_yaml.py:1199), and the control file has its own stem, so touchstone differs by name. The sphere control in the gate wrote no Touchstone, so its set was {source, sha256} (W1 :287). - What the set shows. cells, degree, frequency_hz, ranks, family and femem are all equal. source and touchstone record only where the file is and what it is called. sha256 is the only key derived from the file's content, and it is the one that sees the σ change. The guide says this in these terms. - Never loosen the assertion to a subset or superset test. - Predicted, printed only: g._rel(g._s(c), g._s(a)), predicted ≤ 1e-12 and therefore below L0_BAND: the float layer is blind. The basis is a 2⁻⁵³ relative change in σ plus the 5.010e-16 drift. It is unmeasured on this fixture; the sphere analogue read 7.566e-12 (W1 :288). Also print the Touchstone header (bar generated_utc) of c against a. It is predicted equal: the header carries port order, frequency and z0 only (ports/touchstone.py:177–181), so the .s4p header is blind too. - (c3) Key plants on the real run_b summary, asserted, true by construction (the gate ran them on a synthetic dict, W1 :64). On copies of b: - cells + 1 is flagged as exactly {cells}; - one hex digit of sha256 changed is flagged as exactly {sha256}; - a deleted ranks is flagged as exactly {g.KEYSET}; - a changed elapsed_s is flagged as set() (wall clock is excluded by design). - (c5) Resolution plant, asserted, now backed. g._rel(g._s(b) * (1 + 1e-8), g._s(a)) > g.L0_BAND. Backing: 1.000e-08 = 10.00 × the band (:3696). The gate printed it as a prediction; it is the same arithmetic on the same fixture, now measured. The ceiling is not relevant (the reading is arithmetic, ≈ 1e-8).

No PREDICTED RED: line. A red anywhere stops the slot.

Output. - The diff table examples/mri/paraview_output/mri_27_femem_run_bundle_reproducible_diff.csv, written by rank 0 after every assertion. It has one row per summary key in set(a) | set(c), plus one row per Touchstone header line. The columns are: - key; - layer (deterministic / floating / wall_clock); - a_vs_b (equal, or the rel at 4 significant digits); - a_vs_c4; - flagged_by (which of (c1)–(c5) flag this key, or empty).

It holds no S, Z or matrix entry, only rels and flags. - Setup figure on run_b.result.mesh / run_b.result.cell_tags, with mri:8's call (08_study_four_port_birdcage.py:127–148): air hidden, phantom translucent, slice_normal=(0, 0, 1), and the tag list gathered with allgather as there. Over 600 KiB ⇒ re-render once with show_edges_on_slice=False. - Combined XDMF examples/mri/paraview_output/mri_27_femem_run_bundle_reproducible_combined.xdmf, written as write_xdmf_with_tags(OUTPUT_DIR / f"{BASENAME}_combined", msh, run_b.result.cell_tags, {"owner_rank": r}, comm=comm), then adopt_host_ownership(OUTPUT_DIR, comm=comm). - r is a DG0 Function named owner_rank, whose owned cells hold comm.rank (real part; scatter_forward). It is the partition behind the bundle's ranks: 2. - The guide labels it "the partition this run used", not a reproducibility claim. Its partition is not compared across runs. - No field solve: PortStudyResult.fields is None (study.py:660), and mri:8 already shows the P1 field. - Guide. ## Related, by full filename: - examples: examples/mri/09_study_from_yaml.md first, then examples/mri/21_femem_run_tune_section.md, examples/mri/13_temperature_from_yaml.md and examples/mri/08_study_four_port_birdcage.md; - tests: tests/package/test_wf2_bundle_reproducible.py and tests/package/test_wf1_study_yaml.py.

The guide explains: - what the bundle is; - the two layers and why -n 2 MUMPS is not bitwise run to run (known-issues "Second fixture (2026-09-29)" row), so solve output is never compared bitwise; - why elapsed_s and generated_utc are excluded; - the table of plant × layer: (c1) is caught by both layers, (c2) by floats only, (c4) by the hash only; - that the sha256 / cells equality with a week-old log is the deterministic layer's cross-process check, on one image (an image change moves cells, which is the record-reconciler's job, not a reproducibility failure).

How to use the diff CSV: open it in a spreadsheet and filter layer. ParaView: colour by owner_rank, threshold CellTags. State plainly: one fixture, degree 1, -n 2, one image, in-process cli.main; not a cross-width, cross-machine, degree-2 or physics claim. One sentence in ## 2: ./scripts/run_examples.sh -e mri:27 -n 2 -t 420, heavy by ceiling, the measured wall time. Write ≈, never a tilde. - Docrefs (the EX-115 item 477 lesson). The checker reduces every .xdmf / .h5 / .bp / .csv / .json / .png / .msh token to its basename (scripts/testing/check_example_doc_references.py:116). - The guide never writes summary.json. It lives in a run subdirectory and would read as dead. Say "the run's JSON summary" (mri:21's phrase, 21_femem_run_tune_section.md:11). Say "the .s4p", never its filename. - The only output files the guide names are the combined XDMF, its .h5, the diff CSV and the setup PNG. - Before the census windows, grep -nE "summary\.json|\.(json|msh|bp|s1p|s4p)\b" examples/mri/27_femem_run_bundle_reproducible.md must print only bare-extension mentions (`.s4p`), no filename.

(3) Tier, ranks, measured cost. Heavy by ceiling, -n 2 (g.ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_RECORD_RANK_WIDTH, asserted), complex build. The runner takes -t 420 (mri:21's) and the container timeout -k 30 420. Every window is under 10 min, so the plain runner form is used and no durable capture is needed (§5.1). - Price basis: - each four-port CLI run ≈ 36.8 s (:3686; mesh + sweep at 117 206 cells); - three runs ≈ 110 s; - start-up / import / JIT / prints ≈ 12 s (EX-120's); - setup figure (flagged run only) ≈ 15 s; - DG0 + XDMF ≈ 2 s; - the plants and the parse-only checks < 1 s. - Flagged run predicted ≈ 140 s, range [100, 260] s; control ≈ 125 s, range [90, 240] s. - Memory: ≈ 2–4 GiB summed (EX-120's 80 798-cell hole read 1.75 GiB). report_peak_rss is printed; > 8 GiB is reported. - Cost: ≈ 8.8 measured (example class median) / ≈ 42 predicted min: 10 fixed + ≈ 12 script + ≈ 7 windows (two ≈ 2.5 min runs, dry run, four censuses) + ≈ 6 guide + ≈ 4 leak guard / commit + ≈ 3 spare. - Park if window 3 has not started by minute 28, or window 4 by minute 37 (rule (d)). - Depends on: nothing open. Item 346 is on main. Never run beside another heavy window. - Shared files. Four new paths; nothing under tests/ or src/. If anything under tests/ or src/ turns out to be needed, stop and report; do not edit it.

Windows. Each runs in the foreground with Bash timeout: 660000, as one bare, whole, repo-relative harness call. 0. Orphan check: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 reads 0. 1. WF-10 is ✅ on steps 1, 1e and 2; step 5 is a record on it (the WF-10 §7 row, "Step 5 record"). - Base. tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_four_port_sar10g.py (the gate module). Its fixture is item 358's build_tuned_quadrature (with_z50=False): the copper (Leontovich) F-human hole mesh, 369 387 cells, degree 1, 64 MHz, κ off, r = 0.2 Ω on all 32 gaps, C at the two-port root 118.2437 pF. On it, EX-75's four-port drive (feeds P17 / P21 / P25 / P29, slots 0 / 4 / 8 / 12 of the feed ring, ccw quadrature phases) runs untuned, and 359's 18-point _lattice is read at 10 g under both drives. - Run of record (gate). docs/testing/logs/20261013T141801Z_WF-10-step5-W1.log (heavy, -n 8, 6 passed, Status 0, 259 s harness / 255.0 s window, summed RSS 9.93 GiB, :6405, :6481–6482). (C4₄) m = 1 / 2 / 3: 1.8127 / 0.7215 / 0.2645 % (:6395); two-port control 17.3831 / 0.8080 / 16.1396 % (:6396); spread per radius four-port 3.2122 / 4.2668 / 0.7809 % beside two-port 16.7267 / 20.9986 / 18.6041 % (:6398); verdict drive anisotropy, [True, True, True] (:6399). W0 (20261013T141749Z_WF-10-step5-W0.log, -n 1) is the coding test only and is not re-run here.

Gap (grep at drafting: four_port_sar10g, _c4_misses, _four_port_drive, C4 with 10 g over examples/**/*.py; no example imports the gate module). - mri:18 (examples/mri/18_f_human_four_port_quadrature.py, EX-75) drives this fixture with the four-port and reads only fields: its k-spectrum, |B₁⁺|, C4 / C16 spreads of |B₁⁺| and Y_in. Its docstring says "not 10 g SAR" (:30–31). - mri:17 (examples/mri/17_f_human_tuned_quadrature_b1_sar.py, EX-109) reads the same 18-point 10 g lattice under the two-port drive only. It prints the azimuthal spread (16.7 / 21.0 / 18.6 %) and asserts no C4 identity, because the two-port loading has none. - mri:4 (examples/mri/04_f_human_sar10g_hotspot.py, EX-62) gates C16 of 10 g SAR at c* on the σ = 800 S/m WF-7 fixture under the ideal 32-port superposition, with a single-feed control. It is a different fixture and a different drive, with no tuned copper coil and no two-port comparand. - The angle (new): the drive-dependence of the 10 g C4 covariance on the tuned copper F-human. The same 12 z_c balls (one C4 orbit per radius) pass C4 under the four-port drive and miss it under the clinical two-port. Side by side, the per-radius spreads show that the two-port's 17–21 % azimuthal spread is drive anisotropy, not lattice resolution. No example shows a 10 g quantity under the four-port drive, or a C4 identity that one drive passes and another fails on one set of balls.

  • Executor: example-runner. It does not spawn agents.

  • Depends on: nothing open. Item 422's module (a11ef456, unchanged since) and every imported band are on main. It reads the gitignored logs/wf10/h9p-node-118.2437.json (host mtime 2026-10-13 09:20, written by the gate W1, :6336) and logs/wf12/h12c-cu-s32-a2.npz; both were present at drafting. Absent ⇒ stop, BLOCKED, never a re-solve.
  • Never beside another heavy window. No other heavy, xl or xxl window may be live (pre-check below).
  • Shared files. New paths only; nothing under tests/ or src/. If anything there turns out to be needed, stop and report; do not edit it.

Imports (never restated). Insert _REPO_ROOT into sys.path, then import tests.validation.test_wf10_f_human_four_port_sar10g as g5. - From g5's module namespace: _four_port_drive (:120–258), _c4_misses (:81), _spreads (:88), _zc_rows (:94), _spectrum_share, _ring_vector, TWO_PORT_ZC_RECORD, TWO_PORT_SPREADS, TWO_PORT_C4_MISSES, VERDICT_FRACTION, PREDICTED_C4, PREDICTED_SPREAD4, PREDICTED_TWO_PORT_REPRO, C4_COVARIANCE_BAND, _rotate_z, LATTICE_R_M, C_IN_F_HUMAN_PF, NODE_JSON, _degree_knob, _signed_k_shares, _lattice, _containment. - The test body's own import lines (:308–337), copied verbatim to the script's module level: averaging_ball_radius, build_density_field, mass_averaged_sar, mean_sar; global_cell_tag_set; PHANTOM_RHO_KG_PER_M3; F_HUMAN_RING_RADIUS; DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL; EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL; QUADRATURE_DEGREE, TEN_GRAM_KG; PHANTOM_CELL_TAG; AZIMUTH_MATCH_DEG; REUSE_REPRODUCTION_RTOL; _residual; UNIT_WEIGHT_CONTROL_RTOL; CONDUCTOR_CLEARANCE_M, COVERAGE_BALL_PAD_M, FIRST_BALL_STOP_S, _phantom_geometry; Y0_CODING_BAND; build_tuned_quadrature; _rss_gib. - Identity asserts: - REUSE_REPRODUCTION_RTOL is tests.validation.test_port_birdcage_ring_matrix.REUSE_REPRODUCTION_RTOL (1e-6). Two constants carry that name (EX-114's 18:00 ruling); the PORT-19 one is never imported. - g5.C4_COVARIANCE_BAND is tests.validation.test_birdcage_b1_plus_map.C4_COVARIANCE_BAND. - From src and mri:17 / mri:18's import lines: write_setup_figure, write_xdmf_with_tags, adopt_host_ownership; PORT_LOWER / PORT_UPPER, CONDUCTOR_CELL_TAG as mri:18 imports them. _dg0_vec is copied from mri:17 (:190–196, example to example). - Rules. Never import a test_* name, and never call test_wf10_step5_four_port_sar10g. The script repeats that body's sequence (:342–565 at a11ef456) through the imported helpers, with a provenance comment naming the commit and span, as mri:17 repeats 358 / 359 (mri:17 docstring :10–18). Raise if default_scalar_type is not complex.

Structural asserts at start-up. comm.size == 8; _degree_knob() is None (FEM_EM_WF10_DEGREE unset: degree 1 only); os.path.exists(NODE_JSON). Read NODE_JSON on rank 0 before the builder and bcast it (:345–354), and assert rec["c_in_pf"] == C_IN_F_HUMAN_PF exactly.

Record checks (the 2026-10-14 10:30 ruling's form). Record digits go only into an example-local REC dict, each entry commented with its 20261013T141801Z_WF-10-step5-W1.log:<line>. cells is exact (369 387, :6324). Every other string record is compared at a relative tolerance of 10^-(d−2), where d is its printed significant digits. A record off by more than its tolerance stops the item.

Record Value (W1) d ⇒ tol Line four-port SAR10g, 12 z_c points e.g. 9.391419740e-04 … 6.554475109e-03 W/kg 10 ⇒ 1e-8 :6376–6387 two-port ccw SAR10g, same 12 points 6.830007305e-04 … 4.063626880e-03 W/kg 10 ⇒ 1e-8 :6376–6387 (= g5.TWO_PORT_ZC_RECORD) four-port SAR10g, 6 off-plane points :6388–6393 10 ⇒ 1e-8 :6388–6393 ball masses e.g. 9.994606 g 7 ⇒ 1e-5 :6339–6368 (C4₄) per m 1.8127 / 0.7215 / 0.2645 % 5 / 4 / 4 ⇒ 1e-3 / 1e-2 / 1e-2 :6395 control per m 17.3831 / 0.8080 / 16.1396 % 6 / 4 / 6 :6396 spread per radius, four-port 3.2122 / 4.2668 / 0.7809 % 5 / 5 / 4 :6398 spread per radius, two-port in-window 16.7267 / 20.9986 / 18.6041 % 6 :6398 verdict drive anisotropy, [True, True, True] exact string :6399 c*₄ label and SAR10g(c*₄) r=45 dz=+0 az17+270, 6.554475109e-03 W/kg exact / 10 :6394 P_src,4 / P_phantom,4 2.102028870e-01 / 1.204416570e-02 W 10 :6371 four-port k = 0 / bin 15 share 4.5411e-07 / 0.999450 5 / 6 :6374 per watt, peak-to-mean, P_phantom/P_src,4 3.118166e-02 / 1.2031 / 5.729781e-02 7 / 5 / 7 :6404

Excluded from record equality (round-off readings, asserted at their bands only and printed beside their line): (S_rep) 2.578446e-13 (:6337), (X4-P) 3.286e-13 (:6371), (X4-L) 6.920e-16 (:6372), (Σ_P)₄ 0.000e+00 (:6401), (i)₄ 4.219e-15 / 6.994e-15 (:6400), the two-port (P_w) / (Lin) (:6402), and the in-window-vs-359 reproduction 1.912e-10 (:6397). Wall times and RSS are never records. The Y_in row (:6373) is printed at ≤ 6 significant digits and is not a record.

(1) Anchor — the gate's, asserted at the imported bands. The assert lines are copied from :546–565, one printed line per anchor, beside its REC entry.

Anchor Assertion (C4₄), the gate max over m = 1, 2, 3 of _c4_misses(_zc_rows(sar4, lattice)) ≤ C4_COVARIANCE_BAND (5 %) builder (A0), census, (P_RC) and node NEG, asserted inside build_tuned_quadrature (S_rep) _residual(s_node, s_rec) ≤ REUSE_REPRODUCTION_RTOL two-port (P_w) ≤ DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL, (Lin) ≤ UNIT_WEIGHT_CONTROL_RTOL, Y_in ≤ Y0_CODING_BAND, per sense four-port construction κ off on every sheet; feeds 90° apart within AZIMUTH_MATCH_DEG; feeds 0 / 1 equal the two-port feeds; (X4-K) kinds ['solve','held','held','held']; (X4-P) ≤ DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL; (X4-L) ≤ UNIT_WEIGHT_CONTROL_RTOL (Σ_P)₄, (i)₄ P_phantom,4 against mean_sar; coverage-ball power and mass; all ≤ EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL; coverage radius < F_HUMAN_RING_RADIUS − CONDUCTOR_CLEARANCE_M (iv) worst containment ≤ 0 over every ball

Example-side anchors (asserted; imported bands only). Each is an exact identity. - (O) The 12 z_c balls are one C4 orbit per radius. For the in-window _lattice(az17, z_c), max over m of |_rotate_z(row 0, m·π/2) − row m| / max(LATTICE_R_M) ≤ EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL. This is the gate's coding check (L4)(a) on the actual centres, and the precondition for (C4₄) meaning anything. Predicted ≤ 1e-15. - (X1)₄ / (X1)₂ The DG0 loss maps sum to the phantom power. loss4 = _dg0_vec(0.5·σ·⟨E₄, E₄⟩·v̄·dx(PHANTOM_CELL_TAG)), summed over owned cells and reduced, equals d4["parts"]["p_phantom"] ≤ EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL. The same holds for the ccw field against out["parts"]["ccw"]["p_phantom"]. This is mri:17's (X1) (:396–399), which read round-off on this mesh under the two-port drive; under the four-port drive it is unmeasured, so a red there stops the slot.

(2) Negative controls (rule (e)). - Asserted (backed: same comparison, same fixture, same node, same 12 balls): max(_c4_misses(two-port z_c rows)) > C4_COVARIANCE_BAND. W1 read 17.3831 % at m = 1 (:6396), 3.5× the band, and 359 read the same table (g5.TWO_PORT_C4_MISSES). Only "> band" is asserted, never a factor. - Printed, not asserted — the 180° blindness (predicted): at m = 2 alone, both drives sit inside the band. The prediction is four-port ≈ 0.72 % and two-port ≈ 0.81 % (:6395–6396), so a 180°-only C4 check cannot tell the drives apart, and the gate takes the max over m = 1, 2, 3. The printed line is labelled PREDICTED inside band (printed only); outside that prediction it is reported, with no status effect. - Printed, not asserted: the in-window two-port table against g5.TWO_PORT_ZC_RECORD, max rel, beside g5.PREDICTED_TWO_PORT_REPRO (1e-9; W1 1.912e-10).

Printed only (predictions written in the script before window 3; no band). - The record: spread per radius, four-port beside two-port in-window and g5.TWO_PORT_SPREADS, and ⅓ of the latter (5.58 / 7.00 / 6.20 %). Below it the verdict line, built exactly as the gate does (:463–465, g5.VERDICT_FRACTION): predicted drive anisotropy at all three radii. The ratio spread₄ / spread₂ per radius is predicted ≈ 0.19 / 0.20 / 0.04. - The 18-point four-port table, and c*₄ (predicted r = 45 mm, z_c). - SAR10g(c*₄) per W of P_src,4 beside the two-port's 5.607e-02; peak-to-mean beside 1.309; P_phantom/P_src,4 beside 0.0947 (:6404). - The four-port k = 0 / k = −1 shares beside EX-75's 4.54e-07 / 0.99945. - Price: build, node pair, four-port solves, ball count, per-ball mean / max, SAR phase, DG0 maps, figure, XDMF, _rss_gib summed, window. Labelled "degree 1, untuned four-port at the two-port root: per-W SAR values are not an absolute or tuned-coil SAR".

Outputs. - Setup figure with mri:18's call (:267–290): air hidden, phantom translucent, slice_normal=(0, 0, 1) at z_c. The labels come from d4["feeds4"] ("feed P17 (0 deg)" … "feed P29 (270 deg)"; other gaps "C_in + 0.2 Ohm gap"), so the figure is drawn after _four_port_drive returns. Title ≤ 130 characters, e.g. "mri:28 -- tuned copper F-human, four feeds 0 / 90 / 180 / 270 deg at the two-port root: 10 g C4 orbit (WF-10 step 5)". The hole route draws the coil as a void, and the guide says so. Over 600 KiB ⇒ re-render once with show_edges_on_slice=False. - Combined XDMF examples/mri/paraview_output/mri_28_f_human_four_port_sar10g_c4_combined.xdmf via write_xdmf_with_tags(path, msh, cell_tags, export, comm=comm). DG0, real, each key equal to its Function's name: - SAR_local_4port_per_W and SAR_local_2port_ccw_per_W: loss / (ρ·vol) on phantom cells with loss > 0, divided by the drive's own P_src, mri:17's :593–594; - SAR_local_4p_over_2p_per_W: their ratio where both > 0, else 0; - ZcBall: 1–12 = 1 + 3m + radius index on cells whose midpoint is within a₁₀ of a z_c centre, mri:17's marker loop :596–611; - C4Orbit: 1 / 2 / 3 = radius index on the same cells. - Then call adopt_host_ownership(OUTPUT_DIR, comm=comm). - CSV …_zc_rows.csv in the same paraview_output/: label, r, az offset (0 / 90 / 180 / 270), x, y, z, SAR10g four-port, SAR10g two-port, both per W of P_src, mass. Written on rank 0 after every collective. - Guide. - Why the four-port loading is C4-invariant in CAD (four feeds at Z_th 90° apart, 28 gaps at Z_RC, and ccw weights that pick up a common phase under a 4-slot rotation) and the two-port's is not. - Why each radius's four z_c balls are one C4 orbit, and why the max over m matters (the 180° blindness). - The spread per radius as the record, and how the verdict reads H18's 17–21 % as drive anisotropy rather than lattice resolution (≈ 1.8 cells per 10 g ball on the 0.015 m phantom). - That the four-port drive runs untuned at the two-port root, as in EX-75, so its per-W values compare shapes, not tuned SARs. - A ParaView recipe: threshold ZcBall ≥ 1 coloured by SAR_local_4port_per_W, then the same for SAR_local_2port_ccw_per_W on one colour scale; slice z = z_c on SAR_local_4p_over_2p_per_W; group by C4Orbit. - One sentence in ## 2: ./scripts/run_examples.sh -e mri:28 -n 8 -t 590, heavy, the measured wall time. - Related, by full filename: examples/mri/18_f_human_four_port_quadrature.md, examples/mri/17_f_human_tuned_quadrature_b1_sar.md, examples/mri/04_f_human_sar10g_hotspot.md, then tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_four_port_sar10g.py, tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_tuned_sar10g.py. - States plainly: degree 1, one fixture, an untuned four-port, no absolute SAR, no tuning, no compliance claim. Write ≈, never a tilde. - Docrefs (the EX-115 item 477 lesson). The checker reduces every .xdmf / .h5 / .csv / .json / .png / .msh token to its basename and looks only in the guide's paraview_output/ and figures/ and the shared paraview_output/. The guide names no output file but the combined XDMF, its .h5, the CSV and the setup PNG. The node record is named as NODE_JSON in prose, never by its .json filename, and the npz likewise. Before the census windows, grep -nE "\.(json|msh|bp|npz)\b" examples/mri/28_f_human_four_port_sar10g_c4.md must read nothing.

(3) Tier and windows. Heavy, -n 8, complex build.

Price (from the gate log). The gate window was 255.0 s (:6405): build 113.5 s, node pair 34.1 s, superposition 7.0 s, four-port solves 29.2 s, partitions 3.5 s, and 30 balls + coverage in a SAR phase of 60.6 s at 1.96 s mean / 2.10 s max per ball. On top of that: - two DG0 loss vectors plus their JIT, ≈ 15 s; - the five-field DG0 XDMF on 369 387 cells, ≈ 10 s; - the setup figure (flagged only), ≈ 20 s (mri:18's flagged 206 s against its 194 s control); - start-up, ≈ 10 s.

The run of record is predicted at ≈ 310 s harness, range [250, 500] s, runner -t 590. Summed RSS is predicted ≈ 10.2 GiB (W1 9.93 GiB), ≤ 14 GiB. On 10-15 / 10-16 the host ran ≈ 1.4–2× slow (EX-122's note), and 1.9× reaches 590 s, so window 3 uses §5.1's durable-capture idiom verbatim inside the container command, with the trailing ; exit $rc.

Windows. Each runs in the foreground with Bash timeout: 660000, as one bare, whole, repo-relative harness call. 0. docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 must read 0 (two heavy windows never at once). Confirm no xl / xxl window is live by reading the last rows of docs/testing/xl-ledger.md / xxl-ledger.md with the Read tool, never a shell command naming that service. Confirm examples/mri/28_* does not exist. 1. Pre-censuses, run before any file is written: - scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh EX-127-pre-figures "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && timeout -k 30 60 python3 scripts/testing/check_example_setup_figures.py'" - scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh EX-127-pre-docrefs "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && timeout -k 30 60 python3 scripts/testing/check_example_doc_references.py'"

The last reading on main was examples=119 ok=119 missing=0 broken=0 (20261016T184441Z_EX-122-post-figures.log:155) and dead=0 guide=0 stale=129 exit 2 (20261016T184443Z_EX-122-post-docrefs.log:169). Use what the pre-census reads, because sibling 10-16 items may land first. Exit 2 is staleness information; exit 1 is a failure. 2. Dry run, after the script exists: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh EX-127-dryrun "./scripts/run_examples.sh -e mri:28 -n 8 -t 590 --dry-run". It must print (complex build). 3. Run of record, labelled EX-127, flagged. This is the emitted inner command, with -T, the flag and the durable capture: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh EX-127 "docker compose exec -T -e FEM_EM_SETUP_FIGURES=1 fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && mkdir -p /workspace/logs && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 8 python3 examples/mri/28_f_human_four_port_sar10g_c4.py > /workspace/logs/EX-127-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo [capture] rc=\$rc >> /workspace/logs/EX-127-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/EX-127-raw.log; exit \$rc'"

Pass means all of the following: - Status 0 and [capture] rc=0; - every gate anchor, (O), (X1)₄ / (X1)₂ and the asserted control green; - every covered record inside its tolerance; - the closing "All assertions hold" line.

If the dry run's inner string differs from the above in anything but the flag and the capture, use the dry run's and say so. 4. git add the PNG and check that it is ≤ 600 KiB. No unflagged control re-run (EX-122's ruling: the template asks for one only when a figure is retrofitted, and a second ≈ 5-minute window buys no identity). 5. Write the guide from window 3's log and run the docrefs grep above. Then EX-127-post-figures and EX-127-post-docrefs (the window 1 commands, relabelled). Prediction first: figures N → N + 1, missing=0 broken=0; docrefs dead=0, exit ≠ 1. Any dead reference naming mri_28_* or 28_f_human_four_port_sar10g_c4.md fails the item. 6. git status --porcelain examples/ tests/ src/ lists exactly the three new examples/ paths. 7. The pre-commit leak guard runs on the staged logs.

(4) Traps already paid for. - Read NODE_JSON before the builder. build_tuned_quadrature rewrites it (:6336), and (S_rep) compares against the pre-build copy. FEM_EM_WF10_DEGREE must be unset (asserted): at degree 2 the node path becomes -d2 and the build is a different, ≈ 5× larger problem (item 459, xl entry 35). - Never hold a factor across an impedance change (PORT-19). _four_port_drive factorises on its first feed (with the wall) and holds only the next three. Call it unchanged; never reorder it. - Memory: del out["e"]["cw"], out["e17"], out["e21"] before _four_port_drive, as the gate does (:381–382), and keep out["e"]["ccw"] for the control balls and (X1)₂. - The 180° trap. m = 2 alone passes both drives (0.72 / 0.81 %). The gate and the control take the max over m = 1, 2, 3; never print a single-m verdict. - The gate and the record read the same 12 balls. A C4 green at 5 % rel L2 still allows spreads up to ≈ 10 %, so the gate does not pre-decide the ⅓ record. Never tighten anything to "help" the verdict. - FIRST_BALL_STOP_S (25 s) reduces the four-port lattice to its 12 z_c points if the first ball trips it. That is pre-registered and not a red; the off-plane records are then reported as not read. - Collectives. Every rank enters every mass_averaged_sar / mean_sar call (item 227's deadlock). Ball centres go in as plain floats. Wall times are MAX-reduced, so the STOP decision is collective. DG0 sums are owned-only and reduced. No collective goes inside a rank == 0 branch (the EX-115 item 456 crash). A rank-local exception hangs the job, and Status 124 is a finding, never a retry. - The complex build. .x.array is complex: masks and ratios are built in numpy, np.real comes before every float, and there is no UFL comparison, max_value or sqrt. Every Function is named (EX-79). - Subscripts (the EX-114 KeyError: -1). sar4 / sar2 are dicts keyed by lattice label; _zc_rows returns shape (4, 3); _c4_misses returns a dict keyed 1 / 2 / 3. No negative index on a mapping. Read every subscript in the tail against its type before window 3, because the output section runs after every assertion. - The private-leak guard (EX-112). The copper F-human has private AED counterparts (ANS-8). Print every new value at ≤ 6 significant digits; only the record reprints carry the gate log's digits, which are already tracked. Never print an S, Z or Y array with repr. If the guard fires: never bypass it and never edit a log; move the flagged logs unchanged into logs/leak-held/, commit the rest, mark item 505 BLOCKED, journal the log:line (never the figure), and stop. - Harness shape. Bare, whole command. ./scripts/run_examples.sh runs host-side; take its line from --dry-run, and never wrap the script itself in docker compose exec. A docker-socket denial ⇒ stop and report the exact string. Never raise a timeout or -n. After Status 124 or a kill, run pgrep -c python3 first, and only if it reads 0, the orphan-.c cache sweep (daily-review.md rubric 4) labelled EX-127-cache-sweep. - Rule (i): no script edit after window 3 starts, and no guide edit after window 5 starts. Anchor Assertion (A0r) cells < F_HUMAN_KEPT_ROD_CELL_GUARD; |cells / F_HUMAN_KEPT_ROD_CELL_RECORD − 1| ≤ CELL_COUNT_BAND; _census_checks clean; tag-403 cells > 0 (M0) DG0 σ / εᵣ on owned 403 cells, min = max: 800 / gel εᵣ (with), gel σ / εᵣ (without) masks lead and 3 mm tip-ball counts > 0, disjoint feeds 32 ports in order; P17 / P21 90° apart within AZIMUTH_MATCH_DEG; slots 0 / 4 (P_RC) node partition per arm ≤ DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL (P_w) ccw / cw per arm ≤ DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL (T3) |fold_d − Δq_d| ≤ DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL·|Δq_d| for d ∈ {P17, P21} (Σ_P) mean_sar (solver σ, tag 3) against the partition's P_phantom, per arm, ≤ EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL coverage whole-phantom ball (σ₃) power and mass per arm ≤ EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL; R_cov < F_HUMAN_RING_RADIUS − CONDUCTOR_CLEARANCE_M

(S_rep) is not among them: it is W1a's anchor on item 358's mesh, cited at 20261011T200648Z_IMP-3-step8-W1a-repro.log:6297, and this example does not build that mesh.

Example-side anchors (asserted; imported bands only). Each is an exact identity on this window's own fields. - (L)₀ / (L)_w: the DG0 phantom-loss maps sum to the partition. loss = _dg0_vec(0.5 * arm["sigma"] * ufl.inner(E_ccw, E_ccw) * ufl.conj(v) * dx(PHANTOM_CELL_TAG)) is mri:17's form (:396–397). Its owned sum, reduced, equals arm["parts"]["ccw"]["p_phantom"] within EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL, for both arms. This is mri:17's (X1) (asserted at :559), which read 2.220e-16 / 6.661e-16 on this family's 369 387-cell mesh (20261017T033328Z_EX-127.log:6235). It is unmeasured on the rod mesh, so a red stops the slot. - (L-rod): the rod's own loss map sums to P_rod. The same form on dx(BIRDCAGE_IMPLANT_CELL_TAG) with the with arm's solver σ, owned sum reduced, equals arm_w["parts"]["ccw"]["p_rod"] within EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL. The integrand is the gate's p_rod (:677). - (B) Ball masks (structural). The two 1 g masks (gel cells whose midpoint is within a₁g of TIPS[tip]) have reduced counts > 0 and contain no tag-403 cell.

(2) Negative controls (rule (e)). - The gate's, as the gate wired them (asserted): C1 (Hermitian read-back, conj(w)) and C2 (total-field fold, E_with) each miss > DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL (:843). The predicted factors are printed beside W1b's (PRED_C1 (0.10, 2.00), read 1.9933 / 1.9932; PRED_C2 (0.80, 1.05), read 0.9306 / 0.9305). - Newly asserted, backed by W1b on the same comparison, fixture and mesh. The gate printed these because none had a prior (ruling (3)); W1b is now that prior. - Node NEG per arm ≥ BLIND_FACTOR × DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL, the P_surf-blind miss of (P_RC). W1b read 7.0154e-3 / 7.0153e-3 (:6354, :6357), ≈ 700× above the bar. Its ceiling is P_surf / P_src ≈ 7e-3. The bar is the one the gate's W1a asserts (:335). - C3 (the with-arm whole ball computed with the solver σ instead of σ₃) misses by > EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL. W1b read 8.3070e-05 = P_rod / P_phantom (:6365, :6375). Only "> band" is asserted; the equality with P_rod / P_phantom is printed. - (Cq) Q > 1 on all six tip rows (top / bottom × ccw / P17 / P21). W1b's minimum is 1.647872 (P17 bottom, :6370); the rows are at :6366–6371. This asserts a sign, not a band, as EX-122's (Cq) and EX-83 did. - The review may relabel any of the three as printed.

Printed only (predictions written in the script before window 3; no band). All from numpy masks over owned gel cells, reduced, ccw, using the two arms' σ₃ local SAR on the shared mesh: - Tip-near map ratio. Over gel cells within 1.0 mm of each tip: count, max and volume-weighted mean of SAR_with / SAR_without. Predicted max > Q_top,ccw (3.804): pointwise exceeds the 1 g average. No ceiling is claimed. - Shaft shadow. Over gel cells with 1.0 mm < distance to the rod axis < 2.0 mm and |z| < 5 mm: the volume-weighted mean ratio. Predicted in [0, 1): the conductor shorts E_z along its shaft, and η_z,ccw = 0.918. - Far field. Over gel cells more than 30 mm from the rod axis: the volume-weighted mean ratio. Predicted in [0.97, 1.03]. ΔSAR10g(c*) at ≈ 30.4 mm read −1.65 %. - Price: the gate phases (build, both arms, tip balls), the DG0 maps, XDMF, figure, _rss_gib summed, and the window. Labelled "degree 1, one σ rod, tuned copper F-human at the rod-free root: SAR values are not an absolute, a tip-ratio accuracy or a compliance figure".

Outputs. All written after the asserts. - Setup figure with mri:18's call shape (:267–290): - names: air 2 hidden, phantom PHANTOM_CELL_TAG translucent, CONDUCTOR_CELL_TAG "conductor (hole route: void)", 403 "rod sigma = 800 S/m (tag 403)"; - port boxes: "feed P17 (0 deg)", "feed P21 (90 deg)", all other gaps "C_in + 0.2 Ohm gap"; - slice_normal=(0, 1, 0) through slice_origin=(0, 0, 0), which cuts the rod's axis at x = 15 mm; - title ≤ 130 characters, e.g. "imp:10 -- sigma = 800 S/m rod in the tuned copper F-human gel phantom, two-port 90 deg drive (IMP-3 step 8)". - Over 600 KiB ⇒ re-render once with show_edges_on_slice=False. - Combined XDMF examples/implants/paraview_output/implants_10_sigma_rod_in_tuned_f_human_tip_sar_combined.xdmf via write_xdmf_with_tags(path, msh, cell_tags, export, comm=comm). DG0, real, each key equal to its Function's name: - SAR_local_without_ccw_per_W and SAR_local_with_ccw_per_W: each arm's (L) loss / (ρ·vol) on tag-3 cells, divided by that arm's own ccw P_src (mri:17's :593–594 construction); - SAR_local_with_over_without_ccw: their ratio where the without loss > 0, else 0, computed in numpy; - rod_loss_density_with_ccw_per_W: the (L-rod) vector / vol on tag-403 cells, divided by P_src (W/m³ per W); - one_gram_ball_top, one_gram_ball_bottom, tf_probe_ball (χ_b, the 3 mm (T3) ball). - Then call adopt_host_ownership(OUTPUT_DIR, comm=comm). - CSV …_tip_rows.csv in the same paraview_output/, on rank 0 after every collective: tip, drive, SAR1g without, SAR1g with, Q, mass, η_z, M_cf, est, Q/est (the six gate rows). - Guide. - What a material-switched implant buys: one mesh, so the cellwise ratio is meaningful, unlike imp:3 / imp:9. - Why the tip enhances and the shaft shadows. - Q against the IMP-2 estimate η_z·M_cf + (1 − η_z), and why P17 alone (η_z 0.459) reads Q ≈ 1.7 while ccw reads 3.8. - The adjoint fold (T3): Δq from one held solve, LOAD·Δσ·∫χ_lead w·E_without, against the with-arm solve, and C1 / C2 as the conjugation and total-field traps. - Why σ₃ rather than the solver σ (C3). - That C_in is the rod-free root (no re-tune). - A ParaView recipe: threshold CellTags = 3, slice y = 0 on SAR_local_with_over_without_ccw (log scale), add the threshold CellTags = 403 coloured by rod_loss_density_with_ccw_per_W, then Plot Over Line along x = 0.015, y = 0. - One sentence in ## 2: ./scripts/run_examples.sh -e imp:10 -n 8 -t 590, heavy, the measured wall time. - Related, by full filename: examples/implants/03_rod_in_birdcage_tip_sar.md, examples/implants/07_lead_tf_in_the_coil.md, examples/implants/09_pec_disc_in_birdcage_rim_sar.md, examples/mri/17_f_human_tuned_quadrature_b1_sar.md, then tests/validation/test_imp3_f_human_tuned_rod.py, tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_rod_f_human.py, tests/validation/test_wf9_lead_in_coil_phantom.py. - States plainly: degree 1, one fixture, one σ rod, no tip-ratio accuracy, no heating, no compliance. Write ≈, never a tilde. - Docrefs (the EX-115 item 477 lesson). The guide names no output file but the combined XDMF, its .h5, the CSV and the setup PNG. The node record is named as NODE_JSON in prose, never by its .json filename. Before the census windows, grep -nE "\.(json|msh|bp|npz)\b" examples/implants/10_sigma_rod_in_tuned_f_human_tip_sar.md must read nothing.

(3) Tier and windows. Heavy, -n 8, complex build.

One arm, one window. The example runs W1b's body only. - W1a (156 s) is cited, not run. Its (S_rep) is a reproduction on a different mesh, which mri:17 and mri:28 already show in-window. - Running it as well would put the window at ≈ 510 s on a normal host. - No split exists. (T3) needs E_without, E_with and w in one process, and every window needs the 177 s kept-rod build (gmsh). A split would cost two builds and lose (T3).

Price (from W1b :6376). The window was 319.4 s: build 177.1 s, without arm 53.6 s, with arm 42.7 s, tip balls 28.1 s, and ≈ 18 s for (T3), coverage and SAR10g. On top of that: - the import and start-up, ≈ 10 s; - four DG0 loss vectors plus three masks, ≈ 1–15 s (mri:28's maps read 0.2 s warm, 20261017T033328Z_EX-127.log:6238); - the seven-field XDMF on 436 541 cells, ≈ 10 s; - the figure, flagged, ≈ 5 s (mri:28 4.4 s).

The run of record is predicted at ≈ 350 s harness, range [300, 560] s, runner -t 590. Summed RSS is predicted ≈ 11.5–12 GiB (W1b 11.49), ≤ 14 GiB.

The host-speed risk, stated plainly. - GEO-38 item 485's window was killed at 590 s with gmsh at 431 s against 295–310 s on the same geometry (+39 %, docs/testing/attempts.md:1725). EX-125 ran ≈ 1.9× slow at 2026-10-17 05:10Z. - At +39 % on the build alone, the window reads ≈ 420 s. At 1.7× on the whole window it reaches 590 s. - So window 3 uses §5.1's durable-capture idiom verbatim inside the container command, with the trailing ; exit $rc. A kill parks the item; it never raises -t or -n.

Windows. Each runs in the foreground with Bash timeout: 660000, as one bare, whole, repo-relative harness call. 0. Pre-checks. - docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 must read 0 (two heavy windows never at once). - Confirm no xl / xxl window is live by reading the last rows of docs/testing/xl-ledger.md / xxl-ledger.md with the Read tool, never a shell command naming that service. - ls -la logs/wf10/h9p-node-118.2437.json must exist; absent ⇒ BLOCKED. - Confirm examples/implants/10_* does not exist. 1. Pre-censuses, run before any file is written: - scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh EX-128-pre-figures "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && timeout -k 30 60 python3 scripts/testing/check_example_setup_figures.py'" - scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh EX-128-pre-docrefs "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && timeout -k 30 60 python3 scripts/testing/check_example_doc_references.py'"

The last reading on main at drafting was examples=123 ok=123 missing=0 broken=0 (20261017T051854Z_EX-125-post-figures.log:159) and dead=0 guide=0 stale=132 exit 2 (20261017T051857Z_EX-125-post-docrefs.log:172). EX-127 (item 505, parked) may land first and make it 124. Use what the pre-census reads, and state the census as before / after measured. Exit 2 is staleness information; exit 1 is a failure. 2. Dry run, after the script exists: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh EX-128-dryrun "./scripts/run_examples.sh -e imp:10 -n 8 -t 590 --dry-run". It must print (complex build).

2b. Tail smoke (standard, -n 2, ≈ 30 s; the EX-127 trap's guard). - The script puts everything after the asserts (DG0 fields, map readings, XDMF, CSV, the final prints; not the figure) in one function _outputs(comm, msh, cell_tags, arrays, rows, basename). - Under FEM_EM_EX128_TAIL_SMOKE=1 it calls only that function, then exits 0 printing tail smoke ok. The inputs are dolfinx.mesh.create_unit_cube(comm, 4, 4, 4), cell tags of 3 with 403 on cells within 0.15 of the cube centre, synthetic positive loss arrays, and synthetic tip rows. The basename is implants_10_tail_smoke, in the gitignored paraview_output/. - scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh EX-128-tail-smoke "docker compose exec -T -e FEM_EM_EX128_TAIL_SMOKE=1 fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src timeout -k 30 120 mpiexec -n 2 python3 examples/implants/10_sigma_rod_in_tuned_f_human_tip_sar.py'" - It must read Status 0 and tail smoke ok. A red here is fixed before window 3; rule (i) binds only from window 3. 3. Run of record, labelled EX-128, flagged. This is the emitted inner command, with -T, the flag and the durable capture: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh EX-128 "docker compose exec -T -e FEM_EM_SETUP_FIGURES=1 fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && mkdir -p /workspace/logs && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 8 python3 examples/implants/10_sigma_rod_in_tuned_f_human_tip_sar.py > /workspace/logs/EX-128-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo [capture] rc=\$rc >> /workspace/logs/EX-128-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/EX-128-raw.log; exit \$rc'"

Pass means all of the following: - Status 0 and [capture] rc=0; - every gate anchor, (L)₀ / (L)_w / (L-rod), (B) and every asserted control green; - every covered record inside its tolerance; - the closing "All assertions hold" line.

If the dry run's inner string differs from the above in anything but the flag and the capture, use the dry run's and say so. 4. git add the PNG and check that it is ≤ 600 KiB. No unflagged control re-run (EX-122's ruling; a second ≈ 6-minute window buys no identity). 5. Write the guide from window 3's log and run the docrefs grep above. Then EX-128-post-figures and EX-128-post-docrefs (the window 1 commands, relabelled). Prediction first: figures N → N + 1, missing=0 broken=0; docrefs dead=0, exit ≠ 1. Any dead reference naming implants_10_* or 10_sigma_rod_in_tuned_f_human_tip_sar.md fails the item. 6. git status --porcelain examples/ tests/ src/ lists exactly the three new examples/ paths. 7. The pre-commit leak guard runs on the staged logs.

(4) Traps already paid for. - The rank-0 tail (EX-127 item 505, 2026-10-17). write_xdmf_with_tags returns (None, None) on every rank but 0 (src/fem_em_solver/io/paraview_utils.py:192–194). mri:28 printed xdmf_path.name outside if rank0:, so ranks 1–7 raised AttributeError after every assertion was green (20261017T033328Z_EX-127.log:6278–6287), rank 0 hung to Status 124, and the slot parked. - Discard that return value. Print the path built locally from OUTPUT_DIR / f"{BASENAME}_combined.xdmf". - A rank-0 printer (_say, P) still evaluates its f-string on every rank: no rank-0-only object (that return value, an un-bcast point evaluation, a rank-0 CSV handle) may appear inside one. - Window 2b exercises exactly this tail at -n 2. - Gate fidelity. The body is repeated verbatim; never reorder _arm, the without-then-with order, _free(solver) between arms, or the held ℓ solve on the with-arm P17 factorisation. A held solve under a different termination silently solves a different problem (PORT-19, WF-12), and the wall and every sheet go into both factorisations. Only one factorisation is alive at a time (_free). - Unmapped kept cells silently become vacuum (WF-9.md:262). _build_f_human_rod maps 403 to the gel, and (M0) is the guard. Never build the mesh any other way. - σ₃, never the solver σ, for every SAR ball, the coverage and the SAR maps. The kept σ = 800 S/m rod sits inside every whole-phantom ball and within the tip balls' reach. C3 is the measured miss. The maps restrict to dx(PHANTOM_CELL_TAG), where solver σ = σ₃. - ufl.inner conjugates its second argument. q, the fold, C2 and every field reading use ufl.dot or components (the gate's lines, unchanged). The loss form is inner(E, E)·conj(v), as mri:17. - Read NODE_JSON before the build (_read_record does this first). The rod arm never rewrites it. Any other logs/ write is the raw capture only. - Complex build. .x.array is complex: masks and ratios are built in numpy from midpoints, np.real comes before every float, and there is no UFL comparison, max_value or sqrt. Every Function is named (EX-79). - Collectives. Every rank enters every mass_averaged_sar / mean_sar / evaluate_vector_field_parallel call (item 227's deadlock). Ball centres go in as plain floats. Map counts, sums and maxima are owned-only and reduced; an empty set reduces as 0 / −inf, never a rank-local max() of an empty array. No collective goes inside a rank == 0 branch (the EX-115 item 456 crash). A rank-local exception hangs the job, and Status 124 is a finding, never a retry. - Record subtraction noise. P_rest is excluded (above). Never add a subtraction-derived quantity to REC. - The private-leak guard (EX-112). The copper F-human has private AED counterparts (ANS-8). Every new value prints at ≤ 6 significant digits; only the gate's own _say lines carry W1b's digits, which are already tracked. Never print an S, Z or Y array with repr. If the guard fires: never bypass it and never edit a log; move the flagged logs unchanged into logs/leak-held/, commit the rest, mark item 508 BLOCKED, journal the log:line (never the figure), and stop. - Harness shape. Bare, whole command. ./scripts/run_examples.sh runs host-side; take its line from --dry-run, and never wrap the script itself in docker compose exec. A docker-socket denial ⇒ stop and report the exact string. Never raise a timeout or -n. After Status 124 or a kill, run pgrep -c python3 first, and only if it reads 0, the orphan-.c cache sweep (daily-review.md rubric 4) labelled EX-128-cache-sweep. - Rule (i): no script edit after window 3 starts, and no guide edit after window 5 starts. Check mtimes before committing.

(5) Scope boundary. One fixture: - I21a's kept-rod copper (Leontovich) F-human hole mesh, 436 541 cells, degree 1, κ off, 64 MHz, -n 8; - r = 0.2 Ω on all 32 gaps; the two-port 90° drive at the rod-free root C_in = 118.2437 pF; - one σ = 800 S/m capped rod (r = 1 mm, ℓ = 30 mm, axis ẑ, centre (0.015, 0, 0)) in the gel phantom; - ccw maps.

Not claimed: - an accurate tip ratio (no published comparand until (7c); ANS-10 is the accuracy route); - a PEC, insulated or real lead; - ISO 10974 or ASTM F2182; - heating; - absolute, tuned-coil or pointwise SAR; - compliance; - degree 2 or h-convergence (the 5.50 % human-scale order caveat, WF-7 step 0b); - f₀, Q, match or a re-tune with the rod in; - C16 or the mirror; - (S_rep) on 358's mesh (W1a, cited); - AED, Palace or any external check.

IMP-3, WF-9, WF-10, EX-83, EX-109 and EX-122 do not move.

(6) What a negative result means. Report and stop: journal it in docs/testing/attempts.md, park on attempt/EX-128-<UTC>, and mark item 508 BLOCKED with the unblock condition in the same commit (rule (d)). EX-128 stays ⬜. Never widen a band, never edit tests/ or src/, and never re-record from the example side. - (A0r), (M0) or a mask check red: the kept-rod build moved on main (a mesher or image change). Print cells beside :6350 and file a known-issues entry; never re-band. - (P_RC), (P_w), (T3), (Σ_P) or coverage red: main no longer reproduces the gate. Print the line beside its W1b line; known-issues entry. - A covered record off its tolerance: an example / gate divergence or a drifted main. Print the first differing value beside its log:line. - (L)₀, (L)_w or (L-rod) red: an example-side finding about the DG0 assembly on the rod mesh. Print both sides. - NEG, C3 or (Cq) not separating with the records inside tolerance: not possible, since they are the same numbers. If it happens, the control's code is wrong: BLOCKED. - Window 2b red: fixed before window 3 (not a park). - Leak guard fires: BLOCKED as in the traps, not ✅. - A defect after every assertion is green (figure, XDMF or CSV; the EX-114 / EX-127 shape): BLOCKED with the log:line, returned to the review. No in-slot fix after window 3. - Status 124, over 590 s, or past minute 28 before window 3: park with the last line of the raw capture log. The shrink is the review's: the figure into a separate item, or the P17 / P21 tip rows printed from fewer balls. Never raise -t. - Every printed map ratio is a reading, never a red.

There is no PREDICTED RED: line, so any red stops the slot.

(7) Status it can move. EX-128 ⬜ → ✅ under the §7 Done-when that the review pastes in the same commit as this item (rule (j)). The figures census rises by one from its measured pre-census value, with missing=0 broken=0, and docrefs read dead=0. IMP-3 (its step-8 record stands), WF-9, WF-10 and §2 are unchanged.

Execution order. pre-checks (pgrep 0, ledgers, NODE_JSON, 10_ free) → pre-censuses → script → dry run → tail smoke (2b) → pgrep 0 → run of record (3) → PNG check → guide + docrefs grep → post-censuses → porcelain check → leak guard → commit (script, guide, PNG, harness logs, the §7 row and the §9 DONE line together) → journal.

An overrun parks the item — never raise a timeout or -n. - Before window 1, run docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 and require 0. Import tests/validation/test_imp3_f_human_tuned_rod.py as a module and call _read_record, _load, _build_f_human_rod, _ball_mean_closed_form_tag3, _c_star, _say and _in unchanged. Repeat _run_rod's body (0e7d3abd, lines 410–847, imports 341–408) verbatim with provenance; never call _run_rod, _run_repro or any test_* name. Take every band through the gate's import lines, and assert nothing at a band the gate did not use. - Every rank enters every ball and point-evaluation call. Every count and sum is owned-only and reduced. No UFL comparison or sqrt; no collective inside a rank == 0 branch. Discard write_xdmf_with_tags' return value; no rank-0-only object inside any f-string. Run the tail smoke (window 2b) green before window 3. - Print every new value at ≤ 6 significant digits. If check_private_leak.py blocks a log, move it unchanged to logs/leak-held/, mark item 508 BLOCKED (not ✅) and stop. The guide names the node record only as NODE_JSON, never by its filename. - Emit the runner line with --dry-run and pass it to the harness. docs.text: (1) Queued: no example shows an implant in the human-scale tuned coil. implants:03 / :09 are F-small, and implants:07 excludes the F-human and a tuned coil (07_lead_tf_in_the_coil.md:97). (2) Copy _run_rod's body with provenance; no rule (a) lift. A lift would need a second heavy W1b re-gate in the same hour. (3) Window 2b (the tail smoke) and the FEM_EM_EX128_TAIL_SMOKE mode are dropped. A user-facing example carries no test mode. Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-17 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it. This brief sets and moves no band, record or Done-when.

EX-129 (mat:23) is executed by example-runner, which spawns no agents. It adds exactly three tracked files and edits nothing else: - examples/materials/23_f2182_gel_box_transverse_eddy_source.py; - the same-stem guide, with ## 1. What this demonstrates, ## 2. How to run it, ## Setup figure, ## 3. How to analyze it, step by step and ## Related; - examples/materials/figures/materials_23_f2182_gel_box_transverse_eddy_source_setup.png, ≤ 600 KiB.

Angle (the drive). P36 heats the 650 × 420 × 90 mm box with q = 3Q(y² + z²)/(B² + C²) = Q[w_y(y/B)² + w_z(z/C)²], where w_y = 2.868293 and w_z = 0.131707. This is the transverse SAR shape of a long body in a circularly polarised B₁: E_x = jω(B_z y − B_y z), so |E_x|² ∝ y² + z² (MAT-21.md:1403–1409). In the F2182 placement x is the bore axis (GEO-38.md:354). - The weights are physics, not tuning (10:30 ruling, MAT-21.md:1658). - The mean source is exactly Q, so the source power is the same 49.14 W as in mat:19 / mat:20.

Four things are new to the examples: 1. A source that varies along the two transverse axes. The hot spot sits next to the long ±y side walls, not at the centre (mat:19) or the ±x ends (mat:20). 2. The y centre line. The P2 solve is plotted against the quadratic series and the uniform-source run. 3. The face-heat split moves toward ±y, the opposite pair from mat:20. 4. The thin-axis term in ParaView. The z² term carries 4.4 % of the power on the 90 mm axis. The gate's (c-z) shows the solve resolves it, and the example shows where it sits (theta_quad_minus_noz_series).

Printed only: the centre-versus-side ratio at t* against steady state. This is a probe-placement reading, with no compliance claim.

The source is handed over as the gate's UFL polynomial. A P2 / DG0 hand-off is out of scope: a quadratic is exactly P2, so the P2 path would be an identity (MAT-21.md:1627), and mat:20 already shows the hand-offs.

docs.text:
• Q1 — the angle: accepted. EX-129's ruling (1) asks the next box example for a new geometry, material or delivery mechanism. The package route (ThermalBoxGeometry → Study.temperature → Study.probe) is a delivery mechanism no example uses, and the probe table is a new output quantity. The 10-17 weekly's examples list names the thermal-box route after U59. The physics is mat:19's uniform steady box, and the guide says so in its first section.

(6) Negative result. Report and stop. Journal it in docs/testing/attempts.md, park on attempt/EX-131-<UTC>, and mark item 535 BLOCKED in the same commit. There is no PREDICTED RED: line, so any red stops the slot.

Q · V = 2000 × 0.65 × 0.42 × 0.09 = 49.14 W. W1a:67 reads 49.1400000000098, i.e. ≈ 2.0e-13; W1b:67 reads ≈ 2.6e-12. - (G-json), predicted: steady |convected_power_w − source_power_w| / source_power_w ≤ S2_GAUSS_BAND. This is the steady balance steady.py:175 states. Predicted ≈ 3e-13, range [0, 1e-11]. It is the same ∮ h θ dS as the gate's Gauss (W1a:65, 2.708e-13), but no log has read the summary key itself. The ceiling is 1, and the band sits more than 3 000× above the prediction. - (S0-json), backed: the duty JSON's source_multipliers has length 41 (W1b:63) and equals [float(m) for m in run.thermal.source_multipliers], which is the gate's (I=) line read from disk. Its on-fraction is printed; predicted ≈ 0.5. - (F-diff), by construction: the YAML mapping diff of STEADY against DUTY (g._mapping) is exactly {geometry.divisions, thermal.transient, thermal.duty}. That of STEADY against WRONG_WALL is exactly {thermal.h_w_per_m2_k}. Both were read from the tracked files at drafting.

Printed only: θ_max from the JSON beside W1a:67 / W1b:67 (.4f for values ≥ 10 K, .5g otherwise); each file's run time beside W1a:63 / W1b:63; the steady-to-duty θ_max ratio (new, no prediction band).

(2) Negative controls. - (c-wall), backed, asserted > INTERIOR_BAND. WRONG_WALL goes through cli.main(["run", …]). Its interior miss on the m = 4 comparand is backed by 3.8048e-01 (W1a:66), and WF15_S5_C_WALL is printed beside it. The ceiling is < 1. - (c3), backed, asserted > INTERIOR_BAND. The duty file's θ against the continuous-source step response at t*, backed by 5.0282e-01 (W1b:66), with P26_C3 printed beside it. - (cX), backed. MALFORMED_DUTY through cli.main run and check gives rc (2, 2) both, and its output directory is absent by MPI.LOR (gate :222–235). The refusal names thermal.duty.

Outputs. - Setup figure: the steady m = 4 mesh, z = 0 slice, as examples/materials/24_f2182_gel_box_study_api_probes.py:148–165 builds it. The cell tags are all 1 (meshtags built on that mesh), with slice_normal=(0, 0, 1) and clip_normal=(0, 0, -1). - Two combined XDMFs. The meshes differ, so there is one per mesh. All fields are P1, with names equal to their dict keys and real parts taken. - paraview_output/mri_29_femem_run_f2182_gel_box_files_steady_combined.xdmf holds theta_file_steady, theta_series_steady (the gate's ex, P2 → P1), theta_file_minus_series and theta_wrong_wall (via _on), with the Robin facet tags. - paraview_output/mri_29_femem_run_f2182_gel_box_files_duty_combined.xdmf holds theta_file_duty_tstar, theta_duty_series_tstar (the gate's ex, reused, never recomputed), theta_duty_minus_series and theta_step_series_tstar (ex_s). - Call adopt_host_ownership(OUTPUT_DIR) last. - CSV paraview_output/mri_29_femem_run_f2182_gel_box_files_summary_readback.csv, written on rank 0: file, key, JSON value (≤ 6 significant digits), in-memory value, hex-equal. - Run bundles under paraview_output/mri_29_run_steady/, mri_29_run_wrong_wall/, mri_29_run_duty/ and mri_29_bad/ (_fresh_dir first).

Guide. - ## 1: the three files' keys, line by line, and which keys the summary writes for steady and for duty. - ParaView recipe: open both XDMFs, color by theta_file_minus_series, then Plot Over Line along y. - ## 2: ./scripts/run_examples.sh -e mri:29 -n 2 -t 590, heavy, with the measured wall time. Explain that femem run tests/package/wf1/thermal_box_steady_m4.yaml is the same call from a shell. - Related: examples/materials/24_f2182_gel_box_study_api_probes.md, examples/materials/25_f2182_gel_box_duty_probe_histories.md, examples/mri/20_f_human_thermal_from_yaml.md, examples/mri/27_femem_run_bundle_reproducible.md, tests/package/test_wf1_yaml_thermal_box.py, tests/package/test_wf15_study_thermal_box.py. - Write ≈.

(3) Tier, price, windows. Heavy, -n 2, complex, -t 590.

Price inputs (measured): - steady leg 7.1 s (W1a:68): file 0.8 s plus the Python Study, the P2 comparand and the wrong-wall file; - duty leg 187.1 s (W1b:68): file 9.4 s, Python CN ≈ 10 s, ten-run series interpolation 149.7 s and step response 15.4 s (20261018T112221Z_WF-15-s5-W2-duty.log:63–72); - three check calls and the malformed run, no mesh, < 1 s (gate parse node, 20261018T184753Z_WF-1-s15-W0.log); - setup figure 2.9 s (20261017T110217Z_EX-129.log:50); - two XDMFs ≈ 5–15 s; - start-up ≈ 10 s.

Prediction: run of record ≈ 220 s, range [170, 470] s. That includes a host ≈ 2× slow on the comparand. No coarser case is posed: the records are m = 4 / m = 6.

Item minutes: ≈ 9 measured (example class median) / ≈ 45 predicted (windows ≈ 6, code ≈ 20, guide ≈ 10, fixed ≈ 9).

Park by the minute (rule (d)). - If windows 1–3 are not green and the script is not written by minute 30, park. - If the run of record has not started by minute 38, park. It needs ≈ 4 min, plus ≈ 12 for the guide, the censuses and the commit. - Never start window 4 after minute 40.

Windows. Each runs in the foreground with Bash timeout: 660000, as one bare, whole, repo-relative call. 0. docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 must read 0, and no other heavy, xl or xxl window may be live. Confirm examples/mri/29_* does not exist. 1. Pre-censuses, before any file is written: - scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh EX-132-pre-figures "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && timeout -k 30 60 python3 scripts/testing/check_example_setup_figures.py'" - the same command labelled EX-132-pre-docrefs with check_example_doc_references.py.

The last reading was examples=128 ok=128 missing=0 broken=0 (20261018T215214Z_EX-131-post-figures.log:164) and docrefs dead=0 … stale=141 … exit=2 (20261018T215216Z_EX-131-post-docrefs.log:181). Exit 2 means stale; exit 1 is a failure. If another example lands first, the count is one higher. 2. Import check (complex): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh EX-132-import "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 10 60 python3 -c \"import tests.package.test_wf1_yaml_thermal_box as g; print(g.STEP1_M4_WHOLE, g.P26_T_DUTY, g.DIV4, g.DIV6, g.STEADY.name, g.DUTY.name)\"'" 3. Dry run: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh EX-132-dryrun "./scripts/run_examples.sh -e mri:29 -n 2 -t 590 --dry-run". It must print (complex build). 4. Run of record, EX-132: the emitted line with -T -e FEM_EM_SETUP_FIGURES=1 added. That is scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh EX-132 "docker compose exec -T -e FEM_EM_SETUP_FIGURES=1 fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 2 python3 examples/mri/29_femem_run_f2182_gel_box_files.py'", the EX-131 form (20261018T214758Z_EX-131.log:12). Copy the emitted string, not this one. Pass means all of: - Status 0; - every anchor and control green; - the closing "All assertions hold" line. 5. git add the PNG and check it is ≤ 600 KiB. One re-render with show_edges_on_slice=False is the only permitted re-run. Write the guide from window 4's log, stage it, and run the leak guard on it. Then run EX-132-post-figures / EX-132-post-docrefs. Predicted N → N + 1, broken=0, dead=0. 6. git status --porcelain examples/ tests/ src/ lists only the three new paths. Run scripts/testing/check_private_leak.py on the staged logs.

After Status 124 or a kill: run pgrep -c python3 first. At 0, run the rubric-4 orphan-.c sweep labelled EX-132-cache-sweep.

(4) Traps already paid for. - Leak guard. Print every θ at ≤ 6 significant digits: .4f for θ_max ≥ 10 K (W1a:67's 12.007407304708885 never prints whole) and .5g otherwise. Print errors at .3e. Never print the summary dict or the JSON whole. P37's 6-decimal print collided with a private export (MAT-21.md:1841), and the guard matches at 8 digits (check_private_leak.py:76). - Rank 0. Everything that exists only on rank 0 is used only under if rank0:. That includes the return of write_xdmf_with_tags, the check stdout lines and the CSV rows (the EX-127 failure; the 10-17 weekly counts three of four second attempts as rank-local tail prints). Read every tail f-string before window 4. No collective inside if rank0:. _check_summary and _all are collective, so call them on every rank. - Full-filename docrefs. The guide and the census name every artifact by its full filename (…_steady_combined.xdmf, …_duty_combined.xdmf, …_summary_readback.csv), never a stem or a glob (§9 standing rule (b)). paraview_output/ is gitignored. - Mesh mixing. The file run, the Python Study and the wrong-wall run each build their own mesh. Move fields with _on only. The steady result is on th.submesh, the duty result on th.mesh. - Comparands. Use the gate's _exact (chunked, at dof coordinates) and never interpolate(callable) on the series. Reuse the duty ex for the XDMF: a second evaluation costs 150 s. - XDMF needs P1. np.real before every float. - No cross-build digit or hex comparison. Everything here is complex. - Wrapper. Restore study_yaml.run_study_file in finally and assert is original (21_…py:177–184). A leaked wrapper corrupts every later call. - Runner. ./scripts/run_examples.sh is host-side, so never wrap it in docker compose exec. Emit, then harness. Use -k 30. - Windows. No background window, no raised -t / -n, no script edit after window 4 starts, and no guide edit after window 5 starts (rule (i)).

(5) Scope. - Covered: femem check / femem run in-process (cli.main) on the three tracked thermal_box files and the malformed one: uniform source, Robin on six faces, steady at m = 4, duty CN at m = 6, P1, complex, -n 2. The summary is read back from disk and tied to the records, to Q·V and to the steady balance. - Not claimed: - the installed console script (femem on PATH) or --ranks; - --estimate; - the transverse (quadratic) source from YAML (U64, item 528); - P2 / thermal.degree: 2; - probes or point values (mat:24 / mat:25); - a container wall; - the real build; - perfusion, EM or a coil; - bundle reproducibility (mri:27's angle); - F2182 compliance; - any external check.

(6) Negative result. Report and stop. Journal it in docs/testing/attempts.md, park on attempt/EX-132-<UTC>, and mark item 541 BLOCKED in the same commit. Never widen a band or edit tests/ or src/. - A gate anchor ((K), (UT), (I-Py), (R), (I=)) red: an example/test divergence. Print the first differing value beside its record, and file a known-issues entry against WF-1 step 15. - (G-json) red with (R) Gauss green: the summary's convected_power_w differs from the field's own ∮ h θ dS. That is a finding against _run_thermal_box. File a known-issues entry; no band moves. - (P-json) or (S0-json) red: the summary misreports a gated quantity. Handle it the same way. - The wrapper captures nothing: the CLI route differs from cli.py:159/:201. BLOCKED, with no fallback to calling run_study_file directly. - A printed value missed: report it in the guide and the journal. It has no status effect. - A kill at 590 s: not a result.

There is no PREDICTED RED: line, so any red stops the slot.

(7) Status it can move. - EX-132 ⬜ → ✅ on the §7 Done-when, with the census rising N → N + 1, broken=0 and docrefs dead=0. - WF-1, WF-15, MAT-21 and §2 do not move. - If a review demotes 521b, EX-132 is withdrawn.

Spawn prompt (verbatim). "Use the example-runner agent to execute EX-132, §9 item 541 (docs/planning/chunks/EX-132.md, heading §9 item 541). - Read the brief and any review ruling beneath it first; the rulings hold. - You are the executor: do not spawn agents. - The harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, repo-relative, nothing chained or piped. Run every window in the foreground with timeout: 660000, never in the background, and never delete a log. - Run docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 (require 0, and no other heavy / xl / xxl window live) before windows 1 and 4. Confirm examples/mri/29_* does not exist, and run both pre-censuses before writing any file. - Edit nothing under tests/ or src/. Import through tests.package.test_wf1_yaml_thermal_box as the brief lists. Copy the two solve-node bodies verbatim with only the cli.main and RUN_DIR substitutions. Never call _solve_preamble, never set FEM_EM_WF1_S15, and never import a test_* name. - Restore the run_study_file wrapper in finally. - Print θ at ≤ 6 significant digits. Use rank-0-only values only under if rank0:, with no collective there. - Emit the runner line with --dry-run; use container timeout -k 30 590; never raise -t or -n. - Park by minute 30 / 38 as the brief states. - If check_private_leak.py blocks a log, move it unchanged to logs/leak-held/, mark the item BLOCKED and stop. - On a red, park on attempt/EX-132-*, mark the item BLOCKED in the same commit, and report. - Return the log names, each asserted and printed value beside its record or prediction, the census before / after, and elapsed."
