Traps already paid for. - The hole refusal (mesh.py:4272–4285). Forwarding the new default under as_hole raises on every copper caller, and on xl entry 32 at 02:00 on 10-13 with no session to see it. (K) and W1 are the checks. - "Adds no key" is the byte-identity proof (the phantom_resolution precedent). A pinned emit_leg_ports=True key is harmless to gmsh but defeats the dict check. Omit the key. - Overwriting the boxed npz files. Every old WF-7 command in WF-7.md (:66, :168, :251) names wf7-s32-degree1-n8.npz. The guard refuses it. A failing gmsh build deadlocks at rank > 1 (GEO-23), so the helper's refusal raises before gmsh. - Orphan .c. The degree-1 forms are warm from step 1 and H15a. If a window is killed: pgrep -c python3 first, then the rubric's sweep. Never use pgrep -f "python3 -m pytest". - Status 124 is a finding, not a retry. Scope. - Covered: the σ = 800 solid F-human through WF-7 step 1's own build and _build_f_human's non-hole default; WF-7 steps 1 and 2 at degree 1, 64 MHz, -n 8; the exempt hole build (xl entry 32's module, build only); the save guard and the boxed rebuild knob. - Not claimed, and what remains (2b and the review): - 2b (one slot, predicted): unpin WF-7 step 3 / EX-62 and re-record the printed 10 g figures. Measured 196 s (20260906T034048Z_EX-51-gate-rerun.log.gz:61). - WF-10 / ANS-8 (Q3): κ-corrected H8-lineage records (C_TUNED_F, C_MODE_F, A1/A2_MEAS, ANTI_MODE_C_PF; ANS-8's item-133 circuit records at 1e-6). Measured 334 + 423 + 405 + 292 s. That exceeds one slot, and C_MODE_F also feeds test_wf12_f_human_copper_mechanism.py:215. - mesh:9–11 (Q2): r = 0.07 m GEO-20 / GEO-26 fixtures, not F-human. They are shared with PORT-13's ring matrix and column, POST-6, ports:10–12 and mesh:7. - The hole and quadrant layouts: out of U21 (Settled (a)). - No degree 2 and no absolute S.

Status it can move. No glyph. The §7 Done-when cannot be met by 2a: it needs every moved record re-recorded, which 2b and the rulings Q2 / Q3 define. That mismatch is flagged here. On green: - GEO-35 holds 🟡 with a step 2a record sentence: switched fixture, the six re-recorded constants with their moves, and (I) / (Q) / (N′) green; - WF-7 ✅ gains one sentence (records now on the leg-box-free fixture; boxed values kept and rebuildable); - §10 U21 is annotated "2a DONE, 2b open"; - U27 is unblocked.

Negative result. In every case: report the measurement, park on attempt/GEO-35-step2a-*, mark item 351 BLOCKED in the same commit (rule (d)), and journal it in attempts.md. - W0 red: fix in-slot only inside the new helper, knob or pins; otherwise stop. - W1 red, or a cell count ≠ 369 387: the exemption leaked. Revert (1); BLOCKED. Entry 32 must not meet this commit. - (R1) / (R2) red with (I) green: the 10-07 readings do not reproduce on the same image at 1e-6. That is a run-to-run finding (known-issues); never re-record from W2. - (c2) not separating, or (N′) > 0: the switch did not take effect. Stop. - (I) or (Q) red: an identity broke on the switched mesh. It is a real finding: revert the switch, and WF-7 stands on the boxed fixture. - W2 over minute 42, or a window killed at 590 s: BLOCKED without a result; the review re-poses.

No PREDICTED RED: line.

For the review (rule before queueing). - Q1 (binding). record-reconciler's drift sanity gate stops at ≈ 0.5 % (.claude/agents/record-reconciler.md, "Drift sanity gate") and was written for mesher-version drift. Two 2a sites move by more, because of geometry: pooled κ +4.671 % and the printed cell constant −0.899 %. Does GEO-35's Done-when (weekly-placed) license re-recording these, with step 1's measured moves as the pre-registered reference and W2's 1e-6 reproduction as the check? If not, do not queue 351. The κ assert would be red on the switched default, and demoting it would be loosening. - Q2. Should mesh:9–11 be dropped from U21 (they keep the boxes and their guides say so), or opened as their own step? - Q3. Should the WF-10 / ANS-8 κ-era records be re-recorded (≈ 2 slots), or frozen as records of the boxed fixture with a permanent pin (the analogue of binding ruling (iii))? - Q4. Ratify the 2a / 2b split of U21.

Review rulings (2026-10-09 18:00 review) on item 351 — these outrank the brief above. (Q1) Licensed. GEO-35's §7 Done-when says that "every record the switch moves … is re-recorded under the (1*) licence by record-reconciler, with the gated anchors (C16, mirror, exact identities) re-run green at their unchanged bands". That is an explicit licence for this geometry change. It outranks record-reconciler's ≈ 0.5 % mesher-drift stop for these records only. The licence is not open-ended. The new record values are pre-registered by step 1's knob-on measurement (20261007T005016Z_GEO-35-s1-W2-wf7.log, the :9694–9779 lines the brief cites; cells 502 704, pooled κ 4.805416e-03 and the rest). Each re-recorded value must reproduce that reading at REUSE_REPRODUCTION_RTOL. A value that does not reproduce is a red: stop and record it, with no re-record. No band moves. κ stays a diagnostic (operator ruling 2026-10-02); its record is a reproduction record, not a gate. (Q2) mesh:9–11 are not touched by 2a. U21's text names mesh:9–12. Whether the 0.07 m fixtures belong in U21 is the weekly's call, and it is flagged on the dashboard. (Q3) 2a pins the κ-era WF-10 / ANS-8 records to the boxed mesh (emit_leg_ports=True explicit). Whether they are re-recorded or frozen as boxed-mesh records is the weekly's call. (Q4) The 2a / 2b split is provisional (rule (6)); the weekly ratifies or reverts it. GEO-35 holds 🟡 on 2a, because 2a cannot meet the Done-when. The H13b remark is already ruled in TH-20.md (item 350). (5) Ordering: item 350 (TH-20 2a) is independent of this item. Item 351 runs after 350 in the queue only to keep the heavy windows serial. xl entry 32 (10-13) depends on W1's build-only reading staying 369 387 cells. If W1 is red, stop before W2 and mark the item BLOCKED. Entry 32 must not run on a broken hole path, so the slot also writes "HOLD — item 351 W1 red" into entry 32's status line.

docs.title: §9 item 356 — 2026-10-10 (chain step U21, 2b-i, provisional)
docs.text:
Drafted for the 2026-10-10 03:00 review. Licence: U21 under rule (6). The 10-09 Q1 ruling allows re-recording only values that a prior knob-on run pre-registered. This item makes those runs and re-records and unpins nothing. The weekly ratifies the 2b-i / 2b-ii split tonight. Two windows would double WF-7 step 3's cost, so the work is split: 356 covers WF-7 step 3 and EX-62; 357 (below) covers GEO-25 and mesh:12. No band, record or Done-when moves.

  • Executor: implementer. Tier: W0 standard -n 2; W1 and W2 heavy -n 8, the record width. Cost: ≈ 12 measured (2 × 352 s, 20260925T093315Z_WF-7-step3.log.gz:11686) / ≈ 40 predicted = 15 fixed + 8 code + W0 1.5 + W1 6.5 + W2 6.5 + 2.5 spare. Park if W1 is not green by minute 26.
  • Code (test-only and additive): changes to tests/validation/test_wf7_f_human_sar10g_hotspot.py.
  • (1) build_sar10g_case(comm, *, emit_leg_ports=True) is passed through at the pinned call (:154–156). The comment stays, and mri:4 (04_f_human_sar10g_hotspot.py:236) is unchanged.
  • (2) New knob FEM_EM_GEO35_2B_MEASURE ∈ {unset, boxed, dropped}, read in the fixture (:409–416). dropped passes False; any other value raises. Unset adds nothing.
  • (3) New node test_geo35_2b_measure, which skips when the knob is unset, and a no-mesh …_knob_contract.
  • (4) Two provenance constants, used only under the knob: 537 546 cells (…step3.log.gz:10468) and SAR10g(c*) 2.085815849e-04 (:11614).
  • (5) The leg census imports _owned_census (tests/mesh/test_geo35_leg_port_boxes.py:71) and allreduces it.
  • Anchors (asserted). These hold in W1 and W2, with every band imported:
  • (i) coverage power and mass ≤ EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL (test_birdcage_sar_mass_averaged.py:163);
  • (ii) worst C16 and (iii) mirror ≤ C4_COVARIANCE_BAND (test_birdcage_b1_plus_map.py:120);
  • (iv) every ball is contained.

W1, boxed: the pinned route is the control. Cells must equal 537 546, and SAR10g(c*) must match 2.085815849e-04 within REUSE_REPRODUCTION_RTOL. Import that constant from test_port_birdcage_ring_matrix.py:171 (1e-6), not from test_port19_factor_reuse.py:82 (1e-12). This window also answers the 2a auditor's note for this caller. W2, dropped: (N′) the leg census is 0. - Negative controls (rule (e); the analogue is 2a's (c2) at 77.1× / 910.0×). - (c1) Asserted in W1: all 16 leg tags have more than 0 cells. - (c2) Asserted in W2: cells ≠ 537 546, and the relative change of SAR10g(c*) from the boxed value is > REUSE_REPRODUCTION_RTOL. Predicted 10–3 000×, from step 1's moves of 3.3e-06 … 9.1e-04 (…GEO-35-s1-W2-wf7.log:9733–9780). The ceiling is the mesh move itself, so the bar is > 1×. - (c3) Printed: the P17 control, predicted ≈ 96 %, ≈ 19× the band (:11619). - Printed values are the pre-registration (W2), each beside its boxed value: - cells, predicted ≈ −0.85 % (range [−1.0 %, −0.7 %]); - phantom cells, predicted 22 594 (the phantom boundary is unchanged); - c*, SAR10g(c*) and the nine-ball table; - the 15 C16 values (boxed worst 0.4904 % at R_7); - mirror (0.0502 %), mean SAR, the P17 control, and the |B1+| line.

Round-off residuals (coverage ≈ 1e-13) are band checks, never records, because they jitter between runs (mri:4 guide §3). - EX-62 gets no window. mri:4 prints the values build_sar10g_case returns. It matched the gate to every printed digit (20260930T213057Z_EX-62-fields.log:11571–11584), and 2b-ii re-runs it. WF-10 ×2 and 08 are not worth a window (334–423 s each, and Q3 freezes them). Their pins resolve to the no-key dict that test_geo35_f_human_builder_contract asserts (test_geo35_leg_port_boxes.py:180–181), and W1 runs the same pinned line end to end. - Windows. Run each in the foreground as the whole Bash command, with Bash timeout: 660000. Use -s and node IDs, never -k, and put tests/environment first. Each window is under 10 min, so no redirect is needed. Heavy windows never run side by side. scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-35-s2bi-W<k> "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 <ENV> timeout -k 30 <T> mpiexec -n <N> python3 -m pytest tests/environment <NODES> -v -s --tb=short'" - W0: T 180, N 2. Nodes: the knob contract and test_geo35_leg_port_boxes.py::test_geo35_f_human_builder_contract. - W1: T 590, N 8, FEM_EM_WF7_STEP3=1 FEM_EM_GEO35_2B_MEASURE=boxed, the whole module (6 nodes). Predicted 330–420 s. - W2: the same as W1 with dropped. - Traps. False is reachable only through the knob. There are two REUSE_REPRODUCTION_RTOL constants (see Anchors). cell_tags.values is rank-local, so allreduce. If a window is killed, run pgrep -c python3 first, then the orphan .c sweep. Status 124 is a finding: never lengthen the timeout. Rule (i): no edit after the last window. No AED file, sheet or κ is touched. - Scope. Measurement only. - Nothing is re-recorded, unpinned or moved. - GEO-35 holds 🟡. - mesh:9–11 are untouched (Q2), and so are WF-10 / ANS-8 (Q3). - No degree 2 and no absolute SAR. - Negative result. In every case: report, park on attempt/GEO-35-step2bi-*, mark the item BLOCKED and journal it. - W0 red: fix inside the knob or node only. - W1 red: the image has drifted since 09-30. Disclosed deviation from the brief. The brief asked to emit 402 as a dim-2 gmsh group on interior facets. io/mesh.py's own _interface_facet_tags docstring records that interior dim-2 gmsh groups hang model_to_mesh at -n 2 (known-issues 9, 2026-08-05), and every interior facet group in the module follows that rule. docs.title: §9 item 316 — 2026-10-08 (chain I18a — the coated rod in the phantom; no solve)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-08 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §10 I18a (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4694–4698), weekly-enumerated, serial on nothing; §9 rule (4). No solve; no band, tolerance, record or Done-when moves.

  • Executor: implementer. Tier: heavy (each window ≈ 190–260 s), real build, -n 1 then -n 2. Cost: ≈ 11 measured (chain no-solve median, WF-9.md:155; step 4 took ≈ 10) / ≈ 50 predicted min. Depends on: nothing.
  • Geometry (the weekly's volume read literally). IMP-5's sleeve a = ROD_RADIUS 1 mm, b = 1.5 mm, εᵣ 3 / σ 0 (IMP-5.md:26–29) on step 3's kept rod (_build_kept_rod, tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_rod.py:154; ROD :93–97). The weekly's coat volume π(b² − a²)L is a shaft-only sleeve: the cylinder of radius b between the two cap-centre planes, minus the rod. The hemispherical caps stay bare (an insulated lead with exposed tips). The sleeve's end annuli meet the cap spheres at their equators, where the sphere leaves the plane at a right angle, so there is no tangency sliver. Volumes: V_rod = πa²L + 4πa³/3 = 9.8437e-8 m³; V_coat = π(b² − a²)L = 1.17810e-7 m³; gel = πR²H − V_rod − V_coat = 2.259784e-4 m³.
  • src/ change (one additive key; rule (c), disclosed). implant_rod["coat_radius"] (metres), mirroring IMP-5's coat_radius on cylindrical_domain (io/mesh.py:71,100–134).
  • _normalise_implant_rod (io/mesh.py:4589–4672) returns "coat_radius" (None when absent). Before gmsh it raises a ValueError naming implant_rod on a bool, non-number, non-finite value, a value ≤ radius, keep_cells not True (a coat around a hole is out of scope), or a sleeve not strictly inside the phantom (the existing inside-check with b in place of r). It runs twice (:4257, :4690); None must pass the second call unchanged.
  • Build (:5102–5152): add cyl_b = addCylinder(end0, L·axis, b). Cut the phantom and the air box by cyl_b as well as the rod (removeTool=False). Make the sleeve with occ.cut([cyl_b], rod_dimtags, removeObject=True, removeTool=False), raise unless exactly one solid remains, and append its tag to the fragment tools beside rod_tag (:5197). Its pieces take the new cell group BIRDCAGE_IMPLANT_COAT_CELL_TAG = 404, named "implant_coat", beside :280, :5289–5292, :5543 and :5599. Grep src/ for 404 first; it read empty on 2026-10-08.
  • Interfaces: 402 stays the (3, 403) interface (:4547–4555), so it now covers only the bare caps. No new facet tag is emitted; the interface areas are measured by tag-pair dS in the test. The dolfinx-side rebuild must still find every (3, 403) facet, and the two-use check (:5456–5476) must count the sleeve as a neighbour, not as a hole.
  • Sizing (:5931–5960) is unchanged. The Threshold holds r/3 out to r, so the 0.5 mm sleeve meshes at ≈ 1.5 cells across. No sizing knob.
  • implant_rod_cad (:5517–5528) gains coat_radius_m, coat_cell_tag and coat_kept_mass_m3 (additive; None when unset).
  • New module tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_rod_coat.py. It imports by name and never restates a band:
  • ROD, ROD_RADIUS, ROD_LENGTH, ROD_CENTRE, _build_kept_rod, _rod_volume, _rod_area, KEPT_ROD_CELL_RECORD, KEPT_ROD_CELL_GUARD and _interior_facet_check (test_birdcage_implant_rod.py);

A test_birdcage_volumes_partition_the_box red carrying the surface 59 / 79 string is the 🔴 OPEN known issue (line 97 above). scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-36-step6-W3a-regate "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 420 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_rod.py tests/mesh/test_birdcage_port_tags.py tests/mesh/test_birdcage_conductor_hole.py -v -s --tb=short'" - W3b, the rule (c) re-gate of the as_hole default path (the edited branch). Predicted ≈ 192 s (…buildonly.log:6358). (A0) 369 387 and the 401 line (240 surfaces, area 2.094760146e-01) must print unchanged. scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-36-step6-W3b-regate "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_WF12_STEP4=1 FEM_EM_WF12_STEP4_BUILD_ONLY=1 timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_wf12_f_human_copper_degree2.py::test_wf12_step4_copper_degree2_column -v -s --tb=short'" - Order: W0 → W1 → register the record → W2 → W3a → W3b. docs.title: §9 item 427 — 2026-10-13 (§10 chain I24; chain step, no solve)
docs.text:
GEO-36 step 7: implant_spheroid, an oblate PEC body (a, a, c) in the phantom, in implant_rod's pattern — hole and keep_cells on F-small, kept on the F-human as_hole phantom; CAD identities asserted at -n 1 / -n 2 (implementer; standard by the weekly, heavy ceiling per window as step 6's ruling (3); real build for the F-small module, complex for the F-human module; ≈ 7 measured / 70 predicted min: ≈ 22 min of windows + 15 fixed + ≈ 35 code; depends on nothing). Licence: §10 I24 (the 10-12 weekly, PROJECT_PLAN.md:4758–4762), Phase 7 (7b), §9 rule (4). Target: CAD identities, the weekly's text. No solve; no band, tolerance or Done-when moves; every band imported. A record on a ✅ row. Item 428 (IMP-3 step 9, I25) consumes it.

Geometry (one body for every build). a = 6 mm (equatorial), c = 1.2 mm (along the symmetry axis), aspect 5 — IMP-6's FEM-gated aspect-5 body (step 1, item 404; step 3, item 409), so I25's closed form is the one IMP-6 validated. Centre (0.015, 0, 0), GEO-36's rod centre (step 6 ruling (2): tips, masks and helpers carry over). Symmetry axis x̂: the disc lies in the yz-plane. Reason: the coil-driven field there is ≈ 99 % E_z under P1 (IMP-3 step 1 measured η_z = 0.990426 on the rod axis at x = 0.015, 20261002T170843Z_IMP-3-step1-W2.log.gz:3864), so with the normal along x̂ the dominant field lies in the disc's plane and its rim points (0.015, 0, ±a) take the in-plane enhancement 1/L_x = 8.0155 — IMP-6's in-plane case, the disc-edge analogue of the rod tips (0.015, 0, ±0.016). Closed forms (computed here): e = √(1 − c²/a²) = 0.979796, V = 4πa²c/3 = 1.809557e-7 m³, A = 2πa²[1 + ((1 − e²)/e) artanh e] = 2.473638e-4 m², ρ_r = c²/a = 0.24 mm. Strictly inside both phantoms: radial extent ≤ √(16.2² + 6²) = 17.3 mm < 30 mm (F-small R), |z| ≤ 6 mm ≪ 40 mm.

Why not addSphere + dilate (measured). IMP-6's builder makes the oblate body that way, and OCC's dilated sphere is a B-spline approximation: its volume misses 4πa²c/3 by 4.37e-4 at exactly this a, c (air OCC mass 5.111123404e-06 vs 5.111044263e-06 m³, 20261012T184107Z_IMP-6-step1-W0.log:503; 7.914e-11 m³ over V), 4.4e3× CAD_ANALYTIC_BAND. The prolate path shows the same size of error (:259, :324). So a volume identity against the closed form is unmeetable on that construction. And item 408 measured that the dilated body's rim can be truncated by the mesher (31 / 93 air midpoints inside the true spheroid at finer rim sizing, IMP-6.md § item 408 outcome). Both are answered by one construction: revolve an exact half-ellipse profile made of two quarter-arcs, so the body is the exact ellipsoid of revolution and the rim circle is a model edge.

src/ change (rule (c), additive, disclosed). In src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py: - birdcage_port_domain (:4158) and _build_birdcage_port_model (:4907) gain keyword-only implant_spheroid: Optional[Dict[str, object]] = None. Keys: semi_major a [m], semi_minor c [m] (along axis), centre, axis (normalised), keep_cells (bool, default False). Docstrings gain one paragraph each. - _normalise_implant_spheroid (pure, beside _normalise_implant_rod at :4773), called before any gmsh state exists. Refuse with ValueError (message containing implant_spheroid): implant_rod also set (one implant per build); symmetry_quadrant; as_hole unless keep_cells is True (step 6's rule for the rod, :4796–4797); missing keys, a ≤ c or c ≤ 0, non-finite values; non-3-vector or zero axis / centre; non-bool keep_cells; a body not strictly inside the phantom (conservative bounding-sphere test: |centre_xy| + a < R and |centre_z| + a < H/2). - Construction (in the implant block at :5340, a sibling branch of the rod's): in the local frame, two quarter-ellipse arcs (pole (0, 0, c) → rim (a, 0, 0) → pole (0, 0, −c), centre the origin, major axis x) closed by the axis segment; addPlaneSurface; occ.revolve(…, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 2π); rotate π/4 about local z (the revolve seam half-way between rim points, IMP-6's 45° rule); rotate local ẑ onto axis (about ẑ × axis; identity for +ẑ, π about x̂ for −ẑ); translate to centre. For axis x̂ the local rim direction x maps to world ∓z, so the seam lies at 45° from the rim points (0.015, 0, ±a) — print the seam edge's bounding box. Assert one solid (the rod's fuse check pattern, :5359–5362); record its OCC mass. Verify the arc API in the image first (gmsh.model.occ.addEllipseArc(startTag, centerTag, majorTag, endTag), or addEllipse with explicit zAxis / xAxis). - Shared downstream, keyed exactly as the rod's (the cut-first sequence :5373–5384 with removeTool=not keep; the as_hole fragment entry of the kept body once — step 6's change, GEO-9; the piece policy → BIRDCAGE_IMPLANT_CELL_TAG 403 (:5557); the wall read :5704–5760 — hole: single-use faces inside the padded bbox, kept: the implant pieces' boundary with the two-use check; 402 emitted as an exterior gmsh group on the hole build and rebuilt dolfinx-side on the kept build, :4731–4739). Recommended: generalise the rod's local variables into one "implant body" record (kind, dimtags, bbox, keep) so each shared line keys on it; every rod hunk's behaviour must be unchanged (the re-gates W3a–W3c below are the proof). Reuse tags 402 / 403 (one implant per build), so IMP-3's wall-dof and census helpers work unchanged. - Sizing (beside the rod's at :6241–6281; no Balls — item 408): a Distance from the body's wall surfaces → Threshold SizeMin c/3 = 0.4 mm, SizeMax resolution, DistMin c, DistMax 10c (the rod's r/3 over r → 10r with r ↔ c, the thin dimension); plus IMP-6 step 1's rim tube, a MathEval distance to the rim circle written in the world frame from centre and axis (d = x − centre, z_l = d·axis, ρ_l = √(|d|² − z_l²), dist = √((ρ_l − a)² + z_l²); numbers baked with repr, string printed) → Threshold SizeMin ρ_r, SizeMax resolution, DistMin ρ_r, DistMax 4ρ_r. Print one sizing line as the rod does (:6275–6280). No refinement knob. - Diagnostics: implant_spheroid_cad (None when off): surfaces, wall_area_m2, body_mass_m3, wall_centroid_m, facet_tag, the normalised request, keep_cells, wall_size_m (c/3), rim_size_m (ρ_r); with keep_cells also cell_tag and kept_mass_m3. implant_rod_cad stays None on a spheroid build.

These are I25's imports. - Records registered here (first readings, version-tagged, printed and not asserted in this item; registered from W1a, printed again by W2a): SPHEROID_HOLE_CELL_RECORD, KEPT_SPHEROID_CELL_RECORD. New module tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_spheroid_f_human.py (complex build; step 6's module tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_rod_f_human.py as the template): _f_human_kwargs(as_hole=True) (tests/validation/test_wf7_f_human_b1_quadrature.py:67) plus implant_spheroid = dict(SPHEROID, keep_cells=True); from step 6's module the constants HOLE_CAVITY_SURFACES_RECORD (240), HOLE_CAVITY_AREA_RECORD_M2 (2.094760146e-01), HOLE_PHANTOM_CAD_RECORD_M3, F_HUMAN_KEPT_ROD_CELL_GUARD (600 000) — never its kept fixture or a test_* name; _census_checks (tests/validation/test_wf12_f_human_hole.py:218), _ring_ports (tests/validation/test_birdcage_f_human_rung.py:134), HOLE_CELL_RECORD (tests/validation/test_wf12_f_human_copper_matrix.py:55), _outer_box_tags (tests/validation/test_th14_birdcage_copper.py:133). Anchors (asserted; every band imported). F-small module: - (S1) OCC body mass = V at CAD_ANALYTIC_BAND. (S2) OCC wall area wall_area_m2 = A at CAD_ANALYTIC_BAND. Predicted ≤ 1e-9 each (an exact surface of revolution; no prior on this construction). - (S3) Hole build: CAD(3) = πR²H − V at CAD_ANALYTIC_BAND; ΣCAD(hole) + body_mass_m3 = ΣCAD(flag off) at EXACT (step 2's A1 / A2). - (S4) Kept build — the body / gel partition: CAD(403) = kept_mass_m3 = body_mass_m3 at STRIP_BAND; CAD(3) + CAD(403) = πR²H at STRIP_BAND; ΣCAD(kept) = ΣCAD(flag off) at EXACT (step 3's K2 / K3, step 6's F1–F3). - (S5) Meshed tag-402 area / A in TERMINAL_AREA_BAND: ds on the hole build, dS("+") on the kept build (step 3's trap: ds reads 0 on an interior group). - (S6) Census: hole — cell-tag set = flag-off set, owned census sums to size_global, 402 > 0 facets each exterior with its one cell in tag 3, 403 absent; kept — set = flag-off ∪ {403}, 402 all interior, each between one tag-3 and one tag-403 cell (_interior_facet_check, ghost-aware); flag-off cells = SOLID_CELL_RECORD within CELL_COUNT_BAND. - (S7) The OCC wall centroid at SPHEROID_CENTRE to EXACT·a (all three components printed; the meshed centroid printed only). - (S8) Rim fidelity (item 408's census, made a gate). On both builds, owned tag-3 cells whose midpoint lies within 2ρ_r of either RIM_POINTS entry: count > 0, and the number of those midpoints inside the true spheroid = 0 (reduced). On the kept build, every tag-403 midpoint is inside the true spheroid (s < 1 + 1e-9; a convex body meshed with surface nodes on the CAD surface cannot do otherwise). - (S9) Refusals, each before any gmsh state (gmsh.isInitialized() False after), through _normalise_implant_spheroid: rod + spheroid; symmetry_quadrant; a hole spheroid with as_hole; a = c; c ≤ 0; zero axis; a body poking out of the phantom; keep_cells="yes". Positive pure case: the kept request with as_hole=True returns keep_cells True. - (S10) Cells < KEPT_ROD_CELL_GUARD (320 000) on both builds before any facet reading.

F-human module (step 6's F1–F9 with the body for the rod): (H1) CAD(403) = kept_mass_m3 = body_mass_m3 at STRIP_BAND, and body_mass_m3 = V at CAD_ANALYTIC_BAND; (H2) CAD(3) = V_cyl − body_mass_m3 at STRIP_BAND; (H3) CAD(3) + CAD(403) = V_cyl at STRIP_BAND (V_cyl = πR²H from the kwargs dict, never retyped); (H4) OCC wall area = A at CAD_ANALYTIC_BAND, meshed dS(402) / A in TERMINAL_AREA_BAND; (H5) the coil cavity did not swallow the body: conductor_cavity_cad surfaces = 240 and |area / HOLE_CAVITY_AREA_RECORD_M2 − 1| ≤ STRIP_BAND; (H6) _census_checks(census, cells, _ring_ports()) empty, tag 403 > 0 cells, every owned 402 facet interior between one tag-3 and one tag-403 cell; (H7) the centroid as (S7); (H8) rim fidelity as (S8); (H9) cells < 600 000 before any facet reading.

Printed, never gated (rule (e): no prior measurement on this fixture). Cells per build against 116 085 / 369 387 — predicted: F-small hole 116 085 + [35 k, 85 k] (the rod added 51 286 at r/3 = 0.33 mm over 201 mm²; the disc is c/3 = 0.4 mm over 247 mm² plus the rim tube), kept + [10 k, 30 k] tag-403 cells (the rod read 15 000), F-human kept 369 387 + [45 k, 115 k]; meshed 403 volume / V predicted [0.97, 0.995] (rod: 0.986667); meshed 402 / A predicted [0.985, 0.999]; rim-mask cell counts; E, F, degree-1 and degree-2 N1curl dofs (I25's price input); mesh wall and build time; the seam bounding box.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (C1s, asserted) The dilated-sphere construction misses (S1)'s comparand. A pure-OCC test (scratch model, no mesh, finalised after): addSphere(0, 0, 0, 1), rotate π/4 about z, dilate(a, a, c), getMass against V. Backed by the same comparison on the same solid: 4.374e-4 (20261012T184107Z_IMP-6-step1-W0.log:503, the air-mass difference over V; OCC is deterministic). Assert the miss > CAD_ANALYTIC_BAND; print it beside 4.374e-4 and the separation (≈ 4.4e3×). It is a measured error, not a saturating quantity, so no ceiling bounds it. - (C2s, asserted) The flag-off phantom CAD misses (S3)'s comparand by V/(πR²H − V) = 8.006e-4 (≈ 8.0e3× the band; that factor is also the ceiling). Backed by the flag-off phantom CAD = πR²H to 1.1e-16 and step 2's (C1), the same comparison with V_rod, reading its prediction exactly (20261002T110559Z_GEO-36-step2-W2.log.gz:3616–3617). Assert the miss > CAD_ANALYTIC_BAND; the factor printed. - (C3s, predicted, printed) The hole build misses (S4)'s EXACT sum by body_mass_m3/ΣCAD (≈ 1.6e-5, step 3's C1k read 8.54e-6 for the rod). - (C4s, predicted, printed) (H5)'s swallow miss: A / 2.094760146e-01 = 1.181e-3.

Windows. Bare, whole, foreground; Bash timeout: 660000; -s; no pytest -k; no pipes. Cost basis (measured): three F-small builds in one module, 188 s at -n 1 / 181 s at -n 2 (20261004T200412Z_GEO-36-step3-W1.log, …200730Z_…-W2.log); one F-human kept build, 184 s / 180 s (20261011T185757Z_GEO-36-step6-W1.log, …190108Z_…-W2.log); the re-gates 257 s / 191 s (…190414Z_…-W3a-regate.log, …190838Z_…-W3b-regate.log). - W0 (smoke, collect, complex): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-36-step7-W0-collect "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 timeout -k 30 60 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_spheroid.py tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_spheroid_f_human.py --collect-only -q'" - W1a -n 1, F-small, predicted 170–260 s: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-36-step7-W1a "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 420 mpiexec -n 1 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_spheroid.py -s -v --tb=short'" - W1b -n 1, F-human, predicted 170–240 s: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-36-step7-W1b "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 timeout -k 30 420 mpiexec -n 1 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_spheroid_f_human.py -s -v --tb=short'" - Register the three records from W1a / W1b — the modules' last edit. - W2a / W2b -n 2, the windows of record: the W1a / W1b commands with labels GEO-36-step7-W2a / GEO-36-step7-W2b and -n 2. Every printed number must equal the -n 1 window's. - W3a (rule (c) re-gate, F-small rod paths; step 6's W3a verbatim, relabelled): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-36-step7-W3a-regate "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 420 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_rod.py tests/mesh/test_birdcage_port_tags.py tests/mesh/test_birdcage_conductor_hole.py -v -s --tb=short'" — 167 371 / 182 371 / 116 085 unchanged, (A7) still refuses. docs.title: §9 item 530 — 2026-10-18 (§10 I33, GEO-36 step 7 — implant_rod in C2's tagged box; chain step, build-only)
docs.text:
Drafted read-only for the 2026-10-18 03:00 daily review; the review rules on it.

Numbering. The chunk already has a step 7: item 427's spheroid (above). The weekly's "step 7" is the eighth step of this chunk. The header keeps the weekly's words; window labels say rodbox so that no log collides with step 7's. The review should renumber this as step 8 (ruling 1).

Licence. §10 I33 (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4835–4840, the 10-17 weekly); Phase 7 (7b); §9 rule (4). It is the kept rod of step 6 (item 372) in C2's ASTM box (GEO-38 step 2, item 470), composed through the path item 522 opens. Target: CAD identities only, in the weekly's words. No solve. No band, tolerance, record or Done-when moves; every band is imported. It is a record on a ✅ row.

Executor and cost. - Executor: implementer. - Tier: heavy, build-only. W0 / W1 / W2 run real; R1 runs complex. Container timeout -k 30 is the backstop, and item 522's gmsh stop rule (FEM_EM_GMSH_STOP_RULE=1, 450 s) is armed in W1 and W2. - Ranks: -n 4, the window of record and the width at which C2 and I31 were measured, then -n 2. That is the weekly's "-n 2 / 4". gmsh runs on rank 0 either way (io/mesh.py:4856–4890). - Measured basis: - C2's build: gmsh 310.01 s, window 339 s at -n 4 (20261015T185056Z_GEO-38-s2-W3-n4.log:11894, :11925); 483.82 s at -n 2 in the same slot (…184154Z_GEO-38-s2-W2-n2.log:11878). - I31 attempt 1, killed at 591 s (20261016T020315Z_IMP-6-step4-W1-n4.log:5691). - I31 attempt 2's W1 price T, from item 522. That price is this item's gate. - On F-human the kept rod cost +7.5 s of gmsh over the kept disc at -n 2: 166.17 s (20261011T190108Z_GEO-36-step6-W2.log:6261) against 158.68 s (20261013T203250Z_GEO-36-step7-W2b.log:6264). - Predicted cost per build window: T_rod = T + [−40, +40] s, printed. The window is ≈ T_rod + 35 s, and a stopped window is ≈ 465 s. - Class: chain no-solve. Cost: ≈ 18.6 measured (class median) / ≈ 55 predicted slot-minutes. That is 15 fixed + ≈ 15 code (≈ 25 lines of src/, a ≈ 300-line module lifted from item 522's disc module) + ≈ 20 of windows (W0 ≈ 15 s, R1 180–185 s, W1 and W2 ≤ ≈ 495 s each) + 5 to commit. - No take-next, in either direction. - Slot-time gate: item 522's, verbatim. Only in a 12:00 / 13:30 / 15:00 slot (start line ≤ 5 min late), and only as the slot's first item; any other slot skips it silently. - Family: GEO-36 step 8 (the weekly's step 7), attempt 1 of 4.

Depends on item 522, through its price. "The price" means one line of item 522's W1 log (…_IMP-6-step4-a2-W1-n4.log) at -n 4. The gate is read off main, never off a branch: 1. GO. Item 522 is DONE on main; its W1 log prints [gmsh-stop-rule] under the rule and then [birdcage-mesh] mesh wall time T s with T ≤ 450.00; and (D0)–(D10) are green. Item 530 may then run in any later 12:00 / 13:30 / 15:00 slot, with its own builds under the same rule. - A T in (400, 450] predicts T_rod near the rule. That is printed, never a gate. 2. BLOCKED, to xl. Item 522's W1 log carries [gmsh-stop-rule] STOPPED, or W1 was killed at the container ceiling. Item 522's own commit marks item 530 BLOCKED: "to xl behind I31's 10-25 window; the weekly commissions". No daily re-poses it at heavy. 3. WAIT. Item 522 has not run, was skipped by the slot gate, or is OPEN for "W1 only". Item 530 is not runnable, and a slot skips it to the next item. 4. BLOCKED with item 522. Item 522 is BLOCKED for a defect: an R-gate not bitwise, a (D) red, or a gmsh FAIL. The composition is shared, so item 530 waits for the review's ruling on both.

Code state (main, 2026-10-18, before item 522's lift; the lift shifts these lines by ≤ +30). - The generator. MeshGenerator.birdcage_port_domain, src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py:4245. - The phantom_box refusal is at :4552–4555. Item 522 narrows it to "phantom_box cannot be combined with implant_rod". - The box is normalised at :4563–4574, where phantom_radius becomes the box's xy circumradius (:4573). - The rod's public normalise call is at :4578–4584 and the builder's at :5261–5267. The builder already takes phantom_box (:5257). - _normalise_implant_rod (:5054–5222) has three cylinder containment loops: rod :5132–5141, coat :5166–5176, tip ball :5201–5212. Its as_hole rule (kept and uncoated only) is at :5074–5086. - One implant per build: _normalise_implant_spheroid refuses implant_rod (:4995–4999). - Shared rod and spheroid lines in the builder: the kept flag keep_rod_cells at :5688; the rod mass rod_occ_mass at :5728. Item 522's change (c), parked if implant_rod is not None or implant_spheroid is not None under :5910–5916, already subtracts the rod's mass. The diagnostics implant_rod_cad (wall_area_m2, rod_mass_m3, kept_mass_m3) are at :6283–6306. - C2's tagged-box module: _box_kwargs() at tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_box.py:54–66. Its frame comment is at :60: Lz = 2A = 0.65 m on the coil axis, Lx = 2B = 0.42 m horizontal, Ly = 2C = 0.09 m vertical gel depth. TABLE_OFFSET_M = 0.0 is at :51. - implant_rod: ROD at tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_rod.py:93–97 (r = 1 mm, ℓ = 30 mm between cap centres, axis ẑ); _rod_volume / _rod_area at :113 / :117; _cell_values_with_ghosts at :171; _interior_facet_check at :184; pure test_a7_refusals_raise_without_meshing at :593. - Step 6's F-human kept-rod module: tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_rod_f_human.py, with F_HUMAN_KEPT_ROD_CELL_RECORD = 436541 at :59.

Fixture. - _box_kwargs() plus implant_rod = dict(ROD, keep_cells=True, centre=(rod_offset_m, off, 0.0)). - The axis is ẑ, which is the 650 mm axis: size_m[2] = 0.65. - off is the box's table_offset_m, at mid-depth. - rod_offset_m is a module parameter, ROD_OFFSET_M: Optional[float] = None, set to a value only with a cited source (the TABLE_OFFSET_M precedent). None gives the default 0.25 × size_m[0] = 0.105 m, toward the +x wall, computed from _box_kwargs() and never retyped. - Inside the box: 0.105 + 0.001 = 0.106 < 0.21; 0.001 < 0.045; cap tips at |z| = 0.016 < 0.325. The rod is 0.104 m from the +x wall. - The placement is a modelling choice and claims nothing. The operator may set the standard's placement with a cited source.

Edits allowed. 1. src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py, ruling (c). Keyword-only, additive, disclosed, ≈ 25 lines. - (a) Delete the remaining phantom_box × implant_rod refusal. The rod's own refusals still fire: hole or coat under as_hole, and one implant per build. - (b) _normalise_implant_rod gains keyword-only phantom_box: Optional[Dict] = None. - When it is set, each of the three loops tests both cap centres e with its own radius ρ (r, b, or the tip ball): |e_x| + ρ < Lx/2, |e_y − off| + ρ < Ly/2 and |e_z| + ρ < Lz/2, all strict. - The test is exact: the capsule is the convex hull of its end balls, and the box is convex. - Refusal message: "implant_rod is not strictly inside the phantom_box". - With None, the cylinder lines execute unchanged. - (c) Both call sites pass phantom_box. - One docstring sentence. 2. New tests/validation/test_geo36_rod_f_clinical.py. - The build test is selected by FEM_EM_GEO36_ROD_BOX=1 only, never by -k. One build per process. - It imports by name, never a test_* symbol: - _box_kwargs; - _ring_ports, _owned, _facet_coords, _area, LEG_COUNT, _refuse_before_gmsh (test_geo38_f_clinical_build.py:103, :119, :107, :125, :38, :384); - ROD, _rod_volume, _rod_area, _interior_facet_check, _cell_values_with_ghosts; - _census_checks / _owned_census from tests/validation/test_wf12_f_human_hole.py:218, :209, as C2 imports them (test_geo38_f_clinical_box.py:78); - gmsh_stop_armed, arm_gmsh_stop_rule (tests/validation/gmsh_stop_rule.py, item 522); - _interface_facet_tags. - Constants: F_CLINICAL_ROD_CELL_GUARD = 1_400_000, and C2's conductor mass as a printed comparand (item 522's constant). 3. The disc module's test_d10_rod_with_box_still_refused (parked :129, on main once item 522 lands) turns red by construction under (a). - The licensed, disclosed edit: rename it test_d10_rod_and_disc_with_box_refused, and make its body the box with both bodies, refused with "implant_spheroid cannot be combined with implant_rod". - Nothing else in that module changes, and W0 re-runs it (ruling 2).

Anchors (asserted at -n 4 and -n 2; owned, reduced, collectives before any rank-0 branch). L³ = Lx·Ly·Lz from _box_kwargs(); V_rod = _rod_volume() = 9.843657e-8 m³; A_rod = _rod_area() = 2.010619e-4 m². - (G0) Cells < F_CLINICAL_ROD_CELL_GUARD before any facet reading. - (G1) implant_rod_cad["rod_mass_m3"] = ["kept_mass_m3"] = V_rod, and ["wall_area_m2"] = A_rod, at STRIP_BAND (step 6's (F1) / (F4) bands). - (G2) CAD(403) = V_rod, CAD(3) = L³ − V_rod, and CAD(3) + CAD(403) = L³, at STRIP_BAND. - (G3) The owned tag-3 + tag-403 tet volumes = L³ at STRIP_BAND (planar box, shared interface). The tag-3 extents = C2's (B2) extents. - (G4) Σ cad_mass_by_group + conductor_cad_mass_m3 = air_domain_cad_mass_m3 at STRIP_BAND. This needs item 522's change (c). - (G5) 402: owned count > 0, exterior 0, every facet between one tag-3 cell and one tag-403 cell (_interior_facet_check, after an unconditional create_entity_permutations()), and meshed dS(402) / A_rod in TERMINAL_AREA_BAND. - (G6) The OCC wall centroid lies at the rod centre to EXACT·ℓ. - (G7) _census_checks is empty; tags 3 and 403 are present; tag 1 is absent; implant_spheroid_cad is None. - (G8) Per ring sheet: owned 210+i facets = ring_sheet_gmsh_triangles[i] on 64 / 64 sheets, and area = chord·w at STRIP_BAND. These are C2's (T1) / (T2), owned-facet numpy only. - (G9) Width invariance: every integer of (G0)–(G8) and every CAD float equal at -n 4 and -n 2. - (G10) Refusals (pure, W0): - (N3r) below; - a coated rod with the box under as_hole is refused; - a hole rod with the box under as_hole is refused; - the kept rod is accepted by _normalise_implant_rod(…, phantom_box=box).

Imported bands: STRIP_BAND 1e-9 (tests/validation/test_ops61_exact_strip_ports.py:58); EXACT 1e-9 (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_conductor_hole.py:117); TERMINAL_AREA_BAND (0.95, 1.0) (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_leg_gaps.py:73).

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (N1r) Asserted binary; factor predicted. C2's comparand L³ misses CAD(3) by V_rod / (L³ − V_rod) = 4.006e-6, 4.0e3× STRIP_BAND. That fixed ratio is also the ceiling. - (N2r) Asserted by construction; factor predicted. Item 470's pre-repair conductor reading misses (G4) by V_rod / can = 9.843657e-8 / 4.159880446e-01 = 2.366e-7, 237× STRIP_BAND (can volume from …185056Z_…:11903). - (N3r) The frame misreading, as a planted control. Both outcomes asserted (W0). - The request: "toward a ±y wall by a quarter of the width", read in C2's frame, gives centre (0, 0.105, 0). - The cylinder test accepts it: hypot(0, 0.105) + 0.001 = 0.106 < R = 0.214767 m. - The box test refuses it: 0.106 > Ly/2 = 0.045, a 61 mm breach. - Separation: accept vs refuse, binary. - (N4r) Printed only: - tag-403 cells against step 6's 15 025; - meshed 403 / V_rod against 0.986763, and meshed 402 / A_rod against 0.996276 (step 6 W2, 20261011T190108Z_GEO-36-step6-W2.log); - the conductor mass against C2's 1.994040484843362e-03, predicted ≤ 1e-9 relative.

Printed predictions, written first. - Cells: 1 149 150 + [50 k, 100 k], point 1 216 304 (+67 154, step 6's F-human kept-rod increment). - T_rod = T + [−40, +40] s. - Summed RSS ≈ 2.7 GiB. - E, F and U₂ = 2E + 2F: the price input of a rod solve in F-clinical.

Windows. - General: foreground; Bash timeout: 660000; each harness call is the whole Bash command; -s; durable capture verbatim. - Pre-checks before R1, W1 and W2: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 must read 0, then docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver cat /proc/loadavg is journaled. - Order: code → W0 → R1 → W1 → W2 → commit → journal. - W1 starts by minute 40 of the slot. W2 starts only by minute 44. Otherwise commit with W1 as the record and leave item 530 OPEN for "W2 only" in the next eligible slot. That is not an attempt. - W0 (pure, -n 1, ≈ 15 s): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-36-rodbox-W0 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 120 mpiexec -n 1 python3 -m pytest tests/validation/test_gmsh_stop_rule.py tests/validation/test_geo36_rod_f_clinical.py tests/validation/test_imp6_disc_f_clinical.py tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_rod.py::test_a7_refusals_raise_without_meshing tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_spheroid.py::test_s9_refusals_raise_without_meshing tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_build.py::test_geo38_shield_refuses_attempt1_table -v -s --tb=short'" - R1 (rule-(c) re-gate of the kept rod under as_hole with phantom_box=None, the path (b) edits; also the calibrant; complex, -n 2, 180–185 s; step 7's W3c relabelled): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-36-rodbox-R1-ruleC-step6 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 timeout -k 30 420 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_rod_f_human.py -s -v --tb=short'" - It must reprint, bitwise, the step-6 W2 numbers: 436 541 cells and (F1)–(F9) (20261011T190108Z_GEO-36-step6-W2.log:6261–6300). - Print h = gmsh / 166.17 s. - The F-small rod build is not re-run: no line it executes changes, and its pure (A7) refusals run in W0. Land the code only if R1 and W0 are green (item 494's precedent). - A stop in W2 after a green W1: the -n 4 record stands. The -n 2 width goes to the weekly. - (G1)–(G3) red with W0 green: the box cut around the rod is wrong. - (G4) at ≈ 2.37e-7: change (c) does not cover the rod. - (G5) exterior facets: the cavity reached the rod wall. - (G9) red: a rank-local count. No PREDICTED RED line.

Status it can move. The §7 GEO-36 row stays ✅. Its Done-when ("the identities asserted in one logged window at -n 2, cells and time recorded ⇒ ✅", PROJECT_PLAN.md:1925) is met as a record. The row gains, if it stays ≤ 2 KB: "Step 8 (item 530, I33): the kept rod in F-clinical's ASTM box at x = Lx/4 along the 650 mm axis — identities green at -n 4 / -n 2, ⟨cells⟩ cells, gmsh ⟨T_rod⟩ s." For the review to rule on. 1. Renumber as step 8. 2. Edit 3, to item 522's test_d10_rod_with_box_still_refused. 3. The +x reading of "±y wall". 4. Whether the -n 2 width may defer to a second slot.

Every-item rules (PROJECT_PLAN §9 "Every item"): - bare whole harness calls; - a lost docker socket stops the slot; - no edit after the last window; - timeout: 660000 and -s; - never delete a log; - BLOCKED in the parking commit; - a killed window is not a result; - two heavy windows never at once; - no slot opens docs/private/ or aed_results/.

Executor spawn prompt (verbatim). "Execute §9 item 530 — GEO-36 rod in C2's box (§10 I33) — per docs/planning/chunks/GEO-36.md §9 item 530. Read the brief and any review ruling beneath it first; the rulings hold. Run it only if this session's start line reads 12:00, 13:30 or 15:00 (≤ 5 min late), it is the slot's first item, and item 522's W1 log on main prints [birdcage-mesh] mesh wall time T s with T ≤ 450 and no [gmsh-stop-rule] STOPPED line; otherwise skip it. Run W0, R1, W1 (-n 4), W2 (-n 2) in order, foreground, on the final files; FEM_EM_GMSH_STOP_RULE=1 in W1 / W2 only. R1 must read step 6's numbers bitwise or you revert src/ and stop. On a red, park on attempt/GEO-36-rodbox-*, mark item 530 BLOCKED in the same commit, and report."

docs.title: §9 item 560 — 2026-10-20 (§10 I35, lane 1 — the I34 module's landing step; build-only)
docs.text:
Drafted read-only for the 2026-10-20 03:00 daily review; the review rules on it.

Licence. §10 I35 (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4855–4860, the 2026-10-19 weekly): "a column knob (FEM_EM_GEO36_S8_COLUMN) on GEO-36 step 8's module in test_geo38_f_clinical_column.py's shape — one degree-1 copper column at the feed sheet with the rod in, PRICE printed before the post-column asserts — build-only green at -n 2 asserting I33's 1 217 025 cells; entry 45's prerequisite (i). Serial on nothing." It is docs/testing/xl-pending.md entry 45's prerequisite (i) (:2057). The implementer marks (i) MET in the same commit and does not write the command. The 10-22 03:00 review writes it from entry 40's measured column. No band, tolerance, record or Done-when is set or moved; every band is imported.

Executor and cost. - Executor: implementer. - Tier: heavy by ceiling, not the weekly's "standard". Tier is execution detail. The build-only proof rebuilds I33's mesh in memory: item 530 measured 447.1 s at -n 4 and 444.9 s at -n 2 (gmsh 418.82 / 412.45 s; 20261019T200702Z_GEO-36-rodbox-W1-n4.log, 20261019T201444Z_GEO-36-rodbox-W2-n2.log). That cannot fit standard's 180 s. - The container ceiling is timeout -k 30 590, not 1200. A foreground window must return its footer inside the Bash tool's 660 s, so 590 + 30 is the most a foreground window can carry (rubric element 4; item 530's W1 / W2 used the same). - Ranks: W0 -n 1; W1 -n 2. Both run on the complex image, because the context builds a TimeHarmonicSolver and the sheet widths compile a dS area form (C3a's W1 ran the same way). - Daytime only. This is a composed clinical-scale build (the 10-17 epitaph; the 10-19 weekly's daytime rule, PROJECT_PLAN.md:4758–4762). - It runs only in the 12:00 / 13:30 / 15:00 slots, as the slot's first item, one daytime item per slot. There is no take-next into it or out of it. Any other slot skips it at no attempt cost. - It never shares a slot with items 542, 553, 561 or 566, or any other clinical build. Two heavy windows never run at once. - Deadline: the 10-22 03:00 review reads entry 45's prerequisites. If both 10-20 and 10-21 daytime slots pass without this item, entry 45 stays PENDING (its own text, :2057). Run it ahead of the daytime examples. - Class: chain no-solve (the weekly priced I35 at 6.6, PROJECT_PLAN.md:4933; item 519's ruling (d) re-classed a build-only clinical proof the same way). Cost: ≈ 6.6 measured / ≈ 45 predicted slot-minutes. That is code ≈ 18 (≈ 150 lines added to one module, no src/), W0 ≈ 1, pre-checks ≈ 2, W1 ≈ 8, and commit and journal ≈ 8. - If W1 has not started by minute 42: commit the module with W0 green and mark item 560 OPEN for "W1 only". The next daytime slot runs W1 on the committed file, unchanged (rule (i)). That is not an attempt. - Gmsh stop rule: not armed. This build is priced (I33 built 412–419 s of gmsh under the rule, twice). The 10-19 weekly keeps the epitaph for the next unpriced build (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4758–4762). The new column path never calls arm_gmsh_stop_rule. FEM_EM_GMSH_STOP_RULE is never set in W1 or in entry 45's command (item 522's trap). - Family: GEO-36 step 8 column knob (I35), attempt 1 of 4.

What exists (main, 2026-10-20). - The step-8 module, tests/validation/test_geo36_rod_f_clinical.py (391 lines, item 530, c07031df): - ROD_BOX_ENV (:65); _rod_centre() / _kwargs() (:88–97), which is _box_kwargs() plus the kept rod at (Lx/4, off, 0); - four pure refusal tests (:103–159); - the build test test_geo36_step8_rod_in_astm_box (:165–391), whose (G1) / (G2) / (G4) / (G7) are diag- or census-only reads (:215–226, :265–270, :283, :383–386). - Entry 40's column module, tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_column.py. Never edit it: entry 40 runs it on 10-21. - DRIVEN = "P33", HELD = "P34" (:53–54); _selector() reads FEM_EM_GEO38_STEP1B at call time (:72–73). - _context_from_mesh (:95–138): its material_map maps tag 3 only (:129–130). - _build_f_clinical(comm) (:141–154) returns {"ctx", "cells", "facets", "shield_radius_m", "outer_census"}. - The column body test_geo38_step1b_f_clinical_copper_column (:327–519) calls _build_f_clinical as a module global (:369) and reads F_CLINICAL_R1_CELL_RECORD / F_CLINICAL_R1_UNKNOWNS_RECORD by a call-time from … import (:348–354). - Its order is (A0) / (iv) / (S) asserted (:396–404), then the factorising column and one held drive (:477–478), PRICE and PROJECTIONS (:494–504), then (P) / P_surf / NEG / (R1) asserted (:515–519). PRICE already prints before the post-column asserts. - C3a's helpers (tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_matrix.py; never edit it, since entry 44 runs it): _census_failures (:148–161) and _sheet_geometry (:164–185). - The rod's material precedent: IMP-3 step 8, the kept rod under as_hole on copper F-human. Tag 403 is mapped to SIGMA_WIRE_S_PER_M (tests/validation/test_port_gap_voltage_impedance.py:235, 800 S/m) with the gel's ε_r and μ_r, through dataclasses.replace on the problem (tests/validation/test_imp3_f_human_tuned_rod.py:388, :439–446). Its (M0) reads σ on owned tag-403 cells through build_material_fields (:458–476). - I33's measured numbers (20261019T201444Z_GEO-36-rodbox-W2-n2.log; item 530 outcome): 1 217 025 cells; E 1 606 744; F 2 556 953; U₂ = 2E + 2F = 8 327 394; summed RSS 2.079 GiB.

Code: one module edited, additive only. tests/validation/test_geo36_rod_f_clinical.py gains constants, helpers and tests. No existing line changes: git diff on the module shows insertions only. Edit nothing else, so no src/, no column or matrix module, no example. The one exception is entry 45's status line, after green. - Constants (records imported from I33's log, each commented with it): - S8_COLUMN_ENV = "FEM_EM_GEO36_S8_COLUMN"; - F_CLINICAL_ROD_CELL_RECORD = 1_217_025; - F_CLINICAL_ROD_UNKNOWNS_RECORD = (1_606_744, 8_327_394). - These are I33's measured values, registered as the column's (A0) / PRICE comparands under the (1*) licence, not new targets. - _s8_column_mode(): unset or empty ⇒ None; build or 1 ⇒ itself; anything else ⇒ ValueError (C3a's _mode, :75–81). - The rod's material: IMP-3 step 8's convention. Tag 403 is mapped to HomogeneousMaterial(sigma=SIGMA_WIRE_S_PER_M, epsilon_r=gel.epsilon_r, mu_r=gel.mu_r), where gel is the context problem's tag-3 entry. This is a modelling choice for the review to confirm (ruling 1). Without it, tag 403 takes the air default: an empty rod-shaped bubble in the gel, which the (N-M) control detects. - _build_rod_f_clinical(comm) returns _build_f_clinical's dict shape (plus an extra "problem_gel_only" key the column body ignores). It runs, in order: 1. MeshGenerator.birdcage_port_domain(comm=comm, return_diagnostics=True, **_kwargs()), timed and called through the class attribute (imported inside the function). 2. chord from diag["ring_port_layout"], then ctx, outer_census, _w = col._context_from_mesh(msh, cell_tags, facets, chord, comm). 3. The problem is rebuilt with the rod material via dataclasses.replace. ctx["solver"] is replaced by TimeHarmonicSolver(problem_rod, degree=DEGREE) after del ctx["solver"]; never hold two solvers (WF-12 step 4's trap). 4. The rod and fixture asserts (below), then the return. - test_geo36_i35_rod_column(monkeypatch), @complex_only: - mode None ⇒ skip; - build ⇒ _build_rod_f_clinical, then the column body's pre-column asserts (A0) / (iv) / outer census / (S), copied from :386–404 with F_CLINICAL_ROD_CELL_RECORD; it prints BUILD-ONLY return (t_build, RSS per rank and summed, window) and returns before the Leontovich term or any assembly or factorisation; - 1 (entry 45 only) ⇒ _route_column(monkeypatch), then col.test_geo38_step1b_f_clinical_copper_column() is called directly (col is the module object). - _route_column(monkeypatch) — the "column-shape" route. It runs entry 40's body unchanged on the rod fixture: C8's no-edit route, which item 518's ruling (g) accepted. It applies four patches: - monkeypatch.setenv("FEM_EM_GEO38_STEP1B", "1"); - monkeypatch.setattr(col, "_build_f_clinical", _build_rod_f_clinical); - monkeypatch.setattr(s1a, "F_CLINICAL_R1_CELL_RECORD", F_CLINICAL_ROD_CELL_RECORD); - monkeypatch.setattr(s1a, "F_CLINICAL_R1_UNKNOWNS_RECORD", F_CLINICAL_ROD_UNKNOWNS_RECORD). - s1a is tests.validation.test_geo38_f_clinical_build. The driven sheet is entry 40's P33 and the held drive P34, so entry 45's price is entry 40's shape on one more body. PRICE prints before the post-column asserts by the body's own order. - Alternative, for the review: a copied column body (≈ 110 lines) in this module. It needs no patching, but it can drift from entry 40's shape. The drafter prefers the patch route (ruling 2). - Coding tests skip whenever S8_COLUMN_ENV is set (C3a's _coding marker, :481–482): (K0), (K1), (N-A0) below. - Imports: module objects only (import tests.validation.test_geo38_f_clinical_column as col, … _build as s1a), inside function bodies. Never from … import test_*: pytest would collect entry 40's column test into this module.

Anchors (asserted; owned entities, reduced; collectives before any rank-0 branch). - (A0) Cells = F_CLINICAL_ROD_CELL_RECORD within CELL_COUNT_BAND 0.01 (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_port_sheet_prerequisite.py:57), the column body's form (test_geo38_f_clinical_column.py:400). Predicted rel 0 exactly: gmsh is serial on rank 0, and the same kwargs gave 1 217 025 at -n 4 and -n 2. - (iv), outer census, (S): as the column body (:401–404). _census_checks (tests/validation/test_wf12_f_human_hole.py:218) was clean on this mesh at I33's (G7). - (C) c3._census_failures(ids, owned_counts) is empty. There are 64 specs P33…P96, each with more than 0 owned facets, and 64 = 2·LEG_COUNT. Owned counts come from c3._sheet_geometry(ctx, comm). - (D-rod) I33's diag and census identities, re-read on this build at their imported bands. The weekly's "(D-rod)" label (entry 45, :2063) is mapped here to existing identities, not new ones: - (G1) rod_mass_m3 = kept_mass_m3 = V_rod, and wall_area_m2 = A_rod, ≤ STRIP_BAND 1e-9 (tests/validation/test_ops61_exact_strip_ports.py:58); - (G2) CAD(403) = V_rod, CAD(3) = L³ − V_rod, CAD(3) + CAD(403) = L³; - (G4) Σ cad_mass_by_group + conductor_cad_mass_m3 = air_domain_cad_mass_m3; - (G7) tags 3 and 403 present, tag 1 absent, implant_spheroid_cad is None. - V_rod and A_rod come from _rod_volume() / _rod_area() (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_rod.py:113, :117). (G5), (G8) and (G3) are not repeated: they need facet or tet work, and they are I33's record. - (M) The rod's material in the solver's problem. build_material_fields (src/fem_em_solver/core/time_harmonic.py:219) on the rebuilt problem. Owned tag-403 cells (via _cell_values_with_ghosts, tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_rod.py:171) read σ min = max = SIGMA_WIRE_S_PER_M and ε_r = the gel's. Owned tag-3 cells read σ = SALINE_SIGMA (tests/validation/test_lossy_sphere_fullwave.py:93). All exact, as IMP-3 step 8's (M0) asserted. - (U1) ctx["solver"].function_space() global size × bs = F_CLINICAL_ROD_UNKNOWNS_RECORD[0] = E = 1 606 744, exactly. This is C1 (a)'s (U) identity at degree 1. - (K0) Knob parsing: unset, build and 1 accepted; 2 and x raise ValueError. - (K1) Routing tripwire (no gmsh). Inside monkeypatch.context(): - Apply _route_column, and replace MeshGenerator.birdcage_port_domain with a recorder that raises a sentinel _Routed(kwargs). - Call col.test_geo38_step1b_f_clinical_copper_column(). It must raise _Routed, and the recorded kwargs must carry implant_rod with keep_cells True and centre _rod_centre(), plus phantom_box. - On exit, col._build_f_clinical is the original, s1a.F_CLINICAL_R1_CELL_RECORD == 1_147_366, and FEM_EM_GEO38_STEP1B is unset. This proves entry 40's module is untouched in-process.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (N-route) Asserted (K1's twin). The same call with only FEM_EM_GEO38_STEP1B=1 set, without _route_column, reaches the recorder with kwargs that have no implant_rod: it is the 1.5 T fixture. Binary, so the patch is load-bearing. - (N-A0) Asserted by construction. The 1.5 T record misses the rod mesh: |1 217 025 / 1 147 366 − 1| = 6.07e-2, which is 6.1× CELL_COUNT_BAND. That is the ceiling: a fixed ratio of two records. If the record patch silently failed in entry 45's window, (A0) would go red there before the column. One geometric fact the table must carry (unlogged review arithmetic, asserted below as (P)). The two probes are each "1 mm beyond the tip" of their own fixture, and they are not the same point relative to the source: - I75's bracket rod is a flat-ended source (r ≤ ROD_RADIUS, |z| ≤ L/2), so its probe sits at z = ±16 mm (test_imp8_rod_probe_f2182_fem.py:74). - The clinical rod is a capsule. _probe_points puts the apex at ±(ROD_LENGTH/2 + ROD_RADIUS) (test_geo36_rod_f_clinical_drive.py:288–289; ROD_LENGTH 0.030, ROD_RADIUS 1.0e-3, tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_rod.py:93–94), and _run_heat puts the probe F2182_OFFSET_M = 1 mm beyond it (test_geo36_rod_f_clinical_heating.py:293, :582–584). So it sits at ±17 mm from the rod centre: 2 mm beyond the line's end, which is I78's Z_C, not its Z_P. - On I78's line source that 1 mm moves θ(900 s) by 1 − 6.810428/9.648662 = 0.2941583 (20261108T133157Z_IMP-8-item874-W1.log:54). That is a 29 % confound if the rows are set side by side unlabelled. The 11-09 ruling "a queued window's module is not touched" (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4824–4827) is met by construction, and checked below.

What it is. Entry 67 (I32-3T) is entry 63's twin at 128 MHz. Its body is I32b's _run_heat run under C21's 3 T patch set, exactly as C32 runs I36b's _run_drive under it (test_geo36_rod_f_clinical_3t_drive.py:120–144).

C4's fixture builds that ω from the wf7 / c4 globals, which C21's patch 3 rebinds (test_geo38_f_clinical_3t_box_loaded.py:130–131). - It takes the rod centre from i35._rod_centre() (heating.py:538). That reads s2._f_clinical_kwargs at call time (test_geo36_rod_f_clinical.py:88–91, through s2._box_kwargs), and patch 1 rebinds it (3t_box_loaded.py:125). - C32 printed C20's rod centre (0.105, 0.0, 0.0) under the patch (20261105T133319Z_GEO-36-C32-W0.log:67). It is the same ASTM box at both field strengths, so the F2182 probes sit at the same ±17 mm (I79's (P)). 2. On the stub, the thermal half sees the same two fields at both frequencies. The rod arm gets E_u and the twin 0.5 E_u (_k9_stubs_3t's _drive, 3t_drive.py:315–325). So I32b's stub prints must reproduce by string under the 3 T route. Code. New module tests/validation/test_geo36_rod_f_clinical_3t_heating.py. It writes the anchor and returns the step's three gates to the weekly. As posed, (K-gel) is false by construction, and (K-hole)'s sign is predicted reversed on I32a's stub (premises below). They are printed, not asserted: asserting them would leave a known-red node on main (PROJECT_PLAN.md:3985). No band, target or done-when is set or moved. Family I87, attempt 1 of 4. It depends on xl entry 63 having run: take it no earlier than the 11-13 04:30 slot, with the 02:00 window's commit on main. This item edits entry 63's own module, which entry 60 (11-11) also imports (test_geo38_f_clinical_3t_box_heating.py:36). The 11-09 ruling "a queued window's module is not touched" (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4824–4827) binds, and a default-off knob does not lift it. The 11-11 weekly can rule the premises first.

Why the three gates cannot be asserted as posed (premises, for the weekly). 1. The module's default rod arm is not "gel". - It excludes tag 403 from the thermal domain behind an adiabatic wall (I32a's detail 1, this file's item 707). The stub prints V_sub 9.895833333333e-04 and rod wall 144 (adiabatic) (20261108T181211Z_GEO-36-I32b-L-W0b.log:117). - That is I69's hole in the ε → 0 limit, not a gel rod. An arm that puts the rod cells in the domain at gel properties adds their heat capacity, so "(K-gel) the gel arm reproduces the default's prints to the digit" fails by construction. - So the default-off knob that keeps entry 63's path is unset = the present exclusion. gel is a fourth configuration. 2. On the stub, the in-domain arms differ by heat capacity, below INTERIOR_BAND. - The stub geometry. The stub's "rod" is a 108-cell block, the cells with midpoints at |x|∞ < 12 mm (test_geo36_rod_f_clinical_drive.py:1194). It is 1.0417e-05 m³, 1.04 % of the box (L-W0b.log:103, :106, :117). Its tip balls sit 42 mm off, at _k9_fixture's (±0.03, ∓0.03, 0) (drive.py:1201). The source is uniform in the gel, and the block is unheated. - The prediction (unlogged drafter arithmetic, a point-sink estimate, ±50 %). An in-domain block is a heat sink of strength ≈ ρc_rod·V_b·dθ/dt. At the balls, the gel arm's deficit against the exclusion is ≈ q·V_b/(4πk r)·erfc(r/(2√(κt*))) ≈ 1.8e-2 K on 2.42 K, i.e. 0.4–0.7 %. Inputs: q 4.0e3 W/m³ (L-W0b.log:123), k 0.6, r 42.4 mm, √(κt*) 20.1 mm. - Ti's sink is ≈ 0.57 of gel's. Ti's ρc is 0.557 of gel's (ROD_RHO_C 2.33018e6 against RHO_C 4.18e6), and Ti equilibrates in ≈ 50 s. - Predicted ordering at the balls: hole ≈ default > Ti > gel. Ti/gel − 1 ≈ +1.5e-3 … +3.5e-3, and hole/gel − 1 ≈ +4e-3 … +7e-3. - So (K-Ti) keeps its sign but not the band, and (K-hole) is reversed. I69's source sits at the tips, a different configuration. It reads Ti > gel > hole at z = 0, but hole > gel > Ti at the tip point (2, 15) mm (IMP-8.md:919–921). The weekly's "(I69's sign)" matches the z = 0 row. 3. (S2-tip) on balls that contain rod cells. This is a finding for the Ti clinical variant; the stub cannot reach it. - With the rod in the domain at ρc ≠ RHO_C, the BE identity becomes ⟨θ¹⟩/Δt ≈ ⟨M_ρc⁻¹F⟩, not the scalar-ρc ρc⟨θ¹⟩/Δt ≈ ⟨Πq⟩. - The clinical tip ball (a 6.2035 mm, centred on the rod's end) holds ≈ 22 mm³ of rod, ≈ 2.2 % of its 1000 mm³ (drafter arithmetic: π·1²·6.2 + 2π/3). - So _tip_slope_rows' scalar form is predicted red there at ≈ 1e-3 … 1e-2 on the Ti and hole arms. It stays exact on the gel arm. - The stub's balls contain no rod cells. The Ti clinical window is not priceable until the weekly rules this comparand.

On rod cells, ti sets ROD_K / ROD_RHO_C; hole sets EPS_HOLE·K_GEL / EPS_HOLE·RHO_C; gel overwrites nothing. - _thermal_arm_rod_cells(label, msh, cell_tags, e_sup, sigma_f, G, centre, tips, probes, *, rod_thermal, f2182=None), new. docs.text:
Enumerated by the 11-14 weekly at PROJECT_PLAN.md:5127–5152, under the entry 63 ruling at :4909–4952 (b23fb062). This brief adds execution detail only. No band is set or moved: E_BAND stays 1e-09 and S2_BAND stays 1e-04. Family I32c, attempt 1 of 4. Executor: the implementer, in-slot. No src/ edit; no band moves. Landing ⇒ entry 71 READY."

HOLD: read this before taking the item. The weekly says the step is "serial on nothing — entry 63 has run, the module is free" (:5127–5128). That premise is contradicted by the queue the same weekly commit wrote. - xxl entry 69 (P33-d2, Saturday 11-28) is queued at docs/testing/xxl-queue.d/20261128-GEO-38-P33-d2.env, written in b23fb062. Its module is tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_box_heating.py. - That module imports this one directly at :61 (from tests.validation import test_geo36_rod_f_clinical_heating as i32). - It calls the two functions I32c edits: i32._thermal_arm(…, merged=True) at :173–174 and i32._thermal_failures(arm) at :273. It also uses i32._transient, _probe_theta, _refuse_degree, _box_preconditions, _p37_fixture and the STUB constants. - An AST forward-closure walk at this review: entry 69's closure has 116 modules and contains test_geo36_rod_f_clinical_heating.py. Entry 65's test_geo38_f_clinical_matrix.py (55 modules) and tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py do not.

By the module-hold rule (PROJECT_PLAN.md:3982, "a queued window's own module, every module that window imports … are held until it runs"; :3986, "a default-off knob does not lift it"), the module is held until entry 69 runs on 11-28. I32c is not takeable as written.

The slot does not rule on this. It skips the item, or marks it BLOCKED (hold) with this paragraph, and the review rules. The options the review has, none chosen here: - (α) A ruled exception. Every I32c change sits behind tip_projection=True or the stub-only test nodes, and entry 69 calls _thermal_arm with the default tip_projection=False. So (i)–(iii) leave entry 69's executed path byte-equivalent. That would need proof: run Wreg, which includes entry 69's module, and show _thermal_failures unchanged on arms without tip_projection. See the note under (i) below. - (β) Put the repair in a new module that composes _run_heat and patches _thermal_arm, as I85 does. Entry 71's command would then name that module, not "the same … module" as entry 71 is written (xl-pending.md:2627). - (γ) Wait until after 11-28. Entry 71 (11-17) and entry 67 (11-19) would slip by about two weeks.

Everything below assumes the hold is lifted by (α) or by date.

What the step is. It repairs two of I32b's thermal gates, so that entry 71 can re-run entry 63 with the asserted set entry 55 passed: - (i) The asserted (E) returns to CN plus the Δt₁ BE step. The Δt₁/10 residual is printed as (E10), beside its floor estimate. - (ii) A third one-step BE at Δt₁/100 joins the tip rows, with the two-point and three-point Richardson intercepts printed. (S2-tip) is printed on the clinical body and stays asserted on the stub. - (iii) The separating measurement on the stub: the same Δt₁/10 step with T carried from 0.

Facts verified against the tree (this review, by grep / reading; unlogged, not a record). - The module is tests/validation/test_geo36_rod_f_clinical_heating.py (1452 lines). It is entry 63's module (xl 11-13, run) and entry 71's. - _thermal_arm :296–426. - The third BE step: res10 = _transient(sub, ft, q, dt=DT_1_BOX / 10.0, n_steps=1, theta=1.0) at :354, under if tip_projection: (:352–355). - out is built at :411–416. That is why entry 63's printed (E) was green while the asserted maximum went red. - _thermal_failures is at :429–451. - (E) at :435–436, against arm["E"]. - (S2-tip) at :446–449: worst = max(arm.get("tip_s2_pi", arm["tip_s2"]).values()), asserted at S2_BAND, rod arm only (not arm["merged"]). - tip_s2_pi is set from tip_rows["dt1/10"] at :392. - The tip rows are at :386–398. tip_rows = {"dt1": …, "dt1/10": …} at :389–391, and the tip-ball print is at :393–398. The print is the literal at W0b :116–117 / :123–124. - _tip_slope_rows is at :279–288: plain arithmetic, rows R_Pi, R_DG0, pq_q. It is not edited. docs.title: §9 item 222 — 2026-10-04 (chain U6)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-04 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it.

GEO-37 step 1: the 2D-facet probe. The fixture is a unit box with one rectangle embedded in its interior, tagged as a gmsh dim-2 physical group. It is read through the project's own gmsh interop at -n 1 / 2 / 4 in one logged window. The question is whether the interior rectangle arrives in DolfinX's facet_tags on the 0.11 image complete, unduplicated and without a hang. - Executor: implementer, not mesh-probe. The §7 row and §10 U6 both say mesh-probe. But mesh-probe's contract is "a table + a probe script, never an assertion". The row's Done-when needs the tagged area "against the rectangle's closed form at 1e-9" and the count "equal across widths after reduction" to move ⬜ → ✅, and §4 needs at least one quantitative assertion. A mesh-probe run therefore cannot move the row by construction (rubric element 7). - The deliverable keeps the probe's shape: a probe script plus a table. An implementer adds the asserting test that reads the probe's records. - The review amends the row's executor word in the same commit (rule (j)). - Tier: standard ceiling (the step timeouts sum to 180 s), real build, -n 1 / 2 / 4. The row says "smoke by prediction". The window is predicted at 25–50 s (three launches of ≈ 6–12 s plus pytest ≈ 5 s), so the tier word is re-labelled on measurement. - Class: chain step, no solve. The class median is ≈ 11 min. - Cost: ≈ 11 measured / ≈ 35 predicted min. That is 15 fixed + ≈ 15 code + one window of ≈ 1 min + spare. - Depends on nothing. It is measurement only: no src/ change (the row's letter).

Why this is open (history paid for). - On the 0.7 image, PORT-1 step 3b-iv's dim-2 groups 201 / 202 on interior facets timed out at -n 2 (exit 124 at 181 s) and passed at -n 1 (22.5 s). They were filed as known-issues 9 "hangs model_to_mesh". - The same day's marker probe half-refuted that. model_to_mesh and facet creation completed at -n 2 in 14 s (20260805T034007Z_PORT-1-step3biv-hang-localise-fine.log). What hung was the dS facet-area assembly on a mesh with no ghost cells: the two ranks' stacks differed (a mismatched collective). - The project then rebuilt interfaces dolfinx-side from cell tags. That is _interface_facet_tags (io/mesh.py:282), whose docstring still carries the old diagnosis. Every current sheet, including the exact-rectangle birdcage ports (io/mesh.py:≈5520–5553, shared faces of two piece volumes), goes through that sliver-pair route. - No fixture has tagged an interior face natively since. The 0.11 dolfinx.io.gmsh.model_to_mesh, reached through the shim _model_to_mesh (io/mesh.py:13–28), has never been asked.

Code (tests only). - tests/mesh/probe_geo37_interior_facet.py (probe script; python_files = test_*.py, so it is never collected), taking --out <json>. The model is built on rank 0 inside try / except BaseException, then _raise_geometry_failure_on_every_rank before the collective (GEO-23, so a gmsh throw cannot hang the other ranks). - CAD: - occ.addBox(0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1) and occ.addRectangle(0.1, 0.2, 0.47, 0.8, 0.6). The rectangle is w × h = 0.8 × 0.6 (area 0.48) in the plane z = 0.47; it spans most of the box so a four-way partition is likely to cut near it. - occ.fragment([(3, box)], [(2, rect)]), then synchronize. - Raise unless exactly one volume remains, and unless exactly one surface has bbox z-span < 1e-12 at z = 0.47 with occ.getMass within 1e-12 of 0.48. - Physical groups: addPhysicalGroup(3, [vol], 1); addPhysicalGroup(2, [rect], 201); addPhysicalGroup(2, the six box faces, 101). - Mesh: Mesh.MeshSizeMax = Mesh.MeshSizeMin = 0.08 gives a predicted 10–20 k tets and ≈ 150 rectangle triangles. Record N_gmsh = len(gmsh.model.mesh.getElements(2, rect)[1][0]) and broadcast it. - Import: mesh, cell_tags, facet_tags = _model_to_mesh(gmsh.model, comm, 0, gdim=3) (the project shim, default partitioner), then gmsh.finalize(). - Measure, rank-safely: - fdim = 2; n_owned = mesh.topology.index_map(2).size_local. - For tag t ∈ {201, 101}, the local facets are facet_tags.find(t) and the owned ones are those < n_owned. - Triangle areas in numpy: dolfinx.mesh.entities_to_geometry(mesh, 2, facets) → mesh.geometry.x → ½‖(b − a) × (c − a)‖. - count_t and area_t are owned sums, allreduced. - Also count_local_t / area_local_t (owned plus non-owned local copies, reduced; printed) and the per-rank owned and local counts (gathered and printed: does the partition touch the rectangle?). - The planted control quantity: on the lowest rank owning any 201 facet, drop its first owned 201 facet, giving count_drop, area_drop (reduced). - Rank 0 writes JSON: comm_size, N_gmsh, cells (reduced), all the above, seconds_mesh, seconds_import, seconds_measure, and a completed: true stamp written last. - Never use a UFL dS(201) / ds integral here. That is the assembly that hung in 2026-08 (no ghost cells; the default partitioner gives cells_ghost = 0). A numpy owned-facet sum measures the same area with no collective beyond allreduce. - tests/mesh/test_geo37_interior_facet.py reads GEO37_RECORD_DIR. The module is skipped when that variable is unset, so ordinary suite runs never fail on a missing record. One test per assertion; it prints the table (width | cells | N_gmsh | count | area − 0.48 | local-copy excess | per-rank owned | seconds) and [GEO-37] VERDICT native interior facet tags on 0.11: GREEN|RED.

Anchors (asserted, per width w ∈ {1, 2, 4}). - (A1) No hang: n<w>.json exists, carries completed: true, and comm_size == w. - (A2) Count: count_201 is equal across the three widths and equal to N_gmsh. A route that drops or duplicates partition-boundary facets reads ≠ N_gmsh at -n 2 / -n 4 only. - (A3) Area: |area_201/0.48 − 1| ≤ 1e-9. The closed form is w · h; a planar rectangle tiled by linear triangles is exact, and the predicted reading is ≈ 1e-15. - (A4) Companion, the instrument check: |area_101/6 − 1| ≤ 1e-9, and count_101 equal across widths. This shows the owned-facet arithmetic on the exterior group, which has always reached the tags since GEO-10. The case where (A4) is green and (A3) red is exactly the interior-specific failure.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (c1) A planted dropped facet, asserted by construction. At every width, count_drop == N_gmsh − 1, and |area_drop/0.48 − 1| > 1e-9. - Ceiling: one facet's share ≈ 1/N_gmsh ≈ 7e-3 (predicted from the 0.08 size; printed), ≈ 10⁶ × the band. Every facet has positive area, so the miss is arithmetically certain. - It shows the 1e-9 band detects the failure mode PORT-1 feared: one lost facet. - (c2) Local-copy double count, printed, predicted, never asserted. area_local_201 − 0.48 is predicted 0 at -n 1 and ≥ 0 at -n 2 / -n 4. It is > 0 only where a partition boundary lies on the rectangle (both adjacent tets on different ranks), which the partitioner does not guarantee. It is printed to show what an unfiltered (rank-local) sum would have reported.

Window (foreground, Bash timeout: 660000; the harness call is the whole Bash command, bare and repo-relative; -s; no pipes; ; between widths so a hang at one width does not skip the next; the pytest step is last, so the footer is pytest's status).

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-37-W1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && rm -rf /tmp/geo37 && mkdir -p /tmp/geo37 && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 10 45 mpiexec -n 1 python3 tests/mesh/probe_geo37_interior_facet.py --out /tmp/geo37/n1.json ; PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 10 45 mpiexec -n 2 python3 tests/mesh/probe_geo37_interior_facet.py --out /tmp/geo37/n2.json ; PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 10 45 mpiexec -n 4 python3 tests/mesh/probe_geo37_interior_facet.py --out /tmp/geo37/n4.json ; PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace GEO37_RECORD_DIR=/tmp/geo37 timeout -k 10 30 python3 -m pytest tests/mesh/test_geo37_interior_facet.py -v -s --tb=short'"

  • The rm -rf /tmp/geo37 first is load-bearing: a stale n2.json from an earlier window would fake (A1).
  • The command contains no $, so the host shell expands nothing. Do not add echo $?; (A1) reads completion from the record, not from the exit code.

Traps. - dS on an unghosted mesh (above, PORT-1 3b-iv, two windows). - A rank-0 gmsh throw hangs the other ranks inside the collective import unless it is broadcast first (GEO-23, Status 124 at 120 s × 3). - A non-cutting fragment. If occ.fragment leaves the face unembedded, its triangles are not tet facets: (A2) reads 0 and the guard raises. Fall back to gmsh.model.mesh.embed(2, [rect], 3, vol) before meshing, disclosed in the journal. This is a fixture fix, not a band move. - Owned versus local. Facets are rank-local, and facet_tags carries non-owned copies of partition-boundary facets. Filter by index_map(2).size_local and reduce. Never sum facet_tags.values rank-locally. - After a timeout kill, check orphans and /dev/shm. Run pgrep -c python3 in the container first. A killed mpiexec leaks /dev/shm/mpich_shm_* (known-issues), and the next -n 4 launch can then fail for an unrelated reason. - Run hygiene: PYTHONPATH carries :/workspace; print on rank 0; rule (i).

Scope. - Not claimed: a port solve, a CAD/STEP import, curved or multi-face sheets, a face touching a material interface or the boundary, other partitioners or ghost modes, an xl width, or any change to the importer (the row: no src/ change). - This is one planar rectangle, one mesh size and one partitioner.

Status it can move. The GEO-37 §7 row's Done-when: one logged window at -n 1 / 2 / 4; the tagged count equal across widths after reduction; the tagged area at 1e-9 against the closed form; no hang ⇒ ✅ as a probe, green or red. Both verdicts move ⬜ → ✅: - Green (A1–A3 at every width) registers native facet tags as the (9b) CAD-port route. - Red at any width registers the sliver-pair importer.

The §10 U6 line and the (9b) design sentence are re-pointed by the review accordingly.

Negative result. - This is a probe whose red is a result. A red (A1) (a width killed at 45 s, meaning a hang), (A2) or (A3) is recorded as the verdict RED with the table. Commit on main, because the row closes green or red. - The slot stops after committing, since there is no PREDICTED RED line and a red stops the slot. - It journals which width and which assertion failed, plus the stacks, if a width hung. - The known-issues 9 history gains a 0.11 line. _interface_facet_tags' docstring is not edited (no src/ change). - (A4) or (c1) red: the instrument is wrong, and the verdict is void. Fix the probe and re-run the window in-slot, and disclose it.
