docs.title: GEO-38 — F-clinical-1.5T cost probe (the clinical-scale body coil)
docs.text: Item briefs and execution history (operator directive 2026-10-01). The §7 row is the status of record.

docs.title: Origin — operator directive 2026-10-14 (interactive session)
docs.text:
F-human (0.15 m radius, 0.30 m long) is head-coil sized. Clinical body coils sit just outside the 0.70 m patient bore of wide-bore 1.5 T / 3 T scanners. The human operator directed:

  • F-clinical is the production fixture from here on for all new human-scale work (Phases 7 and 8, future ANS cases, clinically framed Phase 9 examples). The Phase 6 exit stays on F-human; F-human's records stay valid and are frozen as an intermediate fixture.
  • Two viable clinical coil models, one at 1.5 T and one at 3 T — 1.5 T first.

The full directive, nominal geometry table and seven-step ladder are in PROJECT_PLAN §10, paragraph "Clinical-scale coil fixtures" (just before "Phase 7 — implants").

docs.text:

  • 3 T, 70 cm bore: a high-pass quadrature body coil 58 cm long, 70.4 cm in diameter, inside a shield 74.3 cm in diameter and 70 cm long — "Efficient high-frequency body coil for high-field MRI" (MRM), https://mri-q.com/uploads/3/4/5/7/34572113/body_coil_distriubtion_mrm.20177.pdf

The 1.5 T rung diameter (≈ 0.71 m) is set just outside the 0.70 m patient space rather than at the patent's 65 cm carrier (a narrower-bore design). The weekly may refine any value only with a cited source, and records which.

docs.title: Operator ruling 2026-10-15 (interactive session) — the port census
docs.text: 32 legs, 64 sheets. A 32-leg high-pass birdcage has 32 ring gaps on each end ring; every one of the 64 is a lumped sheet (exact CAD rectangle, κ off). Census = 64; the untuned S-matrix at C3 is 64×64 (one factorisation, 63 held columns). Tuning and SAR (C4, C6) use the in-model route: the 64 gaps as series-RC sheets with the 0.2 Ω ESR, driven by two ports in quadrature. The "port census = 32" / "32×32" in the 10-14 text was F-human's 16-leg count carried over by mistake; 16 legs (keeping 32 ports) was considered and rejected because it contradicts the cited 32-rung source. This answers the dashboard's W7.

docs.title: Shared: the F-clinical-1.5T parameter set and what the generator can and cannot do
docs.text:
What exists. MeshGenerator.birdcage_port_domain (src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py:4245–4283) takes every coil parameter chain C needs as a plain keyword: leg_count, ring_radius, leg_spacing (ring-plane separation, rings at z = ±leg_spacing/2, :5140), coil_length (the leg cylinders' span, :5225–5226), ring_gap_length (the high-pass layout), emit_port_sheets, ring_sheet_orientation="longitudinal", as_hole, resolution, conductor_resolution, air_padding, port_box_size. The F-human wrappers do not: FHumanBirdcageGeometry.generator_kwargs (src/fem_em_solver/study.py:440–466) and GEO-25's _params scale every length with s = R / 0.07 (study.py:404–411). At R = 0.355 m that makes the rungs 0.71 m long, the ring gaps 4.1 cm, and the floating leg boxes cross the shield. So the coil is a parameter set on the generator plus a new test module, not a wrapper call.

What does not exist: a shield. grep -i shield src is empty. The outer boundary is the PEC air box (:5504–5511), which TH-14's _outer_box_tags pins as exterior ∖ cavity (tests/validation/test_th14_birdcage_copper.py:133). Item 468 adds a keyword-only shield_radius (sized below). The shield is then the cylindrical outer boundary, a closed PEC can: the lateral face at R_s plus the two end caps at ±z_extent. This is a modelling choice and the step claims nothing for it.

Also not usable here. leg_sheet_strip_fraction needs leg_gap_length (:4560–4566), so it is not part of the high-pass layout. The ring sheets are the whole CAD rectangle chord × w (:4225, :4232) with κ off (ruling 2026-10-02).

Leg count vs port census (for the review). The generator places 2·leg_count ring gaps (ring_port_count, :4206), so 32 legs give 64 ring-gap ports, not 32. The weekly's "port census = 32", "32×32" and "18 C16 × mirror classes" are F-human's (16-leg) figures. Every brief below uses 64 (and 34 C32 × mirror classes for C3: 17 same-ring + 17 other-ring separations). The review re-poses the census before queueing. The other option is 16 legs, which keeps 32 ports but contradicts the 32-rung source.

The parameter set (module constant F_CLINICAL_15T_KWARGS in the new module; it is the single source of truth, as GEO-25's _params is for F-human):

kwarg value rule leg_count 32 §10 table ring_radius 0.355 m rung diameter 0.71 m leg_spacing 0.45 m rung length = ring-centreline separation (the electrical rung between the end rings) coil_length 0.45 + 2 × 0.0321428571 = 0.5142857143 m F-human's leg overhang past the ring centreline, 0.015·s = 0.0321428571 m, held in absolute terms: the same leg/ring junction F-human meshes leg_width, ring_minor_radius 0.012, 0.004 m F-human's conductor stock, unscaled (study.py:425–426) ring_gap_length 0.0171428571 m F-human's absolute gap (0.008·s) port_box_size (0.0214285714, 0.004, 0.0214285714) m F-human's dx, dz. dy is cut from 0.01714 so that the floating leg boxes clear the shield. Their outer face is at R + 0.006 + 0.001 + dy = 0.366 m (:3946–3947). F-human's dy would put it at 0.3791 m, outside R_s. phantom_radius, phantom_height 0.10969 m, 0.65 m C1's load stand-in. The builder always meshes a phantom cylinder (:5253–5261). This one matches the ASTM box's volume (0.65 × 0.42 × 0.09 = 0.02457 m³ = π r² · 0.65) and its 0.65 m axial length, so C1's price includes the load and C2's air length. C2 swaps the box in. air_padding (0.03/0.07) × 0.355 = 0.1521428571 m F-human's margin, scaled with R (study.py:411, :456) shield_radius (new) 0.3725 m shield diameter 0.745 m as_hole, emit_port_sheets, ring_sheet_orientation True, True, "longitudinal" the copper hole route (WF-12) resolution 0.015 m F-human's, absolute conductor_resolution r1 1.6e-3 m / r2 2.4e-3 m r1 is F-human's sizing carried over unscaled. That is GEO-25 branch B: scaling the sizing with R is branch A, which fails CAD_MASS_GATE at 0.893 already at 0.15 m (GEO-25.md:3). r2 is WF-12 item 147's middle rung, which gave 0.7698 × the cells on F-human (WF-12.md:38).

Derived closed forms. - Ring gap. α = g/(2R) = 0.0241449 rad < π/32. Chord 2R·tan α = 0.0171463 m. w = 2·0.004 + 2·0.001 = 0.010 m. Sheet area chord·w ≈ 1.71463e-4 m² (the module takes it from ring_port_layout, never re-typed). - Leg-arc clearance. 0.02028 m. - Air can. z_extent = max(coil_length/2, leg_spacing/2 + r_ring, phantom_height/2) + air_padding = 0.325 + 0.15214 = 0.47714 m (:5484). Can length 0.95429 m; volume π R_s² · 2z_e ≈ 0.41599 m³. - Shield clearances. R_s − max(R + r_leg, R + w/2, leg-box outer face) = 0.3725 − 0.366 = 6.5 mm.

The 1.5 T shield length is not in the §10 table. The can length above follows from the air-padding rule; the weekly may refine it from a cited source.

docs.title: §9 item 468 — GEO-38 step 1a (chain C1 (a)): F-clinical-1.5T built, CAD identities at -n 2, cells and unknowns at two rungs
docs.text:
Executor and cost. - Executor: implementer. - Tier: heavy by ceiling. Build-only, real (default) image, as WF-12 step 1's build windows ran (WF-12.md:50). W1 / W2 at -n 2; the rule-(c) re-gate at -n 1. - Cost: ≈ 10 measured (class median, chain no-solve) / ≈ 55 predicted min. That is 15 fixed + ≈ 25 code + ≈ 15 of windows. - Depends on nothing.

Code. - src/ (ruling (c), disclosed). Add a keyword-only shield_radius: Optional[float] = None to birdcage_port_domain and _build_birdcage_port_model, ≈ 40–60 lines in io/mesh.py. None executes no new line. - Checks before gmsh exists: - Refuse with symmetry_quadrant. - Require shield_radius > max(R + max(r_leg, r_ring), R + w/2, port_radius + dy/2) + port_clearance. - Air domain: occ.addCylinder(0, 0, −z_extent, 0, 0, 2·z_extent, shield_radius) in place of the box (:5504–5511). - _face_on_wall (:5920–5937) also classifies the lateral shield face as a wall. Test: bbox x / y extents at ±R_s within 1e-6 and z-span 2·z_extent. The caps are already caught by the z test. - Diagnostics: shield_radius_m, shield_length_m, and air_domain_cad_mass_m3 (the cylinder's getMass before the fragment). - Test module. New tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_build.py. - Selected only by FEM_EM_GEO38_STEP1A ∈ {r1, r2}, never by -k; skipped when unset. - Holds F_CLINICAL_15T_KWARGS and _f_clinical_kwargs(rung). - Lifts WF-12's _owned_census / _census_checks / _ring_sheet_areas pattern (tests/validation/test_wf12_f_human_hole.py:209–248) with ring ordinals 33..96 (range(leg_count + 1, 3·leg_count + 1)).

Anchors (asserted at r1 and at r2; owned facets / vertices, allreduced — -n 2 is where a missing reduction shows). - (R) rung diameter. Every vertex of each of the 64 longitudinal sheets lies in the plane u = x cos φ_c + y sin φ_c = R. Assert max|u/R − 1| ≤ STRIP_BAND (1e-9, tests/validation/test_ops61_exact_strip_ports.py:58). The sheets are planar CAD rectangles; predicted ≈ 1e-15. - (L) rung length. Per sheet, (z_max + z_min)/2 = ±leg_spacing/2, so the separation is 0.45 m at 1e-9. Also, the leg-end planes satisfy max z over the cavity-wall vertices = coil_length/2 at 1e-9, which is the leg span 0.51429 m. - (S) shield diameter and length. - Every vertex on an outer facet with |z| < z_extent·(1 − 1e-9) has hypot(x, y) = R_s at 1e-9. gmsh places nodes on the OCC cylinder; predicted ≤ 1e-12. - max |z| over outer facets = z_extent at 1e-9. - The trap check, asserted. No cavity-wall (BIRDCAGE_CONDUCTOR_SURFACE_TAG) vertex has hypot ≥ R_s(1 − 1e-9), and _outer_box_tags' census reads outer + cavity = exterior with no tag collision (as test_wf12_f_human_hole.py:440–442). If the shield face lands in the cavity group, the copper wall term is applied to the shield and the PEC group shrinks to the caps. - (N) leg count. Take the cavity-wall facets with all three vertices at z = +coil_length/2 and bin them by round(atan2(y, x)/(2π/32)). Exactly 32 bins are non-empty, and every such vertex lies within r_leg·(1 + 1e-9) of its bin's axis (R cos θ_k, R sin θ_k). - (A) sheet areas. All 64 match ring_port_layout["ring_port_sheet_longitudinal_area_m2"] within SHEET_AREA_BAND 1e-9 (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_leg_offset.py:104). F-human measured 2.220e-15 (WF-12.md:438). - (C) ring-port census = 2·leg_count = 64. - 64 sheet tags, each with > 0 owned facets after reduction. - Cell halves 100+i / 200+i present for i ∈ 33..96. - The 32 floating leg boxes 101..132 are present. as_hole keeps them: emit_leg_ports=False is refused with it, :4555–4559. - No tag 1. - The census sums to the global cell count. - (U) unknown counts. U₁ = E_global and U₂ = 2·E_global + 2·F_global exactly, where U_k = functionspace(msh, ("N1curl", k)) global size and E / F are the global edge / face counts. This is the degree-2 Nédélec dof count on tets. F-human: 2 570 024 = 2·500 568 + 2·784 444 (WF-12.md:521).

Negative control. - (c1) planted dropped facet (GEO-37 (c1), docs/planning/chunks/GEO-37.md:51–53), asserted by construction. On the lowest rank owning a P33 sheet facet, drop its first owned facet. Then |area_drop / (chord·w) − 1| > SHEET_AREA_BAND. Ceiling ≈ 1 / (P33's facet count), ≈ 1e-2, printed. - Printed (predicted, rule (e)). The weekly's census letter (32) beside the measured 64.

Printed predictions, written first. - Cells, r1: ≈ 1.0 M (range [0.8, 1.5] M). - GEO-25's exponent 0.84 is applied to the conductor centreline length. The 0.84 was fitted on a ladder whose conductor length scaled with R (GEO-25.md:3); GEO-25 found the mesh dominated by the conductor refinement. - F-clinical: 32 × 0.51429 + (2·2π·0.355 − 64 × 0.017143) = 16.457 + 3.364 = 19.821 m. F-human: 16 × 0.30 + (2·2π·0.15 − 32 × 0.017143) = 6.136 m. Ratio 3.230. - 3.230^0.84 = 2.678, so 369 387 × 2.678 ≈ 0.99 M. - A three-term fit to GEO-25 branch B (fixed 67 k + 421 k × conductor-length ratio + 16 k × volume ratio, on the solid route, × the hole/solid ratio 0.728) gives ≈ 1.14 M. The shield annulus (11.5 mm from the leg surfaces, inside the 12 mm refine distance) is unpriced, hence the upper end of the range. - Pure volume scaling (× 4.30) would give 1.59 M. That is rejected: GEO-25's r³ prediction overshot by 5×. - Cells, r2: × 0.7698 → ≈ 0.76 M ([0.62, 1.15] M). - Unknowns (F-human ratios E/cells 1.3551 and (2E + 2F)/cells 6.958): - r1: U₁ ≈ 1.34 M, U₂ ≈ 6.9 M. - r2: U₁ ≈ 1.03 M, U₂ ≈ 5.3 M. - Build time. gmsh is serial on rank 0, so the rank count barely moves it: F-human 110.8 / 114.6 / 109.1 / 122.0 s at -n 1 / 2 / 8 / 16 (WF-12.md:7, :690, :58; docs/testing/xl-ledger.md:58). Rate 0.30 ms/cell (item 147: 112 s / 369 k, 81 s / 284 k, 67 s / 233 k). Predicted: - W1 (r1) ≈ 340 s [280, 500]. - W2 (r2) ≈ 260 s [210, 380]. - Together they exceed one 590 s window, so one rung per window. - Memory. Peak RSS ≈ 3–4 GiB summed (F-human 0.88 GiB at -n 1). - Degree-2 xl price, printed in W1 for the weekly (refined in 469): t_b + 287.1 s × ρ^0.84 at -n 16, and memory 89.31 GiB × ρ^0.84, with × ρ^(4/3) printed beside it as the conservative reading. Here ρ = N₁/369 387, and 287.1 s = factorising solve 273.1 + post 14.0, from entry 32 (xl-ledger.md:58). At ρ = 2.68: ≈ 960 s, 204 / 333 GiB, so xl (≤ 512 GiB).

Records. Register F_CLINICAL_R1_CELL_RECORD and F_CLINICAL_R2_CELL_RECORD (version-tagged, (1*) licence) at the measured values. They are printed only here; items 469 and 470 assert them at CELL_COUNT_BAND (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_port_sheet_prerequisite.py:57).

Windows. Foreground; Bash timeout: 660000. The harness call is the whole Bash command, bare. Use -s. W1 / W2 use the §5.1 durable-capture idiom verbatim, trailing ; exit $rc included. Order: - Pre-check. Run docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3; it must read 0. - W0 (rule-(c) re-gate, measured 245 s). WF-12 step 1 W1b's command (WF-12.md:50), relabelled, with the container timeout at 590: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-38-s1a-ruleC-WF-12-step1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_WF12_STEP1=1 timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 1 python3 -m pytest tests/validation/test_wf12_f_human_hole.py::test_wf12_step1_hole_mesh_identities -s -v --tb=short'" - Bitwise reading against 20261002T020254Z_WF-12-step1-W1b.log: hole 369 387 cells, solid 507 266, (iii) 1.155e-05, (iii-b) 5.148e-10. The module has been unchanged since f1c5b98a. - W1 (r1): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-38-s1a-W1-r1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_GEO38_STEP1A=r1 timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_build.py -s -v --tb=short > /workspace/logs/geo38-s1a-w1-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/geo38-s1a-w1-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/geo38-s1a-w1-raw.log; exit \$rc'" - W2 (r2): the same command with r2, label GEO-38-s1a-W2-r2, and geo38-s1a-w2-raw.log.

Traps. - A gmsh raise at -n 2 is broadcast (:4753–4760, GEO-23). Do not drop to -n 1 for W1 / W2: the weekly asks for -n 2. - cell_tags.values, facet areas and vertex extrema are rank-local: count owned facets once and reduce min / max / sum. - pgrep -f "python3 -m pytest" is denied by the bash guard; use pgrep -c python3. - No edit after a file's last window (rule (i)). - A ValueError before gmsh means a clearance conflict in this table. Report it; do not tune the table in-slot unless it contradicts this brief's own arithmetic, and disclose any such fix.

Scope. Geometry and price only: no solve, no port gate, no physics. C1 (b) is item 469.

Negative result. - A red identity. Report and stop; BLOCKED with the reading. An (R) / (S) miss above 1e-9 because gmsh's projected-node accuracy cannot meet it is a rule-(f) case: re-register by measurement on the same quantity, flagged for the review, never silently. - W1 killed at 590 s. That is the finding: r1 does not fit a heavy window. W2 still runs, and the weekly re-rungs or commissions xl. - Cells outside the predicted range. A prediction miss, printed. Not a failure.

No PREDICTED RED line.

Outcome (2026-10-15 06:00 slot, take-next, implementer): BLOCKED — parked attempt/GEO-38-20261015T114612Z. Disclosed src/ addition (ruling (c)): keyword-only shield_radius on birdcage_port_domain / _build_birdcage_port_model (io/mesh.py; closed PEC can via occ.addCylinder, a refusal with symmetry_quadrant, a pre-gmsh clearance check, _on_shield in the cavity-wall test, diagnostics shield_radius_m / shield_length_m / air_domain_cad_mass_m3); default path unchanged — W0 re-gate 20261015T113017Z_GEO-38-s1a-ruleC-WF-12-step1.log (-n 1, 244 s) 1 passed, hole 369 387 / solid 507 266 cells, (iii) 1.155e-05, (iii-b) 5.148e-10, equal to 20261002T020254Z_WF-12-step1-W1b.log. docs.title: §9 item 469 — GEO-38 step 1b (chain C1 (b)): one degree-1 copper column at -n 8, if the price rule says it fits
docs.text:
Executor and cost. - Executor: implementer. - Tier: heavy, complex, -n 8. - Cost: ≈ 12 measured (class median, chain solve) / ≈ 40 predicted min if GO; ≈ 10 if NO-GO (arithmetic and record only). - Depends on 468 landing; if it has not, skip.

Step 0: the price rule (evaluated before any code, from 468's W1 printed lines, and written into the journal). - Inputs. - N₁ = r1 cells, t_b = W1's printed build time, U₁ = degree-1 unknowns; ρ = N₁ / 369 387. - Anchors on F-human: 39.2 s (assembly + factorisation + solve, -n 8) and summed RSS 9.62 GiB (20261002T020713Z_WF-12-step1-W2.log, WF-12.md:58); held drive 2.88 s mean and summed RSS 10.20 GiB with the factor held (20261002T094751Z_WF-12-step2-W2.log, WF-12.md:144); window overhead 199 − 109.1 − 39.2 = 50.7 s. - Predicted window: T = t_b + 39.2·ρ^0.84 + 2.88·ρ^(4/3) + (30 + 20·ρ) s (column at the weekly's exponent; one held drive at the nested-dissection back-substitution scaling; pytest / tests/environment / post overhead). - Predicted memory: M = 10.20·ρ^(4/3) GiB. - GO iff T ≤ 540 s and M ≤ 64 GiB. 540 s is H12B_TIME_CEILING_S, 590 s less a 50 s margin; 64 GiB is H12B_RSS_CEILING_GIB (tests/validation/test_wf12_f_human_hole.py:74–75). - Worked values at t_b = 0.30 ms × N₁: - N₁ = 0.8 M → T ≈ 396 s, M ≈ 29 GiB (GO). - N₁ = 1.0 M → T ≈ 485 s, M ≈ 38 GiB (GO). - N₁ = 1.2 M → T ≈ 574 s (NO-GO). - The break-even is ≈ 1.13 M. - Also printed, not binding: the conservative column 39.2·(U₁/500 568)² (asymptotic nested-dissection factorisation). At U₁ ≈ 1.34 M that is ≈ 280 s, under which a GO window would be killed. That is the risk the weekly's 0.84 accepts. - NO-GO: the item ends here. The arithmetic goes into this file and onto the §7 row, and the 10-17 weekly commissions the column as an xl window. Implementers never commission.

Code (GO only). - New module tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_column.py: - selected by FEM_EM_GEO38_STEP1B=1; - imports F_CLINICAL_15T_KWARGS / _f_clinical_kwargs("r1") and F_CLINICAL_R1_CELL_RECORD from 468's module. - Context builder. A local F-clinical copy of _build_f_human's as_hole branch (tests/validation/test_wf7_f_human_b1_quadrature.py:155–248) with leg_count 32, ring ordinals 33..96 and _ring_gap_frame(i, 32). It is a copy, not an edit: no helper changes, so no re-gate window. - Ports: all 64 sheets at TERMINATED_PORT_IMPEDANCE_OHM. - Copper wall: _leontovich_term / _surface_loss_w with Z_s = (1 + j)·surface_resistance_ohm(ω, 5.8e7), as in test_wf12_f_human_hole.py:444–445. - Shield: PEC through _outer_box_tags. - Drives: P33 factorising, then P34 held on the same factor. Use the drive loop that test_wf12_f_human_copper_matrix.py uses (PORT-19; the operator is identical across the two drives, so holding the factor is licensed).

Anchors (asserted). - (A0) cells = F_CLINICAL_R1_CELL_RECORD within CELL_COUNT_BAND (predicted rel 0; the build is deterministic across widths on F-human). - (iv) the census and the outer / cavity / shield census under reduction (468's (C) and (S)-trap checks at -n 8). - (P) on P33: P_src = ΣP_sheet + P_phantom + P_(Ω∖phantom) + P_surf within DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL 1e-6 (tests/validation/test_birdcage_power_identity.py:227). F-human measured 2.412e-13. - P_surf > 0. - (R1) one reciprocity pair: |S₃₃,₃₄ − S₃₄,₃₃| / max|S| ≤ RECIPROCITY_BAND (imported as test_th14_birdcage_copper.py:103 imports it). Predicted ≈ 1e-14 (F-human 9.167e-15, a different fixture).

Negative control. Asserted binary: the P_surf-blind miss > DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL. Its predicted factor ≈ 100× is printed, rule (e): F-human read 123.3× (WF-12.md:142), which is a different fixture.

Printed. - t_b at -n 8, t_col, t_held, RSS per rank and summed, U₁. - The measured exponent ln(t_col/39.2)/ln ρ beside 0.84. - The coil-loss share P_surf/(P_src − ΣP_sheet) (F-human 0.370). - Projections for the weekly: - C3 = t_b + t_col + 63·t_held, giving C3's tier per §10 (heavy if ≤ 590 s, else xl); - the degree-2 column, t_b + 287.1·ρ^0.84 at -n 16, with memory 89.31·ρ^0.84 and ρ^(4/3) GiB.

Window (GO). Pre-check pgrep -c python3 = 0, then: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-38-s1b-W1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_GEO38_STEP1B=1 timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 8 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_column.py -s -v --tb=short > /workspace/logs/geo38-s1b-w1-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/geo38-s1b-w1-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/geo38-s1b-w1-raw.log; exit \$rc'"

Print each phase line (build done, assembly done, factorisation done) with flush=True, so that a kill still records how far the window got.

Traps. - Wall term placement. The wall term goes first in every factorising call's bilinear list (WF-12.md:109). - ctx["solver"] as built. pec_facet_tags=None would pin the cavity (WF-12.md:51). - Shield classification. If 468's shield check were wrong, the copper term would land on the shield; (iv) re-asserts it. - Kills. After a kill, run pgrep -c python3 first. A kill at 590 s is not a result and is not retried.

Scope. One factorising column plus one held drive, degree 1, 64 MHz. Not covered: the 64×64, passivity, class spreads, |B₁⁺|, tuning, or any absolute loss figure.

Status it can move. GEO-38 🟡 → ✅ as a probe on the amended step-1 Done-when (measured column; degree-2 price stated). A NO-GO or a kill leaves it 🟡, with the prediction or the lower bound as the record and the column on the 10-17 weekly's xl list.

Negative result. - (P) or (R1) red with (iv) green. A finding about the Leontovich wall or the shield at clinical scale. BLOCKED; the weekly reads it. - Kill. The lower bound > 590 − t_b − t_assembly is the record.

docs.title: §9 item 470 — GEO-38 step 2 (chain C2): the ASTM F2182 box in the bore; sheet tags at -n 1 / 2 / 4, congruence, partition
docs.text:
Executor and cost. - Executor: implementer. - Tier: heavy by ceiling, build-only, real image. - Windows: -n 1, -n 2, -n 4 in separate windows. docs.title: Review ruling 2026-10-15 10:30 (item 468 → item 478)
docs.text:
Diagnosis (no log-pathologist: the reading is a CAD closed form, reproduced to the digit, and moves no status). The floating leg boxes are axis-aligned (io/mesh.py:5346–5356), placed at the leg-pair midpoints (2k + 1)·5.625° (:5337–5341) at port_radius r = R + max(r_leg, r_ring) + dy/2 + c = 0.355 + 0.006 + 0.002 + 0.001 = 0.364 m (:3946–3947). A box's outer corner is at ρ = hypot(|r cos φ| + dx/2, |r sin φ| + dy/2): at 5.625° with dx = 21.43 mm that is hypot(0.372961, 0.037678) = 0.374860 m — the W2 log's vertex (0.37296153, 0.03767824) and its cavity max 0.374859907 m (20261015T114056Z_GEO-38-s1a-W2-r2.log:13383, :13390; re-derived by this review). The same formula reproduces the leak census (boxes at 39.375° outside, 50.625° 0.09 mm inside ⇒ tags 101–104, 113–120, 129–132). The 03:00 brief's "6.5 mm clearance" was the face-centre value at 90°; no axis-aligned box meets it above the face-area floor dx·dz ≥ 2.5e-5 (:3938–3943; the best is 6.42 mm at dx = 1.167 mm). The new refusal on the branch used port_radius + dy/2 (branch io/mesh.py:4762–4775) and so passed the bad table; with a corner formula it would have refused before gmsh.

Re-pose (rule (6) re-pose of the step-1 family: attempt 2 of 4; the step's target — rung Ø 0.71 m, rung length 0.45 m, shield Ø 0.745 m, 32 legs, the CAD identities, U₂ = 2E + 2F — is unchanged). 1. port_box_size = (0.004, 0.004, 0.0214285714) m — dx 21.43 → 4 mm (a square section, gap mode's dx = dy convention); dy, dz unchanged. dx feeds no anchor of this step: not port_radius, not the ring-gap layout (which takes no port_box_size, :4709–4719), not chord·w or the 64 sheet areas, not the PEC air extent (:5520, dy only). Face area 8.57e-5 ≥ 2.5e-5; the separation floor 1.25·max(dx, dy) = 5 mm vs 71.4 mm. 2. The design clearance is re-registered as ≥ 5 mm (a provisional modelling choice of the 03:00 review, not a band: it was never a weekly target). Corner max over all 32 boxes at dx = 4 mm: ρ² = r² + 2b² + 2r·b·(cos φ + sin φ) with b = 0.002 at 39.375° / 50.625° (cos + sin = 1.4074036) ⇒ ρ = 0.3668149 m, clearance 5.685 mm, binding on boxes 3, 4, 11, 12, 19, 20, 27, 28 (this review re-derived 0.366813 by components). The 5 mm target admits dx ≤ 5.77 mm. 3. The shield_radius refusal takes, for the leg boxes, max_k hypot(|r cos φ_k| + dx/2, |r sin φ_k| + dy/2) over the actual box angles, and refuses shield_radius together with leg_gap_length (chain C is high-pass only; simpler than a second gap-mode formula); for the ring-gap boxes, (R + w/2)/cos α (0.360105 m here, harmless, the same face-centre error); plus port_clearance. It exports leg_box_corner_radius_m. 4. New anchor (S′): the max vertex hypot over the cells tagged 101–132 equals leg_box_corner_radius_m to 1e-9 (a CAD identity; the boxes are planar-faced so the corner is a mesh vertex). The (S) trap check stays as written and must now read cavity max < R_s. 5. Option (ii), rotating the boxes, is declined: it edits F-human's default box construction (to stay bitwise it would have to be gated behind shield_radius), for ≈ 0.65 mm more clearance.

Unchanged: every band, every prediction other than the cell counts (attempt 1's cells included the stray box cells and are not records), the 64-port census ruling (N_ports = 2·N_legs, the "= 32" returned to the weekly), items 469 / 470 behind this item (469 imports F_CLINICAL_15T_KWARGS and inherits dx). For the weekly to ratify with the 03:00 choices: dx = 4 mm and the ≥ 5 mm clearance.

It goes to xl as above. - (P) or (R1) red with (iv) and the cache check green. A finding about the Leontovich wall or shield at clinical scale: BLOCKED, and the weekly reads it.

No PREDICTED RED line.

docs.title: §9 item 518 — 2026-10-18 (§10 C8, GEO-38 the 3 T twin's generator; chain step, build-only)
docs.text:
Licence. §9 rule (4), §10 C8 (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4883–4889). The step: "F-clinical-3T (rung Ø 0.704 m, shield Ø 0.743 m and length 0.70 m, rung length 0.58 m, 128 MHz) through the 1.5 T generator with a geometry knob; C1 (a)'s identities at 1e-9 …; with the ASTM box, C2's gates at -n 1 / 2 / 4; gmsh stop rule 450 s. Serial on nothing." The geometry comes from the §10 table (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4299) and its source (GEO-38.md:31–34). - This build has never been timed, so under the epitaph this item is its one pricing window: daytime, with the gmsh stop rule. A stop sends the build to the weekly's xl list. It is never a second heavy attempt. - No band, tolerance, Done-when or target is set or moved. Every band is imported.

GEO-38 C8: the F-clinical-3T table fed through the 1.5 T modules' own test bodies (no 1.5 T file and no src/ file edited); C1 (a)'s identities at r1 / r2 at -n 2; C2's box gates at -n 4; each build under a 450 s gmsh stop rule. - Executor: implementer. - Tier: heavy by ceiling, build-only, on the real (default) image, as items 478 and 470 ran. - W0 smoke, -n 1, ≤ 60 s. - W1 r1 with the stand-in cylinder, -n 2: predicted ≈ 400 s [340, 480]. - W2 r2 with the cylinder, -n 2: predicted ≈ 300 s [250, 380]. - W3 r1 with the ASTM box, -n 4: predicted ≈ 400 s [350, 480]. - Each prediction is the measured 1.5 T price above times the predicted cell ratio ≈ 1.16 (below). - Slots: 12:00, 13:30 or 15:00 local only. Any other slot skips this item and takes the next one. That is not a block. - This item never shares a slot with I31 attempt 2 or with item 519. All three are r1-sized clinical builds. - Class: chain no-solve. Cost: ≈ 18.6 measured (class median) / ≈ 45 predicted slot-minutes: code ≈ 15, windows ≈ 19 (W0 1 + W1 7 + W2 5 + W3 7), pre-checks ≈ 2, commit and journal ≈ 8. - If W3 has not started by minute 42: commit W0–W2 and mark item 518 W3 OPEN. The next daytime slot runs W3 alone on the committed module. The item stays runnable, so rule (d) does not apply. - Depends on: nothing in §9. Not on entry 40. - Fallbacks: - If W1's stop rule fires, W2 still runs (r2 is its own, smaller, untimed build), and W3 is skipped. W3 is the same size as W1, and a second r1-sized heavy attempt is exactly what the epitaph forbids. - If (SR0) is red, the pre-registered container-side stop applies (Windows). - Family: GEO-38 3 T twin, attempt 1 of 4. This is a different family from C1 (b): that one is at 2 of 4 (items 469 and 485), the lift (item 494) was not an attempt, and xl entry 40 is its third (GEO-38.md:561, :600).

The 3 T table. The module constant is F_CLINICAL_3T_KWARGS = dict(s1a.F_CLINICAL_15T_KWARGS, **overrides), so every key not listed below keeps its 1.5 T value by construction (tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_build.py:44–64).

kwarg 1.5 T 3 T rule ring_radius 0.355 0.352 rung Ø 0.704 m leg_spacing 0.45 0.58 rung length = ring-centreline separation (10-15 03:00 choice, GEO-38.md:415; ratified 10-17, PROJECT_PLAN.md:4689–4696) — see ruling (b) coil_length 0.5142857142 0.58 + 2 × 0.0321428571 = 0.6442857142 the same absolute leg overhang (GEO-38.md:145) shield_radius 0.3725 0.3715 shield Ø 0.743 m air_padding 0.1521428571 SHIELD_LENGTH_3T_M/2 − max(coil_length/2, leg_spacing/2 + ring_minor_radius, phantom_height/2) = 0.35 − 0.325 = 0.025 the can spans ±z_extent, with z_extent = that max + air_padding (io/mesh.py:5636, :5655–5659). Computed in the module from this expression, never typed. every other key — unchanged 32 legs; leg_width 0.012; ring_minor_radius 0.004; ring_gap_length 0.0171428571; port_box_size (0.004, 0.004, 0.0214285714); phantom 0.10969 × 0.65 (C1's volume-matched stand-in); resolution 0.015; as_hole, emit_port_sheets, longitudinal sheets

The module also holds SHIELD_LENGTH_3T_M = 0.70, RUNG_DIAMETER_3T_M = 0.704, SHIELD_DIAMETER_3T_M = 0.743, RUNG_LENGTH_3T_M = 0.58 and FREQUENCY_3T_HZ = 128e6. The frequency enters no assertion of this item, which is build-only.

Closed forms (drafter-computed; (K0) re-derives and prints them). - Leg boxes. - port_radius r = R + max(r_leg, r_ring) + dy/2 + c = 0.361 m (io/mesh.py:3945–3947). - Leg-box corner, the refusal's own formula (io/mesh.py:4815–4828): 0.363814913104 m, binding at the 39.375° / 50.625° boxes. - Clearance R_s − corner = 7.6851 mm, against the ≥ 5 mm design value (DESIGN_CORNER_CLEARANCE_M, test_geo38_f_clinical_build.py:70); 1.5 T has 5.6851 mm. - Ring-box corner (R + w/2)/cos α = 0.357105868 m. shield_need = 0.364814913 m < 0.3715, so the table passes the refusal. - Ring gaps. α = g/(2R) = 0.024350649 rad. Chord 2R·tan α = 0.017146246 m. Sheet area chord·w = 1.714624621e-4 m² (w = 0.010 m). - Can. - z_e = 0.325 + 0.025 evaluates to exactly 0.35 in float. - Volume π R_s²·0.70 = 0.303505 m³ (1.5 T: 0.415988). - Cap clearances: box ends 25.0 mm, leg ends 27.86 mm, ring tubes 56.0 mm. At 1.5 T the box ends are 152 mm from the caps; see ruling (c). - Phantom against the ring-port check, R − w/2 − r_phantom: 0.2373 m for the cylinder and 0.1322 m for the box circumradius 0.214767 m. The layout check passes (io/mesh.py:4187–4192). - Conductor centreline length: 23.943 m against 19.821 m at 1.5 T (ratio 1.208).

Predictions, written first (printed, never asserted). - Cells: - r1 ≈ 1.33 M [1.15, 1.55] M (≈ 90 % of the 1.5 T r1 count scaled with conductor length, ≈ 10 % with the 27 % smaller can); - r2 ≈ 1.06 M [0.90, 1.25] M (× 0.7956, the 1.5 T r2/r1 ratio); - box ≈ W1's count + 0.16 % (C2's box-vs-cylinder move, GEO-38.md:405). - gmsh: r1 ≈ 345 s [300, 450] quiet and ≈ 560 s at C2 W2's load; r2 ≈ 260 s [220, 330]. - Unknowns at r1: U₁ ≈ 1.77 M, U₂ ≈ 9.1 M. - Summed RSS: ≈ 2.3 GiB at -n 2, ≈ 3.0 GiB at -n 4. - Degree-2 xl projection for the weekly's 3 T C5 price (printed only): with ρ = N₁/369 387 (the brief's definition, not the body's U₁-based PRICE line, GEO-38.md:453), t_b + 287.1·ρ^0.84 s and 89.31·ρ^0.84 GiB, with × ρ^(4/3) printed beside it. Entry 40 recalibrates the exponent on 10-21.

What exists, and why no 1.5 T file is edited. - The shield length needs no src/ edit. - birdcage_port_domain takes every 3 T value as a plain keyword (io/mesh.py:4245–4285). Shield length has no keyword. - On the can route, air_padding enters only z_extent (:5636) and radial_extent (:5635). radial_extent is used only by the quadrant box (:5642–5649), the default box (:5672–5679) and two box-wall fallbacks (:6107–6113, :6643–6650). - With shield_radius set, the outer tagging continues before the box rule (:6633–6642). At 3 T, radial_extent = 0.387 m lies outside the can, so _face_on_wall's box fallback matches no face. - So no ruling (c) and no re-gate. - The 1.5 T bodies read their kwargs through module globals at call time. - test_geo38_step1a_f_clinical_identities checks _rung() (test_geo38_f_clinical_build.py:93–94, :132–134), then calls _f_clinical_kwargs(rung) (:149). - test_geo38_step2_astm_box_mesh_gates checks FEM_EM_GEO38_STEP2 (test_geo38_f_clinical_box.py:69–70), then calls _box_kwargs() (:81), which calls _f_clinical_kwargs("r1") as bound in the box module's own namespace (:40–48, :57). - Every assertion in both bodies is a function of kw and the returned diag, not of a 1.5 T literal: - (R) u = R from kw (:164, :197–198); - (L) from kw (:200–203, :233–234); - (S) / (S′) from diag (:166–167, :227–232, :264–266); - (A) from the layout (:169); - (U) from E and F (:276–283); - the box module's (T2) / (B) / (V) from kw / diag (box :99–106, :159–173). - What depends on 1.5 T values is print-only: PREDICTED_* (build :74–77), the census letter (:40), the body's U₁-based PRICE line (:342–344), and the box (A0) against the 1.5 T record (box :192, :219–222). - The "geometry knob" is that kwargs provider. The new 3 T tests swap it for the 3 T table with monkeypatch.setattr and call the 1.5 T bodies unchanged. - That is literally "through the 1.5 T generator". - The 1.5 T path is bitwise by construction: git diff --stat shows one new test module plus record files. - Entry 40 (10-21) runs test_geo38_f_clinical_column.py, which imports _f_clinical_kwargs and the records from the build module (test_geo38_f_clinical_column.py:145–147, :348–354). Nothing it imports moves. - Alternative, for the review (not this brief): an additive fixture= argument on _f_clinical_kwargs / _box_kwargs, with an env read in the bodies. It edits lines in the module entry 40 imports three days before entry 40 runs. Its bitwise proof is a 1.5 T r1 re-gate window, 323–524 s measured at -n 2. See ruling (g).

Code. One new file, tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_3t.py; edit nothing else. No src/, no 1.5 T module, no example, no xl-pending.md. - Imports. import tests.validation.test_geo38_f_clinical_build as s1a and import tests.validation.test_geo38_f_clinical_box as s2. Import module objects only, never from … import test_*: pytest would collect an imported 1.5 T test function into this module and run its 1.5 T build. - Constants: - C8_ENV = "FEM_EM_GEO38_C8", with values in {r1, r2, box}; - the table and the five constants above; - GMSH_STOP_S = 450.0, STOP_RULE_RC = 86; - the predictions above, as dicts in the shape of PREDICTED_CELLS / PREDICTED_BUILD_S / PREDICTED_U1 / PREDICTED_U2; - F_CLINICAL_15T_FROZEN, a literal copy of the 1.5 T table as of d94320db (test_geo38_f_clinical_build.py:44–64). (K0) asserts the live table still equals it, so the derived 3 T table cannot move silently if someone edits the 1.5 T one. - _f_clinical_3t_kwargs(rung) returns dict(F_CLINICAL_3T_KWARGS, conductor_resolution=s1a.CONDUCTOR_RESOLUTION[rung]). - _GmshStopRule(stop_s, label, action=None) — the stop rule's implementation, gmsh-side. A context manager, active on rank 0 only. - It wraps gmsh.model.mesh.generate and gmsh.model.mesh.optimize, set with the test's monkeypatch so they are restored on exit. - A threading.Timer(stop_s) starts on entry to generate and is cancelled when optimize returns. That is exactly the interval io/mesh.py:6917–6920 reports as mesh wall time, the quantity every price above cites. - The default action prints one flushed line, [GEO-38 C8] GMSH STOP RULE: gmsh > 450 s (3T, <selector>, -n <w>; generate entered at t=<s> after test start; /proc/loadavg <…>) — price recorded as a lower bound; the build goes to the weekly's xl list, then calls MPI.COMM_WORLD.Abort(STOP_RULE_RC). The other ranks are blocked in the collective bcast at io/mesh.py:4898, and Abort tears them down. - Why it can fire mid-mesh: gmsh's Python API calls into a ctypes.CDLL, which releases the GIL during the call. (SR0) proves this on the image before any window relies on it. - The container timeout -k 30 590 stays as the backstop. - The recording domain. monkeypatch.setattr(MeshGenerator, "birdcage_port_domain", staticmethod(wrapper)). The wrapper: - prints a flushed build start t=… line; - enters _GmshStopRule around the original call; - stores the returned diag and the global cell count in a module dict; - prints build done <s>; gmsh <diag mesh_wall_time_s>. - The bodies import MeshGenerator inside the function and call the class attribute (test_geo38_f_clinical_build.py:138–154, box :73, :87–88), so they see the wrapper. - test_geo38_c8_3t_identities(monkeypatch) runs when FEM_EM_GEO38_C8 ∈ {r1, r2} and skips otherwise. It: 1. calls monkeypatch.setenv(s1a.STEP1A_ENV, rung); 2. calls monkeypatch.setattr(s1a, "_f_clinical_kwargs", lambda r: _f_clinical_3t_kwargs(r)); 3. patches s1a.PREDICTED_CELLS, PREDICTED_BUILD_S, PREDICTED_U1 and PREDICTED_U2 to the 3 T dicts, so the body's prints carry the 3 T predictions; 4. installs the recording domain; 5. calls s1a.test_geo38_step1a_f_clinical_identities(); 6. asserts the 3 T table identities (anchors) and prints the brief-ρ projection. - test_geo38_c8_3t_box_gates(monkeypatch) runs when FEM_EM_GEO38_C8=box. It calls monkeypatch.setenv(s2.STEP2_ENV, "1") and monkeypatch.setattr(s2, "_f_clinical_kwargs", lambda r: _f_clinical_3t_kwargs(r)), installs the recording domain, calls s2.test_geo38_step2_astm_box_mesh_gates(), then asserts the table identities. - Coding tests (K0)–(K3) and (SR0) skip whenever FEM_EM_GEO38_C8 is set, so W1–W3 run only their gated test and no stray gmsh session precedes the big build. - Records. After the last window, register F_CLINICAL_3T_R1_CELL_RECORD, F_CLINICAL_3T_R2_CELL_RECORD, F_CLINICAL_3T_R1_UNKNOWNS_RECORD, F_CLINICAL_3T_R2_UNKNOWNS_RECORD and F_CLINICAL_3T_BOX_CELL_RECORD. They are version-tagged under the (1*) licence, each commented with its log. The windowed path never reads them. Disclose this under rule (i), as item 478 did (GEO-38.md:451).

Anchors (asserted). - Inside the 1.5 T bodies, unchanged, at their bands. - C1 (a): - (R) ≤ STRIP_BAND 1e-9 (tests/validation/test_ops61_exact_strip_ports.py:58); - (L), (S), (S′) and (N) at IDENTITY_BAND 1e-9 (test_geo38_f_clinical_build.py:39); - (A) ≤ SHEET_AREA_BAND 1e-9 (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_leg_offset.py:104); - (C) N_ports = 2·N_legs = 64; - (U) U₁ = E and U₂ = 2E + 2F, exact; - the (S) trap check: cavity max < R_s, and tag 1 = exterior ∖ cavity; - corner clearance ≥ 5 mm (:349–381). - C2: - (T1) owned facets = N_gmsh on 64/64 sheets; - (T2), (B1), (B2) and (V1) at STRIP_BAND; - (V2) at CAD_ANALYTIC_BAND 1e-7 (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_conductor_hole.py:123); - (K) (box :232–251). - Added after the body returns: the 3 T table. These read the recorded diag, which the body has just tied to the mesh, plus kw. Each holds at IDENTITY_BAND: - 2·diag["shield_radius_m"] = 0.743 — the body's (S) ties the lateral mesh to R_s; - diag["shield_length_m"] = 0.70 — the generator's own 2·z_extent (io/mesh.py:6959–6962); the body's (S) ties the meshed outer max|z| to it; - 2·kw["ring_radius"] = 0.704 — tied to the sheets by (R); - kw["leg_spacing"] = 0.58 — tied to the sheet z-mids by (L); - the leg count 32 and the census 64, as the body reads them. - Also diag["leg_box_corner_radius_m"] = the closed form 0.363814913104 m at 1e-12; this is the refusal's arithmetic (io/mesh.py:4966–4969). - Box test only: diag["phantom_box"]["size_m"] = (0.42, 0.09, 0.65) exactly. - (K0), coding: - every derived value above is re-derived and printed, z_e == 0.35 exactly; - every key absent from the overrides equals the 1.5 T value; - s1a.F_CLINICAL_15T_KWARGS == F_CLINICAL_15T_FROZEN; - the selector rejects anything outside {r1, r2, box} with ValueError. - (K1) The 3 T table passes every pre-gmsh check. With the builder replaced by item 478's tripwire (s1a._refuse_before_gmsh, test_geo38_f_clinical_build.py:384–393), pytest.raises(AssertionError, match="reached the gmsh builder") holds. Reaching the builder means no refusal fired.

Negative controls. - (K2), asserted. The 3 T table with attempt 1's port_box_size (ATTEMPT1_PORT_BOX_SIZE, :68) is refused before gmsh with "leg-box corner": its corner 0.371859916 m + 1 mm > R_s 0.3715 (computed). Item 478's refusal smoke measured the same comparison on the 1.5 T fixture (20261015T170242Z_GEO-38-s1a-a2-refusal.log), so per rule (e) this is asserted, not predicted. - (K3), asserted by construction. shield_radius 0.3645 (< shield_need 0.364815) is refused; 0.3650 reaches the tripwire. - (SR0), asserted: the watchdog fires inside gmsh. - On rank 0 at -n 1, build a bare gmsh unit cube with Mesh.MeshSizeMax 0.03. Its generate(3) time (≈ 1–3 s) is printed. - _GmshStopRule(0.25, action=record) must record a fire while generate is still in flight (a flag set by the wrapper around the original call). - _GmshStopRule(600, …) must record no fire and leave no timer thread (threading.active_count() back to its baseline). - Call gmsh.finalize() in a finally. The control is binary, with no ceiling. - If generate returns in < 0.25 s, the test fails as inconclusive. The fix is a denser mesh, never a different stop. - The bodies' own (c1) planted dropped facet stays asserted at both widths (test_geo38_f_clinical_build.py:285–292, :349–350; box :178–186, :233–235). - Predicted, printed only (rule (e)): - cells, gmsh time, RSS, and U₁ / U₂ beside the 3 T predictions; - the box module's (A0) line compares against the 1.5 T record (box :219–222), so it reads ≈ +16 % "outside". That is expected and meaningless for 3 T, and the journal sets W3's cells beside W1's.

Windows. Each runs in the foreground with Bash timeout: 660000, pytest with -s, never -k. The harness call is the whole Bash command. Before every window: 1. docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 must read 0; 2. docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver cat /proc/loadavg — copy it into the journal beside that window's gmsh time.

  • W0 (smoke, -n 1). Expected: the 3 T module 5 passed / 2 skipped, the build module 2 passed / 1 skipped, the box module 1 skipped. scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-38-C8-W0 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && unset FEM_EM_GEO38_C8 FEM_EM_GEO38_STEP1A FEM_EM_GEO38_STEP2 && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 60 python3 -m pytest tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_3t.py tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_build.py tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_box.py -v -s --tb=short'"
  • W1 (r1, the stand-in cylinder, -n 2). Expected: 1 passed, 6 skipped. scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-38-C8-W1-r1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_GEO38_C8=r1 timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_3t.py -s -v --tb=short > /workspace/logs/geo38-c8-w1-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/geo38-c8-w1-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/geo38-c8-w1-raw.log; exit \$rc'"
  • W2 (r2, -n 2): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-38-C8-W2-r2 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_GEO38_C8=r2 timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_3t.py -s -v --tb=short > /workspace/logs/geo38-c8-w2-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/geo38-c8-w2-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/geo38-c8-w2-raw.log; exit \$rc'"
  • W3 (the ASTM box, -n 4; skipped if W1's stop rule fired): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-38-C8-W3-box-n4 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_GEO38_C8=box timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 4 python3 -m pytest tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_3t.py -s -v --tb=short > /workspace/logs/geo38-c8-w3-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/geo38-c8-w3-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/geo38-c8-w3-raw.log; exit \$rc'"
  • Pre-registered fallback if (SR0) is red (the timer cannot fire inside gmsh on this image):
  • Run W1–W3 with container timeout -k 30 500 in place of 590. The 500 s is the 450 s rule plus the measured non-gmsh share of the build (28 s on 478 W1: 323.3 − 295.1) plus pytest start-up.
  • A stop then reads as Status 124 at ≈ 500 s with the last [birdcage-mesh] line before generation, and is recorded the same way as a lower bound.
  • Say so in the journal. Do not edit the watchdog in-slot.
  • Rule (i): no module edit after W0 starts, except the record constants after the last window.

Traps already paid for. - Never put a 1.5 T module on the pytest path in W1–W3, and never set FEM_EM_GEO38_STEP1A / FEM_EM_GEO38_STEP2 on the command line. The 1.5 T bodies would then also run on the 1.5 T table: a second r1 build in the same 590 s window, and a certain kill. The 3 T tests set those variables with monkeypatch.setenv, and teardown restores them. - Patch the box module's own binding. s2._f_clinical_kwargs is bound by name at import (test_geo38_f_clinical_box.py:40–48). Patching only s1a leaves the box test building the 1.5 T box. The added diag identities (Ø 0.743, length 0.70) would catch it, but only after a wasted 6-minute window. - The never-timed build is this item's reason to exist (epitaph). A stop-rule line is the price, never a failure, and it is never retried in heavy. - gmsh is serial on rank 0. Host load added 160 s to C2's -n 2 build at 13:41 (GEO-38.md:401). Read every gmsh time beside its loadavg. - Rank safety. The bodies already reduce. The added identities read kw and diag, and diag is broadcast and identical on every rank (io/mesh.py:4942–4945). Never use UFL dS over the sheets (GEO-37.md:41). - The orphan check. After a stop or a kill, run pgrep -c python3 first. A build-only window compiles no form, so the rubric-4 cache sweep (<ID>-cache-sweep) is needed only if a log shows a JIT compile was interrupted. - pgrep -f "python3 -m pytest" is denied by the bash guard. Use pgrep -c python3. - Never tune the table in-slot. A refusal before gmsh on the 3 T table means the table and the formula disagree: report it (GEO-38.md:241, :440). - Durable capture ends in ; exit \$rc. No pipe. Never delete a log. Two heavy windows never run at once.

Scope. The geometry and build price of the 3 T twin, real image, no solve. - Not claimed: - any 3 T solve, port gate, S-matrix, tuning or 128 MHz resonance; - a scanner model — the MRM and Skyra sources are nominal-geometry sources only; - the closed can as the physical shield (a modelling choice; its caps 25 mm from the box ends are part of that choice, ruling (c)); - C2's box gates at -n 1 / -n 2 (ruling (a)).

Negative result. Report and stop. Where the item is neither done nor runnable, park on attempt/GEO-38-<UTC> and mark item 518 BLOCKED in the same commit (rule (d)). - The stop-rule line in W1. This is the price, not a red. - Commit W0 and W2 as records. - The §7 row and §10 C8 gain "3 T r1 build: gmsh > 450 s at loadavg <…> ()". - Mark item 518 STOPPED (priced), with the unblock "the weekly's xl window for the 3 T r1 and box builds". Implementers never commission one. - Item 527 runs on the priced record. - (K1) red. The table is refused before gmsh: report the refusal message. - An (R) or (S) identity miss above 1e-9 that gmsh's projected nodes cannot meet on the 3 T cylinders is a rule (f) case. Re-register by measurement on the same quantity and flag it; never widen silently. - The (S) trap red (cavity max ≥ R_s) contradicts the 7.7 mm closed-form clearance: a geometry finding, BLOCKED with the reading. - (T1) ≠ N_gmsh at -n 4 only is GEO-37's failure mode on the production twin: a known-issues entry and BLOCKED. - Status 124 at 590 s with no STOP line is not a result. Run pgrep, then park with the measured time.

There is no PREDICTED RED: line, so a red anywhere other than the stop rule stops the slot.

Status it can move. No glyph. GEO-38's Done-when is the 1.5 T probe (PROJECT_PLAN.md:1927), so rule (j) writes no "→ ✅". - On green, the §7 row gains: "3 T twin record (§9 item 518, C8): F-clinical-3T (rung Ø 0.704 m, shield Ø 0.743 m × 0.70 m, rung length 0.58 m) through the 1.5 T test bodies with the 3 T kwargs table, no 1.5 T or src/ file edited; C1 (a)'s identities at r1 / r2 at -n 2 and C2's gates at -n 4 green; cells r1 / r2 / box ; U₁ / U₂ <…>; gmsh at loadavg <…> (, , logs)." - The records are registered, §10 C8 gains a DONE line, and item 527 (C9) is unblocked.

Execution order. Code → W0 → pre-checks → W1 → pre-checks → W2 → pre-checks → W3 → record constants → commit (the module, harness logs, the §7 sentence, the §10 DONE line) → journal.

Spawn line (if delegated): "Use the implementer agent to execute GEO-38 §9 item 518 (C8) per docs/planning/chunks/GEO-38.md (read the brief and any review ruling beneath it first). Run it only in a 12:00 / 13:30 / 15:00 local slot. The harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, repo-relative, nothing chained or piped. Run W0, W1, W2, W3 in order, in the foreground, with timeout: 660000, pytest with -s, and container timeout -k 30. Before each, run docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 (it must read 0) and docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver cat /proc/loadavg. Create only tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_3t.py; edit no 1.5 T module, no src/ file and no example. A gmsh STOP RULE line is the price: commit what ran and mark the item STOPPED (priced), never retry. You are the executor: do not spawn agents, and never background a harness window. If the docker socket is denied, stop and report the exact command string."

Outcome (2026-10-18 12:00 slot): DONE, attempt 1 of 4. One new file, tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_3t.py; no 1.5 T module and no src/ file edited (git diff --stat: the module plus logs and docs). - Rung length, ruling (b): the chosen parameter is coil_length = 0.58 m (the leg span, tied by the body's (L) to the cavity wall's max z). leg_spacing = 0.5157142858 m keeps the 1.5 T absolute overhang. This departs from the brief's table (which put 0.58 on leg_spacing), as ruling (b) directs. So z_need = 0.325 (phantom), air_padding 0.025, z_e = 0.35 exactly. Cap clearances: phantom ends 25.00 mm (ruling (c)), leg ends 60.00 mm, ring tubes 88.14 mm. - W0 (20261018T170218Z_GEO-38-C8-W0.log) was red on (SR0)'s second sub-case only. The cause was in the test: the 0.25 s rule's monkeypatch was still stacked under the 600 s rule, so it re-armed its own timer. Fixed with a fresh MonkeyPatch.context() per rule before any build window ran. W0b green, 7 passed / 4 skipped, 42 s (20261018T170322Z_GEO-38-C8-W0b.log). (SR0): unit-cube generate(3) 4.43 s, the watchdog fired inside it. (K2): leg-box corner 0.371859916 m refused. (K3): 0.3645 refused, 0.3650 reaches the builder. - W1 r1 -n 2, 318 s (20261018T170415Z_GEO-38-C8-W1-r1.log): 1 057 895 cells, below the predicted [1.15, 1.55] M (the prediction assumed the longer 0.644 m leg span). Build 312.7 s, gmsh 286.5 s at loadavg 0.96, RSS 2.068 GiB. (R) 6.7e-16; (L) 0; (S) 2.2e-16, cavity max hypot 0.358 < R_s; (S′) corner 0.363814913104 exact, 7.6851 mm clearance; (N) 32; (A) 3.6e-15; (C) 64; U₁ 1 425 765, U₂ 7 335 988 exact; (c1) 5.9e-3 > band. 3 T table: Ø 0.743 / 0.70 / Ø 0.704 / 0.58 exact, corner vs closed form 1.6e-13. Brief-ρ projection (ρ = cells/369 387 = 2.864): t_b + 694.8 s, 216.1 GiB (× ρ^(4/3): 363.2 GiB); the body's U₁-based line reads ρ 3.860, t_b + 892.8 s, 277.7 GiB. - W2 r2 -n 2, 239 s (20261018T170953Z_GEO-38-C8-W2-r2.log): 808 126 cells (r2/r1 0.764). gmsh 212.4 s at loadavg 1.90. U₁ 1 062 903, U₂ 5 518 344. Every identity is green, at the same levels as W1. - W3 box -n 4, 316 s (20261018T171406Z_GEO-38-C8-W3-box-n4.log): 1 061 517 cells (+0.34 % on W1). gmsh 289.4 s at loadavg 1.83, RSS 2.516 GiB. (T1) 64/64 sheets, 2 886 triangles; (T2) ≤ 6.2e-15; (B1) 0; (B2) 0; (V1) 8.46e-11; (V2) 0; (K) none; (c1) green. (A0) against the 1.5 T record reads 7.5 % "outside", which is meaningless at 3 T, as the brief predicted. - The gmsh stop rule never fired. The 3 T build is cheaper than the 1.5 T one at the same rung: shorter legs and a smaller can. - Records were registered after W3 under (1*): F_CLINICAL_3T_{R1,R2}_CELL_RECORD, …_UNKNOWNS_RECORD, F_CLINICAL_3T_BOX_CELL_RECORD. - Owed: C8b, the box at -n 1 / 2 (ruling (a)). Item 527 (C9) is unblocked.

docs.title: §9 item 519 — 2026-10-18 (§10 C3a, the 64×64 sweep module; lane 1 → standard, build-only)
docs.text:
Outcome (2026-10-18 13:30 slot): DONE. W0 (-n 1) 10 passed / 3 skipped, the column module 0 passed / 2 skipped (20261018T183335Z_GEO-38-C3a-W0.log); K1 34 classes / 4 096 pairs, residual 0; K2 reciprocity 0, spread 0; N1 residual 11.25° exactly; N2 controlled ratio 1.680e-3 = 1.68× band (ceiling 1.768e-3); N3 63 specs fail (C). W1 build-only -n 2 green in 335 s (20261018T183353Z_GEO-38-C3a-W1-build.log, loadavg 0.38 before): t_build 332.4 s (predicted 340–560), summed RSS 2.00 GiB (1.51 / 0.48); (A0) 1 147 366 rel 0; (S) 0.361 < 0.3725 m; (C) 64 specs P33…P96, 44–46 owned facets per sheet; (W) worst rel 2.665e-15; (Az) slot residual 5.7e-14°, 34 classes with the stated sizes; (U1) 1 525 193 exact; save path absent. Entry 44 (i) MET.

Licence. §9 rule (5) lane 1 (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4890–4893; lane list :4905–4906). - This item is xl-pending.md entry 44's prerequisite (i) (docs/testing/xl-pending.md:2041): "the 64×64 sweep module on F-clinical (PORT-13's route with PORT-19 reuse, a FEM_EM_GEO38_C3 knob), asserting the port census (64) and the degree-1 unknown count build-only at -n 2". - The module is the code entry 44 runs (xxl Saturday 10-24), which is also PENDING entry 40's price. - The implementer marks (i) MET and does not write the command; the 10-22 03:00 review writes it (:2041). - No band, tolerance or target is set; every band is imported.

GEO-38 C3a: the F-clinical 64×64 copper sweep module — PORT-13's ring-port sweep with PORT-19's held factor, transposed from WF-12 step 2's copper 32×32 — coded, coding-tested, and proved build-only at -n 2: port census 64, sheet widths exact, and U₁ = 1 525 193 exactly. - Executor: implementer. - Tier: heavy by ceiling, not standard (defect 6). The build-only proof builds r1 in memory. That build measured 323.3 s at -n 2 in a quiet hour (478 W1) and 523.6 s under load (C2 W2, the same mesh with the box), so it cannot fit the 180 s standard ceiling. - W0 smoke, -n 1, ≤ 60 s. - W1 -n 2, complex image: predicted 340–560 s (the build plus ≈ 15–25 s for the census, sheet geometry and function space), summed RSS ≈ 2.0–2.5 GiB. - Slots: 12:00, 13:30 or 15:00 local only. Any other slot skips this item and takes the next. Never in the slot that runs item 518 or I31 attempt 2. - Class: lane 1, as the weekly labelled it. Cost: ≈ 3.5 measured (lane-1 median) / ≈ 25 predicted slot-minutes: code ≈ 10, W0 ≈ 1, W1 6–9, commit and journal ≈ 5. - The lane-1 median does not describe a six-to-nine-minute build window; chain no-solve's 18.6 is the closer median (ruling (d)). - If W1 has not started by minute 30, park (rule (d)). - Depends on: nothing in §9. On main: tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_column.py, lifted by item 494 (20261016T093031Z_GEO-38-c1b-lift-W1-census.log, 20261016T093044Z_GEO-38-c1b-lift-W2-imports.log). - Fallback. If W1 is killed at its ceiling, (i) stays open and entry 44 stays PENDING. The review may rule that entry 44's own window serves as the build proof, since the full branch asserts (C) and (U1) before its first drive. That is the review's call, not the slot's. - Family: GEO-38 C3 sweep module, attempt 1 of 4. This is not C1 (b)'s family, which is at 2 of 4.

What exists. - The fixture and the two-drive loop: test_geo38_f_clinical_column.py (519 lines). - _build_f_clinical(comm) (:141–154) builds r1 from _f_clinical_kwargs("r1") and returns ctx, facets, cells, shield_radius_m and outer_census. Its ctx holds the 64 specs at TERMINATED_PORT_IMPEDANCE_OHM, the PEC can through _outer_box_tags, and TimeHarmonicSolver(problem, degree=DEGREE). - _context_from_mesh (:95–138) computes the sheet widths as area/chord (:90–91, :118). - Its fixture asserts are at :386–404. - The _drive closure (:413–475) puts the Leontovich wall first and holds the factor for P34. - It has two drives only: no matrix, no classes, no save. - The template: WF-12 step 2, the copper 32×32 (tests/validation/test_wf12_f_human_copper_matrix.py:86–382). - One factorising drive, then held drives (:228–234, asserted at :273). - (ii) _reciprocity_ratio (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_ring_column.py:776–777) ≤ RECIPROCITY_BAND. - (iii) σ_max and every column Σ|S|² ≤ MATRIX_PASSIVITY_CEILING. - (iv′) classes from the measured sheet azimuth and z (:291–309). - The 1.01 column-scale control, printed (:286–288, :331–333). - Measured on F-human copper (WF-12.md:142, :328): reciprocity 9.17e-15, σ_max 0.9999933, worst class spread 3.27 % ≤ OPPOSITE_SPREAD_BAND. - F-human constants that must not be imported for 32 legs. - AZIMUTH_STEP_DEG = 360/SCALED_LEG_COUNT, N_AZIMUTH_CLASSES and N_SYMMETRY_CLASSES (= 18) all derive from SCALED_LEG_COUNT = 16 (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_ring_matrix.py:185–187, tests/mesh/test_birdcage_port_scaleup.py:89). So _azimuth_class (:206–215) is F-human's. - MATRIX_CONTROL_MARGIN 2.0 (:180) was 32-port arithmetic and is unreachable on 64 ports (negative controls). - _ring_gap_frame(i, 32)'s centre uses the 4-leg module's RING_RADIUS / LEG_SPACING (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_ring_gaps_scaleup.py:136–157). Only its φ̂ is valid here, and φ̂ is all the column module uses (:112). - The unknown count without assembly: TimeHarmonicSolver.function_space() (src/fem_em_solver/core/time_harmonic.py:334–338). - C10's consumer of the saved matrix: ring_mode_rows (src/fem_em_solver/ports/ring_modes.py:164).

Code. One new file, tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_matrix.py; edit nothing else. - In particular, never edit test_geo38_f_clinical_column.py. It is entry 40's queued module (docs/testing/xl-queue.d/20261021-GEO-38-step1b-C1b.env), and it runs on 10-21 against its readout as written (xl-pending.md:1927–1931). - Do not edit the build module, src/, or entry 44's text beyond its status line. - Knobs. - C3_ENV = "FEM_EM_GEO38_C3": unset ⇒ skip; build ⇒ the build-only test; 1 ⇒ the full sweep (entry 44 only); anything else ⇒ ValueError. - Optional C3_DRIVES_ENV = "FEM_EM_GEO38_C3_DRIVES" (1..64, WF-12's _knobs pattern, :77–83): below 64, the matrix gates print SKIPPED. - Counts derived from LEG_COUNT (not bands): AZIMUTH_STEP_32_DEG = 360/LEG_COUNT = 11.25, N_AZIMUTH_CLASSES_32 = LEG_COUNT // 2 + 1 = 17, N_SYMMETRY_CLASSES_32 = 34. - _azimuth_class_32(az_i, az_j) is the fold of :206–215 with the 11.25° step. - Expected class sizes over the 64 × 64 ordered pairs: (same ring, 0) 64, (same, 1…15) 128 each, (same, 16) 64, and likewise for the other ring; 4 096 in total. - _sheet_geometry(ctx, comm) measures each sheet's centroid azimuth (degrees) and z from the owned facets of ctx["tags_f"], gathered once with s1a._facet_coords / s1a._owned. - _run_c3(comm, *, build_only, n_drives=64). - Fixture: the column module's _build_f_clinical(comm), imported. This is entry 40's in-memory route, so entry 40's measured t_b, t_col and t_held price entry 44 directly. - Then (A0), (iv), the outer census and (S), as the column module asserts them (:386–404); then (C), (W), (Az) and (U1) below. - build_only returns here, printing t_build and summed RSS. It returns before the Leontovich wall term and before any assembly or factorisation. - The full branch (never run by this item) is WF-12 step 2's Cu drive loop and matrix block (:164–345), transposed: - P33 factorises and P34…P96 are held; kinds are asserted as 1 solve / 63 held; - per drive: (P) ≤ DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL, P_surf > 0, and a binary NEG; - (ii), (iii), and (iv′) on the 34 classes; - the 1.01 control, printed; - no PEC column (entry 44's readout names none and its price excludes one); - it saves logs/geo38/c3-cu-s64-d1.npz with s64 (complex128), order (P33…P96), azimuth_deg, z_m, cells and n_ranks; - a PRICE line (t_b, t_col, mean and max held cadence, RSS) printed beside entry 40's. - Coding tests (K0)–(K2), N1 and N2 (numpy only) skip when FEM_EM_GEO38_C3 is set.

Anchors (asserted in W1 at -n 2; owned entities, reduced). - (A0) cells = F_CLINICAL_R1_CELL_RECORD 1 147 366 within CELL_COUNT_BAND 0.01 (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_port_sheet_prerequisite.py:57). Predicted rel 0: item 469 read rel 0 at -n 8 (GEO-38.md:332). - (iv) / (S) as in the column module. - (C) census: - 64 specs whose ids are exactly P33…P96 (s1a._ring_ports()); - each sheet has > 0 owned facets after reduction; - 64 = 2·LEG_COUNT. - (W) widths. Every spec's sheet_width_m = 2·r_ring + 2·c = 0.010 m at STRIP_BAND. Here r_ring is from _f_clinical_kwargs("r1") and c is the generator default port_clearance 1e-3 (io/mesh.py:4255, :4831). These are exact rectangles: C2's (T2) area read 2.4e-15. - (Az) measured layout. - Sheet azimuths = (j + ½)·11.25° and the z sign follows the ring, with residual < AZIMUTH_MATCH_DEG 1e-6 (test_port_birdcage_ring_column.py:158). - The measured 64 × 64 pair table has exactly 34 classes with the sizes above. - (U1) ctx["solver"].function_space()'s global size × bs = E_global = F_CLINICAL_R1_UNKNOWNS_RECORD[0] 1 525 193, exactly (test_geo38_f_clinical_build.py:89; 478 W1). - The save path does not exist after the build-only call. - (K0) knob parsing: unset, build, 1, "2", "x", and the drives bounds. - (K1) On the ideal 64-port layout, _azimuth_class_32 gives 34 classes with the stated sizes and residual ≤ 1e-12. - (K2) The matrix gates on a synthetic reciprocal, C32 × mirror-symmetric 64×64, S_ij = f(ring relation, steps): - reciprocity ratio ≤ 1e-15; - every class spread 0; - σ_max printed.

Negative controls. - (N1), asserted by construction. F-human's _azimuth_class (the 22.5° step) applied to the 32-leg azimuths returns residual 11.25° on odd separations, far above AZIMUTH_MATCH_DEG. This catches the import trap. The ceiling is exactly 11.25°. - (N2), asserted. The synthetic matrix with one column × CONTROL_COLUMN_SCALE 1.01 (test_port_birdcage_ring_column.py:180) lifts the reciprocity ratio above RECIPROCITY_BAND 1e-3 (tests/validation/test_port_lumped_sheet_sweep.py:86). - Ceiling, computed first: for equal-norm columns, ≈ 0.01·√2/√64 = 1.77e-3, i.e. 1.77× the band. So a binary "> band" is reachable and MATRIX_CONTROL_MARGIN's 2× is not. - In the full branch the control is printed, predicted (rule (e): no measurement of it exists on this fixture). - (N3), asserted. (C) on a copy of the spec list with P96 removed reads 63 and fails.

Band reconciliation for entry 44 (defect 7, ruling (e)). Entry 44's readout (xl-pending.md:2047) names PASSIVITY_SIGMA_TOLERANCE (1e-9 over 1; tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_four_port.py:129) and ADJACENT_SPREAD_BAND 0.005 (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_lumped_column.py:121). - The template gates at MATRIX_PASSIVITY_CEILING 1.0 (test_port_birdcage_ring_matrix.py:150) and OPPOSITE_SPREAD_BAND 0.05 (test_port_birdcage_ring_column.py:154). - On the F-human copper hole mesh the worst class spread measured 3.27 %, which is 6.5× ADJACENT_SPREAD_BAND. - This module imports the template's two bands and prints the worst spread against ADJACENT_SPREAD_BAND beside them, never asserting it. - If the review rules for ADJACENT_SPREAD_BAND, the 10-22 review writes PREDICTED RED: (iv′) range [0.02, 0.06] into entry 44.

Windows. Each runs in the foreground with Bash timeout: 660000, pytest with -s, never -k. The harness call is the whole Bash command. Before each window, docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 must read 0; then record docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver cat /proc/loadavg. - W0 (smoke, -n 1, complex). Expected: the new module's coding tests pass and its gated tests skip. Editing it after that example's last window is a rule (i) case, which means re-running the example (324 s heavy; :110–112), and that guide is the example lane's to own. The can is 0.954285714 m long (2·z_extent; 20261015T171259Z_GEO-38-s1a-W2-r2-a2.log, GEO-38.md:450); 0.745 m is its diameter. - Its :19–22 "pending the weekly's ratification" is stale: the 10-17 weekly ratified those choices (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4689–4696). - This page states the right values. The page (docs/guide/clinical_coil_fixtures.md, Markdown, no tagged code block). Write "≈", never ~, and "the human operator", never a name. It quotes no AED figure; none applies. 1. What the two fixtures are. These are nominal clinical body-coil geometries, not scanner models. F-clinical is the production fixture for new human-scale work, and the Phase 6 exit stays on F-human (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4287–4322). 2. Geometry, one table with a 1.5 T column and a 3 T column. Row labels are fixed, because the test reads them: - frequency; legs; ring-gap sheets (port census); - rung (conductor) diameter; RF shield diameter; shield (can) length; rung length (ring-centreline separation); leg span; - ring gap (arc); leg width / ring tube radius; leg-box section; leg-box corner clearance to the can; - load (the ASTM F2182 box, 650 × 420 × 90 mm, 650 mm on the axis, centred; C1's stand-in cylinder 0.10969 m × 0.65 m, volume-matched); - sizing rungs (resolution, conductor_resolution r1 / r2); - cells r1 / r2 (records); U₁ / U₂ at r1 (records); gmsh at r1 (measured, with log and local time). - The 1.5 T measured rows come from C1 (a) and C2 (the logs above); the 3 T rows from item 518's. 3. The 2026-10-15 rulings. - The human operator's port-census ruling: 32 legs ⇒ 64 sheets and a 64×64; tuning and SAR by two ports in quadrature with series-RC sheets at 0.2 Ω; 16 legs rejected (GEO-38.md:45–55). - The 03:00 review's provisional choices (:412–417): rung length = ring-centreline separation; the closed PEC can; F-human's absolute conductor sizing; the volume-matched stand-in; leg-box dy 4 mm. - The 10:30 corner ruling (:419–430): dx 4 mm, the ≥ 5 mm corner clearance, the corner refusal, and the leg_gap_length refusal. - All ratified by the 10-17 weekly (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4689–4696). - The 18:00 ruling (:555–561) concerns the cache, not geometry. Name it as such. - Add item 518's rulings (b) and (c) as the review ruled them. 5. How it is built. Prose plus a text block naming F_CLINICAL_15T_KWARGS (tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_build.py), F_CLINICAL_3T_KWARGS (tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_3t.py), MeshGenerator.birdcage_port_domain's shield_radius / phantom_box, and the gate modules. Link ../../examples/meshing/15_f_clinical_coil_astm_box.md as a relative link. 6. Not claimed. A port gate, S-matrix, tuning, resonance, B₁⁺, SAR, a scanner model or ASTM compliance; the closed can as the physical shield. 7. Erratum. The can length (above), with its log.

Code. - The page. - One new test, tests/package/test_geo38_clinical_fixture_page.py (ungated, no dolfinx import beyond what the two modules import at module level). - Edit nothing else. The mesh:15 guide, PROJECT_PLAN.md §9 and docs/guide/validation.md are not touched.

Expected: 1 passed, 6 skipped. scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-38-C8b-W1-box-n1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_GEO38_C8=box timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 1 python3 -m pytest tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_3t.py -s -v --tb=short > /workspace/logs/geo38-c8b-w1-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/geo38-c8b-w1-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/geo38-c8b-w1-raw.log; exit \$rc'"

Traps already paid for. - Never put a 1.5 T module on the pytest path, and never set FEM_EM_GEO38_STEP1A / FEM_EM_GEO38_STEP2 on the command line — the 1.5 T body would also build the 1.5 T box in the same 590 s window (item 518 brief, traps). The 3 T test sets STEP2 itself via monkeypatch. - A STOP RULE line is the price, never a failure, never retried in heavy. It reads as Status 86 with the [GEO-38 C8] GMSH STOP RULE: line; Status 124 at 590 s with no STOP line is not a result. - gmsh is serial on rank 0; host load added 160 s to the 1.5 T -n 2 box build (GEO-38.md:401). Read every gmsh time beside its loadavg. Never run beside the 02:00 xl / xxl window or another heavy build. - After a stop or kill, pgrep -c python3 first. pgrep -f "python3 -m pytest" is denied by the bash guard. A build-only window compiles no form; the cache sweep is needed only if a log shows an interrupted JIT compile. - Durable capture ends in ; exit \$rc; no pipe; never delete a log.

Scope. C2's box gates on the 3 T twin at the two remaining widths; build-only, real image. Not claimed: any 3 T solve, port gate, S-matrix, tuning or 128 MHz resonance; a scanner model; the closed can as the physical shield; anything about xl entry 40 or C3.

Report and stop; journal in attempts.md. - Stop rule fires in W1 or W2: commit the logs; the §7 sentence and §10 C8 gain "3 T box -n <w>: gmsh > 450 s at loadavg <…> ()"; mark item 538 STOPPED (priced) with the unblock "the review re-poses the width or sends it to the weekly's xl list". There is no PREDICTED RED: line, so a red anywhere other than the stop rule stops the slot.

A gmsh STOP RULE line is the price: commit what ran and mark the item STOPPED (priced), never retry. If W2 has not started by minute 40, commit W1 and mark W2 OPEN.
