docs.title: §9 item 561 — 2026-10-20 (§10 C4a, lane 1 → heavy by ceiling; build-only)
docs.text:
Drafted read-only for the 2026-10-20 03:00 daily review; the review rules on it.

Licence. §10 C4a (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4903–4908, the 2026-10-19 weekly): "The in-model Larmor root module on F-clinical-1.5T in H26a's pattern (the ESR series-RC sheet on the 64 gaps, the two-port feed on the bisector, a FEM_EM_GEO38_C4 knob with a node list and the degree knob), build-only asserting the port census 64 and U₁ = 1 525 193; entry 46's prerequisite (i). Serial on C3a (landed)." It is docs/testing/xl-pending.md entry 46's (i) (:2071). The implementer marks (i) MET in the same commit and does not write the command; the 10-25 03:00 review writes it from C3's log and C10. - The ESR is the §9 binding ruling "capacitor ESR" (PROJECT_PLAN.md:3868–3886): r = 0.2 Ω in series on every lumped capacitor, in-model as a series-RC sheet. The κ ruling (:3866) puts κ off on exact sheets. - No band, tolerance, record or target is set or moved; every band is imported.

Executor and cost. - Executor: implementer. - Tier: heavy by ceiling, not "standard". The build-only proof builds the 1.5 T r1 mesh in memory. - C3a's W1 measured t_build 332.4 s, window 335 s at -n 2 (20261018T183353Z_GEO-38-C3a-W1-build.log). - The same r1 build measured 323–524 s at -n 2 across five daytime builds (GEO-38.md:614–624). - Container timeout -k 30 590 is the most a foreground window can carry inside the Bash tool's 660 s. - Ranks: W0 -n 1, W1 -n 2, both on the complex image. - Daytime only: 12:00 / 13:30 / 15:00, as the slot's first item, one daytime item per slot. There is no take-next into or out of it. A skip costs no attempt. - It never shares a slot with 542, 553, 560 or 566. Two heavy windows never run at once. - Deadline: the 10-25 03:00 review, which reads entry 46's prerequisites. That puts it after item 560 (deadline 10-22 03:00) in the daytime order. - Class: chain no-solve (the weekly's 6.6, PROJECT_PLAN.md:4933). Cost: ≈ 6.6 measured / ≈ 55 predicted slot-minutes. That is code ≈ 30 (one new module, ≈ 400–450 lines, mostly H17's body transposed), W0 ≈ 1, pre-checks ≈ 2, W1 ≈ 7, and commit and journal ≈ 8. - If W1 has not started by minute 45: commit the module with W0 green and mark item 561 OPEN for "W1 only". The next daytime slot runs W1 on the committed file, unchanged (rule (i)). That is not an attempt. - Gmsh stop rule: not armed. The r1 build is priced (C3a's 332 s). The 10-17 epitaph binds the next unpriced build. - Family: GEO-38 C4 root module, attempt 1 of 4.

What exists. - H26a's pattern, tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_copper_esr_root.py (838 lines; §9 items 334 / 354 / 459). The F-human code to transpose: - _build_root_fixture (:98–133); - the circuit helpers, all leg-count-agnostic: _thevenin_feed_impedance, _source_voltage, _current_route_s, _parallel_currents, _parallel_loads (:144–180), _z_rc (:188–191, series_rlc_impedance), _y_from_gamma, _active_y_in, _s_route_2x2, _current_route_y_in, _circuit_current_route_s, _rel, SENSES (:194–254); - _sign_change_roots (:631–646); - the node body (:305–607): the _drive closure, wall term first (:402–449); _pair (:469–481); _partition (:486–490); the Z50 pair, (P50), NEG and (Z50) against a stored matrix (:492–518); per node Z_RC on the non-feed gaps, Z_th on the feeds, (P_RC), four Y_in readings and the node JSON (:520–587); asserts (:595–607); - H26a's build-only K1 (:782–838) and _h17_node_json_path (:87–95). - Its F-human-only pieces, which must not be imported (16 legs, F-human records): - _ring_quadrature_slots (tests/validation/test_port_drive_superposition.py:1208–1245: SCALED_LEG_COUNT, 22.5° grid); - QUADRATURE_SLOT_OFFSET = 4 and _k1_shares (16-point FFT) (tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_tuned_circuit.py:52, :99–111); - _apply_degree (reads FEM_EM_WF10_DEGREE and prints F-human records; tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_tuned_b1_sar.py:174–204); - C_MODE_CU_PF, HOLE_CELL_RECORD, P17_*, NPZ_PATH, _build_f_human. - Generic and importable: _respec (test_wf10_f_human_tuned_circuit.py:64–80); _residual (tests/validation/test_port_circuit_layer_field.py); reduce_terminated_ports / s_to_z / z_to_s (fem_em_solver.ports.circuit). - C3a's fixture and helpers. tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_matrix.py, entry 44's module (10-24); never edit it: - DRIVEN = "P33", SAVE_PATH = logs/geo38/c3-cu-s64-d1.npz, BLIND_FACTOR = 1.0 (:49–53); - LEG_COUNT_32 / AZIMUTH_STEP_32_DEG (:56–57); - _ideal_layout (:129–133: P33…P64 bottom ring, P65…P96 top, (j + ½)·11.25°); - _census_failures, _sheet_geometry, _layout_failures (:148–207); - _run_c3's fixture-assert block (:229–296). - The fixture itself: col._build_f_clinical (tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_column.py:141–154, entry 40's module; never edit it). That is C3's fixture too, so C4's (Z50) comparand is C3's saved matrix on the same mesh.

Code: one new file, tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_esr_root.py; edit nothing else (no src/, no WF-10 / C3a / column module, no xl-pending.md beyond entry 46's status line). - Knobs: - C4_ENV = "FEM_EM_GEO38_C4": unset ⇒ the gated test skips; build ⇒ build-only; 1 ⇒ the node run (entry 46 only); else ValueError. - C4_NODES_ENV = "FEM_EM_GEO38_C4_NODES_PF": comma-separated pF. It is required under 1 (no default: C10 sets the grid, and the module invents none). Each node must be > 0, the list is sorted ascending, and a list whose f"{c:.4f}" names collide, or whose nodes do not round-trip at 4 decimals, raises ValueError. The node JSON is named at 4 decimals, so two nodes closer than 5e-5 pF would overwrite each other. Entry 46 already says "≤ 4 decimals". - C4_DEGREE_ENV = "FEM_EM_GEO38_C4_DEGREE": unset ⇒ degree 1; 2 ⇒ 2; else ValueError. These are H20a's _degree_knob semantics with its own name, so a GEO-38 window never reads a WF-10 variable. - Constants: - ESR_OHM is imported from the WF-10 module (:53), not retyped. - QUADRATURE_SLOT_OFFSET_32 = LEG_COUNT // 4 = 8, a derived count. - JSON_DIR = "/workspace/logs/geo38", with node JSON c4-node-<pF:.4f>.json and a -d2 sibling. - SPEC_WIRING_C_PF = 100.0, a wiring value for (Z) only, labelled "not a node, not a prediction". - _feeds_32(ids, geo): DRIVEN = P33. feed2 is the one port on P33's ring (same z sign) whose measured azimuth is az(P33) + 8·11.25° = +90° (mod 360) within AZIMUTH_MATCH_DEG. It returns (feeds, az_feeds, az_bisector = az(P33) + 45°) and raises unless exactly one such port exists. The +90° sense is H17's (ref_k + QUADRATURE_SLOT_OFFSET). The F-human order is [DRIVEN, feed2] + others ascending. - _k1_shares_32(currents, order, slots): the 32-point fold of _k1_shares (k = ±1 of 32). Printed only. - _apply_degree_c4(ctx, comm): _apply_degree's body (:174–204) under C4_DEGREE_ENV, printing F_CLINICAL_R1_UNKNOWNS_RECORD. (Deg) is asserted inside: n = E at degree 1, n = 2E + 2F at degree 2. - _build_c4_fixture(comm): col._build_f_clinical(comm), then C3a's fixture asserts (A0) / (iv) / outer census / (S) and (C) / (W) / (Az), using C3a's helpers by import and copying its :229–296 block. Then _feeds_32, then _apply_degree_c4. It compiles nothing beyond the sheet-width dS area form that _context_from_mesh already compiles. - test_geo38_c4_esr_root(monkeypatch), @complex_only: - build: _build_c4_fixture, then (U1), (F), (Z), then, in the same build, monkeypatch.setenv(C4_DEGREE_ENV, "2") and _apply_degree_c4 again for (Deg-2), H26a's K1 shape (:805–838). It prints BUILD-ONLY return (t_build, t_d2, RSS) and returns before the Leontovich term, any assembly or factorisation. The npz is never opened on this path. - 1 (entry 46 only): H17's node body transposed to 64 ports. It runs: - the npz comparand at c3.SAVE_PATH (absent ⇒ assert-stop, "never re-solve", item 334's ruling (2)); cells equals the npz cells; - the Z50 pair: (P50) ≤ DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL; NEG blind miss ≥ c3.BLIND_FACTOR·band; (Z50) _residual(MEAS50, s64[ix(feed indices in the npz order)]) ≤ REUSE_REPRODUCTION_RTOL, asserted at degree 1 and printed at degree 2 (H26a); - per node: Z_RC on the 62, Z_th on the 2 feeds, (P_RC) ≤ DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL; the four Y_in readings, the C4 / mirror spread and the circuit-only Y_in from the npz printed; _k1_shares_32 printed; the node JSON; - at the end, _sign_change_roots on all four readings, printed. C_in(F-clinical) is the P33 (1, +1j) secant root, a record, never asserted (item 354's ruling); - kinds asserted ["solve", "held"] per pair. - H17's (R) is not carried: C3's npz saves no per-drive power (C3a :466), so there is no record to reproduce. Flagged below. - Coding tests, skipped whenever C4_ENV is set (C3a's _coding marker): (K0)–(K3), (Y0-64), (N1), (N2) below. - Imports: module objects only (import tests.validation.test_wf10_f_human_copper_esr_root as h17, … test_geo38_f_clinical_matrix as c3, … test_geo38_f_clinical_column as col), never from … import test_*. Otherwise pytest collects H17's or C3's gated tests into this module.

Anchors (asserted in W1 at -n 2; owned entities, reduced). - (A0) Cells = F_CLINICAL_R1_CELL_RECORD 1 147 366 within CELL_COUNT_BAND 0.01 (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_port_sheet_prerequisite.py:57); predicted rel 0 (C3a W1). (iv), outer census, (S) as C3a. - (C) port census: 64 specs, exactly P33…P96, each with > 0 owned facets, 64 = 2·LEG_COUNT (c3._census_failures). (W) widths = 0.010 m at STRIP_BAND 1e-9 (tests/validation/test_ops61_exact_strip_ports.py:58). (Az) slot residual < AZIMUTH_MATCH_DEG 1e-6 (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_ring_column.py:158), one port per slot per ring. - (U1) degree-1 global unknowns = E = F_CLINICAL_R1_UNKNOWNS_RECORD[0] = 1 525 193, exactly (tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_build.py:89). - (Deg-2) In the same build with the knob at 2: unknowns = 2E + 2F = F_CLINICAL_R1_UNKNOWNS_RECORD[1] = 7 885 674, exactly. H26a's exact NEG: n(2) ≠ n(1) and n(2)·E = n(1)·(2E + 2F). - (F) the two-port feed: feed2 is on P33's ring, Δaz = 90° within AZIMUTH_MATCH_DEG, and exactly one candidate. The bisector azimuth az(P33) + 45° is printed. Predicted: feed2 = P41, az(P33) = 5.625°, bisector 50.625° (printed, not asserted, because the ordinal-to-slot map is measured). - (Z) the ESR series-RC sheets. _respec(base_specs, None, imp) at SPEC_WIRING_C_PF gives: - 62 non-feed specs with port_impedance_ohm = Z_RC = series_rlc_impedance(64 MHz, r = ESR_OHM, L = 0, C), with Re Z_RC = 0.2 Ω exactly and Im Z_RC = −1/(ωC) at 1e-12; - the 2 feed specs with Z_th = 50·Z_RC/(50 + Z_RC) at 1e-15; - width_correction_kappa is None on all 64 (the 2026-10-02 ruling); - the 64 ids unchanged. - (K0) Knob parsing for all three variables: unset, build and 1; 2 and x refused; nodes required under 1; empty, negative or colliding-at-4-decimals lists refused; degree unset / 2 accepted and 1 / x refused. - (K1) _feeds_32 on c3._ideal_layout() returns P33 and P41, Δaz = 90° ≤ 1e-12, bisector 50.625°. - (K2) _k1_shares_32: a planted pure k = 1 pattern on 32 slots reads 1.0 ≤ 1e-12; a planted k = 2 pattern reads 0 ≤ 1e-12. - (K3) Node-JSON path coding: the -d2 sibling differs from the degree-1 name, both live under JSON_DIR, and neither equals an h17-node-* name. - (Y0-64) H17's (Y0) on a seeded random passive 64×64: the S-route Y_in equals the current-route 1/Z_RC + I_f/V_f within Y0_CODING_BAND 1e-12 (h17.Y0_CODING_BAND, :55). Same identity, same band, the helpers at 64 ports.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (N1) Asserted by construction. F-human's QUADRATURE_SLOT_OFFSET (4) on the 32-leg ideal layout puts feed2 at Δaz = 45°, missing 90° by exactly 45° (the ceiling: half the quadrature angle). This catches the import trap. - (N2) Asserted. F-human's _k1_shares (16-point) on the 32-slot input raises IndexError (slot k ≥ 16), so the 16-leg reader cannot silently fold a 32-leg ring. - (Deg-2) NEG as above (exact integer identity, H26a's). - (Z) planted, asserted: a respec with r = 0 gives Re Z_RC = 0, which differs from 0.2 Ω. This is a binary check that the ESR reaches the specs.

Predictions, written first (printed, never asserted). - (A0) rel 0; - t_build ≈ 332 s [320, 560] at a 1-min loadavg ≤ 4; - degree-2 space ≈ 10–60 s; - window ≈ 370 s; - summed RSS ≈ 2.0 GiB after the build and ≈ 4–6 GiB after the degree-2 space; - F = (7 885 674 − 2·1 525 193)/2 = 2 417 644 (printed beside the measured F).

Windows. Each runs in the foreground with Bash timeout: 660000, pytest -s, never -k. Every harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, repo-relative, nothing chained or piped. docs.text:

Executor and cost. - Executor: implementer. - Tier: heavy, build-only (the weekly's tier). W0 -n 1; W1 -n 2. C3a W1 added ≈ 3 s of context and checks to its build (20261018T183353Z_GEO-38-C3a-W1-build.log). - Container: timeout -k 30 590, the most a foreground window carries. - Daytime only (the weekly's mark): 12:00 / 13:30 / 15:00, as the slot's first item, one daytime item per slot. It never shares a slot with 542, 553, 560 or 561, and two heavy windows never run at once. It has no deadline, so it runs after 560 and 561 in the daytime order. - Class: the weekly priced C11 at 16.7 (chain solve, PROJECT_PLAN.md:4933). Cost: ≈ 16.7 measured / ≈ 30 predicted slot-minutes. The 3 T r1 build is priced (C8: 286.5 s gmsh). - Family: GEO-38 C11 3 T sweep module, attempt 1 of 4.

What exists (main, 2026-10-20). - C3a's module tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_matrix.py. _run_c3(comm, *, build_only, n_drives) (:210–307): - takes _build_f_clinical from the column module, and F_CLINICAL_R1_CELL_RECORD, F_CLINICAL_R1_UNKNOWNS_RECORD and _f_clinical_kwargs from the build module, all by call-time from … import (:211–220); - asserts (A0) / (iv) / outer census / (S) / (C) / (W) / (Az) / (U1) (:252–296); - returns before any assembly when build_only (:298–305); - the full branch saves to the module global SAVE_PATH (:51, :465–469). - The column module's _context_from_mesh (test_geo38_f_clinical_column.py:95–138) reads FREQUENCY_HZ from tests.validation.test_wf7_f_human_b1_quadrature by a call-time import (:107; value 64e6 at test_wf7_f_human_b1_quadrature.py:52) and puts ω in ctx["omega"] (:136). _build_f_clinical (:141–154) calls _f_clinical_kwargs("r1") by call-time import (:145–147) and _context_from_mesh as a module global (:152). - C8's module tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_3t.py: - _f_clinical_3t_kwargs(rung) (:122); - FREQUENCY_3T_HZ = 128e6 (:49); - F_CLINICAL_3T_R1_CELL_RECORD = 1_057_895 (:105), F_CLINICAL_3T_R1_UNKNOWNS_RECORD = (1_425_765, 7_335_988) (:108); - RUNG_DIAMETER_3T_M / SHIELD_DIAMETER_3T_M / SHIELD_LENGTH_3T_M (:45–47); - _install_recording_domain (:202–225) arms C8's 450 s _GmshStopRule, so it is not reused here (the build is priced). - IDENTITY_BAND 1e-9 (tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_build.py:39).

Code: one new file, tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_3t_matrix.py; edit nothing else (no C3a, column, build, 3 T or WF-7 module, no src/). - Knobs: - C11_ENV = "FEM_EM_GEO38_C11": unset ⇒ skip; build ⇒ build-only; 1 ⇒ the full 64-drive sweep at 128 MHz (a future window the weekly may commission, never run here); else ValueError. - C11_DRIVES_ENV = "FEM_EM_GEO38_C11_DRIVES", parsed as C3a's _n_drives (1..64), so a C11 window never reads a C3 variable. - C11_SAVE_PATH = Path("logs/geo38/c11-cu-s64-d1-128mhz.npz"). - _c11_patches(monkeypatch), the "geometry knob at 128 MHz". Otherwise apply _c11_patches, then call c3._run_c3(comm, build_only=(mode == "build"), n_drives=…). After it returns, assert (f), (T3) and, under build, not C11_SAVE_PATH.exists() and not c3's original SAVE_PATH touched (mtime or existence unchanged). - Coding tests, skipped whenever C11_ENV is set: (K0), (K1), (N1)–(N3) below. - Imports: module objects only (c3, col, s1a, t3, wf7), inside function bodies. Never from … import test_*: C3a's, C8's and WF-7's gated tests would be collected and could build.

Anchors (asserted in W1 at -n 2; owned entities, reduced). C3a's anchors are asserted by _run_c3 itself, against C8's records through the patch. - (A0) Cells = F_CLINICAL_3T_R1_CELL_RECORD 1 057 895 within CELL_COUNT_BAND 0.01 (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_port_sheet_prerequisite.py:57). (W) widths = 0.010 m at STRIP_BAND (ring tube radius 0.004, unchanged in the 3 T table). (Az) 34 classes on the 11.25° grid below AZIMUTH_MATCH_DEG. - (U1) Degree-1 unknowns = F_CLINICAL_3T_R1_UNKNOWNS_RECORD[0] = 1 425 765, exactly. - (f) the frequency reached the fixture. The recorded ω = 2π·128e6 at 1e-12 relative (H17's own ω check, test_wf10_f_human_copper_esr_root.py:118). - (T3) the 3 T table reached the builder. From the recorded diag / kw at IDENTITY_BAND: 2·shield_radius_m = 0.743, shield_length_m = 0.70, and 2·kw["ring_radius"] = 0.704 (C8's added identities, test_geo38_f_clinical_3t.py:252–260). - (K0) Knob parsing (unset, build, 1 accepted; 2, x refused; drives 1..64). - (K1) Routing tripwire (no gmsh). Under _c11_patches, with MeshGenerator.birdcage_port_domain replaced by a recorder that raises a sentinel, col._build_f_clinical(MPI.COMM_WORLD) reaches the recorder with ring_radius 0.352 and shield_radius 0.3715. On exit, s1a._f_clinical_kwargs("r1")["ring_radius"] is 0.355 again and wf7.FREQUENCY_HZ == 64e6.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (N1) Asserted by construction. The 1.5 T record misses the 3 T mesh: |1 057 895 / 1 147 366 − 1| = 7.80e-2, which is 7.8× CELL_COUNT_BAND. That is the ceiling: a fixed ratio of two records. A patch that silently failed would turn (A0) red in W1, not pass. - (N2) Asserted (K1's twin). Without _c11_patches, the same tripwire call records ring_radius 0.355: the 1.5 T fixture. - (N3) Asserted. C11_SAVE_PATH != c3.SAVE_PATH, and inside _c11_patches c3.SAVE_PATH reads the C11 path. Predictions, written first (printed, never asserted). - (A0) rel 0; - t_build ≈ 313 s [290, 560] at a 1-min loadavg ≤ 4; - checks ≈ 3–5 s; - window ≈ 325 s; - summed RSS ≈ 2.1 GiB; - (Az) worst residual ≈ 1e-13°. - Printed for the weekly's 3 T column price (the "price input"): ρ₃ = 1 057 895 / 369 387 = 2.8639 and the conservative column 39.2·(1 425 765 / 500 568)² ≈ 318 s, beside entry 40's 364 s. Reading the composition against the code found three defects in item 667's text. Each would have reached the xl window unexercised, because nothing in the module has run under 1:

  1. The sense. The 10-26 weekly's C6a and entry 52 say "the (1, +1j) quadrature drive" and "mean |B₁⁺|_ccw" in one clause. On an azimuth-increasing feed pair those are opposite senses: quadrature_phase_weights (test_birdcage_b1_quadrature.py:175–188) makes ccw the lagging pattern, (1, −1j), and WF-10 step 4 pairs ("cw", "(1,+1j)"), ("ccw", "(1,-1j)") (test_wf10_f_human_tuned_b1_sar.py:699, asserted at :243–244). I36b's _arm superposes (1, +1j) only (test_geo36_rod_f_clinical_drive.py:444). Ruling: the two feed columns are one factorisation, so both senses cost one linear combination each. The target stays the weekly's, "mean |B₁⁺|cw";he body forms bot* superpositions, runs the lattice under ccw, and prints (1, +1j) beside it at c* so the weekly's literal sense also has a number. The weekly rules which clause it meant; no gate depends on it.
  2. The coverage ball cannot clear the conductors. Item 667 said "with the conductor limit taken from F-clinical's ring radius in place of F_HUMAN_RING_RADIUS". The ball must contain the box: half-diagonal √(0.21² + 0.045² + 0.325²) = 0.389551 m, plus COVERAGE_BALL_PAD_M 1 mm = 0.390551 m, against 0.355 − CONDUCTOR_CLEARANCE_M 0.010 = 0.345 m. assert coverage_radius < conductor_limit (the WF-10 line, test_wf10_f_human_tuned_sar10g.py:514) would be a certain red, after the solve. That assert exists because WF-7's conductor was a bulk σ = 800 S/m volume. On a Leontovich hole mesh the copper has no cells, and off the gel σ = 0 and ρ = 0, so a ball past the rungs adds nothing to either side of the identity. Ruling: drop that line (item 667's own execution detail, not a gate); the coverage identity itself is the gate, unmoved, at EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL. Assert instead that the radius reaches the farthest box corner plus the pad.
  3. Tag 403 is gel in arm R, but the density and the tagged mean do not know it. I36b's rho_field zeroes every tag but 3 (:535–537), which is right for arm M. In arm R, tag 403 carries gel σ, so a coverage ball counts its power while mean_sar(subdomain_ids=3) does not. The miss is about V_rod / V_box ≈ 1.5e-6 by volume, four orders over the 1e-10 band: another certain red after the solve. Ruling: in this module the gel is tags (3, 403) together: density_map zeroes only the other tags, mean_sar(subdomain_ids=(3, 403)), (i) on the union. The lattice is unaffected (every 10 g ball clears the rod capsule by ≥ 1 mm).

docs.title: §9 item 776 — 2026-11-03 (§10 C26, chain C / lane 1 — the circuit-vs-root sign, read; chain step (no solve))
docs.text:
Executes §10 C26, with one premise corrected. The weekly's "C_mode with Z_RC" is identical to the r = 0 reading by construction. ring_c_modes (test_geo38_f_clinical_c_mode.py:138) reads C_k = 1/(ω Im λ_anti) on the bare Z. A uniform r adds r·I (ring_mode_rows(esr_ohm=), src/fem_em_solver/ports/ring_modes.py:187–212), which moves Re λ and leaves Im λ alone; ESR ruling (i) says the same. So C_mode cannot carry the sign.

What can carry it is the circuit-layer root: Im Y_in at the feed under the terminations, computed from the saved 64×64 alone. It is the same quantity the in-model roots are read on, and C4's module already prints it as "circuit-only Y_in" (test_geo38_f_clinical_esr_root.py; line :12587 of entry 50's log). Locate that helper first. If it needs the field solve's per-node data rather than the npz, stop: the item is BLOCKED with the reason. The target is kept: a record that decides whether the sign difference is the ESR's or the fixture's.

Measurement. On both saved matrices, which are present: logs/geo38/c3-cu-s64-d1.npz (64 MHz) and logs/geo38/c11-cu-s64-d1-128mhz.npz (128 MHz). - (a) C_mode(k = 1) by ring_c_modes. Control: it reproduces 195.0265 pF (20261024T093056Z_GEO-38-C10-W1.log.gz:106) and 43.9719 pF (20261027T093207Z_GEO-38-C15-W1.log:76) exactly at .4f. - (b) The ESR-invariance identity, asserted: ring_mode_rows with esr_ohm = 0.2 against 0, n_slots = 64. Require |Im λ₁(r) − Im λ₁(0)| / |Im λ₁(0)| ≤ REDUCTION_BAND, and Re λ₁ moving by r to REDUCTION_BAND. This makes ruling (i) a gate on these two matrices. - (c) The circuit-layer root. Im Y_in on P33 (1, +1j) from the npz, from C4's helper unchanged. Terminations are Z_C (r = 0) or Z_RC (r = 0.2 Ω) on the 62 non-feed gaps, with the feed driven across its (r + C) branch. Use a grid of ≥ 9 nodes spanning ±1 % about each C_mode, and read the − → + crossing by the bracketing pair (10-31 ruling). Do this for each twin and each r.

Printed, as a record: the four circuit roots beside the in-model roots (193.5996 / 44.0615 pF) and C_mode, with the signed gap (root − C_mode)/C_mode in % for each. Write the JSON to logs/geo38/c26-sign.json. The reading: - If the r = 0.2 Ω circuit roots reproduce the in-model signs on both twins, the sign is the circuit's (ESR plus feed termination). - If r = 0 already reproduces them, it is the termination's, not the ESR's. - If neither does, it is the fixture's (the field solve beyond the 64×64's frequency point).

Gates. - (a) and (b) above. - The reciprocity and σ_max re-reads on both matrices at RECIPROCITY_BAND / MATRIX_PASSIVITY_CEILING (C10's, imported). - Control for (c): the 1.5 T npz read at 128 MHz (the wrong ω) moves the circuit root by > 1 %.

Pass the frequency explicitly and write a new JSON. - The npz files are gitignored. A missing file is BLOCKED, never regenerated. - The leak guard: this module prints circuit inputs (node capacitances, Z_RC). Print the grid at .4f, and check each printed node form against the guard before the window (entry 51's lesson).

Scope. The circuit layer on two saved degree-1 matrices. Not claimed: a root, a tuning statement, anything at degree 2.

Negative result. - (a) not reproducing means the reader moved: stop and file it. - No crossing in (c) within ±1 %: print the grid's Im Y_in and widen once to ±3 %. If there is still none, record "no circuit root within ±3 %". That is informative too: the in-model roots are then fixture readings.

At r = 0 its minimum is ≈ +1.39e-2 S near 192.30 pF. - 3 T: the − → + crossings are at 43.8515 pF (r = 0, −0.274 %) and 43.5942 pF (r = 0.2, −0.859 %). The control therefore shows only that the wrong ω gives no root near it either, so it does not discriminate here. - Leak guard: node capacitances print at .4f only. Writing the briefs for the 11-04 weekly's chain C slot steps, this review found seven premises in the step text that the code contradicts. Each is corrected as execution detail, with the target kept, and none makes a step unqueueable:

  1. C34: I36b's degree knob already exists. It is not FEM_EM_GEO36_S8_DEGREE but FEM_EM_GEO36_S8_DRIVE_DEGREE, wired through the whole drive branch (test_geo36_rod_f_clinical_drive.py:35–37, :62, :112–130, :219–225, :499–511, :553). It is refused under build, because I36b's build window already asserted (Deg-2) on this mesh: 8 327 394 = 2·1 606 744 + 2·2 556 953 (20261027T170559Z_GEO-36-I36b-W1-build.log:11989–11990). So I36b's half of C34 adds no knob; it is a stub proof of a degree-2 path that has never run.
  2. Entry 62 cannot be one pytest call. C6a's foreign guard refuses FEM_EM_GEO36_S8_DRIVE, FEM_EM_GEO36_S8_DRIVE_DEGREE and FEM_EM_GEO38_C4_DEGREE (test_geo38_f_clinical_box_loaded.py:55–65). Its command is two sequential pytest calls in one window, each with its own environment prefix. That is for the 11-07 weekly, which writes the command. C34 pins it with a test (K-62), and no guard is changed.
  3. C6b: a 50 mm grid anchored at the box centre cannot contain the lattice's x = ±Lx/4 = ±105 mm. The x step is therefore Lx/8 = 52.5 mm, and the z and y steps are 50 mm. "3D" gives one layer in y: the box is 90 mm deep, and a 10 g ball needs |dy| ≤ 30.6 mm. The grid is 91 candidates, of which 90 are kept; the one on the rod axis is excluded.
  4. C6b is off by default (FEM_EM_GEO38_C6_GRID). _run_box is also called by C21 (entry 58) and P61 (entry 59). Without a knob, both windows would buy the grid unpriced, against the weekly's "no degree-1 re-run is bought for it". The K8 exact key-set asserts (box_loaded.py:1031, 3t_box_loaded.py:536) also require it.
  5. C31 is serial on P61b (item 818). "Both senses as P61b's" is P61b's code.
  6. Entry 62's price leaves out the grid. Entry 52's readouts took 169.7 s for ≈ 20 full-mesh ball assemblies (20261103T080009Z_GEO-38-C6.log:12312), at most ≈ 8.5 s per ball at degree 1, -n 8. The grid adds 72 balls, ≲ 610 s at degree 1 (arithmetic, not a measurement). The degree-2 price is the 11-07 weekly's.
  7. |B₁⁺| is curl E interpolated at DG0 midpoints at either degree (src/fem_em_solver/post/faraday.py:58–62). So part of entry 62's degree-1 → degree-2 |B₁⁺| move belongs to the reconstruction, not to the solve. It is printed, never gated.

C3's module (test_geo38_f_clinical_matrix.py) stays byte-identical. 1. C11_DEGREE_ENV = "FEM_EM_GEO38_C11_DEGREE"; C11_SAVE_PATH_D2 = Path("logs/geo38/c11-cu-s64-d2-128mhz.npz"). 2. _degree_knob_c11(): c3._degree_knob_c3's body (test_geo38_f_clinical_matrix.py:103–110) on the new env name. C3's _save_path() (:113–116) and _apply_degree_c3() (:126–) look both names up as module globals at call time. Under the patches, a C11 window therefore reads its own knob and saves to its own degree-2 path. _apply_degree_c3 already asserts n_dofs == F_CLINICAL_R1_UNKNOWNS_RECORD[degree - 1], read from s1a at call time, and patch 3 points that at t3.F_CLINICAL_3T_R1_UNKNOWNS_RECORD. So (Deg) needs no new code. 4. _refuse_c3_degree() stays, and stays first on the selected path: C3's knob in a C11 window is still refused, so a stray 1.5 T knob can never route a 3 T build. Its message changes from "no 3 T degree-2 path (C5e)" to one that names FEM_EM_GEO38_C11_DEGREE. test_c11_k3t_refuses_c3_degree's match= follows the new message, and its unset / empty / "2" cases stay as they are. In test_geo38_c11_3t_matrix's build branch, the (S) path is c3._save_path() read after _c11_patches, so it is C11_SAVE_PATH at degree 1 and C11_SAVE_PATH_D2 at degree 2. docs.text:

Queued after item 869 (C5e), the open daytime item, first at 12:00 on 11-08. The weekly's text (binds). "C3's module gains the r2 mesh (conductor_resolution 2.4e-3 m — GEO-38 step 1a's second rung, 912 804 cells, U₁ 1 184 518, built in 245 s at -n 2, 20261015T171259Z_GEO-38-s1a-W2-r2-a2.log) behind a knob (FEM_EM_GEO38_C3_RUNG=r2, default r1), the (A0) record for r2 registered, build-only green at -n 2 with the census 64 and U₁ exact; stub-run as C5c was."

The r2 record, as read. 20261015T171259Z_GEO-38-s1a-W2-r2-a2.log (real build, -n 2, Status 0, 250 s, :12129–12130): - :12102: 912 804 cells; build 245.4 s (gmsh 222.2 s); summed peak RSS 1.759 GiB. - :12110: (C) N_ports 64. - :12111: (U) E 1 184 518, F 1 905 089; U₁ = E; U₂ 6 179 214 = 2E + 2F. - Registered as F_CLINICAL_R2_CELL_RECORD / F_CLINICAL_R2_UNKNOWNS_RECORD (tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_build.py:87, :90), with CONDUCTOR_RESOLUTION["r2"] = 2.4e-3 (:71). - No module has built r2 since 10-15. "Registered" here means C3's route asserts against those records for the first time.

Why a patch and not a parameter. C3's _run_c3 builds through the column module's _build_f_clinical, which hard-codes _f_clinical_kwargs("r1") (tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_column.py:147). _run_c3 imports F_CLINICAL_R1_CELL_RECORD, F_CLINICAL_R1_UNKNOWNS_RECORD and _f_clinical_kwargs from s1a at call time (test_geo38_f_clinical_matrix.py:279–287). _apply_degree_c3 imports the unknowns record the same way (:129). That is the seam C11 already routes through: _c11_patches rebinds s1a._f_clinical_kwargs, the two R1 records and c3.SAVE_PATH (test_geo38_f_clinical_3t_matrix.py:114–124). This item copies that pattern with one rung instead of one frequency, as item 869 copies it for the degree knob.

Route: tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_matrix.py only. The column module, the s1a build module, C11's module and C4a's module stay byte-identical. 1. C3_RUNG_ENV = "FEM_EM_GEO38_C3_RUNG" and SAVE_PATH_R2 = Path("logs/geo38/c3-cu-s64-d1-r2.npz"). The second gives a future r2 sweep its own file; it never touches entry 44's c3-cu-s64-d1.npz. 2. _rung_knob_c3(): unset, empty or "r1" ⇒ "r1"; "r2" ⇒ "r2"; anything else ⇒ ValueError. _rung_checked() calls it, and on "r2" refuses a set FEM_EM_GEO38_C3_DEGREE with ValueError before gmsh ("r2 is degree 1 only (C35)"). docs.text:
Written by the 2026-11-08 18:00 daily review under §9 rule (6), provisional until the weekly ratifies or reverts it. It serves C33 (PROJECT_PLAN.md §10 chain C, "C33 … serial on entry 58 green. As written 11-04"; full text docs/planning/plan-archive.md:49008–49012). C33's subgoal and target are unchanged. This item builds C33's reader ahead of its window and proves it on the landed half, as C36 built C37's reader ahead of entry 62 (ANS-11.md item 871). Family C44, attempt 1 of 4. Chain C's rule-(6) count since the 11-07 weekly: 1 of 6 with this item.

C33's text (binds). "The 1.5 T / 3 T reader: entries 52 and 58's JSONs — the ratio of the lattice means, of the centroid means and of SAR10g(c*) per accepted watt, the two hotspot locations, Im Y_in at the two roots, P_box / P_acc at each; JSON written. A record."

The source, read against the code (a correction of route, not of target). - The JSONs C33 names are host-only, because /logs/ is gitignored (.gitignore:82). Entry 52's is logs/geo38/c6-node-193.5996.json (4 468 B, 2026-11-03). Entry 58 will write c6-node-44.0525.json, through C6a's writer (test_geo38_f_clinical_box_loaded.py:739–741) under _c21_patches. - Neither file is reproducible from a fresh clone. The binding precedent is the 11-05 03:00 ruling ("the tracked log is the source", ANS-11.md), and I68′'s module reads its tracked log for the same reason (test_geo36_i68_lumped_vs_clinical.py:4–7). - Every field C33 names is printed on a [GEO-38 C6a] line. On entry 52's log these are 20261103T080009Z_GEO-38-C6.log:12063 (node, V_s), :12281 (S2), :12285–12286 (Y_in ccw / cw), :12288 (centroid means), :12289–12306 (lattice), :12307 (c*) and :12310 (normalisers). - The ans:11 page already parses exactly these lines (parse_c6_log, derived). - The reader therefore reads the tracked logs. The host JSON is read only as a custody cross-check, when it is present. - Entry 58 runs C6a's _run_box unchanged under _c21_patches (test_geo38_f_clinical_3t_box_loaded.py:7–30), so its log carries the same line forms. - Its feeds are P33 / P41; c4._feeds_32 is unchanged at 3 T (:28). - It also prints one (C21) mean |B1+|_ccw: centroid mean … line, which the page's means regex does not match, because that regex needs a number after _ccw. C21's own stub log shows that line beside the matched one (20261105T181050Z_GEO-38-C31-W0r.log:145, :147).

Code: one new module, tests/validation/test_geo38_c33_field_strength_reader.py. The ans:11 page, its unit test, C6a, C21 and src stay byte-identical. 1. Loader. Load the page exactly as tests/unit/test_ans11_record_page.py:36–44 does, with the same sys.modules name ans11_record_page, so both modules share one module object. Use the page's parse_c6_log, derived, _read_log and SOURCE_LOG. Never re-implement a regex. 2. Constants and find_log. - Constants: ENTRY58_GLOB = "*_GEO-38-C6-3T.log" (entry 58's XL_CHUNK, xl-pending.md entry 58 command); ENTRY58_NODE_PF = "44.0525" (entry 57's crossing, 20261108T080008Z_GEO-38-C16r.log:13229, at four decimals, as entry 58's queue file carries it); ENTRY52_NODE_PF = "193.5996". - find_log(glob) searches docs/testing/logs/ (either suffix), then logs/leak-held/ (read only). Entry 54's log was held for one timing line (item 866). - It returns (path, "tracked" | "held"), or None. Two matches raise ValueError. 3. side(parsed). Kept as strings, plus the floats from derived(parsed): - the node token; - the lattice mean per √P_acc (derived); - the centroid mean per √P_acc (the normalisers' b1_per_sqrt_p_acc token); - SAR10g(c*) per P_acc (sar_per_p_acc); - the c* label and its r / dz / az; - Y_in under both senses at both feeds; - P_box / P_acc (p_box_over_p_acc). 4. check_side(parsed, node_pf). These are spec-free derived checks. The page's check_derived needs the 1.5 T SPEC, so it cannot serve the 3 T side. Each check holds at half a unit in the printed token's last digit plus its inputs' rounding (bound = Σ 0.5·10⁻ᵈ/|mantissa| over the tokens involved): - (D-Pacc): _p_acc_spec(S2, (1, −1j), V_s, 50) from the parsed S2 / V_s against the normalisers' P_acc token, rel ≤ 1e-8. Item 833 measured 1.255e-10 against the same token's SPEC copy. - (D-box): P_box / P_acc against its printed quotient. - (D-sar): c* SAR / P_acc against sar_per_p_acc. - (D-cen): centroid b1p_ccw / √P_acc against b1_per_sqrt_p_acc. - The argmax of the lattice SAR is the c* label. The c* SAR string equals its lattice line's string. The S₁₂ string equals the S₂₁ string. - (Node): the node token is the side's node string. 5. ratios(s15, s3). It returns the 3 T / 1.5 T ratios of the lattice mean per √P_acc, the centroid mean per √P_acc, SAR10g(c*) per P_acc and P_box / P_acc, printed at .6e (≤ 7 significant digits). - Both c* locations are printed side by side. - Im Y_in at the two roots is printed side by side, with the cw P33 entry first (C4's root series), never as a ratio, since the signs need not agree. 6. custody_json(parsed, path). Rank 0 reads, then a bcast. When c6-node-<node>.json exists on the host, each C33 field, formatted the way its log token is printed, must equal that token's string. S is formatted as .10e, Y_in as {:+.9e} per part, and everything else as .9e. When the file is absent, print "host JSON absent", which is not a failure. 7. The gated test test_geo38_c33_reader. Its knob is FEM_EM_GEO38_C33, in C21's _c21_mode shape: - unset: skip; - 1: entry 52 is required, and entry 58 is optional, printed as "pending (xl entry 58)"; - both: both are required, an absent one fails, and rank 0 writes /workspace/logs/geo38/c33-1p5t-3t.json only after every check holds; - anything else: ValueError.

This item runs 1 only.

Anchors (asserted). - (X52) parse_c6_log(SOURCE_LOG) succeeds, and its node is 193.5996. - (D52) Every check_side item is green on entry 52. - (J52) The host JSON is present on this host. Expect 0 mismatches over S2, Y_in under both senses, both centroid means, the 18 × 2 lattice values, c* and its cw ball, and P_box / P_src / P_acc. This review's spot check (unlogged python, not a record): sar_star, p_acc, the four Y_in pairs, both means, S₁₁ and the first lattice line all format to their log strings, and the 18-point mean formats to 1.497917e-08, the SPEC's 1.49792e-08 at its digits. - (Self), a coding test. Copy entry 52's log to tmp_path as 20990101T000000Z_GEO-38-C6-3T.log, with only the node token (:12063) and the wrote path (:12311) rewritten from 193.5996 to 44.0525. side reads it, and (Node) passes for the 3 T side. Every ratio prints 1.000000e+00: the strings are identical, so the floats are too. The two c* locations are equal. This proves the 3 T path on the line forms entry 58 prints. - (Pend) On this tree find_log(ENTRY58_GLOB) is None. At 1, the gated test prints "entry 58: pending" and writes nothing under logs/geo38.

Controls (asserted). - (N-digit) In the tmp 3 T copy, one digit of the c* SAR on the c* line is changed. Both (D-sar) and the c*-vs-lattice string check fail, naming the 3 T side. - (N-node) The tmp copy under the 3 T name, but with the node left at 193.5996, makes (Node) raise. - (N-two) Two files matching the glob in a tmp directory raise ValueError. - (N-json) A tmp JSON with sar_star changed in its 8th significant digit makes (J52) fail, naming sar_star. - (N-both) At both on this tree (knob monkeypatched, pytest.raises), the gated body fails, naming entry 58.

Printed (the record of the 1.5 T side). C33's table, with its 3 T column reading "pending (xl entry 58)".

Windows (bare, foreground, Bash timeout: 660000; pgrep -c python3 in the container reads 0 first): - W0: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-38-C44-W0 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 120 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/unit/test_ans11_record_page.py tests/validation/test_geo38_c33_field_strength_reader.py -v -s --tb=short'". The knob is unset, so the coding tests run and the gated test skips. Every test_ans11_record_page.py node must stay green on each rank, which proves the shared loader. C43's W1 ran them inside its 42 per rank (20261108T152614Z_ANS-11-C43-W1-r2.log). - W1: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-38-C44-W1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_GEO38_C33=1 PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 180 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/validation/test_geo38_c33_field_strength_reader.py -v -s --tb=short'" - W1-n1: the same command at mpiexec -n 1, labelled GEO-38-C44-W1-n1.

Tier. Standard, -n 2 and -n 1, complex (the page imports C6a, which imports dolfinx), no solve. Class: chain step (no solve). docs.text:
Written by the 2026-11-08 18:00 daily review under §9 rule (6), provisional. It serves C39 (PROJECT_PLAN.md §10 chain C, "C39 … serial on entry 60 green"); C39's target is unchanged. Family C46, attempt 1 of 4. Chain C's rule-(6) count: 3 of 6 with this item.

C39's text (binds). "The 1.5 T / 3 T thermal reader: entries 59 / 60's JSONs — θ at the hotspot ball and P37's six points at t* per accepted watt under both senses, cem43 and the six-minute window at the hotspot, the 1.5 T / 3 T ratio of each; JSON written. A record."

The source (a correction of spelling, for the weekly). Neither P61's module (test_geo38_f_clinical_box_heating.py, entry 59's) nor C31's (test_geo38_f_clinical_3t_box_heating.py, entry 60's) writes a JSON. Neither file contains an open( or json.dump call. Their results exist only as print lines (test_geo38_f_clinical_box_heating.py:239–250), so the reader parses the window logs.

The line forms are on two tracked stub logs, each with a both-sense block: - 1.5 T (P61b): 20261105T103249Z_GEO-38-P61b-W0.log, block header :146; - 3 T (C31): 20261105T181050Z_GEO-38-C31-W0r.log, block header :130. That block's lines run :131–179.

Per sense, the block prints: - I32's [gel twin <s>] lines (:158–163): the 1 g ball θ(t*) and the probe θ(t*), per gel watt (G·P = 1 W), and CN N=40 to t* 2821.500 s; - P61's lines (:164–167): sources … per-accepted-watt factor P_gel/P_acc (<s>), hotspot c* … theta(t*) per P_acc watt … (point; final-field read …); cem43 per P_acc watt … ; running mean (W 360 s) max … at t …, and one probe <name> line per probe.

Code: one new module, tests/validation/test_geo38_c39_thermal_reader.py. P61, C31, I32 and src stay byte-identical. 1. parse_heat_log(path, at_line=None). It splits the log into blocks at start: -n <r>, P61 body; node C <pF> pF, degree 1; … thermal senses [<list>] lines. - Block selection. A window log must hold exactly one block whose senses are ['ccw', 'cw'], otherwise ValueError. Stubs select their block by its header line. - Per sense, every token is kept as a string, with I32's lines attributed by their [gel twin <s>] label: - P_gel, P_acc and the factor; - the hotspot label and point; - θ_point, θ_final, cem43, the running-mean maximum and its t; - each P61 probe value; - I32's ball θ, ball radius and probe values; - t*. - A gzip-tolerant reader, as in item 906. 2. Constants. - ENTRY59_GLOB = "*_GEO-38-P33.log". This glob cannot match …-P33-3T.log. - ENTRY60_GLOB = "*_GEO-38-P33-3T.log". Entry 60's XL_CHUNK is written by its READY review. If it differs, C39's slot updates this constant and says so. - Nodes: "193.5996" (entry 59's command) and "44.0525". - find_log as in item 905. 3. check_block(block, node_pf). Each check holds at its half-unit bound, Σ 0.5·10⁻ᵈ/|mantissa| over the tokens involved. - (D-f) The factor = P_gel / P_acc. - (D-scale) On each probe, P61's θ per P_acc = I32's θ per gel watt × factor. - (Cem) The closed-form dose bracket at the hotspot: t*·R^(43 − T_INF) ≤ cem43 ≤ t*·R^(43 − T_INF − θ_point). - R = 0.25 is cem43's r_below (src/fem_em_solver/thermal/dose.py:45), and T_INF = 20.0 is imported by name (test_mat15_coil_driven_heating_phantom.py:84). - It holds when the history starts at θ = 0 and its maximum is its last sample, i.e. monotone heating under a continuous source (I75's control). - Precondition: θ_point < 43 − T_INF. Otherwise print "bracket not applicable" and do not assert. - (RA) The running-mean maximum ≤ θ_point, and its t equals t* at the print's 0.1 s. Both are identities of a monotone history. - (T*) The parsed t* string = f"{T_STAR_BOX:.3f}" (test_mat21_box_fem). - (Node) The node token is the side's node string. - (Probes) On a window log, the probe names equal p61._probes()'s, P37's six (test_geo38_f_clinical_box_heating.py:129–131). On a stub, the block's own probes are printed. 4. side(block). Per sense, the readout is: - the ball θ per P_acc watt = I32's ball θ × factor, which is C39's "θ at the hotspot ball", labelled derived, with the point read beside it; - each probe; - cem43, and the excess cem43 − t*·R^(43 − T_INF). At these θ, cem43 is dominated by the 20 °C baseline, so its ratio alone reads ≈ 1; - the six-minute (360 s) running-mean maximum.

ratios(s15, s3) gives the 3 T / 1.5 T ratio of each, per sense, at .6e. 5. The gated test test_geo38_c39_reader. Its knob is FEM_EM_GEO38_C39: - 1: each of entries 59 / 60 that is present is read and checked, and an absent one prints "pending"; - both: both are required, and rank 0 writes /workspace/logs/geo38/c39-thermal-1p5t-3t.json after every check holds.

This item runs 1 only. On this tree it runs with both entries absent.

Anchors (asserted, coding tests on the tracked stub logs). - (Stub-59) / (Stub-60) check_block is green on P61b W0 :146 (node 193.5996) and on C31 W0r :130 (node 44.0615), under both senses. This review's arithmetic on C31 W0r (unlogged, not a record): - (D-f): cw :174 gives 3.3e-15 against 5e-15, and ccw :164 gives 3.0e-14 against 5e-14; - (D-scale): ccw interior :161 / :166 gives 7.4e-11 rel, and cw interior :171 / :176 gives 6.0e-10 against a bound of ≈ 8.3e-10; - (Cem): ccw :165, cem43 / lower − 1 = 5.84e-05 inside the bracket's 1.19e-04 width; cw :175, 6.5e-06 inside 1.32e-05; - (RA): ccw 7.999503341e-05 ≤ 8.550504504e-05 at t = 2821.5 s. - (Stub-dry) C39's table is rendered from the two stub blocks, P61b as "1.5 T" and C31 as "3 T", with "STUB" in every line. Every cell is non-empty under both senses, and each ratio equals the quotient of its parsed tokens. - (Pend) Entries 59 / 60 are absent, so the gated test at 1 prints two "pending" lines and writes nothing.

A tmp log containing two both-sense blocks also raises. - (N-sense) at_line=97 (senses ['cw']) under the window rule raises ValueError (both senses required).

docs.text:
Written by the 2026-11-11 03:00 daily review from §10 C39 (PROJECT_PLAN.md chain C, "C39 (lane 1 → chain step, standard, -n 1, no solve; serial on entry 60 green)"), under §9 rule (4). It does not count against rule (6). Family C39, attempt 1 of 4. Executor: implementer, in-slot (items 907 / 917 precedent). C39's target binds: "C46's thermal reader on entries 59 / 60's tracked logs: θ at the hotspot ball and P37's six points at t* per accepted watt under both senses, cem43 and the six-minute window at the hotspot, the 1.5 T / 3 T ratio of each beside P83's closed-form prediction; JSON written. A record." This brief adds execution detail only.

What it is. Item 907 left C39 as "one FEM_EM_GEO38_C39=both window in the first slot after entry 60's log lands". Entry 60 (GEO-38 P33-3T) ran at 02:00 11-11 (20261111T080008Z_GEO-38-P33-3T.log, commit 5bd81697): - Status 0, 732 s (:12375), [capture] rc=0 (:12371); - 5 passed and 5 skipped per rank on 8 ranks; - the collected gates read "failures none (ASSERTED)" (:12307); - its queue file 20261111-GEO-38-P33-3T.env is gone from xl-queue.d/.

Entry 59 is 20261110T080008Z_GEO-38-P33.log (Status 0, 852 s; item 936's read). The weekly reads the decision rules on both entries; this item reads the logs and does not rule on them.

Premises, read against the code and the two logs at this review (unlogged, not a record). 1. The globs match once each. ENTRY60_GLOB = "*_GEO-38-P33-3T.log" (test_geo38_c39_thermal_reader.py:54) matches 20261111T080008Z_GEO-38-P33-3T.log only. ENTRY59_GLOB = "*_GEO-38-P33.log" (:52) cannot match the -3T name. The 3 T node constant "44.0525" (:56) equals the log's header node (:141) and the window's FEM_EM_GEO36_S8_DRIVE_C_PF=44.0525 (:12). No constant needs updating. 2. One block per log. grep -c "P61 body" reads 1 in each log, because rank 0 alone prints. The headers are 20261111T080008Z_GEO-38-P33-3T.log:141 and 20261110T080008Z_GEO-38-P33.log:139, both starting at column 0 with start: -n 8, P61 body; … thermal senses ['ccw', 'cw']. The line before each is a bare [GEO-38 P61] fragment, which _RX_HEAD (^start: -n …) does not need. The C6 body header that follows (:143 / :141) does not match P61 body. Each block ends at the first gates: failures line (:12307 / :12356). Each log has exactly two hotspot lines and one gates line. 3. Interleaved lines parse. Rank 0's P61 lines are glued to pytest tokens: - entry 60 :12293 starts PASSEDPASSED…[GEO-38 P61] sources, sense (1,+1j) (cw, heated); - entry 60 :12298 and :12307 start with a …::test_c31_k0_knobs_foreign_sense_and_box_time_base node id; - entry 59 :12343 carries the same PASSED… prefix, as item 936 found.

Every token regex in parse_heat_log (:137–151) is applied with re.search (:203–251), never match or startswith, so the glued lines parse. _RX_HEAD is anchored at ^, but both headers start at column 0 (premise 2). The sources: summary lines (:12304 / :12355) have no ", sense" and do not match _RX_P61_SRC. 4. The print forms match. Probe names are P0 centre … P5 top face in both the I32 and P61 lines, in _probes()'s order. t* reads 2821.500 (= f"{T_STAR_BOX:.3f}"), the running-mean t reads 2821.5 and W reads 360. Every probe line reads valid True. 5. Expected checks (this review's arithmetic on the tokens, unlogged; all inside their bounds): - (D-f): rel 3.4e-11 / 9.3e-11 at 1.5 T (ccw / cw) and 1.9e-10 / 1.4e-10 at 3 T. The tightest is 3 T ccw at 1.90e-10 against its half-unit bound ≈ 2.57e-10. - (D-scale): the worst error / bound is 0.511 at 1.5 T (ccw P4) and 0.750 at 3 T (ccw P0), over 12 probe arms per log. - (Cem): cem43 / lower − 1 = 1.11e-03 / 8.5e-04 at 1.5 T against bracket widths 2.24e-03 / 1.76e-03, and 4.48e-03 / 3.90e-03 at 3 T against 9.07e-03 / 8.00e-03. - (RA): the running maximum ≤ θ_point on all four arms. 6. P83's prediction is not printed by the C46 module. It contains no P83 / MAT-21 reference: _c39_body prints C46's table and writes the JSON, nothing else. Route (no code edit): the slot quotes P83's predicted lines in the Outcome by file and line, beside the window's measured ratios. They are from 20261110T103343Z_MAT-21-P83-W1.log, a tracked closed-form record written before entry 60's window: - the power share s₃/s₁.₅: :77 (3.6935), with the full-token value 3.6934995 at :51; - θ(c*, t*) per accepted watt and its 3 T / 1.5 T ratio under the u / e / n / walled-u pictures: :79–83 (3.6935 for every picture, the power share × (Sym) 1); - the dose excess ratios: :95–98 (u 3.7001, e 3.6985, n 3.6944, walled 3.7001). The cem43 ratio is printed there only, with its caveat; - the SAR shape part: :107–109 (1.110448), and (c-pow) at :119.

P84 (item 954, EX-194) puts the two side by side on one page through code. Editing the C46 module is not the cheapest route. It is landed and green (items 907 / 918), and its import closure includes entry 63's module (test_geo38_f_clinical_box_heating.py:58 imports test_geo36_rod_f_clinical_heating.py, queued for 11-13; the 11-09 weekly's ruling (c)). So it stays byte-identical.

Code. None. If a check is red, stop (see Negative result).

Anchors (asserted, the module's own, at both). - (Real59) / (Real60) find_log reads "tracked" for both, with the base names above. - (D59) / (D60) require_block on each log under both senses, at C46's half-unit bounds: (Node) 193.5996 / 44.0525, (D-f), (P_gel) P61 = I32 by string, (D-scale) on the six probes, (Cem) bracket, (RA) max ≤ θ_point with t = 2821.5 and W = 360, (T*), and (Probes) names = p61._probes(). - The ratios print at .6e. Rank 0 writes the host JSON /workspace/logs/geo38/c39-thermal-1p5t-3t.json only after every check holds.

Negative controls (the module's own, unchanged, in the same windows). - (N-cem) The bracket at T_INF + 1 K excludes the stub's cem43 by the factor 1/R = 4, which is also its ceiling. - (N-scale) One planted digit turns (D-scale) red on that probe only. Item 907 measured rel 9.2e-05. - (N-blocks) / (N-sense) raise as before. - (Pend) test_c46_pend_and_knob fires on the empty roots (item 918) and compares the JSON's stamp before and after its own body (item 917's fix), so it stays green with the JSON present.

Expected readings (review arithmetic on the tokens, unlogged; ≤ 5 digits; a miss above 1e-4 relative is disclosed, never red). 3 T / 1.5 T per accepted watt, ccw | cw: - hotspot point θ: ≈ 4.0425 | 4.5397; - ball θ (derived): ≈ 4.0304 | 4.5137; - 360 s running-mean maximum: ≈ 4.0426 | 4.5460; - cem43 excess over t*·R^(43 − T_INF): ≈ 4.0455 | 4.5772; - cem43 itself: ≈ 1.0034 | 1.0031. This is the baseline-dominated ratio, printed only. - The accepted-power factor ratio (P_gel/P_acc, 3 T over 1.5 T) is ≈ 3.6935 (ccw), equal to P83's power share to ≈ 1e-9 relative, and ≈ 4.2876 (cw).

What it is. custody_json (tests/validation/test_geo38_c33_field_strength_reader.py:230) formats the JSON's dz as f"{j['c_star'][2]:.6f}" (:265), while C6a prints dz signed — dz {z:+.6f} m (tests/validation/test_geo38_f_clinical_box_loaded.py:706) — and the ans:11 page's parser keeps the token as printed (_LABEL and the c* regex, examples/ansys_benchmarks/ans11_f_clinical_1p5t_box_loaded_64MHz/11_f_clinical_1p5t_box_loaded_64MHz.py:86, :107). docs.text:
Enumerated by the 11-14 weekly at PROJECT_PLAN.md:5180–5190 (chain I, shared with chain C), with its entry-62 ruling at :4885–4908. Brief written by the 2026-11-15 03:00 daily review as execution detail. A record: no band is set or moved. Family C56, attempt 1 of 4. Executor: the implementer, in-slot (items 906 / 967 precedent). The weekly's target binds: "C45's parse_i36_log on entry 62's call-2 block beside entry 48's — tip 1 g Q on the four balls, η_rod(T1), the rod's power share, Im Y_in at the root — the degree-1 → degree-2 move per figure printed and the 10-24 exit's order rule applied to the clinical rod figures … Validation target: custody of both logs' strings; the verdict line is the record."

What the step is. Entry 62's call 2 (I36 at degree 2, node 185.7629 pF) prints the rod block that entry 48 printed at degree 1 (node 193.5996 pF). C56 reads both blocks with C45's landed parser and prints each figure's degree-1 → degree-2 move. It then prints the order rule's verdict. It solves nothing and edits no landed file.

Facts verified against the tree (this review, by grep / reading; unlogged, not a record). - C45's module is tests/validation/test_geo36_c40_rod_frequency_reader.py: - parse_i36_log :130–210 (a window log must hold exactly one block; the count is in the ValueError); - check_side :222–246; require_side :249–256; _half_ulp_rel :213–219; _read_log :85–93 (reads .gz); _on_root :67–79; - custody_json :300–338 (string comparison, written before the 10:30 11-12 ruling); - ENTRY48_LOG :51, ENTRY48_NODE_PF :47, ENTRY48_BALLS :55, HOST_JSON_DIR :56; - _k_c32 :354–364 lazily imports C32's module. - Entry 48's log is now gzipped: docs/testing/logs/20261102T080008Z_GEO-36-step9-I36.log.gz (41 719 B, housekeeping f7f8f460). _read_log reads it; cite the base name 20261102T080008Z_GEO-36-step9-I36.log. The block runs from :12062 ((Z) node 193.5996 pF) to :12502 (wrote …/i36-node-193.5996.json): - arm M :12491, its Y_in :12494; arm R :12495, its Y_in :12498; - tip :12501, degree 1:. - Entry 62's log docs/testing/logs/20261114T080009Z_GEO-38-C19.log (1 638 873 B, uncompressed): - It has exactly one [GEO-36 I36a] … (Z) node line, :24756 (185.7629 pF). The log's only other (Z) node line is :12160, tagged [GEO-38 C6a], and _RX_NODE (:117) does not match it. So parse_i36_log(path) reads one block with no at_line: :24756–:25196 (wrote /workspace/logs/geo36/i36-node-185.7629-d2.json). - In the block: arm M :25185, Y_in :25188; arm R :25189, Y_in :25192; tip :25195 reads degree 2:. - The tip line carries the four balls in entry 48's order (top, bottom, top_apex, bottom_apex) and eta_rod(T1 = …) = |E_M|/|E_R| 3.443491 (valid True; printed). The T1 tuple is entry 48's exactly. - Every one of these lines prints once in the -n 16 log (rank 0 only). So each match is exactly one distinct line with count 1 (the 10:30 11-12 ruling). - Call 2's knobs: FEM_EM_GEO36_S8_DRIVE_DEGREE=2 and the node, :12; rc2=0 :25454. - The tokens (the logs' own strings), degree 1 (entry 48) | degree 2 (entry 62): - Q top 4.460568 | 4.145285; bottom 4.428040 | 4.133394; top_apex 4.413534 | 4.116078; bottom_apex 4.341688 | 4.089076; - η_rod(T1) 3.642324 | 3.443491; - arm M share 3.740924e-05 | 3.133232e-05; arm R share 4.082742e-06 | 4.084342e-06; - arm M P_vol 2.538288262e-03 | 2.452173476e-03 W. - These match the weekly's quoted figures (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4904–4905: 4.145 / 4.133 / 4.116 / 4.089, 3.443491, 3.1332e-05). - The host JSONs logs/geo36/i36-node-193.5996.json (5 122 B) and logs/geo36/i36-node-185.7629-d2.json (5 126 B) are present on this host. They have the same keys (M, R, c_pf, census_m, degree, eta_t1, feeds, q), and the d2 JSON's degree is 2. They are custody only, and they are absent on a clone. - Premise corrected (1): the (Deg) check. parse_i36_log runs on entry 62 unedited, but C45's check_side hard-codes (Deg) degree 1 (:242–243). So require_side raises on entry 62 by construction. C56 does not edit C45. It calls check_side and requires that the only failing entry is "<name> (Deg) degree 1", with detail degree 2. It then asserts its own (Deg2). - Premise corrected (2): "a move > 2 % on a per-watt figure". The weekly's named rod figures are normaliser-free ratios: Q = SAR_1g(M)/SAR_1g(R) with both arms under the same (1, +1j) drive, η = |E_M|/|E_R|, and the share = rod / P_vol. None of them is a per-watt figure. Call 2 prints no P_acc: the log's only P_acc token is call 1's :12410. So the block's only power normaliser is each arm's P_vol. - The brief applies the exit's threshold (0.02, as the ans:11 page's ORDER_RULE_REL, 11_f_clinical_1p5t_box_loaded_64MHz.py:745) to the weekly's named figures, as the weekly wrote. - It adds SAR_1g(M) / P_vol(M) per ball as the one per-watt form the block supports. - The verdict names each row over the threshold and its class (ratio or per-watt). Whether a normaliser-free ratio is a "per-watt figure" under the 10-24 rule is the 11-16 weekly's question. - Premise noted (3): the node changed too. Every move mixes the order change with the node change (193.5996 → 185.7629 pF), as C37's did (ANS-11.md § item 983 Outcome, caveat). C56 cannot separate the two, and says so in its printed verdict. - Module hold (the 03:00 11-15 digest, PROJECT_PLAN.md:3985–3989). C56 is one new module and edits nothing. - Its one test-module import is C45's module. - An AST walk of the forward import closures at this review: entry 64's module reaches 69 modules, entry 65's 55, entry 69's 116. None contains C45's module. C45's importers are only tests/package/test_wf17_clinical_rod_records_page.py and I88's reader. - C45 lazily imports C32's test_geo36_rod_f_clinical_3t_drive.py (:356). That module is in entry 69's closure, but importing a held module is always allowed, and C56 does not call _k_c32 anyway. - Result: the hold is not engaged; takeable before 11-28.

Code. One new file, tests/validation/test_geo36_c56_rod_degree2_reader.py. Every existing file stays byte-identical. - Imports: import tests.validation.test_geo36_c40_rod_frequency_reader as c45 (plus stdlib and pytest). No other test module, no src/, no dolfinx. - Constants: - ENTRY62_LOG = c45.TRACKED_LOG_DIR / "20261114T080009Z_GEO-38-C19.log"; - ENTRY62_NODE_PF = "185.7629"; - ENTRY62_JSON = c45.HOST_JSON_DIR / "i36-node-185.7629-d2.json"; - ORDER_RULE_REL = 0.02, commented "the 10-24 exit's pre-registered threshold, as the ans:11 page's ORDER_RULE_REL; not a band set here"; - ORDER_RULE_FIRES = "clinical rod figures quoted at degree 2 only, degree-1 values as records beside them" and ORDER_RULE_QUIET = "the 2 % order rule does not fire"; - TAG = "[GEO-36 C56]"; - WEEKLY_QUOTED = the six strings of PROJECT_PLAN.md:4904–4905, each with its format: Q at .3f, η as the string, the share at .4e. Every literal has ≤ 7 significant digits. - check_degree2(block, node_pf, name). - It takes res = c45.check_side(block, node_pf, name), prints every line, and requires that the failing names are exactly [f"{name} (Deg) degree 1"] with detail "degree 2". - It appends (f"{name} (Deg2) degree 2", block["tip"]["degree"] == "2", …). - It raises AssertionError naming every other failure. - rod_rows(block) returns [(row, cls, value)]: - the rule rows: q.<ball> ×4, eta_t1 and share.M (cls="ratio"), and sar_m_per_p_vol.<ball> ×4 (cls="per-watt", SAR_M / arm M's P_vol); - the printed-only rows (cls="printed", never in the rule): share.R (the gel twin's floor), sar_r_per_p_vol.<ball> ×4, arm M's p_vol and rod. - moves_and_rule(b1, b2). - Per row it computes f"{x2 / x1 - 1:+.3e}" (C37's form, ≤ 4 significant digits). - rows_over = the rule rows with |move| > ORDER_RULE_REL; the sentence is FIRES if any, else QUIET. - It returns the table and {"threshold", "rows_over", "rule_rows", "sentence"}. The verdict is printed, not asserted. - print_c56(b1, b2) prints: - one line per row: degree 1 | degree 2 | move | class | over; - Im Y_in per arm and feed, degree 1 | degree 2, side by side and never as a ratio (C45's form); - the verdict line: {TAG} order rule (threshold 0.02; the node moved 193.5996 -> 185.7629 pF with the order): rows over [...] -> "<sentence>". - custody_values(block, path) wraps c45.custody_json. Following the 10:30 11-12 ruling, a mismatch whose two strings are equal as values (float, complex, or equal repr lists) moves to print_form_only and is printed; any other mismatch is a value mismatch. Without the JSON it returns None and prints "absent; custody not run". - Nodes (no knob; both logs are tracked): 1. test_c56_x62_d62 — (X62): one block, node 185.7629, block lines :24756–:25196 printed, balls == c45.ENTRY48_BALLS in order, feeds ("P33", "P41") on both arms, degree "2", η valid "True". (D62) is check_degree2 green. 2. test_c56_x48_d48 — c45.parse_i36_log(c45.ENTRY48_LOG), then c45.require_side(b48, c45.ENTRY48_NODE_PF, …) (degree 1, unedited). The node and ball names are asserted as in C45's _read_entry48, without _k_c32. 3. test_c56_k_weekly — (K-wk): each parsed degree-2 token, at the weekly's quoted digits, equals WEEKLY_QUOTED. 4. test_c56_moves_rule — prints the table and the verdict (the record). It asserts the row set and classes (10 rule rows, the printed-only rows apart) and that every move is computed from the parsed strings. 5. test_c56_j_custody — (J62r) / (J48): with each host JSON present, value mismatches == []; n_fields and any print_form_only are printed. Item 906 measured 29 fields on entry 48. Absent ⇒ printed and passed (a clone). 6. Controls test_c56_n_deg, _n_digit62, _n_blocks62, _n_rule and _n_custody, as below. Rank 0 writes the tmp copies on tmp_path and broadcasts the path, through C45's _on_root (C45's _renamed_copy pattern).

Gates (asserted; no band set or moved). - (X62); (D62) — C45's half-unit (D-Q) on the four balls and (D-share) on both arms, imported unchanged — plus (Node) and η valid; (Deg2). - (X48) / (D48), as C45's. - (K-wk). - (J62r) / (J48) value custody where the JSONs exist. - Predicted (the review's arithmetic on the tokens, unlogged): - (D-Q) rel 2.421e-08 … 4.522e-07 against bounds 7.092e-07 … 7.141e-07 (bottom's is the tightest, at 64 % of its bound); - (D-share) arm M 9.910e-08 ≤ 1.598e-07, arm R 3.863e-08 ≤ 1.231e-07. - Entry 48's side is C45's measured green (item 906 Outcome).

Negative controls (asserted). - (N-deg): entry 48's block through check_degree2 raises, naming (Deg2) — the degree-1 block is refused. - (N-digit62): in a tmp copy of entry 62's log, top's Q is changed in its 4th decimal (4.145285 → 4.145385, rel 2.4e-05, ≈ 34× the 7.1e-07 bound — ample). check_side's failing set is then exactly {(D-Q) top, (Deg) degree 1}, and check_degree2 raises naming (D-Q) top. - (N-blocks62): a tmp copy with :24756 duplicated in place makes parse_i36_log raise "2 I36a blocks". - (N-rule): on synthetic row pairs, a rule row at × 1.019 gives QUIET; × 1.021 gives FIRES, naming that row; a printed-only row at × 1.5 gives QUIET. This is the threshold's ceiling: the rule resolves ±0.1 % around 2 %. - (N-custody) (host JSON present only; otherwise printed and skipped): a tmp copy of the d2 JSON with q.top scaled by 1 + 1e-5 gives exactly one value mismatch, q.top. The .6f print resolves 2.4e-07 relative, so the margin is ≈ 40×.

Printed (the record): - the C56 table; - Im Y_in side by side: arm M P33 −1.255086443e-03 | −5.219706121e-04 S, P41 +2.956504218e-03 | +2.416937460e-03 S (no sign flip between the two 1.5 T roots); - the verdict line. - Expected readings (the review's unlogged arithmetic; a miss above one unit in the 4th digit is disclosed, never red): - Q −7.068e-02 / −6.654e-02 / −6.740e-02 / −5.818e-02; - η −5.459e-02; - arm M share −1.624e-01; - SAR_M / P_vol −7.378e-02 / −6.934e-02 / −7.089e-02 / −6.187e-02; - printed only: the gel twin's SAR_R / P_vol −3.309e-03 / −2.978e-03 / −3.728e-03 / −3.894e-03, arm R share +3.919e-04, arm M P_vol −3.393e-02, rod power −1.909e-01. - So the rule is predicted to fire on all 10 rule rows, matching the weekly's Q ≈ −5 … −8 %. The gel twin's per-P_vol SAR moves < 0.4 %: the move sits at the rod tip. That is a reading for the weekly, not a claim.

Windows (bare and foreground, Bash timeout: 660000; docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 reads 0 first): - W0 (-n 2, the rank check, with C45 as an unedited regression): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-36-C56-W0 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 180 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/validation/test_geo36_c56_rod_degree2_reader.py tests/validation/test_geo36_c40_rod_frequency_reader.py -v -s --tb=short'". Expect, per rank by token: 4 (test_complex_mode.py) + 10 (C56) + 11 (C45) passed, and 1 skipped (C45's knob-gated reader, knob unset). C45's 15 / 1 with test_complex_mode.py is 20261109T103547Z_GEO-38-item918-W0-C45-r2.log. - W1-n1 (the record, the step's -n 1): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-36-C56-W1-n1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 120 mpiexec -n 1 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/validation/test_geo36_c56_rod_degree2_reader.py -v -s --tb=short'". Expect 14 passed. At -n 2 the tables print once per rank, so W1-n1 is the log the Outcome quotes. - No page changes, so there is no docrefs window.

Price / Tier / Class / Cost. - Standard (the step's label), -n 2 then -n 1, complex build (C45's precedent windows; the module itself imports no dolfinx). No solve. - Class: chain step (no solve). Cost: ≈ 10.8 measured (class median) / 30 predicted min. - C45's windows ran 2–3 s (20261109T043413Z_GEO-36-C45-W1.log, 20261112T104117Z_GEO-36-C40-W1-n1.log). Parsing the 1.6 MB entry-62 log plus two tmp copies adds ≈ 2 s per call. Both windows together are under 30 s; the rest is writing the module.

Traps already paid for. - Items 906 / 967's lists apply. - Never edit C45's module. Its (Deg) degree 1 is its design; I88's reader and the wf17 page import it. - A reader requires exactly one distinct match with the count printed, and never takes "the first" (10:30 11-12). parse_i36_log already raises on any count but 1. Print the count of [GEO-36 I36a] … (Z) node lines (1). - Custody compares values; a print-form-only difference is printed, not red. - -n 2 prints every table once per rank: count verdicts per rank, by token, and quote W1-n1. - Entry 48's log is .gz: read it through c45._read_log, cite the base name, and never gunzip it. - Tmp copies live on tmp_path; rank 0 writes, then broadcasts. - Write nothing under /workspace/logs/geo36: entry 62's d2 JSON is the custody evidence. - The leak hook (MIN_SIGNIFICANT_DIGITS = 8): derived prints use +.3e / .4e, and raw tokens are the tracked logs' own. On a refusal, move the log unchanged to logs/leak-held/, name the hook's line by number only, and never use --no-verify. - Bare foreground harness calls, Bash timeout: 660000, container timeout -k 30, pytest -s, no -k. docs.text:
Drafted by a read-only Plan agent and reviewed by the 2026-10-02 18:00 daily review.

GEO-2 / GEO-6 / GEO-7: one CAD-identity QA utility. This is the 09-30 weekly's target. - Executor: implementer. Tier: standard, real build, -n 2 then -n 1. - Cost: ≈ 4 measured / ≈ 35 predicted min. - Depends on: nothing. Attempt: 1 of 4.

Why these rows were rejected before (09-29 18:00 review §6): GEO-7 was string formatting, GEO-6 had no identity on graded cells (its report compares cell-count ratios), and GEO-2's title and code disagree. This item gives all three one volume-identity anchor.

Code (additive, rule (c) disclosure): src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh_qa.py. - New function:

cad_identity_report(mesh, cell_tags, *, expected_tags, box_volume=None, exact_volumes=None, record_volumes=None, rtol=1e-9, comm=None) - It returns a frozen CadIdentityReport with these fields: - tag_volumes, total_volume; - missing_tags, unexpected_tags; - partition_rel = |Σ_expected V_t / V_mesh − 1|; - box_rel, exact_rel{tag}, record_rel{tag}; - flags, a subset of tag_set / partition / box / exact_volume / record; - passed. - Tag sets come from owned cells only (indices < size_local), allgathered. - Volumes use tests/mesh/helpers.py:74–88's expressions verbatim: subdomain_id=(int(tag),), Constant(1.0), assemble_scalar, allreduce SUM, np.real. - Export it from io/__init__.py. The default rtol is VOLUME_PARTITION_BAND (helpers.py:71).

Test: new tests/mesh/test_mesh_qa_cad_identity.py. It imports the existing modules' constants and calls and restates none of them. - (A0) The rtol default == VOLUME_PARTITION_BAND. - (A1) Every tag_volumes[t] and total_volume == helpers.tag_volume / helpers.total_volume, bitwise, on all three meshes. - (A2) Records reproduced, with passed True on each: - R1, coil_phantom_domain (test_mesh_tag_integrity.py:35–43, called as at :101): - tag set {1, 2, 3, 4}; - record_volumes = UNIFORM_VOLUMES_RECORD (:89–94) at 1e-9, the gate's own band (:212–218), reproduced on 0.11 at 20260930T123217Z_GEO-5-W1.log:605–609; - box_volume = test_coil_phantom_conforming._analytic_box_volume() (:61–80), the identity at :129; - the partition identity (:136). - R2, two_torus_domain (test_two_torus_conforming.py:36–49, call copied from :75–84): - tag set {1, 2, 3} (:86); - box from _analytic_box_volume(…) (:52–55, identity at :97); - partition (:104). - R3, birdcage_port_domain in box-port mode at BASELINE_CONTROL_RESOLUTION 4.8e-3 (test_birdcage_conductor_sizing.py:101, call :108–123; constants test_birdcage_port_tags.py:22–32): - tag set {1, 2, 3, 101…104}; - box from test_birdcage_port_tags._analytic_box_volume() (:35–52); - partition; - exact_volumes {101…104: 0.010·0.008·0.010 = 8.0e-7}, the identities at :168–184; - cells printed against 33 185 (20260826T093202Z_GEO-21-step2-gate.log:11075), not asserted.

Negative controls (planted on the built meshes, no remesh). Each verdict pattern is asserted, since it holds by construction of the plant. Each numeric miss is predicted and printed beside the reading (rule (e)). - (N1) Tag merged. Relabel every R1 tag-3 value to 4 (owned and ghost). - Expect flags == {tag_set} (missing {3}), with partition and box still ≤ 1e-9. - Pass no records. - (N2) Ungrouped cell. Drop one owned tag-3 cell from R1's MeshTags, on the lowest rank that owns one. - Expect flags == {partition}. - The miss is that cell's volume / V_mesh, predicted ≥ 1e-7 (≥ 100× the band) and printed. - (N3) Port box re-tagged (GEO-2). Re-tag one owned tag-101 cell to 2 on R3. - Expect flags == {exact_volume}, for 101 only. - The miss is that cell's volume / 8e-7, predicted ≥ 1e-3 and printed.

Windows. Foreground, Bash timeout: 660000, each harness call bare and whole. - W1 (≈ 90 s):

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh GEO-7-W1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 180 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/mesh/test_mesh_qa_cad_identity.py tests/io/test_mesh_qa_diagnostics.py tests/mesh/test_mesh_tag_integrity.py tests/mesh/test_geometry_sanity_report.py tests/mesh/test_birdcage_port_tags.py::test_birdcage_port_layout_diagnostics_match_the_closed_forms tests/mesh/test_birdcage_port_tags.py::test_birdcage_port_layout_rejects_too_small_or_overlapping_port_regions -v -s --tb=short'" - W2 (≈ 40 s): the same with -n 1, labelled GEO-7-W2, and only tests/environment tests/mesh/test_mesh_qa_cad_identity.py.

Read owned cells only. - Test selection: never select with -k; node IDs are fine. Import constants and helpers only, never test_* names. - Do not run the ungraded birdcage partition test. It is red; that is item 186's business. Items 184 and 186 both read test_birdcage_port_tags.py, but only 186 edits it. They are independent. - Run hygiene: use -s. Make no edit after the last window (rule (i)).

Negative result: - (A1) not bitwise: the expression differs. Fix it once, then park. - An (A2) record misses 1e-9: the generator drifted. Print every reading, open a known-issues entry, and stop. Never re-record in-slot. - A plant raises a second flag, or misses its own: stop. - On any stop: park on attempt/GEO-7-<UTC> and mark BLOCKED in the same commit (rule (d)). - There is no PREDICTED RED line.

Outcome — DONE 2026-10-03 (19:30 CDT slot, implementer).

Windows: - W1 (-n 2): 20261003T005340Z_GEO-7-W1.log, 91 s, 25 passed, 4 skipped. The skips are the complex-only environment tests. - W2 (-n 1): 20261003T005520Z_GEO-7-W2.log, 73 s, 15 passed, 4 skipped.

Partition and box are ≤ 4.2e-15. - R2, two_torus_domain: partition and box are ≤ 9.1e-15. - R3, the birdcage: the four port boxes read 8.000000000e-07, with exact_rel ≤ 4.4e-16. Partition and box are ≤ 1.6e-14. Cells are 33 185, equal to the record (printed only).

Controls: - (N1) {tag_set}, missing {3}. - (N2) {partition}. The miss is 1.88e-5 / 2.33e-5 against a predicted ≥ 1e-7. The cell differs per width. - (N3) {exact_volume}, tag 101 only. The miss is 4.17e-2 against a predicted ≥ 1e-3.

Disclosed (rule (c)): the change to io/mesh_qa.py and io/__init__.py is additive. src/ cannot import tests/, so the default band is a module constant, CAD_IDENTITY_RTOL = 1e-9. (A0) asserts it equals helpers.VOLUME_PARTITION_BAND.

GEO-2, GEO-6 and GEO-7 all go 🧪 → ✅.

Audit, 2026-10-03 03:00 daily review (§4; one auditor per row). Item 184 shares two windows across three rows. - GEO-2: PASS. The anchors are report.flags == frozenset() (test :211–212) and the N3 flag pattern (:289–291). The layout tests ran at -n 2 only, which is what the Done-when asks for. - GEO-6: PASS on substance. The auditor's DEMOTE was on the tier word alone, and this review overrules it. The row read "smoke" against windows of 91 s (W1) and 73 s (…005520Z_GEO-7-W2.log:2071–2073), so the tier is relabelled standard with no re-run.
