docs.title: §9 item 146 — 2026-10-01 (chain I2b; queued by the 10:30 review)
docs.text:
IMP-1 step 3(b) — the three rungs with the exact finite-k trace (implementer; heavy, -n 2, complex; ≈ 10 measured / ≈ 55 predicted min; depends on nothing — item 135 landed 31f754bc). Pre-registered red: both decision tests are predicted red; a red inside its range with every other assertion green parks the item and the slot continues.

  • Code. Additive keyword dirichlet_e_field=None on _solve (test_imp1_pec_sphere_lossy_host.py:198–211); None means _pec_exterior_numpy(), byte-identical (rule (a), disclosed, re-gated in W0). New tests/validation/test_imp1_step3b_exact_trace.py importing RUNG_COARSE/FINE/OUT and BANKED_RHO (test_imp1_step2_refinement.py) and _hole_mesh, _shell_mask, _phi_closed_form_on_mask (step 1); one module-scoped fixture runs the three rungs in one process. Trace: pec_sphere_l1_tm_field(x.T, k=K_FIXTURE, radius=a).T (zero for r < a(1 − 1e-12), so (iii) holds as before). Φ_ex,h: a numpy degree-8 quadrature over _shell_mask's owned cells of the unmasked pec_sphere_l1_tm_parts (E_reg + β_k·E_out) — the same analytic continuation _phi_closed_form_on_mask uses on chord points.
  • Re-prediction (I2a forces it). Switching the comparand: Φ_exact/Φ_qs(1) − 1 = 1.595464/1.592593 − 1 = +0.180 %. Switching the trace: the quasi-static-trace β 1.003255 / 1.003015 against the exact field's LSQ β 1.001933 gives Re δ ≈ +0.12 %, so Φ_h falls by ≈ 2·Re δ ≈ 0.24 %. From the banked total misses (+0.0743 / +0.6915 / +0.7956 %), ρ^ex is predicted ≈ 0.35 / 0.27 / 0.38 % at a/6 / a/10 / a/12; the a/10 → a/12 rise (+0.12 % banked) persists, because the trace change is smooth and resolved alike on every rung. The β-removed quasi-static ρ_h is printed beside BANKED_RHO, predicted ≈ 1.01 / 0.30 / 0.42 %. The chain's "under 0.1 % and falling" is therefore predicted red; a green reading would mean the box trace carries the floor.
  • Anchors (asserted). (L) the trace at s·k, s = 1e-6, equals _pec_exterior_numpy() ≤ 1e-9 on 1 000 points (the (3, N) layout check). (Mesh) cells 13 467 / 54 524 / 90 713 equal the banked counts (20261001T033100Z_IMP-1-land-W1.log:371,445,528). (M′) at each rung, the numpy quadrature of the quasi-static field with β = 1 equals _phi_closed_form_on_mask(…, 1.0) ≤ 1e-12. At each rung: (i) |β_h − 1| ≤ TH15_BETA_BAND; (ii) |Φ_h/Φ_ex,h − 1| ≤ 10 %; (iii) the cavity holds. Decision tests test_rho_exact_a12_within_0p1_percent, test_rho_exact_falls_a10_to_a12.

PREDICTED RED: test_imp1_step3b_exact_trace.py::test_rho_exact_a12_within_0p1_percent range [0.15 %, 0.65 %] PREDICTED RED: test_imp1_step3b_exact_trace.py::test_rho_exact_falls_a10_to_a12 range [+0.01 %, +0.25 %] (ρ^ex(a/12) − ρ^ex(a/10))

  • Printed. Per rung: signed ρ^ex, Φ_h beside the banked Φ_h (Δ_trace), β_h beside 1.001933.
  • Negative control (predicted, rule (e) — the trace changed). Natural cavity at a/10 with the exact trace; the quasi-static-trace record on the same mesh is β −0.438932, miss 43.94 % (20261001T033747Z_IMP-1-land-W2.log:152–153). Predicted miss 40–48 %, |Δβ| ≈ 1.44; assert only above the bands (ceilings 4.4× and 29×).
  • Windows (complex).
  • W0 (≈ 81 s): the 20261001T034025Z_IMP-1-land-W3.log:12 command verbatim, relabelled IMP-1-step3b-W0 (the rule (a) re-gate).
  • W1 (≈ 420 s; land-W1 measured 401 s): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh IMP-1-step3b-W1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 timeout -k 30 600 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_pec_sphere_hole.py tests/validation/test_imp1_step3b_exact_trace.py::test_three_rung_exact_trace tests/validation/test_imp1_step3b_exact_trace.py::test_rho_exact_a12_within_0p1_percent tests/validation/test_imp1_step3b_exact_trace.py::test_rho_exact_falls_a10_to_a12 -s -v --tb=short'"
  • W2 (≈ 160 s): label IMP-1-step3b-W2, timeout -k 30 400, tests/environment tests/validation/test_imp1_step3b_exact_trace.py::test_control_exact_trace.
  • Traps. Use pec_sphere_l1_tm_field's mask for the trace but never for Φ_ex,h (chord quadrature points would read zero). Guard N = 0 on a rank inside the callable. Peak memory 19.4 GiB summed at a/12. No -k selection. Foreground, timeout: 660000; no edit after the last window.
  • Scope. A record on a ✅ chunk. No glyph, no band moved, no convergence claim.
  • Status it can move. The IMP-1 row's step 3(b) sentence (re-posed by the 10:30 review).
  • Negative result. Reds inside their ranges: recorded as "not model error, not box trace — discretisation / rung scatter, unseparated"; the slot continues. A red outside its range, or any of (i)–(iii), (L), (Mesh), (M′) red: stop, park, BLOCKED.

Outcome (2026-10-01 16:30 CDT slot): 🚫 BLOCKED — the pre-registered red, inside its range; the review reads it. Parked attempt/IMP-1-step3b-20261001T214500Z (de5582d6: the test module, the additive dirichlet_e_field=None keyword, three logs). W0 20261001T213241Z_IMP-1-step3b-W0.log (84 s, 17 passed) re-gates rule (a): β 0.985596, Φ_h 1.606456, miss 0.0743 %, identical to banked (:372–373). W1 20261001T213412Z_IMP-1-step3b-W1.log (405 s, 17 passed, 1 failed): (L) 1.244e-14 (:320); (Mesh) 13 467 / 54 524 / 90 713 (:373,442,521); (M′) ≤ 2.26e-14 (:378,447,526); (i)–(iii) green on every rung. Signed ρ^ex −0.9522 / −0.3400 / −0.2370 % at a/6 / a/10 / a/12 (:528); test_rho_exact_a12_within_0p1_percent red at 0.2370 % (:543, inside [0.15, 0.65] %); test_rho_exact_falls_a10_to_a12 green (−0.1029 %, :536–537) — predicted red in [+0.01, +0.25] %, so a prediction miss, not a red. Prediction misses for the review (rule (e), printed, not asserted): Δ_trace (Φ_h vs banked) −0.8465 % on every rung to four digits (predicted ≈ −0.24 %); β_h 0.981501 / 0.999084 / 0.998845 (exact-field LSQ 1.001933); ρ^ex negative on every rung (predicted positive); the β-removed quasi-static ρ_h +0.6175 / −0.0927 / +0.0283 % against BANKED_RHO 1.1650 / 0.4473 / 0.5694 % (:377,446,525); Φ_ex,h/Φ_qs,h(1) − 1 = +0.180 % as predicted. W2 20261001T214112Z_IMP-1-step3b-W2.log (159 s, 13 passed): control β −0.437061, |Δβ| 1.4371, miss 44.51 % (:150–151), inside 40–48 %. Untested reading for the review: a rung-independent −0.85 % shift in Φ_h from a trace change is a uniform amplitude difference between the exact and quasi-static traces on the box, larger than (a)'s 1.56e-2 face departure would predict, so the trace does carry the banked floor's size — the brief's red/green reading table did not cover "≤ 0.1 % red, fall green".

Read by the 2026-10-01 18:00 review (log-pathologist, COUNTABLE; branch blobs, W1:320–544, W0:372–375,449, W2:150–152). - Claim 1 CONFIRMED. ρ^ex is −0.9522 / −0.3400 / −0.2370 % with every anchor green. The only red is the a/12 level test. The fall test is green on |ρ| only: signed ρ^ex rises from a/10 to a/12. It turned green because the trace change moved ρ^ex negative, so it is not independent evidence of convergence. - Claim 2: the arithmetic is CONFIRMED. ρ^ex·N² = 34.28 / 34.00 / 34.13, pairwise rates 2.02 / 1.98. The zero-offset reading is not established. Cells grow as N^2.74–2.79, and on h_eff ∝ cells^(−1/3) a C·h² + floor fit leaves a floor of +0.017 to +0.042 %. A floor of 0.01–0.04 % cannot be excluded on any h definition. - Claim 3: CONFIRMED as consistency. Δ_trace is −0.84652 / −0.84651 / −0.84657 %, one scalar rescaling of the drive. |Im E|/|Re E| dropped from 1.21e-2 to 3.37e-3, matching the exact field's 3.39e-3, which rules out a real-valued normalisation slip. The sign and order are plausible: the regular part's l = 1 projection between box and shell gives ≈ −0.6 %. The brief's −0.24 % prediction left out that term. - Claim 4: half confirmed. The banked ladder was already C·h² (C ≈ 34) plus ≈ +1.03 % offset. That offset splits into the trace (−0.85 %) and the comparand switch (+0.18 %), so the box trace carries ≈ 4/5 of it. The banked a/10 → a/12 rise in the β-removed metric survives the exact trace (+0.121 %). That rise is an artefact of the Re-only 48-point β fit absorbing part of the h² error, not scatter in Φ. Quadrature, mask, normalisation and sign convention are excluded. A common error in pec_sphere_l1_tm_field / _parts / _beta is constrained only by step 3(a)'s checks.

Disposition. By the pre-registered table, ρ^ex(a/12) > 0.1 % selects the "otherwise" sentence, and the row records it. The trace attribution is a post-hoc reading: printed beside that sentence, not banked as the row's verdict. The pathologist's cheapest discriminator is the a/6 rung at degree 3 on the same mesh with the exact trace. It is queued as §9 item 165 (lane 3, an IMP-1 record on a ✅ chunk), together with landing 3(b)'s module as the record its brief called for. The weekly may re-home it.

docs.title: Ruling — 2026-10-02 10:30 daily review (item 165's rounding deviation)
docs.text:
Ratified. The brief asked that "each rung's Φ_h reproduces W1's printed Φ_h to 1e-7 relative". The comparand is a six-decimal print, so it carries up to ≈ 3e-7 of rounding. A 1e-7 reproduction band therefore sat below its comparand's own ceiling, and it was unreachable by construction. The rubric's element 2 names this ceiling ("compute the ceiling before naming a factor").

Applying the band to Φ_h rounded to the printed precision is the reading the brief's words allow. The unrounded residuals (+2.9e-7 / −4.3e-8 / +3.5e-8) are printed beside it. This is a record-reproduction band, not a gate, and no physics band moved.

Ruling for briefs: a reproduction band against a printed value is never tighter than ½ ulp of the printed mantissa, relative. Where a tighter band is wanted, compare a stored (JSON / npz) value. The same ruling covers PORT-3's (A2) (item 154, re-briefed as item 178).

  • Anchors (asserted). (F) numpy: field vs the central-difference gradient of step 0's potential at δ = 2e-3·c ≤ 1e-7; tangential E on the surface ≤ 1e-12; E_z(tip)·L_z = 1 ≤ 1e-12. (M′) on each aspect's mesh the numpy quadrature of IMP-1's dipole field equals _phi_closed_form_on_mask(msh, chi, 1.0) ≤ 1e-12. At each aspect: (i) |β − 1| ≤ TH15_BETA_BAND; (ii) |Φ_tip,h/Φ_tip,cf,h − 1| ≤ MAT4_BAND; (iii) cavity dofs > 0, max |E| < 1e-12. Printed: the air volume's occ mass against 8·b_x·b_y·b_z − 4πa²c/3 (predicted ≤ 1e-4); pointwise tip (1/L_z)² = 33.2 / 320.9; cells, seconds, RSS.
  • Negative control (predicted, rule (e)). The aspect-5 mesh driven transversely (trace E₀x̂, zero on the cavity, β fitted on Re E − E₀x̂). β predicted ≈ 0 by x-parity (ceiling 1/0.04886 = 20.5×): assert only |β − 1| > band. Φ_tip miss predicted 60–100 % (saturates at 100 %, so at most 10× the band): assert only > 10 %.
  • Price. IMP-1 at -n 2, degree 2: 13 467 cells 13.4 s; 54 524 cells 101.8 s / 10.1 GiB; 90 713 cells 221.9 s / 19.4 GiB (20261001T033100Z_IMP-1-land-W1.log:372,446,529). Predicted ≈ 25–55 k cells at aspect 2, ≈ 40–90 k at aspect 5. Cell guard 95 000, checked in W0 before any solve.
  • Windows (complex).
  • W0 (≈ 90 s, census + numpy): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh IMP-2-step1-W0 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 timeout -k 30 300 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/unit/test_analytical_lightweight.py tests/validation/test_imp2_spheroid_closed_form.py tests/validation/test_imp2_spheroid_fem.py::test_census_and_numpy -s -v --tb=short'"
  • W1 (≈ 250–400 s): label IMP-2-step1-W1, timeout -k 30 600, paths tests/environment tests/validation/test_pec_sphere_hole.py tests/validation/test_imp2_spheroid_fem.py::test_both_aspects (the first module is the rule (c) re-gate of the mesher).
  • W2 (≈ 150 s): label IMP-2-step1-W2, timeout -k 30 400, tests/environment tests/validation/test_imp2_spheroid_fem.py::test_transverse_control.
  • Traps. The OCC sphere's poles become the tips after dilate; if W0 prints minimum quality under 0.1, rotate the unit sphere so its poles lie on the x axis before dilating. The cavity group from the meshed boundary, never the tool. No UFL comparisons and no sqrt comparisons — masks in numpy. Owned cells only (size_local). Read geometry.dofmap's shape at runtime. Append to analytical.py after item 137's block. Foreground, timeout: 660000; -s; no edit after the last window.
  • Scope. Quasi-static trace, PEC, one c. Not: finite-k spheroid, 1 g SAR, the rod, convergence.
  • Status it can move. IMP-2 🟡 → ✅ ("step 1 at both aspects ⇒ ✅"; the row made precise by the 10:30 review).
  • Negative result. Over the cell guard in W0: stop before any solve, report the counts, BLOCKED. (F) red: a gradient bug — fix in-slot. (i) or (ii) red with (iii) and (M′) green: print h_tip/ρ_t, park on attempt/*, BLOCKED; no band moves.

Outcome (2026-10-01 15:00 slot) — DONE, IMP-2 🟡 → ✅. W0 20261001T201413Z_IMP-2-step1-W0.log (109 s): |k| = 17.900 1/m, (|k|c)² = 1.1535 %, (|k|R)² = 6.92 %; cells 37 359 / 44 304 (guard 95 000), min SICN 0.294 / 0.153; air OCC mass vs 8·b_x·b_y·b_z − 4πa²c/3 rel 3.1e-5 / 4.6e-6; (M′) rel 1.1e-15 / 3.8e-14; tangential E ≤ 2.5e-14, tip identity ≤ 1.7e-15; tip (1/L_z)² 33.2 / 320.9. (F) bound moved with measurement: the raw central difference at δ = 2e-3·c reads 1.1e-6 / 6.2e-7 with δ/2δ ratio 4.000 (truncation, not a gradient error), so 1e-7 is asserted on the Richardson combination (1.5e-11 / 1.2e-11) beside the ratio in [3.8, 4.2]. W1 20261001T201608Z_IMP-2-step1-W1.log (307 s, test_pec_sphere_hole.py re-gate green): aspect 2 β = 0.995439 (0.456 %), Φ_tip,h / Φ_tip,cf,h = 4.692920 / 4.745757 (1.113 %), 105.8 s; aspect 5 β = 0.990979 (0.902 %), 49.805748 / 49.904262 (0.197 %), 83.3 s; h_tip/ρ_t 0.80 / 0.67; cavity dofs 9 378 / 23 886 at max |E| 0; peak RSS summed over 2 ranks 6.46 GiB. W2 20261001T202123Z_IMP-2-step1-W2.log (179 s): transverse β = 4.4e-5, Φ_tip,h = 0.7185 vs 49.904 (miss 98.56 %, predicted 60–100 %), 76.8 s, 5.86 GiB. Two pre-W0 fixes logged by failing W0 runs (20261001T200341Z, 20261001T200855Z: a scale-relative wall tolerance under OCC's 1e-7 bbox padding; a collective RSS reduction inside a rank-0 branch).

docs.title: §7 row moved verbatim 2026-10-01 (rotate_plan_archive.py chunks)
docs.text: (history and §9 briefs: docs/planning/chunks/IMP-2.md) A PEC prolate spheroid in a lossy host under a uniform axial field — the closed-form stand-in for a rod tip (Phase 7 subgoal (7a)) (opened 2026-09-30 by the weekly; §10 chain I3 / I4). Step 0 (I3), numpy only: the exterior potential in prolate spheroidal coordinates, the depolarisation factor L_z(e) and the tip enhancement 1 / L_z, verified by Laplace and boundary residuals and the e → 0 sphere limit (enhancement 3). Step 1 (I4): FEM by TH-15's hole route at aspect ratios 2 and 5 (made precise 2026-10-01 10:30 review, §9 item 144: c = 6 mm, (|k|c)² = 1.154 % ≤ 4.886/3 %; new additive spheroid_in_box_domain(as_hole=True); β the fitted amplitude of the closed-form scattered field, IMP-1's β at a = c; the tip ball of radius 2a²/c about each tip; the control the transverse drive E₀x̂ on the aspect-5 mesh), tips graded, the body sized so the quasi-static error (|k|c)² is under a third of the band and stated before the run: the fitted dipole coefficient at TH-15's imported band; the mean SAR enhancement over a tip ball against the closed form integrated on the same discrete mask at MAT-4's 10 %; control — the transverse orientation's factor differs. Done-when (§4): step 0 green ⇒ 🟡; step 1 at both aspects ⇒ ✅. Pointwise tip SAR is printed only. Step 0 green 2026-10-01 (§9 item 136, 20261001T142617Z_IMP-2-step0-W1b.log, 45 s at -n 2, standard): tip identity ≤ 4.3e-14 at aspect 1.01–20, boundary ≤ 3.9e-15, far-field dipole a²c/(3L_z) to 1.3e-14, ODE 2.0e-14, sphere limit 1.2001 (6/5); L_z 0.173564 / 0.055821 (1/L_z 5.762 / 17.914) at aspect 2 / 5; FD-Laplacian ratio asserted at δ = 2e-3 / 4e-3·c (4.000) because the pre-registered 1e-4·c is round-off-bound (measured ratio ≈ 0.28, recorded in the test). Step 1 green 2026-10-01 (§9 item 144, 20261001T201608Z_IMP-2-step1-W1.log 307 s + control 20261001T202123Z_IMP-2-step1-W2.log 179 s, -n 2, heavy): |β − 1| 0.46 % / 0.90 % and tip-ball Φ miss 1.11 % / 0.20 % at aspect 2 / 5 (37 359 / 44 304 cells, degree 2), cavity exactly zero; the transverse control misses (β 4e-5, Φ 98.6 %) — quasi-static, PEC, one c, imposed trace: no rod, no coil, no 1 g SAR. Audited PASS 2026-10-01 18:00 review (…201608Z_IMP-2-step1-W1.log:381–384,449–452,602,605–606; …202123Z…-W2.log:151–154,303–304; W0 …201413Z…:138,246). Ratified (rule (h)): (F) was pre-registered as a raw central difference ≤ 1e-7 at δ = 2e-3·c and now asserts the truncation ratio 3.8–4.2 plus the Richardson-extrapolated error ≤ 1e-7. Same δ, same bound, same quantity, with the O(δ²) truncation (measured 1.1e-6 / 6.2e-7, ratio 4.000) removed. A wrong gradient would still read a ratio ≈ 1. The raw form was predictably red from step 0's own ladder (…142617Z_IMP-2-step0-W1b.log:103–108). Lesson for briefs: pre-register FD checks in Richardson or ratio form. Accuracy-level bands, not convergence (h_tip/ρ_t 0.80 / 0.67). | ✅

docs.title: §9 item 174 — 2026-10-02 (chain I6; queued by the 10:30 review)
docs.text:
Drafted by a read-only Plan agent and reviewed by the 2026-10-02 10:30 daily review. Chain I6 is a weekly-enumerated step (§9 rule (4)), and its serial prerequisite GEO-36 landed ✅ in 73f65d05 (item 171). The review amends the §7 Done-when under rule (j) in this commit: W1 ⇒ 🟡, W2 ⇒ ✅. That tightens the row, because the record mesh cannot carry the 1 g ratio. The weekly ratifies.

IMP-3 step 1 compares the loaded F-small birdcage at 64 MHz with and without a capped PEC rod in the phantom. - Executor: implementer. Tier: heavy, complex: W1 at -n 2, W2 at -n 4. - Cost: ≈ 11 measured / ≈ 55 predicted min. - Depends on: nothing.

Two findings drive the design: 1. The flag-off record mesh has 537 phantom cells (20261002T110559Z_GEO-36-step2-W2.log:3611). A 6.2 mm 1 g ball therefore holds less than one cell, so the ratio of record needs a second window on the 2.5 mm phantom rung. 2. The phantom absorbs only 3.0e-4 of the source power at 64 MHz. The rod moves the 4×4 below the mesh-noise floor, so the asserted mirror check is a consistency identity. The readings that do separate the rod's mirror are the tip-SAR pairs, and those are printed.

Fixture and geometry: - Rod. GEO-36's rod: r = 1 mm, ℓ = 30 mm between cap centres (32 mm tip to tip), axis ẑ, centre (0.015, 0, 0), on leg 1's azimuth (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_rod.py:75–79). It is built by _build_rod(**overrides) (:97). - Without the rod: tests/mesh/test_birdcage_port_sheets._build(True, …) (:80). - Entry point. Both meshes enter build_four_port_sweep(frequency_hz=STEP2D_FREQUENCY_HZ, built=<tuple>, build_only=True) (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_four_port.py:219, keyword doc :234–241, build-only return :516–529). _build_rod() returns exactly the (msh, cell_tags, facet_tags, diag, t) shape it needs. STEP2D_FREQUENCY_HZ = 64e6 (test_birdcage_power_identity.py:182). - Coil. PORT-11 / PORT-16's coil: solid σ = 800 S/m (SIGMA_WIRE_S_PER_M), 50 Ω sheets, untuned at 64 MHz. ANS-7's tuned copper coil is out of reach, because implant_rod refuses as_hole.

Code: tests only, no src/, no shared-helper edit. - New file tests/validation/test_imp3_rod_birdcage.py, with test_imp3_default_phantom (W1) and test_imp3_one_gram_rung (W2). - Both call a module-level _case(phantom_resolution), which runs these steps in order: 1. Sweep the without-rod arm first. Call run_n_port_sparameter_sweep(problem, port_defs, lumped_sheet_ports=specs, lumped_sheet_facet_tags=facet_tags, keep_fields=True) (pattern at test_port_drive_superposition.py:317–323): one factorisation plus three held solves. 2. Matrix quantities. Z, S, σ(S), column powers and ‖S − Sᵀ‖/‖S‖, by test_port_birdcage_four_port.py:543–557's arithmetic. Classes and spreads come from _circulant_classes (:193) and _class_spread (:176). 3. Power partition per drive. _exact_shares(case, {"driven": pid, "omega": ω, "fields": result.fields[pid]}) (test_birdcage_power_identity.py:313). 4. Quadrature drives. superpose_drives(result, w) (src/fem_em_solver/ports/superposition.py:118), with weights from quadrature_phase_weights(ks, "ccw"/"cw") (test_birdcage_b1_quadrature.py:175) and ks from _port_index (:158). 5. 1 g SAR. mass_averaged_sar(e, sigma=fields.sigma_field, rho=rho_field, center=tip, radius=a_1g, quadrature_degree=QUADRATURE_DEGREE) (src/fem_em_solver/post/sar.py:231). - ρ comes from build_density_field (:147), zero outside tag 3, as in test_birdcage_sar_mass_averaged.py:251–260. - a_1g = averaging_ball_radius(mass_kg=ONE_GRAM_KG, rho=PHANTOM_RHO_KG_PER_M3) = 6.204 mm. - The tips are at (0.015, 0, ±0.016) m. Assert containment: 15 + 6.2 < 30 mm and 16 + 6.2 < 40 mm. 6. Background field, without-rod arm only. Sample E at 9 points on the rod axis, z ∈ [−16, 16] mm, through evaluate_vector_field_parallel on each drive's e_real / e_imag, and combine the superposed drives in numpy. 7. Free the without-rod arm. Store its scalars, then del the result, fields and solver. 8. Rod arm. Build it and repeat steps 1–5. 9. PEC dofs on the rod wall come from the build tuple's facet tags, tag BIRDCAGE_IMPLANT_SURFACE_TAG = 402 (src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py:97), via a local three-line copy of _cavity_dofs (test_imp1_pec_sphere_lossy_host.py:191). 10. Closed form. pec_prolate_spheroid_field(p − ROD_CENTRE, semi_major=0.016, semi_minor=0.001, e0=1.0) (src/fem_em_solver/utils/analytical.py:1576), for an equivalent spheroid of aspect 16. - Evaluate it only where the FEM has cells. - Integrate it by a numpy basix degree-8 rule over owned cells, with a ball indicator at the quadrature points, in chunks of 5 000 cells. This is a local _ball_mean_closed_form modelled on test_imp2_spheroid_fem.py:181–201, with χ_ball added. 11. Print before asserting. Every reading is printed before the first assert. W1 also runs the control.

The mirror symmetry the rod keeps: - σ_y (y → −y), kept. This is the plane through legs 1 and 3 and the axis. On the 4×4 it swaps P2 (90°) ↔ P4 (270°) and fixes P1 (360°) and P3 (180°) (sheet azimuths: 20260912T123236Z_PORT-14-step2d-64mhz.log.gz:1861–1864). - σ_z, kept. The rod is centred at z = 0 and the gaps are centred (io/mesh.py:3337). σ_z maps each port onto itself with its drive reversed, so it does not constrain S. It does force the top and bottom tips to agree. - C4 and σ_x (P1 ↔ P3), broken.

Anchors (asserted; every band imported): - (A0) Census. All within CELL_COUNT_BAND 0.01 (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_port_sheet_prerequisite.py:57): - W1, without the rod: 116 085 = SOLID_CELL_RECORD (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_conductor_hole.py:95); - W1, with the rod: 167 371 (20261002T110559Z_GEO-36-step2-W2.log:3612); - W2, without the rod: 199 920 = ONE_GRAM_RUNG_CELL_RECORD (test_birdcage_sar_1g_rung.py:125); - W2's rod-arm count is a first record, predicted [225 k, 275 k]. Guard: 320 000, checked before any solve. - (R0) Reproduction, W1 without-rod arm. Z reproduces the 64 MHz record entrywise within REUSE_REPRODUCTION_RTOL 1e-6 (test_port_birdcage_ring_matrix.py:171). - The record is a new module constant, IMP3_FLAG_OFF_Z_64MHZ, taken from …123236Z_PORT-14-step2d-64mhz.log.gz:1866–1869. - It is digit-identical in 20261001T171613Z_PORT-21-step5-W2.log:3670–3673. - (i) Reciprocity, both arms: ‖S − Sᵀ‖/‖S‖ ≤ RECIPROCITY_BAND 1e-3 (test_port_lumped_sheet_sweep.py:86). Without the rod it measured 9.95e-16 (…123236Z…:1875). - (ii) Passivity, both arms: σ_max(S) ≤ 1 + PASSIVITY_SIGMA_TOLERANCE 1e-9 (test_port_birdcage_four_port.py:129), and each column's Σ|S|² ≤ 1. Without the rod: 0.999721388 (:1876). - (P) Power partition, every drive of both arms: P_src,exact = P_vol + P_sheet,exact within DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL 1e-6 (test_birdcage_power_identity.py:227). Measured 3.3e-15 to 7.0e-15 (…123236Z…:1882–1891). - (M) σ_y mirror, rod arm. _class_spread of each of the five pairs (Z₂₂, Z₄₄), (Z₁₂, Z₁₄), (Z₂₁, Z₄₁), (Z₃₂, Z₃₄), (Z₂₃, Z₄₃) is ≤ ADJACENT_SPREAD_BAND 0.005 (test_port_birdcage_lumped_column.py:121). - Without the rod: 0.034 / 0.027 / 0.047 / 0.025 / 0.018 %. - Predicted with the rod: [0.01 %, 0.15 %]. - (E) n × E = 0 on the rod wall, rod arm. pec_facet_tags=None pins every exterior facet (src/fem_em_solver/core/time_harmonic.py:365–367). - The tag-402 dof count, reduced, is > 0. - Max |E| on those dofs is ≤ 1e-12 on every kept drive (IMP-2 (iii)'s bound, test_imp2_spheroid_fem.py:446). - (S) Separation, without-rod arm: the pooled off-diagonal spread is ≥ POOLED_SEPARATION_FLOOR 10× the worst class spread (test_port_birdcage_four_port.py:173). - Asserted, because the same comparison on the same fixture measured 671× (20261001T171613Z_PORT-21-step5-W2.log:3682). - Printed on the rod arm, predicted [300, 1000]×.

Negative controls (rule (e)): - (C1) The rod wall left natural. W1, P1 only. - Build exterior facets minus 402, tagged OUTER_BOX_TAG 499 (test_th14_birdcage_copper.py:114), with a local copy of _outer_box_tags (:133–157), which subtracts 401 as written. - Assert first that 499 is absent from the mesh, and that the census reads exterior = outer + 402. - Run _solve_driven(dict(case, problem=replace(problem, facet_tags=outer, pec_facet_tags=(OUTER_BOX_TAG,))), "P1") (test_birdcage_b1_plus_map.py:142) on a fresh solver. - Asserted: (P) still closes at 1e-6 (it is a theorem), and the knob is wired: max |E| on the 402 dofs is > 1e-12. - Predicted, printed: the natural-wall tip 1 g over the without-rod tip 1 g in [0.7, 1.3], and PEC over natural in [2, 10]. A ratio of positive SARs has no ceiling, so no factor is claimed. - (C2) What the 4×4 sees of the rod. Predicted, printed. - ΔP_phantom/P_phantom in [1 %, 15 %]. - ΔΣ_i|S_i1|² in [5e-6, 1e-4], and max |ΔS| in [1e-6, 1e-3]. - The σ_x pairs sit at the same mesh floor as the mirror pairs (without the rod: 0.051 %). This 4×4 cannot separate σ_y from C4; that is a scope fact. - (C3) Field-level mirror, both arms and windows. Printed. - The tip 1 g pairs P2 / P4, ccw / cw and top / bottom: each predicted ≤ 1 %. C4_COVARIANCE_BAND 5 % is shown as a reference, never asserted. - P1 / P3, related only by the broken σ_x: predicted [50 %, 95 %], ceiling 100 %.

Printed beside predictions written first. None of these is asserted; their accuracy is ANS-10's. - The ratio of record (W2; W1's coarse value beside it): Q = SAR_1g,tip(rod) / SAR_1g,tip(without) at both tips, for P1–P4, ccw and cw. Predicted [2, 10]. - Ball masses: 1.000 g without the rod; predicted 0.9817 g with it. - The closed form: - M_cf = ⟨|E_cf|²⟩ / E₀² on the same quadrature-masked region, predicted [2.5, 6]; - L_z(aspect 16) = 0.009693 (prolate_spheroid_depolarisation, analytical.py:1493); - the axial fraction η_z, predicted [0.5, 1.0]; - the estimate η_z·M_cf + (1 − η_z), with Q / estimate predicted in [0.6, 2.5]. - The quasi-static scale: (|k|·c_eq)² ≈ 7.4 % (|k| = 17.0 1/m, from SALINE_SIGMA 0.5 and SALINE_EPSILON_R 78). - Also: P_phantom per drive, the narrowed facet counts per sheet, ΔS, cells, times and the summed peak RSS.

Windows. Bash timeout: 660000, foreground, each harness call bare and whole. - Basis: - without the rod, 64 MHz, -n 2: mesh 21.5 s, four solves 7.0 s, module 93 s (…123236Z…:1859,2084); - the rod build: mesh 42.1 s, module 121 s (GEO-36 W2:3612,3792); - the 0.0025 rung: mesh 34.2 s, sweep 75.4 s, module 251 s at -n 4 (20260908T140457Z_MAT-4-step5.log.gz:1903,1934,2290). - W1 (the 🟡 window), predicted [150, 300] s:

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh IMP-3-step1-W1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 timeout -k 30 420 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_imp3_rod_birdcage.py::test_imp3_default_phantom -v -s --tb=short'" - W2 (the ✅ window), predicted [220, 480] s, with §5.1 durable capture and the trailing ; exit $rc:

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh IMP-3-step1-W2 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && mkdir -p /workspace/logs && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 4 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_imp3_rod_birdcage.py::test_imp3_one_gram_rung -v -s --tb=short > /workspace/logs/imp3-step1-w2-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo [capture] rc=\$rc >> /workspace/logs/imp3-step1-w2-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/imp3-step1-w2-raw.log; exit \$rc'"

Traps already paid for: - Build order. Build without the rod first, then with it, in both windows: a failed gmsh build contaminates the process (GEO-23). The rod + 0.0025 combination has never been built; a FAIL is recorded verbatim and never retried. - built= ignores mesh-sizing keywords. Pass phantom_resolution=PHANTOM_RESOLUTION_1G_RUNG to _build / _build_rod themselves. - Tag 402 lives in the build tuple, not in the sweep's facet tags. Keep that handle. - A held factorisation silently solves a different problem (PORT-19, WF-12). The control uses _solve_driven's fresh solver. - Point evaluation inside the hole raises (post/sar.py:357–361). The axis samples therefore come from the without-rod arm only. - Rank-local quantities. assemble_scalar, cell_tags.values and locate_dofs_topological are rank-local: reduce them, and count owned dofs only. Keep collectives outside any rank == 0 branch. - No UFL comparisons, and no sqrt comparisons. Do the ball mask and the closed form in numpy. - Free the without-rod arm before the rod build in W2. - Harness discipline: - always -s; node IDs only; no pytest -k; no pipes; - Status 124 is the finding: pgrep -c python3, then the cache sweep, and never lengthen the timeout; - no module edit after W1 starts (rule (i)).

Scope: degree 1, 64 MHz, the untuned solid-coil 4×4 with 50 Ω sheets, and one rod on leg 1's azimuth, axial. Not covered: - the accuracy of the tip ratio (ANS-10); - absolute or pointwise SAR, heating, compliance or convergence; - the tuned or copper coil; - F-human; - other rod placements; - ISO 10974 (WF-9) and ASTM F2182 (7c).

Aspect 16 lies beyond IMP-2's FEM-checked aspects (2 and 5).

Status it can move: - §7 IMP-3 ⬜ → 🟡 on W1, then 🟡 → ✅ on W2, per the amended Done-when. - §10 chain I6 is then done, and the weekly that reads it commissions ANS-10.

Negative result: - (A0) or (R0) misses: the fixture moved. Stop and mark BLOCKED. - (i), (ii), (P), (M) or (E) red: park on attempt/IMP-3-step1-<ts>, write a known-issues entry and mark BLOCKED (rule (d)). Never widen a band. - (M) red with the without-rod pairs green: print the per-sheet facet counts, and file a known-issues entry on the rod grading perturbing the P2 / P4 sheet triangulations. - The C1 knob not wired: a test bug. Fix it in-slot and re-run W1. - W2 over the cell guard, a gmsh FAIL, or Status 124: W1 stands and IMP-3 holds 🟡. Mark BLOCKED on the mesher. - A printed ratio outside its prediction: report it; it has no status effect. - There is no PREDICTED RED line.

Outcome (2026-10-02, implementer slot 12:00 CDT): W1 and W2 green; IMP-3 ⬜ → ✅. New module tests/validation/test_imp3_rod_birdcage.py (mtime 17:04:04Z, before W1 at 17:04:28Z; unedited after). - W1 20261002T170428Z_IMP-3-step1-W1.log, -n 2, 241 s (13 passed; predicted [150, 300] s). docs.title: §9 item 235 — 2026-10-04 (chain I9)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-04 18:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §10 chain I9 (PROJECT_PLAN.md ≈ line 4598), a weekly-enumerated step (§9 rule (4)); ANS-10 was re-homed to this Palace twin by the 10-03 weekly (≈ line 4483). No band, tolerance, Done-when or validation target moves.

IMP-3 step 3 — the Palace twin. Palace's 4×4 at 64 MHz, order 1, on the rod fixture with and without the rod, its own identities asserted; ours at degree 1 on the same exported meshes; ΔS(rod) per class, ours against Palace, printed. - Executor: implementer. New probe + new test module; no src/, no edit to any existing file. - Tier: heavy. Export -n 1; Palace -np 8; ours -n 2. Complex container for every non-Palace window. - Class: chain step (solve), measured median ≈ 18–23 min. - Cost: ≈ 20 measured / ≈ 45 predicted min (15 fixed + ≈ 15 code + ≈ 7 compute + ≈ 8 spare). - Depends on: nothing. GEO-36's hole build and leg_sheet_strip_fraction are both on main.

Settled from the code (read before designing). - The rod is a PEC hole, not a meshed region. _build_rod() (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_implant_rod.py:125) cuts the rod out of the phantom; its wall is exterior facet tag BIRDCAGE_IMPLANT_SURFACE_TAG = 402, every 402 facet exterior with its cell in tag 3 (GEO-36 (A5)). Ours pins it by the default exterior PEC (pec_facet_tags=None, IMP-3 (E), 7 437 dofs, max |E| 0). Palace therefore needs the rod wall as its own boundary attribute listed under PEC. The kept-cells build (keep_cells=True, item 219) is WF-9's, not this item's. - IMP-3's fixture uses ragged port sheets. test_birdcage_port_sheets._build(True) / _build_rod() pass no leg_sheet_strip_fraction, so build_four_port_sweep narrows each sheet by the midpoint filter: 26 triangles per port (20261002T170428Z_IMP-3-step1-W1.log:1837,3646). Palace refuses that set (MFEM abort: Specified direction does not align …, 20260929T110504Z_OPS-61-step1a-W3.log:86), and the 10-02 binding ruling makes a new fixture's ports exact CAD rectangles. So this twin runs on the exact-rectangle sibling of IMP-3's fixture: the same two builders with leg_sheet_strip_fraction=GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION. Nothing in the generator refuses the rod + strip combination (io/mesh.py:4244–4271), but it has never been built. IMP-3's ragged records stay valid as records. - Ours' ΔS(rod) per class at degree 1 is not a tracked record. IMP-3 W1 printed both arms' S to 10 digits (…170428Z_IMP-3-step1-W1.log:3682–3685, 3704–3707) and max |ΔS| = 2.663e-4 (:3727; W2 1.32e-4). No per-class ΔS and no module constant exist, and those are ragged meshes anyway. Computed from those lines for scale (this brief's arithmetic, not a record): |Δ mean_k| = 1.25e-4 / 3.48e-5 / 3.80e-5, i.e. 2.1e-4 / 8.3e-5 / 1.1e-4 of |mean_k| (self / adjacent / opposite). The same arms' class spreads are 0.057 / 0.060 / 0.037 % without the rod (:3687). ΔS(rod) between two separately meshed arms is therefore at or below the remesh floor. Ours against Palace on the same mesh pair is still a sharp test, because both codes see the same two meshes. But the remesh-free rod effect is ΔS_wall = S(rod mesh, PEC wall) − S(rod mesh, natural wall), on one mesh. That is printed beside ΔS(rod).

Code (new files only; additive; disclosed). - New probe scripts/probes/imp3_step3_palace_rod.py. It loads scripts/probes/ops61_step1a_palace_ans4.py by importlib (precedent tests/validation/test_wf5_q_two_ways.py:71–78) for _tri_areas, _read_port_s, _identities, _p_check, _fmt, NARROW_BASE, EXTERIOR_TAG. Do not edit the OPS-61 probe. Its export cannot be re-run as a regression without overwriting step 1b's f05x.json. Output directory logs/imp3/ (gitignored). - export (serial; assert comm.size == 1). Build without the rod first: _build(True, leg_sheet_strip_fraction=GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION). Then the rod: _build_rod(leg_sheet_strip_fraction=GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION). For each arm: - Take the drive set from build_four_port_sweep(frequency_hz=STEP2D_FREQUENCY_HZ, built=<tuple>, build_only=True) (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_four_port.py:219,516–529): N_i = case["facet_tags"].find(SHEET_IFACE + i). These are exactly the facets ours drives, so no second narrowing code exists. - Split exterior_facet_indices into the rod wall (the build tuple's facet_tags.find(402)) and the rest. Write triangles with attribute 1 (outer), 20 + i (N_i) and 402 (rod wall). - Write the tets with their cell tags, positively oriented. Copy the Gmsh 2.2 writer of export (:248–283); do not lift it. - Meshes are imp3x_off.msh and imp3x_rod.msh. - Configs use the materials, LumpedPort (R 50, +Z, Attributes [20+i]), Order 1, Freq [0.064] and Linear block of export's config() (:300–342): - imp3x_off.json: PEC [1]; - imp3x_rod.json: PEC [1, 402]; - imp3x_rodnat.json: PEC [1], PMC [402]. Check the PMC key spelling in the image's config-schema.json, as step 1a's W0 did (:296–297). If it is absent, leave 402 unassigned (Palace's natural default) and journal which form ran. - Output "postpro_<name>". Assert no target file exists before writing (never overwrite). - Write imp3x_meta.json: cells, per-port N_i facets / area / h, and the wall facet count and area, per arm. - Anchors, asserted: - (X1) without-rod cells within CELL_COUNT_BAND of ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_CELL_RECORD 117 206 (test_ops61_exact_strip_ports.py:64); exact equality printed; - (X2) rod-arm cells < ROD_CELL_GUARD_W2 320 000 (test_imp3_rod_birdcage.py:115), checked before writing; - (X3) every N_i area = 5.6e-5 within STRIP_BAND (:58), both arms; - (X4) outer exterior area 0.3072 within the probe's EXTERIOR_AREA_BAND 1e-9, both arms; - (X5) rod arm: every 402 facet exterior, count > 0, meshed wall area / (2πrℓ + 4πr²) inside TERMINAL_AREA_BAND (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_leg_gaps.py:73); without-rod arm: 402 count 0. - read. - Run _p_check(name, path, "[IMP-3 3 W5]") on imp3x_off and imp3x_rod; their fails are asserted. On imp3x_rodnat it is printed only, because that run is the control. - Print per class: Palace ΔS(rod) = mean_k(S_rod) − mean_k(S_off), and Palace ΔS_wall = mean_k(S_rod) − mean_k(S_rodnat), as |Δ|/|mean_k(S_off)|. - Print Palace's σ_y pairs on S (MIRROR_PAIRS, test_imp3_rod_birdcage.py:148) beside ADJACENT_SPREAD_BAND. - Print Palace imp3x_off against logs/ops61/postpro_f05x/port-S.csv, read-only, per class. - Never read z_matrix_ohm, the aed key, docs/private/ or aed_results/. - Dispatch is export | read, nothing else. - New module tests/validation/test_imp3_palace_twin.py (@complex_only, one test): - Same two builds, same order, through build_four_port_sweep(…, built=…, build_only=True), then run_n_port_sparameter_sweep(problem, port_defs, lumped_sheet_ports=specs, lumped_sheet_facet_tags=facet_tags, degree=1) (pattern test_imp3_rod_birdcage.py:299–321). keep_fields=True on the two rod-arm sweeps only. Free the without-rod arm before the rod build. - The natural-wall sweep is a fresh sweep on replace(problem, facet_tags=outer, pec_facet_tags=(OUTER_BOX_TAG,)), with outer from IMP-3's _outer_box_tags(msh, build_facet_tags, comm) (:205). This is IMP-3 C1's construction (:655), applied to all four drives. - It reads Palace's three CSVs through the new probe (importlib), prints the comparisons below, and saves ours' three S matrices to logs/imp3/ours_imp3x_p1.json on rank 0. - κ stays off (the default width_correction_kappa=None; binding ruling 10-02).

Anchors (asserted; bands imported, never restated). - (P) Palace, W5, on imp3x_off and imp3x_rod. This is item 159's set as _p_check applies it: - ‖S − Sᵀ‖/‖S‖ ≤ RECIPROCITY_BAND (test_port_lumped_sheet_sweep.py:86); - σ_max ≤ 1 + PASSIVITY_SIGMA_TOLERANCE, and every column power ≤ 1 + 1e-9; - every S-class spread ≤ ADJACENT_SPREAD_BAND (test_port_birdcage_lumped_column.py:121); - pooled ≥ POOLED_SEPARATION_FLOOR × the worst (test_port_birdcage_four_port.py:129,173). - On the rod arm the C4 spreads are backed by IMP-3's rod arm (≤ 0.083 % on the ragged sibling, :3709). - Palace log check (executor, journalled), W2–W4: - elements total = the export's count; - Rs = 4.375e+01 Ω/sq on attributes 21–24 (= 50 · 0.007 / 0.008); - ω/2π = 6.400e-02 GHz; - four GMRES solver converged lines. - Export (X1)–(X5), W1 (above). - Ours, W6: - (F) every N_i = 5.6e-5 within STRIP_BAND, with w = A/h = 7.0e-3, on both arms. Cells equal imp3x_meta.json's exactly, per arm: same builder, deterministic gmsh, serial mesh. - (i) and (ii) as IMP-3 asserts them (:621–623) on all three sweeps. - (E) rod PEC arm: max |E| on the reduced tag-402 dofs ≤ PEC_WALL_MAX_E (:135) for every drive. - (Kw) natural arm, P1: max |E| on those dofs > PEC_WALL_MAX_E. This is backed on the ragged sibling by IMP-3 C1, which measured 1.29e-4 against 1e-12. - (M) σ_y pairs on the rod PEC Z ≤ ADJACENT_SPREAD_BAND. - (S) without-rod separation ≥ POOLED_SEPARATION_FLOOR.

Printed, never gated (ours against Palace, per class, |Δ mean|/|mean|, via _circulant_classes): - (T) The matched-order tie, per arm (off, rod PEC, rod natural): ours S against Palace S. Predicted ≤ 1e-6. f05x measured 2e-10 / 1e-10 / 6e-11 (item 159). - ΔS(rod), ours against Palace: |Δ_k,ours − Δ_k,Palace| / |Δ_k,Palace|, plus the entrywise max |ΔS_ours − ΔS_Palace| / max |ΔS_Palace|. Predicted ≤ 1e-4. The derivation: a matched-order S gap of ≈ 1e-10 · |S| ≈ 6e-11 absolute, against |Δ_k| ≥ 1e-5, gives ≈ 1e-5 relative; the margin ×10 is for the smallest class. - ΔS_wall, ours against Palace: the same form. Predicted ≤ 1e-3, because |Δ_wall| may be as small as ≈ 1e-6 · |S|. - Sizes: - |Δ_k(rod)|/|mean_k| predicted in [1e-5, 1e-3]; the ragged pair read 2.1e-4 / 8.3e-5 / 1.1e-4. - |Δ_k,wall|/|mean_k| predicted in [1e-6, 1e-3]. - Free ties: - Ours without-rod against ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_S_P1_RECORDS["64"] (test_ans4_exact_strip_records.py:141). Predicted ≤ 1e-6 if test_birdcage_port_sheets._build and test_birdcage_leg_offset._build coincide; both read 116 085 with the flag off. - Palace imp3x_off against Palace f05x, predicted ≤ 1e-9 on the same condition. - A miss on either is a reading about the builders, not a stop. - Palace prices: total time, iterations, peak memory and ND unknowns per run.

Negative controls (rule (e); unbacked on this fixture, so predicted and printed, with separations computed). - (C1) The wrong wall: ours rod (PEC) against Palace imp3x_rodnat, per class. - This gap equals |Δ_wall|/|mean|, predicted in [1e-6, 1e-3]. - Against the matched (T) gap (≤ 1e-9, measured ≈ 1e-10), the separation is predicted ≥ 1e3×. The least case is 1e-6 / 1e-9. - Ceiling ≈ 1e-3 / 6e-11 ≈ 1.7e7×. The round-off floor of (T) bounds it. - It shows that the 402 attribute reached Palace's solve. A PEC list that silently dropped 402 would make imp3x_rod equal imp3x_rodnat, so (T) on the rod arm would read ≈ |Δ_wall|, not ≈ 1e-10. - (C2) The arm swap: ours without-rod against Palace imp3x_rod. This gap equals |Δ(rod)|/|mean| plus the remesh change, predicted [1e-5, 1e-3]. Separation against (T) is ≥ 1e4×. - (Kw) is the asserted knob (above). It is backed on the same quantity on the ragged sibling with ≈ 1.3e8× separation. - (P)'s power to discriminate was shown on f05x by item 159's flip (200.02 % spreads against the 0.5 % band, ceiling 400×). It is not re-run.

Windows (bare, whole, foreground, Bash timeout: 660000; -np ≤ 12; Palace v0.18.1, image fem-em-palace:0.18.1, compose profile palace). - Pre-check (not a harness call): ls logs/imp3/. If any imp3x_* file exists, stop and report: never overwrite. logs/ops61/ is read-only to this item. - W1, export (≈ 90 s, range 60–150). Basis: strip export 31 s at -n 1 (F10a W3); rod mesh 42.1–47.4 s (GEO-36 W2; IMP-3 W1 :3646).

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh IMP-3-item235-W1-export "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src timeout -k 30 300 mpiexec -n 1 python3 scripts/probes/imp3_step3_palace_rod.py export'" - W2, Palace without the rod (≈ 25 s; f05x o1: 23.35 s Palace total, 1.8 G, item 159). This is the box-speed gate.

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh IMP-3-item235-W2-palace-off "docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile palace run --rm -T fem-em-palace bash -lc 'cd /workspace/logs/imp3 && timeout -k 30 590 palace -np 8 imp3x_off.json'" - Box-speed gate (binding, after W2). r = W2's Palace Total / 23.35 s (20261002T021838Z_OPS-61-F10b-W2-palace-f05x.log). - r ≤ 2.5: run everything. - r > 2.5: run W3–W5 (the Palace record still fits 590 s), skip W6, and mark BLOCKED, slow box. W6 projects to ≥ 375 s against its 420 s ceiling. - W3, Palace with the rod (predicted 35–60 s Palace total, peak 2.3–3.5 G). - Cells ≈ 168 500 (167 371 + the strip's +1 121), ×1.44 f05x; ND (p = 1) predicted 190–215 k. - The command is W2's with imp3x_rod.json, labelled IMP-3-item235-W3-palace-rod. - W4, Palace with the natural wall (as W3): imp3x_rodnat.json, labelled IMP-3-item235-W4-palace-rodnat. After any kill, check docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml ps for a lingering fem-em-palace container. - W5, read (≈ 3 s). This is the probe's last window; no probe edit after it starts.

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh IMP-3-item235-W5-read "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src timeout -k 30 300 mpiexec -n 1 python3 scripts/probes/imp3_step3_palace_rod.py read'" - W6, ours (≈ 150 s, range 110–250). Basis, IMP-3 W1 at -n 2: builds 25.9 + 47.4 s, four solves ≈ 7 s per arm, module 241 s with SAR and C1. The closing window; no module edit after it starts.

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh IMP-3-item235-W6-ours-p1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 timeout -k 30 420 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_imp3_palace_twin.py -v -s --tb=short'"

Traps already paid for. - Never hand Palace a ragged sheet set (the step 1a abort) and never build the rod fixture without leg_sheet_strip_fraction. An abort on any port set is a finding: never change Direction in-slot. - The exterior includes the rod wall. Exporting exterior_facet_indices as attribute 1 would make the wall PEC in all three configs and break (X4) and (C1). Split it first. - Tag 402 lives in the build tuple's facet tags, not in the sweep's (IMP-3 trap). - Build order and width. Without the rod first, then the rod (GEO-23). The new keyword combination builds at -n 1 first (W1), because a gmsh failure deadlocks wider runs (F10a). A gmsh FAIL is recorded verbatim and never retried. - Import only helpers and constants from test_imp3_rod_birdcage. Never import a test_* name: pytest would collect it and run IMP-3's W1 inside W6. - A held factorisation silently solves a different problem (PORT-19, WF-12). The natural-wall arm is its own sweep on the replaced problem, and (Kw) proves the knob. - Areas, counts, assemble_scalar and dof counts are rank-local: reduce. The export is serial. - Compare S classes only. Never read Palace's z_matrix_ohm. - A GMRES … did not converge line is a finding: that run's S is not measured. Never change Order, MaxIts or Tol in-slot. - Harness discipline: -s, tests/environment first, FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1, foreground, no pipes. On Status 124, run pgrep -c python3 first and never lengthen the timeout. - Palace's numbers go in the record at full detail (version, config, mesh cited). No AED number, and no Palace figure set against an AED one, in any tracked file. Never open docs/private/, aed_results/ or COMPARISON_private.md.

Shared files. Item 234 (OPS-61 step 2, the ANS-6 hole mesh in Palace) is expected to add modes to scripts/probes/ops61_step1a_palace_ans4.py. This item only imports from that file, so the two do not overlap. If item 234 lands first, check that _p_check(name, path, tag) and _read_port_s(path) keep their signatures. If this item ever needs to touch that file, the change is additive in separate functions with separate dispatch branches: rebase and keep both sides.

Scope. Covered: Palace order 1 and ours at degree 1, 64 MHz, on the exact-rectangle sibling of IMP-3's rod fixture (σ = 800 S/m untuned coil, 50 Ω, one axial rod on leg 1's azimuth): S per arm, ΔS(rod) and ΔS_wall per class. Agreement at matched order is a check of the PEC-hole boundary and port bookkeeping between two independent codes. It is not a check of discretisation error, and not of the rod's physical effect on S, which sits at the remesh floor. Not covered: - The tip SAR, the tip ratio Q and its accuracy. That was ANS-10's original question (§2 ≈ line 437). Palace's fields are not read here, so the question stays open. - Tissue, heating, compliance, ISO 10974 (WF-9), ASTM F2182 (7c). - Absolute S / Z_in, any h- or p-statement (one mesh, one order; Palace order 2 would cost ≈ 270 s × 1.44 ≈ 6–7 min per run, which the review can price). - The tuned or copper coil (implant_rod refuses as_hole), F-human, other rod placements, the kept-cells rod. - AED, src/ and any band.

Status it can move. - §7 IMP-3 stays ✅ (no glyph). Its Done-when names step 1 only, so under rule (j) the review adds a step-3 record sentence. The candidate text, which holds only if W5 and W6 are green and every printed (T) gap is ≤ 1e-6: "Palace order 1 matches ours at degree 1 on the exact-rectangle rod fixture to ≤ 1e-6 per class on both arms; ΔS(rod) and ΔS_wall agree at matched order". - §10 I9 is done. - ANS-10 has no §7 row. The weekly reads this as its Palace reading: agree / disagree / inconclusive on the rod's 4×4 effect. It does not answer the tip ratio's accuracy. - §2 ≈ line 437 may gain one clause ("the rod's 4×4 effect agrees with Palace at matched order"). Its "ratio's accuracy" clause stays.

Negative result. - W1 gmsh FAIL on the rod + strip build: record it verbatim, open a known-issues entry, BLOCKED on the mesher. Never retry. - (X1)–(X5) red: the export is not the fixture. Stop before any Palace window and mark BLOCKED. - A Palace abort, or a log lacking the export's element count or Rs = 4.375e+01: record it verbatim, open a known-issues entry, BLOCKED (rule (d)). - The PMC key refused: re-write imp3x_rodnat.json with 402 unassigned. If Palace then rejects an unassigned exterior attribute, (C1) is "not measured". Not a stop. - (P) red on imp3x_off or imp3x_rod: report every identity's number, park, BLOCKED. Never widen. - Ours (F), (i), (ii), (E), (Kw), (M) or (S) red: park on attempt/IMP-3-step3-<ts>, open a known-issues entry, BLOCKED. - (T) without the rod > 1e-6: ours did not solve the exported mesh. Stop, BLOCKED; do not print ΔS. - (T) without the rod green, but the rod arm > 1e-6: a reading, not a failure. It would be the first disagreement between the two codes, located at the PEC hole. Print it per class and report; the review reads it. - Box-speed gate trips: a partial record (Palace only), BLOCKED (slow box). The review re-queues W6. - A printed size outside its prediction: report it; no status effect. - No PREDICTED RED line.

Outcome, 2026-10-04 22:30 slot — ✅ DONE, all six windows green.
