docs.title: PORT-15 — The circuit layer
docs.text: The circuit layer — HFSS + Circuit dynamic link: terminate the N-port S-matrix in a capacitor network, read tuned S₁₁ and the mode spectrum without re-solving the field problem; pure linear algebra on PORT-13's 32×32 — feature ladder A3 (operator directive 2026-09-04; serial on PORT-13 ✅) | 🟡 (step 1 ✅ 2026-09-05, 22:30 slot — the circuit layer's algebra exists and every anchor is green on the first run; no band moved, no FEM touched. New tests/unit/test_port_circuit_layer.py, one smoke window, real build, -n 1, timeout -k 30 120: 10 passed in 1.80s, Status 0, 4 s (20260905T033509Z_PORT-15.log:80, 83–84). Code added to src/fem_em_solver/ports/circuit.py (PORT-14's file, extended; reduce_terminated_ports and its signature untouched): birdcage_highpass_mesh_matrices (the N-window ladder's mesh L and C_inv, per-element sequences accepted so a detuned ladder can be built), birdcage_highpass_mode_frequencies (the closed form, derivation (C3)–(C5) in the docstring; the literature it reproduces cited by author and year only — Hayes et al. 1985, Leifer 1997 — and no number from either enters the module), and s_to_z / z_to_s at a real z0. Convention that makes the closed form come out as written: l_ring_h and c_ring_f are the per-ring-segment values, so a window carries 2L_r and 2/(jωC) and the KVL leg term 4L_l sin²(πk/N) halves to the entry's L_r + 2L_l sin²(πk/N). Anchor (i) — for N ∈ {4, 16} the closed-form ω_k² (k = 0…N/2, each 0 < k < N/2 present twice) equal the np.linalg.eigvals spectrum of L⁻¹C_inv, sorted, at the pre-stated rtol 1e-12: measured 5.280e-16 (N = 4) and 2.366e-15 (N = 16), i.e. 400× and 400× inside; imaginary parts asserted ≤ 1e-12 relative to the eigenvalue scale (ω² is O(1e16) in SI, so an absolute 1e-12 there would be vacuous). ω_0 = 1/√(L_r C) asserted exactly — the end-ring mode is kept, not discarded (:43–50). Anchor (ii) — the Z-route cross-check on a random passive reciprocal 4×4 (S = U diag(σ) Uᵀ, Takagi, σ = 0.9…0.1, seed 20260905, ‖S‖₂ < 1 asserted): terminating port 4 through reduce_terminated_ports equals z_to_s(Z_aa − Z_ab (Z_bb + Z)⁻¹ Z_ba) with Z = s_to_z(S) at 1.4–2.7e-16 against the 1e-12 bar, for all six terminations 50 Ω / −j159.15 Ω / +j62.83 Ω / 200 Ω / short / 1e9 Ω (:59–74) — the S route and the Z route are the same reduction, so PORT-14's gate is not an artefact of the Γ form. Anchor (iii) — Γ = 0 returns S_aa bitwise (np.array_equal, max diff 0.000e+00, one and two ports, :77). Negative control — one leg's L_l ×1.01 in the mesh matrices moves the spectrum off the closed form by 4.129e-03 in ω² (2.062e-03 in ω) on the worst mode against the pre-stated ≥ 1e-3 bar, and splits the degenerate k = 1 pair by 4.129e-03 (its partner unmoved at 0.0); the first-order ceiling 2ε/N = 5.000e-03 is asserted as an upper bound and held, and the k = 0 end-ring mode is unmoved at 7.7e-16 — no leg current in that mode, which is the physics (:53–56). Not claimed: nothing about the FEM coil — no L_l/L_r read from the 32×32, no resonance, no tuning, no mode-spectrum claim about any meshed birdcage, no §2 change. That is step 2: the inductances read from PORT-13's 32×32 and the resonances compared, plus gate (i) against PORT-14's measured 3×3 (with the 1.6e-3 / 3.4e-3 / 7.2e-4 residuals in hand, not re-derived).) ~~⬜ (step 1 — the ladder-network closed form and the termination reduction as pure-numpy identities, no FEM — queued 2026-09-04 18:00 review as §9 item 3; gate (i) against PORT-14's solve and the 32×32 termination are later steps)~~

docs.title: PORT-16 — The ≈1 %-of-supplied accounting gap on the 4-leg fixture
docs.text: The ≈1 %-of-supplied accounting gap on the 4-leg fixture — every single drive on the loaded F-small birdcage reads P_acc − ½∫σ\|E\|² ≈ 6.7e-05 W, the same absolute figure on all four ports (0.23 % scatter, POST-6 step 1b) and 0.98 % of supplied power, i.e. sitting at 0.98× the imported 1e-2 POWER_BALANCE_BAND. Diagnosis chunk (opened 2026-09-06 weekly review; serial on nothing): attribute the gap to one term by measurement — candidates, each a separate in-run print: (a) the lumped sheet's own dissipation ½ Re(Z_p)∫\|K\|² dA versus the volume loss the sheet's box carries; (b) the conductor/phantom partition of ∫σ\|E\|² against the sheet-facet flux; (c) h: the same three prints on WF-6 step 3f's finer phantom mesh and on PORT-14 step 1b's ×0.75 / ×0.6 conductor rungs, so the gap's exponent in h is measured, not guessed. Done-when: one candidate reproduces the gap on the record mesh to ≤ 10 % of itself with the other two printed and separated, a negative control (the sheet resistivity ×2 must move (a) and not (b)), and the gap's h-rate printed — then the review decides whether POWER_BALANCE_BAND is a band or a record. No band moves in this chunk. Step 1 scoped 2026-09-06 18:00 review (§9 item 4, ruling (5)) — the exact discrete power identity first: the fixture's supplied and sheets are both built from the sheet terminal currents (test_birdcage_b1_plus_map.py::_power_shares, ½ Re(V_src Ī) and ½\|I\|² Re Z_p) while the volume loss is an exact integral, and by Cauchy–Schwarz the terminal form of a sheet's dissipation is a lower bound on ½∫Re(Y_s)\|E_t\|² dA whenever E_t is not uniform across the sheet — a ≈1% effect with the gap's sign. Step 1 assembles P_src,exact = −½ Re ∫ J_src·Ē dA, P_sheet,exact and P_vol on all four drives and asserts (i) the discrete identity P_src,exact = P_vol + P_sheet,exact at 1e-6 (a theorem of the Galerkin solution, solver residual 1e-10-class), (ii) the Cauchy–Schwarz inequality on every sheet, (iii) the attribution (sheets_exact − sheets_terminal) + (supplied_terminal − supplied_exact) reproducing the gap to ≤ 10% of itself; the ×2 sheet-resistivity control must leave (i) closed and move the sheet term (size predicted). Standard, -n 2, ≈ 140 s (3g's 106 s + one control solve). Candidate (c) — the h rungs — is step 2 if the split does not attribute the gap. Step 1 executed 2026-09-07, 00:00 implementer slot — the gap is attributed to candidate (a), and nothing leaks. tests/validation/test_birdcage_power_identity.py, 20260907T051231Z_PORT-16.log, 16 passed … 129.04s (:1997), Status 0 / Elapsed 131 s (:2065–2066), standard, timeout -k 30 300, -n 2, complex, one window (plus a collect-only smoke, 20260907T050807Z_PORT-16.log, and one discarded window whose sign bug is recorded below). (i) closes at machine precision: the real part of a(E,E) = L(E) — P_src,exact = P_vol + P_sheet,exact, assembled through the package's own lumped_port_bilinear_term / lumped_port_linear_term with the solved phasor in both argument slots — reads 6.760e-15 / 9.656e-15 / 1.048e-14 / 4.414e-15 on P1–P4 against the pre-registered 1e-6 (:1882–1893), so the assembly does not leak power and POST-6's mechanism (b), "a real un-accounted loss channel", is excluded. (ii) holds on all sixteen sheet readings with the ratio ceiling/terminal at 1.010592–1.010593 (:1895–1910). The item's pre-registered field-only form of (ii) is not a theorem on the driven sheet — I there is driven by E_t + E_src ĥ while P_sheet,exact carries E_t alone — so the provable total-field form is asserted on all four sheets and the item's literal form on the twelve undriven ones, with the driven sheet's field-only ratio (0.2292) printed; the derivation is in the module docstring and the repair was made on paper before the first run. (iii) is arithmetic and attributes nothing: it reproduces the gap to 3.148e-13 by construction while splitting it into −54.2765× and +55.2765× itself (:1912–1915). (iv), the finding, registered on window 1's measurement and asserted in window 2 at the row's own ≤10% done-when bar: the gap is the Cauchy–Schwarz deficit of the terminal-current sheet form. C ≡ Σ_sheets ½Re(Y_s)∫\|E_t + E_src ĥ\|² dA gives C − sheets_terminal = the gap to 3.212e-13 / 4.770e-13 / 5.086e-13 / 2.276e-13, and P_vol + C = supplied_terminal to all ten printed digits (:1917–1920) — i.e. ½\|I\|²Re Z_p is the uniform-field lower bound on the dissipation the sheet's own constitutive law deposits, and the 1.06% by which the sheet field departs from uniform across the sheet is the whole of the 0.98%-of-supplied gap. Negative control: Z_p ×2 leaves (i) at 1.369e-15 and moves P_sheet,exact by a factor 0.484102 (:1922–1923) — just outside the item's predicted [0.5, 2] window, which is printed and never asserted per rule (e); asserted were the sign (it moved, ≥1e-3 relative) and the exact ceiling P_sheet,exact ≤ P_src,exact. Phantom/conductor ratio 1.633092e-04 (control) vs 1.257803e-04 (unmodified P1). No band moved, no src/ change, POWER_BALANCE_BAND untouched and the POST-6 red still red. Window 1 (20260907T050816Z_PORT-16.log, 3 failed, 12 passed … 146.73s, Status 1) is committed as evidence: it read rel dev = exactly 2.000e+00 on every drive and on the control, the signature of P_src = −(P_vol + P_sheet) — a sign transcription in this module's own _source_power_w (L = −jωμ₀∫K·conj(E) already carries the load convention's minus, so P_src,exact = +Im L(E)/(2ωμ₀)), fixed in the test, not in src/, and not by touching a band. Step 2 (h rungs) is no longer needed to attribute the gap — its remaining value is the gap's h-exponent, which is now a question about the sheet field's non-uniformity and not about a missing loss channel; the review owns whether to run it and whether POWER_BALANCE_BAND is a band or a record. Step 2 executed 2026-09-07, 06:00 implementer slot — the attribution carries to the superposed drive and the deliberate red is re-pointed, not widened. tests/validation/test_port_drive_superposition.py only (no src/, no edit to step 1's module — no helper signature changed, so rule (c)'s re-run was not triggered; the step-1 import is lazy because test_birdcage_power_identity imports _loss_power_w from the superposition module at its :162 and pytest collects it first alphabetically, a genuine collection-order cycle). 20260907T110826Z_PORT-16.log, 23 passed … 101.91s (:2038), Status 0 / Elapsed 104 s (:2106–2107), standard by measurement (timeout -k 30 400), -n 2, complex; plus a collect-only smoke (…110534Z, 4 s), a first green main window on the pre-docstring-correction tree (…110545Z, 23 passed … 104.33s, same digits to the last place), and a re-collect (…110815Z, 4 s). (i) the exact discrete identity holds on the superposed field: ccw P_src,exact 3.837471142e-03 W = P_vol 2.663302665e-03 + P_sheet,exact 1.174168477e-03, rel dev 5.877e-15; cw 1.435e-14, both against the imported DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL 1e-6 (:1942–1943). (ii) the attribution closes: ccw P_acc − P_vol = 3.511221378e-04 W = C − sheets_terminal = 3.511221378e-04 W, rel dev 9.881e-14; cw 1.581e-13, against the imported ATTRIBUTION_RTOL 1e-1 (:1945–1946) — the whole of the drive-level residual is step 1's Cauchy–Schwarz deficit, measured on a drive none of step 1's four solves is. Control of the generalisation (asserted at 1e-12): w = e_k reproduces step 1's own _exact_shares for drive k — p_src, sheet_field_total, sheet_ceiling_total — at rel dev 0.000e+00 on all twelve readings (:1948–1951), bit for bit as predicted, so the weight-vector generalisation is linearity and nothing else. New _exact_shares_w builds sheet s as replace(spec.sheet(driven=True), source_voltage_v=w_s·V_src) and sums step 1's own helpers; the _source_power_w sign trap cannot recur because the sign is never re-transcribed. Nothing widened: POWER_BALANCE_BAND keeps 1e-2, its import and its three green asserts (single-drive residuals 9.795751e-03 / 9.796209e-03 / 9.794985e-03 / 9.795283e-03, :1914; CROSS_TERM_TRIGGER; BLIND_SUM_MIN_MISS), and the 1.164806e-01 terminal residual is printed on both senses beside the band and asserted nowhere (:1917, :1921). The POST-6 known-issues entry retires in this commit. Step 3 (the gap's h-exponent on the ×0.75 / ×0.6 rungs) is the weekly's to commission — it is a question about the sheet field's non-uniformity, not about a missing loss channel. | ✅ (2026-09-07 — the exact discrete power identity closes at 1e-14 on every single drive and on the superposed quadrature drive, the ≈6.7e-05 W gap is attributed to the terminal form's Cauchy–Schwarz deficit at 1e-13, and the drive-level assertion is re-pointed at the identity; POWER_BALANCE_BAND ruled a record and unmoved. Step 3's h-rate is optional and unclaimed)

docs.title: PORT-18 — Does the lumped-sheet port read its current off one side of a discontinuous component
docs.text: Does the lumped-sheet port read its current off one side of a discontinuous component — and is that side assigned differently on the four C4 sheets? — opened 2026-09-10 03:00 review on GEO-31's verdict (same support, same boundary, different interior cut at every rung, including the ×1 rung every port gate passed on). The mechanism this row tests, read off the code rather than inferred: on the four-port birdcage the sheet SHEET_IFACE + i is the interface between PORT_LOWER + i and PORT_UPPER + i — the gap box's mid-plane, so its normal is (to be verified in-probe) ±ẑ — and the fixture drives it with drive_direction=(0, 0, 1) (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_four_port.py:397), i.e. ĥ ∥ n̂. sheet_terminal_current reads ∫ E('+')·ĥ dS and lumped_port_linear_term injects K_imp·v('+') (src/fem_em_solver/ports/lumped.py:306, 333); _restrict's docstring justifies '+' because n̂ × E is single-valued (Jin (1.60)) — true of the tangential trace the bilinear term uses, not of the normal component E·n̂, which N1curl leaves discontinuous across a facet. Which cell DOLFINx calls '+' is a per-facet property of the cut, so four congruent patches cut differently can read four different mixes of lower-side and upper-side traces. That would put the asymmetry into both the source and the read-back on every rung, amplified as the cut coarsens relative to the field — the frame GEO-31 reading (i) set. Executor mesh-probe, measurement-only, 🧪 by the §3 rule, no solve, real build. Import scripts/probes/geo30_birdcage_c4_refinement_census.py's RUNGS / _build_rung and GEO-31's SHEET_IFACE + i interface-tag selection verbatim (as GEO-31 did); new scripts/probes/port18_sheet_plus_side_census.py. The measurement, per rung (all four RUNGS), per sheet: (0) ∫ (n('+')·ẑ)² dS / A_i — the premise check, printed; (1) the '+'-side lower-half fraction f_i = ∫ χ_L('+') dS / A_i with χ_L the DG0 indicator of cell tag PORT_LOWER + i; (2) for a smooth, C4-invariant field not in N1curl degree 1, E = ẑ·cos(2π(z − z̄)/λ)·(1 + (x² + y²)/ρ₀²) (z̄ the common sheet-centroid height, λ = 4× the sheet's gap height, ρ₀ the leg radius, all measured in-probe and printed) interpolated into N1curl degree 1: the read-backs R_i^+ = ∫E('+')·ẑ dS / A_i, R_i^− and R_i^avg at pinned quadrature degrees q ∈ {2, 4, 8}, the expression comparand ∫ g dS / A_i at q = 8, and the four-sheet spread (max − min)/|mean| of each. (3) Repeat (1) at -n 1 on the ×1 and ×0.75 rungs only — side assignment can depend on the partition. Anchors (asserted — closed forms and an identity): (A) partition identity ∫ (χ_L + χ_U)('+') dS = A_i to ≤ 1e-12 relative on every sheet at every rung — without it (1) measures a broken indicator; (B) interpolation-exactness: E_lin = (−z/ρ₀, 0, 1 + x/ρ₀) is of the form a + b × x, so N1curl degree 1 represents it exactly and its trace is continuous: assert R_i^+ = R_i^− = 1 + x̄_i/ρ₀ to ≤ 1e-9 relative on every sheet at q = 2, with x̄_i = ∫x dS / A_i measured in-probe. Negative control (asserted — arithmetic, not predicted): the same E_lin is deliberately not C4-invariant; for four sheets 90° apart at radius ρ₀, Σ cos θ_i = 0 and max − min of cos θ_i is ≥ √2, so its four-sheet spread must read ≥ 1.40 — a spread metric that returns ≈ 0 regardless fails here. Printed, asserted nowhere (rule (e)): the f_i table at both rank counts; the spreads of R^+, R^−, R^avg and the expression by q at all four rungs side by side with the imported gate spreads (ANS-4 ×1 Z classes 0.1012 / 0.0916 / 0.0654 %, ×0.75 0.5390 / 0.4591 / 1.6886 %, known-issues 🔴 2026-09-09); and the discriminator sentence: (a) f_i equal across the four sheets at every rung and R^+ spread ≲ the R^avg spread ⇒ the read-back's side choice is excluded, and the solve (the source term's v('+')·ẑ included) is the remaining suspect; (b) f_i differs across sheets and the R^+ spread exceeds the R^avg spread and tracks the rungs that broke ⇒ the '+' restriction of a normal component is a port-model defect in lumped.py; (c) spreads fall with q at fixed f_i ⇒ quadrature, curable. Tier / ranks / cost: four meshes (GEO-31 measured 144 s for exactly these at -n 2, meshing 25–37 s each) plus DG0/N1curl interpolation and a few dozen facet assemblies ⇒ window 1 -n 2, timeout -k 30 500; window 2 -n 1 on two rungs, timeout -k 30 300; -s on both, real build; standard by expectation, heavy by ceiling. Traps already paid for: every SpatialCoordinate-bearing facet form pins metadata={"quadrature_degree": q} (POST-5 step 1, nine-minute FFCx compiles, poisoned cache entries); interior-facet forms need a restriction on every argument (_restrict); no UFL ordering comparison and no sqrt inside one (OPS-22, WF-6 step 4c) — the field above uses neither; the DG0 indicator must be set on ghost cells too, or '+' on a partition-boundary facet reads 0 (set owned values, then x.scatter_forward()); cell_tags.values, assemble_scalar and centroids are rank-local — allreduce before printing; timeout -k 30; no run_in_background; -k a or b splits inside a quoted container command; sweep find /root/.cache/fenics -name '*.c' -size 0 and delete stubs only. Scope: measures the side assignment and the read-back only, not the solve; closes nothing and rehabilitates no rung. ANS-4 keeps ✅ + INCONCLUSIVE, WF-6 stays 🟡, ANS-4 step 2a / WF-6 step 4f stay blocked, and no port band, record or src/ line moves. Negative result: if (0) reads far from 1 the premise ĥ ∥ n̂ is wrong: print it and stop. If (b), open a known-issues row naming sheet_terminal_current and lumped_port_linear_term and stop. Do not switch to ufl.avg in-slot: it would move every PORT-9 / PORT-11 / PORT-16 / ANS-4 / WF-6 record at once, and that is a review's ruling with its own re-run plan. If (a), record it and stop: the finding moves the suspect onto the solve. MEASURED 2026-09-10 04:30 slot — PREMISE (0) FALSE; stopped on the row's first negative branch (mesh-probe, scripts/probes/port18_sheet_plus_side_census.py; window 1 -n 2 all four rungs Status 0 / 154 s, 20260910T093526Z_PORT-18.log; window 2 -n 1 ×1 + ×0.75 Status 0 / 68 s, 20260910T093810Z_PORT-18.log). Asserted self-tests green in both windows: (A) partition identity worst 1.089e-15 vs 1e-12; (B) E_lin read-backs R^± = 1 + x̄_i/ρ₀ to ≤ 9.99e-16 (relative denominator max(|1 + x̄_i/ρ₀|, 1), since the θ = 180° sheet's target is ≈ 0 — disclosed in the docstring); negative control spread 2.000000 vs ≥ 1.40 (…093526Z…:7011–7025, 7144). Premise (0): ∫(n('+')·ẑ)² dS / A_i = 0.000000000000000 on all 16 sheet readings at -n 2 and all 8 at -n 1 (:7008, 7037, 7066, 7095; …093810Z…:3517, 3546), corroborated independently of the form by the sheet bounding boxes — extents (1.400e-02, ≈1e-18, 8.000e-03) m on P1/P3 and (≈1e-18, 1.400e-02, 8.000e-03) m on P2/P4 (:7007): each sheet is a vertical radial–axial plane with an azimuthal normal, not the gap box's horizontal mid-plane this row read off the code. So ĥ = ẑ lies in the sheet, E('+')·ẑ is a tangential component N1curl keeps single-valued, and the mechanism this row tests (a cut-dependent '+' side on a discontinuous normal component) does not exist on this fixture — for the read-back and, by the same argument, for the source term's v('+')·ẑ. The (a)/(b)/(c) predicates were not evaluated; no known-issues row, no ufl.avg, no src/ or band change. Printed, asserted nowhere, and consistent with the premise reading: f_i (here the PORT_LOWER + i box half, which on this geometry is not a z-half) varies across sheets and rearranges completely with the partition (×1: 0.714/0.148/0.091/0.722 at -n 2, 0.544/0.959/0.017/0.193 at -n 1), yet R^+, R^−, R^avg are identical to every printed digit at q = 2, 4 and 8 and at both rank counts — side assignment and quadrature both demonstrably inert. One lead for the review, printed only: the smooth field's N1curl-interpolant read-back spread tracks the rungs that broke — ×1 7.223213e-06, ×0.75 3.520702e-04 (≈ 49×), resolution 0.012 3.139712e-06, 0.0095 7.307614e-04 (≈ 233×) — while the exact expression comparand sits at ≤ 4.2e-15, and the sheet pairings match GEO-31's centroid readings (×1 P1 = P2, P3 = P4; ×0.75 P1 = P3, P2 = P4; 0.012 P4 alone; 0.0095 all four). The magnitudes are 0.035% / 0.073%, below the imported ANS-4 ×0.75 Z class spreads (0.5390 / 0.4591 / 1.6886 %), so the read-back of a given field is cut-sensitive but not by itself at gate scale; whether the solve amplifies it is not measured here. Disposition is the review's. Disposition, 2026-09-10 10:30 review: accepted as measured (20260910T093526Z_PORT-18.log:7008, 7037, 7066, 7095; 20260910T093810Z_PORT-18.log:3517, 3546; both asserted self-tests green; 🧪, no audit owed). The wrong premise was the 03:00 review's code reading, not the executor's. The generator's own comment says the sheet plane contains the leg axis and the radial direction, so its normal is azimuthal (src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py:3972–3974). Premise check (0) caught the error in 222 s of compute. The '+'-side mechanism is excluded for both the read-back and the source term. The executor's relative denominator in (B), max(|target|, 1), is ratified: the θ = 180° sheet's target 1 + x̄/ρ₀ is ≈ 0, and the absolute residual ≤ 9.99e-16 is the stronger statement either way. The printed lead is taken up by GEO-32: the interpolant read-back spread tracks the broken rungs with GEO-31's sheet pairings, and a C4-congruent cut is the one change that removes that lead without a solve. ANS-4 step 2a and WF-6 step 4f stay blocked. | 🧪 MEASURED 2026-09-10 04:30 slot — premise false; measurement-only, 🧪 by the §3 rule

docs.title: §9 item 246 — 2026-10-05 (lane 1)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-05 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it.

PORT-18 step 2: the sheet's two one-sided current readings on the exact rectangles. This is the lane-1 target the 10-03 weekly named (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4643–4644): "on the exact-rectangle fixture the sheet's two one-sided current readings agree at the imported band ⇒ ✅". - Executor: implementer, not mesh-probe. The item asserts, and it runs one solve. - Tier: standard by prediction, heavy by ceiling (timeout -k 30 300). Complex build. Two windows: W1 at -n 2, W2 at -n 1. Side assignment rearranges with the partition (09-10: f_i at ×1 read 0.714/0.148/0.091/0.722 at -n 2 and 0.544/0.959/0.017/0.193 at -n 1), so both widths are needed. - Class: lane 1. The class median is ≈ 8 min (restock 10-04 18:00). Cost: ≈ 8 measured / ≈ 35 predicted min (15 fixed, ≈ 12 code, two windows of ≈ 2–3 min each, spare). - Depends on nothing. No src/ change: one new test module only.

What "the two one-sided current readings" are, read off the code. - sheet_terminal_current (src/fem_em_solver/ports/lumped.py:338–364) returns I⁺ = (1/(R h)) ∫_S (E('+') + E_src)·ĥ dS. It restricts through _restrict (:270–281), which hard-codes '+' on an interior sheet. - The other reading is I⁻: the same integrand with '−'. The 09-10 probe measured exactly this pair as R⁺ / R⁻. For the smooth field see scripts/probes/port18_sheet_plus_side_census.py:258–259; for E_lin see :283–284. - 09-10 measured the sheet normal as azimuthal and ĥ = ẑ as lying in the sheet (20260910T093526Z_PORT-18.log.gz:7007–7008). So E·ĥ is a tangential component. N1curl keeps that single-valued, which makes I⁺ = I⁻ an identity up to round-off whichever cell DOLFINx calls '+'. The item asserts that identity on the sheet the ports actually use, for a solved field.

The imported band (never restated). - EXACTNESS_BAND = 1e-9 (scripts/probes/port18_sheet_plus_side_census.py:84). This is the band that probe held R^± to in (B) (:493–497). - PREMISE_BAND = 1e-6 (:86), the probe's own threshold on the premise reading ∫(n('+')·ẑ)² dS / A. - Import both with the probe's own path-insert idiom (:71–77). Precedent for a test importing from scripts/probes: tests/validation/test_post8_owner_rule_ans2.py. - If the import fails or has side effects, stop BLOCKED. Do not retype the numbers.

The comparison from the 09-10 record, and a correction to the target's wording. The weekly's phrasing expects the exact sheet to collapse a ragged-sheet discrepancy. The record holds no such discrepancy. - 09-10 read the full gap face F_i (58 triangles at ×1, …093526Z_PORT-18.log.gz:7000). F_i is a CAD face on both fixtures. The probe did not read the narrowed strip N_i that the ports integrate over, and it read no solved field. - On F_i, R⁺ = R⁻ to every printed digit at q = 2 / 4 / 8 (13 significant digits, i.e. ≤ ≈ 2.7e-13 relative, :7012–7020). E_lin's R^± matched the closed form to ≤ 8.88e-16 (:7023–7024). - On the old fixture the ragged part was N_i: +4.20e-2 in area (20261001T215942Z_OPS-61-F10a-W1.log:3582). Its one-sided readings were never measured. - This item therefore tests no collapse. It carries the identity onto the exact N_i (40 triangles at both widths, 20261001T220051Z_OPS-61-F10a-W2.log:3591–3594) and onto a solved field. The predicted reading is round-off (≈ 1e-15 … 1e-13), not a fall. - The review should say so in the row amendment below.

Code (tests only): new tests/validation/test_port18_exact_strip_one_sided.py, complex_only. - Fixture (module scope). Call rung = _four_port_rung("PORT-18 exact 10 MHz", np.zeros(4), degree=1, leg_sheet_strip_fraction=GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION) (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_leg_offset_sweep.py:199). - This is item 192's base call (test_ans4_exact_strip_records.py:435–448) at the default FREQUENCY_HZ = 10 MHz, with κ off (width_correction_kappa=None, the 10-02 ruling at PROJECT_PLAN.md:3692). - It hoists create_connectivity / create_entity_permutations (:294–295). - Then solved = _solve_driven(rung, "P1") (tests/validation/test_birdcage_b1_plus_map.py:142–203). It keeps E and returns the production I⁺ for all four sheets in solved["currents"]. - I⁻. Rebuild the sheets exactly as _solve_driven does ([s.sheet(driven=(s.port_id == "P1")) for s in rung["specs"]]). Mirror lumped.py:356–364 with r = lambda f: f("-"), using lumped._sheet_measure for the measure. Allreduce, then divide by h. - Also build a '+' copy of the same mirror, for the fidelity check (B0). - Jump metric. J_i[g] = sqrt( ∫_{N_i} |(g('+') − g('−'))·ĥ|² dS / ∫_{N_i} |g('+')·ĥ|² dS ). - Write the integrand as ufl.inner(d, d), with d the scalar difference. - Assemble on every rank and allreduce. Assert |imag| ≤ 1e-12·real silently, print the imaginary part, and take sqrt in numpy. - No sqrt and no comparison inside UFL. - Interpolated fields (the probe's definitions, :243–254, :276–281): - E_lin = (−z/ρ₀, 0, 1 + x/ρ₀) and the smooth field, both in N1curl degree 1 on the rung's mesh. - ρ₀ is the mean N_i centroid radius, printed beside RING_RADIUS. z̄ is the mean centroid height, and λ = 4 h. - Every SpatialCoordinate-bearing facet form pins metadata={"quadrature_degree": q}. - Planted control field. g = s·ẑ, with s = χ_L − χ_U the DG0 indicator difference of PORT_LOWER + i / PORT_UPPER + i. Set owned values from cell_tags, then x.scatter_forward() (the probe's _indicator idiom, :141–150).

Anchors (asserted, every sheet, both widths unless stated). - (P0) Fixture identity. - Cells vs ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_CELL_RECORD within CELL_COUNT_BAND. - Each N_i area vs SPEC_AREA_M2 (test_ans4_exact_strip_records.py:131–133) within STRIP_BAND (test_ops61_exact_strip_ports.py:58). - At -n 2 only (ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_RECORD_RANK_WIDTH): ‖S − ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_S_P1_RECORDS["10"]‖/‖rec‖ ≤ STEP3A_RECORD_RTOL. At -n 1 it is printed. - Backed by item 192 W1 (20261003T093408Z_ANS-4-item192-W1-p1.log:1899, 2117–2132). - (P1) Premise. ∫(n('+')·ĥ)² dS / A_i ≤ PREMISE_BAND on every N_i, i.e. ĥ lies in the sheet. - Asserted: 24 of 24 readings on F_i were 0.000000000000000 (…093526Z…:7008, 7037, 7066, 7095; …093810Z…:3517, 3546). N_i ⊂ F_i is coplanar. - (A) E_lin closed form. R_i^± = 1 + x̄_i/ρ₀ within EXACTNESS_BAND, with the relative denominator max(|target|, 1) (ratified by the 09-10 10:30 review). - Asserted: ≤ 8.88e-16 on F_i (:7023–7024). - (B0) Mirror fidelity. The test's '+' copy reproduces solved["currents"][P_i] to ≤ EXACTNESS_BAND relative. Without this, (B) compares a production reading with a different integrand. - (B) The weekly's target. For the P1-driven solve: |I_i⁺ − I_i⁻| / |I_i⁺| ≤ EXACTNESS_BAND on all four sheets, and J_i[E] ≤ EXACTNESS_BAND. The same J_i bound holds for the smooth interpolant. - Predicted ≈ 1e-15 … 1e-13 (the 09-10 interpolant reading on F_i); printed beside the measured value. - The undriven sheets carry O(0.5)-of-driven currents (|S₂₁| ≈ 0.47 in the record), so no denominator is near zero. Print the four |I_i⁺|.

Negative control (asserted: arithmetic, not predicted). - J_i[g] = 2 exactly for the planted DG0 field. - Every N_i facet separates a PORT_LOWER + i cell from a PORT_UPPER + i cell. F_i is built from that cell-tag pair (io/mesh.py:290–373, via _sheet_areas), and N_i ⊂ F_i (OPS-61 (A3)). - So g('+') = −g('−') = ±ẑ, whichever side is '+'. - Assert |J_i[g] − 2| ≤ EXACTNESS_BAND. The separation from (B)'s band is 2e9. 2 is this field's closed form, not a tunable factor. - A jump metric that is blind to a discontinuity (one that reads only '+', for example) returns 0 here and fails. - Printed beside it: the signed one-sided means of g, which are ±(2f_i − 1) with f_i = ∫χ_L('+') dS / A_i, at each width. This shows the side assignment the identity is indifferent to.

Printed, never asserted. - I_i^± to 10 digits, |I⁺ − I⁻|/|I⁺|, and J_i for each field. - f_i. - The smooth-field four-sheet spread on N_i, beside 7.223213e-06 on F_i ×1 (…093526Z…:7012). That is GEO-32's lead, not this item's. - Rung, sweep and solve times.

Windows (foreground, Bash timeout: 660000; each harness call is the whole Bash command, bare and repo-relative; -s; no pipes; no -k selection).

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh PORT-18-step2-W1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 timeout -k 30 300 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_port18_exact_strip_one_sided.py -s -v --tb=short'"

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh PORT-18-step2-W2 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 timeout -k 30 300 mpiexec -n 1 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_port18_exact_strip_one_sided.py -s -v --tb=short'"

Cost, from logs. - Exact ×1 rung: 29.77 s, and four degree-1 driven solves in 9.00 s, at -n 2 (20261003T093408Z_ANS-4-item192-W1-p1.log:1899). The rung is 27.05 s at -n 1 (20261001T215942Z_OPS-61-F10a-W1.log:3575). - tests/environment plus light port modules: 51 s at -n 1 (20261002T201726Z_PORT-3-W2.log). - Predicted W1 ≈ 100–150 s and W2 ≈ 110–180 s, inside the 300 s ceiling. - Box-speed gate: if the rung print exceeds 60 s at -n 2, the box is slow. That is a price, not a defect. A window killed at 300 s stops the item BLOCKED with the reading; never lengthen the timeout.

Traps. - Rank-local data: cell_tags.values and facet_tags.values. The DG0 indicator must reach ghost cells (scatter_forward), or '+' on a partition-boundary facet reads 0. assemble_scalar is reduced before any assert. - Collectives: every rank runs every collective, and asserts come after them. A comm. call inside if comm.rank == 0: deadlocks (item 227). - Complex build: ufl.inner conjugates its second argument, so (B)'s difference is taken on the restricted values before inner. No UFL ordering comparison and no sqrt (OPS-22, WF-6 4c). Take real parts only after the reduction, and print the imaginary parts. - Compiles: pin quadrature_degree on every SpatialCoordinate facet form (POST-5). Sweep orphan .c stems only with pgrep -c python3 reading 0, as the rubric's one-line sweep. After a kill, run pgrep -c python3 first. - The S premise is asserted at rank width 2 only. At -n 1, print it. - Run hygiene: rule (i); no edit after the last window.

Scope. - Degree 1, 10 MHz, P1 drive, on the exact ×1 mesh only. Degree 2, the production default, is not exercised. The identity is degree-independent in theory but unmeasured there. - The source term's v('+')·ĥ rests on the same tangential argument and is not measured. - No ragged rung is re-tested or rehabilitated. ANS-4 step 2a and WF-6 step 4f stay as they are. - No band, record, κ setting or src/ line moves. - A ✅ licenses no S₁₁ / Z_in / f₀ figure. It says only that the read-back's '+' restriction is not a source of asymmetry on exact-rectangle sheets.

Negative result. - (B) red (with (P0), (P1), (A), (B0) and the control green): the tangential trace disagrees across a facet. That is an orientation or permutation defect, not physics. - Open a known-issues row naming sheet_terminal_current and _restrict. - Park on attempt/PORT-18-step2-<UTC> and mark BLOCKED in the same commit (rule (d)). - No ufl.avg switch in-slot. It would move every port record at once; this is the row's own instruction. - (P1) red: the exact-strip sheet is not the plane the 09-10 record measured. Stop and report. - (P0) red: the fixture drifted. On an image change this is record-reconciler work; otherwise stop. - (B0) or control red: the instrument is wrong. Fix it once in-slot, disclose, and re-run the window. If it is still red, BLOCKED. - There is no PREDICTED RED line; the drafter predicts green.

Status it can move. PORT-18 🧪 → ✅. - Row amendment (rule (j)), in the review's own commit. The §7 row (PROJECT_PLAN.md:2683) carries no Done-when, only the 09-10 measurement. The review appends:

Done-when (2026-10-05 03:00 review, rule (j); the 10-03 weekly's lane-1 target, §9 item 246): on the exact-rectangle ×1 fixture (leg_sheet_strip_fraction = GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION, κ off), for a P1-driven degree-1 10 MHz solve at -n 2 and -n 1, sheet_terminal_current's '+' reading and its '−' mirror agree within EXACTNESS_BAND (probe:84) on all four sheets, together with the jump metric J_i[E]. E_lin meets its closed form, the premise ĥ ⊥ n̂ holds, and the planted DG0 discontinuity reads J = 2 ⇒ 🧪 → ✅. (The 09-10 record holds no ragged-sheet one-sided discrepancy to collapse: it read the CAD face F_i, where R⁺ = R⁻ to print precision; this closes the identity on the gated strip N_i and on a solved field.) - The Tier cell also gains: "step 2: standard by prediction, heavy by ceiling, -n 2 + -n 1, one degree-1 solve".

docs.title: PORT-19 — Reuse the factorisation across the drives of one sweep
docs.text: Reuse the factorisation across the drives of one sweep — one factorisation per sweep instead of one per port. Opened 2026-09-10, operator direction, on measured cost. The premise, verified in code before this was scoped: in run_lumped_sheet_port_case the extra_bilinear_terms list is built over every port id and references only sheet.sheet_resistivity and ω (ports/lumped.py:484–489), while extra_linear_terms references only sheets[driven_port_id] (:490–493). The system matrix is therefore the same for every drive of a matched-termination sweep and only the right-hand side changes — the textbook multiple-RHS case. Today each drive builds its own LinearProblem and re-factorises: the ANS-4 step 2d log shows one factorize+solve starting per drive, fifteen for fifteen drives. The cost, measured on that run (-n 16, degree 2, 128 MHz): 743 k unknowns 42 s/drive, 1.80 M unknowns 280 s/drive, 3.83 M unknowns 1335 s/drive — and the factorisation is almost all of it. Consequence for the deliverable: a 32-port human-scale sweep at the resolution ANS-4 matched AED at is ≈ 2.5 M unknowns × 32 drives ≈ 5.4 h, which fits no window; with reuse it is one factorisation plus 32 back-substitutions, ≈ 20 min. That is worth more than the 512 → 754 GiB tier and more than extra cores, and it is why xxl is a safety net rather than the fix. Step 1 — prove the premise by measurement, not by reading (smoke, -n 2, no new solver path): assemble the sweep's matrix for drive 1 and for drive 2 on the gated 4-leg fixture and assert they are bit-identical — same nonzero pattern, and ‖A₁ − A₂‖_∞ == 0.0 exactly, not to a tolerance — while the two right-hand sides differ (‖b₁ − b₂‖₂ > 0; the earlier wording "by more than the reference impedance" compared a vector norm to ohms and was struck 2026-09-11 03:00 review). If they are not identical the chunk is void and the finding is the negative result: say which term carries the drive and stop. Step 2 — implement (standard, -n 2): factor once per sweep and solve N right-hand sides, in ports/sparameters.py, behind a default-on keyword so the per-drive path stays reachable for a control. dolfinx's LinearProblem discards its factor with the object, so the reuse has to hold the PETSc KSP/PC across solves — core/time_harmonic.py:563–579 already documents that holding it holds the MUMPS factor and names the peak-memory tradeoff, which here is cheaper than today because one factor is held instead of N built in sequence. Gates, every band imported and unmoved: the 4-leg 4×4 at 10 MHz reproduces PORT-9 leg (d)'s recorded S to 1e-12 or better (it is the same arithmetic, so anything looser is a defect, not a tolerance); reciprocity, σ_max and the C4 class spreads unchanged; and the per-drive route re-run in the same window agrees with the reused route entry by entry. Negative control, asserted: with reuse forced on a sweep whose drives do change the matrix (perturb one port's port_impedance_ohm), the reused result must differ from the per-drive result by ≥ 100× the reproduction band — i.e. the optimisation is provably unsafe exactly where its premise fails, so a future change that breaks the premise cannot pass silently. Printed, gated by nothing: wall time per drive before and after, and the factor's memory. Done-when: both steps ✅, the 32-port PORT-13 sweep re-run and its recorded 32×32 reproduced, the speedup recorded as a measurement rather than a claim. Not in scope: iterative solvers, preconditioners, and any change to the port model — this chunk changes when a factorisation happens and nothing else. Step 1 recorded 2026-09-10 21:00 slot — premise holds, measured: on the gated 4-leg fixture (116 085 cells, 139 140 N1curl(1) dofs, 10 MHz, -n 2, complex) the sum of the four lumped_port_bilinear_terms assembled for drives P1…P4 has one nonzero pattern and ‖A_k − A_1‖_∞ = 0.0 exactly for every k, with 0 differing CSR values (20260911T020253Z_PORT-19-step1.log:1832–1835); per-port ρ_s driven == undriven byte for byte (:1836–1839). Controls: (i) ‖b_1 − b_2‖₂ = 1.768708357 against ‖b_1‖₂ = ‖b_2‖₂ = 1.250665673 (:1840); (ii) P2 at 51 Ω moves A by ‖·‖_∞ = 3.747617978e-02, relative 1.960784314e-02 = 1 − 50/51 as the 1/ρ_s coefficient predicts, 321 CSR values, same pattern (:1841). 17 passed, 60.11 s, Status: 0, harness elapsed 62 s (:1917, 1986–1987); regression tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_four_port.py (additive build_only keyword) 16 passed, 78.69 s, Status: 0, 81 s (20260911T020408Z_PORT-19-step1-regression.log:1971, 2039–2040). The base bilinear_form takes no sheet and was not assembled. Step 2 is live as scoped. Step 2's negative control re-specified 2026-09-11 03:00 review: "reuse forced on a sweep whose drives do change the matrix (perturb one port's port_impedance_ohm)" cannot be built. The perturbed port's sheet enters every drive's matrix, so that matrix is still drive-invariant, as step 1's control (ii) shows. The control is now a stale factor: a factor assembled with P2 at 51 Ω solves the 50 Ω drives' right-hand sides. It is asserted to differ from the per-drive result by more than the 1e-12 reproduction band. The ≥ 100× factor is printed as predicted (rule (e)), because no prior S-level measurement backs it. Queued as §9 item 2. docs.title: §9 item 247 — 2026-10-05 (lane 1)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-05 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it.

PORT-2 step 1: the port tagging contract as a round trip on the exact-strip fixture. This is the lane-1 target the 10-03 weekly named (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4645–4646): "the port tagging contract as a round-trip test on the exact-strip fixture ⇒ ✅". - Executor: implementer. - Tier: standard by measurement of the same build. The row's "smoke" is the pure-Python unit module's word and is re-labelled (see the row amendment). No solve. Complex env, because the fixture's records are tagged to the complex 0.11 image. Two windows: W1 at -n 2, W2 at -n 1. - Class: lane 1. The median is ≈ 8 min. Cost: ≈ 8 measured / ≈ 30 predicted min (15 fixed, ≈ 10 code, two windows of ≈ 1.5 min each). - Depends on nothing. No src/ change: one new test module.

The contract, read off the code. - src/fem_em_solver/ports/definitions.py contains: - the tagging contract comment, :14–22 (facets primary, edges fallback, name template port_<id>_<suffix>); - PortDefinition, :28–61; - required_port_tags, :72–79; - validate_required_port_tags_exist, :82–111. Its warning (:88–97) requires a globally reduced tag set: OPS-14 measured a rank-local read raising on 4/4 ranks at -n 4. - validate_port_ordering, :114–135, and run_port_calibration_checks, :224–246. - On the birdcage the definitions are built in _four_port_rung (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_leg_offset_sweep.py:394–405): - positive_tag = SHEET_IFACE + i. This is a facet tag, rebuilt on the dolfinx side by _interface_facet_tags (src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py:290–373) and narrowed by _narrowed_radial (:166–196). - negative_tag = CONDUCTOR_CELL_TAG. This is a cell tag. - orientation = "leg_gap_axial_plus_z", and z0_ohm = REFERENCE_IMPEDANCE_OHM. - The matching LumpedSheetPortSpec objects are built at :380–391. - Nothing on the lumped-sheet route checks that a PortDefinition's positive_tag equals its spec's facet_tag. run_n_port_sparameter_sweep checks only validity and uniqueness of IDs (src/fem_em_solver/ports/sparameters.py:394–402). - tests/ports/test_port_definition.py exercises the model on literal integers only. No test has read a mesh's tags back through it. The round trip is that test.

Code (tests only): new tests/validation/test_port2_exact_strip_tag_roundtrip.py. - Fixture (module scope). - Call _build(np.zeros(4), leg_sheet_strip_fraction=GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION) (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_leg_offset.py:107). - Then run _sheet_areas and, per port, _sheet_azimuth_deg / _port_frame / _projected_extents / _narrowed_radial. This is the sequence of _rung (tests/validation/test_ops61_exact_strip_ports.py:79–117) and of _four_port_rung (:297–333), imported, never retyped. - Build the PortDefinition objects and the specs exactly as :380–405 does. The specs are constructed only so that their facet_tag can be read; there is no solve. - Reduced tag sets. - facet_set = the sorted union of comm.allgather(np.unique(tags.values).tolist()), the idiom at src/fem_em_solver/ports/excitation.py:271–275. - cell_set is built the same way from cell_tags.values. - Helper _roundtrip(port_defs, specs, msh, tags, comm). It runs every collective on every rank and returns per-port records. It then raises ValueError("port tag/geometry mismatch: …") naming every port for which either: - the spec's facet_tag ≠ positive_tag, or - the tagged facet set's quarter-turn index round(az/90) mod 4 ≠ i − 1.

Anchors (asserted, both widths). - (T0) Premise. - 0.5·dx·dz equals SPEC_AREA_M2 (tests/validation/test_ans4_exact_strip_records.py:131–133, the 0.007 × 0.008 CAD rectangle) within STRIP_BAND (test_ops61_exact_strip_ports.py:58, 1e-9). - Cells vs ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_CELL_RECORD (:64) within CELL_COUNT_BAND. - (T1) Existence, and the right dimension. - validate_required_port_tags_exist(port_defs, facet_set ∪ cell_set) returns. - Stricter, and asserted separately because the validator does not know about dimensions: every positive_tag ∈ facet_set and negative_tag ∈ cell_set. - (T2) Non-empty, with an exact owned-count reduction. Per port: - n_i = the allreduced count of facets < index_map(2).size_local carrying the tag (_owned_facet_count, test_ops61_exact_strip_ports.py:72–76). - Assert n_i > 0. - Assert n_i == |⋃_ranks local_to_global(all local facets carrying the tag)|. This is an integer identity: a reduction that counts ghost copies, or loses one, fails it. - Print n_i beside the 40 triangles recorded at -n 1 and -n 2 (20261001T215942Z_OPS-61-F10a-W1.log:3576–3579; 20261001T220051Z_OPS-61-F10a-W2.log:3591–3594). This is printed only: a mesher record, never registered as a constant. - (T3) Area. |A_i / SPEC_AREA_M2 − 1| ≤ STRIP_BAND per port, with A_i from _interface_area_or_zero. - Asserted: +1.110e-15 … +1.554e-15 on this fixture at -n 2 (…220051Z…:3591–3594). - (T4) Bijection. - port_id → positive_tag is injective, and its image equals {SHEET_IFACE + i} ⊂ facet_set. - Each spec's (port_id, facet_tag) equals its definition's (port_id, positive_tag). - The quarter-turn index of P_i's tagged set is i − 1. This is an integer test with no band. P1 reads ≈ 360.0000° (20261001T220154Z_OPS-61-F10a-W0-regate.log:5313), so the mod 4 is load-bearing. - validate_port_ordering(..., expected_port_order=["P1", "P2", "P3", "P4"]) returns. - run_port_calibration_checks passes on port_face_areas = {P_i: A_i} at its own default ratio of 1.25. Print the ratio.

Negative controls (asserted, by construction; every rank). - (C1) Missing tag. - Drop every facet of SHEET_IFACE + 3 from the tags on every rank, and rebuild meshtags with sorted indices (_narrowed_radial's argsort idiom). - Re-reduce the tag set. validate_required_port_tags_exist must raise ValueError matching r"missing required port tags: \[<SHEET_IFACE+3>\]". - The raise is deterministic and identical on every rank, because the set is reduced. - (C2) Swapped tag. Relabel the facets of SHEET_IFACE + 2 ↔ SHEET_IFACE + 4. - Assert that validate_required_port_tags_exist passes. The existence contract is blind to a swap; this is a set identity. - Assert that (T3) also passes. The areas are equal, as the backing above shows. - Assert that _roundtrip raises "port tag/geometry mismatch" with both P2 and P4 in the message. Their quarter-turn indices are off by 2, so the failure is arithmetically certain. - This is the control that shows why (T4) exists. - (c3) Printed, predicted, never asserted. The rank-local read OPS-14 paid for: whether each rank's np.unique(tags.values) alone holds all four sheet tags, gathered and printed. - At -n 1 it does trivially. At -n 2 it depends on the partition. - Compute it with no validator call inside a rank-divergent branch.

Windows (foreground, Bash timeout: 660000; each harness call is the whole Bash command, bare and repo-relative; -s; no pipes; no -k selection). The existing unit module runs in the same window.

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh PORT-2-step1-W1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 timeout -k 30 180 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/ports/test_port_definition.py tests/validation/test_port2_exact_strip_tag_roundtrip.py -s -v --tb=short'"

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh PORT-2-step1-W2 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 timeout -k 30 180 mpiexec -n 1 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/ports/test_port_definition.py tests/validation/test_port2_exact_strip_tag_roundtrip.py -s -v --tb=short'"

Cost, from logs. - One exact ×1 rung builds in 26.62 s at -n 2 (20261001T220051Z_OPS-61-F10a-W2.log:3590) and 27.05 s at -n 1 (…215942Z…W1.log:3575). The two-rung OPS-61 module took 57 s at either width. - tests/environment plus two pure ports modules took 51 s at -n 1 (20261002T201726Z_PORT-3-W2.log). - Predicted ≈ 70–100 s per window: standard, inside the 180 s ceiling. - Box-speed gate: a rung print over 60 s means a slow box, which is a price. A kill at 180 s stops the item BLOCKED with the reading; never lengthen the timeout.

Traps. - Rank-local data: cell_tags.values and facet_tags.values are rank-local; this is the very OPS-14 defect the validator's docstring names. Filter facets by index_map(2).size_local before counting. - Reductions: _projected_extents / _sheet_azimuth_deg reduce through allgather, elementwise (PORT-9 3c: allreduce on arrays falls through to Python's min). - Collectives: every rank runs every collective, and asserts come after them. pytest.raises runs on every rank. A comm. call under if comm.rank == 0: deadlocks (item 227). - meshtags needs sorted, unique indices. - Azimuth wrap: 360° ≡ 0°. - No UFL form beyond _interface_area_or_zero's dS. It ran green at -n 2 on this fixture (OPS-61 W2). - Compiles: sweep orphan .c stems only with pgrep -c python3 reading 0. - Run hygiene: rule (i).

Scope. - One fixture (exact ×1, zero offsets), one mesh, no solve. - Not exercised: - physical-group names (PORT_TAG_NAME_TEMPLATE, definitions.py:22). The birdcage carries integer tags only; named CAD ports are (9b)'s and GEO-37's; - the edge fallback; - ragged fixtures; - a displaced-leg layout. - The contract is silent on dimension. On this fixture the negative terminal is a cell region; that is recorded, not ruled on. - A geometry-aware swap check in src/ would be a feature, not this lane's. The test-local helper is the deliverable.

Negative result. - (T1) or (T4) red on the unplanted fixture: the port-ID ↔ sheet contract that every four-port record relies on is broken. - Stop. docs.text: The gap-voltage (current-drive) route must report the S-matrix — on that route the undriven ports are open, so S_ij = b_i/a_j is not a column of S; the route's Z is the open-circuit matrix and z_to_s(Z) is S (opened 2026-09-19 by the weekly from the ANS-3 adjudication; known-issues 2026-09-19; serial on nothing; OPS-57's single impedance-to-S implementation is the conversion to call if it has landed, otherwise the existing sparameters_from_impedance) | ✅ 2026-09-20 — steps 1–3 all executed (steps 1–2 in the 04:30 slot, item 11; step 3 in the 09:00 slot, item 17). Step 3 (records, -n 2, complex, standard): the four S-derived records are re-recorded under S = z_to_s(Z) with the power-wave digits kept beside them and asserted to fail each record's own band, and step 2's strict xfail is removed. ports:2 green — 20260920T140828Z_PORT-20.log, Status 0, 181 s: measured ‖S − Sᵀ‖/‖S‖ = 3.112130445718013e-05 and ‖S‖₂ = 0.8613568944845725, reproducing the new records at 1.59e-11 absolute / 1.43e-12 relative against the unmoved 1e-6 bands; the PORT-1 step-4 gate module green — 20260920T141141Z_PORT-20.log, 18 passed / 190 s (was 17 passed / 1 xfailed), passivity_max_sigma 0.8613568944814173 vs the new record 0.861356894 (miss 4.814e-10, band 1e-6) and symmetry ratio 3.1121289645891435e-05 vs 3.112129e-05 (miss 3.541e-13, band 5e-7). The ans:3 leg was not run — pre-registered stop: 03_two_torus_gap_ports_10MHz.py:725-727 rewrites the gitignored COMPARISON_private.md unconditionally whenever aed_results/ is present (it is), which the step forbids, so that case's generated metrics.json / COMPARISON.md still carry the pre-correction S table — filed as a 🟡 known-issues entry (2026-09-20) with its unblock condition; its records are imported from examples/ports/02_…py and are already corrected. For the next interactive session: CLAUDE.md's "PORT-20" open-finding clause (§ the two external findings paragraph) is now stale — the current-route finding is fixed; CLAUDE.md is the operator's file and no slot edits it. History (steps 1–2, item 11): The change landed as pre-registered: run_n_port_sparameter_sweep routes the gap-voltage branch through the new _assemble_current_drive_route_matrices → sparameters_from_impedance(Z); the lumped-sheet branch is untouched. Additive ports/circuit_skrf.py (network_from_records, terminate via an skrf.circuit.Circuit netlist — SeriesImpedance→Ground per terminated port, Circuit.Port per kept port in ascending order, explicit port_map; no reflection coefficient computed in our code) and tests/validation/test_port_circuit_skrf.py (every record / band imported from the PORT-14 / PORT-15 modules; new: IDENTITY_BAND 1e-12, and PORT-15's in-model tuned S₁₁ stored as a cited record from 20260914T020419Z_PORT-15.log:3732). 20260923T093456Z_PORT-23.log, Status 0, 8 s, -n 2, 6 passed per rank (:93, :96). (a) 64 MHz at C_tuned = 1.556993028375804e-11 F: max|Δ| skrf vs (C2) 3.511e-16 (1×1) / 1.415e-16 (2×2) ≤ 1e-12 (:56–62); (b) 10 MHz, P1 terminated, C / L / R ≤ 1.388e-16 (:66–69); (c) the skrf sweep's single zero equals C_tuned (|ratio−1| 0, |Im Z|/|Z| 1.585e-15 ≤ 1e-6); tuned S₁₁ vs PORT-15's in-model record 8.256e-05 ≤ REDUCTION_BAND 1e-3 (:74–78); (d) 50→75→50 Ω round trip 2.122e-15, power vs traveling 1.433e-15, skrf 75 Ω vs raw z_to_s(s_to_z) 9.421e-16 (:82–85; the third check added by the executor at the same band to cover the superposition.py convention clause). Negative control (asserted), 2×2-kept per the 09-23 ruling: a P2↔P3 swapped port map misses (C2) by 2.019e-01 = 201.9× the 1e-3 floor; class gap |S₁₂−S₁₃| 1.596e-01 above the 1e-2 stop (:88–90). API note for step 2: in 2.1.0 Circuit lives at skrf.circuit.Circuit (skrf.Circuit raises; 20260923T093252Z_PORT-23-api-probe.log). Scope: identities on stored matrices; the printed Z_in is not an absolute claim (PORT-21). History: Why a library, and why the raw layer stays: the raw (C2) reduction in ports/circuit.py is forty lines pinned to a closed form and is what the PORT-14/PORT-15 gates run through; it stays as the control. scikit-rf is the product: Touchstone in, connection-list netlist, termination / cascade / de-embed / renormalise native, the same object an HFSS Circuit user builds — so ANS-7 compares like with like and matching networks, baluns and cable models come free. Conventions (power vs pseudo waves, port order, z0 renormalisation — the PORT-20 class of bug) are checked once, here, against the raw layer. Step 1 — the identity. Additive ports/circuit_skrf.py: network_from_records(s, z0, f) builds an skrf.Network from a stored 4×4 (the PORT-15 module records at 64 and 10 MHz, imported); terminate(network, {port: Z}) builds an skrf.Circuit of that network plus lumped impedances on the terminated ports and returns the kept-port S. Gates (asserted): (a) terminate vs reduce_terminated_ports at C_tuned on the stored 64 MHz 4×4 (the PORT-15 step 3 sweep, imported), 1×1 and 2×2 kept, max|Δ| ≤ 1e-12 — an identity, the band is machine precision; (b) the same at 10 MHz with the PORT-15 step 2 terminations (the reduction floor); (c) the tuning zero found by sweeping C through terminate reproduces C_tuned to TUNING_IM_Z_RTOL (imported) — the tuned S₁₁ then reproduces PORT-15's in-model record at the imported REDUCTION_BAND; (d) convention control: renormalising the network to a different real z0 (75 Ω) and back returns the input to 1e-12, and s_def='power' vs 'traveling' agree for real z0 to 1e-12 — asserts the library's wave convention is the one superposition.py documents. Negative control (asserted): a deliberately mis-ordered port map (ports 2 and 3 swapped in the netlist) breaks gate (a) by ≥ 1e-3 — port order is the silent failure a netlist invites, and the control shows the gate sees it. Printed, never gated: the kept-port Z_in from both engines, the skrf version. Done-when: (a)–(d) and the control green through the harness at -n 2 (numpy + stored records; no field solve), elapsed recorded ⇒ PORT-23 ✅ and the plan's circuit-layer sentence in §2.1 names scikit-rf as the engine with the raw reduction as its control. Step 2 (amended 2026-10-01 10:30 review, rule (j), to the 2026-09-30 weekly's lane-1 target; §9 item 155): on ans:7's 51 stored grid 4×4 S (logs/ans7/B1.json / B2.json, Cu and PEC), terminate (P2–P4 in C_F) reproduces Route B's Z_bare (route_b_z on z_from_s) to S_VS_Z_ROUTE_RTOL at every point; parallel_rows on the skrf-side Z_in gives f₀, R_in, Q_loaded within 1e-9 of the raw route and within test_ans7_sparse_route_b.BANDS of metrics.json's rows; harness, complex, -n 2 ⇒ PORT-23 ✅. The former step 2 (Touchstone + a text netlist for Ansys Circuit and skrf, on the TH-17 / PORT-22 tuned fixture) leaves this row for the weekly to re-home. Not in scope: nonlinear or time-domain elements (that would be ngspice, and nothing in the plan needs it).

docs.text:

docs.text:
Outcome (2026-10-08 04:30 implementer slot): BLOCKED as a record — the pre-registered PREDICTED RED: (Im-bitwise) fired inside its range [1e-18, 1e-13]. Run docs/testing/logs/20261008T094657Z_PORT-24-step1.log (6 s, smoke, -n 1). Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-08 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Settled from the code. - ring_mode_rows (src/fem_em_solver/ports/ring_modes.py:130), ring_mode_rows_v2 (:186, composes v1, passes esr_ohm through to every inner call incl. controls :206), terminated_currents (:116, y_load = jωC at :121; feed rows yin :163; feed 2×2 jwc·I :172). λ_k is the antisymmetric eigenvalue of the k-block of Ẑ = W Z Wᴴ (k_blocks :74, antisymmetric_eigenpair :88); C_mode = 1/(ω Im λ₁) :147, 180. - 4-port circuit terminations (F-small): _capacitor_impedance / tuned_input (tests/validation/test_port_circuit_layer_field.py:355, 365, via series_rlc_impedance(f, c_f=C) — already takes r_ohm, src/fem_em_solver/ports/lumped.py:138) and the ans:7 SPEC circuit layer z_cap / add_c1 / route_b_s / route_b_z (examples/ansys_benchmarks/ans7_tuned_copper_birdcage_driven_sweep/07_tuned_copper_birdcage_driven_sweep.py:167–185). Anchors (asserted). - (B) default bitwise: with esr_ohm unset, every output of the edited functions on each stored record equals the pre-change function's output bitwise (the pre-change source loaded from git show <sha>^:path pinned, never HEAD:), and tests/unit/test_ans8_private_comparison.py stays green (its tracked-file byte-identity check). - (S) at r = 0.2 Ω: Re λ_k(r) − Re λ_k(0) = r for every k, at 1e-12 relative; Im λ_k and C_mode bitwise unchanged — on the F-human 32×32 (k = 0…8) and on the F-small 4×4 at 10 / 64 / 128 MHz (λ_k there is the N = 4 DFT diagonal through a local helper, per ruling Q2 below). - (P) planted non-uniform r (one gap at 0.4 Ω, the rest 0.2): the uniform shift fails on every mode.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (P) predicted, asserted as the Done-when's control: a bottom-gap plant shifts the bottom ring's k-domain diagonal by mean(r) = 0.2125 Ω, the top's by 0.2, so the antisymmetric eigenvalue moves ≈ 0.206 Ω, ≈ 3 % of r off the identity — ≈ 1e10 above the 1e-12 bar (ceiling: the full 0.2 Ω plant excess). No prior measurement; predicted. - (T) predicted: an implementation that wires r into the termination only (y_load) leaves λ_k unchanged and fails (S) by exactly r (100 %). This is the reason r must enter the loop impedance (Z + diag r), not only the load.

Traps already paid for. Bitwise default needs a branch, not arithmetic: 1/(0 + 1/(jωC)) is not bitwise jωC, so the r = 0 path must keep the old expression; pin the pre-change commit (test_orphan_guard.sh, OPS-43); pytest needs -s for the printed rows; never -k a or b inside the quoted command; harness foreground.

Status it can move. PORT-24 ⬜ → 🟡 (the row's step-1 Done-when, PROJECT_PLAN.md:2716); unblocks T26 / PORT-24 step 2.

PREDICTED RED: (Im-bitwise) range [1e-18, 1e-13]

(Max relative |Im λ_k(r) − Im λ_k(0)| / |Im λ_k(0)| over k and records, and the same for C_mode. A red inside the range with every other assertion green parks the item as a record for the weekly. A red above 1e-13 stops the slot. The default-bitwise clause (B) is a hard assertion, not covered by this line.)

Questions for the review (answered below). (Q1) The Done-when requires Im λ_k bitwise while Re shifts at 1e-12. If r enters as Z + diag(r) and λ is re-computed by np.linalg.eig, Im is not guaranteed bitwise (LAPACK is not shift-invariant to the last bit); if λ(r) is formed as λ(0) + r, Im is bitwise but (S) is tautological for uniform r and only (P) exercises the eig path. The review rules which reading of "λ_k(r)" the step implements (network λ unchanged plus a new loop eigen-impedance key, or Z + diag r), or pre-registers a PREDICTED RED for Im-bitwise; the implementer does not choose. (Q2) On the F-small 4×4, λ_k is undefined in the code today (ring_mode_rows is 32-port only): the review names it (4-point DFT diagonal of Z, or eigvals of Z + rI sorted by k).

Review rulings (2026-10-08 03:00 daily review). (Q1) λ_k(r) is computed through the production path on the terminated matrix (Z + diag(r) through the new esr_ohm keyword), never formed as λ(0) + r. "Im λ_k and C_mode bitwise unchanged" is asserted as written, with the PREDICTED RED: (Im-bitwise) line above. The default (r = 0 / unset) bitwise-vs-stored-records clause stays a hard assertion via the r = 0 branch, compared against a pinned pre-change commit, never HEAD:. (Q2) On the F-small 4×4, λ_k is the N = 4 DFT diagonal v_kᴴ Z v_k with the normalisation ring_mode_rows uses at N = 32. ring_mode_rows cannot take N = 4: N_SLOTS = 16 and two rings are fixed at module level (ring_modes.py:38–39), and _canonical_permutation (:56) rejects anything but 32 ports. So the test module carries a local helper, first asserted equal to ring_mode_rows' construction (_dft_matrix :68 / k_blocks :74) on the F-human 32×32 to 1e-14. (Q3) Settled in item 309 below.

docs.title: §9 item 309 — 2026-10-08 (chain T26 prerequisite — PORT-24 step 2, in-model series-RC sheet)
docs.text:
Outcome (2026-10-08 12:00 implementer slot): GREEN on all three arms ⇒ PORT-24 ⬜ → 🟡 on step 2 alone (step 1, item 308, stays BLOCKED). Module tests/validation/test_port24_series_rc_sheet.py (new; helpers imported by name, no edit to any other file). Fixture: F-small exact-rectangle hole mesh (_exact_geo, GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION), 80 798 cells, 64 MHz, degree 1, κ off (width_correction_kappa=None asserted on every spec), copper Leontovich column, C = C_F = 6.629e-11 F, Z = r − j37.51389328 Ω. Construction per arm: the 50 Ω 4×4 (4 solves), then for each sheet i the field-solved 3×3 with sheet i carrying its series-RC against reduce_terminated_ports(S₄, 50, {i: series_rlc_impedance(f, r_ohm=r_ref, l_h=0, c_f=C)}) — PORT-14's identity on every sheet — and one P1 drive (P2–P4 in the arm's series-RC) for the power identity. - r02 (20261008T170256Z_PORT-24-step2-r02.log, 94 s): (I) residuals P1–P4 3.049e-5 / 3.036e-5 / 3.041e-5 / 3.004e-5 (≤ REDUCTION_BAND 1e-3, asserted); (P) power identity 1.011e-12 (≤ DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL 1e-6, asserted); 50 Ω 4×4 reciprocity 7.4e-16. - r0 (20261008T170618Z_PORT-24-step2-r0.log, 140 s): (I) 3.097e-5 / 3.084e-5 / 3.088e-5 / 3.051e-5; (Z) r = 0 series-RC sheet vs the capacitor-only sheet (ans:7 z_cap) per-sheet 3×3: 5.2e-16 / 7.6e-16 / 2.5e-16 / 2.8e-16 (≤ LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND 1e-9, asserted; not bitwise 0 — printed as measured); (P) 1.017e-12; RC sheets dissipate exactly 0 W. - plant (20261008T170439Z_PORT-24-step2-plant.log, 91 s): (Pl) the planted P2 (0.4 Ω) against the 0.2 Ω reduction 1.095e-2 = 10.95× REDUCTION_BAND (asserted > band); unplanted max 3.049e-5 (asserted ≤ band); (P) 1.012e-12. The brief's predicted ceiling (≈ 5.3e-3, the terminal-impedance level) is exceeded by ≈ 2× — the S-level residual is larger than the impedance-level excess (|Γ| ≈ 1 termination, the (I − S_bb Γ)⁻¹ factor). The asserted direction holds; the ceiling was printed, never asserted — recorded as a missed prediction, not a failure. - (Dz), printed only: with the RC sheets' dissipation omitted the identity residual reads 7.031e-3 of P_src at r = 0.2 (1.0e-12 at r = 0). The RC sheets take 70.8 % of the non-port dissipation (P_RC 2.545e-5 W vs P_vol + P_surf 1.051e-5 W; P1's 50 Ω sheet dominates P_src). The brief's "≈ Q_Cu/(Q_Cu + Q_C)" is a share of the dissipated power excluding the 50 Ω load, not of P_src, so the two printed numbers do not compare directly. - Q(r)/Q(0), printed only: at fixed stored energy, P_rest/(P_rest + P_RC) = 0.2923; with Q_C = 1/(ωCr) = 187.57 this implies Q_rest = 454.1 for the copper + phantom losses. P_rest itself moves 0.7 % between r = 0 (1.058e-5 W) and r = 0.2 (1.051e-5 W) on the same drive. - Price: 23 s mesh, ≈ 5.7 s per 50 Ω 4×4, ≈ 14 s per 3×3, 4.5 s per field solve at -n 2 — every arm far under the 590 s heavy ceiling; the weekly may re-label the §7 tier column from this.

Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-08 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it. If item 308 did not land, skip. Licence: §7 row step 2 (PROJECT_PLAN.md:2716), §10 T26 (:4586–4592). No band, tolerance, Done-when or target is set or moved. Target (row's): identities on one fixture.

  • Executor: implementer. Tier: standard, -n 2, one arm per window (r = 0.2; r = 0; planted), container timeout -k 30 180. Class: chain step (solve). Depends on: item 308.
  • Cost: ≈ 60 predicted min (15 fixed + 20 code + ≈ 12 compute + spare). Prior measurement: ANS-7-item195-W2-routeA, 548 s (docs/testing/test-results.md:2961). That window is the in-model exact-strip Route A on F-small, but it covers several sweep nodes. A single 64 MHz point should be well under it, and T26 calls the class "257 s" (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4592). If a single-arm window overruns 180 s, kill and report; never raise the timeout. The review may re-tier to heavy, since the §7 row's "standard" was not priced against this.
  • Settled so far: the sheet impedance already accepts r — series_rlc_impedance(f, r_ohm=r, l_h=0, c_f=C) (src/fem_em_solver/ports/lumped.py:138); capacitor sheets are placed via LumpedPortSheet with z_term = series_rlc_impedance(…) (tests/validation/test_port_lumped_rlc_termination.py:247). The F-small exact-rectangle fixture with in-model C is tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py (_exact_geo :409, route_a :425, C_F :91); κ off (width_correction_kappa=None, §9 binding ruling :3733).
  • Anchors (asserted; imported by name). The sheet (r, C) is compared with series_rlc_impedance(0.2, 0, C) at REDUCTION_BAND (tests/validation/test_port_lumped_rlc_termination.py:88). Its source comment (:85) names it "the PORT-14 §7 entry's pre-stated band for the reduction identity", ‖S′_meas − S′_pred‖_F / ‖S′_pred‖_F (:15), so it is kept. The r = 0 vs capacitor-only 4×4 at LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_four_port.py:165); exact power identity with the sheet's own dissipation at DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL (tests/validation/test_birdcage_power_identity.py:227). Printed: Q(r)/Q(0) vs 1/Q = 1/Q_Cu + 1/Q_C, Q_C = 1/(ωCr).
  • (Pl) planted non-uniform r — predicted, asserted to fail on the planted sheet. One sheet is at 0.4 Ω, the other three at 0.2. That sheet's identity against series_rlc_impedance(0.2, 0, C) must fail. At C_F = 6.629e-11 F (ans7 metrics.json c_f; test_ans7_exact_strip.py:91) and 64 MHz, |1/(ωC)| ≈ 37.5 Ω, so the 0.2 Ω excess is ≈ 5.3e-3 relative at the terminal-impedance level. That is ≈ 5× REDUCTION_BAND, with a ceiling of ≈ 5.3e-3. The S-level residual is not measured and may be smaller, so the margin is predicted. A planted residual inside REDUCTION_BAND means the identity cannot see r at this C: report and stop, never a pass. The three unplanted sheets must still pass.
  • (Dz) dissipation omitted — predicted, printed, never asserted. With the sheet's own dissipation left out, the power-identity residual should read ≈ the ESR share of loss, Q_Cu/(Q_Cu + Q_C), with Q_C = 1/(ωC r) ≈ 188 at this C. No prior measurement on the same fixture, so it is not asserted.
  • Traps: complex build first (tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py, FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1); exact rectangles only, never a sub-sheet out of a box; no ufl.max_value/ordering on complex operands; pin facet-integral quadrature degree; container timeout -k 30 ≤ 590.

New module only; helpers imported from test_ans7_exact_strip.py / test_port_lumped_rlc_termination.py by name, with no edit to either file.
  • Scope / status: Done-when step 2 ⇒ PORT-24 ✅ (with step 1 green). Not claimed: measured ESR, frequency dependence, AED. Negative result: report and stop, attempt/PORT-24-step2.

Review rulings, second pass (2026-10-08 03:00 daily review, items 308 / 309). (309-tier) Heavy, not standard: no 64 MHz degree-1 exact four-port window at -n 2 has been measured on this fixture (the nearest, ANS-7-item195-W2-routeA, took 548 s over several points), so each of the three arm windows runs at container timeout -k 30 590; a kill parks the item and is the price record. The §7 row's tier column is the weekly's to re-label from the measurement. (308-scope) Item 308 edits src/ and adds one new test module only. It does not edit examples/ansys_benchmarks/…/07_tuned_copper_birdcage_driven_sweep.py (that is T27's, example-runner, serial on T26) nor tuned_input in test_port_circuit_layer_field.py: the new module re-implements those terminations with esr_ohm, and asserts its r = 0 path bitwise equal to the existing helpers by import. Any src/ public signature change re-runs scripts/docs/generate_api_reference.py and tests/package/test_wf17_api_reference.py in the same slot.

Review rulings (2026-10-08 10:30 daily review, after item 308 parked). (308-disp) Item 308 stays BLOCKED for the 10-10 weekly. Its red is the Done-when's own clause ("Im λ_k and C_mode bitwise unchanged"), measured at 2.889e-15 / 4.571e-16 on F-human through np.linalg.eig of the shifted 2×2 k-blocks and exactly 0 on F-small (20261008T094657Z_PORT-24-step1.log). Landing the branch as written would put a red test on main, and changing the clause to a tolerance is moving a Done-when — neither is a daily's to do.
