The example's own assertions run unmodified inside step 4: that is (X). - What the spy records. It records a call only when sys._getframe(1).f_code.co_filename resolves to the example's path. src callers bound the real function at their own import, and anything else is forwarded unrecorded. For a recorded call, on every rank (the example's call is collective, OPS-40/55): 1. Forward the call unchanged; this is what the example receives. 2. Measure n_inc = _n_incident(msh, pts, comm) first. 3. own = real(f, pts, comm, owner=RULE) and leg = real(f, pts, comm, owner=None), on the identical pts array of this call. 4. owner_orig, owner_local = point_owner_cells(msh, pts, comm). 5. The legacy cell, from _dg0_index(msh) evaluated with owner=None (t2's _legacy_cells pattern; complex build: .real, assert .imag == 0). 6. At each multi-incidence probe, an in-cell evaluation on the owning rank, shared by buffer Allreduce SUM.

Store the caller line, f.name, the element family, the owner kwarg, and copies of everything above. comm is kwargs.get("comm"), else the first positional argument after points, else MPI.COMM_WORLD, because mag:2 passes none.

Anchors (asserted). - (X) The example's own assertions pass at their imported bands, untouched, in every spied window (table above), and run_path exits 0. Each window's log carries the example's full stdout (-s). - (E) Every recorded call carries owner == RULE, and at least one call is recorded. The returned values are bytewise equal to own (the same call, the same batch). - Predicted, printed: call counts mag:1 1, mag:5 2, th:3 4, th:4 6, th:6 4, th:7 4, th:9 4. - The call count equals the -n 2 npz's at the other widths. - (S) Per recorded call: - own is _bitwise_equal_across_ranks; - at every probe with n_inc == 1, own bytes equal leg bytes, call by call on that call's own point array; - at n_inc > 1, own equals the in-cell evaluation to ≤ CLOSED_FORM_TOL relative, with the denominator floored at FIELD_SCALE_FLOOR. - (O) At -n 2, rank 0 writes /workspace/logs/post8/step3b-ii-e1-<tag>-n2.npz (gitignored) and then Barrier. The file holds, per call, owner_orig, n_inc, the caller line and own. At -n 4 / -n 1 the test loads it, with pytest.fail if it is missing (never recompute), and asserts the call count, every n_inc array and every owner_orig array exactly equal. - Printed only, no band: the max over calls and probes of ‖own_w − own_2‖ / ‖own_2‖ (.3e). - Predicted: th ≤ 5e-10 (t1 measured 1.108e-11 on the same sphere family); mag ≤ 1e-3 (t2 measured 9.647e-04, a run-to-run spread of the magnetostatic solve). - The re-gates (rule (c) for item 526): the unedited mat:2, mat:3 and mri:2 run bare at -n 2, Status 0 with their own assertions. - Predicted: every printed figure digit-identical to its guide's record. They sample cell centroids or an imposed uniform field, all single-incidence (526 Scope, POST-8.md:325). - The executor compares each printed record row with the guide by hand and journals it.

Predictions for (S), printed, not asserted. - Single-incidence everywhere except: - th:4's two profile calls (:380): the 25 points sit at z = L/2, a lattice plane of the create_box mesh (n = 24 in z, :184–188), and x = a/2 at k = 12. They are multi-incidence. They sample the CG1 export, which is continuous, so the owner value equals the in-cell value and PROFILE_RMS_MAX's printed 0.200 % does not move at its printed digits. - mag:1's point 0 at (r_wire, 0, 0): an OCC cylinder's seam lies at φ = 0, so a multi-incidence wire/air edge is likely. - Printed per multi-incidence probe: n_inc, the owner and legacy indices, and the delta between the owner and legacy samples ((R), ruling 537).

Negative controls. - (N0), asserted (rule (e)), on th:3's first e_real call and mag:5's penalty B call (both DG; same form as t1 / t2): - V is the lexicographically smallest vertex of probe 0's owner cell, with coordinates shared by Allreduce SUM; - n_inc(V) ≥ N0_MIN_INCIDENT, and max/min |f| over V's incident cells (each rank's _owned_incident_cells, then allgather) > 1 + N0_SPREAD_FLOOR. - Predicted: > 1.007 (t1's sphere) and > 1.01 (DG B; t2 measured 4.2). - It is printed only for the other DG calls and skipped for CG1 calls, since a continuous field has no jump. - (N1), printed: the legacy cell at V against the owner, at each width.

R1 consequence (mag:1), declared before the run. - The switch from CG1 to DG moves the guide-table rows "Relative L2 error 51.9781 %", "Max relative error 76.7330 %" and "Decay ratio 20.31" (01_straight_wire.md:17–23), plus the per-radius ratio prose (:126–128), by construction. No assertion reads them, so this is not a red, and no PREDICTED RED line is written. - Re-registered only under R1: the queueing review's ruling, written beneath this brief. Re-record from the -n 2 log, keeping the superseded CG1 digits in an HTML comment as EX-30 did (01_straight_wire.md:25–36). Also re-sync :107–114, which says the digits "reproduce … at fixed rank count". - The energy row 2.630243e-08 J and the mesh row 21 830 / 4 662 cannot depend on sampling. A move in either is a finding: stop. - Predicted, printed: relL2 within ±10 points of 51.98 %, direction not predicted. - Without R1, nothing is re-recorded.

Windows. Each window runs in the foreground with Bash timeout: 660000, pytest -s, and container timeout -k 30. Each harness call is the whole bare Bash command. Before every compute window, docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 reads 0. 0. Pre-checks: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml ps shows fem-em-solver Up; pgrep reads 0. 1. Pre-censuses: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh POST-8-step3b-ii-e1-pre-figures "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && timeout -k 30 60 python3 scripts/testing/check_example_setup_figures.py'" scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh POST-8-step3b-ii-e1-pre-docrefs "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && timeout -k 30 60 python3 scripts/testing/check_example_doc_references.py'" Exit 2 means stale, exit 1 is a failure. Predicted delta: none (no example and no figure added). 2. Dry run (prints lines only; host-side, never inside docker compose exec, never without --dry-run): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh POST-8-step3b-ii-e1-dryrun "./scripts/run_examples.sh -e 1,5,th:3,th:4,th:6,th:7,th:9,mat:2,mat:3,mri:2 -n 2 -t 180 --dry-run" It confirms each example's build (mag real; th / mat / mri complex) and environment. If a printed line carries an environment variable the commands below lack, add it to that window verbatim and journal it. 3. Code: the edits and the module. 4. Collect, both builds: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh POST-8-step3b-ii-e1-W0-real "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 60 python3 -m pytest tests/post/test_post8_step3b_ii_example_sites.py --collect-only -q -s'" scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh POST-8-step3b-ii-e1-W0-complex "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 60 python3 -m pytest tests/post/test_post8_step3b_ii_example_sites.py --collect-only -q -s'" 5. Runs of record, one example per window, -n 2. Each writes its npz. - Real (mag1, then mag5): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh POST-8-step3b-ii-e1-mag1-n2 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_POST8_EXAMPLES=1 timeout -k 30 180 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/post/test_post8_step3b_ii_example_sites.py::test_mag1 -v -s --tb=short'" - Complex (th3, th4, th6, th7, th9, in that order): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh POST-8-step3b-ii-e1-th3-n2 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_POST8_EXAMPLES=1 timeout -k 30 180 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/post/test_post8_step3b_ii_example_sites.py::test_th3 -v -s --tb=short'" - The other five are these commands with the tag in the label and the node ID changed. 6. -n 4 groups: - POST-8-step3b-ii-e1-mag-n4: the real form with -n 4 and node IDs ::test_mag1 ::test_mag5, container 180. - POST-8-step3b-ii-e1-th-n4: the complex form with -n 4 and the five th node IDs in order, container 180. 7. -n 1 groups: - POST-8-step3b-ii-e1-mag-n1: container 180. - POST-8-step3b-ii-e1-th-n1: container 400, heavy by ceiling. 8. Re-gates, bare examples, -n 2, complex: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh POST-8-step3b-ii-e1-mat2-regate "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src timeout -k 30 300 mpiexec -n 2 python3 examples/materials/02_lossy_sphere_sar.py'" - …-mat3-regate: examples/materials/03_gelled_saline_presets.py, container 300. - …-mri2-regate: examples/mri/02_mass_averaged_sar.py, container 180. 9. Guides. Re-sync the seven guides: one sentence at the step that reads the sampled values, naming the owner rule, the single-incidence count and the -n 2 log by full filename. mag:1 also gets the R1 table work. Then run the post-censuses (window 1 relabelled …-post-figures / …-post-docrefs): the same counts, broken=0, dead=0. 10. git status --porcelain examples/ tests/ src/ scripts/ docker/ lists only the seven scripts, seven guides and the new module. Run scripts/testing/check_private_leak.py on the staged logs.

Traps already paid for. - Batch composition (item 537's deviation, attempts.md ≈ 1698). .eval bytes depend on the batch, at ULP level. Every byte comparison ((E), (S)) is made call by call on that call's own point array. Never concatenate or split captured batches, and never compare against a re-sample built differently. The (O) spread is per call. - Rule (i): an edit to any edited example or to the module after window 5 starts means windows 5–7 again (all spied windows). An edit to a guide does not. - ./scripts/run_examples.sh --dry-run only prints lines. Every example runs in its own bare harness call above, never through the runner. - Never set FEM_EM_SETUP_FIGURES. No figure changes, and a re-render dirties tracked PNGs. The examples' paraview_output/ directories are gitignored, including mag:1's cwd-relative /workspace/paraview_output/. - runpy hygiene: - patch both import paths before run_path; - set sys.argv (mag:4-style argparse elsewhere would otherwise read pytest's argv); - a nonzero SystemExit is a red; - undo() in finally, so the grouped -n 4 / -n 1 windows start each example clean. - Rank safety: every spy collective runs on all ranks inside the example's own collective call. Only rank 0 prints. n_inc and .eval are rank-local until reduced. Ownership comes only from point_owner_cells (buffer Allreduce MIN). - Complex build: tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py goes first. The DG0 index is complex, so compare .real and assert .imag == 0. Use no ufl ordering on complex operands. - The bash hook denies non-harness pytest and pgrep -f "python3 -m pytest". pgrep -c python3 is the check that runs. - Use new npz names only. Never touch step3a-n2.npz, step3b-n2.npz or step3b-ii-t1-* / t2-*. - A kill is not a result. Run pgrep -c python3 first, then at 0 the rubric cache sweep as POST-8-step3b-ii-e1-cache-sweep. Never raise a timeout or -n. - Leak guard: spy prints at ≤ 6 significant digits, ratios and spreads .3e. On a flag, move the log unchanged to logs/leak-held/, mark BLOCKED and report (item 526 precedent). - Never load ans:2; never open docs/private/ or aed_results/; no AED number. In guides, ≈, never a tilde; full filenames only.

Scope. Seven example call sites, one new test module, seven guides and three re-gates. Not claimed: - item 548's five sites; - mri:1 :486–487 (outside the 17, for the weekly); - 3b-iii; - the src/ legacy callers outside the census; - flipping evaluate_vector_field_parallel's default; - removing the CG1 export's own partition dependence at th:4 :375 / :380 (step 1's mechanism; the rule cannot reach inside an interpolant); - any band or record; - POST-8 ✅.

Negative result. Report and stop. Park on attempt/POST-8-3b-ii-e1-*, mark item 547 BLOCKED in the same commit (rule (d)), and never loosen a band or re-record in the slot. - (X) red at -n 2: stash that example's edit and run it bare at -n 2 as …-<tag>-baseline (the window-8 form). - Baseline red: the failure predates the item; open a known-issues entry. - Baseline green: the rule moved an asserted record. Journal per probe n_inc, the owner and legacy indices and the delta. The review re-poses the site (a (1*) re-record by record-reconciler, or a source switch); never re-record here. - (X) red only at -n 4 / -n 1: the example's band is not width-free. Open a known-issues entry; the review re-poses. - (E) red: the edit is not the one ruled. Park. - (S) red: - if every red probe has owner index = legacy index and differs by a few ULP, it is the batch effect inside one call. Report it; the review re-poses (S)'s byte form; - otherwise it is a rule-path defect: new known-issues entry. - (O) red: the indices are not partition-free. New known-issues entry. - (N0) red: park for a re-pose. - A re-gate red, or a printed digit moved against its guide: annotate known-issues 2026-09-27 (3b-i's flip reached an example). The review rules. - Census broken or dead > 0 from this item's own text: fix the reference. Otherwise report. - Status 124: not a result; park with the measured time.

There is no PREDICTED RED: line; a red anywhere stops the slot.

Status it can move. POST-8 stays 🟡: the Done-when (PROJECT_PLAN.md:2670) still needs 548 and 3b-iii. - The §7 state line's "12 examples open" becomes "3b-ii examples e1 done; 5 examples open (mag:2, mag:4, mag:6, ports:1, ports:12)". - It gains: "Step 3b-ii-e1 done (§9 item 547): seven example sites (mag:1, mag:5, th:3/4/6/7/9) sample under the owner rule [mag:1 on the DG source, R1]; each example's own assertions green at -n 1 / 2 / 4; / probes single-incidence, rule = legacy bytewise there; owner indices exact across widths, spread printed; mat:2 / mat:3 / mri:2 re-run green after 3b-i ()." - Known-issues 2026-09-27's "Verified at" gains e1, and the entry stays OPEN until 3b-iii.

Census windows. Setup figures: pre and post, counts unchanged, broken=0. Docrefs: pre and post, dead=0 both sides. Journal both readings.

Execution order. Pre-checks → pre-censuses → dry run → code → W0 real / complex → -n 2 × 7 → -n 4 × 2 → -n 1 × 2 → re-gates × 3 → guides → post-censuses → git status / leak check → commit → journal.

Commit list: - the seven example scripts and seven guides; - tests/post/test_post8_step3b_ii_example_sites.py; - the harness logs (the test-results.md rows are the harness's own); - PROJECT_PLAN.md: the §7 POST-8 sentence and §9 item 547 DONE; - docs/testing/known-issues.md: the 2026-09-27 "Verified at"; - this file's outcome line.

The journal goes in attempts.md in its own commit.

Spawn line: "Use the example-runner agent to execute POST-8 §9 item 547 (step 3b-ii-e1) per docs/planning/chunks/POST-8.md (heading §9 item 547) and the review ruling beneath it, R1 included. - Read the brief and the ruling first; the ruling holds. - You are the executor: do not spawn agents. - The harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, repo-relative, nothing chained or piped. - Run every window in the foreground with timeout: 660000, pytest -s, container timeout -k 30, in the brief's order. pgrep -c python3 must read 0 before each compute window. - ./scripts/run_examples.sh is used only with --dry-run. - Edit only the seven named call sites (and mag:1's comment under R1), their guides, and the new module. Never set FEM_EM_SETUP_FIGURES. Never re-record anything except mag:1's table under R1. - Compare bytes only call by call on the same point array. - If the docker socket is denied, stop and report the exact command string. - If the leak guard fires, move the log unchanged to logs/leak-held/, mark BLOCKED and stop. - On a red, park on attempt/POST-8-3b-ii-e1-*, mark item 547 BLOCKED in the same commit, and report. - Return the log names with elapsed times, per example the call count / single-incidence count / (O) result / spread, the (N0) readings, the re-gate digits against their guides, and the census before and after."

Questions for the review. - R1 (mag:1). Switch the sample from the CG1 B_lag to the DG source B under the rule, and license the guide-table re-record above? The CG1 interpolant carries step 1's partition dependence, which the rule cannot remove, so the current 51.9781 % is a -n 2-specific figure. If declined: keyword only, table held. - R2 (mag:6, item 548). The sample is the CG1 export on purpose. The drafter recommends the keyword only, with no switch. This is the analogue of t2's :149 / :239 ruling, except that here the CG1 value is the asserted object. - R3. The spied -n 2 window is each edited example's run of record. Its own assertions run as __main__, and the spy only forwards and adds side calls. There is therefore no separate bare run, except for the three unedited re-gates. - R4. mri:1 :486–487 is named for the weekly. - R5. The re-classification table above supersedes item 526's α / β / γ labels for the examples.

(N0) mag:5 6.329747 (n_inc 22), th:3 1.000082 (n_inc 26; asserted floor 1 + 1e-6 holds, the 1.007 prediction missed). -n 4: mag group 2 passed, (O) exact, spreads 1.681e+00 (mag:1, CG1 interpolant) and 3.827e-06 (mag:5); th group red on th:4 only (20261019T140524Z_POST-8-step3b-ii-e1-th-n4.log, Status 1, 36 s): PROFILE_RMS_MAX reads 2.25 % against 0.200 % at -n 2. docs.text:
• Diagnosis (log-pathologist ruling; journal docs/planning/reviews/2026-10-19-daily-1800.md §4). The log is admissible: footer Status 1, 100 s (20261019T183519Z_POST-8-step3b-ii-e2-mag4-n2.log:755–758), with the same tuple on both ranks (:700–701, :732–733).
  • (1) CONFIRMED. The red is (S) at call 0, probe 20 (_drive_e2:410 → _check_e_s:204, :695–700), after all three rungs of the example ran to completion (:266, :445, :637, :678). Components 0 and 1 differ by exactly 1 ULP; component 2 is equal.
  • (2) Hypothesis A CONFIRMED from the code: within one call, owner and legacy evaluate different inputs on this mesh. two_torus_domain is partitioned with GhostMode.shared_facet (src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py:2306–2326, docstring :1371); birdcage_port_domain is too (:4911–4920). The legacy batch on a rank is every point that hits a local cell, owned or ghost, and the gather keeps the last rank's value (post/evaluation.py:379–388, :413–415). The owner batch is only the points whose owner cell is owned on that rank (:389–396). So on a ghosted mesh a single-incidence probe can be evaluated in a different batch (A1), or on a different rank in a ghost copy (A2). Which of these, or a ghost-copy coefficient difference (A3), produced probe 20's ULP is UNCOUNTABLE.
  • (3) Hypothesis B REFUTED (from code plus bytes). _n_incident counts owned copies, so n_inc = 1 means every ghost copy is a copy of the one cell. A different cell on the coarse rung would move components 0 and 1 (≈ 2 % of |B|, discretisation-dominated) by far more than 1 ULP.
  • (4) The (S) loop stops at its first red, but probe 20 is call 0's last index (21 points). So probe 20 is call 0's only single-incidence red. Calls 1–2, the multi-incidence checks and (N0) are unread. The journal's "other probes unknown" is corrected for call 0.

(S)'s premise, "call by call, same batch" (:870, :963), does not hold on a ghosted mesh, where owner and legacy are not evaluated in the same batch even on one call. How (S) is asserted on ghosted fixtures (bytes in a same-batch re-evaluation, an in-cell tolerance, or per-copy singletons) moves an assertion's form, so it is the weekly's. … POST-8 → ✅ needs e4 and 3b-iii both" (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4755–4774).

The reading of "owner-cell average" (Q1). So the published Row 1 is 3a's cell family: the mean of σ|E|²/(2ρ) over the owner cell, by route (ii), the DG0 indicator (:204–236). The weekly's parenthesis, "the DG-split SAR of the owner cell at each probe point", could instead be read as 3a's raw family, the owner-rule point value. The two differ: cell/raw was 0.639 … 1.596 (20261003T033225Z_POST-8-step3a-W1.log.gz:1953). This brief is written on the Done-when's reading, and the alternative swaps one function and one record (Q1).

docs.title: POST-9 — Adjoint sensitivities of safety functionals
docs.text: Adjoint sensitivities of safety functionals — the gradient of a real functional J(E) (phantom absorbed power, accepted power, a region's averaged SAR, later a lead-tip SAR / temperature) with respect to many parameters at the cost of one extra back-substitution (operator directive 2026-09-28, interactive session; Phase 9, motivated by the worst-case implant-heating research direction: gradient-based search over lead trajectory / tissue properties / coil state instead of brute-force sampling, and first-order uncertainty on a safety margin). Why it is cheap here: the time-harmonic system A(p) u = b is complex-symmetric (Aᵀ = A, reciprocal media), so the adjoint Aᴴ λ = (∂J/∂u)ᴴ is A λ̄ = conj(∂J/∂u)ᴴ — the same factorization the forward solve already holds (PORT-19 keeps one per sweep); then dJ/dp_i = 2 Re(λᵀ (∂b/∂p_i − ∂A/∂p_i u)) + ∂J/∂p_i for every p_i from assembled ∂A/∂p_i forms, no extra solve per parameter. Theory: Jin 3e (FEM formulation and reciprocity chapters) for the discrete system; cite chapter/equation in step 0. Steps (written now, placed by the weekly): 0 — design note: functionals (smooth only — a 10 g-averaged SAR at a fixed cube, never a max, whose derivative is not defined at ties), parameter classes (per-region σ / εᵣ; per-cell σ as a field; lumped C and port drives through PORT-15 / POST-6, where the gradient is exact circuit algebra; geometry / lead path later, shape derivative, a separate step), the conjugation convention written out once and tested. 1 — per-region material gradients, gated on a closed form: dP_abs/dσ for the TH-1 lossy plane-wave slab and for the TH-10 lossy sphere on an imposed field, each by differentiating the closed form (analytic, or complex-step on the series), at the imported TH-1 / TH-10 bands' order; plus a Taylor test (remainder \|J(p + hδ) − J(p) − h ∇J·δ\| falls as h², observed rate ≥ 1.9 over ≥ 3 halvings) and a negative control (a deliberately un-conjugated adjoint fails the Taylor test at rate ≈ 1). 2 — the same on the F-small four-port birdcage (Cu, TH-14): gradients of phantom absorbed power w.r.t. phantom σ / εᵣ and coil σ, Taylor test, and a measured cost ratio (adjoint + all gradients vs one forward solve, asserted ≤ 1.5 on the held factorization). 3 — per-cell σ gradient on F-small, and first-order uncertainty Var J ≈ ∇Jᵀ Σ ∇J for a stated tissue-property covariance, checked against a small Monte-Carlo ensemble (a record, not a gate, until the ensemble size is justified). 4 — consumers, each its own chunk when opened: lead-path shape sensitivity for Phase 7 (WF-9), temperature functionals through the Phase 8 Pennes solve (coupled adjoint), worst-case search. Serial on: TH-1 ✅, TH-10 ✅, TH-14 ✅, PORT-19 ✅; steps 1–3 need nothing from Phases 6–8. Not claimed: any worst-case or compliance statement; gradients of non-smooth functionals (maxima). | ⬜ Future work, Phase 9 (operator directive 2026-09-28). Not dated; the weekly places it. It is not on §9 rule (5)'s lanes unless the operator releases it.

The like-for-like reading (step 4's own two-rung form on the finest pair): [−2.0415 %, −0.4256 %], p_eff 2.876, which overlaps both of step 4's brackets — 10 MHz [−2.1492 %, −0.9050 %] and 30 MHz [−3.3675 %, −0.3812 %]. That is the pre-registered signature that the eddy→displacement "trend" was the resolution term all the way to Larmor, extending step 4's finding from 30 MHz to 64 MHz on a measured rung rather than an extrapolation. Supporting identities all green: complex-power residual 4.71e-14 loaded / 6.11e-14 free against 1e-9; the σ-blind control has the free solve dissipating exactly 0.000 W against the loaded 0.634 W; ΔR by dissipation equals ΔR by reaction to all ten printed digits (1.3512462e+00 Ω); I′ 0.968758 A. ΔX ratio 0.9478, the box-truncation reading MAT-6 step 9 measured, unchanged in kind. Three caveats, stated: (1) Dodd–Deeds is quasi-static and is the comparison, not the reference, at 64 MHz — what converges here is agreement with the quasi-static form, which bounds displacement-current effects on this fixture rather than validating full-wave physics against an independent 64 MHz reference; (2) the fit rests on three rungs at ratio 2 with no fourth to check it, and the two-rung p_eff of 2.876 disagrees with the three-rung p of 1.623, so the bracket is the honest object and the point estimate is not; (3) d₀ = −0.7834 % sits just outside the 10 MHz bracket's upper end (−0.9050 %) while the bracket overlaps it — another reason to read the bracket. Consequence, and it is a review's, not this run's: §2.1's "coil-at-Larmor is an extrapolation" sentence is now revisitable — a 64 MHz h → 0 bracket exists and is consistent with 10 / 30 MHz — and the 2026-09-13 weekly owns whether it moves. Nothing in §2 was changed here.

docs.title: Narrative — moved verbatim from PROJECT_PLAN.md §7 (OPS-47)
docs.text:
TH-15 — internal PEC bodies: the conductor as a hole with n × E = 0 on its surface ⬜ (commissioned 2026-09-04 by operator directive, interactive session; the first of two conductor-model routes; serial on nothing; TH-14 and ANS-6 are serial on it.) Why. Every conductor in every gated fixture is a solved-inside volume whose σ is capped by the mesh: δ = √(2/(ωμ₀σ)) ≥ r_wire (asserted in test_port_gap_voltage_impedance.py::test_sigma_respects_the_skin_depth_constraint), which is where the 800 S/m coil comes from. Copper at 10 MHz has δ ≈ 21 µm; no volume mesh resolves it. §1's steps 2–3 (tuning, matching, B₁⁺ and SAR per unit accepted power) are loss-partition quantities and the 800 S/m coil carries a coil-loss share no real birdcage has, so no per-workflow parity claim on a tuned coil can be made on it. The solver has two outer-boundary modes (TimeHarmonicBoundaryCondition: natural, PEC) and no interior conductor model of any kind. This chunk adds the lossless one; TH-14 adds the lossy one on the same mesh and facet tags. Path. Through the TH-1 solver and the PORT-9 extra_bilinear_terms hook — not through TH-3's ⚠️ option set, which the §9 standing rule forbids extending; the review confirms that reading before step 1 runs.

  • Step 0 (mesh, measurement first). Does MeshGenerator emit a conductor as a hole — its volume absent from the cell set, its surface present as a tagged facet set — for the two-torus and birdcage_port_domain generators, with the port sheets still touching the (now surface-only) terminals? Probe with the mesh-probe agent on the two-torus fixture first. Pre-registered stop: if OCC fragmentation of a hollow torus against a sheet lands in the GEO-23 "overlapping facets" family, this becomes a GEO chunk and TH-15 waits on it. Record cell counts against the solved-inside records (a hole is fewer cells; say how many). 🧪 MEASURED 2026-09-05 (00:00 implementer slot, mesh-probe, two-torus only; 🧪 by the §3 rule — the probe tests/mesh/probe_two_torus_conductor_hole.py asserts nothing, and step 1 is what gates this). Seven harness windows, -n 1, real build, standard tier, 3–48 s each. The answer is yes, and the pre-registered stop did not fire — no Invalid boundary mesh (overlapping facets), no mesher fallback, no gmsh warning on the cut route; B meshes as "3D Meshing 5 volumes with 1 connected component". Both variants repeat bit-identically (2 repeats each; every count and printed digit exact). Control (A, solid): 184 176 cells / 31 550 vertices, reproducing the 0.11 record exactly (20260905T050518Z_TH-15.log:950–951, repeat …051110Z:950–951). B (hole): 161 461 cells / 29 345 vertices — a 13.7% cheaper mesh, −22 715 cells (…051023Z:510–511, repeat …051156Z:510–511). Conductor tags absent from the cell census ({3: 110 778, 101, 102, 111, 112}, no tag 1 or 2, …051023Z:512) against A's {1: 9471, 2: 9348, 3: 110 696, …} (…051110Z:952) — the air tag moves only +82 cells (+0.074%), the re-triangulation at the removed interface; the rest of the delta is A's 18 819 conductor cells plus 3 978 fewer gap-piece cells (in B each gap box is two halves, not six pieces). The sheet still touches the terminals: B's port sheets carry 1579 facets each at area 1.451325262e-04 against nominal_area identically, rel dev 1.868e-16 and 0.000e+00 — tighter than A's 2.241e-15 / 2.988e-15 and far inside the 1e-9 reading (…051023Z:514–515). Both halves of each gap box are present in the CAD census. The conductor surface arrives as a facet set: B tag 301, 7642 facets, area 1.515910101e-02 (…051023Z:516) against A's conductor/air interface 7658 facets, 1.515909540e-02 — −16 facets (−0.21%), areas agreeing to 3.7e-7 relative. One mechanism finding step 1 must not rediscover. occ.cut with removeTool=False preserves the tool volume but not its surfaces' identity with the cavity — measured, each torus keeps 6 of its 7 faces and the air gets its own 22 cavity faces. Building the conductor-surface physical group from the retained tool therefore tags faces that are not faces of any tet, and _model_to_mesh aborts: nodes not attached to any tet=716, then Invalid rank has value 1 but must be nonnegative and less than 1 / Abort(202007046) (…050616Z:506–509, isolated by the group-suppressed diagnostic …050827Z). The group must be derived from the meshed volumes' boundary (a face bounding exactly one of air/gap and not flat against an outer wall); that route gives duplicates=0, nodes not attached to any tet=0, and survives dropping the conductor volumes 22/22. Group 301 is exterior to the meshed domain, so it comes straight out of model_to_mesh — no known-issues-9 interior-facet hazard. MeshGenerator was not edited; B is a probe-local copy of the OCC sequence. Step 0b (the birdcage hole) and step 1 are unblocked; step 1 inherits the surface-group rule above.
  • Step 1 (formulation, cheap fixture). Homogeneous Dirichlet on the conductor-surface facet dofs (locate_dofs_topological on the tagged facets — an H(curl) tangential-trace condition, Jin §1.5.2), volume excluded. Gate (closed form): a PEC sphere in a uniform time-harmonic field at 10 MHz — the TH-8 fixture with the sphere's material replaced by the hole — against the static-limit dipole field outside the sphere (E_r, E_θ on the TH-8 sample set); band ≤ the TH-8 record's own miss × 2, pre-stated in the module from the imported TH-8 constant, never restated. ~~Negative control: the same sphere at σ = 800 solved inside must not pass the PEC closed form (the field penetrates \~δ); print its miss.~~ Control corrected by the 2026-09-05 03:00 review, before the step runs. The σ = 800 volume sphere is not a negative control on this fixture: the TH-8 excitation is a quasi-static electric field (k₀R = 5e-3), where what matters is σ/(ωε₀) = 1.4e6 at 10 MHz, so the lossy volume sphere's exterior dipole coefficient is the PEC value to ≈1e-6 — it would pass. (δ ≈ 5.6 mm is the eddy-current penetration and is irrelevant to an E-field exclusion problem.) The same arithmetic says the TH-8 dielectric at ε = 78 has β = (ε−1)/(ε+2) = 0.9625, within 3.75% of the PEC's β = 1 — so a 4.9% band on the field cannot tell a PEC hole from a dielectric sphere. Hence the gate is on the dipole coefficient itself, and the control is the natural cavity: with no condition on the cavity facets the curl-curl weak form's gradient block enforces n·(εE) = 0 there, a void with β = −½ — an exterior E_r at r = 1.2R, θ = 0 of 1 − 2·0.5·(1/1.2)³ = 0.421 E₀ against the PEC's 2.157 E₀, an 80% miss, ceiling |Δβ| = 1.5. Assert the control misses by ≥ 5× the band; the ceiling is 30× and none larger is claimed. Full item in §9 (item 3 of the 2026-09-05 03:00 review). 🟡 MEASURED 2026-09-05 (07:30 implementer slot), NOT CLOSED — the gate passes, one other pre-stated anchor does not, and its band is not mine to move. Code parked on attempt/TH-15-20260905T124500Z; main carries only this note and the logs. All of (a), (b), (c) written; standard tier, -n 2, complex build, four harness windows, 28 / 5 / 6 / 12 s. The gate (anchor i): on the middle rung (13 239 cells — the hole is 25% cheaper than TH-8's 17 667 at the same resolution) the fitted exterior dipole coefficient is β = 1.019746, |β − 1| = 1.9746% against the 4.886% band (20260905T123453Z_TH-15.log:132–133). The control (natural cavity): β = −0.419038 against the void's closed-form −½, |β − 1| = 141.9%, 29.0× the band (…:141), inside the 1.5 ceiling and over the 5× separation. Anchor (iii): |Im E|/|Re E| = 0.000e+00. Anchor (iv): 1702 cavity dofs on tag 2 (reduced), max |E| on them 0.000e+00 (…:136) — the chord quadrature points of a cavity edge lie strictly inside the absent sphere, where the data callable is zero, so the trace is pinned exactly. Anchor (v): the tagged and default routes locate the identical dof array per rank, 4836 = 4836 dofs reduced, and (1,) releases the cavity to 3134 (…:147). test_dielectric_sphere.py is 2 passed with the additive keyword off (20260905T123859Z_TH-15.log:345), its finest rung 2.442% — the imported TH8_RECORD_INTERIOR_MISS = 0.02443 to the digit. What failed: anchor (ii), the pointwise field miss at the same band. Max |E − E_closed|/E₀ over the two shells is 46.07% (rms 18.6%, relative-L2 15.6%) against 4.886% (…123453Z:134, …123612Z:101–102) — while the β fitted from the same 48 points is right to 2%, because the pointwise error is orthogonal to the dipole column and averages out of the least squares. It is a discretisation floor, not a defect: the TH-8 ladder measured through scripts/probes/th15_pec_hole_resolution.py (20260905T123827Z_TH-15.log:191–199) gives (h = 0.0125 / 0.00833 / 0.00625; 4530 / 13 239 / 29 563 cells) β-miss 9.305 / 1.975 / 2.864%, max miss 59.16 / 46.07 / 20.54%, rms 25.07 / 18.64 / 10.73%, relative-L2 21.03 / 15.64 / 9.00%, fitted rates in h +1.84 / +1.47 / +1.19 / +1.19 — everything converges, and the finest TH-8 rung is still 20.5% pointwise. Lowest order N1curl 1 cell from a Dirichlet-pinned curved wall (the 1.2R shell sits 1.2 h off it) has a pointwise floor ≈10× its dipole moment's miss; this is the WF-6 step 3h class (pointwise estimator floor ≫ the integral identity's), and anchor (ii) restated the field band the 03:00 review had already argued cannot discriminate here. The ruling the next review owes this step: demote (ii) to a printed record (the WF-6 step 3h precedent) and close step 1 on (i), (iii), (iv), (v) + the control, band untouched — or re-scope it to the converging quantity. The slot did not widen or delete it; nothing here is a licence to move 4.886%. RULING — 2026-09-05 10:30 review: anchor (ii) is re-scoped to the converging quantity; nothing at 4.886% moves. The 03:00 review's own argument (a ≈5% field band cannot discriminate PEC from dielectric on this fixture) should have retired the pointwise field anchor when it moved the gate to β, and did not; the slot's ladder now shows the pointwise miss is a first-order N1curl floor still at 20.5% on the finest TH-8 rung — a band it could only pass on a mesh no TH-8 rung is. Flag (rule (j)): gate (a) is closed as step 3 re-posed it (the k = 1 pair within κ of 64 MHz at C_mode, not at C_tuned — the mis-posing note below); the weekly confirms that reading. Audited PASS 2026-10-01 10:30 review (20261001T124058Z_TH-17-gate-c-W1.log:1445,1449,1711–1713; …124451Z…W2.log:1776–1777,2039–2041; W3 :996,1360 reproduces 20260928T095346Z_TH-17-step3.log:995,1359–1360 digit for digit). Gate (a) amended under rule (j), same review: (a) reads "the k = 1 pair within κ of 64 MHz at C_mode" — the 2026-09-26 weekly's re-pose (T5b; plan-archive.md:34745–34751, :34798–34801), band unchanged; at C_tuned the pencil's lowest pair is 129.6 MHz by construction (W2 :962–963). test_gate_c_k2_identity_c_mode / test_gate_c_k2_identity_c_tuned (env-gated FEM_EM_TH17_GATE_C=1; tests only; steps 2 / 3 bodies untouched — their closures copied into _CircuitSide). (c-M) circuit k = 2 zero 7.798269895e+07 Hz vs the pencil's k = 2 singlet 7.838759746e+07 Hz: 5.165e-03 = 0.487 κ; (c-T) 1.581275645e+08 vs 1.589189395e+08 Hz: 4.980e-03 = 0.469 κ (step 2's zero reproduced to 3.1e-10 ≤ 1e-9); (d′) |(f̄_pair(2C)/f̄_pair(C))·√2 − 1| = 3.772e-03 = 0.356 κ. Singlet: nearest other eigenvalue to f₂ 17.9 % (M) / 18.4 % (T) away (band 0.5 %). f₁ < f₂ asserted on both sides, both legs; no k = 0 sign change in 60–100 MHz (M) or 100–200 MHz (T). Negative controls asserted: (N1) k = 2 zero vs the k = 1 pair 2.122e-01 = 20.00 κ (M), 2.201e-01 = 20.75 κ (T); (N2) vs the pencil's k = 2 at 2·C_mode (5.558095900e+07 Hz) 4.031e-01 = 38.00 κ. Printed: k = 2 √2 ratio 1.002752 (predicted 1.002771); fixed-point re-solve at ω_lin = 2π·Re f₂ −3.45e-07 (M), −1.81e-05 (T); DFT off-diagonal per grid point in the logs. 20261001T124058Z_TH-17-gate-c-W1.log (Status 0, 226 s), 20261001T124451Z_TH-17-gate-c-W2.log (Status 0, 228 s), W3 rule (i) re-run of step 3 verbatim 20261001T124845Z_TH-17-gate-c-W3.log (Status 0, 195 s; every step 3 digit reproduced); heavy, -n 4, complex, 13 passed each. Not claimed: no eigenvector class label, no (C5) fit, no AED, B₁ or human-scale statement. Prior status: 🟡 Step 3 EXECUTED 2026-09-28 (09:30 UTC slot, §9 item 59, chain T5b) — GREEN: tuned by the eigen route, (a) and (b) pass at 64 MHz; (e) green, 20260930T200647Z_TH-17-gate-e-W1.log; (c) open, so the glyph stays 🟡. (2026-09-30 15:00 slot, §9 item 117: gate (e) — σ = 0 on the phantom, ε_r kept, PEC coil — |Im λ|/Re λ (H1, C_mode, 64 MHz) 4.789e-18 / 3.674e-18, (H2, c_tuned_farad(), 128 MHz) 2.169e-20 / 8.159e-19, all ≤ CONTROL_IM_RE_BOUND 1e-10 (:1025); negative control (L) σ = SALINE_SIGMA 6.563e-4 / 6.541e-4, Im f +2.111e4 / +2.104e4 Hz, pair equal to step 3's record to ≤ 6e-11; Re f shift (H1) − (L) −4.51e-6 / −4.49e-6 relative (:1020); (H2) vs STEP2_RECORDED_PAIR_HZ −1.480e-4 / −1.464e-4 (printed, no prior); |Im(xᴴBx)|/|xᴴBx| 2.3e-20 at σ = 0, 1.05e-2 at σ = 0.5 (:1023–1024). 13 passed, 123 s, -n 4, heavy.) (2026-09-30 10:30 review: gate (e) queued, §9 item 117, read by its parenthetical — σ → 0 on the phantom with ε_r kept, PEC coil; "machine zero" read as TH-14's imported CONTROL_IM_RE_BOUND 1e-10 on the same GNHEP routine. Both readings are for the weekly to confirm; (c) stays the weekly's to re-pose.) test_th17_birdcage_eigenmodes.py::test_step3_eigen_route_tuning (env-gated FEM_EM_TH17_STEP3=1; tests only, no src/, step 2's paths untouched, no band widened). 20260928T095346Z_TH-17-step3.log, Status 0, 186 s (heavy; -n 4, complex, FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1, timeout -k 30 600, -s, tests/environment first, 13 passed); 13 four-drive sweeps + 3 eigen solves, rank-0 peak RSS 0.63 GiB. Fixture item 51's (80 181 cells, 111 121 dofs). C_mode: one sweep at 64 MHz (physical σ), z₁ = avg(z₁, z₃) = 0.5547 + 37.515j Ω (|z₁ − z₃|/|z₁| 8.5e-16 — reciprocity, no C4 claim; DFT off-diagonal 2.8e-05); Im z₁ > 0 asserted; C_mode = 1/(ω₆₄ Im z₁) = 6.628769508e-11 F (predicted 6.63e-11 from the L_eff fit — 0.02 %). Eigen at C_mode (ω_lin = 2π·64 MHz, z_ref_hz=None, target 64 MHz; 25.2 s): pair 6.432991449e+07 / 6.433349959e+07 Hz (Im f ≈ +2.1e+04 Hz), (a) asserted: |Re f − 64|/64 = 5.155e-03 / 5.211e-03 ≤ κ 1.060762e-02 (0.49 κ — step 2's +0.49 % carried over, as predicted, landing near 64.3 MHz); (b) asserted: split 5.57e-05 ≤ 0.005. Next eigenvalue above the pair 7.838759746e+07 Hz (printed). Circuit side at C_mode (60–100 MHz, 5 MHz grid + secant; printed): k = 1 (≡ k = 3) zero at 6.400000005e+07 Hz (|Im|/|z| 1.0e-07 — by construction); k = 2 sign change interpolated at 7.80e+07 Hz (the pencil's 7.839e+07 Hz, 0.47 % above); k = 0: no sign change in 60–100 MHz. Ordering (printed, not asserted): k = 1 lowest, k = 2 above, no k = 0 — low-pass, as step 2. Negative control asserted: at 2·C_mode (target 64/√2 MHz, 9.6 s) the pair 4.565970696e+07 / 4.566223088e+07 Hz misses 64 MHz by 2.865e-01 = 27.0 κ (predicted ≈ 27.4 κ, ceiling 27.6); (f_neg/f_pair)/(1/√2) = 1.003772 (printed). Fixed-point re-solve (printed): ω_lin = 2π·Re f₁, z_ref_hz = Re f₁: 6.432990943e+07 Hz, shift −7.9e-08. Not claimed: no (C5) fit, no PEC control (e), no AED, no physical-capacitor claim; (a) is a first reading beside 1c's two-torus 2.053 %. Prior status: 🟡 Step 2 EXECUTED 2026-09-27 (09:30 UTC slot, second item, §9 item 51, chain T5a) — GREEN: re-posed (a) and (b) pass and the fixed-point shift is recorded; (c)–(e) stay open, so the glyph stays 🟡. test_th17_birdcage_eigenmodes.py::test_step2_circuit_eigen_identity (env-gated FEM_EM_TH17_STEP2=1; no src/; additive z_ref_hz=None keyword on the module's own _capacitor_mass_forms / solve_modes — unset path byte-identical — because Z_p = 1/(jωC) was evaluated at 64 MHz while L1 used ω_ref, so at ω_lin ≠ 2π·64 MHz the capacitor mass scaled by ω₆₄/ω_ref; the re-solve passes ω_ref/2π). 20260927T094905Z_TH-17-step2.log, Status 0, 279 s (heavy; -n 4, complex, timeout -k 30 590, -s, tests/environment first, 13 passed), 31 four-drive sweeps (≈ 6.4 s each) + 2 eigen solves. Fixture exactly 1b (ii)'s (80 181 cells, 111 121 dofs, sheets 211–214 at azimuth 0/90/180/270°, h/w 1.096773, C_tuned 1.556993028e-11 F on all four). Live eigen pair 1.295936260e+08 / 1.296011466e+08 Hz — 1b (ii)'s record reproduced to all ten digits (:965–966). Circuit side: matched-sweep S → open-circuit Z = z0(I+S)(I−S)⁻¹, z_k = diag(F·Z·Fᴴ) (DFT off-diagonal residual 7.1e-05 → 2.7e-04 across 100–200 MHz, printed), phantom σ·f/64 MHz. Zeros of Im z_k − 1/(ωC), classified by TUNING_IM_Z_RTOL: k = 1 and k = 3 at 1.289622334e+08 Hz (|Im|/|z| 2.1e-09), k = 2 at 1.581275645e+08 Hz (printed; the pencil's 1.589189395e+08 Hz, 0.50 % above — same sign and size as k = 1, not gated), k = 0 none in 100–200 MHz. (i) asserted: |f_circ − Re f_eig|/Re f_eig = 4.872e-03 / 4.930e-03 ≤ κ 1.060762e-02 (:1897) — the circuit zero sits 0.49 % below the eigen pair, ≈ 0.46 κ. (ii) asserted: eigen split 5.803e-05 ≤ 0.005. (iii) asserted: circuit split 0.000e+00 ≤ 0.005 — reading for the review: with Z symmetric (reciprocity), diag(F·Z·Fᴴ) gives z₁ = z₃ identically, so (iii) is a reciprocity identity, not an independent C4 check; the C4 content is the printed off-diagonal residual. Negative control asserted: at 0.5·C_tuned on the same grid Z(f), the k = 1 zero at 1.770855e+08 Hz misses Re f_eig by 3.664e-01 = 34.5 κ; the rule-(e) prediction (≈ 1.8328e+08 Hz, √2 × 129.6 MHz) printed, not asserted (measured 3.4 % below it). Fixed-point shift (printed): eigen re-solve at ω_lin = 2π·1.295936e+08 gives 1.295784580e+08 / 1.295861517e+08 Hz, −1.170e-04 (< 0.1 %, the Done-when's threshold); physical-σ circuit zero 1.289468618e+08 Hz, −1.192e-04 vs linearised. Not claimed: no 64 MHz statement (T5b), no AED. Unexplained beside it: 1c's two-torus circuit ↔ eigen reading of 2.053 % (≈ 2κ) vs 0.49 % here. Prior status: 🟡 Step 1c EXECUTED 2026-09-21 (11:00 UTC slot, §9 item 24) — GREEN: the pencil-with-sheet-mass machinery is validated against a closed form (one LC loop). test_th17_birdcage_eigenmodes.py::test_step1c_lc_loop_closed_form (env-gated TH17_STEP1C=1; no src/), 20260921T110359Z_TH-17.log, Status 0, 394 s (heavy; -n 4, complex, timeout -k 30 1100, durable capture, -s). Fixture two_torus_domain(port_gap, emit_port_sheet, as_hole), every constant imported: 161 461 cells, 195 296 N1curl deg-1 dofs; the loop's sheet is facet tag 211 (the item said 201 — on the hole route 201/202 do not exist; 211 is torus 1's port sheet), h 1.395505060e-02 m, w = A/h 1.040000000e-02 m, h/w 1.341831788 (:539). L_fem = Im Z_in/ω (printed, :541–543): 1.062839664e-07 H at 10 MHz, 1.073064785e-07 H at 64 MHz (used); Grover 1.085172998e-07 H beside, ratios 0.979420 / 0.988842 — never gated; Z₂₁/Z₁₁ = 0.1604 / 0.1613 (the open loop's residual coupling, printed). C = 1/((2π·64e6)²·L_fem) = 5.763076340e-11 F in-run. (a) asserted: nearest eigenvalue Re f = 6.268576548e+07 Hz vs f_LC = 6.4e+07 Hz, 2.053 % ≤ 5 % (:571; Im f +2.6e-09 Hz). (b) asserted: at 2·C, Re f = 4.444741942e+07 Hz, ratio 0.7090512 vs 1/√2 = 0.7071068, 0.275 % ≤ 2 % (:572). Negative control asserted: capacitor form removed ⇒ 0 eigenvalues in f_LC·[0.8, 1.2] (:573); the shift-invert at f_LC with nev = 6 converged only the gradient cluster (Re f 8.1–9.1 kHz), so the predicted ≳ 0.5 GHz first cavity mode was not reached at this target — prediction untested, printed as "none" (rule (e)). Solve walls 96 / 124 / 99 s. Consequence (item 24's "under green"): the 1b (ii) ≈ 129.6 MHz floor stands as the F-small fixture's spectrum under the four-port loading, handed to the 09-26 weekly with the review's reading that row gate (a) may be mis-posed (below); no slot re-scopes gate (a). Prior status: 🟡 Step 1 part (i) executed 2026-09-19 04:30 slot (second item, take-next) — the cost probe is CHEAP and the pencil assembles, but NO EIGENVALUE LANDS NEAR THE 64 MHz TARGET, so parts (ii)/(iii) did not run and the (C5) third-residual band is NOT pre-registered. Landed additive and green on main: core/cavity.py gains complex_relative_permittivity, general_mesh_pencil, solve_general_mesh_modes (_cavity_forms and every box path byte-identical — nothing above the TH-17 banner comment was touched), and tests/validation/test_th17_birdcage_eigenmodes.py::test_cost_probe (env-gated TH17_PROBE=1, so the default collection is unchanged). Probe, -n 4, 20260919T094827Z_TH-17.log:899–915, 51 s wall: 80 181 cells, 111 121 N1curl deg-1 dofs, mesh 20.62 s + eigensolve 26.70 s = 47.80 s total, ru_maxrss 0.612 / 0.521 / 0.529 / 0.516 GiB (summed 2.179). Against the §9-item STOP rule (> 15 min or > 40 GiB at -n 4) that is 0.797 min and 2.179 GiB — PROCEED, by ≈19× in time and ≈18× in memory; this step does not re-price to XL. C_tuned imported live from PORT-15 step 3 (tuning_sweep + select_c_tuned on S_64MHZ_EPS0_RECORD) at 1.556993028375804e-11 F, never restated. The blocker (the whole finding): with nev = 6 and shift-invert at k₀² = (2π·64 MHz/c)² ≈ 1.799, the nine converged eigenvalues are the N1curl gradient (null-space) cluster — λ ∈ [1.448e-09, 2.294e-09], i.e. Re f ≈ 1.8–2.3 kHz, |λ − target| ≈ 1.8 for every one of them. Nothing in the pencil sits at 64 MHz. The capacitor term's sign and scale are as derived (B_sheet = −(c²/ω_ref²)·L1(ω_ref) = +(C·h/w)/ε₀ ∫(n×u)·(n×v), positive-definite added mass, which is the direction that pulls the air box's \~GHz cavity modes down), so the leading hypothesis is that the added surface mass is orders of magnitude too small to move any mode from \~GHz to 64 MHz, and/or the gradient cluster must be deflated before shift-invert can reach the physical branch — the TH-9 path discards it by a null_cutoff_fraction, which this general-mesh path does not yet do. Next attempt: (1) deflate/filter the null space (or solve the k₀² > 0 branch with EPS.setDeflationSpace / a larger ncv), (2) print the un-loaded (C = 0) spectrum on the same mesh to locate the physical branch, (3) only then re-price nev/target. Prior state: ⬜ Step 1 written 2026-09-18 (interactive operator session under the enumerated-chain licence, §9 rule (4); it is §10 chain step 5 — the internal "tuned birdcage" milestone; queued as §9 item 5). Fixture: TH-15 step 3's hole mesh (birdcage_port_domain(…, as_hole=True), the coil PEC by the exterior default, test_th15_birdcage_pec_hole.py) with the phantom (σ 0.5 S/m, εᵣ 78) and PORT-14's four gap sheets as capacitor sheets at PORT-15 step 3's C_tuned (imported from test_port_circuit_layer_field.step3_tuning — tuned["c_f"] — never restated); no source, no termination. Formulation: the lumped-sheet bilinear term (L1, ports/lumped.py) with Z_p = 1/(jωC) is −ω²μ₀(h/w)C ∫(n×u)·(n×v) — a surface mass term (h/w by (L2): R = Z_p·w/h, so 1/R = (h/w)·jωC; the row said w/h until 2026-09-19 — a typo the 04:30 slot caught; the landed code derives and implements h/w) — and the phantom's conduction is linearised as a complex permittivity at ω_lin exactly as TH-14 step 1 linearised the Leontovich wall (core/cavity.py: solve_impedance_wall_cavity_mode, one fixed-point re-solve at Re ω), so the whole problem is one non-Hermitian generalised pencil A x = λ (B + B_sheet(C)) x, shift-invert at k₀² = (2π·64 MHz/c)² (_solve_pencil_nonhermitian), nev ≥ 6. Additive src/: a general-mesh pencil builder beside _cavity_forms (the box path byte-identical; TH-9 and TH-14 step 1 gate modules re-run green). Readout: the complex eigenfrequencies nearest 64 MHz — the k = 1 degenerate pair (mode 1), the k = 0 end-ring mode above it and the k = 2 mode below (high-pass ordering, ports/circuit.py: birdcage_highpass_mode_frequencies (C5)), each with Q = Re ω/(2|Im ω|). Gates (asserted): (a) mode-1 Re f at 64 MHz within PORT-14's named κ systematic (≈ 1 %; the constant imported from the PORT-14 step 3 module, named in the §9 item) — C_tuned put the driven port's reduced network at series resonance there, so this is the circuit-layer ↔ eigen-layer consistency identity; (b) the pair degenerate to the imported PORT-11 C4 spread band (0.5 %); (c) closed-form structure: f_0 > f_1 > f_2 fit (C5) ω_k⁻² = C(L_r + 2L_l sin²(πk/4)) with positive L_r, L_l (two unknowns, three equations; the third residual asserted ≤ a band the cost probe sets and the §9 item pre-registers before the gated run) — this replaces the chain's "step-2 inductances", which PORT-15 step 2 read off negative (gap capacitance dominating); (d) negative control: at 2·C_tuned mode 1 moves by the (C5) factor 1/√2 on Re f to the same band; (e) PEC-phantom control (σ → 0, Hermitian pencil): Im ω at machine zero, the Re f shift printed. Done-when: (a)–(e) through the harness at -n 4, the fixed-point shift recorded (< 0.1 % or the band re-read), elapsed recorded ⇒ TH-17 → ✅ and Phase 6's first physics target ticked. Not claimed: no absolute mode frequency against AED (ANS-6's), no B₁ homogeneity, no human scale. Cost probe first (§5.1): mesh + one shift-invert solve at -n 4, printed dofs / time / ru_maxrss — unmeasured on this mesh (TH-9 / TH-14 were boxes). Step 1 part (i) ran 2026-09-19 (04:30 slot, f085e51): the probe is cheap (47.8 s, 2.18 GiB at -n 4; general_mesh_pencil / solve_general_mesh_modes landed additively in core/cavity.py, TH-9/TH-14 gates re-run green 941fa15) but shift-invert at the 64 MHz target returned only the N1curl gradient cluster (nine pairs at Re f ≈ 2 kHz), i.e. no eigenvalue anywhere in (0, ≈ 90 MHz) — parts (ii)–(iii) BLOCKED. Step 1b (written 2026-09-19, operator session; §9 item 10) — locate the missing mode or the defect, with a closed form: (i) assemble the sheet mass alone and print ‖B_sheet‖ against ‖B‖ restricted to the sheet dofs — a zero says the (L1) forms never reached the pencil (facet tags / restriction), the first thing to rule out; (ii) a target scan — shift-invert at 1, 4, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512 MHz with nev = 6, printing every converged eigenvalue with Re f > 1 MHz — to find where the capacitor-loaded modes actually sit; (iii) the closed-form LC control: a PEC circular loop (torus, major radius a, wire radius r) with one capacitor sheet in a gap resonates at f = 1/(2π√(LC)) with L = μ₀a(ln(8a/r) − 2) (the loop closed form already in the repo, tests/validation/test_port_self_impedance_energy.py, imported), C chosen to put f near 64 MHz; the pencil's nearest eigenvalue asserted within 5 % on a mesh where the loop's own L (from PORT-1's energy route) is within 2 % of the closed form. (iii) is the gate that decides between the pencil is wrong (known-issues entry, the §7 formulation re-derived) and the birdcage's eigen-resonance at C_tuned is simply not at 64 MHz (a finding about the circuit-layer identity, and (ii) says where it is). Heavy by measurement of (i) (seconds); -n 4. Step 1b parts (i) and (ii) EXECUTED 2026-09-20 04:30 slot — the sheet mass is present and locally dominant, and the loaded spectrum's floor is ≈ 129.6 MHz, not 64 MHz. 20260920T093810Z_TH-17.log, Status 0, 232 s, 3 passed, -n 4, 111 121 dofs; both new tests env-gated behind TH17_STEP1B=1 (default collection unchanged), plus an additive target_hz keyword on the module's own solve_modes wrapper — no src/ change. (i) printed, never gated (:1742–1747): the four gap sheets each carry 26 owned facets, area 5.835299e-05 m², h 8.000000e-03 m, w 7.294124e-03 m, h/w 1.096773e+00 (tags 211–214, identical — the C4 fixture). ‖B_volume‖_F = 1.634083724e+01 vs ‖B_sheet‖_F = 1.364209336e+01 (ratio 8.348e-01), and on a sheet-dof indicator the sheet form dominates the volume form by 1.569208687e+03 (1.760307187e+02 vs 1.121780169e-01). So the (L1) forms do reach the pencil and the added surface mass is not negligible where it acts: the "too small to move a mode" half of step 1's hypothesis is refuted, and the facet-tag/restriction failure mode (i) existed to rule out is ruled out. (ii) printed, never gated (:1753–1800): the eight-target scan converges 6–14 pairs per target but finds nothing with Re f > 1 MHz at the 1, 4, 16, 32 or 64 MHz targets — the gradient cluster only, reproducing step 1 at its own target. Thirteen eigenvalues above 1 MHz appear from 128 MHz up: the lowest physical modes are a near-degenerate pair at 1.295936260e+08 and 1.296011466e+08 Hz (split 5.80e-05 relative, i.e. 0.0058 % — the C4 pair, well inside PORT-11's 0.5 % spread band), then 1.589189395e+08 Hz, then a heavily damped 2.966755624e+08 Hz (λ = 2.559e+01 + 4.497e+01j), with the 256 and 512 MHz targets re-finding the same three and adding 5.283e+08 / 5.551e+08 / 5.553e+08 Hz. The finding: the loaded pencil's spectrum has a hard floor at ≈ 129.6 MHz and nothing in (2 kHz, 129.6 MHz); the 64 MHz target is in a genuine spectral gap, so shift-invert returning only the null space there is the correct answer to the question asked, not a solver defect. Not yet decided — which is what (iii) exists for: whether the ≈ 129.6 MHz floor is the physical C_tuned resonance (making step 1's gate (a) the false premise) or the pencil mis-scales the sheet term, cannot be settled by (i)/(ii), because neither carries a closed form. Part (iii), the LC loop control — the step's only asserted anchor — is NOT executed, and its pre-condition is contradicted by the repo's own record (§9 standing rule (e), reported not decided): item 10 asserts the loop's PORT-1 energy route must give L within 2 % of the closed form as the mesh pre-condition, but that fixture's recorded reading is 4ωW_m/I² = 7.437 Ω against Grover's 6.818 Ω — 9.1 %, measured 2026-08-03 and carried there as printed, not gated, attributed to the 0.08 m PEC-box padding (test_port_self_impedance_energy.py, module docstring and test_magnetic_energy_reactance_against_grover). The 2 % pre-condition is therefore unreachable on PORT-1's fixture as it stands, and (iii) needs a padding/resolution rung for L — unpriced — before its 5 % eigenvalue anchor is honest. Both anchors left untouched. Also for whoever writes (iii): the helper is named grover_loop_inductance, not loop_inductance as item 10 has it. Step 1c (written 2026-09-21 03:00 review, §9 item 24, rule (f) applied by the review): (iii) is re-registered on a fixture that exists — two_torus_domain(port_gap, emit_port_sheet, as_hole), torus 1's sheet carrying C, torus 2's gap open — with L taken from that fixture's own driven lumped-sheet route (Im Z_in/ω), so both sides of the unchanged 5 % are the fixture's numbers; Grover is printed beside, never gated (no single-loop generator exists; PORT-1's 9.1 % is an impressed-current fixture at a fixed 0.08 m padding). Adds the 2·C → 1/√2 closed form at 2 % and the sheet-removed negative control. Reading handed to the 09-26 weekly, not ruled here: this module's pencil loads all four ports with C_tuned (_capacitor_mass_forms, live=None), while PORT-22's driven sweep feeds P1 and tunes Im Z_in(P1) = 0; an eigenfrequency of the four-capacitor structure satisfies Im Z_in(P1) = 1/(ωC_tuned) instead, so the 1.2959e+08 Hz floor and PORT-22's 63.9986 MHz zero answer different equations and are not in conflict — gate (a) ("mode 1 at 64 MHz") may be mis-posed for this termination; no slot re-scopes it. Amended 2026-10-01 03:00 review (rule (j), on the 2026-09-30 weekly's re-pose, §10 T5c): (c) := T5a's identity (i) on the k = 2 class at C_mode and at c_tuned_farad() (k = 0 too if a sign change falls in the grid), |f_circ − Re f_eig|/Re f_eig ≤ κ (STEP2D_C_OVER_TERMINAL_64MHZ_P1), with f₁ < f₂ asserted on both sides — the (C5) high-pass fit is retired (the four-leg gap layout is low-pass); (d) := at 2·C_mode, |(f̄_pair(2C)/f̄_pair(C))·√2 − 1| ≤ κ (step 3 printed 3.772e-3 and never asserted it). The Done-when's (a)–(e) read with these two clauses (§9 item 131).

docs.title: TH-19 — Carry the matched source projection to the coil, and retest the production element order
docs.text:
Carry the matched source projection to the coil, and retest the production element order — opened 2026-09-10, operator direction. The decision this reopens. §10's TH-12 clause (2026-08-23) pins degree 1 for every coil-fed Phase-5/6 solve. The clause is explicitly reversible on evidence, and its condition is already satisfied. The step is split; only 0a is queued. 0b, the mirror-built full mesh, is ≈ 30 min of separate code (the D2 cell-tag permutation and the re-derived cavity tag). It is the split TH-16 made between 3a and 3c.

Corrections to the premise: - F-human has LEG_COUNT = 16 (tests/validation/test_birdcage_f_human_rung.py:76). Its 32 ports are 2 × 16 ring gaps, and there are 16 floating leg-port boxes (P1–P16) with no sheets. - The refusal moved to src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py:3856–3876, with its docstring at :3612–3621. The hole route is chain H's copper fixture, and with as_hole the current code would: - drop the ring sheets; - count the cut-plane faces as cavity wall; - centroid-test the conductor solids it keeps. - The π/32 control. With 16 legs, the ring-gap centres sit at odd multiples of π/16. A reflection across a line at π/32 therefore puts every centre onto a leg azimuth. Its miss, 2R·sin(π/32) = 2.9405e-2 m, is the ceiling: the largest miss any mirror can have.

TH-20 step 0a generalises TH-16 step 3a's quadrant cutter (birdcage_port_domain(symmetry_quadrant=True)) to the F-human hole layout: ring gaps, no leg gaps, as_hole=True, longitudinal sheets, leg_count % 4 == 0. The geometry restated. docs.text:
Drafted by a read-only Plan agent and reviewed by the 2026-10-02 18:00 daily review. Licence: rule (6) re-pose of item 176, same family and target. No band moves in this item. Item 176 is superseded by this one.

  • Executor: implementer. Tier: heavy, -n 2 (W3) / -n 1 (probe). Class: chain step (no solve).
  • Cost: ≈ 9 measured / ≈ 40 predicted min. Depends on: nothing.

Why. Item 176 was red only on Q3: |4·A₄₀₁,q/A₄₀₁,f − 1| = 1.498e-4 > 5e-5 (W1 :8160). That 5e-5 was registered on a different comparison: hole vs solid on the same full sizing (test_wf12_f_human_hole.py:83–106).

Facet counts fit a triangulation reading: - The quarter has 4 × 19 836 = 79 344 wall facets against 78 066 on the full mesh (+1.64 %). - Item 147's logs show δ·N roughly constant (635 / 578 / 567), so the chord deficit goes as 1/N. - The model |δ_f|·(4N_q/N_f − 1) = 8.14e-3 × 0.0164 = 1.33e-4, which is 89 % of the reading.

The quarter grades over 64 surfaces against the full mesh's 240 (W1 :72, :6206; Sampling 20 per surface, io/mesh.py:5197). So the bisected surfaces (legs 0 and 4, the ring arcs centred on 0 and π/2) are re-meshed by construction. Where the difference sits cannot decide the question alone; facet count and the trend with h decide it.

Part 1 — land the code (rule (c), disclosed). The four logs, their test-results.md rows and the outcome block are already on main (landed by the 18:00 review). 1. Pre-check: git log --oneline dea66f77..HEAD -- src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py must be empty (it was empty at 5625faed). If it is not, stop and report. 2. Take two paths from attempt/TH-20-step0a-20261002T191039Z: src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py and tests/validation/test_th20_quarter_f_human_mesh.py. Take nothing else from the branch: never path-checkout test-results.md or this file. 3. Do not edit Q3, its 5e-5 band or F_HUMAN_WALL_AREA_RTOL. 4. Add a known-issues entry, OPEN 2026-10-02: - test_th20_q1_to_q6_quarter_identities is red only under FEM_EM_TH20_STEP0=1 (Q3 1.498e-4 > 5e-5, W1 :8194). - Q0 and Q7 are green, and the default suites skip the test. - It is resolved by item 182 → the 03:00 ruling → the 0a re-run. 5. Delete the branch after the landing commit (git branch -D; the .git/config warning is harmless).

Anchor (asserted). W3 on main at -n 2 must reproduce the branch's W3: - [TH-16 step 3a] full 116 085 cells exact, quarter 36 034 (…W3-regate.log:2640); - TH-15 3a 80 181 / 116 085; - 16 passed; - the TH-20 module unflagged: the six Q7 refusals pass and the heavy tests skip.

Part 2 — probe (a measurement, with no asserts). Write tests/mesh/probe_th20_quarter_wall_area.py on the pattern of probe_wf12_cavity_wall_area.py, run as python3 -u … --conductor-resolution <h>. - Build: the module's _kwargs() plus conductor_resolution=h, the full mesh first, then symmetry_quadrant=True (GEO-23). - Reuse _class_of, _owned_facet_split, _cell_value and _exterior_facet_area for the tag-401 wall. - Restrict the full mesh to the kept quadrant by exact triangle clipping (Sutherland–Hodgman against x ≥ 0, then y ≥ 0). Clip all four quadrants Qᵢ. - Bands, assigned by the centroid of each clipped piece: - N: min(x, y) ≤ 2h; - S: the rest of the bisected sectors, θ < π/16 or θ > 7π/16; - F: π/16 ≤ θ ≤ 7π/16, air class only; - R: the ring-port class, by tag (117–120, 133–136, 217–220, 233–236).

Prints per rung: - cells for the full and quarter meshes, gmsh time, RSS; - A_f and A_q against CAD (δ_f, δ_q); - 4q/f − 1, the model |δ_f|(4N_q/N_f − 1), and their ratio ρ; - ΔA = A_q − A_f∩Q₁ in m²; - per band: ΔA, ΔA/A, ΔN/N.

Reproduce first (determinism; a miss is the finding, so stop): - 1.6 mm: 369 387 / 97 414 cells, 19 836 facets, A_q 5.195046113e-02, A_f 2.077707230e-01 (W1 :6202, :8151, :8160). - 2.4 / 3.2 mm, full mesh: 284 363 / 233 097 cells, A 2.0682947116e-01 / 2.0538649807e-01, 45 738 / 29 054 facets (item 147's hole logs).

Negative controls (rule (e)), all predicted and printed: - (P1) The clip partition Σᵢ A_f∩Qᵢ/A_f − 1 ≤ 1e-12. - (P2) The full mesh's own spread, max |4A_f∩Qᵢ/A_f − 1|. It is the comparator with no cutter; its magnitude is unmeasured. - (P3) A planted missing face: A_q minus tag 117's ring-port wall (≈ 4.9 / 4.8 / 4.5e-5 m², item 147's class totals / 64).
