docs.title: §9 item 233 — 2026-10-04 (chain H13a)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-04 18:00 daily review. Licence: §9 rule (4). This is the weekly's enumerated step: §10 chain H13a, re-targeted to four quarter solves with the band and target unchanged (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4433–4438, :4563–4565). Steps 0a / 0b landed as items 197 / 198. The 10-03 weekly ratified them with the rule (f) band TH20_QUARTER_WALL_AREA_RTOL 1.69e-3 and sub-identity Q3-b.

  • Executor: implementer. Tier: heavy, complex, -n 8, two windows: W1 prices and is the prior measurement, W2 closes. Class: chain solve.
  • Cost: ≈ 23 measured (the chain-solve class median) / ≈ 55 predicted min. That is ≈ 30 min of code (mostly imports, below), W1 ≈ 5 min, W2 ≈ 7 min and records ≈ 8 min.
  • Depends on: nothing. 0a and 0b are on main (20261003T112030Z_TH-20-step0a-r3-W2.log, 20261003T130342Z_TH-20-step0b-W2.log). Family: TH-20 step 1, attempt 1 of 4.

It fits heavy: the price, from measured logs. - Mesh phase. 0a's _meshes() builds the direct full hole mesh first: 109.9 s build, 101.5 s gmsh (20261003T130342Z_TH-20-step0b-W2.log:6230). Then it builds the quarter: 97 414 cells, 28.5 s (:8179). The mirror build took 3.24 s at -n 2 (item 198's outcome). - Full 32×32. The mirror-built mesh has 389 656 cells, 5.5 % more than the direct hole mesh that WF-12 step 2 swept at degree 1, -n 8. That sweep measured: - 500 568 unknowns (20261002T020713Z_WF-12-step1-W2.log); - a Cu factorising drive of 34.0 s; - a held drive (solve + post) of mean 2.88 s, max 3.57 s; - summed RSS 9.94–10.20 GiB; - 32 drives plus a PEC column in 309 s of pytest (20261002T094751Z_WF-12-step2-W2.log:6385–6386, :6480).

Scaled to this mesh: ≈ 528 k unknowns, a factor of ≈ 36–40 s and 31 held drives in ≈ 90–110 s. - Quarter sectors. Each has ≈ 135 k unknowns. Predicted: factor 5–12 s, held ≈ 0.5–1 s. That is ≈ 10–20 s per sector and 40–80 s for all four. - Totals. W1 (3 full drives) is predicted at 240–340 s and W2 (32 drives) at 330–480 s, with summed RSS ≤ 16 GiB. Both fit heavy (≤ 1200 s, ≤ 12 ranks, ≤ 128 G), so no xl entry is needed. The 103 GiB xxl reading of 09-26 is degree 2 on the solid 507 266-cell route. It is H13b's comparand, not this step's.

What it asserts. - Notation. A sector (b_x, b_y) names the BC on x = 0 (tag 501) and on y = 0 (tag 502): E = PEC (pinned), M = PMC (natural). - Kept ports. K = (P17, P18, P19, P20, P33, P34, P35, P36) (KEPT_RING, test_th20_quarter_f_human_mesh.py:75). All eight are interior to the quarter (0a's interior_ordinals, W2 :8183), so every sector carries all eight live. - Image map π_g, per ring (bottom 17 + j, top 33 + j): - σ_y: j ↦ 15 − j; - σ_x: j ↦ (7 − j) mod 16; - σ_xσ_y: j ↦ j + 8 (mod 16).

Import this as CLOSED from test_th20_mirror_built_full_mesh.py:70–74. - Port orientation sign. Every ring spec drives along its own +φ̂, with φ̂ = (−sin φ_c, cos φ_c, 0) (_ring_gap_frame, tests/mesh/test_birdcage_ring_gaps_scaleup.py:136–157). A reflection R_g maps +φ̂ at o to −φ̂ at π_g(o). So (R_g d_o)·d_{π_g(o)} is −1 for σ_x and σ_y, and +1 for σ_xσ_y. - Sector character. With E on a plane, the field satisfies E = −R E(R r) (tangential components odd). The image port's voltage, in its own +φ̂ convention, is then (−1)·(−1)·V = +V. With M it is −V. - Hence χ_s(g) = ε_x^[σ_x ∈ g] · ε_y^[σ_y ∈ g], with ε = +1 for E and −1 for M. - Check: the uniform k = 0 ring current is odd under a reflection, and it lives in (E, E). The k = ±1 modes live in (E, M) and (M, E). - This is the opposite of the naive "PEC = odd ⇒ −1" reading that TH-16's axial ports suggest. - Reconstruction R (32×32). - For i, j ∈ K: S^s_ij = Σ_g χ_s(g) S_{i, π_g(j)}, so S_{i, π_g(j)} = ¼ Σ_s χ_s(g) S^s_ij. - S_{π_h(i), π_k(j)} = S_{i, π_{hk}(j)}. S is invariant under the D2 action because the two orientation signs cancel. - Every full ordinal is π_h(i) for exactly one (i, h). Assert the bijection. - Port normalisation. The sheets lie wholly inside the quarter, so V_q = V and I_q = I. The quarter ports keep 50 Ω (TERMINATED_PORT_IMPEDANCE_OHM, test_port_birdcage_four_port.py:125). TH-16's doubled Z (test_th16_quarter_birdcage.py:113) and halve_sheet_spec do not apply.

Code: tests only, no src/. Do not edit the 0a, 0b, TH-16 or WF-12 modules. Write a new tests/validation/test_th20_quarter_solves.py, gated on FEM_EM_TH20_STEP1=1 and marked @complex_only.

Knobs: - FEM_EM_TH20_STEP1_FULL_DRIVES=N drives the first N ports of _ring_ports() on the full mesh. Unset means 32. Below 32, the matrix-wide gates print SKIPPED. - FEM_EM_TH20_STEP1_CONTROL=1 asserts the controls.

Steps: 1. Meshes. Call m = _meshes() from 0a, which builds the direct full mesh first and then the quarter (GEO-23). Here the direct full mesh is used only for the box-speed reading. Leave it in the cache: it costs < 1 GiB. 2. Quarter sectors, in the order (E,E), (E,M), (M,E), (M,M). - Facet tags: the quarter's own q["facets"]. Its exterior facets are exactly {1, 401, 501, 502} (0a Q3). - pec_facet_tags: (1, 501, 502) / (1, 501) / (1, 502) / (1,). - Problem: test_th14_birdcage_copper._problem(msh_q, cells_q, FREQUENCY_HZ, q["facets"], pec) (:229). - Wall: _leontovich_term(msh_q, q["facets"], z_s, ω) (:160), with z_s = (1 + 1j)·surface_resistance_ohm(ω, 5.8e7). It goes first in the factorising call's bilinear list. - Sheets: _interface_facet_tags(msh_q, cells_q, {SHEET_IFACE + o: (PORT_LOWER + o, PORT_UPPER + o) for o in KEPT_RING}). - Specs, as _build_f_human builds them (test_wf7_f_human_b1_quadrature.py:133–150): chord from diag["ring_port_layout"]["ring_port_gap_chord_m"], width = area/chord, drive = φ̂ from _ring_gap_frame(o, LEG_COUNT), interior=True, 50 Ω. - One fresh TimeHarmonicSolver(problem, degree=DEGREE) per sector. Run 1 factorising + 7 held drives with a local copy of WF-12's _drive (test_wf12_f_human_copper_matrix.py:170–220) and its S-column formula (:197–199). The power block may be dropped, but keep P_surf on each sector's first drive. - Cleanup: del fields after every drive; del solver; gc.collect() between sectors. - Prints: constrained DOFs per sector (_constrained_dofs, test_th16_quarter_birdcage.py:189), times, and _rss_report. 3. Mirror-built full mesh. After the four sectors are freed, rebuild it exactly as 0b does (test_th20_mirror_built_full_mesh.py:296–338): - _gather_owned; - _mirror with ("sy", axis 1), then ("sx", axis 0); - _distribute, then distribute_entity_data, with the connectivity hoisted.

Import the helpers. That is ≈ 20 lines restated, without the C4/C5 branches. 4. Full facet tags. Classify every local exterior facet, owned and ghost, by 0b's geometric rule (_derived_facets, :239–272; FACE_TOL 1e-9; r_e / z_e from _extents): - box faces → OUTER_BOX_TAG 499; - the rest → 401.

One MeshTags carries both. Set pec_facet_tags=(499,) and apply the Leontovich term on 401 of the same MeshTags. Count owned facets only. 5. Full sheets. After distribution, run _interface_facet_tags for all 32 ring ordinals, as 0b's _sheet_stats does. Each image sheet takes its preimage's spec numbers (width, chord), so the specs within an orbit are bitwise equal. Its drive is its own φ̂. 6. Full sweep. One solver, with the wall term first: 1 factorising + (N − 1) held drives in _ring_ports() order. The S_f columns follow WF-12. 7. Box speed and the W2 projection, printed in W1. - s = direct-full build time / 108 s. Normal speed is 109.9 s (…0b-W2.log:6230) and 107.2 s (WF-12 step 2 W2). - Projected W2 = elapsed time before the full sweep + the factorising drive + 31 × the max held cadence + 30 s.

Anchors (asserted; bands imported). - (P0) Premise. Both cell counts are exact (the 0a / 0b records): quarter 97 414, mirror-built 389 656. Owned facets on 501 / 502 = 1 825 / 1 811 (CUT_FACES_X0/Y0, test_th20_mirror_built_full_mesh.py:68–69). The mirror-built mesh has 79 344 owned 401 facets and 0 exterior facets on either plane (0b M4). - (P1) Constrained DOFs: (E,E) > (E,M), (M,E) > (M,M), in TH-16's (P3) form. - (P2) P_surf > 0 on each sector's first drive and on the full sweep's first drive, so the wall is in every operator. - (P3) The orientation premise: |(R_g d_o)·d_{π_g(o)} − τ_g| ≤ 1e-12 for every o ∈ K and every g, with τ = −1, −1, +1 for σ_x, σ_y, σ_xσ_y. The image map is a bijection onto the 32 ordinals. - (A) The anchor: max_ab |S_f − R|_ab / |R_ab| ≤ LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND 1e-9 (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_four_port.py:165). - TH-16 3c gated the same identity on F-small at this band and read 1.520e-12 (20260930T093451Z_TH-16-step3c-W1.log:1014–1019). - Taken over the driven columns: 3 × 32 entries in W1, all 1 024 in W2. Predicted 1e-13 – 1e-10. - Print the Frobenius ‖S − R‖/‖S_f‖ and m |Rb| (predicted ≥e-3). - (I1) Reciprocity:** ‖S − Sᵀ‖_F/‖S‖ ≤ RECIPROCITY_BAND 1e-3 (test_port_lumped_sheet_sweep.py:86, the 32×32 gate WF-12 used). It applies to S_f (W2) and to each S^s. Predicted ≈ 1e-14 (WF-12 read 9.167e-15). The entrywise max is printed beside RECIPROCITY_Q_BAND 1e-12 (test_th16_quarter_birdcage.py:116), not asserted. - (I2) Passivity: σ_max ≤ MATRIX_PASSIVITY_CEILING 1.0 (test_port_birdcage_ring_matrix.py:150) for S_f (W2) and for each S^s. Each S^s is a compression of S_f onto a χ-subspace, so σ_max(S^s) ≤ σ_max(S_f). Predicted for S_f: ≈ 0.99999 (WF-12 read 0.999993339). - (I3) S_f's own D2 invariance (W2): max |S_f[π_g(a), π_g(b)] − S_f[a, b]| / |S_f[a, b]| ≤ 1e-9 for g ∈ {σ_x, σ_y, σ_xσ_y}. Predicted ≈ 1e-13. It holds whatever the orientation sign, because the signs square away. So it does not test the χ table; (A) does.

Printed, never asserted: - per sector: the 8×8 S^s, times and DOFs; - ΔRSS per sector and for the full sweep, and the quarter-to-full solve-phase ratio (TH-16 read ≈ 0.29). This is the degree-1 input to H13b's bracket; - S_f(P17, P17) beside WF-12's direct-mesh copper value 0.383271 + 0.391623j (two meshes; a record only); - the box speed s and the W2 projection.

Negative controls (rule (e)). Each is arithmetic on the measured matrices, and each equals what a solver making that mistake would return: the swapped matrices are the operators such a solver would factor. Each is predicted and printed in W1 on its 3 columns, then asserted in W2 under FEM_EM_TH20_STEP1_CONTROL=1, with W1 as the prior measurement on the same fixture (item 176's idiom). - (C1) The orientation trap. Assemble with TH-16's axial convention (ε = −1 for E). - χ flips on σ_x and σ_y, so the 512 entries with hk ∈ {σ_x, σ_y} become −R. - Their miss is |−R − S_f|/|R| = 2 ± (A). That is the ceiling of any sign error, ≈ 2e9 × the band. The other 512 entries are unchanged. - Assert exactly 512 entries with |miss/2 − 1| ≤ 1e-9, and the rest ≤ 1e-9. W1 shows the same split on its 96 entries: 48 / 48. - (C1x) PMC for PEC on x = 0 in every sector. This is TH-16 3c's control applied to the whole plane. - χ flips on σ_x, so the 512 entries with hk ∈ {σ_x, σ_xσ_y} miss by exactly 2 ± (A). The assert has the same form as C1. - The self entries do not move, because χ_s(e) = 1 for every s. So the old row text's "wrong-cut control > 0.5 on the self class" cannot be read here: the weekly's four-solve re-target replaced that form, and C2 covers the self class. - (C2) One mis-set plane in one sector. Solving (E,E) with x = 0 left natural gives the (M,E) operator, so substitute S^(E,E) := S^(M,E). - Every entry moves by ¼ (S^(M,E) − S^(E,E))_ij. - It is read on the self class: the min over the 32 diagonal entries of |ΔR_aa|/|S_f,aa|. - Ceiling: ½/|Sa| ≈ 0.91. ch sector is passive, so |S^si| ≤ 1, and |Sa| ≈ 0.548 from WF-12's S₁₇,₁₇. - Prediction: the (E,E) sector carries k = 0, 2, 4, 6 and (M,E) carries k = 1, 3, 5, 7, so the reading is O(0.1), in [1e-2, 0.91]. - Assert ≥ 1e-3. That is 1e6 × the anchor band and ≥ 10× below the predicted floor. - A fifth solve with the plane mis-set would add only round-off, so none is run.

Windows. Bash timeout: 660000, foreground, each harness call bare and whole. Copy the §5.1 durable capture verbatim, with the trailing ; exit \$rc. - W1, at -n 8, with 3 full drives: the price, the box-speed reading, (A) on 96 entries, and the controls printed. Predicted 240–340 s.

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh TH-20-step1-W1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_TH20_STEP1=1 FEM_EM_TH20_STEP1_FULL_DRIVES=3 timeout -k 30 540 mpiexec -n 8 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_th20_quarter_solves.py -v -s --tb=short > /workspace/logs/th20-step1-w1-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/th20-step1-w1-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/th20-step1-w1-raw.log; exit \$rc'" - Gate before W2. Run W2 only if W1 is Status 0, (A) is green on its columns, and the printed projection is ≤ 560 s. The projection already carries the box speed; s is printed as the diagnostic. - W2, at -n 8, with 32 full drives and the controls asserted. This is the window the step closes on. Predicted 330–480 s.

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh TH-20-step1-W2 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_TH20_STEP1=1 FEM_EM_TH20_STEP1_CONTROL=1 timeout -k 30 600 mpiexec -n 8 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_th20_quarter_solves.py -v -s --tb=short > /workspace/logs/th20-step1-w2-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/th20-step1-w2-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/th20-step1-w2-raw.log; exit \$rc'" - Why -n 8, not -n 2: the 32-drive full sweep is priced only at -n 8 on this fixture. The mirror build and its distribution were already proven at -n 2 (0b W2), and every reduction is visible at any n > 1.

Traps (paid for): - The orientation sign (above). Azimuthal ports flip under a reflection: E ⇒ +1, M ⇒ −1. Getting it backwards gives C1's exact-2 signature on half the entries. That is a test defect, not a physics finding. - Never reuse a held factor across sectors or meshes. A held factor solves a changed problem without complaint (PORT-19; WF-12's PEC-column trap). Use one solver per sector, with the wall term in each factorising call. - _outer_box_tags is wrong on the quarter. Exterior-minus-401 includes 501 / 502, so every sector would silently become (E,E). Use the quarter's own tags 1 / 501 / 502. - No TH-16 port rescaling. The ring sheets are interior to the quarter: 50 Ω, full width, no halve_sheet_spec. - Never build the quarter alone (GEO-23). _meshes() builds the direct full mesh first, and (P0)'s 97 414 is recorded on that order. - Tag ghost exterior facets too on the mirror-built mesh, because Dirichlet DOF location reads local facets. Count owned facets only. - No collective inside if comm.rank == 0:. Item 227's W1 deadlocked rank 0 on exactly that (WF-7.md, 2026-10-04 12:00 outcome). Reduce first, then print. - Interior facet tags hang at -n 2 (known-issues 9). Distribute cells only, and hoist create_connectivity(fdim, tdim) and create_entity_permutations() before any facet query (0b's pattern). - del fields after every drive (test_wf7_f_human_ring_matrix.py:361). cell_tags.values and assemble_scalar are rank-local. - Facet forms stay free of SpatialCoordinate (_leontovich_term already is). - Keep these out of the window: - tests/mesh/test_birdcage_port_tags.py, the open GEO-23 red; - the 0a and 0b modules, which re-run their own anchors and add ≈ 60 s. - Always -s; no pytest -k; no pipes. - Rule (i): no edit after W1 starts. The slot checks the module's mtime against W2's start. - On Status 124: pgrep -c python3 in the container, then the cache sweep. Never lengthen the timeout.

Scope. - Fixture: degree 1, 64 MHz, the copper Leontovich wall (σ = 5.8e7), on the mirror-built mesh of the 1.6 mm hole fixture. - Ports and run: 50 Ω terminations, exact ring sheets with κ off (the 10-02 binding ruling), -n 8. - What the identity gates: it is a same-mesh, same-code identity. It gates the symmetry planes, the sector characters and the port bookkeeping.

Not covered: - any two-mesh band. The mirror-built and direct full meshes are independent triangulations (Q3 reads 1.498e-4), and WF-12's 32×32 is only printed beside S_f; - C16: the mirror-built mesh is D2-symmetric by construction, not C16; - C_mode, tuning, |B₁⁺| / SAR; - degree 2, or any memory claim (H13b); - the σ = 800 solid route; - 128 MHz.

Negative result: - (P0) off a record: stop. This is an image or record drift (record-reconciler). Commit nothing but the log. - (A) red with the exact-2 pattern on the σ_x / σ_y images: the χ table is inverted in the test. Park on attempt/TH-20-step1-<ts> and mark BLOCKED (rule (d)). The re-pose fixes the table; rule (i) forbids an edit after W1. - (A) red otherwise, with (P0)–(P3) and (I1)–(I3) green: a symmetry-plane or port-bookkeeping defect, or a round-off floor above 1e-9 at this size. Report the per-entry pattern (by g and by |R_ab|), park, and mark BLOCKED. The band is imported and never widened; any rule (f) question is the review's. - (I1) or (I2) red on a sector: a finding on the sector operator. Write a known-issues entry, park, and mark BLOCKED. - C1 / C1x not exactly 2, or C2 under 1e-3: the control is blind or the assembly is wrong. The step does not close. - W1's projection > 560 s, or W1 killed at 540 s: a price, not a defect. Report it and mark BLOCKED. The next try is a later normal-speed slot. If a normal-speed box also projects over 560 s, H13a needs an xl entry, which the weekly commissions. - There is no PREDICTED RED line.

Status it can move: - §7 TH-20 ⬜ → 🟡 on a green W2 (rule (j), checked). The row's Done-when is "step 1's identity asserted in one logged window ⇒ 🟡; step 2 priced ⇒ ✅". W2 asserts the identity (A) together with (P0)–(P3), (I1)–(I3) and C1 / C1x / C2 in one logged window. ✅ waits on step 2 (H13b). - §10 chain H13a is annotated DONE. H13b (the quarter at degree 2, priced) becomes the weekly's to pose, with this window's degree-1 quarter-to-full time and memory ratio as its input. - Flag for the weekly: the row's moved-verbatim text ("three quarter solves … wrong-cut control > 0.5 on the self class") is out of date. Step 1 now runs four solves, per the 10-03 re-target. The self class is read by C2, because a whole-plane swap leaves the self entries unchanged.

Outcome (2026-10-04 21:00 slot): ✅ DONE. W1 20261005T020349Z_TH-20-step1-W1.log (309 s) and W2 20261005T020907Z_TH-20-step1-W2.log (369 s) Status 0; (A) 2.106e-11 over all 1 024 entries against 1e-9; (P0)–(P3), (I1)–(I3), C1 / C1x (512 / 512 at exact 2) and C2 (0.1135) green. Quarter-to-full solve-phase ratio 0.261, full-sweep ΔRSS +5.69 GiB. TH-20 → 🟡; H13a DONE.

docs.title: §9 item 350 — 2026-10-09 (chain step H13b)
docs.text:
Outcome 2026-10-10 (19:30 slot): ✅ step 2a DONE, TH-20 holds 🟡. tests/validation/test_th20_quarter_degree2.py. W1 (EE) attempt 1 crashed on a test-code bug before any solve (index_map(1) read before create_entities(1), 20261010T003223Z_TH-20-step2-W1-EE.log; no npz written), fixed, W1 re-run from scratch under rule (i). (P0) 97 414 / 1 825 / 1 811 on both solve windows; (Deg) 684 904 = 2E + 2F (E 134 230, F 208 222). Per sector EE / EM / ME / MM at -n 8: factorising drive 67.14 / 59.47 / 56.88 / 52.75 s, held max 3.17 / 2.10 / 2.01 / 1.97 s, sector 86.4 / 74.4 / 70.8 / 66.5 s, peak summed RSS 17.08 / 17.42 / 18.82 / 19.57 GiB, INFOG(17) 15 046 / 15 326 / 14 823 / 15 076 MB; (I1) 3.03e-14 / 6.43e-14 / 4.75e-14 / 4.11e-14; (I2) σ_max 0.999979 / 0.999983 / 0.999982 / 0.999983; P_surf > 0 on all. (P1) degree-2 constrained DOFs 35 228 > 26 030, 25 960 > 16 702 (ratio to degree 1 ≈ 3.30–3.32, not the predicted ≈ 2 — printed prediction miss). (P3) 1.1e-16. PROJECTION(3) 435 s ⇒ W2 ran all three sectors. C2 = 1.0994e-1 printed, not asserted (ruling 2; the FEM_EM_TH20_STEP2_CONTROL assert path was not implemented and the variable was dropped from W3's command), inside the predicted [0.08, 0.15]. R(P17, P17) d2 0.402611 + 0.391882j (d1 0.383439 + 0.391631j); R saved to logs/th20/th20-step2-d2-R.npz. Step-2b projection: 537 … 1 074 s full factor at -n 8. Logs: 20261010T003627Z_TH-20-step2-W1-EE.log (310 s), 20261010T004145Z_TH-20-step2-W2-EMMEMM.log (430 s), 20261010T004901Z_TH-20-step2-W3-assemble.log (72 s).

Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-09 18:00 daily review. Licence: §9 rule (4) for H13b as the 10-05 weekly enumerated it (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4740–4742; full text docs/planning/plan-archive.md:38157–38165). Its comparand clause is re-posed under rule (6), because it is blocked: neither the named comparand nor the named fallback can serve (below). The target stays the weekly's. The reassembly identity remains the step's target, and its full-mesh half moves to an xl part for the weekly to commission. No band is set or moved.

  • Executor: implementer. Tier: heavy, complex, -n 8 for the solve windows and -n 1 for the assembly window (no mesh, no solve). Class: chain solve, step 2a.
  • Cost: ≈ 13 measured (the class figure the review supplies) / ≈ 55 predicted min. That is ≈ 20 min of code (a new module, mostly imports), W1 ≈ 5 min, W2 ≈ 8 min, W3 ≈ 1 min and records ≈ 10 min.
  • Depends on: nothing. H15b ran green (20261009T070009Z_WF-7-step0e-H15b.log), but this item does not read its npz (below). It is order-independent of U21 (below). Family: TH-20 step 2, attempt 1 of 4.

The comparand question, settled from the code and the records. The 10-05 text asserts "the four degree-2 quarter sectors reassemble … H15b's saved matrix at the imported 1e-9". If H15b slips, a "fresh one-column degree-2 full solve (priced by xl 09-19)" stands in. Neither can be the comparand of a 1e-9 identity: - H15b's matrix belongs to a different fixture. It is the σ = 800 solid route (conductor as a lossy volume) on the direct mesh: 507 266 cells and 3 256 418 unknowns at degree 2 (20261009T070009Z_WF-7-step0e-H15b.log:10924–10925). TH-20's quarter is the copper Leontovich hole route, and step 1 reassembled the mirror-built 389 656-cell mesh (20261005T020907Z_TH-20-step1-W2.log:8343). - The solid route has no quarter. The cutter refuses the solid ring-gap quadrant before gmsh (src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py:4346–4351, "the solid ring-gap quadrant is not gated … use as_hole=True"; 0a's Q7 asserts that refusal). - Same-physics meshes do not agree at an identity band either. On copper, the direct and mirror-built meshes give S(P17, P17) = 0.383271 + 0.391623j against 0.383439 + 0.391631j (step 1 W2 :8381), a 3e-4 difference. - So no reading of H15b's npz can test the sector characters. That npz was never this step's comparand: the 10-05 text took a matrix saved for C_mode (H15b's readout) as if it were the mirror-built copper 32×32. - The fallback, read as written, has the same defect. "Priced by xl 09-19" is WF-7 step 0b, again the σ = 800 solid route. - The correct fallback cannot fit a slot. That is one degree-2 column on the mirror-built copper mesh, predicted 389 656 / 369 387 × 2 570 024 ≈ 2.71 M unknowns. Its direct-mesh twin (2 570 024 unknowns) did not return a factorising drive inside the ≈ 445 s left after a 112.5 s build at -n 8: Status 124 at 590 s (20261006T123338Z_WF-12-step4-W1.log:6352–6372). The weekly moved it to xl entry 32 (10-13, -n 16, predicted 600–1 800 s; docs/testing/xl-pending.md:1643–1653). A one-column full solve is therefore xl-only.

What fits one slot, and what this item is. Step 2a computes the quarter half of the identity at degree 2: - the four (PEC / PMC)² sector 8×8 matrices on the quarter that step 1 used, with their price; - the per-sector identities, asserted; - the D2 reassembly R (32×32), saved.

Step 2b, for the weekly to commission on xl, is one degree-2 full column on the mirror-built copper mesh at -n 16, with (A) asserted on its 32 entries against the R this item saves. Entry 32's 10-13 reading prices it.

The price, from measured logs. - Mesh phase: ≈ 145 s per window. _meshes() builds the direct full hole mesh first (GEO-23) and then the quarter; step 1 W2 reached the first sector at t = 144.4 s, box speed s = 1.054 (20261005T020907Z_TH-20-step1-W2.log:8304). - Closest measured analogue for one degree-2 quarter sector: MAT-19 step 3p. It is a degree-2 copper-hole fixture with lumped sheets, 93 956 cells against the quarter's 97 414, run at -n 8. EM drives 64.0 / 59.5 s, summed ru_maxrss 18.12 GiB (20261008T124839Z_MAT-19-step3p-W2.log:1076, :1105). - Same-order solid analogue: PORT-21 step 4, 746 144 unknowns at degree 2, -n 8. MUMPS factorization 39.2 s, INFOG(17) 16 357 MB (20261001T094205Z_PORT-21-step4-W1.log:2083, :2142, :2217). - Lower bound from the full mesh. In step 1 at degree 1, the sector-to-full factor ratio was 3.95 / 31.62 s (:8306, :8344). The full degree-2 copper factor exceeds 445 s. Hence the sector factor is ≳ 56 s. - Predicted, per sector at -n 8: - quarter unknowns 2E + 2F ≈ 0.66–0.72 M (0.2637 × 2 570 024 plus the cut-plane entities); - factorising drive 60–130 s; - held drive plus post 1.5–4 s each; - sector total 75–160 s; - summed RSS 15–30 GiB, freed between sectors. - Window totals. W1, one sector, is predicted at 240–330 s. W2, three sectors, is predicted at 400–540 s. Both fit heavy: ≤ 590 s container timeout, ≤ 12 ranks, well under 128 GiB. - The 10-05 text's "≈ 170–250 s, 25–35 GiB for the quarter" is superseded. It was scaled from the solid route's xxl figure through H13a's 0.261. H16 measured that the solid-route price does not transfer to copper (2026-10-07 weekly ruling, PROJECT_PLAN.md:4574–4579).

Code: tests only, no src/. Write a new tests/validation/test_th20_quarter_degree2.py, marked @complex_only. Do not edit test_th20_quarter_solves.py: it is step 1's closed module, and rule (i) applies to its record. Import from it: - _make_drive (:168), _specs (:219), _reconstruct (:112), _recip (:242), _sigma_max (:238), _pi (:86), _owned_tag_count (:162); - SECTORS, GROUP, TAU, COPPER_SIGMA, QUARTER_CELL_RECORD (:47–70), C2_FLOOR (:59).

Also import _meshes / KEPT_RING (test_th20_quarter_f_human_mesh.py:232, :75), _constrained_dofs (test_th16_quarter_birdcage.py:189), _problem (test_th14_birdcage_copper.py) and _rss_gib (test_wf12_f_human_hole.py:191).

Test 1, test_th20_step2_degree2_sectors, is gated on FEM_EM_TH20_STEP2=1. It runs the sectors named in FEM_EM_TH20_STEP2_SECTORS (comma list from EE, EM, ME, MM; unset means all four; anything else raises before the build). It follows step 1's sector loop (test_th20_quarter_solves.py:342–409) with three changes: 1. Degree. DEGREE_2 = 2 is a module constant passed to TimeHarmonicSolver(problem, degree=DEGREE_2). Never import DEGREE from test_wf7_f_human_b1_quadrature.py: it is 1 (:53). 2. (Deg), on the first sector's solver, before any assembly, in H16a's form (test_wf12_f_human_copper_degree2.py:125–145): solver.degree == 2, and the global unknowns from solver.function_space() equal 2E + 2F of the quarter mesh (topology.index_map(1/2).size_global). 3. Saving. Each sector's 8×8 S^s, its constrained-DOF count, its P_surf and its price go to /workspace/logs/th20/th20-step2-d2-<sector>.npz (gitignored). Write on rank 0 after every collective, with exclusive create (open(path, "xb")). An existing file raises before the build: no stale-file mixing across attempts.

Per-phase prints, each after a collective _rss_gib, go per sector: - the constrained DOFs; - the factorising drive (solve + post); - held max and mean; - the sector total; - summed and per-rank RSS, and ΔRSS.

The window prints PROJECTION(k) = t_before_first_sector + k × t_sector_max + 30 for k = 1, 2, 3.

Test 2, test_th20_step2_assemble, is gated on FEM_EM_TH20_STEP2_ASSEMBLE=1. It builds no mesh and runs no solve: it reads the four npz files. Missing any of the four ⇒ fail. - It rebuilds preimage exactly as step 1's (P3) block does (:303–321) and asserts that block's bijection and τ again (pure arithmetic). - It runs R = _reconstruct(ss, kept, ordinals, preimage) and saves R plus the four S^s to /workspace/logs/th20/th20-step2-d2-R.npz (exclusive create). That file is step 2b's comparand. - FEM_EM_TH20_STEP2_CONTROL=1 asserts C2.

Both tests must be written before W1 starts.

Anchors (asserted; bands imported, never set): - (P0) Quarter cells == QUARTER_CELL_RECORD 97 414, and owned 501 / 502 facets == CUT_FACES_X0 / CUT_FACES_Y0 1 825 / 1 811 (test_th20_mirror_built_full_mesh.py:68–69). These are step 1's (P0), in every solve window. - (Deg) solver.degree == 2 and unknowns == 2E + 2F exactly, in every solve window. - (P2) P_surf > 0 on each sector's factorising drive, so the Leontovich wall is in every operator. - (I1) per sector: ‖S^s − S^sᵀ‖_F / ‖S^s‖_F ≤ RECIPROCITY_BAND 1e-3 (tests/validation/test_port_lumped_sheet_sweep.py:86). Predicted ≈ 1e-14, as step 1 read 3.3e-15 … 1.0e-14 at degree 1 (:8306–8333). The entrywise max is printed beside RECIPROCITY_Q_BAND 1e-12 (test_th16_quarter_birdcage.py:116), not asserted. - (I2) per sector: σax(S^s) ≤ MATRIX_PASSIVITY_CEILING 1.0 (klzxh:1085). Predicted 0.99999 (step 1: 0.999991–0.999993). - (P1), in W3 om the saved counts:** constrained DOFs EE > EM, ME > MM. Step 1 read 10 662 > 7 874, 7 853 > 5 035 at degree 1 (:8342). At degree 2, each count is predicted ≈ 2× (edges plus faces on the PEC planes). - (P3), in W3: the image bijection and |(R_g d_o)·d_π(o) − τ_g| ≤ 1e-12 (step 1 read 1.1e-16, :220).

Printed, never asserted: - the price against the pre-stated bracket above: unknowns, factor, held, sector total, summed RSS, and INFOG(17) from the FEM_EM_SOLVER_PROGRESS=2 MUMPS block; - the quarter's peak summed RSS beside H15b's full σ = 800 103.95 GiB at -n 16 (docs/testing/xl-ledger.md:55), and beside the degree-2 copper full column's ">445 s unreturned at -n 8"; - a projected price for step 2b: the measured sector factor × 8 … 16 at -n 8 (ratio 1/8, step 1's degree-1 measure, to the N² nested-dissection bound of 1/16), labelled a projection; - the d1 → d2 move of S^s(P17, P17) against step 1 W2's degree-1 rows. These are records, not comparands:

sector degree-1 S^s(P17, P17) step 1 W2 line EE +0.087643 + 0.432975j :8307 EM +0.584504 + 0.435851j :8316 ME +0.275464 + 0.258848j :8325 MM +0.586144 + 0.438849j :8334 - R(P17, P17) at degree 2 beside step 1's 0.383439 + 0.391631j (:8381); - H15b's σ = 800 values: not printed at all. They belong to a different fixture.

Negative controls (rule (e)): - (C2) The collapsed sectors, asserted in W3 under FEM_EM_TH20_STEP2_CONTROL=1. The quantity is min over i ∈ K of |S^(M,E)_ii − S^(E,E)_ii| / |Σ_s S^s_ii|. - Why this is step 1's C2. For every full ordinal a = π_h(i), R_aa = ¼ Σ_s S^s_ii (the self class has g = e), and ΔR_aa = ¼ (S^(M,E) − S^(E,E))_ii. Step 1 rd S_f,aa = R_aa to 2.106e-, so this sector-only form is step 1's C2 to ≈ 1e-10. - What a brok run returns. A solver that reused a ld factor across sectors, or a pec tuple taken from _outer_box_tags (every sector silently becomes (E,E)), returns four identical S^s and reads exactly 0. - The asse: ≥ C2_FLOOR 1e-3test_th20_quarter_solves.py:59, imported). - The backing measurementstep 1's 1.134-1 on the same mesh, the same comparison and the same sectors, at degree 1 (20261005T020907Z_TH-20-step1-W2.log:8385). That sits 113× above the floor. - Ceiling: 2 / (4 × 0.548) ≈ 0.91 (|S^s_ii| ≤ 1). Predicted at degree 2: [0.08, 0.15], printed beside the reading. - Flagged for the review: the backing measurement is at degree 1. If the review reads "the same fixture" under rule (e) as excluding a change of order, C2 is printed in W3, not asserted, and the step cannot close on it. - (Deg) control, predicted and printed in H16a's form: a degree-1 space would read E, not 2E + 2F. This is the WF-15 step 1 degree-default trap.

Windows. Bash timeout: 660000, foreground, each harness call bare and whole. The solve windows use §5.1's durable capture verbatim, trailing ; exit \$rc included. The first, before W1, is a pre-flight (no harness): - A Glob of the repo's logs/th20/ (the container's /workspace/logs/th20/) must show no th20-step2-d2-*.npz. A leftover file from an earlier attempt is reported, not silently removed. - grep -n emit_leg_ports tests/validation/test_birdcage_f_human_rung.py tests/validation/test_th20_quarter_f_human_mesh.py must be empty (the U21 check, below).

  • W1, the cost probe, (E,E) alone at -n 8. Predicted 240–330 s.

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh TH-20-step2-W1-EE "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && mkdir -p /workspace/logs/th20 && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_SOLVER_PROGRESS=2 FEM_EM_TH20_STEP2=1 FEM_EM_TH20_STEP2_SECTORS=EE timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 8 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_th20_quarter_degree2.py -v -s --tb=short > /workspace/logs/th20-step2-w1-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/th20-step2-w1-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/th20-step2-w1-raw.log; exit \$rc'"

  • Gate before W2, read from W1's printed PROJECTION(k):
  • PROJECTION(3) ≤ 540 s: W2 runs EM, ME and MM together (below).
  • Else PROJECTION(2) ≤ 540 s: W2 runs EM and ME, and W2b runs MM. Same command with the sector list and label changed (TH-20-step2-W2-EMME, TH-20-step2-W2b-MM; raw logs th20-step2-w2-raw.log, th20-step2-w2b-raw.log).
  • Else PROJECTION(1) ≤ 540 s, and ≥ 3 × PROJECTION(1) + 10 min of the slot remain: one sector per window.

  • Otherwise stop. That is the price, not a defect (see the negative results).

  • W2, three sectors at -n 8. Predicted 400–540 s.

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh TH-20-step2-W2-EMMEMM "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && mkdir -p /workspace/logs/th20 && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_SOLVER_PROGRESS=2 FEM_EM_TH20_STEP2=1 FEM_EM_TH20_STEP2_SECTORS=EM,ME,MM timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 8 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_th20_quarter_degree2.py -v -s --tb=short > /workspace/logs/th20-step2-w2-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/th20-step2-w2-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/th20-step2-w2-raw.log; exit \$rc'"

  • W3, the assembly and the window the step closes on, at -n 1. No mesh and no solve; C2 is asserted. Predicted 20–40 s.

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh TH-20-step2-W3-assemble "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_TH20_STEP2_ASSEMBLE=1 FEM_EM_TH20_STEP2_CONTROL=1 timeout -k 30 180 mpiexec -n 1 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_th20_quarter_degree2.py -v -s --tb=short'"

  • Why -n 8 and not -n 2. The sector solve at degree 2 is priced only at -n 8. Step 1 proved the same reductions (_make_drive's sheet_terminal_current(…, comm) and _owned_tag_count) at -n 8, and every reduction is visible at any n > 1.

The U21 interaction: unaffected, and order-independent. - Why unaffected. TH-20 builds through _kwargs() = _params(F_HUMAN_RING_RADIUS, scale_sizing=False) + as_hole=True + longitudinal sheets, calling birdcage_port_domain directly (test_th20_quarter_f_human_mesh.py:117–123). U21's switch list is _build_f_human, mesh:9–12, WF-7 / WF-10 and EX-62 (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4863–4868). GEO-35 step 1 also refuses emit_leg_ports=False with as_hole or symmetry_quadrant before gmsh (src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py:4281–4285). - What the quarter keeps. It keeps its leg boxes P1–P4 (tags 101–104, 0a Q1), and its 97 414-cell record stands whichever lands first. - How a switch is detected. If U21 put the switch into _params itself, the pre-flight grep is non-empty, or the build raises ValueError before gmsh, or (P0) misses 97 414. Each of these stops the item (negative results). - Flag for the review, outside this item. _build_f_human(comm, as_hole=True) is the path of WF-12's degree-2 module and of xl entry 32 on 10-13 (test_wf12_f_human_copper_degree2.py:114). A U21 switch that does not exempt as_hole will make entry 32 raise at mesh.py:4281.

Traps (paid for): - H15b's npz is not this step's comparand (above). Never load /workspace/logs/wf7/wf7-s32-degree2-n16.npz here: it is σ = 800 solid on a different mesh, and any band read against it is a two-fixture number. - Never reuse a held factor across sectors. A held factor solves a changed problem without complaint (PORT-19; step 1). Use one fresh solver per sector, with the wall term first in each factorising call. C2 is the check. - _outer_box_tags is wrong on the quarter. Use the quarter's own tags 1 / 501 / 502 with step 1's pec_of table (test_th20_quarter_solves.py:358–359). - No TH-16 port rescaling and no halve_sheet_spec. The ring sheets are interior to the quarter: 50 Ω, full width. - Never build the quarter alone (GEO-23). _meshes() builds the full mesh first, and (P0)'s 97 414 is recorded on that order. - The degree default trap (WF-15 step 1): the imported DEGREE is 1. (Deg) asserts 2. - No collective inside if comm.rank == 0:. Item 227's W1 deadlocked on exactly that. Reduce first, then save and print. - del fields after every drive, and del solver, problem; gc.collect() between sectors. - Durable capture: copy the idiom verbatim with the trailing ; exit \$rc (WF-6 4h's Status: 0 over a red). The final [capture] rc= line must be the last line. - On Status 124: run pgrep -c python3 in the container, then the cache sweep (rubric item 4's command, label TH-20-step2-cache-sweep). A killed first degree-2 compile on the quarter forms can leave an orphan .c. Never lengthen the timeout. - Keep out of every window: tests/mesh/test_birdcage_port_tags.py (the open GEO-23 red), and the 0a / 0b / step 1 modules (they re-run their own anchors). - Always -s; no pytest -k; no pipes. - Rule (i): no edit to the module after W1 starts. If it changes, W1 onward re-runs, and stale npz files are refused by the exclusive create.

Scope. - Fixture: degree 2, 64 MHz, copper Leontovich wall (σ = 5.8e7), the 1.6 mm hole fixture's quarter (97 414 cells), 50 Ω terminations, exact ring sheets with κ off (the 10-02 binding ruling), -n 8.

Not covered: - the reassembly identity (A) at degree 2. It needs the mirror-built full degree-2 column (step 2b, xl, the weekly's); - any comparison with H15b's σ = 800 matrix; - a full-mesh memory claim beyond the printed projection; - C_mode, tuning, |B₁⁺| / SAR, 128 MHz; - absolute S; - C16.

Negative result: - W1 killed at 590 s, or no PROJECTION(1) ≤ 540 s: a price, not a defect. It means the sector factor exceeds ≈ 400 s at -n 8. Record it, journal it in attempts.md, park the module on attempt/TH-20-step2-<ts> and mark §9 item 350 BLOCKED (rule (d)). The unblock is that the weekly moves the four sectors into the step 2b xl window. - (P0) off its record, the pre-flight grep non-empty, or a ValueError from the build: stop and commit only the log. It is either U21 reaching _params or a record drift (record-reconciler). Report which. - (Deg) red: the solver is not at degree 2. Fix in-slot only before W1; after W1, park. - (I1) or (I2) red on a sector: the first degree-2 finding on a quarter sector operator. Write a known-issues entry, park, and mark BLOCKED. The bands are imported and never widened. - C2 < 1e-3: the sectors collapsed (a reused factor or a wrong pec tuple). The step does not close; park. - There is no PREDICTED RED line.

Status it can move. - §7 TH-20 state line: "step 2a DONE (item 350): the degree-2 quarter priced — unknowns, per-sector time and memory — with per-sector reciprocity / passivity, (Deg) and C2 asserted; R saved for step 2b". - Glyph: stays 🟡. Flagged for the review (rule (j)). The row's Done-when reads "step 2 priced ⇒ ✅", which a green 2a literally meets. But the 10-05 weekly posed step 2 as the reassembly identity at 1e-9 ("TH-20 → ✅ on it"), and the row's state line repeats that. 2a does not assert (A). The executor closes on the row's posed step: it holds 🟡 and flags. The review either rules that the Done-when's "priced" is met (⇒ ✅) or keeps ✅ on step 2b and amends the row's step-2 sentence to name the mirror-built comparand instead of H15b. - §10 H13b is annotated: 2a DONE; 2b is posed for the weekly (xl, one degree-2 mirror-built copper column at -n 16, (A) on its 32 entries against th20-step2-d2-R.npz, priced by entry 32's 10-13 reading).

Review rulings (2026-10-09 18:00 review) on item 350 — these outrank the brief above. (1) Glyph: TH-20 holds 🟡 on item 350. Item 350 is step 2a — the quarter half of H13b, priced, with R saved. The 10-05 weekly's H13b target is the degree-2 reassembly at the imported 1e-9 (plan-archive.md:38160–38162), which 2a does not assert. The row's step-2 sentence ("priced ⇒ ✅") predates the finding that H15b's σ = 800 solid matrix is not the comparand. So the executor does not close on the row's letter. This review does not amend the Done-when (rule (6) forbids it); it flags the mismatch for the 10-10 weekly. (2) C2 is printed, not asserted. Its only backing measurement is degree 1 (…TH-20-step1-W2.log:8385); a change of element order is a different comparison under rule (e). The step's gates are (I1), (I2) and (Deg). (3) Step 2b — one degree-2 mirror-built copper column on xl at -n 16, asserting the reassembly on its 32 entries against the saved R — is the weekly's to commission, priced from xl entry 32's 10-13 reading (dashboard). (4) This is a re-pose of a blocked step under rule (6): the comparand changed, and the target did not. It is provisional, and the weekly ratifies or reverts it. H13b's attempt count is 1 of 4. (5) Independent of GEO-35 step 2 (item 351), whichever lands first; the pre-flight check in the brief stays.

docs.title: §9 item 412 — 2026-10-13 (§10 chain H13b-a; lane 1, no solve)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-13 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §10 chain H, "H13b-a (lane 1, no solve). A degree knob on TH-20's quarter module (H20a's pattern: build-only at -n 2, unknowns = 2E + 2F per sector asserted, unset bitwise) — the landing step either route of H13b needs. Serial on nothing" (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4686–4689), and xl entry 37 (docs/testing/xl-pending.md:1807–1817). The pattern is H20a, WF-10 step 4a, §9 item 368 (docs/planning/chunks/WF-10.md § "§9 item 368"; tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_tuned_b1_sar.py:118–169, :771–845). No band, tolerance, Done-when or target is set or moved.

What already exists, and therefore where the knob goes. The weekly's text names tests/validation/test_th20_quarter_f_human.py; no such file exists (entry 37 repeats the name). The quarter route has three modules: - test_th20_quarter_f_human_mesh.py — step 0a's meshes (_meshes(), :232–263), no solver; - test_th20_quarter_degree2.py — step 2a (item 350). It already is the degree-2 quarter: DEGREE_2 = 2 (:60), and (Deg) = 2E + 2F was asserted in its solve windows (684 904 = 2·134 230 + 2·208 222, 20261010T003627Z_TH-20-step2-W1-EE.log:8305). A degree knob there would duplicate a measured fact, and the module has no full-mesh side; - test_th20_quarter_solves.py — step 1 (item 233), the only module that builds the mirror-built full mesh and solves on it, at the imported DEGREE = 1 (:280; sectors :368, full :462).

H13b's anchor (A) is step 1's identity at degree 2: the four sectors' R against a direct degree-2 column on the mirror-built 389 656-cell mesh, the mesh the sectors reconstruct (ruling (3) of 2026-10-09 18:00 above; :728–740). So the knob goes on step 1's module: with FEM_EM_TH20_DEGREE=2 and FEM_EM_TH20_STEP1_FULL_DRIVES=1, its existing test runs four degree-2 sectors and one degree-2 mirror-built column (P17) and asserts (A) on that column's 32 entries — entry 37's window, in one module, with no new identity code.

TH-20 step 2b-a: FEM_EM_TH20_DEGREE on test_th20_quarter_solves.py, proven by a build-only window and a degree-1 re-gate. - Executor: implementer. Tier: heavy — W1 build-only -n 2, W2 step 1's closing window -n 8; W0 smoke -n 1. Class: lane 1 (median 6) / chain no-solve (median 7). Cost: ≈ 7 measured / ≈ 45 predicted min (15 fixed + ≈ 15 code + W0 ≈ 1 + W1 ≈ 4 + W2 ≈ 6.5 + spare). If W1 has not started by minute 40, park (rule (d)). - Depends on nothing open. W0–W2 need no gitignored input. Family: TH-20 step 2b, landing (H13b's attempt count stays 1 of 4).

Code — tests/validation/test_th20_quarter_solves.py only, additive. src/, the 0a / 0b / step-2a modules, test_th16_quarter_birdcage.py and test_wf7_f_human_b1_quadrature.py are not edited. - Knob. DEGREE_ENV = "FEM_EM_TH20_DEGREE"; _degree_knob() read at call time, H20a's parser in shape: unset or empty ⇒ None (the degree-1 path, untouched); "2" ⇒ 2; anything else, "1" included, ⇒ ValueError (one degree-1 path, never two). The effective degree is DEGREE if knob is None else 2; it replaces DEGREE at :368 and :462 and in the start line (:295). - Build-only knob. BUILD_ONLY_ENV = "FEM_EM_TH20_STEP1_BUILD_ONLY": unset / empty ⇒ off, "1" ⇒ on, anything else ⇒ ValueError. FEM_EM_TH20_STEP1=1 stays the selector. - (Deg) in the solve path, both degrees. After each sector solver (:368) and after the full solver (:462): msh.topology.create_entities(1) and (2) first, then n_dofs = index_map.size_global · index_map_bs, E = index_map(1).size_global, F = index_map(2).size_global; assert solver.degree == deg and n_dofs == E at degree 1 or n_dofs == 2E + 2F at degree 2, exactly; print E, F, n_dofs and the records below. The four sectors share one quarter space, so their four counts are also asserted equal ("per sector", as the weekly wrote). - (P1) at degree 2. _constrained_dofs (:366; test_th16_quarter_birdcage.py:189) counts on an N1curl-1 space. At degree 2 call step 2a's _constrained_dofs_degree(msh_q, facets_q, pec, 2) (test_th20_quarter_degree2.py:100–109, a private import — never a test_* name); the unset path keeps _constrained_dofs bit for bit. Step 2a read 35 228 > 26 030, 25 960 > 16 702 (20261010T004901Z_TH-20-step2-W3-assemble.log), printed beside. - Lift, not copy. Move the mirror build and full facet tags (:411–442) into a module-level _mirror_built_full(msh_q, cells_q, q, comm) returning {msh, cells, ftags, fcensus, n_cells, t_mirror}; the test calls it where the block was, and the mirror (P0) checks (:443–452) stay in the caller. This is the rule (a) lift _run_step2 received for mri:06; W2 proves the degree-1 path unchanged. - Build-only branch, right after the quarter (P0) (:340): for each sector, _problem(...) + TimeHarmonicSolver(problem, degree=deg) + (Deg) + del; then _mirror_built_full and the mirror (P0); then the full _problem(msh, cells, FREQUENCY_HZ, ftags, (OUTER_BOX_TAG,)) + solver + (Deg); print summed RSS (_rss_gib) and the elapsed time; assert not fails; return. No _make_drive, no sheet tags, no form, no assembly, no factorisation — WF-12 4a's "return before any fem.form" (no orphan .c risk). - The saved R, printed only (for entry 37). In the solve path at degree 2 only, after (A): if /workspace/logs/th20/th20-step2-d2-R.npz exists, rank 0 opens it read-only (allow_pickle=False), checks its ordinals equal the window's, and prints max |R_window − R_saved| / |R_saved| over the driven columns (step 2a's R, -n 8; predicted ≤ 1e-10 across rank counts) — printed, never asserted, never written. Absent ⇒ one "absent" line. - FEM_EM_TH20_STEP1_CONTROL is not touched by the knob. Whether entry 37 asserts C1 / C1x / C2 at degree 2 is its command's choice (C2 at degree 2 has one reading, 1.0994e-1, step 2a W3, printed there under ruling (2)).

Tests. - (K0) test_th20_step2ba_knob_coding — ungated, numpy only, monkeypatch: the degree parser (unset / "" / " " ⇒ None; "2" / " 2 " ⇒ 2; "1", "3", "x", "2.0" ⇒ ValueError — the rejected values are the parser's negative control); the effective degree (None ⇒ DEGREE == 1, 2 ⇒ 2); the build-only parser ("0", "yes", "2" ⇒ ValueError); the records' own arithmetic 684_904 == 2 * 134_230 + 2 * 208_222. - (K1) is the existing test under FEM_EM_TH20_STEP1_BUILD_ONLY=1 (W1); (K2) the existing test with both knobs unset (W2).

Anchors (asserted). - (P0) quarter 97 414 cells, owned 501 / 502 = 1 825 / 1 811; mirror-built 389 656 cells, owned 401 = 79 344, 0 exterior facets on the planes — the module's own records (:52–54), in W1 and W2. - (Deg-q) W1, knob 2: on each of the four sector solvers, degree 2 and unknowns = 2E + 2F on the quarter exactly. Record 684 904 = 2·134 230 + 2·208 222 (20261010T003627Z_TH-20-step2-W1-EE.log:8305, same mesh, -n 8), printed beside; -n 2 must read the same global numbers (a rank-reduction check, as WF-12 4a's W1 was). - (Deg-f) W1, knob 2: on the full mirror-built solver, degree 2 and unknowns = 2E + 2F exactly. No prior count on this mesh: predicted ≈ 2.71 M (389 656 / 369 387 × 2 570 024 = 2 711 047; :733), range [2.65 M, 2.76 M], printed only. - (Deg-1) W2, knob unset: each sector and the full solver read degree 1 and unknowns = E exactly (quarter E = 134 230 printed beside). - (Bit) W2: step 1's W2, re-run verbatim on the edited module with both knobs unset, is green: (A) ≤ LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND on all 1 024 entries, (P0)–(P3), (I1)–(I3), and C1 / C1x / C2 asserted under FEM_EM_TH20_STEP1_CONTROL=1. Printed beside step 1's record (20261005T020907Z_TH-20-step1-W2.log:8380–8385): (A) 2.106e-11, S_f(P17, P17) = R(P17, P17) = 0.383439 + 0.391631j, (I3) 1.882e-11, C1 / C1x 512 / 512, C2 1.1346e-01. "Bitwise" means reproduced at round-off (H20a's W2 reading, WF-10.md item 368 outcome): the asserted gates are the bar; a printed reading off its record beyond the last printed digit is reported, not asserted.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - Asserted (backed), the quarter: a degree-1 space has E unknowns, not 2E + 2F. Both numbers are measured on this quarter (…003627Z…:8305–8306): assert n(2) != E and n(2) * E == E * (2E + 2F) in exact integers — the ratio 684 904 / 134 230 = 5.102 is also the ceiling. The WF-15 step 1 degree-1-default trap. - Asserted, the parser: K0's rejected values raise ("1" above all — the second degree-1 path H20a forbade). - Predicted, printed, the full mesh: n(2)/E on the mirror-built mesh, predicted 5.10–5.14 (quarter 5.102, direct hole mesh 5.134); no prior measurement on this mesh, so nothing beyond (Deg-f) is asserted.

Windows. Foreground, bare, repo-relative; Bash timeout: 660000; -s; complex. - W0 (smoke, -n 1; K0 green, the gated test skips): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh TH-20-step2ba-W0 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 60 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/validation/test_th20_quarter_solves.py -v -s --tb=short'" - W1 (build-only, -n 2, knob 2). Predicted 170–250 s harness: direct full build 109.9 s and quarter 28.5 s at -n 2 (20261003T130342Z_TH-20-step0b-W2.log.gz:6230, :8179), the mirror 3.24 s at -n 2 (item 198), five degree-2 spaces seconds (H20a's: 0.1 s, 20261011T140313Z_WF-10-step4a-W1.log:6219), pytest start ≈ 15 s; summed RSS ≤ 3 GiB predicted (H20a 1.10 GiB, :6221), printed. §5.1 durable capture verbatim: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh TH-20-step2ba-W1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_TH20_STEP1=1 FEM_EM_TH20_STEP1_BUILD_ONLY=1 FEM_EM_TH20_DEGREE=2 PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/validation/test_th20_quarter_solves.py -s -v --tb=short > /workspace/logs/th20-step2ba-w1-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/th20-step2ba-w1-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/th20-step2ba-w1-raw.log; exit \$rc'" - Before W2: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 must read 0. - W2 (the degree-1 re-gate, -n 8, both knobs unset; step 1's W2 command (item 233 above) with the label and raw-log name changed; predicted 330–420 s, as step 1's 369 s): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh TH-20-step2ba-W2-regate "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_TH20_STEP1=1 FEM_EM_TH20_STEP1_CONTROL=1 timeout -k 30 600 mpiexec -n 8 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_th20_quarter_solves.py -v -s --tb=short > /workspace/logs/th20-step2ba-w2-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/th20-step2ba-w2-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/th20-step2ba-w2-raw.log; exit \$rc'" - No module edit after W0 starts (rule (i)). Any edit ⇒ W0, W1 and W2 again.

Traps already paid for. - index_map(1) before create_entities(1) raised "Missing IndexMap in Topology" and cost step 2a's first W1 (20261010T003223Z_TH-20-step2-W1-EE.log). Create edges and faces on the quarter and on the mirror-built mesh before reading E and F. - The degree-default trap (WF-15 step 1): TimeHarmonicSolver(problem) is degree 1, and the imported DEGREE is 1. Never monkeypatch DEGREE in test_wf7_f_human_b1_quadrature (WF-12 4's docstring). - Never build the quarter alone (GEO-23): _meshes() builds the direct full mesh first; (P0)'s 97 414 is recorded on that order. - Interior facet tags hang at -n 2 (known-issues 9): the build-only branch makes no sheet tags; create_connectivity(fdim, tdim) and create_entity_permutations() stay hoisted before any facet query on the mirror-built mesh (0b's pattern — the lift keeps it). - No collective inside if comm.rank == 0: (item 227's deadlock): the saved-R read is rank-0 numpy after every collective; reduce first, then print. - Never hold two solvers: del solver, problem; gc.collect() per sector (:377–378) holds in both branches. - The orientation sign (item 233): the χ table is not touched; C1's exact-2 signature in W2 would show it. - After a kill: pgrep -c python3 first; at 0, the rubric-4 sweep under label TH-20-step2ba-cache-sweep. Never -k; no pipe; never delete a log; two heavy windows never run at once.

Scope. A knob, a build-only branch and their counts; the degree-1 path re-gated. Not claimed: any degree-2 S, (A) at degree 2 (step 2b, entry 37), a price for entry 37, the C2 floor at degree 2, TH-20 ✅, AED.

Negative result. Report and stop. docs.title: Step 1b-0 — the dipole / sphere-reflection anchor, numpy only (§9 item 107, 2026-09-30 12:00 slot)
docs.text:
Why a sphere, not the box (10:30 review, journal docs/planning/reviews/2026-09-30-daily-1030.md §4). The entry's original step-1b clause cannot produce a band, for two reasons:

  1. R(θ) is planar. Jin (9.48) is the reflection of a plane wave off a flat first-order ABC. Its rms over a cube, weighted by the dipole's power pattern sin²θ_z, is ρ ≈ 0.113 whatever the box size (measured here: 0.11309, max |R| 0.26795 in the corner direction). No box size makes that number smaller, so it cannot set a band that tightens as the box grows.
  2. Curvature is missing. On a curved boundary the first-order condition also reflects through the 1/(2(k₀R)²) term: 5.1 % at 0.5 λ₀. A box has no closed-form reflection. A sphere has one.

The anchor. Take a z-directed Hertzian dipole with e^{+jωt}, x = k₀r, C = 1, f = 1 − j/x − 1/x² and g = 1 − j/x:

  • E_r = 2C cosθ (1/x² − j/x³) e^{−jx}
  • E_θ = C sinθ (j f/x) e^{−jx}
  • η₀H_φ = C sinθ (j g/x) e^{−jx}

These are the standard small-dipole fields (Balanis, Antenna Theory, eqs. 4-8 / 4-10). That citation is from memory and not verified in-repo; the converted Jin text does not carry the dipole. For that reason (n1) and (n2) verify the field independently.

On r = R the first-order ABC n × ∇ × E + jk₀ n × n × E = 0 (Jin §9.2 (9.44) at s = 1, §9.3 (9.54)) reduces to E_θ = η₀H_φ. Write the field as E = A·E_out + B·conj(E_out); the incoming wave's field is H_in = −conj(H_out). For a general surface impedance E_θ = z η₀ H_φ this gives

Γ(z) = B/A = (f − z g) e^{−2jx} / (f̄ + z ḡ)

and four special cases:

  • z = 1 (the ABC): Γ_sph = −e^{−2jx}/(2x² − 1 + 2jx), with |Γ_sph| = 1/√(1 + 4x⁴).
  • z = f/g (the exact impedance): Γ = 0.
  • z = 0 (PEC): Γ = (f/f̄) e^{−2jx}, with |Γ| = 1.
  • z = −1 (γ → −γ): |Γ| = √(1 + 4x⁴).

The ABC reflects a fraction 1/(2x²) of the wave for x ≫ 1, and fully as x → 0.

Verified (tests/validation/test_th5_dipole_sphere.py, docs/testing/logs/20260930T171635Z_TH-5-step1b0-W1.log, 46 s, 17 passed, -n 2, complex image; numpy only):

  • (n1) ∇×∇×E − k₀²E by nested central differences, at 20 off-axis points in 0.2 ≤ r ≤ 0.5:
  • δ = 1e-3: 3.614e-4. δ = 2e-3: 1.445e-3. The ratio is 3.998, i.e. pure δ² truncation.
  • δ = 2.5e-4: 2.259e-5 ≤ 1e-4 (:88).
  • Step-size finding. At the item's δ = 1e-3 the 1e-4 bound is red by 3.6×. The item's trap clause ("a red by a factor ≲ 10 with the residual falling as δ² is a step-size finding") applies. The bound was not touched: it is asserted at 2.5e-4, and the δ² ratio is asserted in [3.8, 4.2]. The first window is 20260930T171523Z_TH-5-step1b0-W1.log:88.
  • (H) The analytic η₀H is (j/k₀)∇×E to 3.902e-6 at δ = 1e-4 (:89).
  • (n2) The radiated power at r = 0.3 equals 4πC²/(3η₀k₀²) to 1.33e-15 (64-point Gauss–Legendre, exact for this polynomial integrand).
  • (n3) On the standing wave E_out + Γ_sph·conj(E_out), with H from a central-difference curl of E at δ = 1e-4, max |E_θ − η₀H_φ|/|E_θ| over 20 polar angles:
  • x = π: 2.427e-7.
  • x = 2π: 4.817e-8.
  • At δ = 1e-3 both are 100× larger, the δ² signature.
  • Control: Γ = 0 misses by 0.106275, equal to |f − g|/|f|.
  • (n4) Reflection magnitudes:
  • |Γ_sph(π)| = 0.0505957066, |Γ_sph(2π)| = 0.0126641323, ratio 3.9952.
  • |Γ_sph(1e-3) − 1| = 1.3e-9.
  • Γ(z = f/g) = 2.9e-17.
  • Γ(z = 1) matches Γ_sph to 3.5e-18.
  • The PEC case equals (f/f̄)e^{−2jx} to 1.6e-16.
  • |Γ(z = −1)| = 19.7645.
  • (n5) ρ = 0.11309 against the predicted 0.113, and max |R| = 0.26795.

Consequence. The derivation holds, so the entry's conditional step-1b clause (the FEM gate on a sphere at k₀R = π, §9 item 114) is effective. The bar it may not freeze above is |Γ_sph(π)|/3 = 1.69e-2. TH-5 stays 🟡.

docs.title: Step 1b — the dipole gate on the sphere, FEM (§9 item 114, 2026-09-30 13:30 slot)
docs.text:
Fixture. MeshGenerator.ball_domain(radius=0.5), λ₀ = 1 m (k₀R = π), degree 1, vacuum. Every dof of the cells with r ≤ 0.15 is pinned to E_out (r clamped ≥ 0.05). The shell carries A E_out + B conj(E_out), and Γ = B/A is read by a volume least-squares projection over 0.22 < r < 0.42 (χ is DG0 by midpoints, quadrature degree 8). E_out is written as e^{−jx}[2cosθ(1/x² − j/x³) r̂ + (jf/x)(cosθ r̂ − ẑ)], in numpy for the drive and in UFL for the projection, so nothing divides by ρ. New code sits in tests/validation/test_th5_dipole_sphere.py (tests only); _assemble_complex is imported from the step-1a module.

W1 (20260930T184708Z_TH-5-step1b-W1.log, BAND = None, 19 passed, 214 s, -n 2):

  • (P) A planted Γ = 0.01 − 0.02j is recovered to 8.4e-15 (:108).
  • Ladder (:112–124):
λ₀/20 (19 553 cells) λ₀/40 (151 498 cells) (E) |Γ_E| 5.0600e-3 1.7695e-3 (A) |Γ_A − Γ_sph| 5.2789e-3 1.8336e-3

The ceiling is 1.69e-2, so it was frozen. - Controls (printed, :126–127): - PEC: Γ = 0.782555 − 0.623784j (predicted 0.777 − 0.629j). - |Γ_PEC|/|Γ_A| = 21.61. The item predicted 18–22 and gave a ceiling of 19.76. The excess over the ceiling is the discretisation error on |Γ_A| at λ₀/20, since that ceiling holds only for the exact Γ_sph. - The miss ratio is 198.6 (predicted 275, range 90–830). - The conjugated γ gives |Γ| = 21.65. - Printed only (:128–130): - k₀R = 2π at λ/20: |Γ_A| 0.009915 against 0.012664, difference 4.64e-3. This is the λ/20 error at a smaller reflection, not a gate. - Degree 2 at res 0.1 (2 502 cells, R/h = 5): the (E) / (A) errors are 3.18e-2 / 3.34e-2. That rung is too coarse to read. - The box leg was not run: it is printed-only and unpriced in-slot.

W2 (20260930T185052Z_TH-5-step1b-W2.log, BAND = 6e-3, the only edit): 19 passed in 183 s, with the same figures to the printed digit. It asserts |Γ_E| ≤ B, |Γ_A − Γ_sph| ≤ B at λ₀/40, B ≤ 1.69e-2, and that PEC misses Γ_sph by > B (≈ 1.05).

The exact-impedance premise (E) reads the same error floor, so the residual is discretisation and faceting, not the ABC.
