docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-16 18:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §9 rule (6) (PROJECT_PLAN.md ≈ :3853), a provisional next step of live §10 chain U toward subgoal 9a (a study-level Python API + YAML/CLI), after U56 (§9 item 484) and U57 (§9 item 496), both in this file. Chain U's provisional count becomes 3 of 3, the last the daily may write before the 10-17 weekly. Chain U's validation target, quoted: "each step reproduces a gated result or asserts a gated identity through the API, within its unmoved band". Target: reproduction plus an identity. No band, tolerance, record, Done-when or validation target is set or moved; every band is imported by name. Anchors: WF-15 step 3's records (§9 item 330, docs/planning/chunks/WF-15.md ≈ :411–471) — MAT-17 step 2 cases A / B and MAT-18 2(b) (T1) at .4e, under MAT-17's INTERIOR_BAND / BALANCE_BAND — read through femem run's call, run_study_file, from three tracked files; and the YAML Study = the Python Study (_spec_diff == [] at parse, θ at L0_BAND after the solve). Items 484 and 496 (above) and item 330 (WF-15.md) are the templates. No sheet, κ or capacitor-ESR ruling is engaged: there is no port, no capacitor and no field.

Owner. WF-1 owns femem run's schema (steps 1–13 are items 256 … 496). This is WF-1 step 14. WF-15 owns the API it drives (step 3, item 330) and does not move.

Finding at drafting (code reading on da7e369c, nothing run): YAML cannot express a thermal-only Study today, and study_yaml.py alone cannot make femem check accept one. The smallest feasible scope is study_yaml.py (≈ 130 lines, all inserted) plus ≈ 8 inserted lines in cli.py's check; study.py is untouched. Five walls, in the order a file meets them: - Sections. _REQUIRED_SECTIONS = ("study", "geometry", "material", "excitation") (study_yaml.py:129, checked at :847–849) and _parse_study requires study.frequency_hz (:235). A thermal-only Study has no material (Study.__init__ raises TypeError on anything but None, study.py:117–118) and no frequency (self.frequency_hz = None, :127). - Geometry / excitation kinds. _parse_geometry's kinds are _EXCITATION_FOR's keys (study_yaml.py:134–139, :254): no thermal-only kind; UniformHeatSource is not an excitation kind (:375) and none of ThermalBallGeometry, UniformHeatSource, TransientSpec, DutyCycle, ContainerWall is imported (:107–118). - Thermal. On a sphere_in_box, thermal: admits only k_w_per_m_k, h_w_per_m2_k, t_inf_c, source_scale, degree (:564). Verified: a transient section exists only on f_human_birdcage (_parse_thermal_f_human, :598–683, keys dt_s, n_steps, rho_c_j_per_m3_k, theta, startup_half_steps); there is no duty key anywhere and no wall key. - Run. run_study_file calls study.solve(comm) unconditionally (:1150) — Study.solve raises TypeError on a thermal-only Study (study.py:171–172) — and then float(study.frequency_hz) (study_yaml.py:1157). - Check (outside study_yaml.py). cli.main(["check", f]) prints m.sigma / m.epsilon_r of study.material on rank 0 (cli.py:159–164): AttributeError on None. tests/package/test_wf1_check_family.py:32 globs every non-malformed_ file in tests/package/wf1/, so a good thermal file there turns that re-gate red. This is the reason for the cli.py lines (question 1 for the review; the alternative is below). - Nothing else is missing. The API does the work: Study(ThermalBallGeometry(...), None, UniformHeatSource(q)) and Study.temperature(RobinCooling, transient=TransientSpec, duty=DutyCycle | None) dispatch to _study_transient_temperature (study.py:1246–1247, :1434–1492), which builds the mesh itself, refuses source_scale != 1 (:1443–1444) and returns a TransientStudyResult (:1401–1418) carrying mesh, k / rho_c / q, source_multipliers, source_power and max_balance_residual.

The change. Every line is inserted; no existing line of study_yaml.py or cli.py is edited (docstring additions are inserted lines). Standing rule (c) still applies because two insertions sit on the path every file takes (T2, T5): disclose them and re-run the gates of every path they touch (Windows). - (T1) study_yaml.py's from .study import (…) block gains ContainerWall, DutyCycle, ThermalBallGeometry, TransientSpec, UniformHeatSource (five inserted lines). __all__ unchanged; public_surface.txt (WF-13) must not move. - (T2) In _parse_mapping, after the unknown-top-key loop (:842–846) and before the required-sections loop (:847): geo = mapping.get("geometry"); if isinstance(geo, dict) and geo.get("kind") == "thermal_ball": return _parse_thermal_ball_mapping(mapping, source). The version and top-key checks stay first for every file; any other file falls through to the unchanged path (a missing geometry still raises at geometry, :849). - (T3) New _parse_thermal_ball_mapping(mapping, source), returning _load's 4-tuple (Study, "thermal_ball", outputs, _BallThermal); validation order fixed, first error raises: - required sections geometry, excitation, thermal (missing ⇒ at that name); then refused sections study, material, conductor, tune (present ⇒ at that name, reason "a thermal_ball study has no frequency / EM degree / density" (study), "… no EM material: k is thermal.k_w_per_m_k, ρc is thermal.transient.rho_c_j_per_m3_k" (material), "… no conductor" / "… no tune route"); - geometry (the ThermalBallGeometry field names, as the four-port route uses its dataclass's): _unknown (kind, radius, resolution, wall), _missing (radius, resolution), each _number, finite and > 0, else at geometry.<key>; wall optional, a mapping (else at geometry.wall) with exactly thickness_m, k_w_per_m_k, rho_c_j_per_m3_k (_unknown / _missing at geometry.wall.<key>), each finite and > 0; - excitation: _kind(sec, ("uniform_heat_source",), "excitation", source); _unknown (kind, q_w_per_m3); _missing (q_w_per_m3); finite and > 0; - thermal: _unknown (k_w_per_m_k, h_w_per_m2_k, t_inf_c, degree, source_scale, transient, duty); source_scale present ⇒ at thermal.source_scale ("applies to an EM source; scale excitation.q_w_per_m3 instead" — the API's own refusal, study.py:1443–1444, raised at parse); transient absent ⇒ at thermal ("a thermal_ball Study needs thermal.transient" — the API's TypeError, study.py:1439–1440); the base keys through _parse_thermal(base, "sphere_in_box", source) (the F-human route's own reuse, :621–622); transient copied from _parse_thermal_f_human's block (:624–658, same five keys, same checks, same field names; docs.text:
• Rule (6) count: U65, U66 and U67 are chain U's three provisional steps before the 10-19 weekly (the cap). The weekly ratifies or reverts all three. No band, tolerance, Done-when or target is set or moved.
  • Q1, the two pinned rows: as proposed. Move both inputs to outputs: {probes: []}: 500's row at tests/package/test_wf1_yaml_thermal_ball.py:317–318, and item 539's (c-ball) at tests/package/test_wf1_yaml_thermal_box_probes.py:217–222, with its print text and docstring. W0 asserts that both still raise with field outputs.probes. These are the only existing assertions this item edits, and both edits are disclosed in the journal. This is the 18:00 pattern for 521b's row.
  • Q2: R1 stands. The ball path calls _parse_box_probes unedited. Calling an existing parser is neither a copy nor a factor, and one parser is the smaller surface.
  • Q3: refuse the walled ball (the narrower admission). A disclosed study_yaml.py admission with every YAML gate re-run. Serial on nothing." Lane 2 by the same block. No band, tolerance, record, Done-when or target is set or moved; every band is imported by name: WIDTH_RTOL = 1e-9 (tests/validation/test_post8_step3a_averaged_row1.py:88, the POST-8 3a band), L0_BAND (tests/validation/test_mat5_em_coupled_sphere.py:104), LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_four_port.py:165), EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL (tests/validation/test_birdcage_sar_mass_averaged.py:163). This is WF-1 step 20 (step 19 is item 545). Templates: item 344 (outputs.sar / b1_plus on the same fixture) and item 545 (the latest admission, its re-gate set).

Feasibility (source only). - post.sar.point_sar(e_real, e_imag, points, *, sigma, rho, comm, owner="lowest_original_cell") (src/fem_em_solver/post/sar.py:332–378) is POST-8 3b-i's owner-rule default (§9 item 526): σ|E|²/(2ρ) from the split real / imaginary fields; a point no rank evaluates raises. - The port Study's field-keeping solve Study._solve_port_fields (src/fem_em_solver/study.py:1952–2033) is cached on study.fields_result and returns {port_id: TimeHarmonicFields}, whose e_real / e_imag (core/time_harmonic.py:134–135) are exactly the DG split point_sar and the owner rule are written for. run_study_file's four-port branch already reaches it through _sar_summary / _b1_plus_summary (src/fem_em_solver/study_yaml.py:1795–1798). - The phantom is the cylinder r < phantom_radius = 0.03 m, |z| < phantom_height/2 = 0.04 m, centred at the origin (FourPortBirdcageGeometry, study.py; io/mesh.py:3686–3692); σ is study.material.sigma (materials/phantom.py), ρ is study.density_kg_m3 (the value Study.sar uses). - Today outputs.probes on a four_port_birdcage raises at outputs.probes ("probes are defined only on a sphere_in_box", _parse_probes, study_yaml.py:1050–1085, dispatched at :1141–1142). No existing test pins that refusal for a four-port file (grep of tests/package at drafting); the F-human row (tests/package/test_wf1_yaml_f_human.py:235–236) and the sphere / box / ball rows stay true.

Executor: implementer. Tier: standard by prediction, heavy by ceiling (item 344's container timeout -k 30 400 on this fixture), complex build, -n 2 for W0 / W1; the width legs at -n 1 and -n 4. Class: chain step (solve), ≈ 16.7 measured / ≈ 60 predicted min: 15 fixed + ≈ 12 src + ≈ 8 file and module + windows ≈ 24 (below) + ≈ 1 spare. The change (src/fem_em_solver/study_yaml.py only; insertions plus one disclosed edited line, rule (c)). - (P1) _parse_em_probes(value, source) -> tuple, a new function after _parse_box_probes: outputs.probes on a four_port_birdcage is a mapping {points: [[x, y, z], …]} (the b1_plus shape; EM probes are points, thermal probes are balls). Unknown keys ⇒ outputs.probes.<key>; missing / empty points ⇒ outputs.probes.points; a bad entry ⇒ outputs.probes.points[i] (_triple). Returns a tuple of float triples. - (P2) Edited line: _parse_outputs's out["probes"] = _parse_probes(...) (:1142) becomes a two-way dispatch — _parse_em_probes(sec["probes"], source) when geometry_kind == "four_port_birdcage", else _parse_probes(...) unchanged. _parse_probes, _parse_box_probes and the ball / box outputs lines are not edited; the F-human and sphere refusals keep their fields. - (P3) The in-phantom check, before any mesh: inserted in _parse_mapping (:1172–1265) where the parsed geometry and outputs are both in hand: each point must satisfy hypot(x, y) < geometry.phantom_radius and abs(z) < geometry.phantom_height / 2 (strict; σ and ρ below are the phantom's), else StudyConfigError at outputs.probes.points[i] ("outside the phantom"). - (P4) _em_probe_summary(study, points, comm) -> dict, a new function after _b1_plus_summary: res = study._solve_port_fields(comm) (cached; collective); for each port id, in res.fields order, sar = point_sar(f.e_real, f.e_imag, pts, sigma=float(study.material.sigma), rho=float(study.density_kg_m3), comm=res.comm) (owner default, never the complex field twice), e_abs = sqrt(2 ρ sar / σ). Returns {"points", "owner": "lowest_original_cell", "sigma_s_per_m", "rho_kg_m3", "values": {port: {"sar_w_per_kg": [...], "e_abs_v_per_m": [...]}}} (floats). Function-local imports from .post.sar; src never imports tests. - (P5) Inserted in run_study_file's four-port branch after the b1_plus lines (:1797–1798): if "probes" in outputs: # WF-1 step 20 (§9 item 564) / summary["probes"] = _em_probe_summary(study, outputs["probes"], comm). The module docstring and run_study_file's docstring each gain one clause (disclosed hunks). - Never: touch study.py, cli.py, post/, __all__; admit probes on f_human_birdcage, capacitor_sheets or a copper / hole four-port beyond what _parse_outputs already lets through (the copper F-small file reaches the same branch — reachable, not measured, not claimed).

The npz absent ⇒ the width node fails with a message (never re-created there). - Printed only: the legacy owner=None values at each width beside the owner values (the POST-8 motivation; never asserted here); per-point |E| and SAR per 1 V drive; the width spreads in units of the band.

First measurement on this fixture — predicted 1e-2 to 3e-1 (|E| grows ≈ linearly with r near the axis, so δSAR/SAR ≈ 2δr/r ≈ 0.1). The bar is ≥ 1e7× below the prediction and a relative difference has no ceiling here; a value ≤ 1e-6 means the probe ignores its coordinates — stop. - (c-ref) the refusals that must not move — asserted: the F-human and sphere probe rows above, unedited.

docs.text:
The 11-04 weekly wrote U125 as "WF-1 step 10". That number is stale: step 10 is used, and the latest step is 27 (item 730). U125 is step 28.

Reproducing P63's R1 "on the same mesh" needs two public-surface choices. Both are written here as execution detail, with the target kept, and named in the dashboard for the 11-07 weekly to ratify or revert (as field_strength_t was).

1. thermal.initial placement and the wall keys. - thermal.initial sits under thermal: as a sibling of transient, so _TOP_KEYS is unchanged. - geometry.wall uses the ball's _WALL_KEYS names (thickness_m, k_w_per_m_k, rho_c_j_per_m3_k), plus divisions. - divisions is the number of cells across the wall. P63 uses N_w = 2 (test_mat21_wall_fem.py:74–75), and it cannot be derived from the other keys.

2. A walled box is P48b's 1D-reduced form. - The wall sits on ±z only. - Robin cooling applies on z = ±(C + d) only. - The four side faces are Neumann (test_mat21_wall_fem.py:12–15; P63's _robin_facets(..., (2,))).

"The test's own record". P63's W1b prints only R1 − R0 at P5, not θ_R1 itself. So the new module computes P63's R1 directly in the same window and compares against that, and it checks the drift against W1b's print.

docs.title: §9 item 878 — 2026-11-08 (§10 U139, chain U — 9a, WF-1 step 30, the dose readout through YAML; chain step (solve), standard, real)
docs.text:
Written by the 2026-11-08 03:00 daily review from the 11-07 weekly's enumerated §10 U139 (rule (4); not provisional). The target, anchor and control are the weekly's; the execution detail is the review's. Family U139, attempt 1 of 4. Independent of U134 / U135. Next: item 888 (U140).

Executes §10 U139. A thermal: {dose: …} readout (MAT-20's cem43 and six-minute window) on U125's thermal-box files. It asserts (Q-wf), P68's dose gate, at DOSE_BAR on P68's mesh and Δt (the walled box with heat capacity), plus (E). CLI = API by repr. A wall named without a thickness is refused. Envelope entry.

How the target is read (execution detail; the target is unchanged). - (Q-wf) is P68's gate: cem43 on the FEM point history against _q_check_g's quadrature at DOSE_BAR (tests/validation/test_mat21_wall_pre_equilibration_duty25_dose_fem.py:287–292). - P68's mesh is item 682's walled box: 119 808 cells, (52, 32, 12) (20261105T224651Z_MAT-21-P68-W1.log:58). P68's Δt is 70.5375 s (:53). - Why U125's files: P68's own runs are D = 0.25, and a wall beside a duty is a ratified refusal (11-07 weekly; study.py:1905–1906, study_yaml.py:1061–1062). So the gate runs on U125's continuous walled files: R1 is P63's R1, R0 its uniform-start twin. They use that mesh and Δt (20261105T210638Z_WF-1-s28-W1-r2.log:90–92). P68's D = 0.25 dose values are not reachable through YAML and are not claimed. - The dose form is new. No landed YAML key carries cem43. The only six-minute form in YAML is the F-human thermal.window_s (study_yaml.py:808–813, U46's), not U57 / U58's: U57 is capacitor_sheets (item 496) and U58 the thermal_ball duty / wall files (item 500).

Code (src, rule (c), additive; with dose=None every path is byte-identical). - study.py: - New @dataclass(frozen=True) class DoseReadout, next to TransientSpec (:2041): - fields points_m: tuple (a non-empty tuple of finite (x, y, z)) and window_s: float = 360.0; - the comment cites running_average's default (thermal/dose.py:108) and _SIX_MINUTE_WINDOW_S (:3352); - __post_init__ validates both fields; - exported in fem_em_solver.__all__ (src/fem_em_solver/__init__.py:54, :61). - _study_temperature (:1601) gains dose=None. A dose with the tuned two-port hook, or on any geometry except ThermalBoxGeometry, raises ValueError("dose is defined on a transient ThermalBoxGeometry only (WF-1 step 30)") before any solve. Otherwise the dose passes to _study_box_temperature. - _study_box_temperature (:1898): a dose with transient=None, with a TransverseQuadraticHeatSource, or beside a duty raises ValueError naming the case. Otherwise it passes to _study_transient_temperature. - _study_transient_temperature (:2125) gains dose=None. With a dose: - extra["snapshot_steps"] = tuple(range(n_steps + 1)), through solve_transient_conduction (thermal/transient.py:110, :288–294); - a dose point outside the gel box [−A, A] × [−B, B] × [−C, C] raises ValueError; - after the solve, read each snapshot on one fixed batch (the dose points, in order) with post.evaluation.evaluate_vector_field_parallel (post/evaluation.py:224; P68's _read route). A point not found raises ValueError. Then clear the snapshots (P68's :193–200); - per point: cem43(times, T[:, j]) and running_average(times, T[:, j], window=window_s) (thermal/dose.py:45, :108), with times = dt * np.arange(n_steps + 1). - TransientStudyResult (:2090) gains a last, defaulted field dose: Optional[dict] = None, in plain floats: - points_m, times_s; - temperature_c (n_t × n_pts); - cem43_s (one per point); - six_minute: {window_s, peak_c, t_max_s} (per point). - Docstrings of _study_temperature, TransientStudyResult and DoseReadout name WF-1 step 30 and MAT-20. No dose limit, threshold or compliance wording (thermal/dose.py:18). - study_yaml.py: - _parse_thermal_box_mapping (:968–1158): - "dose" joins the allowed thermal keys (:1052). The section is thermal.dose: {points_m: [[x, y, z], …], window_s: w}; - points_m is required, parsed with _triples (:1167). window_s is optional, parsed with _positive_finite (:832); omitted means DoseReadout's own default; - refused at thermal.dose without thermal.transient, beside thermal.duty, or with a transverse_quadratic source; - a point outside the gel is refused at thermal.dose.points_m[i]; - beside outputs.probes, refused at outputs.probes. - The parsed readout rides in outputs["dose"], as tune does; _load's 4-tuple and _BallThermal stay unedited. - Geometry parses first, so a wall without a thickness is refused at geometry.wall.thickness_m before the dose is read. - Other files: on thermal_ball and sphere_in_box files, thermal.dose stays an unknown key, refused by the landed _unknown. - run_study_file (:2242–2247): a ThermalBoxGeometry with "dose" in outputs goes to a new _run_thermal_box_dose. It copies _run_thermal_box's lines (:1904–1976), passes dose=outputs["dose"] to study.temperature, and adds summary["dose"] = thermal.dose. _run_thermal_box stays unedited. - Module docstring: the thermal_box bullet (:63–69) names thermal.dose. - New files in tests/package/wf1/: - thermal_box_wall_gradient_m4_dose.yaml and thermal_box_wall_m4_dose.yaml: U125's R1 / R0 files byte for byte, plus thermal.dose: {points_m: [P5, ADJ_PT], window_s: 360.0}. Each coordinate is the repr of P68's HIST_PTS (…duty25_dose_fem.py:104; ADJ_PT's z is 0.9 * C_BOX, tests/validation/test_mat21_pre_equilibration_closed_form.py:59). - malformed_thermal_box_dose_wall_without_thickness.yaml: the R1 dose file without geometry.wall.thickness_m. - New module tests/package/test_wf1_yaml_thermal_box_dose.py, knob FEM_EM_WF1_S30, real build. - Imports, by name: - from tests.package.test_wf1_yaml_thermal_box_wall: R1_FILE, R0_FILE, CELLS, DT, _field, _with, _without, _py_study, and the direct-R1 names it imports (_walled_box, _materials, _rho_c_field, _robin_facets, ROBIN, RUNG, A_BOX, B_BOX, C_BOX, D_WALL, H_GEL, K, Q, RHO_C, T_INF, G_GRAD, N_MAIN, IDENTITY_BAND, E_BAND, I_P5); - from P68's module: HIST_PTS, HIST_LABELS, GRID_BAR; - DOSE_BAR and T_GRID from tests.validation.test_mat21_box_dose_closed_form; - _q_check_g and _win_check_g from tests.validation.test_mat21_box_dt_duty125_dose_closed_form (:131, :139); - AVG_BAR and W_B2 from tests.validation.test_mat20_running_average; - _dose from tests.validation.test_mat21_pre_equilibration_duty_dose_closed_form (:56); - _read from tests.validation.test_mat21_wall_pre_equilibration_fem (:160); - LOGS, WF1, _spec_diff, _mapping, _fresh_dir, _rc_all from tests.package.test_wf1_study_yaml; - cem43 and running_average from fem_em_solver.thermal.dose. - Helpers for item 888: the direct-R1 history and the (Q-wf) / (Win-wf) collection are module-level helpers (_direct_r1_history, _dose_gates), never test_* functions, so item 888 can import them. - Docstring: backticks WF-1, MAT-20, MAT-21, and cites P68's and U125's logs. - Envelope: - a new [names.DoseReadout] entry with both nodes; - the W1 node under [names.run_study_file], [names.ThermalBoxGeometry] and [names.TransientSpec]; - the W0 node under [names.load_study]; - each with # WF-1 step 30 (§9 item 878). - Wval regenerates docs/guide/validation.md (MAT-20 becomes a gating chunk). Wgen writes docs/guide/api/DoseReadout.md.

Gates (asserted, bands imported, none set). - W0, no mesh (test_wf1_s30_parse_and_refusals, -n 2): - (K) - With their dose lines removed, both dose files equal U125's files' text (custody). - _spec_diff against U125's parsed Studies is []. - The parsed DoseReadout's repr equals repr(DoseReadout(tuple(map(tuple, HIST_PTS)), W_B2)), and each coordinate matches by float.hex. - femem check reads rc (0, 0). - (Ref) - The malformed file is refused at geometry.wall.thickness_m; femem run and femem check read rc (2, 2) and nothing is written. - Variants, each refused at its field: a dose without a transient; a dose beside a duty (unwalled-box variant); with the quadratic source; with a point outside the gel; beside probes; on a thermal_ball file. - API: dose= raises ValueError on the steady box, on the ball, on the EM sphere (_study(degree=1) from tests.package.test_wf15_study_lossy_sphere, no solve), beside a duty, and with the quadratic source. - Build calls 0. - W1, the solve (test_wf1_s30_dose_reproduces_p68_gate). Four runs: - direct R1: as test_wf1_yaml_thermal_box_wall.py:330–338, with snapshot_steps=tuple(range(N_MAIN + 1)); each snapshot read by _read on HIST_PTS (one batch); history T_INF + θ; - run_study_file on both dose files; - the Python twin: _py_study().temperature(RobinCooling(K, H_GEL, T_INF), transient=TransientSpec(DT, N_MAIN, RHO_C, initial_gradient_k_per_m=G_GRAD), dose=DoseReadout(…)).

The gates: - (Grid) summary["dose"]["times_s"] against T_GRID: max |t − T_GRID| / DT ≤ GRID_BAR (P68's W0 form; it read 3.553e-15 steps, …P68-W1.log:53). (Cells) 119 808 on every build. - (Q-wf) On R1, R0 and the Python run, at P5 and ADJ_PT: _q_check_g(T_hist[:, j], times) rel ≤ DOSE_BAR. P68's six histories read ≤ 5.374e-16 (…P68-W1.log:78–83). - (Win-wf) _win_check_g(T_hist[:, j], times, window=W_B2): rel ≤ AVG_BAR, and lo ≤ peak ≤ hi (item 708's form). - (I-h) / (I-d) - The R1 file's history against the direct one: max rel ≤ IDENTITY_BAND (U125's (I) read 0.000e+00, …s28-W1-r2.log:94). - Its cem43_s at each point against _dose of the direct history: rel ≤ IDENTITY_BAND. - The same two checks on the Python run. - (R) The R1 history's last row at P5, minus T_INF, equals U125's θ(P5) +1.224895450933e+00 K (…s28-W1-r2.log:91) within 5e-13: half the print's last digit (§9's standing ruling on I41, IMP-3.md). - (E) max_balance_residual ≤ E_BAND on the direct run, both files and the Python run. - (CLI = API by repr) - Recompute cem43(times, T[:, j]) and running_average(…) in the test from the run's own thermal.dose history. They equal summary["dose"]["cem43_s"][j] and the six_minute peak / t_max by repr. - summary.json on disk equals run.summary, elapsed_s excluded. - Only the dose files' summaries carry dose.

Control (asserted at the gate's band, rule (e)). (c-init-d) The R0 file's cem43_s at P5 misses R1's by more than DOSE_BAR. This is P68's control form (…duty25_dose_fem.py:293–299); its D = 0.25 miss read 4.6009e-01 (…P68-W1.log:85). No log backs a size on the continuous files, so the miss is printed and asserted only > DOSE_BAR. Predicted, printed, not asserted: positive, and at least of order U125's θ(P5) rel miss 1.493e-01 (…s28-W1-r2.log:95), since the dose is exponential in T.

Printed (records, no band). - D at P5 and ADJ_PT for R1 and R0, in P68's .6e on its peak scale (_dose is cem43 of T_INF + θ on T_GRID, no normalisation). - The R-swap miss, as P68 prints it. - The six-minute peak and t_max. - The read time per run.

Windows. Real build. Every window is bare and foreground, Bash timeout 660000 ms. pgrep -c python3 in the container must read 0 before W1, Wreg-r and Wreg-c. - W0: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-1-s30-W0 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 120 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/package/test_wf1_yaml_thermal_box_dose.py -v -s --tb=short'". - W1: W0's command with label WF-1-s30-W1, FEM_EM_WF1_S30=1 added to the env and timeout -k 30 300. Wrap it in the durable capture of 20261104T030134Z_IMP-8-I55-W2-item803.log:12, including the trailing ; exit $rc. - Price: U125's W1-r2 took 16 s for four runs (…s28-W1-r2.log:106–107). P68's runs took 2.7–3.5 s to solve plus 4.4–4.7 s for 41 snapshot reads each (…P68-W1.log:60–64). Four runs with histories: predicted 40–90 s. - Wreg-r1 (real, -n 2, timeout -k 30 600): 20261105T210709Z_WF-1-s28-Wreg-r.log:12's command, verbatim (12 passed, 71 s, :267–268). - Wreg-r2 (real): U125's module with FEM_EM_WF1_S28=1, the 20261105T210638Z_WF-1-s28-W1-r2.log:12 command (16 s). U125's runs must read unchanged. - Wreg-c (complex, -n 2, timeout -k 30 600): 20261105T210828Z_WF-1-s28-Wreg-c.log:12's command (204 s, :83–84), plus tests/package/test_wf15_study_sphere_transient.py::test_wf15_s15_sphere_transient_refusals. - Then Wgen, Wval, Wapi, Wdoc, in that order: WF-1.md:2295–2298, labelled WF-1-s30-W….

Tier. Standard (W1), -n 2, real (Wreg-c complex). Class: chain step (solve). Cost: ≈ 6.8 measured / 35 predicted min.

Traps already paid for. - Real build. The walled-box records are real-build (U125, P63, P68). The W1 node asserts not tests.complex_mode.IS_COMPLEX, as test_wf17_thermal_box_wall_tutorial.py:171 does. - The window default. _SIX_MINUTE_WINDOW_S is defined at study.py:3352, after TransientSpec. A dataclass default that names it at class creation raises NameError. Write 360.0 with the citation. - Batch bytes. .eval bytes depend on batch composition (item 537). The direct run and the Study read the same two-point batch, call by call, per snapshot. - Snapshots. Hold them, read them on one batch, then clear them (P68's :193–200). - cem43 input. It refuses non-increasing times and a non-zero imaginary part (thermal/dose.py:65–80). Pass np.real values. - P5's position. P5 sits on the gel–wall interface z = C, a mesh plane. Read it as P68 did; never perturb it. - The duty refusal. A wall beside a duty is a ratified refusal. Do not lift it to reach P68's D = 0.25 runs. - Not a probe. Study.probe refuses a walled box (study.py:2229–2230). The dose readout is a point history, not a probe, and does not route through _study_probe. - Estimate table. No new YAML lands under examples/ or docs/guide/ (the estimate-table discovery trap, item 873). - Bookkeeping. src imports nothing from tests/; the copied lines cite their span. elapsed_s is per rank. Count verdicts per rank, by token; use -s. Run Wgen before Wapi.

Scope. The 1D-reduced walled box (R1 / R0, continuous source): two points, one rung, one Δt, from the YAML and from the API. Not claimed: P68's D = 0.25 dose values (wall + duty is refused); a dose on the ball, the EM sphere, F-human, the unwalled box or under a duty; a dose band, limit or threshold; compliance; a cited PMMA ρc (W3).

Green: (1) C_mode 1.131080769863e-10 F, 4.3e-13 vs 1e-9 (:10652); (2′) Y-route = current-route 9.1e-15 vs 1e-10 (:10654); ungated numpy two-route 3.9e-16, Z_th → 50 Ω control 0.210 (:243); cells +0.52 %, 32×32 reciprocity 9.7e-15, σ_max 0.999923; 2×2 reciprocity ≤ 5.0e-15, column Σ|S|² ≤ 0.321; control |C₂/C_mode − 1| 0.332900, H8-configuration share at C₂ 0.151201 (both asserted, green). Red: (2) circuit vs in-model 2.399e-03 > REDUCTION_BAND 1e-3 (:10658) — below item 62's 3.49e-3 in H8's configuration at the same C, same order; (3) feed-ring k = ±1 share 0.791268 < 0.9, as predicted (≈ 0.795), other ring 0.951558 (:10659); circuit parallel-drive 0.7899 / 0.9511, H8 configuration 0.7882 / 0.9511 (:10660). Per-k in-model P17, feed ring (−1): |k| = 0 0.1724, |k| = 1 0.7913, |k| = 2 0.0226; other ring |k| = 0 0.0004 (:10661–10662) — the shortfall is k = 0 leakage on the feed ring, confirming the ruling's premise is the drive geometry, not the feed loading. Circuit-only, printed: two-port quadrature 0.7910, opposite pair (0 / 8) 0.9888, four-port quadrature 0.9899 (k = 0 exactly rejected, :10666–10674). Unblock: the operator's / weekly's ruling on the drive geometry (dashboard item is the review's) and, for (2), the band reading the 2026-09-28 known-issues entry carries. No band moved. Chain H8b — WF-10 step 1d: tune by mode on the configuration a birdcage uses (C on all 32 gaps, P17 / P21 driven across their gap's C) (implementer; serial on 128 by file — skip unless 128 landed; heavy; -n 8; complex; tests only; ≈ 55 slot-min: ≈ 8.5 min of window + 15 fixed + ≈ 30 code). Executes the operator's ruling (a) (95dcaced); item 62's parked code is the base.
  2. Prediction, written first: the share (3) is predicted RED (review's drafting, from item 62's own eigenpairs, …step1b.log:10621–10638, C16 assumed exact, no feed loading): feed ring ≈ 0.795, other ring ≈ 0.953 — reproducing item 62's 0.7898 / 0.9515 (:10649) without any 50 Ω feed. The loss is k = 0 leakage: the two k = 0 modes resonate at 154.1 / 159.7 pF, ≈ 6 Ω of reactance from C_mode; a 90° two-port pair does not reject k = 0. The run is the confirming measurement of the operator's premise; red names its cause.
  3. Code. First git log bf6e1ede..main -- tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_tuned_circuit.py lists only 128's commit. Land the branch's step-1b block (:290–≈640 on attempt/WF-10-step1b-20260929T020339Z) by path, merged by hand into 128's file — never a branch merge (it carries a log and a test-results row). Add test_wf10_step1d_parallel_drive, gated by FEM_EM_WF10_STEP1D=1. In-model: all 32 sheets non-50 Ω — the 30 non-feed gaps at Z_C, P17 / P21 at Z_th = 50·Z_C/(50 + Z_C), P17 driven at 1 V (= V_th). An ungated numpy test on a random passive 32×32: the current-route S equals the Y-route S to ≤ 1e-12, and fails if Z_th is replaced by 50 Ω.
  4. Anchors (asserted). (1) C_mode from _mode_blocks / _antisymmetric_eigenpair (branch :350–372) reproduces 1.131080769863e-10 F (…step1b.log:10642) within LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND. (2) circuit = in-model 2×2 S at 50 Ω within REDUCTION_BAND 1e-3 (test_port_lumped_rlc_termination.py:88) — circuit: tuned_input(…, C_mode, terminated=range(2, 32))[1] → s_to_z → inverse → + jωC_mode·I → z_to_s; in-model from currents only: V_i = δ_i,P17 − Z_th·I_i, V_s = (50 + Z_C)/Z_C, S_ij = 2V_i/V_s − δ_ij. (2′) the Y-route circuit S equals the same formula on (Z₃₂ + diag Z_load)⁻¹ e₀ within 1e-10 (ANS-7's two-route precedent, 7.891e-13, 20260929T094009Z_ANS-7-item69-W2-B2.log:2819–2830). (3) the k = ±1 share ≥ 0.9 on the feed ring (ring −1), by _k1_shares (:99) on the P17 column's in-model currents. Step 1's cell, reciprocity and passivity gates.
  5. Negative control (rule (e)). Asserted: |C₂/C_mode − 1| > 0.10 (measured 0.332900, :10643; C₂ does not depend on the feed configuration), and the H8-configuration circuit share at C₂ < 0.5 (0.151201, :10643). Printed only: the parallel-drive circuit share at C₂ (≈ 0.15); circuit-only and outside the ruling, a per-k power table per ring and the share for three drives — two-port quadrature (predicted ≈ 0.80), an opposite pair (slots 0 / 8, ≈ 0.99), four-port quadrature (0 / 4 / 8 / 12, ≈ 0.99).
  6. Window. W1 (≈ 451–515 s; item 62's W1 451 s, 11.8 GiB, :10651): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-10-step1d-W1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && mkdir -p /workspace/logs && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_WF10_STEP1D=1 timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 8 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_tuned_circuit.py -s -v --tb=short > /workspace/logs/wf10-step1d-w1-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/wf10-step1d-w1-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/wf10-step1d-w1-raw.log; exit \$rc'"
  7. Traps. With Z_th on the feeds the 50 Ω voltages, s_column and sheet_powers are all wrong: read currents only. drive_voltage_v stays 1 V; V_s goes into post-processing. _respec needs a per-port impedance map covering the feeds. The first drive passes reuse_factorization=False. C_mode is not select_c_tuned's pick. The step-1b and step-1c tests stay env-gated and are not run.
  8. Scope. Degree 1, σ = 800, 64 MHz, single-port drive. Not: re-tuning for feed loading, a match, |B₁⁺| / SAR (H9), an eigensolve, a band.
  9. Status it can move. The WF-10 row records step 1d (🟡 stays). Green (2) and (3): §10 H8b landed and the known-issues 2026-09-28 entry re-scoped to H8's configuration.
  10. Negative result. (1) off: stop. (2) red: the entry gains the reading; per the chain, 128's sweep is what the review reads. (3) red, as predicted: record both rings, both configurations and the per-k table naming k = 0; the drive geometry goes to the operator (dashboard) — it is the ruling's premise; park on attempt/*, BLOCKED (rule (d)). No band moves.

docs.text: (history and §9 briefs: docs/planning/chunks/WF-10.md) The tuned human-scale birdcage: tune F-human in the circuit layer, then B₁⁺ and the 10 g SAR hotspot of the tuned coil (opened 2026-09-26 by the weekly; §10 chain H8 / H9; serial on WF-7 ✅, PORT-15 ✅, POST-6 ✅). WF-7's coil is untuned — 32 ports in 50 Ω; a body coil is driven at two quadrature ports with a capacitor across every other gap. | 🟡 Step 1 ✅ 2026-09-27 (09:30 slot, §9 item 52) — tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_tuned_circuit.py (FEM_EM_WF10_STEP1=1), 20260927T095735Z_WF-10-step1.log (-n 8, 334 s, window 296.7 s, 12.146 GiB): cells 507 266 (+0.52 %); κ 4.590991e-03; κ-corrected 32×32 reciprocity 8.85e-15, σ_max 0.999923; feeds P17 + P21 (slots 0/4, one ring); the sweep finds one sign change, a zero at C_tuned = 19.7327 pF, |Im Z|/|Z| 2.8e-15, R_in 13.63 Ω, |S11| 0.572; identity residual 6.99e-04 ≤ REDUCTION_BAND (in-model vs circuit 2×2); 2×2 reciprocity ≤ 2.6e-15, column Σ|S|² 0.333; NEG 0.5·C_tuned 1364× band (predicted ≥ 10×, held — printed, now measured, assertable from step 2); |S21| 0.0805 both routes; cond(I − ΓS_tt) 4.61; Q proxy (C·dX/dC/R) 6.85 unloaded / 1.47 loaded. Mode identification: the k = ±1 share of the slot currents at that zero is only 0.084 (feed ring) / 0.025 (other ring) — select_c_tuned's pick is not the k = 1 mode, so step 2 must not take it as the homogeneous mode; selection by k-share is step 2's design question. Operator ruling 2026-09-28 (interactive session): step 1b — C_mode from the k = 1 block of the symmetry-split 32×32, checked by the in-model identity and a k = ±1 share ≥ 0.9, negative control on the k = 2 block, optional xl eigensolve — is §10 chain H8′; step 2 is serial on it. Step 1b W1 RED 2026-09-28 (21:00 slot, §9 item 62 → BLOCKED) — 20260929T020339Z_WF-10-step1b.log (-n 8, 451 s, rc 1; code parked on attempt/WF-10-step1b-20260929T020339Z): λ₁ (ring-antisymmetric) +2.0406 + 21.9860j Ω, Im λ₁ > 0 held; C_mode 113.108 pF (5.73× H8's 19.7327 pF); off-block residual of F Z Fᴴ 4.18e-3 (printed); identity 3.4865e-03 > REDUCTION_BAND 1e-3 (FAIL); k = ±1 share in-model: feed ring 0.7898 (FAIL, < 0.9), other ring 0.9515; circuit beside: 0.7882 / 0.9511 — the circuit and the model agree on the shortfall, so it is in the prediction, not the identity. The item's named candidate cause fits: C_mode assumes C on all 32 gaps, while the feed ring carries two 50 Ω feeds. Predicted control held (C₂ 75.454 pF, 33.3 % off; share at C₂ 0.151 / 0.153 < 0.5); W2 not run (the identity failure precedes the control assertion, so W2 would reproduce W1). Known-issues entry filed. H9 does not run; the band and the next H8′ step are the operator's / the weekly's. Step 1c recorded 2026-10-01 (06:00 slot, §9 item 128) — reading MIXED, a record (no glyph, no band moves). test_wf10_step1c_c_sweep (FEM_EM_WF10_STEP1C=1 / _W2=1), 20261001T110240Z_WF-10-step1c-W1.log (-n 8, 423 s, window 375.2 s, 12.17 GiB, rc 0) and 20261001T110957Z_WF-10-step1c-W2.log (-n 8, 405 s, window 357.7 s, 12.43 GiB, rc 0); the 32×32 carried in the gitignored logs/wf10/h8a-held-s32.npz. Asserted, green: (A1) MEAS at C_tuned = …step1.log:10609 entrywise to 5.7e-12, residual 6.992446e-04 reproduced; (A2) MEAS at C_mode = …step1b.log:10647 to 1.7e-11, residual 3.486500e-03 reproduced; (A3) cells 507 266 = npz, guard re-solve = W1's MEAS to 3.8e-13; NEG 0.5·C_tuned 1364.00× band (≥ 10×); 32×32 reciprocity 8.5e-15, σ_max 0.999923; every 2×2 reciprocity ≤ 4.8e-15, column Σ|S|² ≤ 0.334. Scan (2 001 log-spaced C): cond 4.61 at C_tuned (H8's value), 10 interior local maxima; the two largest at 75.70 pF (cond 23.1, 0.3 % from the k = 2 anti-mode 75.45 pF) and 105.02 pF (cond 21.4); cond falls monotonically from there to C_mode, so the rule's upper off-point lands at 113.01 pF, 0.09 % below C_mode. Rule points (C, residual, cond): C_tuned 19.73 pF 6.99e-4 / 4.61; on 75.70 pF 2.02e-3 / 23.1; off 88.35 pF 3.58e-3 / 12.5; on 105.02 pF 6.11e-3 / 21.4; off 113.01 pF 3.51e-3 / 18.6; C_mode 113.11 pF 3.49e-3 / 18.6. On/off ratios: lower on-point 2.885 (vs C_tuned) / 0.564 (vs 88.35 pF); upper 1.707 / 1.738. Not a spike (the lower cond peak sits below its upper neighbour), not a trend (the anchor/off sequence dips 3.58e-3 → 3.51e-3 between 88 and 113 pF, and the upper on-point is 1.7× both neighbours); residual/cond 8.7e-5 … 2.9e-4, so the residual does not track cond; log-log slope of residual vs C ≈ +1.03 (all 6 points), +0.95 (anchors + off-points) — the residual grows roughly ∝ C with a ≈ 1.7× excess at 105 pF. Per the item's negative-result rule ("mixed": report and stop; never refit) the known-issues 2026-09-28 Cause cell is not moved by this slot. Rule (a): 20260927T100316Z_WF-10-step1-ruleA-PORT-15.log green (additive terminated=None on _im_z / tuning_sweep). Step 1d W1 🚫 RED 2026-10-01 (09:00 CDT slot, §9 item 133 → BLOCKED) — 20261001T140319Z_WF-10-step1d-W1.log (-n 8, rc 1, window 299.5 s, 12.07 GiB; code parked on attempt/WF-10-step1d-20261001T140319Z): C on all 32 gaps, P17 / P21 at Z_th = 50·Z_C/(50 + Z_C). (1) C_mode reproduced to 4.3e-13; (2′) two circuit routes 9.1e-15; controls green (C₂ 33.29 % off, H8-configuration share at C₂ 0.151). (2) identity 2.399e-03 > 1e-3 (red; item 62 read 3.49e-3 at the same C in H8's configuration); (3) feed-ring share 0.7913 (red, as predicted), other ring 0.9516 — feed-ring |k| = 0 power 0.172; an opposite-pair or four-port quadrature drive (circuit only) gives 0.989 / 0.990. The feed geometry, not the feed loading, sets the share. Step 1 (H8, heavy), as registered: from WF-7 step 1's 32×32 at 64 MHz (degree 1), keep two feed ports 90° apart on one ring, terminate the other 30 ring gaps in C, find C_tuned with PORT-15 step 3's tuning_sweep / select_c_tuned. Asserted: the circuit-reduced 2×2 equals one in-model solve with PORT-14 capacitor sheets at C_tuned on the 30 gaps within the imported REDUCTION_BAND, κ per PORT-14 step 3; the imported reciprocity and passivity gates on the reduced network. Negative control: the prediction at 0.5 × C_tuned misses the in-model solve by ≥ 10× the band. This is predicted and printed, not asserted, at step 1 (rule (e); 2026-09-27 03:00 review, rule (j)). No F-human measurement of that comparison exists; PORT-22's asserted control rests on F-small (20260920T110503Z_PORT-22.log:2153). It becomes assertable from step 2 once step 1 has measured it. Printed: the k = 1 harmonic share of the 16 ring-gap currents per ring (mode identification), feed-port isolation, R_in. Step 2 (H9, heavy): ccw quadrature \|B₁⁺\| and the 10 g SAR hotspot of the tuned coil by superpose_drives with the circuit layer's port currents, gated on reproducing step 1's in-model field at POST-6's imported band and on the C16 / mirror identities WF-7 steps 2–3 import, the mirror identity evaluated on a lattice that includes points off the mirror plane (WF-7's hotspot lay on it, so its mirror check was cw-vs-ccw at one point — weekly ruling 2026-09-26); the hotspot table printed beside WF-7's untuned one. Done-when (§4): both steps' asserts executed, elapsed recorded; §2.1 gains one sentence. Not claimed: a match, a mode spectrum, compliance, a second phantom; degree 1 carries the 5.5 % order caveat. If ring-gap capacitor sheets do not solve, that is the finding and step 1 stops there. Steps 1c / 1d (the operator's 2026-09-30 ruling, numbered H8a / H8b by that night's weekly; written 2026-10-01 03:00 review, rule (j)): 1c (H8a) — on H3's 32×32, the circuit ↔ in-model identity residual at 2 001 circuit-scanned C in [C_tuned, C_mode] and solved at a guard point plus four rule points (two on-points at local maxima of cond(I − ΓS_tt), two off-points), H8's and item 62's points reproduced at 1e-9 (asserted); the spike / trend / mixed reading printed, a record (§9 item 128). 1d (H8b) — C on all 32 gaps, P17 / P21 driven across their gap's C, C_mode from the k = 1 block: circuit = field within REDUCTION_BAND 1e-3 and the feed-ring k = ±1 share ≥ 0.9 asserted, the k = 2 control (§9 item 133). Step 2 is gated on step 1d's in-model field at C_mode, re-derived on WF-12 step 3's copper matrix (the weekly's chain H: H9 on copper). Done-when (§4), amended: steps 1, 1d and 2 asserted, elapsed recorded ⇒ ✅.

docs.title: §9 item 334 — 2026-10-08 (chain step H17 part 1)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-08 18:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §10 chain H bullet "H17. WF-10 step 1e — the in-model Larmor root on copper, with ESR" (grep H17. \WF-10` step 1e` in PROJECT_PLAN.md), enumerated by the 10-07 weekly (§9 rule (4)); binding rulings §9 "sheets and κ" (exact rectangles, κ off) and "capacitor ESR" (r = 0.2 Ω; a feed is driven across its gap's (r + C) branch). No band, tolerance, Done-when or validation target is set or moved. Target (the weekly's): identities; the root is part 2's record.

WF-10 step 1e part 1: a C-node module on the copper F-human hole mesh with series-RC sheets on all 32 gaps and the two-port 90° feed, reading the sign of Im Y_in per node; one node run as its smoke. - Executor: implementer. Tier: heavy, -n 8, complex; W0 (smoke, -n 1, numpy only) then W1. Class: chain step (solve). Cost: ≈ 9 measured / ≈ 50 predicted min (15 fixed + ≈ 20 code + W0 ≈ 1 + W1 ≈ 6 + ≈ 8 spare). If W1 has not started by minute 40, park (rule (d)). - Depends on: PORT-24 step 2 only (§9 item 309, landed 91254c5a). Not on item 308 (attempt/PORT-24-step1-20261008T0948Z) and not on item 311 / T25's ruling: the 10:30 review's "serial on 309 → 311 → T25's ruling" is wider than §10's "Serial on PORT-24 step 2". Part 1 asserts only field-side identities. Its sheet impedance is series_rlc_impedance(f, r_ohm=0.2, l_h=0, c_f=C) (src/fem_em_solver/ports/lumped.py:138), already on main and the one item 309 gated. Its one circuit-side quantity is a printed numpy reading with a local load vector. Nothing calls ring_mode_rows(..., esr_ohm=…), and nothing is taken from the 308 branch. Never concurrent with another heavy window (the 128 G container). - Family: WF-10 step 1e, attempt 1 of 4.

Settled from the code. - Fixture: _build_f_human(comm, as_hole=True) (tests/validation/test_wf7_f_human_b1_quadrature.py:64; DEGREE = 1 :53, FREQUENCY_HZ 64 MHz :52), unchanged. Cu wall z_s = (1+1j)·surface_resistance_ohm(omega, COPPER_SIGMA), _leontovich_term (tests/validation/test_th14_birdcage_copper.py:160), first in every factorising call's bilinear list; _surface_loss_w :174. - Port order, feeds and specs: _ring_quadrature_slots(built["sheets"]) (tests/validation/test_port_drive_superposition.py:1208), QUADRATURE_SLOT_OFFSET 4 (tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_tuned_circuit.py:52), order [P17, feed2] + rest by number (item 285's, so the npz below lines up), _respec(specs, None, impedances) (test_wf10_f_human_tuned_circuit.py:64, κ = None asserted on every spec). - Lift, never import from a branch: copy verbatim into the new module, with a provenance comment naming attempt/WF-12-step3-a2-20261006T1702Z tip b3cafbfd and the line spans: _thevenin_feed_impedance / _source_voltage / _current_route_s / _parallel_currents / _parallel_loads (:130–166), the _drive closure (:314–365), and _pair (:471–482). _thevenin_feed_impedance(z, 50) and _source_voltage(z, 50) take a complex z unchanged, so they are passed Z_RC instead of Z_C. Do not land test_wf12_f_human_copper_c_mode.py (its (2) is red by design). - Stored record: /workspace/logs/wf12/h12c-cu-s32-a2.npz (gitignored; on this box; keys c_mode, cells, order, s32, meas50, slot_k, slot_sign, … — 20261008T093959Z_WF-12-step3b-W1.log:65). Open read-only, allow_pickle=False. Absent ⇒ stop and report, never skip.

Code (tests only, no src/). New tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_copper_esr_root.py. It holds two tests. - (Y0) test_wf10_step1e_y_in_coding, ungated numpy, no solve. Take a seeded random passive 32×32 Z (Re-positive-definite) and Z_RC = series_rlc_impedance(64e6, r_ohm=0.2, l_h=0, c_f=118.1186e-12). The S-route Y_in must equal the current-route Y_RC + I_f/V_f from _parallel_currents / _parallel_loads within 1e-12 (ring_mode_rows' y_in_with_c_s form, src/fem_em_solver/ports/ring_modes.py:163, with jωC → 1/Z_RC). The S-route here is the feeds' 2×2 S at 50 Ω with the gap RC inside the network, then Γ_act → Y_in. - test_wf10_step1e_copper_esr_nodes, selected by FEM_EM_WF10_STEP1E=1. It reads the node list from FEM_EM_WF10_STEP1E_NODES_PF (comma-separated pF). Unset means one node, the npz c_mode (1.181185799070e-10 F, 20261006T170222Z_WF-12-step3-a2-W1.log:6366). Sequence: build → (A0), (iv) → the Z50 pair (all 32 sheets at 50 Ω, z_th = 50 Ω, v_s = 1 V; P17 factorising with partition=True, P21 held) → (R), (P50), NEG, (Z50) → per node one pair: the 30 non-feed gaps at Z_RC(C), P17 and P21 at Z_th = 50·Z_RC/(50 + Z_RC), V_s = (50 + Z_RC)/Z_RC. P17 factorises (wall first, partition=True) and P21 is held. That gives S_node = _current_route_s(cur, [0, 1], Z_th, V_s), then (P_RC), then Y_in. For part 2, rank 0 writes one JSON per node to /workspace/logs/wf10/h17-node-<pF>.json (C, S_node, Y_in both senses, partition, times), then a Barrier. - Y_in (defined here; §10 does not): the active input admittance at P17 under the two-port quadrature drive with incident waves a = (1, +1j). Γ_act = S₁₁ + S₁₂·(+1j), and Y_in = (1 − Γ_act)/(50·(1 + Γ_act)), which equals the source's view of (network ∥ the feed gap's r + C) — ring_mode_rows' y_in_with_c_s with 1/Z_RC for jωC. The (1, +1j) drive is the cw / "two-port quadrature (0/4)" drive item 285 printed (branch :443, :561). The same quantity at P21, and the (1, −1j) sense at both feeds, are printed beside it. Read: sign(Im Y_in) at each node, printed; never asserted.

Anchors (asserted, every band imported). - (A0) cells 369 387 = HOLE_CELL_RECORD (tests/validation/test_wf12_f_human_copper_matrix.py:55) within CELL_COUNT_BAND 0.01 (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_port_sheet_prerequisite.py:57), also = npz cells; (iv) _census_checks, reduced. - (R) the Z50 pair's P17 drive (H12b's 50 Ω P17 drive) reproduces P17_P_SRC_RECORD_W / P17_P_SURF_RECORD_W (test_wf12_f_human_copper_matrix.py:56–57) within REUSE_REPRODUCTION_RTOL 1e-6 (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_ring_matrix.py:171). Measured 2.109e-11 / 1.506e-11 (…step3-a2-W1.log:6355). - (P50) P_src = ΣP_sheet + P_phantom + P_rest + P_surf on that drive within DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL 1e-6 (tests/validation/test_birdcage_power_identity.py:227). Measured 2.420e-13 (:6356). - (Z50) — §10's "Z50 closure": _residual(S_50, s32_npz[:2, :2]) (tests/validation/test_port_circuit_layer_field.py:142) ≤ REUSE_REPRODUCTION_RTOL. The npz order[:2] must equal [P17, feed2], asserted first. Measured 6.761e-14 in-run (:6373). Here the comparand is the stored matrix (a cross-run reproduction), predicted ≤ 1e-10 from (R)'s 2e-11 cross-run level. Also print _residual(S_50, meas50). - (P_RC) — §10's "exact power partition", at the RC node: P_src = Σ_32 P_sheet (30 RC sheets + 2 Z_th feeds, each through _sheet_field_dissipation_w, which assembles the sheet's own impedance) + P_phantom + P_rest + P_surf within DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL. A driven complex Z_th sheet in the partition has no prior measurement; the identity is algebraic (a(E,E) = L(E)). - (Y0) as above, ≤ 1e-12.

WF-10 step 5: the 10 g lattice under EX-75's four-port drive, gated by C4.

Why C4 is exact here, and what the lattice already measures. - EX-75's four-port loading (feeds at slots 0 / 4 / 8 / 12 of the feed ring at Z_th, the other 28 gaps at Z_RC) is mapped onto itself by a 90° rotation (4 slots). - The ccw weights quadrature_phase_weights([0, 1, 2, 3], "ccw") pick up a common phase under that rotation. So |E|², and hence SAR10g, is C4-invariant in CAD; only the mesh breaks it. - 359's _lattice (tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_tuned_sar10g.py:58–77) puts the z_c rows at az₁₇ + 0 / 90 / 180 / 270°. Each radius's four z_c points are therefore one C4 orbit. The C4 identity needs no extra balls, and the per-radius spread is exactly that orbit's dispersion. - The two-port drive on this same lattice (359's logged ccw values, 20261010T171705Z_WF-10-step2s-W1.log:6354–6365; stdlib arithmetic at drafting) reads C4 relative-L2 misses (row m against row 0, over the three radii) of 17.38 % (m = 1), 0.81 % (m = 2), 16.14 % (m = 3). Its spreads reproduce :6375 (16.727 / 20.999 / 18.604 %). - The pattern is 180°-periodic: high at +0 / +180, low at +90 / +270. That is the elliptical-polarisation signature the weekly named. The 180° rotation alone does not separate the drives, so both the gate and the control take the maximum over m = 1, 2, 3.

No existing module and no example is edited. - Imports: - from 358's module: build_tuned_quadrature, C_IN_F_HUMAN_PF, NODE_JSON, _signed_k_shares, _degree_knob; - from 359's module: _lattice, _containment; - the bands and helpers 359 imports (:133–169); - plus EX-75's four-port names: quadrature_phase_weights (tests/validation/test_birdcage_b1_quadrature.py:175), _rotate_z (tests/validation/test_birdcage_b1_plus_map.py:283), _relative_l2 (:600), AZIMUTH_MATCH_DEG (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_ring_column.py:158), _respec (tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_tuned_circuit.py:64), _z_rc / _thevenin_feed_impedance / _source_voltage (tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_copper_esr_root.py:120, :76, :81), _leontovich_term / _surface_loss_w (tests/validation/test_th14_birdcage_copper.py:160, :174), COPPER_SIGMA (tests/validation/test_wf12_f_human_copper_matrix.py), _source_power_w / _sheet_field_dissipation_w (tests/validation/test_birdcage_power_identity.py:296, :253), and the fem_em_solver.ports.lumped terms. - _four_port_drive(out, comm), module-level: lifted from examples/mri/18_f_human_four_port_quadrature.py:254–265 (feeds) and :477–578 (solve, superposition, (X4-P), (X4-L), (X4-K)) at 63e58597, with a provenance comment naming the commit and spans. Tests never import an example. The only delta: it returns ef4, the partition dict, kinds4, r_x4p, r_x4l, y4, feeds4, az4 and the times. - _c4_misses(rows) and _spreads(rows), numpy. rows has shape (4, 3) (row m at az₁₇ + 90m; columns r = 15 / 30 / 45 mm). _c4_misses returns {m: _relative_l2(rows[m], rows[0], all-true)} for m = 1, 2, 3; _spreads returns 359's (max − min)/mean per column (…sar10g.py:282–286). - TWO_PORT_ZC_RECORD: a module dict of the twelve logged ccw values. Each entry is commented with its …step2s-W1.log:63xx line, and the dict is used only by the coding test. - (L4) test_wf10_step5_c4_lattice_coding, ungated numpy. All asserted: - (a) for az₁₇ ∈ {11.25, 0, 33.7}, _rotate_z(row 0, m·π/2) equals _lattice's row m to ≤ 1e-12 m, m = 1, 2, 3; - (b) the four-port weights' FFT bins 0 and 1 are ≤ 1e-12 and |bin 15| = 4 (EX-75's W0); - (c) a planted C4-invariant table gives _c4_misses ≤ 1e-15; - (d) TWO_PORT_ZC_RECORD gives _c4_misses 0.17383 / 0.00808 / 0.16140 and _spreads 0.16727 / 0.20999 / 0.18604, each to 1e-3 relative, with max_m > C4_COVARIANCE_BAND. This is the coding control, backed by logged numbers. - test_wf10_step5_four_port_sar10g, selected by FEM_EM_WF10_STEP5_SAR=1 (never -k). Sequence: 1. assert _degree_knob() is None (degree 1 only). 2. Read NODE_JSON on rank 0 before the builder and bcast (359's :173–182). 3. out = build_tuned_quadrature(comm, with_z50=False), then (S_rep). 4. _phantom_geometry; print the bbox centre's xy offset (the C4 axis is the coil axis). 5. del out["e"]["cw"], out["e17"], out["e21"], keeping out["e"]["ccw"]. 6. _four_port_drive, then (Σ_P)₄: P_phantom,4 against mean_sar(ef4)["dissipated_power_w"]. 7. 18 four-port balls on _lattice(az₁₇, z_c) with the STOP rule; c*₄ = the argmax. 8. 12 two-port ccw balls on the z_c rows (the control). 9. The four-port coverage ball and mean_sar (359's :258–269 on ef4). 10. Containment for every ball. - Ball calls go through mass_averaged_sar with QUADRATURE_DEGREE / TEN_GRAM_KG exactly as 359's ball() (:214–225).

(1) Anchors (asserted, bands imported). - (C4₄) — the gate: max over m = 1, 2, 3 of _c4_misses(four-port z_c rows) ≤ C4_COVARIANCE_BAND (tests/validation/test_birdcage_b1_plus_map.py:120, 5 %). - Inherited: - from the builder: (A0), census, (P_RC) and node NEG; - (S_rep) ≤ REUSE_REPRODUCTION_RTOL (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_ring_matrix.py:171); - the two-port (P_w) / (Lin) as 359 asserts them (:350–355). - Four-port construction identities (EX-75's, ruled asserted 2026-10-11): (X4-K) kinds ["solve", "held", "held", "held"], (X4-P) ≤ DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL (EX-75 read 3.274e-13) and (X4-L) ≤ UNIT_WEIGHT_CONTROL_RTOL (4.161e-16). Also the four-port azimuths 90° apart within AZIMUTH_MATCH_DEG, with feeds 0 / 1 equal to the two-port feeds. - (Σ_P)₄ and (i)₄ coverage power and mass ≤ EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL (tests/validation/test_birdcage_sar_mass_averaged.py:163). 359 read 0.0 and 2.4e-15 / 7.0e-15. - (iv) every ball ≤ 0 by CONTAINMENT_MARGIN_M against the measured bbox.

(2) Negative controls (rule (e)). - Asserted (backed — same comparison, same fixture, same node): the two-port ccw drive's max_m C4 miss on the same 12 z_c points > C4_COVARIANCE_BAND. 359's logged values give 17.38 % at m = 1, 3.5× the band. Only "> band" is asserted, never a factor. - The in-window two-port values are printed beside 359's ten-digit values. They are predicted equal to ≤ 1e-9 relative (same build and node), printed only. - Asserted (coding): (L4)(d). - Predicted, printed only (no prior four-port SAR on this fixture): - the four-port C4 misses, predicted 0.3–3 % per m. Basis: 359's same-mesh 10 g mirror reads 1.28 % rel L2 with per-point misses up to 4.71 % (:6358), and EX-75's field-level four-port C4 spread is 0.17 %; - the per-radius four-port spread, predicted 0.5–6 %.

Printed: the record, against predictions written first. - Spread per radius: four-port, beside the in-window two-port and 359's 16.7 / 21.0 / 18.6 %. The verdict line is printed only: drive anisotropy if spread₄(r) ≤ ⅓ · spread₃₅₉(r) (5.58 / 7.00 / 6.20 %) at all three radii; lattice resolution next suspect if it exceeds that at all three; mixed otherwise, with the per-radius table. Predicted: drive anisotropy. - The four-port 18-point table; c*₄ (predicted r = 45 mm, z_c, any azimuth); SAR10g(c*₄) per W of P_src,4 beside 5.607e-02 W/kg per W; peak-to-mean beside 1.309; P_phantom/P_src,4 beside 0.0947; the four-port k = 0 / k = −1 shares beside EX-75's 4.54e-07 / 0.99945. - Price: build, node pair, four-port solves, ball count, per-ball mean and max, SAR phase, summed RSS, window.

(3) Windows. Foreground. The harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, repo-relative, nothing chained or piped. Bash timeout: 660000; -s; tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py first. Before W1, docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 must read 0. - W0 (smoke, -n 1; (L4) green, the gated test skips): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-10-step5-W0 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 60 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_four_port_sar10g.py -v -s --tb=short'" - W1 (heavy, -n 8, predicted 260–400 s harness): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-10-step5-W1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && mkdir -p /workspace/logs/wf10 && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_WF10_STEP5_SAR=1 PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 8 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_four_port_sar10g.py -s -v --tb=short > /workspace/logs/wf10-step5-w1-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/wf10-step5-w1-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/wf10-step5-w1-raw.log; exit \$rc'"

(4) Traps already paid for. All of 358's, 359's and EX-75's traps apply (above and docs/planning/chunks/EX-75.md item 379 (4)). The ones this item meets first: - Never hold a factor across an impedance change (PORT-19). The builder's last factor is the two-port node loading, so the first four-port solve factorises, with the wall first, and only the next three are held. - On a superposed drive every feed is a driven sheet at its own V_src = w_i (dataclasses.replace; LumpedPortSheet is frozen, src/fem_em_solver/ports/lumped.py:184). r is on the feeds too: Z_th and V_s come from Z_RC. - κ off: _respec(base_specs, None, imp4), and assert every width_correction_kappa is None. - Feed slots come from out["slots"] on the feed ring (EX-75 :255–260). Never hard-code port names. - m = 2 alone passes the two-port drive (0.81 %). The gate and the control take the max over m = 1, 2, 3; a gate on 180° only would be blind. - The gate and the record read the same 12 balls. A C4 green at 5 % rel L2 still allows spreads up to ≈ 10 %, so the gate does not pre-decide the ⅓ record. Never tighten the gate to "help" the record. - Collectives: every rank enters every mass_averaged_sar / mean_sar call (item 227's deadlock). Ball centres go in as plain floats. Containment is against the measured bbox. Wall times are MAX-reduced, so the STOP decision is collective. - The builder rewrites h9p-node-118.2437.json: read it first. FEM_EM_WF10_DEGREE must be unset (asserted); this module is never on entry 35's path. - Memory: del the cw, E₁₇ and E₂₁ fields before the four-port solves; keep ccw for the control balls. - Never import a test_* name or an example; never -k; no pipe; never delete a log. - On status 124 or a kill: run pgrep -c python3 first; only at 0, the orphan .c sweep labelled WF-10-step5-cache-sweep. Never raise the timeout or -n. - Rule (i): no module edit after W0 starts.

(5) Scope. Degree 1, 64 MHz, κ off, one copper hole fixture, the 0.015 m phantom (≈ 1.8 cells per 10 g ball), r = 0.2 Ω on all 32 gaps, C at the two-port root 118.2437 pF (the four-port drive runs untuned, as in EX-75). c*₄ is a lattice argmax. Not claimed: - a four-port tuning, f₀, Q, match or S₁₁ / Z_in; - an absolute SAR; - compliance; - an h-statement; - degree 2; - any AED comparison; - that the clinical fixture should change (it stays two-port, operator 2026-10-01).

(6) Negative result. Report and stop. Park on attempt/WF-10-step5-*, mark item 422 BLOCKED in the same commit (rule (d)) and journal. - (C4₄) red with (X4-*) green: a C4-exact drive misses C4 at 10 g on this lattice. That is the lattice / phantom resolution itself, H24's "otherwise" branch, measured directly. File a known-issues entry with the per-point table and print the spread anyway; never re-band. - Control inside the band: the in-window two-port field did not reproduce 359's. Stop and print both tables. - (S_rep) red: report both records. - (X4-*) red: a defect in the lifted four-port solve. - (Σ_P)₄ or (i)₄ red: a SAR-chain defect; file a known-issues entry. - A spread above ⅓ of the two-port's with (C4₄) green is not a red. It is the record, and it reads "lattice resolution next suspect" for the weekly.

No PREDICTED RED: line. A red anywhere stops the slot.

(7) Status it can move. No glyph. WF-10 is ✅ on "steps 1, 1e and 2 asserted, elapsed recorded" (PROJECT_PLAN.md:2964), and step 5 is not in it. EX-75 (✅ on its example Done-when) does not move. - On green, the WF-10 row gains a "Step 5 record (§9 item 422, H24)" sentence: (C4₄) per m, the two-port control, the spread per radius beside 16.7 / 21.0 / 18.6 % and the verdict line. - §10 H24 reads DONE, and the next weekly reads the verdict against its H18 reading (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4582–4587): drive anisotropy confirmed, or the lattice-resolution step posed. - Known-issues changes only on a red.

Spawn line: "Use the implementer agent to execute WF-10 §9 item 422 per docs/planning/chunks/WF-10.md (read the latest Review ruling paragraph first). The harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, repo-relative, nothing chained or piped. Run every window in the foreground with timeout: 660000, pytest with -s, container timeout -k 30. No src/ edit; write only the new module tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_four_port_sar10g.py; never import a test_* name or an example (lift mri:18's four-port solve with provenance); FEM_EM_WF10_DEGREE stays unset."

docs.title: §9 item 459 — 2026-10-15 (§10 H26a, WF-10 step 1e at degree 2, prerequisite; chain no-solve)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-15 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §10 chain H, weekly-enumerated (§9 rule (4)), quoted, not changed: "H26a (lane 1, no solve). A degree knob on WF-10 step 1e's root module (tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_copper_esr_root.py; H20a's pattern: FEM_EM_WF10_DEGREE read at call time, build-only at -n 2 asserting unknowns = 2E + 2F on the hole mesh, unset bitwise on the degree-1 path) — entry 39's prerequisite (i). Standard. Serial on nothing" (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4754–4758). It is prerequisite (i) of xl entry 39 (docs/testing/xl-pending.md:1867–1886). No band, tolerance, Done-when or target is set or moved. H26a only makes entry 39 runnable; it reads nothing at degree 2 beyond the dof count. The template is item 368 (H20a, this file, "§9 item 368"), including its outcome and the 03:00 ruling (3) beneath it.

Deadline. Entry 39 goes to xxl Saturday 10-17 only if H26a has landed by the 10-16 03:00 review (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4642–4644, :5026–5031). The accepted weekly usage-cap outage runs Thursday night to Friday noon (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4907–4908), so in practice H26a must commit in a 10-15 daytime slot. The drafter recommends it as the first item of 10-15's queue, ahead of the weekly's suggested F37 PEC / F39 order (PROJECT_PLAN.md:5014). Those two are Palace windows with no deadline.

WF-10 H26a: FEM_EM_WF10_DEGREE on step 1e's root module, proven by a build-only window and a degree-1 re-gate of its closing windows. - Executor: implementer. - Tier: W0 smoke (-n 1); W1 heavy by ceiling (-n 2, build-only, 121 s measured on the same build); W2 heavy (-n 8, item 354's W1b re-run); W3 smoke (-n 1, numpy only). - Class: chain no-solve (median 10 measured). Cost: ≈ 10 measured / ≈ 45 predicted min (15 fixed + ≈ 15 code + W0 ≈ 1 + W1 ≈ 2.5 + W2 ≈ 5 + W3 ≈ 0.5 + ≈ 6 commit / journal / spare). If W1 has not started by minute 40, park (rule (d)). - Depends on: nothing open. W2 reads logs/wf12/h12c-cu-s32-a2.npz (20 812 bytes, present on the host at drafting). If it is absent, run W0 / W1 / W3, skip W2, and mark the item BLOCKED with "W2 re-gate pending: npz absent". Never re-solve the 32×32. - Family: WF-10 H26 (degree-2 root), attempt 1 of 4.

What the module is today, and why the H20a pattern needs four changes here, not one. - No builder. Unlike 358's module, step 1e has no builder function. test_wf10_step1e_copper_esr_nodes builds inline: _build_f_human(comm, as_hole=True) (:310), then (A0) / (iv) (:315–323), then solver = ctx["solver"] (:330). DEGREE is imported from test_wf7_f_human_b1_quadrature (:266) and used only in the start print (:304). - Degree-1 comparands asserted. The module asserts two degree-1 records that are certain reds at degree 2: - (R) against P17_P_SRC_RECORD_W / P17_P_SURF_RECORD_W (:433–434, asserted :529–530). Entry 32's degree-2 P_src is 7.013612856e-03 W against the 6.916352890e-03 W record, a 1.41 % move (20261013T070008Z_WF-12-step4-H16.log:6711, test_wf12_f_human_copper_matrix.py:56). - (Z50) against the degree-1 npz s32[:2,:2] (:445, asserted :533). Entry 32's S17,17 moved 3.550 % from d1 to d2 (PROJECT_PLAN.md WF-12 row, …H16.log:6711–6720). - The node JSON path is an inline f-string. The writer is h17-node-{c_f * 1e12:.4f}.json (:513) and the reader is h17-node-{c_pf:.4f}.json (:617). A degree-2 run would overwrite the degree-1 records, and tests/package/test_wf16_study_tuned_f_human.py:101 reads h17-node-118.2000.json as a printed control. - The root reader (test_wf10_step1e_root_bracket, :608) must read the degree-2 files when the knob is set.

Code — tests/validation/test_wf10_f_human_copper_esr_root.py only, additive. src/, test_wf10_f_human_tuned_b1_sar.py (H20a's module), test_wf7_f_human_b1_quadrature.py and every importer of this module are not edited. - The knob is H20a's, imported, never re-implemented (one parser, one env name). Import DEGREE_ENV, _degree_knob, _apply_degree, E_RECORD, F_RECORD, N_DOFS_D2_RECORD, PREDICTED_RSS_D2_GIB and RSS_D2_BUILD_RECORD_GIB from tests.validation.test_wf10_f_human_tuned_b1_sar (:95–104, :118, :139). - Inside function bodies only. That module imports this one at module level (test_wf10_f_human_tuned_b1_sar.py:51), so a module-level import here is circular. Pytest would hit a partially initialised module and raise ImportError. - _apply_degree(ctx, comm) -> (solver, degree, counts) is unchanged and asserts (Deg) inside: degree-1 unknowns = E, degree-2 = 2E + 2F, exactly. - New module-level constants: - BUILD_ENV = "FEM_EM_WF10_STEP1E_BUILD" — the build-only selector, set only in W1, never in entry 39. - STEP1E_DEGREE2_GATES = {"printed": ("(R)", "(Z50)"), "asserted": ("(A0)", "(iv)", "(Deg)", "kinds", "(P50)", "NEG", "(P_RC)")}. - ENTRY32_P_D2 = 1.468e-13 and ENTRY32_NEG_D2 = 119.0 (20261013T070008Z_WF-12-step4-H16.log:6711–6712, printed beside at degree 2). - New _h17_node_json_path(c_pf, degree), module-level, never a test_*: - None ⇒ os.path.join(JSON_DIR, f"h17-node-{c_pf:.4f}.json"), character-identical to :513 / :617; - 2 ⇒ the same with -d2.json; - anything else ⇒ ValueError. - New _build_root_fixture(comm), module-level: the body of :309–323 moved verbatim, plus _apply_degree after (A0) / (iv). - It returns {"built", "ctx", "cells", "t_build", "degree", "counts", "solver_built"}. - solver_built is the object _build_f_human created, kept only at degree 1. At degree 2 it is set to None before return, so two solvers are never held (H20a's test_wf10_f_human_tuned_b1_sar.py:333–337). - It compiles no form and assembles nothing. - test_wf10_step1e_copper_esr_nodes calls it in place of :309–323 and keeps assert built["cells"] == cells_npz (:322) after the call, because the npz is read before the build (:293–300). - test_wf10_step1e_copper_esr_nodes() — the signature is unchanged; body edits only: - (a) the start line (:304) prints the effective degree and the knob (degree {eff} ({DEGREE_ENV} {knob or 'unset'}; fixture DEGREE {DEGREE})), as H20a's :310–311 does; - (b) at degree 2, (R) and (Z50) are computed and printed as "degree-1 record comparand, d1 → d2 move, printed only (H26a)", and their asserts (:529–530, :533) run only at degree 1; - (c) kinds, (P50), NEG (:528, :531–532) and per-node kinds / (P_RC) (:534–537) stay asserted at both degrees. At degree 2, the (P50) / NEG lines print ENTRY32_P_D2 / ENTRY32_NEG_D2 beside; - (d) the writer (:513) goes through _h17_node_json_path(c_f * 1e12, _degree_knob()), and rec (:503–510) gains one additive key, "degree"; - (e) the circuit-only (npz s32 …) print (:495–497) gains the label "degree-1 npz" at degree 2. Nothing else changes. - test_wf10_step1e_root_bracket() — the signature is unchanged: - the path at :617 goes through _h17_node_json_path(c_pf, _degree_knob()), with assert rec.get("degree", 1) == (knob or 1) beside the existing c_f / r_ohm asserts (the existing degree-1 JSONs have no key and default to 1); - the first print names the degree; - the part-1 reproduction print (:633–640) runs only at degree 1 (at degree 2 it would compare a degree-2 node to a degree-1 log). - Every existing module-level name stays, with the same value and signature. Sixteen test modules and examples import from this one (ESR_OHM, JSON_DIR, NPZ_PATH, SENSES, Y0_CODING_BAND, PREDICTED_SLOPE_FACTOR, _z_rc, _active_y_in, _thevenin_feed_impedance, _source_voltage, _current_route_s, _sign_change_roots, …; e.g. test_wf10_f_human_refined_reroot.py:41–49, tests/unit/test_ans8_v3_rows.py:26–32, examples/mri/18_f_human_four_port_quadrature.py:110). src/fem_em_solver/study.py:2009 copies four helpers from it with provenance and must stay in step with them.

Tests added (H20a's K0 / K1, adapted). - (K0) test_wf10_step1e_degree_knob_coding(monkeypatch) — ungated, numpy only: - _h17_node_json_path(118.2, None) equals the old f-string character for character, and 118.1186 and 121.0 likewise; - _h17_node_json_path(118.2, 2) ends -d2.json under JSON_DIR and differs from the degree-1 path; - _h17_node_json_path(118.2, 1) raises ValueError; - STEP1E_DEGREE2_GATES: (R) and (Z50) printed, the printed and asserted sets disjoint, and (A0), (Deg), (P50), NEG and (P_RC) asserted; - the knob's own parser is H20a's and is not re-tested here. - (K1) test_wf10_step1e_build_only(monkeypatch) — @complex_only, selected by FEM_EM_WF10_STEP1E_BUILD=1 (never -k), H20a's K1 (test_wf10_f_human_tuned_b1_sar.py:801–845) on this module's builder: - with monkeypatch.delenv(DEGREE_ENV), call out = _build_root_fixture(comm); assert out["degree"] == 1, that out["ctx"]["solver"] is out["solver_built"] (the unset path does not rebuild), and that n_dofs == E; - then monkeypatch.setenv(DEGREE_ENV, "2") and run _apply_degree(out["ctx"], comm) on the same ctx; assert degree 2, n_dofs == 2E + 2F and the NEG identity; - print E, F, both counts, the build time and the summed RSS. Labels: [WF-10 H26a K1].

Anchors (asserted). - (A0) 369 387 cells, census none — the module's own (:321–323). - (Deg-1) unset ⇒ degree 1, the same solver object, unknowns = E = 500 568 (20261011T140313Z_WF-10-step4a-W1.log:6215, :6217, same mesh). - (Deg-2) knob 2 ⇒ degree 2, unknowns = 2E + 2F = 2 570 024 exactly (…step4a-W1.log:6218–6219). Predicted equal. - (Bit) W2 / W3: item 354's W1b and W2, re-run verbatim on the edited module with the knob unset, are green. - W2 reproduces 20261010T093739Z_WF-10-step1e2-W1b.log, all asserted: (R) 2.110e-11 / 1.507e-11 (:6311), (P50) 2.407e-13 (:6312), NEG 123.6× (:6313), (Z50) 3.245696e-14 (:6316) and (P_RC) at 118.60 / 121.00 (:6319, :6331). - W2 prints Y_in at both nodes beside :6322–6323 / :6334–6335, for a to-the-printed-digit comparison (H20a's W2 read: identity residuals at round-off, readings to the printed digit). - W3 reproduces C_in,F-human = 118.243680 pF (20261010T094215Z_WF-10-step1e2-W2.log:76) from the five degree-1 JSONs. W2 rewrites two of them with reproduced values.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - Asserted (backed): a degree-1 space has E unknowns, not 2E + 2F. Assert n(2) ≠ n(1) and n(2)/n(1) = (2E + 2F)/E = 5.134216 exactly. This is the same comparison on the same mesh (…step4a-W1.log:6220), and the ratio is its own ceiling. - Asserted (coding): the -d2 path differs from the degree-1 path (K0). - Predicted, printed: the summed RSS after the degree-2 space is ≤ PREDICTED_RSS_D2_GIB (2 GiB), beside H20a's 1.10 GiB (…step4a-W1.log:6221). - For entry 39, not this item: at degree 2, (P50) and NEG stay asserted. They are backed by entry 32's same-comparison degree-2 reading: P17 driven, all 32 sheets at 50 Ω, copper hole, (P) 1.468e-13 and NEG 119.0× (…H16.log:6711–6712).
