docs.title: WF-15 — Study v0 on the lossy sphere
docs.text: Item briefs and execution history (operator directive 2026-10-01). The §7 row is the status of record.

docs.title: §9 item 240 — 2026-10-05 (chain U3)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-05 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §10 chain U3 (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4622–4625), a weekly-enumerated step (§9 rule (4)); WF-14 ✅ 2026-10-04 (20261005T022839Z_WF-14-W1.log) meets "serial on U2". No band, tolerance, Done-when or validation target moves.

WF-15 step 1: Study v0 on MAT-4 step 1's lossy sphere. One scriptable object composes five things: a geometry generator, a MAT-1 material, an imposed field, a solve (degree 2 by default) and a SAR result. Assembled this way, it must reproduce MAT-4 step 1's mean-SAR figure against the direct call, and land inside MAT-4's band, at -n 2. Its public names are then registered in WF-14's envelope. - Executor: implementer. New src/ module plus one additive closed-form helper and the __all__ export; a new test module; the registry and snapshot. No existing gate module, helper or record is edited. - Tier: W0 / W1 standard, W2 heavy (re-declared from the row's "standard by prediction" by pricing below), W3 / W4 the WF-14 / WF-13 windows verbatim. -n 2 throughout, which is the row's letter. Complex build for every solve window. - Class: chain step (solve), measured median ≈ 16 min (2026-10-04 18:00 restock). - Cost: ≈ 16 measured / ≈ 60 predicted min. That is 15 fixed + ≈ 25 code + windows ≈ 1 + 2 + 7 + 0.5 + 1 min + ≈ 8 spare. Tight against the 1-hour timebox, and W2 is most of the compute. - Depends on: nothing open. WF-14's files are on main, and nothing named Study exists in src/ (grep, 2026-10-05).

Settled from the code (read before designing). - MAT-4 step 1's figure is degree 1, and there is no degree-2 record of it. The gate solves at TimeHarmonicSolver(problem, degree=1) (tests/validation/test_lossy_sphere_sar.py:189). The fine rung is h = R/10 in / R/5 out. On the 0.11 image it reads 8.291558e-08 W/kg, 3.536 % at σ = 0.57 S/m on 74 020 cells (20260921T111802Z_OPS-55-callers-complex.log.gz:1137). The same rung reads 8.291558128e-08 to ten digits on the material_map path (20260930T003229Z_MAT-1-reanchor-W1.log:494). The 2026-08-03 figure, 8.291696e-08 on 74 019 cells (20260803T020448Z_MAT-4-step1-gate.log.gz:499), is a pre-0.11-image record and cannot be reproduced today. No module solves this fixture at degree 2. test_lossy_sphere_degree2.py (TH-12) is the TH-10 Larmor sphere, a different fixture. Do not invent a degree-2 MAT-4 record. - How "degree 2 by default" squares with "digit-identical against the direct call". The comparand is the direct call at the Study's own degree, on the same mesh. MAT-4's band is the closed-form gate at either degree. So the item has two legs: - the default leg (degree 2): the Study equals the direct degree-2 call, and both sit inside MAT-4's band; - the record leg (degree=1 passed explicitly): the Study reproduces the degree-1 figure above, which is the only figure MAT-4 step 1 owns. - The direct call is MAT-1's _solve_case material_map branch (tests/materials/test_phantom_material_model.py:360–407), copied into the new module with a degree parameter. The source is hard-coded degree=1 at :383 and is not edited. At degree 1 the copy must reproduce :494's map SAR, which proves the copy faithful ((D1) below). - The material slot is MAT-1's class, GelledSalinePhantomMaterial (src/fem_em_solver/materials/phantom.py:22). It takes either a preset name (from_preset, :43; presets low / mid / high = (0.45, 80) / (0.75, 78) / (1.05, 76), :13–18) or an explicit instance. - MAT-4's σ = 0.57, εᵣ = 78 is not a preset. The figure legs pass GelledSalinePhantomMaterial(0.57, 78.0, 64e6). MAT-1's (P1) / (P2) showed this assembles bitwise the material_map path's arrays and operator (…MAT-1-reanchor-W1.log:485–490). - The preset-by-name route is exercised by a "mid" leg, which reproduces MAT-1's own record (:497). - It goes in as phantom_material with phantom_tag=1. The default 3 raises on this mesh (core/time_harmonic.py:113, :278–282). - The imposed field has no src/ home. The quasi-static exterior (uniform + dipole) field exists only as the test-private _exact_exterior_numpy (test_lossy_sphere_sar.py:98–124). An installed package cannot import tests/, which is WF-13's rule. - TimeHarmonicSolver's default degree is 1 (core/time_harmonic.py:318). The Study must pass its own.

Code. - (1) src/fem_em_solver/utils/analytical.py: new dielectric_sphere_quasistatic_field(*, radius, epsilon_c, e0=1.0). It returns the (3, n) callable. - Its arithmetic is copied verbatim, in the same operation order, from test_lossy_sphere_sar.py:104–122: beta = (epsilon_c - 1.0) / (epsilon_c + 2.0); e_in = 3.0 * e0 / (epsilon_c + 2.0); common = beta * e0 * R**3 / r_safe**5; and so on. It returns dtype=PETSc.ScalarType. - It is additive: no existing function changes. - (2) New src/fem_em_solver/study.py with three public names, all frozen dataclasses or a plain class: - SphereInBoxGeometry(sphere_radius, box_half_width, resolution_sphere, resolution_far, sphere_tag=1). Its .build(comm) wraps MeshGenerator.sphere_in_box_domain (io/mesh.py:2545). - QuasiStaticSphereField(e0=1.0). It builds the Dirichlet callable through (1), from the geometry's radius and ε_c = complex(epsilon_r, -sigma / (omega * EPSILON_0)). Here ω = 2.0 * np.pi * frequency_hz, the same expression as test_lossy_sphere_sar.py:79 and phantom.py:122. - Study(geometry, material, excitation, *, frequency_hz, degree=2, density_kg_m3=1000.0). material is a GelledSalinePhantomMaterial or a preset name. Background is HomogeneousMaterial(sigma=0.0, epsilon_r=1.0), and the boundary is "pec_zero_tangential_a" with dirichlet_e_field. - .solve(comm=MPI.COMM_WORLD) builds the mesh and returns a result exposing mesh, cell_tags, fields, solver and degree. - .mean_sar() calls post.sar.mean_sar(fields.e_complex, sigma=fields.sigma_field, rho=density_kg_m3, cell_tags=…, subdomain_ids=sphere_tag, comm=…) and returns its dict unchanged. - No import from tests/, and no new solver code: the Study only composes existing calls. - (3) src/fem_em_solver/__init__.py: export the three names and add them to __all__ (25 → 28). - (4) tests/package/public_surface.txt: add the three names, sorted. tests/package/validation_envelope.toml: one [names.X] table per new name, each listing the WF-15 gate nodes below. Node IDs only, no number (WF-14 (N)). - (5) New tests/package/test_wf15_study_lossy_sphere.py, @complex_only on every solve test (tests/complex_mode.py:26), so that WF-14's real-build collection imports it cleanly. - Imports (names only, nothing restated): SPHERE_RADIUS, BOX_HALF_WIDTH, E0, EPSILON_R_SPHERE, FREQUENCY_HZ, OMEGA, RHO_KG_M3, SIGMA_HIGH, SPHERE_TAG, _exact_exterior_numpy and _interior_probe_points from test_lossy_sphere_sar.py. From test_phantom_material_model.py: MAT4_BAND (:222), SOLVE_FLOOR_RECORD (:239), _dg0_owned_diff, _same_pattern, _difference, _volume_operator (:246–329) and build_preset_sphere_mesh (:434). From test_mat5_em_coupled_sphere.py:104: L0_BAND. - Fixtures: module-scoped deg1 and deg2. Each builds the Study, solves it, and then runs the direct call on the Study's own mesh / cell_tags, so the upstream compares share one owned layout. - Nodes: - test_wf15_imposed_field_is_mat4_wall_data_bitwise (no solve); - test_wf15_study_default_degree_is_two (no solve); - test_wf15_degree1_reproduces_mat4_record; - test_wf15_preset_leg_reproduces_mat1_record; - test_wf15_default_degree2_matches_direct_call.

Anchors (asserted). - (F) The imposed field is MAT-4's wall data, bitwise. Evaluate QuasiStaticSphereField at σ = 0.57 / εᵣ 78 and _exact_exterior_numpy(SIGMA_HIGH) on _interior_probe_points(), the box corners and the rank's owned geometry nodes. Assert np.array_equal. Predicted exact: same floats, same operation order. - (Deg) The default is degree 2, structurally. Study(...).degree == 2 without the argument, and the solved e_complex space's element degree == 2. Both are exact. - (M) The geometry generator equals the direct generator. The global cell count of SphereInBoxGeometry(R, 0.02, R/10, R/5).build equals build_preset_sphere_mesh(comm)'s in the same process, exactly. It is printed beside the version-tagged 74 020 (…MAT-1-reanchor-W1.log:485), never asserted at equality to that number. - (U) The upstream identity, bitwise, at the leg's degree. This is MAT-1's (P1) / (P2) construction, Study against direct: - DG0 σ / εᵣ / μᵣ: max |Δ| == 0.0 with 0 differing on owned dofs, and owned total == global cells; - the curl-curl operators from each path's fields have the same CSR pattern and ‖A_study − A_direct‖_∞ == 0.0. - Asserted at degree 1 (W1) and degree 2 (W2). - (P) SAR post-processing is bitwise. The Study's mean_sar_w_per_kg == mean_sar(...) called directly on the Study's own fields (same field, same process, a deterministic assembly plus a 2-rank allreduce). - (D1) The direct copy is faithful (degree 1). The direct SAR against :494's map record 8.291558128e-08, relative ≤ L0_BAND 1e-9. - (I) The Study equals the direct call end to end, at the leg's degree. |SARtudy − SAR_direct| / SAR_rect ≤ L0_BAND and |⟨E⟩_study − ⟨E_z⟩_dirt| / |⟨Ez⟩_direct ≤ L0_BAND, printed at .10e. - Why this and not bitwise:** two MUMPS solves at -n 2 are not bitse-identical even in one process. The floor on this fixture is 5.962e-13 … 4.450e-11 (known-issues.md:81; SOLVE_FLOOR_RECORD). - Why L0_BAND:** it is this fixture's existing in-run lve-to-solve band. MAT-5 step 2's (L0) measured 7.193e-11 against it (20260930T124701Z_MAT-5-step2-W2.log:160), so it sits ≈ 22× above the floor. - Asserted at degree 1. At degree 2 it is asserted on the imported band. That the degree-2 floor lies under it is redicted* (unmeasured), and the measured value printed. - (R) MAT-4's figure, digit-identical (record leg, degree=1). - (R1) The Study's SAR against 8.291558128e-08, relative ≤ L0_BAND. - (R2) f"{sar:.6e}" == "8.291558e-08", which is MAT-4's own print format (test_lossy_sphere_sar.py:303) and its 0.11-image figure (…OPS-55…:1137). The value …558128 is 3.7e-7 relative from the .6e rounding edge, against a 4.5e-11 floor, so the string compare is safe. - (G) Inside MAT-4's imported band, at both degrees. - Mean SAR against uniform_sphere_sar_closed_form(e0=E0, epsilon_r=78, sigma=0.57, omega=OMEGA, rho=RHO_KG_M3, epsilon_0=EPSILON_0) ≤ MAT4_BAND 0.10 (test_lossy_sphere_sar.py:321, bound at test_phantom_material_model.py:222). - Interior Im/Re E_z ≤ 0.10 (:347), through evaluate_vector_field_parallel. - The interior spread < 0.02 (:331, a literal bound by value with that citation, as MAT-1 did). - (Pre) The preset route ("mid", degree=1). - Study(material="mid")'s SAR printed .4e equals MAT-1's 6.8832e-08 (…MAT-1-reanchor-W1.log:497). - Its error against the closed form is ≤ MAT4_BAND (3.548 % recorded).

Printed (predicted, not asserted). - The degree-2 closed-form error. Predicted in [0.2, 4] %. The arithmetic: MAT-4's own rungs read 8.679 % at R/6 and 3.536 % at R/10 (…OPS-55…:1136–1137). An O(h²) fit puts the degree-1 limit at ≈ 0.6 %. Degree 2 removes most of the h-error but not the faceted-sphere volume (V_mesh/V_exact 0.996387) or the O((k_in R)²) model term (|k_in|R = 0.179). - The degree-2 Im/Re error. Predicted ≤ 0.6 % (degree 1: 0.55 %). - SAR_d2 / SAR_d1 − 1. Predicted in [−3.5, 0] %. - Degree-2 DOFs. Predicted ≈ 497 k (6.72 per cell, as IMP-1's rungs). - The degree-2 SAR at .10e. This becomes WF-15's record for WF-17. - Per-solve seconds and summed peak ru_maxrss (never cgroup memory.peak, TH-12 caution).

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (c1) 1-ULP σ through the Study's material path. Asserted. - The planted perturbation is GelledSalinePhantomMaterial(np.nextafter(0.57, 1), 78, f) through build_material_fields(..., phantom_tag=1). No solve is needed. - The check: (U)'s array compare against the direct σ must read > 0 on > 0 dofs. - Backing: MAT-1 (c1) measured exactly 2⁻⁵³ = 1.1102230246251565e-16 on 19 496 dofs (…MAT-1-reanchor-W1.log:491), the same comparison on the same fixture. DG0 arrays do not depend on the N1curl degree. - Ceiling: 2⁻⁵³ is the smallest nonzero reading the compare can return, so this control shows that (U)'s == 0.0 is at full resolution. - (c2) σ·(1 + 1e-9) on the operator. - At degree 1, asserted: ‖A″ − A_direct‖_∞ > 0, backed by 1.1777e-9 (relative 2.41e-14, :493). - At degree 2, predicted O(1e-9). It is printed, and its > 0 is not asserted. - (c3) The wrong material end to end, (I)'s comparator turned on a known mismatch (degree 1). Asserted. - The check: |SARid − SAR_direct(0.57)| / SAR_direct >klzzwxh:0271. - Ceiling: the closed-form separation is |6.6474e-08 / 8.008354e-08 − 1| = 16.99 %. The measured value on this fixture is 16.98 % (:494 vs :497), ≈ 1.7e8 × the band. - This shows that (I) can fail. - (c4) Dege mismatch (W2). Predicted. - (I)'s comrator, Study (degree 2) against a direct degree-1 solve (one extra ≈ 12 s solve), must exceed L0_BAND. Predicted 0.1–3.5 %; it is printed only, because no degree-2 measurement exists on this fixture. - (Deg) carries the asserted half. - Not re-bought: MAT-4's two-σ σ-blind control (separation 4.850 against ceiling 4.855, > 3). It stays MAT-4's, at degree 1. The record leg reproduces that gate's figure, and W0 re-runs it.

Windows. Foreground; the harness call is the whole Bash command, bare and repo-relative; Bash timeout: 660000; -s; node IDs, never -k; tests/environment first; complex windows source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode + FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1; PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace. - W0, MAT-4 step 1 re-gate (rule (c)). The direct call's gate is re-run green in this slot, and its log carries today's degree-1 record. Standard. Price: 40 s (test-results.md:133). scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-15-W0-mat4 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 timeout -k 30 180 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/validation/test_lossy_sphere_sar.py -s -v --tb=short'" - W1, degree-1 legs. Standard. Predicted 60–110 s: - three degree-1 solves (Study 0.57, direct 0.57, Study "mid"), at ≈ 11.7 s EM each (…MAT-5-step2-W2.log:160); - two meshes, ≈ 2 s each; - three or four operator assemblies; - MAT-1's comparable window of five solves took 123 s (test-results.md:2518).

scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-15-W1-deg1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 timeout -k 30 180 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/package/test_wf15_study_lossy_sphere.py::test_wf15_imposed_field_is_mat4_wall_data_bitwise tests/package/test_wf15_study_lossy_sphere.py::test_wf15_study_default_degree_is_two tests/package/test_wf15_study_lossy_sphere.py::test_wf15_degree1_reproduces_mat4_record tests/package/test_wf15_study_lossy_sphere.py::test_wf15_preset_leg_reproduces_mat1_record -s -v --tb=short'" - Box-speed gate. If W1 exceeds 150 s, stop BLOCKED as a slow box before W2. On a ×1.4 box, W2's upper estimate (≈ 480 s) would pass its 590 s ceiling. - Orphan sweep before W2. W2 compiles the degree-2 forms cold. First pgrep -c python3 in the container must read 0, then: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-15-cache-sweep "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /root/.cache/fenics && for c in libffcx_*.c; do s=\${c%.c}; ls \$s.*.so >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo orphan \$s; rm -f \$s.c \$s.c.cached \$s.o; }; done; echo sweep done'" - W2, the default degree-2 leg. Heavy. Predicted ≈ 370 s, bracket 240–480 s; ≈ 15 GiB summed RSS per solve, ≤ 30 GiB if the first factorisation is still held. - Price source: IMP-1's degree-2 rungs in the same σ 0.57 / εᵣ 78 host at 64 MHz, -n 2, complex. 54 524 cells / 366 574 dofs took 101.8 s / 10.12 GiB; 90 713 cells / 604 884 dofs took 221.9 s / 19.43 GiB (20261001T033100Z_IMP-1-land-W1.log:445–446, 528–529). WF-15 step 4: Study.probe(probes, cooling) — MAT-19's ball-average probe through the API. Additive in src/fem_em_solver/study.py: Study.probe(probes: Sequence[ProbeBall], cooling: RobinCooling, *, levels=3) reuses self.temperature(cooling) (_study_temperature, study.py:748; it solves once if self.result is absent), forms θ = T − cooling.t_inf_c on the P1 submesh space (scatter_forward), and calls the public thermal.probe.ball_average (thermal/probe.py:168) per probe. No copy of the probe algorithm: one call path. - Executor: implementer. Tier: standard, -n 2 (W1) and -n 1 (W2), complex build. docs.title: §9 item 523 — 2026-10-18 (§10 U60, Study.probe on a thermal-only Study; chain step, solve)
docs.text:
Drafted by a read-only agent for the 2026-10-18 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Code read on d94320db; nothing was run.

Licence. §10 chain U, U60 (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4855–4860): "Study.probe on a thermal-only Study (the WF-13 design gap): point probes on the ball and box Studies reproduce MAT-19's virtual-probe record and the Robin series at the points within INTERIOR_BAND; the three helpers that raise raw exceptions raise StudyConfigError naming the field, with controls. Serial on U59 for the box half." The gap was read from source by the 2026-10-17 10:30 review (docs/planning/chunks/WF-13.md:699–707). Chain U's target applies. No band, tolerance, record, Done-when or target is set or moved. Owner: WF-15, which owns Study.probe (step 4, item 326, this file :358–404); this is WF-15 step 6 (step 5 is item 521a, docs/planning/chunks/WF-1.md "§9 item 521"). Templates: items 326, 330 and 507.

Findings at drafting (source only, not run). 1. Study.probe cannot reach a thermal-only temperature. _study_probe calls self.temperature(cooling) with no transient (src/fem_em_solver/study.py:1539). On a ThermalBallGeometry that dispatches to _study_transient_temperature (:1253–1254), which raises TypeError when transient is None (:1446–1447), before any mesh. The fix is a keyword pass-through, not a new algorithm: ball_average (thermal/probe.py:168–171) works on any P1 θ. 2. MAT-19's record cannot be reproduced to its digits on a ball Study. MAT-19's (T) 1.7315e-03 is a maximum over 3 probes × 40 times on MAT-12's EM-solved sphere-in-box tag-1 submesh, 19 496 cells (20261005T095808Z_MAT-19-step1-W1.log.gz:203; tests/validation/test_mat19_virtual_temperature_probe.py:83). A ThermalBallGeometry is a gmsh ball_domain (study.py:1343–1348), a different mesh, and Study.probe returns one reading per probe at the end time, not a series (ProbeStudyResult, :1509–1519). - What can be reproduced is MAT-19's gate: its exact Helmholtz ball-mean comparand _ball_mean (test_mat19_…py:117–127) and its band, at t* on the same physics (R, k, h, ρc, q_cf, probes). - Item 326 scoped exactly this out: "Not claimed: … MAT-19's (T) 1 % gate (it is on the q_cf transient, not reproduced here)" (this file, :392). This item closes that. - A time series through the Study (snapshots) is not posed. 3. The band name. MAT-19's band is P_BAND = 1e-2 (tests/validation/test_mat10_sar_to_heat_sphere.py:59, imported at test_mat19_…py:56). U60 says INTERIOR_BAND, which is also 1e-2 but is MAT-13's constant, the one MAT-21 uses. The drafter imports each half's own constant: P_BAND for the ball (MAT-19's gate) and INTERIOR_BAND for the box (MAT-21's). The values are equal and no band moves (question 2). 4. "Point probes" is read as probes centred at points. Study.probe is MAT-19's ball average (an owned-cell integral). Scalar point evaluation on the box is P37's (MAT-21 step 10, PROJECT_PLAN.md:4808–4816) and is not claimed. 5. The box comparand at a probe is exact. On the steady box with uniform q, ∇²θ = −Q/K, so θ + Q|x − c|²/(6K) is harmonic. The ball mean over B(c, a) is therefore θ̄ = θ_series(c) − Q a²/(10K) whenever the ball lies inside the box (mean of |x − c|² over the ball = 3a²/5). This is the identity MAT-19's _ball_mean steady term carries for the sphere (steady … − 3a²/5, test_mat19_…py:126). The truncated series obeys it to its truncation deficit, 4.6708e-6 (COMPARAND_FLOOR, tests/validation/test_mat21_box_fem_p2.py:83). 6. The three helpers (study.py:155–168) on a thermal-only Study, predicted: - omega → TypeError (2.0 * np.pi * None); - epsilon_c() → AttributeError (None.epsilon_r); - dirichlet_field() → AttributeError ('UniformHeatSource' object has no attribute 'dirichlet_field'). W0 observes them before any edit (item 507's pattern). 7. StudyConfigError lives in study_yaml.py (src/fem_em_solver/study_yaml.py:158–165, a ValueError subclass with (source, field, reason)), and study_yaml imports study at module level. So study.py can raise it only through a function-local import, which is cycle-safe at call time. Every sibling thermal-only refusal raises TypeError (:171–172, :533–537, :1446–1447), so the letter's StudyConfigError makes these three a ValueError among TypeErrors (question 1).

How the item handles U59 not having landed. The box half needs 521a's ThermalBoxGeometry and its steady branch, and nothing from 521b. - If item 521a is DONE when the slot starts: run everything below. - If it is not: write and run the helper and ball nodes only (N0, N1); do not write N2; register only those two. Mark item 523 "DONE (ball half + helpers); box half waits on 521a" in the same commit. The next review re-poses the box half as 523b from this text (N2, W2, its registry lines), attempt 1 of 4. - The helper guard keys on self.frequency_hz is None, which is true only on a thermal-only Study (the EM constructor refuses None, study.py:133–134). So it needs no ThermalBoxGeometry name and covers both geometries whichever lands first.

  • Executor: implementer. Tier: W0a–c smoke (-n 1, no mesh, real); W1 / W2 standard (real build, -n 2, as U60 says; the comparands are closed forms, so no complex-build record is read); re-gates in their own builds.
  • Class: chain step (solve). Cost: ≈ 18 measured / ≈ 45 predicted min = 15 fixed + ≈ 14 code + windows ≈ 7 (W0a–c 0.3, W1 1.2, W2 0.8, RG1 0.4, RG2 0.5, RG3 2.0, RG4 1.1, Wgen / Wval / Wapi / Wdoc 0.4) + ≈ 6 journal. Prices: item 326's W1 22 s / W2 26 s (20261008T201316Z_WF-15-s4-W1-n2.log.gz, …201344Z…W2-n1.log.gz), item 330's W0a 119 s, item 500's RG2 64 s. Park if W0 + code are not done by minute 25, or W1 has not started by minute 30.
  • Depends on: nothing for the ball half and helpers; item 521a for the box half. Family: WF-15 step 6, attempt 1 of 4.

The change (src/fem_em_solver/study.py only; insertions plus one disclosed signature change). - (P1) _study_probe(self, probes, cooling, *, levels=3, transient=None, duty=None). The two keywords have defaults, so every existing caller is unchanged. - transient is None and duty is None ⇒ the existing call self.temperature(cooling), character for character (the sphere path, item 326's records). - Otherwise ⇒ self.temperature(cooling, transient=transient, duty=duty). - The def line is the one existing line that changes (rule (c), disclosed). Everything after the temperature call is unchanged: θ = T − t_inf_c (:1541–1543) works on the ball mesh, where the TransientStudyResult's P1 temperature lives on the full mesh, and on 521a's box ThermalStudyResult. - (P2) _refuse_thermal_only_attr(study, field, method), after _refuse_thermal_only (:533–537). If study.frequency_hz is None, it runs from .study_yaml import StudyConfigError and raises StudyConfigError("<Study>", field, f"{method} is not defined on a thermal-only Study (no EM material / frequency / imposed field)"). It is called by its global name as the first statement of: - omega (field frequency_hz); - epsilon_c (field material); - dirichlet_field (field excitation). Three inserted lines plus the helper. - Never: edit ball_average, _study_temperature, _study_transient_temperature, the item 326 module or any MAT-19 module; change the behaviour of omega / epsilon_c / dirichlet_field on an EM Study.

Test module: new tests/package/test_wf15_study_probe_thermal.py (knob FEM_EM_WF15_S6=1 for N1 / N2; when it is set, assert not IS_COMPLEX and size 2). The first docstring paragraph backticks only WF-15, MAT-19, MAT-21. It is written whole after W0 and not edited after W1 (rule (i)). - Imports (module-level names; never a test_* name): - A_PROBE, CENTRES, DISPLACED, _q_cf, _ball_mean from tests/validation/test_mat19_virtual_temperature_probe.py:76–127; - R, K, H, T_INF, P_BAND, B_BAND, _allsum from tests/validation/test_mat10_sar_to_heat_sphere.py:51–61, :70; - RHO_C, T_STAR, N_MAIN from tests/validation/test_mat12_transient_sar_heating_sphere.py:68–71; - box: A_BOX, B_BOX, C_BOX, HALF, Q (test_mat21_box_closed_form.py), _steady_ex (test_mat21_box_fem.py:78–83), K_GEL, H_GEL, T_INF as T_INF_GEL (test_mat15_coil_driven_heating_phantom.py:82–84), INTERIOR_BAND (test_mat13_transient_perfusion_sphere.py:64); - IS_COMPLEX (tests/complex_mode.py:23). - Nodes: N0 test_wf15_s6_helpers_refuse (no mesh, both builds); N1 test_wf15_s6_ball_probe_reproduces_mat19_gate; N2 test_wf15_s6_box_probe_robin_series (only if 521a is DONE). - Registry (lines added under # WF-15 step 6 (§9 item 523)): N0 / N1 / N2 under [names.Study]; N1 under [names.ThermalBallGeometry] / [names.TransientSpec] / [names.UniformHeatSource] (tests/package/validation_envelope.toml:223–250); N2 under 521a's [names.ThermalBoxGeometry]. The §9 standing rule applies (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4058): Wgen / Wval / Wapi / Wdoc in the same slot, with the regenerated docs/guide/api/ and docs/guide/validation.md committed.

Anchors (asserted; bands imported by name). - (H) N0, the helpers, no mesh. On Study(ThermalBallGeometry(0.1, 0.005), None, UniformHeatSource(2000.0)), and on 521a's box Study if it exists: - omega, epsilon_c() and dirichlet_field() each raise StudyConfigError with .field equal to frequency_hz / material / excitation; - isinstance(exc, ValueError); - 0 build calls. - On the EM sphere Study (sphere_mat4.yaml's Python twin, no solve), omega float.hex-equals 2.0 * np.pi * f, and epsilon_c() equals the formula at :161–163 by hex. - (A-ball) N1, MAT-19's (P8) identity through the thermal-only Study. The whole-ball probe ProbeBall((0, 0, 0), 2.0 * R) reads |P_Ω − ∫θ dx / V_h| ≤ B_BAND·|∫θ dx / V_h| and |V_Ω,h / V_h − 1| ≤ B_BAND, with ∫ via _allsum and np.real. Item 326 read 6.040e-16 / 1.221e-15 on the EM submesh (20261008T201316Z_WF-15-s4-W1-n2.log.gz). - (T*-ball) N1, MAT-19's gate at t*. - The fixture: Study(ThermalBallGeometry(R, 1.0e-3), None, UniformHeatSource(_q_cf())).probe(PROBES, RobinCooling(K, H, T_INF), transient=TransientSpec(T_STAR / N_MAIN, N_MAIN, RHO_C)). That is CN with Rannacher, MAT-12's schedule, at h ≈ MAT-12's h_in = 1 mm (A_PROBE = 2 h_in, test_mat19_…py:76). - Asserted: |P_j / _ball_mean(|c_j|, A_PROBE, T_STAR, q_cf) − 1| ≤ P_BAND for the three CENTRES. - Predicted ≤ 3e-3: MAT-19's maximum over all 40 times on its own mesh was 1.7315e-03 (…MAT-19-step1-W1.log.gz:203), printed beside, never compared. - Printed: the ball's global cell count, the probe volumes against 4πa³/3, and max_imag_ratio. - (R-box) N2, the Robin series at the probe centres. - The fixture: 521a's m = 4 steady box Study, Study(ThermalBoxGeometry(HALF, (52, 32, 8)), None, UniformHeatSource(Q)).probe(BOX_PROBES, RobinCooling(K_GEL, H_GEL, T_INF_GEL)). - BOX_PROBES: radius a = 0.0135 m (2 h_eff at m = 4, MAT-19's 2h rule; h_eff 6.750514e-03, 20261013T142646Z_MAT-21-step1r-W1-steady.log:102), at c₀ = (0, 0, 0), (0, ±0.5 B, 0) and (±0.5 A, 0, 0). Each ball lies inside the 0.9-interior box (a ≤ 0.9 C − |z| = 0.0405 m), asserted first as (M). - Asserted: |P_j / (θ_series(c_j) − Q a²/(10 K)) − 1| ≤ INTERIOR_BAND for all five, where θ_series is _steady_ex() evaluated at the point. Predicted ≤ 5e-3: the m = 4 whole-box L2 is 3.459853e-03 (…step1r-W1-steady.log:102). - (A-box): ProbeBall((0, 0, 0), 0.4) (beyond the half-diagonal, 0.3896 m) reads ∫θ/V_h at B_BAND. - Printed only: the four mirror-pair differences (create_box's tetrahedral split is not mirror-symmetric).

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (c-disp) The displaced ball probe — predicted, asserted only as a miss. DISPLACED (1 mm radially inward of c₂, test_mat19_…py:82) read against c₂'s nominal comparand at t* gives > P_BAND. Predicted ≈ 5.4e-2: MAT-19 read 5.421e-02 at n = 40 on its own mesh (…MAT-19-step1-W1.log.gz:209). The separation is set by the comparand itself, θ̄(5.5 mm) against θ̄(6.5 mm), computed in numpy and printed beside it. Different mesh, so the factor is predicted; ≈ 5× the band. - (c-wall) The wrong wall on the box — predicted, asserted only as a miss. The same probes on RobinCooling(K_GEL, 2.0 * H_GEL, T_INF_GEL) against the right-h comparand at c₀ give > INTERIOR_BAND. Predicted ≈ 0.35 (range 0.30–0.42), from the slab estimate θ(0) ≈ qC/h + qC²/(2k), 12.4 → 7.9 K, and 521a's (c-wall) interior reading if it has landed (cite its log line). - (c-mv) The mean-value correction, printed only. The point value θ_series(c₀) against the ball mean differs by Q a²/(10K) = 0.0608 K on θ ≈ 12.0 K (≈ 0.5 %, under the band). It is shown so that nobody mistakes a point comparand for a passing ball one. - (c-guard) The helper guard removed — asserted, backed by W0. Inside monkeypatch.context(), study_mod._refuse_thermal_only_attr is set to lambda *a, **k: None. Then each helper raises exactly the exception type and message fragment that W0a–c logged (item 507's control). If W0 shows a different type, the control asserts the observed one (the module is written after W0). - (c-pass) By construction: probe(PROBES, cooling) on the ball Study with no transient still raises TypeError (:1446–1447, unchanged). That is the pre-change behaviour, and it shows the pass-through is what reaches the solver.

Windows (foreground; Bash timeout: 660000; pytest -s; node IDs, never -k; the harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, repo-relative, nothing chained or piped; pgrep = docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 reads 0 before W1 and RG3). Order: W0a, W0b, W0c (before any edit), code, W1, W2, RG1, RG2, RG3, RG4, Wgen, Wval, Wapi, Wdoc. - W0a / W0b / W0c — observe, before any edit, asserting nothing. The -c program contains no single quote (item 480's trap); escaped double quotes only. A traceback with status 1 is the observation, not a red. scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-15-s6-W0a-observe-omega "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src timeout -k 10 60 python3 -c \"import fem_em_solver as f; s = f.Study(f.ThermalBallGeometry(0.1, 0.005), None, f.UniformHeatSource(2000.0)); print(s.omega)\"'" W0b (label WF-15-s6-W0b-observe-epsilon-c) is the same with print(s.epsilon_c()); W0c (label WF-15-s6-W0c-observe-dirichlet) with print(s.dirichlet_field()). - Dispositions: a raw exception ⇒ the reading holds, go on. Status 0 (a helper returned a value) ⇒ record the printed value, drop that helper from (H) and its control, and say so. Status 124 ⇒ pgrep first, then stop. - W1 (real, -n 2; N0 + N1; predicted 30–70 s: a ≈ 25k-cell ball, CN N = 40 at under 1 s per step, ball_average 0.1 s, item 326's start-up): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-15-s6-W1-ball "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_WF15_S6=1 timeout -k 30 180 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/package/test_wf15_study_probe_thermal.py::test_wf15_s6_helpers_refuse tests/package/test_wf15_study_probe_thermal.py::test_wf15_s6_ball_probe_reproduces_mat19_gate -s -v --tb=short'" - W2 (real, -n 2; N2, only if 521a is DONE; predicted 25–50 s: the m = 4 box steady in 0.6 s, …step1r-W1-steady.log:100, plus five probes and the wrong-wall solve): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-15-s6-W2-box "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_WF15_S6=1 timeout -k 30 180 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/package/test_wf15_study_probe_thermal.py::test_wf15_s6_box_probe_robin_series -s -v --tb=short'" - RG1 / RG2 (complex; rule (c): P1 changes _study_probe's signature, the sphere path). Item 326's W1 and W2 verbatim (20261008T201316Z_WF-15-s4-W1-n2.log.gz:12, 22 s; 20261008T201344Z_WF-15-s4-W2-n1.log.gz:12, 26 s), labels WF-15-s6-RG1-probe-n2 / -RG2-probe-n1, in that order. RG1 rewrites logs/wf15/probe-n2.npz with the new study.py hash, and RG2 reads it; this is the module's own hash guard. Predicted equal to item 326's readings ((A) ≤ 1e-14, (W) ≤ 1e-10, (c1) 7.5333e-03). - RG3 (complex; P2 sits on every EM Study's dirichlet_field / epsilon_c): item 330's W0a verbatim (20261008T213439Z_WF-15-s3-W0a-wf15.log.gz:12, 119 s), label WF-15-s6-RG3-wf15. test_wf15_imposed_field_is_mat4_wall_data_bitwise is the bitwise check on dirichlet_field. - RG4 (complex; omega on the port / tune path, study.py:1100): item 500's RG2 verbatim (20261017T003710Z_WF-1-s14-RG2.log:12, 64 s), label WF-15-s6-RG4-tune. - Wgen / Wval / Wapi / Wdoc: item 500's four commands verbatim (20261017T004807Z … 004837Z_WF-1-s14-W*.log:12), labels WF-15-s6-W*. - Not re-run (disclosed): item 330's transient legs and item 500's YAML legs (neither calls probe or the helpers); 521a's windows (the box half only reads 521a's API).

Traps already paid for. - MAT-19's: the probe is an owned-cell integral, with no point owner. Every rank enters the one allreduce (item 227's deadlock). Ghost values are needed; ghost cells are never summed. Centres are plain floats (POST-8 3a). Use θ, not T (item 258). - The thermal degree is 1 (RobinCooling.degree), never Study.degree. - The real build here; the re-gates in complex. Never float.hex across builds; (H)'s hex checks are within one process. - The function-local import of StudyConfigError must stay inside the helper. A module-level from .study_yaml import … in study.py is an import cycle (study_yaml.py imports study at load). - The control patches fem_em_solver.study._refuse_thermal_only_attr, so the three call sites must look the name up globally (item 507's trap). - The -c quoting (W0): no single quote inside bash -lc '…'. - Never -k; no pipe; never background a window. Status 124 is not a result; after a kill run pgrep first, then the rubric's cache sweep as WF-15-s6-cache-sweep.

Scope. Covered: Study.probe on a thermal-only ball Study at t* (transient pass-through) against MAT-19's exact ball-mean comparand at P_BAND, and on 521a's steady box Study against the Robin triple series' exact ball mean at INTERIOR_BAND; the whole-domain probe identity at B_BAND on both; three helpers refusing with StudyConfigError; real build, -n 2. Not claimed: - MAT-19's 1.7315e-03 or its 40-time series (a different mesh, and no series in the Study); - probes on the duty-cycled or transient box (no exact ball mean is posed there); - scalar point evaluation (P37); - probes from YAML on thermal-only files (outputs.probes stays refused on thermal_ball, study_yaml.py:845); - Note 2026-10-19: resolved by WF-1 steps 17 (§9 item 539, box) and 19 (§9 item 545, ball): outputs.probes is admitted on both thermal-only families (refused beside a ball's geometry.wall), and U60's ball readings reproduce through a tracked file (20261019T110412Z_WF-1-s19-W1-ball-probes.log). - the installed console script; - a real probe's volume or self-heating; - any compliance statement.

Negative result. Report and stop. Park on attempt/WF-15-step6-<UTC>, mark item 523 BLOCKED (rule (d)) in the same commit, and journal it. - (A-ball) / (A-box) red: the probe does not see the Study's mesh as MAT-19 does. Stop; open a known-issues entry. - (T*-ball) red with (A-ball) green: the ball Study's CN at 1 mm misses MAT-19's comparand at t*. Print the three ratios, the cell count and MAT-19's t* rows. That is a finding about the gmsh ball against the EM submesh; the band is unmoved. - (R-box) red: print each point's ratio beside the m = 4 whole-box L2. A red at the ±x points alone suggests the probe is sampling the mesh (P10's trap); report it, and never shrink a in-slot. - RG1 / RG2 not reproducing item 326's readings: P1 changed the sphere path. Revert. - RG3 / RG4 red: P2 changed an EM path. Revert. - W0 showing no raw exception for a helper: drop that helper, as the W0 dispositions say. That is not a red.

docs.text:
• The red is the brief's own named negative, so its unblock is the weekly's ("the weekly re-poses the band"). This is a finding for the review / record-reconciler under the (1*) licence. The band never moves in-slot. - (I) red with (U) green: the in-process solve floor exceeds 1e-9 on this fixture. That is a finding for known-issues.md:80's exposure census. Stop. - (T1) red with (R) green: a writer or reader layout defect on a 4×4. Stop; it is PORT-7's module's business. - (G) red: PORT-11's identities fail through the Study but not through the direct call. This is a real finding. Revert (3); BLOCKED. - The box-speed gate fails, or W2 is killed at 590 s: BLOCKED without a result. The review re-poses.

docs.title: §9 item 259 — 2026-10-05 (chain U9, daily provisional)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-05 18:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §9 rule (6) (PROJECT_PLAN.md:3707–3717). This is a provisional next step of live chain U, toward the chain's own validation target ("each step reproduces a gated result within its unmoved band", :4649–4651) and Phase 9 subgoal (9a)'s "solve (frequency / sweep …) and results (S / Z / Touchstone …)". It is step 1's own hypothesis for next (attempts.md:2535). No band, tolerance, Done-when or validation target moves. Every band is imported by name; none is set here. Depends on nothing (item 244 is on main).

WF-16 step 2: the frequency sweep through the Study. One Study(FourPortBirdcageGeometry.f_small(), phantom, LumpedPortDrive(), frequency_hz=FREQUENCY_64_HZ[, degree=1]) is constructed once. It is solved at 10, 64 and 128 MHz on one mesh and returns one PortStudyResult per frequency plus one multi-frequency .s4p. Each frequency's S, in memory and as parsed back from the file, equals item 192's registered exact-rectangle record at that frequency within LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND, at the record's own degree and width. PORT-11's gates are imported per frequency. - Executor: implementer. Additive src/ change in study.py only, one new test module, and one registry edit. No existing gate module, helper, record, test or src/ line is edited. - Tier: W0 standard. W1 heavy by ceiling (-n 2, container 400 s). W2 heavy (-n 8, 590 s). W3 / W4 standard. Complex build for W0–W2. - Class: chain step (solve). Measured median ≈ 9 min (the 18:00 review's restock figure). Package steps have only one measurement so far (step 1, ≈ 10 min of windows). - Cost: ≈ 50 predicted min. That is 15 fixed + ≈ 18 code + windows ≈ 2.0 + 3.3 + 0.2 + 5.1–6.3 + 0.1 + 0.6 ≈ 12 min + ≈ 5 spare. If W1 is not green by minute 35, park (rule (d)).

API decision (the executor may rename; the shape is fixed by the constraints). - (S1) A new method, Study.solve_sweep(frequencies_hz, comm=MPI.COMM_WORLD). It returns a new PortStudySweepResult. Alternatives rejected: - Making frequency_hz accept a sequence edits an existing __init__ line (self.frequency_hz = float(frequency_hz)) and breaks Study.omega / epsilon_c for the sphere family. - A constructor frequencies_hz= keyword forces frequency_hz to become optional, another signature edit. - A sweep list on LumpedPortDrive splits frequency between two objects. - The method mirrors the HFSS "setup + frequency sweep" split: frequency_hz stays the Study's solution frequency for solve(), and the sweep list is the sweep. Nothing in Study.__init__, Study.solve, _study_solve_ports, FourPortBirdcageGeometry, LumpedPortDrive or PortStudyResult changes. - (S2) What solve_sweep does. - Validation: refuse a non-port Study (TypeError, as mean_sar does for the converse). Refuse an empty, non-finite, non-positive, or not strictly increasing list (ValueError, not a silent sort, because export_touchstone needs non-decreasing frequencies, ports/touchstone.py:65, and result order must equal input order). - geometry.build(comm) is called once. The specs and port definitions are built once with LumpedPortDrive.specs_and_definitions. - Then, per frequency f: - a fresh TimeHarmonicProblem with the same lines as _study_solve_ports (study.py:434–447), with frequency_hz=f and phantom_material=dataclasses.replace(self.material, frequency_hz=f); - run_n_port_sparameter_sweep(..., degree=self.degree), called exactly as study.py:451–457 calls it; - one PortStudyResult. - The problem lines are copied, not factored out of _study_solve_ports. A shared helper would edit the scalar path and oblige step 1's degree-2 W2 (268 s) to re-run, which this slot cannot hold. - self.frequency_hz, self.material and self.result are left untouched. The result is also stored as self.sweep_result. - Constant-property gel across the sweep: σ, εᵣ and μᵣ are copied, and only the frequency tag changes. This is what item 192's records solved: material_map HomogeneousMaterial(0.5, 78) at every frequency (leg_offset_sweep.py:357–371). The docstring says there is no dispersion model. - (S3) PortStudySweepResult (dataclass): - fields: frequencies_hz (tuple), results (list of PortStudyResult, all sharing one mesh), mesh_time, sweep_times, comm; - property s_matrices (an (F, 4, 4) complex128 array); - method .write_touchstone(path). It calls export_touchstone([r.sweep for r in results], results[0].port_definitions, output_path=path, write_csv_companion=False) on rank 0 only, then Barrier, and returns the path on every rank (the PortStudyResult.write_touchstone pattern, study.py:405–421). export_touchstone already writes N sweeps row-major per block (:183–186) and load_touchstone already reads them, so no ports/ edit is needed. - Not exported, as PortStudyResult was not. __init__.py and public_surface.txt are therefore unchanged. If the executor finds that a new top-level name is needed, it follows item 244's Code (4) verbatim. - (S4) Allowed diff: git diff src/fem_em_solver/study.py shows insertions only, plus at most the module __all__ line. W1 runs step 1's module unedited in the same process to show that the scalar path is unchanged.

Settled from the code (read before designing). - Record keys, all present. - ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_S_P1_RECORDS (degree 1, -n 2) has "10", "64", "128" (tests/validation/test_ans4_exact_strip_records.py:141–226). - ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_S_P2_X1 (degree 2, -n 8) has "10", "64", "128" (:233–318). - Frequency map: import FREQUENCIES (:135, {"10": FREQUENCY_HZ, "64": FREQUENCY_64_HZ, "128": FREQUENCY_128_HZ}) and iterate it in that order. Do not restate the values. - The comment at :229–232 ("printed comparand only, never asserted") went stale with item 244, and this item asserts P2_X1 at 10 / 128 MHz too. Do not edit that module: a comment edit re-opens its windows under rule (i). The review owns the comment. - Backing for 1e-9 per frequency. - Degree 1, -n 2: 6.601e-11 / 9.557e-11 / 9.449e-11 at 10 / 64 / 128 MHz, the same comparison in two separate processes (20261004T093239Z_ANS-4-item212-W0-p1-unset.log:2169/2172/2176 = 20261004T183107Z_ANS-4-item225-W0-p1-unset.log:2169/2172/2176). - Degree 2, -n 8: 64 MHz is 8.178e-11 (20261005T203015Z_WF-16-W2-deg2.log, step 1). 10 and 128 MHz have never been reproduced across processes, so their backing is the step-1 reasoning: .9e print rounding ≤ 5e-10 plus the cross-process spread 8.912e-13 gives ≤ 5.01e-10. - The records' own procedure is mesh once, then three sweeps on it: item 192 built the base rung at 10 MHz and reused its mesh for 64 / 128 (test_ans4_exact_strip_records.py:442–457, _reuse_of). The Study sweep does the same in a different order. Each frequency is an independent factorisation, so order does not enter. - The phantom-frequency check is abs(phantom.frequency_hz − problem.frequency_hz) > 1e-9 raises (core/time_harmonic.py:472–474). dataclasses.replace makes them equal exactly. GelledSalinePhantomMaterial is frozen (materials/phantom.py:21). Do not use with_frequency_adjustment (:74): it computes σ·ratio**0.0, which is equal by IEEE but is a different code path to justify. - Touchstone (step 1's notes still hold): - the file has a generated_utc line, so compare numbers, never bytes; - .12e pairs and .9e frequencies; - a ! frequency_points_hz: header (touchstone.py:179); - load_touchstone (:204) returns (freqs, mats, ports) with mats shaped (F, N, N); - skrf.Network(path) gives .f of length F and .s of shape (F, 4, 4). - Gate readings to expect (printed and compared by eye, never asserted as values): - Degree 1, -n 2 (…item225-W0…:2156/2160/2165): - reciprocity 4.593e-15 / 4.509e-16 / 5.003e-16; - σ_max 0.999993740606 / 0.999760093664 / 0.999136167640; - spreads 0.0818/0.0397/0.0433, 0.0747/0.0691/0.0897, 0.0816/0.1048/0.1669 %; - separation 113.78× / 451.71× / 351.38×. - Degree 2, -n 8 (…item192-W3-p2.log:2254/2264/2270): - reciprocity 1.246e-14 / 2.662e-15 / 2.584e-15; - σ_max 0.999995411581 / 0.999819887372 / 0.999307666284; - spreads 0.0888/0.0388/0.0507, 0.0333/0.0338/0.0441, 0.0213/0.0344/0.0352 %; - separation 107.95× / 957.45× / 1716.14×.

Code. - (1) src/fem_em_solver/study.py: insert PortStudySweepResult and _study_solve_sweep, attached as Study.solve_sweep = _study_solve_sweep (the Study._solve_ports pattern, :482). Optionally add "PortStudySweepResult" to the module __all__. - (2) tests/package/validation_envelope.toml: append the new sweep node IDs to [names.Study] (:151–159), [names.FourPortBirdcageGeometry] and [names.LumpedPortDrive]. Node IDs only (WF-14 (N)). No snapshot change. - (3) New tests/package/test_wf16_study_sweep.py. - @complex_only on every solve node. - It reuses step 1's knob FEM_EM_WF16_DEGREE, so W1 is step 1's W1 command plus one path. Import _degree, needs_degree, DEGREE2_RECORD_WIDTH, _rel, _p0 and OUT_DIR from tests/package/test_wf16_study_four_port.py. Never import its leg fixture, which would re-solve. - Width guard, asserted (not skipped): degree 1 requires -n 2 (ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_RECORD_RANK_WIDTH) and degree 2 requires -n 8. - Module fixture sweep_leg: - build the Study at FREQUENCY_64_HZ with phantom GelledSalinePhantomMaterial(SALINE_SIGMA, SALINE_EPSILON_R, FREQUENCY_64_HZ). Pass degree=1 only for degree 1; degree 2 is the default. - sw = study.solve_sweep(tuple(FREQUENCIES.values()), comm); - write OUT_DIR / f"wf16_sweep_f_small_p{d}_n{size}.s4p"; - print mesh, per-frequency sweep and Touchstone seconds; - report_peak_rss. - Nodes: - test_wf16_sweep_api_and_refusals (no solve); - test_wf16_sweep_one_mesh_per_frequency_problems; - test_wf16_sweep_s_equals_records; - test_wf16_sweep_touchstone_equals_records; - test_wf16_sweep_port11_gates.

Anchors (asserted; all bands imported). - (K′) API pins and refusals, structural (no solve). - inspect.signature(Study.__init__) has exactly the parameters (self, geometry, material, excitation, frequency_hz, degree, density_kg_m3) with defaults 2 and 1000.0. This is a pin that the scalar constructor is untouched. - solve_sweep on an F-small Study raises ValueError for each of (), (FREQUENCY_128_HZ, FREQUENCY_HZ), (FREQUENCY_64_HZ, FREQUENCY_64_HZ), (0.0,) and (float("nan"),), before any mesh is built. - On a SphereInBoxGeometry Study it raises TypeError. - The retagged phantom at each f has σ, εᵣ, μᵣ == the input and frequency_hz == f. - All exact. - (F′) One mesh, the SPEC rectangle. - all(r.mesh is sw.results[0].mesh), and the geometry is built once (one mesh_time). - Cells / ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_CELL_RECORD within CELL_COUNT_BAND. - Per port, step 1's (F) clauses on results[0].sheets against SPEC_* within STRIP_BAND. Same imports as step 1. - (U′) Per-frequency problems. - r.problem.frequency_hz == f and r.sweep.frequency_hz == f, exactly. - r.problem.phantom_material == dataclasses.replace(phantom, frequency_hz=f). - Every spec and port definition is field-equal (==) to frequency 0's. - r.sweep.is_placeholder is False. - DG0 σ / εᵣ / μᵣ built from each frequency's problem against the 64 MHz entry's read max |Δ| == 0.0 on owned dofs (_dg0_owned_diff, as step 1). Step 1's (c3) already showed that this comparator resolves 2⁻⁵³, so it is not re-planted here. - After the sweep: study.frequency_hz == FREQUENCY_64_HZ, study.material is phantom, and study.result is None. The scalar state is not mutated. - (R′) S equals the record, per frequency. For each key k in FREQUENCIES, ‖S_k − rec[k]‖_F / ‖rec[k]‖_F ≤ LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND, where rec is P1 (degree 1, -n 2) or P2_X1 (degree 2, -n 8). - Predicted, degree 1: 6.601e-11 / 9.557e-11 / 9.449e-11, digit-identical to the three prior processes. - Predicted, degree 2: ≈ 8.2e-11 at 64 MHz, and 1e-11 … 3e-10 at 10 / 128 MHz. - Asserted. The degree-2 10 / 128 MHz legs are asserted on reasoned backing (first measurement). The review should note that P2_X1["10"] / ["128"] become asserted comparands here. - (T′) One multi-frequency Touchstone. - (T1′) load_touchstone and skrf.Network: - three frequency points, each within FREQ_ATOL_HZ of FREQUENCIES[k], in order; - nports 4, ports P1–P4, z0 50; - each block against the in-memory sw.s_matrices[i] at max |ΔS| ≤ ANCHOR_TOL. Predicted ≈ 6e-14 (step 1: 6.873e-14 / 5.716e-14). - (T2′) Each loaded block against rec[k] ≤ LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND. Predicted equal to (R′) to three digits. - (G′) PORT-11's gates per frequency, on each result's own S and Z: - (i) RECIPROCITY_BAND; - (ii) PASSIVITY_SIGMA_TOLERANCE on σ_max and on every column power; - (iii′) ADJACENT_SPREAD_BAND and POOLED_SEPARATION_FLOOR, with _circulant_classes / _class_spread. - Imported exactly as step 1 imports them (test_wf16_study_four_port.py:73–89). Expected readings are listed above.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (c4) Frequency confusion matrix, asserted. Compare every loaded block i against every record key j with the (T2′) comparator. The diagonal is ≤ band (that is (T2′)); every off-diagonal entry must exceed LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND. - Hand arithmetic on the registered records (pure Python from :141–318), ‖rec_i − rec_j‖/‖rec_j‖:

| rows i → columns j | `P1` | `P2_X1` |
|---|---|---|
| 10 → 64 / 128 | 0.8103 / 1.2367 | 0.8395 / 1.2592 |
| 64 → 10 / 128 | 0.8120 / 0.5524 | 0.8515 / 0.5594 |
| 128 → 10 / 64 | 1.2763 / 0.5689 | 1.3138 / 0.5755 |
  • Minimum 0.5524, ≈ 5.5e8× the band. The in-test matrix is printed first and must reproduce these to two digits; otherwise the comparator is mis-wired: stop.
  • This is the control a frequency-blind sweep (every point solved at self.frequency_hz) fails, and it is also what (R′) at 10 / 128 MHz would read in that case.
  • (c5) Planted block swap in the parsed file, asserted. Swap the loaded 10 MHz and 128 MHz blocks, keeping the frequency labels, and re-run (T2′):
  • the 10 / 128 MHz entries must exceed the band (predicted 1.2367 / 1.2763 for P1, 1.2592 / 1.3138 for P2_X1);
  • the 64 MHz entry stays ≤ band.
  • It is a deterministic function of the records, computed in-test and printed before it is asserted. The review may relabel it as predicted.
  • (c6) Resolution of the band, asserted by construction. Add δ = 3·LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND·‖rec["64"]‖_F to entry (0, 1) of the loaded 64 MHz block. (T2′)'s comparator must then read > band.
  • Backing: the triangle inequality, ≥ 3e-9 − (T2′ reading) > 2e-9.
  • Predicted 3.0e-9 ± 1e-10.
  • Ceiling: this shows that the band is resolved at 3× above it, so the comparator is not saturated by the .12e round trip (≤ 5e-13).
  • (c1′) Cross-degree record per frequency, asserted. S_k against the other degree's rec[k] must exceed the band. Predicted 0.0102 / 0.0491 / 0.0555 (degree 1) and 0.0102 / 0.0495 / 0.0559 (degree 2). The 64 MHz pair reproduces step 1's (c1). The smallest, 0.0102 at 10 MHz, is ≈ 1.0e7× the band.

Printed (not asserted). Mesh seconds, per-frequency sweep seconds, Touchstone seconds, summed peak ru_maxrss (report_peak_rss), and the derived bound ‖S_sweep,64 − S_scalar,64‖ ≤ (R′₆₄ + step 1's (R) in the same W1 process). Windows. Foreground. The harness call is the whole Bash command, bare and repo-relative (bash_guard rule 3). Bash timeout: 660000; -s; tests/environment first; never -k; no pipe or redirect. Traps already paid for (step 1's list holds verbatim; the new ones come first). - Never use the scalar path for a sweep. Calling solve() three times with a mutated self.frequency_hz rebuilds the mesh three times (+54 s at degree 2) and leaves the Study's state changed. Scope. - Covered: item 192's F-small ×1 fixture (117 206 cells), exact SPEC rectangles, κ off, σ = 800 S/m conductor, saline 0.5 / 78. Three frequencies (10 / 64 / 128 MHz) on one mesh through one Study. Degree 1 at -n 2 and degree 2 (default) at -n 8. Stop. - (c4), (c5), (c6) or (c1′) at or under the band, or (c4) not reproducing the table to two digits: the comparator is blind or mis-wired. Stop. - W1 red on a step-1 node: the edit broke the scalar path. Revert (1); BLOCKED. - W0 red: revert (1); BLOCKED. - W3 red: a registry omission. Fix it (in-letter) and re-run W3. - W4 red: revert (1); BLOCKED. - The box-speed gate fails, or W2 is killed at 590 s: BLOCKED without a result. Radius from averaging_ball_radius(mass_kg=mass_g/1000, rho=self.density_kg_m3) (sar.py:214). ρ is a build_density_field (sar.py:147) at density_kg_m3 on the phantom tag and 0.0 on every other tag of the MPI-reduced tag set. Test: new tests/package/test_wf16_study_sar.py. Reuse step 1's knob FEM_EM_WF16_DEGREE and import _degree, needs_degree, DEGREE2_RECORD_WIDTH, _record, _rel, _p0 from tests/package/test_wf16_study_four_port.py:92–124. Anchors (asserted; bands imported). - (R) Same fixture. fields_result.s_matrix against _record(degree) at LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND, the step-1 comparator. Predicted: 9.56e-11 (degree 1), ≈ 8.2e-11 (degree 2). This proves that keeping fields did not move the solve. - (i) Whole-phantom coverage identity. For drive P1, Study.sar(radius_m=WHOLE_PHANTOM_BALL_RADIUS_M, centres=[(0,0,0)], drives=["P1"]) power and mass against post.sar.mean_sar (sar.py:57) over the phantom tag on the same kept field, and mass against ρ·V_phantom, each ≤ EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL. The four cyclic pairs |SAR(c_{k+1}; k+1) − SAR(c_k; k)| / SAR(c_k; k) ≤ C4_COVARIANCE_BAND (5 %, the band MAT-4 step 4 imports). Predicted range [0.05 %, 7 %]; it straddles the band, so read the trap below. - (iii) API = operator. Drive P1 at c_0: the Study.sar dict equals a direct mass_averaged_sar call on fields_result.fields["P1"] with the same ρ and radius, at relative difference ≤ EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL. Predicted 0.0. - (iv) Containment. CENTRE_RADIUS_M + a_10g < phantom_radius and WHOLE_PHANTOM_BALL_RADIUS_M lies between the phantom circumradius and the nearest conductor, both on study.geometry's fields. - 9 operator calls in total: 4 diagonal, 4 controls and 1 whole ball (MAT-4 made 21; its off-diagonal 4×4 and its 1 g column are not needed for this identity).

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (c1) Mis-paired far-side ball, SAR(c_{k+2}; k) against SAR(c_k; k). Sign asserted > C4_COVARIANCE_BAND at every k. Printed, never asserted. The 4 × 1 diagonal and the 10 g maximum over the evaluated centres, labelled "max over 4 evaluated centres at 1 V drive, NOT a spatial search, NOT a C95.3 compliance figure". Also the kernel mass against ρ·4/3·π·a³ (predicted ≤ 0.3 %, as MAT-4's 10 g row), the global phantom cell count, and a_10g / h_phantom.

Traps already paid for. - The binding risk is resolution. FourPortBirdcageGeometry passes no phantom_resolution (study.py:247–267), so the phantom is meshed at resolution = 0.015 m. The executor confirms this from the printed phantom cell count; the generator default is io/mesh.py:3996. Then a_10g / h ≈ 0.89, which is MAT-4 step 4's 1 g ratio (6.2 / 7.5 = 0.83), and that column read 0.41–6.84 % (…MAT-4-step4.log:1944–1947). At a / h = 1.78 the 10 g column read 0.06–0.33 %. Degree 2 should help, but the mesh is not C4-symmetric (c4_congruent_sheets=False, study.py:263), and that is the step-3h mechanism. Do not add a phantom_resolution field to make (ii) pass: that changes the fixture away from item 192 and is the review's call. - Pin quadrature_degree. An unpinned SpatialCoordinate integral can compile for > 9 min (POST-5). The ball is a UFL conditional, so compare squares and never sqrt (WF-6 4c). - The degree-2 N1curl form at quadrature degree 16 is a new JIT compile in W2. If it is killed, run pgrep -c python3 (expect 0) and then the orphan-stem sweep (rubric item 4) before any re-run. - cell_tags.values is rank-local: build ρ's tag map from global_cell_tag_set, as MAT-4 does (:254–260). - Phantom frequency: GelledSalinePhantomMaterial(SALINE_SIGMA, SALINE_EPSILON_R, FREQUENCY_64_HZ), as in step 1. Record the four pairs on the row, add a known-issues entry ("10 g C4 on the 0.015 m phantom"), and leave it for the review's ruling on a phantom_resolution field. WF-16 step 5: Study.b1_plus(). WF-6's gated |B₁⁺| C4 covariance identity runs through the API on item 192's fixture at 64 MHz. That is one base copy plus three rotated copies (+90° / −90° / 180°): the "four-copy" set WF-6 step 1d / 2b asserted at CG1. The band is the imported C4_COVARIANCE_BAND (5 %, tests/validation/test_birdcage_b1_plus_map.py:120; its provenance note is at :104–119). - Executor: implementer. Same tiers and windows as item 321 (W0 / W1 -n 2 degree 1 / W2 -n 8 degree 2 / W3 API). Cost: one cached field solve, plus a CG1 projection and parallel point evaluation per drive. WF-6 step 2b evaluated 51 points per drive. Predicted ≈ 10 min of windows, ≈ 45 predicted min. Measured: item 321's windows, once they land.

API. Study.b1_plus(*, drives=None, comm=...) reuses fields_result (item 321 (A1)) and returns {port_id: CG1 Function of B₁⁺}. It builds magnetic_flux_density_from_e(e, ω) → project_to_cg1 (post/faraday.py:69) → b1_plus (post/faraday.py:300), which is the gated CG1 estimator of step 1d, never the DG0 curl (DG0 is printed-only, :113–118). Port Study only (TypeError otherwise). The executor confirms the order of project_to_cg1 and b1_plus from test_birdcage_b1_plus_map.py:739–790, the CG1 path, before coding. W3 as in 321 (API reference + envelope).

Anchors (asserted). - (B1) C4 covariance. On phantom tag-3 centroids inside WF-6's sample cylinder (import _sample_points (test_birdcage_b1_plus_map.py:246, it takes a sweep dict, and reads only "mesh" and "cell_tags" (:253, :258), so pass those two from fields_result; it filters on PHANTOM_CELL_TAG, which must equal the Study's phantom_tag = 3 (study.py:215), asserted) and _rotate_z (:283); never restate the radii), the rotation angles are read off the sheets' azimuths. For each of P2@+Δ, P4@−Δ and P3@2Δ against P1, the ‖·‖₂ mismatch is ≤ C4_COVARIANCE_BAND. Evaluate through evaluate_vector_field_parallel only. Predicted 1.5–3 %: WF-6 step 2b at 64 MHz on the ragged fixture read 2.2187 / 2.1667 / 1.9574 % (20260831T140418Z_WF-6-step2b.log:4800–4802), and degree 2 on exact sheets is not predicted to be worse. - (B2) API = package. The P1 map from Study.b1_plus equals the hand-built chain on the same kept field, max |Δ| / max |B₁⁺| ≤ EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL (test_birdcage_sar_mass_averaged.py:163). Predicted 0.0. - (B3) Valid-point floor. Every sample point is valid on all four drives (step 2b read 51 of 51). The count is printed, and asserted to be the full set.

Negative control (rule (e)). Mis-rotation: P2 read at the counter-rotated points (−Δ) against P1. Sign asserted > C4_COVARIANCE_BAND, as test_the_cg1_estimator_still_resolves_the_drive_azimuth (:778–791) does. Size predicted from step 2's 95.20 % control (20260831T033704Z_WF-6-step2.log): 80–100 %, with the ceiling set by the ratio of two non-negative maps.

Printed, never asserted. |B₁⁺| at the phantom centre per drive at 1 V (a record, not homogeneity, not absolute), and the WF-6 step-5 four-copy spread statistic if it can be imported without a re-solve. Step 5 read 5.2506 % at h = 0.015 on the unloaded fixture. It is not the gate here, and the brief does not gate it.

Traps. Never f.eval(points, np.arange(n)). Do not use the DG0 curl. The rest is as item 321 (cache sweep, -s, foreground, -k 30, complex mode with test_complex_mode.py first).

Scope. A symmetry identity at one frequency on one fixture. No homogeneity / CV, no closed-form B₁⁺, no absolute field, no quadrature drive, no tuning. Status: the WF-16 row gets an annotation (no glyph), §10 U24 is done, and Phase 9 (9a) results gain B₁⁺. Negative result: (B1) red with (B2) and the control green is a finding. Record it, add a known-issues entry, and the review rules on it; never widen the band. (B2) red is a plumbing defect inside the new lines. No PREDICTED RED: line.

Outcome (2026-10-08 13:30 CDT slot): ✅ GREEN, all windows first run. W0 20261008T185132Z_WF-16-s5-W0.log 4 s, 5 passed / 4 skipped (refusal + PHANTOM_CELL_TAG == phantom_tag == 3 asserted); W1 …185141Z_WF-16-s5-W1-deg1.log 43 s, 9 passed; pgrep -c python3 0, sweep …185232Z_WF-16-s5-cache-sweep.log (no orphans, 84 s); W2 …185400Z_WF-16-s5-W2-deg2.log 98 s, 9 passed, 18.41 GiB summed peak RSS over 8 ranks; regenerator …185555Z_WF-16-s5-W3-regen.log 2 s (only docs/guide/api/Study.md moved, +5 envelope lines); W3 …185559Z_WF-16-s5-W3-api.log 8 s, 12 passed. Fixture 117 206 cells, drive rotation 90.000000° read off the sheets, 51 sample points. Readings (degree 1 -n 2 / degree 2 -n 8): (B1) P2@+Δ / P4@−Δ / P3@2Δ = 1.8695 / 1.9494 / 1.6405 % and 1.3563 / 1.4607 / 1.2824 % (≤ 5 %), inside the predicted 1.5–3 % at degree 1 and below it at degree 2; (B2) 0.0 / 2.840e-16 (≤ 1e-10); (B3) 51 of 51 on every image; control P2@−Δ 35.0040 / 35.2720 % (sign asserted > 5 %). Size prediction missed (not asserted, reported per rule (e)): the drafter's 80–100 % came from step 2's 95.20 % control, which is a different pairing; this control (P2 read at the counter-rotated points, a 180° mis-rotation of P2's map) reads ≈ 35 % at both degrees. Printed: |B₁⁺| at the phantom centre per 1 V drive 1.6673 / 1.7007 / 1.6653 / 1.6743e-08 T (degree 1) and 1.6225 / 1.6462 / 1.6178 / 1.6295e-08 T (degree 2) — a record, not absolute, not homogeneity. Solve 34.66 / 92.56 s, 4 CG1 projections 2.69 / 1.27 s, evaluations 0.89 / 0.31 s. Disclosure: study.py insertions only (Study.b1_plus, Study.b1_plus_at). The confirmed CG1 order (test_birdcage_b1_plus_map.py:587–598, :627–639) is magnetic_flux_density_from_e → project_to_cg1 → point evaluation → |B_x + jB_y|/2; post.faraday.b1_plus is a DG0 operator (it reshapes the DG0 vector array) and is not applied to the projection. So Study.b1_plus() returns {port_id: CG1 vector B Function} rather than a CG1 scalar of |B₁⁺|, and Study.b1_plus_at(points, drives=…) returns {port_id: (|B₁⁺| values, valid)} through evaluate_vector_field_parallel. WF-16 step 6 — Study.tune(k=1). Weekly text: PROJECT_PLAN.md lines 4748–4752. Read the fixture finding below before queueing. As written, both reproductions compare against records on other fixtures.

Fixture finding (rule (e): reported, not decided). Study builds exactly one port fixture: item 192's F-small (FourPortBirdcageGeometry, src/fem_em_solver/study.py:189). That fixture has exact CAD rectangles, κ off, a solid σ = 800 S/m conductor (conductor_sigma_s_per_m, :216), and no hole. The two records the weekly names sit on other fixtures: - TH-17's C_mode = 6.628769508e-11 F (TH-17.md, step 3) is on item 51's fixture: the TH-15 PEC hole mesh, 80 181 cells, 111 121 dofs, ragged sheets 211–214 with h/w 1.096773, w 7.294 mm. It was recorded at -n 4 and is printed in the log, not a module constant. Only STEP3_C_MODE_PREDICTED_F = 6.63e-11 exists (test_th17_birdcage_eigenmodes.py:1044). - PORT-22's records are on the 116 085-cell degree-1 mesh with in-run κ (PORT22_KAPPA_64MHZ_RECORD, test_port22_driven_sweep_resonance.py:127). They are taken at C_tuned = 1.557e-11 F (PORT15_STEP3_C_TUNED_F, :110), not at C_mode. They are a single P1 drive with P2..P4 terminated (tuned S₁₁, Z_in), not a 4×4.

Three consequences follow. LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND (1e-9, test_port_birdcage_four_port.py:165) is a same-fixture bitwise band, so it cannot hold across a mesh, sheet and κ change. Reaching either record through the API would need a ragged or κ geometry, and the 2026-10-02 binding ruling forbids that for new fixtures. And an exact-fixture C_mode against TH-17's ragged PEC value at REDUCTION_BAND 1e-3 (test_port_lumped_rlc_termination.py:88) is a cross-fixture comparison, not a reproduction. The κ ≈ 1.06 % and ANS-6's ragged→exact moves of 0.8–1.7 % suggest it misses, but no measured range exists for a PREDICTED RED line. The drafter does not re-pose the target. Two readings for the review: (R1) hand U25 back to the weekly as mis-posed; (R2) the review re-poses it under rule (j), if that is within its licence. A candidate is sketched under Candidate re-pose for that decision only; it is not adopted here.

As written (if the review holds the weekly text). - Anchor: - (a) Study.tune(k=1) returns C_mode = 1/(ω₆₄·Im z₁), with z₁ = diag(F·Z·Fᴴ) from the Study's own 4×4. This is TH-17 step 3's circuit route, Z = z0(I+S)(I−S)⁻¹, with Im z₁ > 0 asserted. It is compared with 6.628769508e-11 F at REDUCTION_BAND. - (b) The in-model tuned 4×4 at C_mode is compared with PORT-22's record at LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND. - Both are expected red for the fixture reasons above, with no registered range. Do not queue this reading without a PREDICTED RED range from the weekly.

Candidate re-pose (R2, for the review only; same bands, no target invented). - Anchor: - (a′) Identity: Study.tune(k=1).c_mode_farad equals TH-17 step 3's own circuit-side routine run on the same PortStudyResult.s within REDUCTION_BAND. Import that routine (_CircuitSide in test_th17_birdcage_eigenmodes.py) into the test, never into src/. - (b′) PORT-22 (i)'s identity on the Study's fixture: the in-model tuned S₁₁ (P2..P4 loaded by Z_C = 1/(jωC_mode) sheets, P1 driven) equals the circuit-reduced S₁₁ from the untuned 4×4 within REDUCTION_BAND. This is the same identity and band as PORT-22 (i). PORT-22 measured 8.256e-05 = 0.083× band on its fixture. - Printed only: this fixture's C_mode beside TH-17's 6.6288e-11 F and the relative gap, labelled cross-fixture. No f₀, Q or S₁₁ absolute. - Negative control (rule (e)): the circuit prediction at 0.5·C_mode misses the in-model curve. Asserted > 10× band. Predicted ≈ 1000× from PORT-22's 1116.9× on its fixture; the ceiling is |S₁₁| ≤ 1 against a 1e-3 band. A second asserted control: tune(k=1) on a Study with frequency_hz = 128 MHz must not return the 64 MHz C_mode (frequency confusion; item 259's control pattern). - API (public ⇒ same slot): Study.tune(k: int = 1, *, comm=…) → a TuneResult (c_mode_farad, z_k, the tuned S). It is added after _study_solve_sweep (study.py:544) and refuses non-port geometries the way mean_sar does (:166). The circuit algebra comes from src/fem_em_solver/ports/ (circuit.py / circuit_skrf.py). Nothing is imported from tests/, the tuned in-model solve reuses LumpedPortDrive sheets, and no new mesh is built. Regenerate scripts/docs/generate_api_reference.py and run tests/package/test_wf17_api_reference.py in the same slot. - Tier / ranks / cost: heavy by ceiling, -n 2, degree 1 (P1, like step 1's W1). The cost is item 244 W1's 138 s for build plus one four-drive solve. The in-model tuned single drive adds ≈ 20 s (PORT-22's 45 + 20 s per frequency) and a 0.5·C circuit evaluation (free). Prediction ≈ 170–220 s. Degree 2 at -n 8 (≈ 300 s, W2's 268 s + 30 s) is optional and second. - Harness: 1. scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-16-s6-W0 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && cd /workspace && FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src timeout -k 30 300 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/validation/test_wf16_study_tune.py -v -s --tb=short'" 2. Then tests/package/test_wf17_api_reference.py as a smoke window. - Traps paid for: complex comparisons (OPS-22, WF-6 4c) do not arise because tune is NumPy on S, not UFL. Fixture traps: - C_mode must be computed in-run, never restated. - Z_C at the solve frequency must be computed in-run, not at a reference ω. This is TH-17 step 2's z_ref_hz scaling trap. - z₁ = z₃ is a reciprocity identity, not a C4 check (TH-17 step 2 (iii)). - Use -s, durable capture with ; exit $rc, and run the orphan-stem sweep only with pgrep -c python3 = 0. - Scope boundary: no tuned f₀, Q, matching or absolute S₁₁ / Z_in (§2, the h-rungs are pending). No claim that this C_mode equals TH-17's, and no eigen route. ANS-7 stays 🟡. - Negative result: if (a′) or (b′) misses its band, report the measurement and stop. Park on attempt/WF-16-s6-* and journal in attempts.md. A (b′) miss on the exact fixture is a finding about the sheet-loaded tuned solve and goes to known-issues. Never re-band. - Status it can move: none of the §7 WF-16 row's Done-when (✅ 2026-10-05; tuning is listed under "Not claimed"). It is a record beyond the Done-when, like step 2: the API reference gains tune. The 9a ladder in §10 chain U ticks U25. If this cannot move a status the review accepts, decline under rule 7.
