That gives C_mode = 1/(2π·64e6·39.09) ≈ 6.362e-11 F, ≈ −4.0 % from TH-17's 6.6288e-11 F: 40× REDUCTION_BAND (1e-3, tests/validation/test_port_lumped_rlc_termination.py:88). The degree-1 exact-hole C_mode has not been logged. Ragged→exact moves elsewhere are 0.8–1.7 % (ANS-6). The degree-1 reading is therefore expected red as well, at an unregistered size.

ESR ruling. Both named records are lossless-capacitor records: TH-17 has PEC conductors and an ideal C, and PORT-22 has ideal C_tuned sheets. Under the 2026-10-06 operator ruling (PORT-24 row: "Lossless records are never re-read with r"), any Study.tune reproduction of either record runs with esr_ohm = 0 and is labelled lossless in the API docstring, the test name and the journal. A tune(..., esr_ohm=0.2) path, if built, is a separate record and is never compared with them.

Rubric, as written (for the record; every element fails). 1. Anchor: (a) C_mode = 1/(ω·Im z₁) from the Study's 4×4 vs 6.628769508e-11 F at REDUCTION_BAND: cross-fixture, predicted red at an unregistered size. (b) The in-model tuned 4×4 at C_mode vs PORT-22's record at LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND: no comparand exists, because PORT-22 has no 4×4 at C_mode. 2. Negative control: none can be separated from an anchor that is red by construction. 3. Cost (if the reviewer overrules): item 244's W1, 138 s at -n 2 degree 1 (20261005T202623Z_WF-16-W1-deg1.log), plus one in-model tuned four-drive solve, ≈ 30–45 s (PORT-22's 45 s + 20 s per frequency, item 323). Heavy by ceiling, -n 2. 4. Traps: those of item 323 (in-run C_mode, never restated; Z_C at the solve ω; z₁ = z₃ is reciprocity, not C4). 5. Scope: no f₀, Q, match or absolute S₁₁. 6. Negative result: a red on (a) is the item-323 finding re-bought. A PREDICTED RED line cannot be written, because the degree-1 exact-hole size is unlogged and the range would rest on one degree-2 reading. 7. Status it can move: none. WF-16 is ✅ and lists tuning under "Not claimed". A pre-registered cross-fixture red moves no row, which fails rubric element 7 ("a curiosity, not work").

Recommendation: do not queue. Mark U25 BLOCKED in §9 (or omit it) with the unblock condition "the weekly writes a same-fixture comparand for C_mode and for the tuned 4×4", returned to the 10-12 weekly a second time. For that weekly only (not adopted here), three same-fixture comparands exist without a new target class: - (i) C_mode against TH-17 step 3's own circuit-side routine (_CircuitSide in test_th17_birdcage_eigenmodes.py) run on the Study's PortStudyResult.s at REDUCTION_BAND. This is item 323's R2 (a′), an identity. - (ii) The tuned in-model S₁₁ against the circuit-reduced S₁₁ from the untuned 4×4 at REDUCTION_BAND. This is PORT-22 (i)'s identity on the Study's fixture, item 323's (b′). - (iii) A reproduction of ANS-7's exact-hole C_mode (tune_cmode, tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py:1304; Cu and PEC columns) through U26's copper Study. That record currently lives only in the gitignored logs/ans7_exact/ node JSONs (present on the host, 2026-10-11) and the harness log, so the weekly would first have to register it as a module constant.

Each of (i)–(iii) changes U25's target, which is the weekly's to do (§9 rule (6)).

Executor spawn prompt: none. The item is not queued.

docs.title: §9 item 373 — 2026-10-11 (U37 — WF-16 step 10, capacitor sheets with ESR; chain step (solve))
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-11 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §10 chain U, "U37. Study excitation gains capacitor sheets with ESR" (PROJECT_PLAN.md, chain U block), a weekly-enumerated step (§9 rule (4)); the 10-10 weekly's flag 2 names WF-16 as U37's home. Target (the weekly's): reproduction of PORT-24 step 2's series-RC records through the Study. The step is numbered 10 here because U36 (serial after it) is the weekly's "step 9"; the review may renumber. No band, tolerance, Done-when or validation target is set or moved; every band is imported by name.

WF-16 step 10: Study(FourPortBirdcageGeometry(as_hole=True), gel, CapacitorSheets(C, esr_ohm, on=…), conductor=LeontovichWall(), degree=1) on the F-small exact four-port at 64 MHz, -n 2, reproducing PORT-24 step 2's three identities and its records. - Executor: implementer. Additive src/ (one new public class, one new private solve function, one result subclass) plus one 3-line insertion inside an existing refusal branch (below); one new test module; registry, surface snapshot and API pages. - Tier: standard by the weekly; heavy by ceiling under PORT-24's ruling (309-tier) for this fixture at -n 2 (container timeout -k 30 590). Predicted W1 140–300 s (below). Class: chain step (solve). Cost: ≈ 51 predicted min (15 fixed + ≈ 25 code + W0 0.3 + W1 ≈ 3–5 + RG1 2.6 + Wgen / Wapi / Wdoc 0.3 + W13 0.6 + ≈ 4 spare). If W1 has not started by minute 38, park (rule (d)). - Depends on: nothing open. Items 309 (PORT-24 step 2) and 324 / 360 (step 7, copper) are on main. - Family: WF-16 step 10, attempt 1 of 4.

API (names are the weekly's; the shape is the drafter's — the review may amend, the executor adapts names only and discloses). - CapacitorSheets(c_f, esr_ohm=0.0, *, on, drive=LumpedPortDrive()), a frozen dataclass in study.py, accepted in the Study's excitation slot. Every sheet whose port id is in on carries the series-RC termination Z = series_rlc_impedance(f, r_ohm=esr_ohm, l_h=0.0, c_f=c_f) (src/fem_em_solver/ports/lumped.py:138); every other sheet is a lumped port with drive's z0 / impedance / voltage, driven in turn. Method impedance_ohm(frequency_hz). __post_init__ refuses (ValueError) non-finite or non-positive c_f, negative or non-finite esr_ohm, an empty or duplicated on, and a non-LumpedPortDrive drive. - The dispatch hook — inside the existing refusal branch, so no pre-existing route executes a new statement. In _study_solve_ports (study.py:606–607) the branch if not isinstance(self.excitation, LumpedPortDrive): raise TypeError(...) gains, before its raise: hook = getattr(self.excitation, "_solve_port_study", None); if hook is not None: return hook(self, comm). A LumpedPortDrive never enters the branch, so every existing route (four-port, sweep-free copper, F-human, YAML, the tutorials, the bundle) executes exactly its pre-change statements; the auditor can check this on the diff. U36 (item 382) reuses the same hook for its drive, so it needs no further edit to this function. - CapacitorSheets._solve_port_study(study, comm) delegates to a new private _study_solve_capacitor_sheets(study, comm): 1. Refuse, before any mesh: an FHumanBirdcageGeometry (TypeError, U36's territory); an on id outside P1 … P{leg_count} (ValueError); an on that leaves no port (ValueError). 2. Build the geometry and the problem with the same lines as _study_solve_ports (study.py:611–631: geom.build, _conductor_setup, the material_map / as_hole branch, phantom_material), copied, not factored out (a shared helper would edit the scalar path — step 2's rejected alternative, item 259 (S1)). 3. specs, port_defs = self.excitation.drive.specs_and_definitions(geom, built["sheets"]) (a call, no edit); specs′ = dataclasses.replace(s, port_impedance_ohm=Z) on the on sheets. 4. Drive each kept port (ascending port order, the order PORT-24's _terminated_three_port uses, tests/validation/test_port24_series_rc_sheet.py:103–121) with run_lumped_sheet_port_case(problem, port_defs (all four), specs′, facet_tags=…, driven_port_id=…, degree=study.degree, extra_bilinear_terms=cond_terms, solver=shared): the first drive factorises, the rest reuse the factor (the sweep's own reuse lines, ports/sparameters.py:434–460; legal because every drive shares specs′, PORT-19's premise). S_kj = b_k/a_j by _power_waves(V, I, z0) (ports/sparameters.py:72), z0 the kept ports' common z0_ohm. 5. Return a new CapacitorStudyResult(PortStudyResult) (not exported, as PortStudyResult is not): s_matrix K×K over the kept ports; port_definitions = the kept ones; new fields all_port_definitions, capacitor_port_ids, capacitor_impedance_ohm; specs = specs′ (all four); sweep = None, z_matrix = None; write_touchstone raises NotImplementedError (a reduced-network Touchstone is out of scope). - Exports: CapacitorSheets in study.py's __all__, the package __init__, tests/package/public_surface.txt (sorted) and one [names.CapacitorSheets] table in tests/package/validation_envelope.toml listing this step's node IDs (node IDs only, WF-14 (N)). Regenerate docs/guide/api/ (Wgen). Never add a Study.__init__ keyword — the constructor is pinned (tests/package/test_wf16_study_sweep.py:158–175, the OPS-70 W7 red that a conductor kwarg once caused).

Settled from the code (checked on 510f41f9). - PORT-24 step 2's fixture is the Study's step-7 fixture. PORT-24 builds th14._sheets_build(True, as_hole=True, leg_sheet_strip_fraction=GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION) + th14._build_ports(..., width_correction_kappa=None) (tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py:409–425), 80 798 cells; step 7's Study(FourPortBirdcageGeometry(as_hole=True, strip_fraction=GATED_WIDTH_FRACTION), …, conductor=LeontovichWall(COPPER_SIGMA)) reproduced ANS-6's Cu class means on that same build at ≤ 1.376e-10 (20261010T171026Z_OPS-70-item360-W9-copper.log:1824) on 80 798 cells (ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_HOLE_CELL_RECORD, tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py:112). - run_lumped_sheet_port_case only places sheets for the ids in its ports argument (ports/lumped.py, the sheets = {pid: … for pid in port_ids} dict and the bilinear list over port_ids). Passing only the kept port definitions would silently drop the capacitor sheet (an open gap). Hence step 4 passes all four definitions and drives only the kept ones — exactly PORT-24's construction. run_n_port_sparameter_sweep drives every port it is given, so it cannot be used here. - The power-wave S is an S-matrix column only where every undriven port sits at z0 (ports/sparameters.py:176–206). Over the kept ports that holds; the capacitor sheet is not a port of the reduced network, so s_matrix never carries its row or column. - series_rlc_impedance(f, r_ohm=0, l_h=0, c_f=C) and _ANS7.z_cap(ω, C) (examples/ansys_benchmarks/ans7_tuned_copper_birdcage_driven_sweep/07_tuned_copper_birdcage_driven_sweep.py:167) are different expressions of 1/(jωC); PORT-24 measured the resulting 3×3s apart at 2.5e-16 … 7.6e-16, not bitwise (20261008T170618Z_PORT-24-step2-r0.log:941–944). - Imported constants (never restated): C_F (tests/validation/test_ans7_exact_strip.py:91); FREQUENCY_HZ, DEGREE, ESR_OHM, PLANT_OHM, PLANT_INDEX, POWER_DRIVEN, _rc, _terminated_three_port, _rel (tests/validation/test_port24_series_rc_sheet.py:67–124, module-level; never import its test_*); _ANS7 (via test_ans7_exact_strip); REDUCTION_BAND (tests/validation/test_port_lumped_rlc_termination.py:88); LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_four_port.py:165); DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL, _sheet_field_dissipation_w, _source_power_w (tests/validation/test_birdcage_power_identity.py:227, :253, :296); REFERENCE_IMPEDANCE_OHM (tests/validation/test_port_package_sparameters.py:140); ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_CLASS_MEANS_P1, ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_HOLE_CELL_RECORD, ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_RECORD_RANK_WIDTH, CLASSES, _class_means (tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py:103–144, as step 7 imports them); th14._surface_loss_w (tests/validation/test_th14_birdcage_copper.py:174); FREQUENCY_64_HZ, SALINE_SIGMA, SALINE_EPSILON_R (tests/validation/test_lossy_sphere_fullwave.py:92–94); reduce_terminated_ports (src/fem_em_solver/ports/circuit.py:81); step 7's _geometry (tests/package/test_wf16_study_copper.py:80).

Test module: new tests/package/test_wf16_study_capacitor_sheets.py. @complex_only on every solve test. One module-scoped fixture; width asserted (never skipped) MPI.COMM_WORLD.size == ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_RECORD_RANK_WIDTH (2). - Mesh economy (test-side, disclosed). Inside the fixture, pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() wraps FourPortBirdcageGeometry.build so that the first call runs the real build and later calls with an equal geometry and the same communicator return that dict. This mirrors PORT-24's one-mesh-per-arm structure and saves ≈ 9 × 23 s. The hit count is asserted (Studies − 1) and printed. The first Study (S0 below) is the real build. If the review rejects the wrap, W1 grows to ≈ 375 s predicted (≈ 495 s at the 1.32× box reading), still inside 590. - Studies, in this order (all degree=1, frequency_hz=FREQUENCY_64_HZ, phantom GelledSalinePhantomMaterial(SALINE_SIGMA, SALINE_EPSILON_R, FREQUENCY_64_HZ), conductor=LeontovichWall(study_mod.COPPER_SIGMA), geometry _geometry()): S0 = LumpedPortDrive() (the 50 Ω 4×4); S_i(0.2) = CapacitorSheets(C_F, ESR_OHM, on=(P_i,)), i = 1…4; S_plant = CapacitorSheets(C_F, PLANT_OHM, on=("P2",)); S_i(0) = CapacitorSheets(C_F, 0.0, on=(P_i,)), i = 1…4; S_A = CapacitorSheets(C_F, ESR_OHM, on=("P2", "P3", "P4")) (Route A: P1 driven). - Nodes: test_wf16_s10_api_and_refusals (no solve); test_wf16_s10_cu_record; test_wf16_s10_per_sheet_identity; test_wf16_s10_r0_equals_capacitor_only; test_wf16_s10_power_identity; test_wf16_s10_planted_esr_is_seen.

Anchors (asserted; bands imported). - (K) API, no solve. CapacitorSheets(C_F, ESR_OHM).impedance_ohm(FREQUENCY_HZ) == _rc(ESR_OHM) exactly (the same call). Each __post_init__ refusal raises ValueError; an FHumanBirdcageGeometry Study with a CapacitorSheets raises TypeError before any mesh; solve_sweep, sar, b1_plus and mean_sar on a CapacitorSheets Study raise TypeError before any mesh (their existing LumpedPortDrive / geometry checks); CapacitorSheets(C_F).drive == LumpedPortDrive(). - (R0) The fixture's record, through the edited function. S0's Cu class means (_class_means) against ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_CLASS_MEANS_P1["64"]["cu"] ≤ LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND; cells == ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_HOLE_CELL_RECORD. Prior: 4.093e-11 / 8.673e-11 / 1.376e-10 (…item360-W9-copper.log:1824). - (I) Per-sheet identity at r = 0.2 (the weekly's "per-sheet identity at PORT-14's imported band"). For each i: ‖S_i(0.2) − reduce_terminated_ports(S0, z0, {i: _rc(ESR_OHM)})‖_F / ‖pred‖_F ≤ REDUCTION_BAND. Same comparison, same fixture, direct route: 3.049022e-05 / 3.036163e-05 / 3.040555e-05 / 3.003774e-05 (20261008T170256Z_PORT-24-step2-r02.log:941–944). - (Z) r = 0 against the capacitor-only sheet. For each i: ‖S_i(0) − C_i‖_F / ‖C_i‖_F ≤ LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND, where C_i = _terminated_three_port(res.problem, res.all_port_definitions, res.specs, res.facet_tags, res.conductor_terms, i, _ANS7.z_cap(ω, C_F)) S_0)'s own** problem (the direct, fresh-factor route). This is the Studys-direct reproduction in one process. Prior on the direct-vs-direct form: 2.5e-16 … 7.6e-16 (…r0.log:941–944). Predicted here ≤ 1e-11 (factor reuse against fresh factorisation; PORT-19). - (P) The exact power identity with the sheets' dissipation counted, on S_A's problem: one run_lumped_sheet_port_case(…, driven_port_id=POWER_DRIVEN, return_fields=True, …) with res.specs, accounted exactly as PORT-24's lines 199–211 (copied with a provenance comment), P_surf by th14._surface_loss_w(msh, res.conductor_facet_tags, Z_s, e, comm) as step 7's _identity does: |P_src − ΣP_sheet − P_vol − P_surf| / |P_src| ≤ DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL. Prior: 1.011e-12 (…r02.log:945).

Records, printed beside the prior (rows equal at the printed digits are reported; a digit mismatch with every assertion green is reported, not a stop — EX-89 item 332 (Q1)). (I) at .6e beside …r02.log:941–944; (I) at r = 0 beside …r0.log:941–944; (P)'s P_src / P_sheets / P_vol / P_surf at .9e beside …r02.log:945; (Dz) 7.031342e-03 (:946); Q(r)/Q(0) 2.922955e-01 and Q_rest 4.541422e+02 (:947). Also printed (no prior, never asserted): S_A's S₁₁ against reduce_terminated_ports(S0, z0, {1: Z, 2: Z, 3: Z}); per-Study solve seconds; the cache hit count.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (N1) Planted ESR — asserted, backed. ‖S_plant − reduce_terminated_ports(S0, z0, {PLANT_INDEX: _rc(ESR_OHM)})‖ / ‖pred‖ > REDUCTION_BAND. Same comparison, same fixture: 1.095344e-02 = 10.953× the band (20261008T170439Z_PORT-24-step2-plant.log:942, :949). The factor is printed, not asserted. A planted residual inside the band means the Study's sheet cannot see r: stop. - (N2) (Z)'s comparator sees r — predicted, printed only. ‖S_i(0.2) − C_i‖ / ‖C_i‖, predicted ≈ 1e-2 (a 0.2 Ω shift moved the same 3×3 by 1.1e-2 in (N1)'s backing), ≈ 1e7× LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND. No same-comparison prior, so it is never asserted.

Windows. Foreground. The harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, repo-relative, nothing chained or piped. Bash timeout: 660000 on every window; pytest with -s; tests/environment first in every complex window; never -k. Every window is under 10 min, so no durable capture. Before W1 and RG1: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 reads 0. - W0 (smoke, no solve, complex): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-16-s10-W0 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 timeout -k 30 180 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/package/test_wf16_study_capacitor_sheets.py::test_wf16_s10_api_and_refusals tests/package/test_wf16_study_sweep.py::test_wf16_sweep_api_and_refusals tests/package/test_wf16_study_four_port.py::test_wf16_geometry_constants_and_refusals tests/package/test_wf16_study_sar.py::test_wf16_sar_refusals_and_pins tests/package/test_wf16_study_b1.py::test_wf16_b1_refusal_and_tag -s -v --tb=short'" — the constructor pin and the pre-existing refusal nodes beside (K). - W1 (record window, -n 2, heavy by ceiling; predicted 140–300 s): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-16-s10-W1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 timeout -k 30 590 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/package/test_wf16_study_capacitor_sheets.py -s -v --tb=short'". Price basis: PORT-24 arms 94 / 140 / 91 s, mesh 23.0 s, 50 Ω 4×4 5.6–5.9 s, ≈ 14 s per fresh 3×3, arm totals 90.1 / 137.5 / 87.4 s (…r02.log:910, 940, 948; …r0.log:948; …plant.log:948). Here: one mesh 23 + S0 6 + nine K = 3 Studies with a reused factor ≈ 9 × 6 + four direct 3×3s ≈ 56 + S_A and its identity solve ≈ 13 + start-up ≈ 15 ⇒ ≈ 167 s; ≈ 220 s at the 1.32× box reading (OPS-70 item 349). - RG1 — standing rule (c), the pre-existing gate through the edited function (the step-8 precedent, ruling (3) on item 355): step 1's four-port module at degree 1, verbatim from 20261010T095623Z_WF-16-s8-W1r-regression.log:12, label WF-16-s10-RG1-four-port: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-16-s10-RG1-four-port "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_WF16_DEGREE=1 timeout -k 30 400 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment tests/package/test_wf16_study_four_port.py -s -v --tb=short'" (156 s measured). The copper route through the edited function is re-gated inside W1 by (R0). - Wgen / Wapi / Wdoc (step 7's W2 / W3, 20261008T190811Z_WF-16-s7-W2-apigen.log:12, 20261008T190813Z_WF-16-s7-W3-api.log:12; the link pass 20261008T203022Z_WF-17-step3-W0b-docrefs-guide.log:12), labels WF-16-s10-Wgen, WF-16-s10-Wapi, WF-16-s10-Wdoc, commands verbatim. Wapi reads 12 passed or more; Wdoc reads 0 dead. - W13 — the installed package (__init__ changed): WF-15 step 3's W4 command verbatim (20261008T214317Z_WF-15-s3-W4-wf13.log:12), label WF-16-s10-W13, ≈ 35 s.

Standing rule (c), named in full. The edited function _study_solve_ports is reached by: test_wf16_study_four_port.py (RG1), test_wf16_study_copper.py (its route re-asserted by (R0)), test_wf16_study_f_human.py, test_wf1_study_yaml.py (the F-small CLI node), test_wf1_yaml_copper.py, test_wf17_more_tutorials.py (the four-port block) and test_wf2_bundle_reproducible.py (the four-port bundle). The inserted lines sit inside the not isinstance(…, LumpedPortDrive) branch, which none of those routes enters, so the drafter proposes RG1 + (R0) as the in-slot coverage. If the review instead requires every reaching module in the slot, the additional windows are priced from their last runs: F-human W0 82 s / W1 327 s heavy -n 8 (20261010T094853Z_WF-16-s8-W0.log, 20261010T095024Z_WF-16-s8-W1.log), YAML F-small 147 s (20261010T020956Z_OPS-70-W4-yaml-f-small.log), YAML copper 98 s (20261010T171139Z_OPS-70-item360-W21-copper.log), the four-port tutorial 104 s (20261008T202702Z_WF-17-step3-W1-four-port.log), the bundle 73 s (20261010T024102Z_OPS-70-W24b-wf2-four-port.log) — ≈ 14 min more, which breaks the timebox; the review would then queue them as a serial lane-1 item (item 360's precedent) rather than in this slot.

Traps already paid for. - Never pass only the kept port definitions to run_lumped_sheet_port_case — the capacitor sheet vanishes (open gap) and every identity still "runs". (I) would catch it as a large miss; the code must not need catching. - Never hold a factor across an impedance change (PORT-19): a factor belongs to one specs′; each Study factorises once. - Never edit Study.__init__'s signature (pinned; OPS-70 W7 red, 20261009T022354Z_OPS-70-W7-wf16-deg1-fp-sweep.log:5645). - A new field on an existing frozen dataclass broke step 1's field-set pin once (step 7, first W0 red, 20261008T190237Z_WF-16-s7-W0-deg1.log): this item adds no field to LumpedPortDrive, FourPortBirdcageGeometry or PortStudyResult — the new fields live on the subclass. - The hole route has no conductor cells: the copied problem lines keep the {} material_map branch for as_hole (step 7's first W1 raised on the missing tag 1, 20261008T190040Z_WF-16-s7-W1.log). - No solve output is compared bitwise (MAT-1 item 81; MAT-5 item 237). (Z) is at the band, not ==, although its direct-vs-direct prior read ≤ 7.6e-16. - The CapacitorSheets docstring renders verbatim on its API page, and docrefs reads artifact-shaped tokens inside docstrings (item 274: summary.json in a docstring cost a window). Name no .json / .s4p / .xdmf file in it. - cell_tags.values and assemble_scalar are rank-local: reduce every power before the identity. - On status 124 or a kill: pgrep -c python3 first; at 0 only, the rubric's orphan-stem sweep as one bare call labelled WF-16-s10-cache-sweep. Never raise a timeout or change -n. - Rule (i): no edit to study.py, the test module, the registry or the snapshot after their last green window. Write ≈, never a tilde. docs.title: §9 item 388 — 2026-10-11 (WF-16 step 11; lane 1, defect fix)
docs.text:
Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-11 18:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §9 rule (5) lane 1 (🧪/⚠️ revalidation and defect fixes on shipped surfaces), from the observation item 382's drafter recorded above ("Observed, out of scope, for the review", this file, item 382). No band, tolerance, Done-when or validation target is set or moved; every band is imported by name. Items 321–324's rulings (this file, "Review rulings (2026-10-08 03:00 daily review, items 321–324)") and the sheets-and-κ binding ruling hold.

WF-16 step 11: the field-keeping port solve (_solve_port_fields, behind Study.sar / Study.b1_plus / Study.b1_plus_at) applies the Study's conductor exactly as Study.solve() does. - Executor: implementer. One existing private function edited (_study_solve_port_fields, src/fem_em_solver/study.py:1592–1660), one new test module, a known-issues entry filed and retired in the same commit. No public name, no docstring of a public object, no __init__ change. - Tier: heavy by ceiling (container timeout -k 30 400, the reacher modules' recorded ceiling), -n 2 throughout, complex. Class: lane 1 (defect fix). Cost: ≈ 40 predicted min (15 fixed + ≈ 12 code + W0r ≈ 1 + W1 ≈ 2.5 + RG1 1.7 + RG2 2.0 + ≈ 3 known-issues / row / journal + ≈ 3 spare); lane-1 class median ≈ 17 measured. If W1 has not started by minute 35, park (rule (d)). - Depends on: nothing open. Items 324 / 360 (step 7, copper), 321 / 322 (steps 4 / 5) and 373 are on main. - Family: WF-16 step 11, attempt 1 of 4.

What the code says (read by this drafter on fed0e27c, not run). The brief's premise is stated precisely here because it differs from the shorter form in which it reached the review. - _study_solve_ports (study.py:609–676) calls cond_kwargs, cond_terms = _conductor_setup(self, built, comm) at :625, maps the conductor tag only on the solid route (material_map=({} if geom.as_hole else {…}), :632–636), passes **cond_kwargs to TimeHarmonicProblem (:640: facet_tags= the outer-box meshtags, pec_facet_tags=(OUTER_BOX_TAG,)), passes extra_bilinear_terms=cond_terms to the sweep only when set (:651), and stores conductor_terms / conductor_facet_tags on the result (:673–674). - _study_solve_port_fields (:1592–1660) does none of that: no _conductor_setup, an unconditional material_map={geom.conductor_tag: …} (:1619–1623), no conductor keywords, no extra_bilinear_terms, no conductor_* fields on its result. - _conductor_setup (:1877–1902) refuses a non-LeontovichWall conductor (TypeError) and a LeontovichWall on as_hole=False (ValueError, "as_hole") before it touches built. - TimeHarmonicProblem validates every material_map tag against the MPI-reduced cell-tag set (core/time_harmonic.py:150–181, collective). - So the defect has two faces, and neither is "silently Leontovich-less fields on the hole route": - (F1) Hole route (as_hole=True, conductor LeontovichWall() or None): Study.sar / b1_plus / b1_plus_at raise ValueError: material_map references tags that do not exist in problem.cell_tags: [1], because the hole mesh has no tag-1 cells. Same message, same 80 798-cell build, measured once before: step 7's first W1, when step 7's own copy of these lines still mapped tag 1 (20261008T190040Z_WF-16-s7-W1.log:947, known tags [2, 3, 101, 102, 103, 104, 201, 202, 203, 204]). Study.solve() on the same Study works (step 7, 20261010T171026Z_OPS-70-item360-W9-copper.log:1824–1825). Loud, not silent: the copper Study's SAR and |B₁⁺| outputs have simply never run. - (F2) Solid route + LeontovichWall() (as_hole=False): Study.sar / b1_plus silently return the σ = 800 S/m solid-conductor fields, while Study.solve() on the same Study refuses with _conductor_setup's ValueError. This is the silent face, and it is item 382's drafter's original wording. - The YAML front end (src/fem_em_solver/study_yaml.py) refuses conductor: kind: leontovich without geometry.as_hole: true at parse (_parse_conductor, :333–348), so it never reaches (F2); a conductor + outputs.sar / outputs.b1_plus file reaches (F1) through _sar_summary / _b1_plus_summary (:667–706, study._solve_port_fields at :679) and raises. No test covers that combination (tests/package/test_wf1_yaml_copper.py has no outputs; test_wf1_yaml_sar_b1.py has no conductor). - run_n_port_sparameter_sweep accepts keep_fields=True together with extra_bilinear_terms (ports/sparameters.py:310–327, the per-drive call at :450–461 passes both), so the fix needs no change below study.py.

The fix (one function, copied lines, no shared helper). In _study_solve_port_fields, between msh = built["mesh"] and the TimeHarmonicProblem(...) call, and in the same order as _study_solve_ports: 1. cond_kwargs, cond_terms = _conductor_setup(self, built, comm) — after msh = built["mesh"], before the problem (:624–625's order; the no-mesh refusal node below depends on it). 2. material_map=({} if geom.as_hole else {geom.conductor_tag: HomogeneousMaterial(...)}) — :632–636 copied with its comment. 3. **cond_kwargs as the problem's last keyword (:640). 4. In the sweep call, **({"extra_bilinear_terms": cond_terms} if cond_terms else {}) (:651), keep_fields=True kept. 5. conductor_terms=cond_terms, conductor_facet_tags=built["mesh_facet_tags"] if cond_terms else None on the PortStudyResult (:673–674; existing fields, no new field). A provenance comment names _study_solve_ports and the base commit. Copied, not factored out (item 259 (S1), item 373's precedent: a shared helper would edit the scalar route). For conductor=None on as_hole=False the problem receives the same keywords, the same material_map dict and the sweep the same keywords as before — statement-for-statement the pre-fix route; RG1 / RG2 re-gate it.

Test module: new tests/package/test_wf16_study_conductor_fields.py. @complex_only on every solve node. Width asserted (never skipped) MPI.COMM_WORLD.size == ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_RECORD_RANK_WIDTH (2) in the fixture. Imports only module-level names, never a test_*: ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_CLASS_MEANS_P1, ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_HOLE_CELL_RECORD, ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_RECORD_RANK_WIDTH, CLASSES, _class_means (tests/validation/test_ans6_exact_strip.py); _geometry, NEGATIVE_CONTROL_FLOOR (tests/package/test_wf16_study_copper.py:80, :68); th14.DRIVEN, th14._surface_loss_w (tests/validation/test_th14_birdcage_copper.py:108, :174); DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL, _sheet_field_dissipation_w, _source_power_w (tests/validation/test_birdcage_power_identity.py:227, :253, :296); LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_four_port.py:165); BLIND_FACTOR (tests/validation/test_wf12_f_human_copper_matrix.py:61); PHANTOM_CELL_TAG (tests/validation/test_port_birdcage_lumped_column.py); FREQUENCY_64_HZ, SALINE_SIGMA, SALINE_EPSILON_R (tests/validation/test_lossy_sphere_fullwave.py:92–94). - Module fixture fields, in this order (the order makes the pre-fix run fail fast): (1) Cu Study A = Study(_geometry(), phantom, LumpedPortDrive(), frequency_hz=FREQUENCY_64_HZ, degree=1, conductor=LeontovichWall(study_mod.COPPER_SIGMA)); res_f = A._solve_port_fields(comm); assert A.result is None. (2) res_s = A.solve(comm). (3) PEC-hole Study B, the same with conductor=None; res_p = B._solve_port_fields(comm). (4) The kept-field identity on res_f.fields[th14.DRIVEN] — _identity of tests/package/test_wf16_study_copper.py:84–110 copied with a provenance comment, minus its run_lumped_sheet_port_case call: e, sigma_f from the kept field; sheets from res_f.specs; P_surf by th14._surface_loss_w(msh, res_f.conductor_facet_tags, z_cu, e, comm); returns P_src, P_sheets, P_phantom, P_non_phantom, P_surf, the residual and the P_surf-blind residual |P_src − P_sheets − P_total| / |P_src|. (5) Records: A.sar(mass_g=10.0, centres=[(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)], drives=["P1"]) and B's; A.b1_plus_at([(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)], drives=["P1"]) and B's. Every power reduced before use; every sar / b1_plus_at call collective on both ranks. - Nodes: test_wf16_s11_conductor_refused_before_mesh (no solve); test_wf16_s11_cells_and_terms; test_wf16_s11_field_route_equals_solve; test_wf16_s11_records[cu], [pec]; test_wf16_s11_kept_field_power_identity; test_wf16_s11_negative_wrong_column; test_wf16_s11_negative_surface_blind.

Anchors (asserted; bands imported). - (K) Refusal parity, no mesh. With monkeypatch.setattr(FourPortBirdcageGeometry, "build", lambda self, comm: {"mesh": None}): a solid-route Study (FourPortBirdcageGeometry(), conductor=LeontovichWall()) raises ValueError matching "as_hole" from study.sar(centres=[(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)]) and from study.b1_plus(); a Study with conductor=object() raises TypeError from study.sar(...); getattr(study, "fields_result", None) is None after each. This is (F2) closed: the field route refuses where solve() refuses. - (K1) res_f.cells == res_p.cells == ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_HOLE_CELL_RECORD; res_f.conductor_terms has length 1 and res_f.conductor_facet_tags is not None; res_p.conductor_terms is None and res_p.conductor_facet_tags is None (the default adds nothing). - (S=) Field route = solve() on the same Cu Study. ‖res_f.s_matrix − res_s.s_matrix‖_F / ‖res_s.s_matrix‖_F ≤ LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND. Precedent for the comparison: step 4's (R), the field route against step 1's solve-route record on the σ = 800 fixture, test_wf16_sar_r_same_fixture (tests/package/test_wf16_study_sar.py:244–251), 9.557e-11 (20261008T184215Z_WF-16-s4-W1-deg1.log:1884) and 9.559e-11 on the last re-gate (20261010T021557Z_OPS-70-W8-wf16-deg1-sar-b1.log:1884). There is no existing field-route-vs-solve() node on the copper Study (the field route could not run there). Predicted here ≤ 1e-14 (same build, same sweep code, independent factorisations); printed at .3e; never asserted bitwise. - (R) The fixture's records through the field route. _class_means(res_f.s_matrix) against ANS6_EXACT_STRIP_CLASS_MEANS_P1["64"]["cu"] and _class_means(res_p.s_matrix) against ["pec"], per class ≤ LEG_D0_REPRODUCTION_BAND. Priors on the solve route, same fixture: cu 4.093e-11 / 8.673e-11 / 1.376e-10, pec 5.052e-11 / 3.878e-11 / 5.875e-11 (…item360-W9-copper.log:1824–1825). - (P) The exact power identity on the kept field, with the conductor's surface loss counted. On res_f.fields["P1"]: P_surf > 0 and |P_src − ΣP_sheet − P_phantom − P_non_phantom − P_surf| / |P_src| ≤ DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL. This is step 7's (b) (test_b_copper_surface_loss_identity, tests/package/test_wf16_study_copper.py:190–193), whose P1 field came from a separate run_lumped_sheet_port_case solve; here the field is the sweep's kept one, the field sar and b1_plus read. Prior on the direct route, same fixture, same drive: residual 8.507e-13, P_src 4.806472101e-03 W, P_surf 1.516873149e-06 W, P_phantom 1.870050049e-06 W (…item360-W9-copper.log:1823), printed beside the kept field's at .9e (records, not asserted; a digit mismatch with every assertion green is reported, not a stop).

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (N1) Wrong column — asserted, backed. _class_means(res_f.s_matrix) against the "pec" record and _class_means(res_p.s_matrix) against the "cu" record each miss by > NEGATIVE_CONTROL_FLOOR (1e-5) per class. Backing: the cu-vs-pec class-mean gap on this fixture, 6.420e-04 / 2.811e-04 / 4.861e-04 (…item360-W9-copper.log:1826), measured on the solve route; the field route equals it to (S=)'s band. Factors over the floor ≈ 64 / 28 / 49 printed, not asserted. (The review may relabel this predicted on the ground that the backing reading is the solve route's; the assertion would then be dropped and the factor printed.) - (N2) Surface-blind identity — asserted, backed. The kept-field residual with P_surf omitted is ≥ BLIND_FACTOR × DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL (= 1e-5). Ceiling: the blind residual is P_surf / P_src ≈ 3.1559e-04 on this fixture and drive (…item360-W9-copper.log:1823, direct route), so the largest factor this fixture can show over DISCRETE_IDENTITY_RTOL is ≈ 316× and the 10× bar is reachable with ≈ 32× margin; the factor is printed. This is the control that separates "the kept field carries the wall term" from a PEC-walled field: on a PEC wall the tangential field, and so P_surf, is ≈ 0, and the identity would close without it. - (N0) The pre-fix route's discrepancy — measured by W0r below. Drafted by a general-purpose agent for the 2026-10-15 03:00 daily review; the review reviews it. Licence: §10 chain U, weekly-enumerated (§9 rule (4)), quoted, not changed: "U53 (9a; heavy, -n 8). Serial on nothing" (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4837–4840). Target: reproduction. No band, tolerance, Done-when or validation target is set or moved; every band is imported by name. The sheets-and-κ ruling (2026-10-02) binds. The capacitor-ESR ruling is not engaged, because the read is lossless, as Study.tune's own docstring states (study.py:1024–1026). Items 445 / 452 (U50 / U51, this file) are the templates.

Finding at drafting: the Study cannot express this today. The src/ addition is sized here and disclosed under standing rule (c). - Study.tune refuses every F-human Study. - _refuse_f_human(self, "tune") comes first (src/fem_em_solver/study.py:1030; the helper is :526–530). - The method is then four-port-only (:1031–1032) and LumpedPortDrive-only (:1033–1034). - Its modal read is the 4-point DFT (:1046–1048), which cannot read a 32-port two-ring matrix. - tests/package/test_wf16_study_tune.py:107–112 asserts the refusal on the copper F-human TwoPortQuadratureDrive Study. - The F-human LumpedPortDrive S route refuses any conductor. _study_solve_ports raises TypeError("FHumanBirdcageGeometry is the solid sigma = 800 route only; conductor must be None (WF-16 step 8)") (:619–621). - The only copper F-human Study today is U36's TwoPortQuadratureDrive (:2190–2195), and it returns a feeds' 2×2 at a node, not the 32×32 a mode read needs. - tests/package/test_wf16_study_f_human.py:164–165 asserts the refusal on the solid geometry (FHumanBirdcageGeometry(), as_hole=False). - Nothing else is missing. - _conductor_setup (:1972–1997) checks only as_hole and already serves the F-human hole: U36's hook calls it (:2207). - FHumanBirdcageGeometry.build returns mesh_facet_tags (:521). - LumpedPortDrive.specs_and_definitions names the ports P17…P48 (:549, :563). These are the SPEC names ring_port_map_from_names maps (src/fem_em_solver/ports/ring_modes.py:42–53). - The 32-port mode algebra is already in src: _canonical_permutation (:56), k_blocks (:74), antisymmetric_eigenpair (:88) and ring_mode_rows (:164, returning c_mode_f = modes[1]["c_anti_f"], c_k2_f, off_block, :222–230). - WF-12 step 3's 118.1186 pF is ring_mode_rows_v2's c_mode_f. Its window asserted it equal to the in-test _mode_blocks construction at 1.776e-15 (20261006T170222Z_WF-12-step3-a2-W1.log:6367). - The addition — src/fem_em_solver/study.py only, ≈ 40 lines. Two existing-line edits (S1, S2), so rule (c) applies: disclose them, and re-run their pre-existing gates green in the same slot (RG1, RG2 below). - (S1) :619 — the refusal's condition gains and not self.geometry.as_hole. The solid geometry with a conductor still raises TypeError before any mesh, so test_wf16_study_f_human.py:164–165 stays green by construction. - (S2) In _study_tune (:1016), two lines are inserted before _refuse_f_human (:1030): if isinstance(self.geometry, FHumanBirdcageGeometry) and isinstance(self.excitation, LumpedPortDrive): return _study_tune_ring(self, k, comm=comm). A TwoPortQuadratureDrive F-human Study still reaches the refusal and raises TypeError, so test_wf16_study_tune.py:107–112 stays green. - (S3) A new private _study_tune_ring(self, k=1, *, comm=MPI.COMM_WORLD) -> TuneResult, placed after _study_tune: - type-check k as the four-port branch does (bool or non-integer ⇒ TypeError, :1035–1037); - k not in (1, 2) ⇒ ValueError before any solve; - self.solve(comm) only if self.result is None; - names = [pd.port_id for pd in self.result.port_definitions]; perm = _canonical_permutation(ring_port_map_from_names(names)); - z = s_to_z(S, float(self.excitation.z0_ohm)); blocks, off = k_blocks(z[np.ix_(perm, perm)]); - lam = [antisymmetric_eigenpair(blocks[m])[0] for m in range(9)]; - Im lam[k] <= 0 ⇒ ValueError; - return TuneResult(k=k, frequency_hz=float(self.frequency_hz), z_k=np.array(lam), c_mode_farad=float(1.0 / (self.omega * lam[k].imag)), off_diagonal_residual=float(off)). - Imports are function-local from .ports.circuit / .ports.ring_modes (src never imports tests). There is no ESR argument (lossless, as :1024–1026). - (S4) TuneResult's docstring (:1000) gains "or the 32-port F-human ring read (z_k = the ring-antisymmetric eigenvalue per k = 0…8)". Anchors (asserted; bands imported). - (K0) Refusals and the ring read on a synthetic, no mesh. Every geometry's build is monkeypatched to raise, as test_wf16_study_tune.py:92–100 does. - Refusals: - the copper F-human TwoPortQuadratureDrive(118.0e-12, esr_ohm=ESR_OHM) Study's tune() raises TypeError (unchanged); - Study(FHumanBirdcageGeometry(), …, LumpedPortDrive(), conductor=LeontovichWall()).solve() raises TypeError ((S1) keeps it); - on the copper hole LumpedPortDrive Study, tune(k=0) / tune(k=3) raise ValueError and tune(k=1.0) / tune(k=True) raise TypeError, all with zero build calls and study.result is None. - The synthetic: - choose 2×2 blocks Ẑ_m = [[a_m, b_m], [b_m, a_m]] for m = 0…15, with a₁ − b₁ = 0.3 + 21.05j Ω (≈ the copper value, :6362) and seeded values elsewhere; - form Z = Wᴴ blockdiag(Ẑ) W with W = I₂ ⊗ F, F_jk = e^{−2πi jk/16}/4 (ring_modes.py:68–71, re-built in-test), and S = z_to_s(Z, 50); - shuffle rows, columns and the names P17…P48 together by a seeded permutation; - set study.result = SimpleNamespace(s_matrix=S, port_definitions=[SimpleNamespace(port_id=n) for n in names]), as test_wf16_study_tune.py:128 does for the four-port. - Asserted on the synthetic: - t1.c_mode_farad = 1/(ω Im(a₁ − b₁)) and t2.c_mode_farad = 1/(ω Im(a₂ − b₂)), each ≤ EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL; - both equal ring_mode_rows(S, port_map=ring_port_map_from_names(names), …)'s c_mode_f / c_k2_f; - off_diagonal_residual ≤ EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL (block-diagonal by construction); - an unshuffled copy gives the same C bit for bit (the name → canonical map). - (R0) The fixture tie. - res.cells == HOLE_CELL_RECORD (369 387) and == npz cells. - _residual(S_study[p][:, p], s32_npz) ≤ REUSE_REPRODUCTION_RTOL, with p mapping the Study's port order to the npz order. - Asserted on reasoned backing; predicted ≤ 1e-10. docs.title: Review ruling 2026-10-15 18:00 (item 472, the (K0) re-band)
docs.text: Ratified. (K0) is the W0 check that the ring read does not depend on port row order. Both shuffled reads equal the closed form and ring_mode_rows at 0.000e+00 (:52). The brief's "bit for bit" was a drafting slip: a reordered linear solve has no such identity. The project's band for exact identities under rounding is EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL. The executor re-registered the clause on the same quantity and disclosed it in the commit, §9, this file and the code comment. That is rule (f)'s path, and the review now ratifies it. No gate rests on the bitwise clause: (R0), (I), (a) and (c1) were each green at their pre-registered bands. Standing note for drafters: do not pre-register "bit for bit" on a quantity computed through a dense inverse or solve whose row order differs between the two sides. Use EXACT_IDENTITY_RTOL.

docs.title: §9 item 993 — 2026-11-15 (§10 U13a, chain U — rule (4), the 11-14 weekly's re-pose; chain step (no solve))
docs.text:
Enumerated by the 11-14 weekly at PROJECT_PLAN.md:5020–5039 (the ruling) and :5257–5260 (the step). Brief drafted 2026-11-15 as execution detail. A record plus CAD identities: no band is set or moved. Family U13a, attempt 1 of 4. Executor: the implementer, in-slot (item 985 precedent). The weekly's target binds: "a CadQuery-authored F-small four-port (the 1d authoring script's pattern, four named sheets at the generator's exact-rectangle positions) imported through U12′'s route: (CAD) the four sheets tagged with fragment lineage and each area at STRIP_BAND at -n 1 / 2 / 4; (Q) a mesh-quality reading (min dihedral angle, max aspect) on the un-optimised mesh printed beside the primitive mesh's; no solve. Validation target: the CAD identities at STRIP_BAND."

What the step is. U12′ (item 985, b8214906) proved the named-sheet route on a unit box: a CadQuery STEP whose free face PortSheet reaches import_step by name (highest_dim_only: false + surface_groups), is embedded by occ.fragment and tagged 201 with its area exact. U13a moves that route to the F-small four-port: four CadQuery-named sheets placed where MeshGenerator.birdcage_port_domain(leg_sheet_strip_fraction=0.5) puts its exact centre strips (OPS-61 step 1b), imported, tagged by name, each area at STRIP_BAND; and, because the route skips Netgen (known-issues 2026-11-14), the un-optimised mesh's quality is read beside the primitive's. U13b (serial on this) is the solve.

Facts verified against the tree (this review, by grep / reading; unlogged, not a record). - STRIP_BAND = 1.0e-9 at tests/validation/test_ops61_exact_strip_ports.py:58; U12′ restated it as a literal with that provenance comment (tests/mesh/test_step_import_cq_port_sheet.py:43). U13a imports it (from tests.validation.test_ops61_exact_strip_ports import STRIP_BAND, the test_birdcage_implant_spheroid_f_human.py:51 precedent), never restates it. - U12′'s route: src/fem_em_solver/io/step_import.py config keys highest_dim_only and surface_groups (name → tag by getEntityName + fragment out_map, never a geometric selector). With surface_groups set the Netgen pass is skipped (:320–330, the if named_surfaces: pass branch); key absent ⇒ optimize("Netgen") unchanged. Config shape: tests/mesh/data/geo34_step1d_port_sheet.json (resolution, outer_boundary_tag, highest_dim_only, volume_groups with bbox_contains selectors, surface_groups entries {name, step_name, role, tag}). The import's diagnostics carry diag["surface_groups"][name] with tag, role, step_name, cad_area, n_triangles, route (test :91–100). - U12′'s gates to copy: (P1) owned-facet area vs analytic and vs cad_area at STRIP_BAND (:89–102); (P2) owned count == n_triangles, 0 one-sided (:105–116); (P3) dS(tag) at STRIP_BAND·A (:119–132); (P4) global tag set + validate_required_port_tags_exist (:135–144); (n3) drop-one-facet control (:147–157); (n-hDO) default read raises naming the sheet (:160–166); (n1) absent name raises everywhere (:169–173); (n2) without surface_groups no port tag (:176–184). W1 20261114T181927Z_GEO-34-U12p-W1.log: 10 passed per width, Elapsed 11 s for -n 1 / 2 / 4 (:728–729; command :12, PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace, timeout -k 30 60 per width). - The authoring pattern: tests/mesh/cq_author_geo34_step1d.py (64 lines) runs under cq-python, which clears PYTHONPATH (docker/Dockerfile:41, cited at :4), so it cannot import the generator; it restates its constants as literals with provenance, builds each sheet as an explicit 4-corner cq.Face.makeFromWires(cq.Wire.makePolygon(...)) (never makePlane), asserts area at 1e-12 and bbox at 1e-6, and exports a cq.Assembly of named products (:46–54). The STEP is committed once with a sha256 pin (test :38) and a narrow .gitignore negation (b8214906). - The generator's exact-rectangle positions: src/fem_em_solver/io/mesh.py:5568–5591. Each leg's sheet is addRectangle(port_radius − ½·port_dx, −½·port_dz, 0, port_dx, port_dz) at azimuth 0 in the xy plane; with leg_sheet_strip_fraction = f the centre rectangle addRectangle(port_radius − ½·f·port_dx, −½·port_dz, 0, f·port_dx, port_dz) is fragmented out before placement, and every piece takes _place_sheet_in_leg_frame(piece, box_angle) (:414–434: one snapped affine R_z(angle)·R_x(π/2), so at 0 / 90 / 180 / 270° corners stay on exact coordinates). The numbers port_radius, port_dx, port_dz and each box_angle are not module constants; read them from the built model (diag["port_box_size_m"] gives (dx, dy, dz), test_ops61_exact_strip_ports.py:85). - The comparand: OPS-61's (A2) — every exact strip N_i = 0.5·dx·dz within STRIP_BAND (test_ops61_exact_strip_ports.py:15–16, asserted :193–199); the full sheet is SHEET_AREA_M2 = 1.120000000e-04 (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_phantom_resolution.py:69), so the strip is 5.6e-05 m² by arithmetic (assert against 0.5·dx·dz from the model, not this literal). - The primitive mesh for (Q): _build(np.zeros(LEG_COUNT), leg_sheet_strip_fraction=0.5) (tests/mesh/test_birdcage_port_sheets.py:80–90, called at test_ops61_exact_strip_ports.py:81–83); flag-on record 117 206 cells at -n 1 (:65, ANS4_EXACT_STRIP_CELL_RECORD). Netgen runs on it (key-absent generator path). - A quality helper exists: _tet_quality(x) in tests/mesh/probe_wf6_sheet_facet_census.py:83–110 returns per-tet radius ratio 3 r_in / R_circ and min dihedral (degrees) from an (n, 4, 3) coordinate array. Import it; "max aspect" = max of 1 / (3 r_in / R_circ) (state the definition in the print). - The OCC writer drops named sheets (known-issues 2026-10-07), which is why 1a's STEP cannot carry them; 1b's own round trip prints "mesh differs" (tests/mesh/test_step_import_four_port.py:26–28). - Known-issues 2026-11-14 (docs/testing/known-issues.md:895–902): Netgen "456 illegal tets" then SEGV on the 1d fixture (20261114T181903Z_GEO-34-U12p-W1.log:111–116, Status 15, 2 s); cause undiagnosed (GEO-34 1e, item 996, is the probe); Resolves with: "a measured quality reading on the un-optimised named-sheet mesh with the step's gates green, or an optimiser route that keeps the embedded face. Never by re-enabling the pass on the key-absent path." U13a green is the first half of that clause.

Pre-registered design choice (the review's; flag if the slot finds otherwise). "CadQuery-authored F-small four-port" is read as: the solids come from the generator's own STEP export (1a's step_export_path= on _build, emit_port_sheets=True, strip flag off; the OCC writer drops the sheets, which is what we want) re-read inside CadQuery (cq.importers.importStep), and the four named strip faces are authored in CadQuery at the generator's positions and added as products PortSheet1 … PortSheet4 of one cq.Assembly. Authoring the whole birdcage in CadQuery from parameters is GEO-34 step 1c (independent kernel), not this step. If importStep + Assembly.export loses the solids' names or merges them, stop and report — do not switch to a full CadQuery rebuild in-slot.

Code. 1. W0a probe (not collected) tests/mesh/probe_u13a_fsmall_sheet_positions.py, dolfinx env: build _build(np.zeros(LEG_COUNT), emit_port_sheets=True, step_export_path=<logs path>) once and print, for each of the four legs, box_angle, port_radius, port_dx, port_dz and the four placed strip corners (gmsh.model.getValue on the strip's boundary points or occ.getBoundingBox on the fragment's centre piece, !r format). These printed corners are the literals the authoring script restates, cited by log:line. 2. Author tests/mesh/cq_author_u13a_fsmall_four_port.py (1d's pattern; cq-python): read the generator STEP, add four explicit 4-corner polygon faces from W0a's literals, assert each area == 0.5·dx·dz (literal from W0a) at 1e-12 and bbox at 1e-6, export the assembly, print bytes + sha256. Commit the STEP once under tests/mesh/data/ with a narrow .gitignore negation, sha256 pinned (if the file exceeds ≈ 2 MB, stop and ask the review — U12′'s was 21 KB). 3. Config tests/mesh/data/u13a_fsmall_four_port.json: highest_dim_only: false, outer_boundary_tag, the volume groups 1a's config already maps (tests/mesh/data/geo34_fsmall_birdcage_step.json — copy its volume_groups verbatim), and four surface_groups {name: port_i, step_name: PortSheet<i>, role: port, tag: 200+i} (pick tags that collide with no generator tag; grep SHEET_IFACE first). 4. Test tests/mesh/test_step_import_u13a_fsmall.py, real build, any width, every count and integral reduced before asserting. Per sheet i: (C1) owned-facet area / (0.5·dx·dz) − 1 and / cad_area − 1 within STRIP_BAND; (C2) owned count == n_triangles, 0 one-sided or two-sided as the topology dictates (a strip inside a port box is interior: expect 2 cells per facet — state it); (C3) dS(200+i) within STRIP_BAND·A; (C4) step_name and route record the fragment lineage, tag set == the config's; (C5) azimuth of sheet i == 90°·(i−1) to AZIMUTH_MATCH_DEG (import it from test_port_birdcage_four_port; same pre-gate as 1b (iv)). (Q) printed only: min dihedral, max aspect, cell count on the import and on _build(..., leg_sheet_strip_fraction=0.5) side by side, with the definitions in the line.

Gates (asserted; no band set or moved). (C1)–(C5) at -n 1, -n 2, -n 4; (P0) ghosts at -n > 1.

Negative controls (asserted). (n-drop) one owned strip facet dropped on one rank misses STRIP_BAND (U12′'s (n3)); (n-swap) the config with PortSheet2 ↔ PortSheet3 fails (C5) naming both; (n-hDO) default highest_dim_only raises naming a PortSheet (U12′'s :160–166); (n-absent) step_name="PortSheet9" raises on every rank.

Printed. (Q) both columns; cells (import vs primitive 117 206 record); n_triangles per sheet; stage seconds (author, import + tag, quality pass).

Windows (bare and foreground, Bash timeout: 660000; docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 reads 0 first; container-side ≤ 600 s; timeout -k 30 mandatory): 1. W0a WF-16-U13a-W0a-positions: the probe, -n 1 plain python3, timeout -k 30 120. 2. W0b WF-16-U13a-W0b-author: cq-python tests/mesh/cq_author_u13a_fsmall_four_port.py tests/mesh/data/u13a_fsmall_four_port.step, timeout -k 30 120. 3. W1a / W1b / W1c WF-16-U13a-W1-n1 / -n2 / -n4: one width per window (the F-small import is ≈ 37 s of import + tag at -n 2, GEO-34 step 2's stage seconds, against U12′'s 10 k-tet box), each PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 180 mpiexec -n <k> python3 -m pytest tests/mesh/test_step_import_u13a_fsmall.py -v -s --tb=short; W1a also carries tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py as U12′'s did. Real build (no complex source). 4. W2 rule (c) WF-16-U13a-W2-ruleC: only if any src/ line changes — U12′'s W2a command verbatim. Expected: no src/ edit, so W2 is not run. Rule (i): no test, config or STEP edit after its last window.

Price / Tier / Class / Cost. - Standard, -n 1 / 2 / 4, real build, no solve. - Windows: W0a ≈ 40–60 s (one F-small build + export; 1b's build ≈ 2–3 min at -n 2 includes its solves, test_step_import_four_port.py:37), W0b ≈ 10 s, W1a–c ≈ 60–120 s each (import + tag ≈ 37 s, plus the primitive _build for (Q) ≈ 40 s), total ≈ 6–8 min of windows. - Class: chain step (no solve). Cost: ≈ 10.8 measured (class median) / 45 predicted min (three new files + a committed STEP).

Traps already paid for. - cq-python clears PYTHONPATH: the authoring script restates literals, cited to W0a's log:line; never import fem_em_solver there. - Never makePlane (orientation ambiguous); explicit polygon faces. - The OCC bbox pads by the shape tolerance (≈ 1e-7): bbox checks at 1e-6, area at 1e-12 (1d's :38–41). - The default read drops free faces: highest_dim_only: false is required; embedding is read with getEmbedded, not upward adjacency (b8214906 message). - Do not re-enable Netgen on the named-sheet branch, and never touch the key-absent path (known-issues 2026-11-14 "Never by …"). - Exact rectangles only, κ off (CLAUDE.md hard rule; 2026-10-02 ruling): never triangulate a sub-sheet out of a box; no κ. - cell_tags.values, assemble_scalar, local max/min are rank-local — reduce before asserting; (Q) minima / maxima via allreduce(MIN/MAX). - A gmsh throw on rank 0 under mpiexec -n 2 can deadlock (GEO-34 1d brief): W0a / W0b are plain python3, -n 1. - Cell counts are printed, never gated (1b: "mesh differs").

Scope. The named-sheet route on F-small: four exact strips tagged by name with fragment lineage, areas at STRIP_BAND, at three widths; and one quality reading. Not claimed: any port, S or Z quantity (U13b); item 192's P1 (withdrawn, PROJECT_PLAN.md:5023–5029); that the un-optimised mesh is adequate for a solve (U13b's gates are that test); the Netgen SEGV's cause (item 996).

Negative result. - (C1)/(C3) miss at STRIP_BAND: the route does not carry the exact rectangle on a multi-volume model. Stop, BLOCKED, park on attempt/WF-16-U13a-*; the review files known-issues. - A sheet not found by name, or found twice (fragment split it across a port-box face): record the lineage printed, stop — that is a finding about the CAD, not a band. - (Q) degenerate (min dihedral below ≈ 1° or a zero-volume tet): print, do not assert; U13b's premise is then the review's call. - No PREDICTED RED: line.

Outcome commit. The logs, the probe, the author script, the STEP + its .gitignore negation, the config, the test, docs/planning/chunks/WF-16.md Outcome paragraph, and the §9 line marked DONE with the local (CST) slot, in one commit through the hook.

Executor spawn prompt (verbatim, if delegated). "Execute §9 item 993 — WF-16 U13a — per docs/planning/chunks/WF-16.md "§9 item 993". Create tests/mesh/probe_u13a_fsmall_sheet_positions.py, tests/mesh/cq_author_u13a_fsmall_four_port.py, tests/mesh/data/u13a_fsmall_four_port.{step,json} (STEP committed once, sha256 pinned, narrow .gitignore negation) and tests/mesh/test_step_import_u13a_fsmall.py. Edit no src/ file; never re-enable optimize(\"Netgen\") on the named-sheet branch. The four named strips sit at the generator's exact-rectangle positions read from W0a's printed corners (leg_sheet_strip_fraction=0.5); import STRIP_BAND from tests/validation/test_ops61_exact_strip_ports.py, never restate it; κ off. Gates (C1)–(C5) at -n 1 / 2 / 4, one width per window; (Q) printed only, beside the primitive's. No solve. The harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, repo-relative, nothing chained or piped; foreground, Bash timeout: 660000; container timeout -k 30; pytest -s. pgrep -c python3 reads 0 first. Never edit a pattern, literal or band to rescue a red. On a red, park on attempt/WF-16-U13a-* and mark §9 item 993 BLOCKED in the same commit. Never delete a log. Never --no-verify. Do not spawn agents."

Review note (2026-11-15 10:30 daily, provisional for the 11-16 weekly) — what "CadQuery-authored" means in item 993. cq-python clears PYTHONPATH (docker/Dockerfile:41), so the authoring script cannot import the generator. Rebuilding the whole birdcage in CadQuery is step 1c's and is not this item: a slot that finds the route needs it stops and reports.

W0a (20261115T210354Z_WF-16-U13a-W0a-positions.log, -n 1, 28 s): port_radius 0.07, dx = dy 0.014, dz 0.008 (:1796), strip 0.5·dx·dz = 5.6e-05 (:1797), the four placed strip corners at exact coordinates (:1799–1817); generator STEP 2 499 178 bytes, build + export 25.18 s. WF-17 step 1: a user-guide page whose "first study" block is the test input. One new page, docs/guide/first_study.md, carries one fenced block tagged ```python first-study. A new test module reads the committed page, extracts that block verbatim and execs it through the harness at -n 2, degree 2 by default. The mean SAR it returns must reproduce WF-15's record inside L0_BAND, and land inside MAT-4's imported band against the closed form. docrefs gains an additive, opt-in Markdown-link pass and reports zero dead links over docs/guide/, with a planted dead link detected. - Executor: implementer. - Tier: - W0 / W0b smoke (real build, no mpiexec); - W1 standard (complex, -n 2); - W2 heavy (complex, -n 2, 590 s).

The item is heavy, -n 2. The row's "standard by prediction" is re-declared by the price below: one degree-2 solve on this fixture is 282.4 s. - Class: chain step (solve + docs), measured median ≈ 9 min. - Cost: predicted ≈ 40 min. That is 15 fixed + ≈ 15 code (page ≈ 60 lines, test ≈ 200 lines, checker ≈ 40 lines) + windows W0 0.5 + W0b 0.1 + W1 1.5 + sweep 0.2 + W2 6 min + ≈ 2 spare. - Depends on: nothing open. study.py, the WF-15 module and its logs are on main (4239ba88 and later).

Settled from the code (read before designing). - docrefs (scripts/testing/check_example_doc_references.py) is blind to Markdown links today. - Its reference pass matches only filename-shaped tokens ending .py or an artifact suffix (REFERENCE_RE, :120–122; ARTIFACT_SUFFIXES, :116). - It checks a .py only by basename anywhere under src/ examples/ scripts/ tests/ (repo_basenames, :266–272). - A [text](../x.md) link, a link to a moved directory, or a wrong relative path is never resolved. - --docs-root already accepts any repo-relative tree (:366–370, :382), so --docs-root docs/guide scans the guide. The guide pass (:459–480) runs over ./run_examples.sh --list whatever the docs root, and its guide= count is the examples corpus's, not the guide's. - So the Done-when's "zero dead links" needs an additive link pass. Without one, the guide-mode dead=0 is vacuous for links. - There is no docs/guide/ (or docs/user/) directory. mkdocs.yml has a nav, but nothing in the harness builds it, and the row does not claim a hosted site. This item does not edit mkdocs.yml or docs/index.md (see open questions). - The WF-15 degree-2 record has no named constant anywhere in tests/. It lives only in the §7 row and in 20261005T170537Z_WF-15-r2-W2a-deg2-study.log:170 (8.0116577245e-08; full repr 8.011657724511505e-08 at :163). - Adding it to test_wf15_study_lossy_sphere.py would edit a gate module, which would force a re-run of W2a (428 s, rule (c)). - So the new module holds WF15_DEG2_RECORD = 8.0116577245e-08 with that citation. - Study composition, as landed (src/fem_em_solver/study.py:90–176): - Study(geometry, material, excitation, *, frequency_hz, degree=2, density_kg_m3=1000.0). - .mean_sar() solves on first call (:166–167) and returns post.sar.mean_sar's dict, whose key is mean_sar_w_per_kg (post/sar.py:141). - All four names the tutorial needs are already exported by fem_em_solver (GelledSalinePhantomMaterial, SphereInBoxGeometry, QuasiStaticSphereField, Study; the WF-15 module imports them so, test_wf15_study_lossy_sphere.py:42–47). - No new public name is needed. If one is added, WF-14's snapshot and envelope gates apply and W3 / W4 of item 244 must be run; the brief does not expect it. - The fixture's constants are importable: - SPHERE_RADIUS 0.01, BOX_HALF_WIDTH 0.02, E0 1.0, EPSILON_R_SPHERE 78.0, SPHERE_TAG 1, FREQUENCY_HZ 64.0e6, RHO_KG_M3 1000.0, SIGMA_HIGH 0.57 (tests/validation/test_lossy_sphere_sar.py:68–79); - GEOMETRY (test_wf15_study_lossy_sphere.py:98–104, resolutions SPHERE_RADIUS / 10.0 and / 5.0); - _closed (:222–228, which calls uniform_sphere_sar_closed_form, src/fem_em_solver/post/sar.py:368); - MAT4_DEG1_RECORD (:87). - GelledSalinePhantomMaterial is a frozen dataclass (materials/phantom.py:21–40), so material equality is exact field equality.

Code. - (1) New docs/guide/first_study.md, the user-guide page. Sections: - What you will compute: mean SAR in a 1 cm-radius gelled-saline sphere under an imposed uniform 1 V/m field at 64 MHz, checked against the closed form. - Before you start: the Docker service, complex mode source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode, and a cost of ≈ 5 min and ≈ 20 GiB summed RAM at 2 ranks (W2a: 282.4 s, 20.41 GiB, …W2a…:158). - The first study: the one tagged block. - Run it: save the block as a script and run mpiexec -n 2 python3 first_study.py inside the container in complex mode. - What you should see: one fenced ```text first-study-output block holding mean SAR = 8.0116577245e-08 W/kg. The prose says that the last digit or two can differ between runs (≈ 1e-11 relative) and that the test holds it to 1e-9. The closed form is 8.008354e-08 W/kg, 0.04 % away. - What this does not show: no coil, no ports, no h-convergence, an imposed field only. - How this page is tested: a relative link to the test module.

The page links, by relative path, to ../../src/fem_em_solver/study.py, ../../tests/package/test_wf17_first_study_tutorial.py and ../../tests/package/test_wf15_study_lossy_sphere.py (≥ 3 links, all live). It cites no run artifact (.json / .png / .xdmf …), so the freshness rule cannot fire on it. Write ≈, never ~. No AED number.

The block uses only existing names and the Study defaults: no degree= and no density_kg_m3=. To reproduce GEOMETRY bitwise it writes R = 0.01 and resolution_sphere=R / 10, resolution_far=R / 5, the same float division as SPHERE_RADIUS / 10.0. It also passes GelledSalinePhantomMaterial(0.57, 78.0, 64e6), QuasiStaticSphereField(e0=1.0) and frequency_hz=64e6. It calls sar = study.mean_sar() and prints f"mean SAR = {sar['mean_sar_w_per_kg']:.10e} W/kg". It has no if __name__ guard requirement: the test execs with __name__ == "__main__", so either form runs. - (2) New tests/package/test_wf17_first_study_tutorial.py. - Helpers: - extract_tagged_block(text, tag) -> str. The opening fence is a line matching exactly ```python first-study (info string python <tag>, so GFM and mkdocs still highlight Python). The block runs to the next line that is exactly ```. Zero or more than one match raises LookupError. - exec_block(source, *, stop_before_solve) runs exec(compile(source, "docs/guide/first_study.md#first-study", "exec"), {"__name__": "__main__"}) under contextlib.redirect_stdout, and echoes the captured text from rank 0. Through pytest's monkeypatch, a spy wraps Study.mean_sar: it calls the original and records the instance and the returned dict. With stop_before_solve, Study.solve is replaced by a recorder that stores self and raises a private _StopBeforeSolve, which the helper catches. The spy never alters what the block computes. - Imports (names only, nothing restated): - GEOMETRY, _closed, MAT4_DEG1_RECORD from tests/package/test_wf15_study_lossy_sphere.py; - SIGMA_HIGH, EPSILON_R_SPHERE, FREQUENCY_HZ, E0, RHO_KG_M3 from tests/validation/test_lossy_sphere_sar.py; - MAT4_BAND (tests/materials/test_phantom_material_model.py:222); - L0_BAND (tests/validation/test_mat5_em_coupled_sphere.py:104); - run_checker and checker (tests/unit/test_doc_reference_exit_codes.py:46, :54); - complex_only (tests/complex_mode.py:26). - Every node prints the sha256 of the page bytes and of the extracted block. This is the rule (i) audit trail: the hash must be identical in W0, W1 and W2 and equal to the committed page's. - Nodes: - test_wf17_extracts_exactly_one_first_study_block (W0); - test_wf17_block_configures_the_wf15_study (W0); - test_wf17_planted_page_and_parameter_controls (W0); - test_wf17_expected_output_states_the_record (W0); - test_wf17_docrefs_guide_has_zero_dead_links (W0); - test_wf17_docrefs_detects_a_planted_dead_link (W0); - @complex_only test_wf17_planted_degree1_block_misses_the_record (W1); - @complex_only test_wf17_first_study_block_reproduces_wf15_record (W2). - (3) scripts/testing/check_example_doc_references.py: an additive --check-links flag, default off. - What it checks. Over the scanned docs_root pages, every inline link or image [t](target) / ![t](target) and every reference definition [t]: target, outside fenced code blocks (track ``` fences). - What it skips. Targets with a URL scheme (://, mailto:) and pure #fragment targets. - How a target resolves. Strip #… and ?…, then resolve against the page's directory. A target outside REPO_ROOT is dead (it exists only on this box). Anything else must exists(). - Reporting. Each dead link appends "<page>:<line>: dead link -> <target>" to the existing violations list, so it scores in dead= and exit 1. Before RESULT:, one line prints: Link pass: <n> link(s) checked over <m> page(s), <d> dead. - Unchanged. The RESULT: line format (RESULT_RE, exit-code module :48–51), the exit-code contract and the default invocation's output are all unchanged. With the flag absent, the new code is not entered. - Anchor fragments are not resolved (scope).

No other src/ or tests/ file is edited. In particular this item edits none of study.py, __init__.py, public_surface.txt, validation_envelope.toml (items 256 / 259 / 260 may).

Anchors (asserted). - (X) Extraction from the committed page. extract_tagged_block(Path("docs/guide/first_study.md").read_text(), "first-study") returns one non-empty block, which contains the call Study( exactly once (AST: exactly one ast.Call whose function name is Study). Exact. - (K) The block configures WF-15's Study, exactly (no solve). Exec with stop_before_solve, then on the recorded instance: - geometry == GEOMETRY (frozen dataclass equality, so bitwise floats); - material == GelledSalinePhantomMaterial(SIGMA_HIGH, EPSILON_R_SPHERE, FREQUENCY_HZ); - excitation == QuasiStaticSphereField(e0=E0); - frequency_hz == FREQUENCY_HZ, density_kg_m3 == RHO_KG_M3, degree == 2; - by AST, the Study call carries no degree keyword (the tutorial teaches the default; operator order rule 2026-10-01).

All exact. - (E) The page states the record. The single ```text first-study-output block, extracted with the same helper, holds one mean SAR = <x> W/kg line, and float(x) == WF15_DEG2_RECORD. That is a decimal literal against a decimal literal: exact. - (D) docrefs over the guide. run_checker("--docs-root", "docs/guide", "--check-links") parses dead == 0, and the Link pass: line reports n ≥ 1 link checked (the page carries ≥ 3 by design; n printed). guide=, stale= and exit are printed, not asserted (guide= is the examples corpus's: 20261005T201859Z_EX-90-post-docrefs.log:85 read guide=0). - (Deg) Degree 2 by default, structurally (W2). recorded.degree == 2, recorded.result.degree == 2, and the solved e_complex space's ufl_element().degree == 2. Cells and N1curl dofs are printed beside the version-tagged 74 020 / 482 158 (…W2a…:158), never asserted equal to them. - (R) WF-15's record, inside its band (W2). The spy-recorded mean_sar_w_per_kg, against WF15_DEG2_RECORD, must be ≤ L0_BAND 1e-9 relative, printed at .3e beside the value at .10e. - Asserted, with this backing. The same quantity on the same fixture, degree and width, compared across processes: - W2b's (I) read 2.633e-11 (20261005T171253Z_WF-15-r2-W2b-deg2-direct.log:160); - the cost probe's Study SAR 8.0116577256e-08 (20261005T112831Z_WF-15-probe-deg2-cost.log:107) sits 1.37e-11 from the record; - the record's .10e print rounding is 1.4e-12 against the repr at :163. - Predicted 5e-12 … 5e-11. The auditor's ≈ 1e-10 cross-process reading would still sit 10× under the band. - Never compare the .10e string. The repr sits 0.385 of a last-digit unit (4.8e-12 relative) from that print's rounding edge, below the measured 1.4e-11 … 2.6e-11 spread, so the string can flip between processes. - (G) Inside MAT-4's imported band (W2). |SAR − _closed(SIGMA_HIGH, EPSILON_R_SPHERE)["sar_w_per_kg"]| / closed ≤ MAT4_BAND 0.10 (test_phantom_material_model.py:222 = test_lossy_sphere_sar.py:321). Asserted. The same comparison on the same fixture read 0.041 % (…W2a…:165). - (Out) The page prints what it returns (W2). On rank 0, the captured stdout contains f"{recorded_sar:.10e}". Structural, exact.

Negative controls (rule (e)). - (c1) Untagged or doubly-tagged page raises (W0). - Planted: the committed page text with its ```python first-study fence rewritten to ```python, so zero tags; and the same text with the tagged block duplicated, so two tags. - extract_tagged_block must raise LookupError in both cases. - Asserted, by construction. This is a deterministic function of new code on a synthetic input (the precedent is OPS-19's synthetic dead-reference fixture, test_doc_reference_exit_codes.py:161–178). The review may relabel it as predicted. - (c2) One parameter changed, caught before any solve (W0). - Planted: the extracted block with its σ literal 0.57 replaced by 0.75. Assert the literal occurs exactly once first; if the page's formatting moves, the control fails loudly, and that is intended. - Exec with stop_before_solve. (K)'s comparator must report material unequal and nothing else. - Asserted, by construction (frozen-dataclass inequality on a changed float). - (c3) A planted dead link is detected (W0). - Planted in tmp_path: a synthetic guides/p.md with one live link to a sibling file the fixture creates, one dead link [x](no_such_page.md), and one link-shaped [y](also_missing.md) inside a fenced code block. - With --docs-root <tmp>/guides --check-links, the checker must read dead == 1 exactly: not 0, which would be a blind pass, and not 2, which would mean fences are not skipped. - The same tree without --check-links is printed only: predicted dead=0, the pre-extension blindness the item exists to close. - Asserted, by construction (OPS-19 precedent, as (c1)). The review may relabel it. - (c4) One parameter changed, executed end to end (W1). - Planted: the extracted block with degree=1 added to its single Study(...) call by AST transform (ast.unparse), then exec'd for real at -n 2. - Asserted: - |SAR_planted − WF15_DEG2_RECORD| / WF15_DEG2_RECORD > L0_BAND. Backing: the same Study call at degree 1 on this fixture read 8.291558128515863e-08 (20261005T170210Z_WF-15-r2-W1-deg1.log:312). That is 3.494 % from the record, ≈ 3.5e7 × the band; the ceiling is not binding. - |SAR_planted − MAT4_DEG1_RECORD| / MAT4_DEG1_RECORD ≤ L0_BAND. Backing: WF-15's (R1) read 6.222e-11 on the same call (…W1-deg1.log:315).

This shows that the exec path really solves the parameters it is given, and that (R)'s comparator can fail.
  • Not re-bought: WF-15's (U) / (P) / (I) Study-against-direct identities and MAT-4's σ-blind control. The tutorial composes the same Study, and those gates stay WF-15's and MAT-4's.

Windows. Foreground. The harness call is the whole Bash command, bare and repo-relative; nothing chained or piped (bash_guard rule 3). Bash timeout: 660000. -s. Node IDs, never -k. Complex windows: source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode + FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 and tests/environment first. PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace. Order matters for rule (i): finish the page first, and re-run W0 after any page edit. W2 runs last, and no file it reads is edited after it. - W0, docs, extraction, (K) and the planted controls, plus the rule (c) re-run of the checker's exit-code contract. Smoke: real build, serial (the shape WF-14's W3 used). Predicted ≈ 15 s; the exit-code module alone took 10 s, 27 passed (20260921T111239Z_OPS-59.log.gz). The complex nodes skip here by design.

Traps already paid for. - Never compare a solve output bitwise or by its printed string. Two -n 2 MUMPS solves differ at ≈ 1e-11 across processes (W2b 2.633e-11; known-issues.md:81, SOLVE_FLOOR_RECORD), and the .10e print of this value sits 4.8e-12 from a rounding edge. - Two degree-2 solves never share a 590 s window on this fixture at -n 2 (item 240). This item has one per window by construction. Do not add a direct-call comparison to W2. - Price a degree-2 window by the fixture's own measurement (item 240's 1.8× miss): the price above is WF-15's own. - TimeHarmonicSolver(problem) silently means degree 1 (core/time_harmonic.py:318). (Deg) and (K)'s no-degree= AST check catch a fall-through. - Rule (i) bites harder here than usual: the page is the test's input. Why a new page, not a section of tuned_copper_birdcage.md. Steps 3 and 4 each made one page per tutorial with its own test module (four_port_s.md / temperature.md / tuned_copper_birdcage.md). Step 4's (X) asserts exactly one ```python block per tag and one Study( call on its page, and that page is closed under rule (i) by 20261012T003232Z_WF-17-step4-W1.log; adding a block to it would re-open step 4's W0 / W1 (a second 150 s heavy window) for no new reading. The page (headings as tuned_copper_birdcage.md: # The tuned copper birdcage from a YAML file, ## What you will compute, ## Before you start, ## The study file, ## Run it, ## What you should see, ## What this does not show, ## How this page is tested). Prose quotes no number beyond the record. - "What you will compute": the same coil as tuned_copper_birdcage.md, described in a study file instead of Python; femem run solves it once and writes a JSON summary (prose, never a file name) with the node S, the active admittances Y_in per sense, the 10 g SAR at 19 ball centres and |B₁⁺| at two points. - The 19th centre (390a's finding, stated, not hidden): the file's centre 19 is M(c*), the image of c* under the feed-bisector mirror (56.25°), which maps az 11.25° onto 101.25° — it coincides bit for bit with lattice row 6 (r = 45 mm, az₁₇ + 90°, index 5), so it is not an independent centre; it is listed so the summary carries the cw reading at the mirror image beside c*'s ccw reading. The page never presents it as a nineteenth sample. - "Before you start": complex build; 8 MPI ranks, ≈ 4–5 min; the file sets degree: 1 (an omitted degree means the Study default, 2 — which this coil cannot afford here). - The YAML block (tag f-human-tuned-copper, fence ```yaml f-human-tuned-copper): the tracked file's 45 lines verbatim, its provenance comment line included.
