U144 (item 904, WF-15 step 18) gated MAT-17's duty identities through the Study at its default EM degree 2 on the EM sphere; U132 (item 863, step 16) gated the continuous transient there. U133's page, docs/guide/sphere_heating_transient.md, still opens "What this does not show" with "No degree 2" (:202) and tells the reader to set degree=1 (:30–31), so a reader who omits degree= runs a gated path the page does not show. This step is that page's default-degree section, Python only, as U143 (item 903) was its duty section at degree 1. Not a fence move: "No degree 2" is page prose, not a code refusal; no test pins it (git grep -n "No degree 2" -- tests/ read empty at this review); U143's "Not claimed: degree 2 (item 904's)" pointed at item 904, now landed. No record is pinned: U132 / U144 left the degree-2 (A_t) 1.6447e-03 "printed, not pinned" (tests/package/test_wf15_study_sphere_transient.py:42, :522, :625); this step asserts bands only and puts no degree-2 digit on the page. Provisional until the weekly ratifies or reverts it. WF-17 step 37. Family U145, attempt 1 of 4. Depends on nothing (items 903 and 904 are on main).

Code (docs + tests only; no src edit; the _study_temperature docstring stays "gated … at EM degree 1" — widening it is the weekly's, item 904). - The page gains a section, "At the Study's default degree", directly after "The same heating, pulsed" (ends :165) and before "The same two runs from YAML files" (:167). - One ```python sphere-transient-degree2 block, self-contained: the duty block's lines (:113–149) verbatim, except that the Study( call carries no degree= keyword (Study(geometry, material, field, frequency_hz=64e6, density_kg_m3=1000.0)), plus one final line print(f"study degree = {study.degree}"). Exactly one Study(, one DutyCycle(, no probe. Never write degree=2 on the page: the section's point is the default, and (X) checks the absence. - One ```text sphere-transient-degree2-output block: exactly sphere cells = 19496 and study degree = 2. No other digit: the degree-2 (A_t) and the U144 records (D·P1 0.961467, closed-form duty 1.8120e-03) are printed records, not pins, and stay off the page. - Prose: without degree= the field is solved with second-order elements (the default) while the heat equation stays first-order; the test checks the continuous run against the same closed-form series and band (0.11) as "What you should see", the pulsed run against the Duhamel superposition (band 1e-12), and that the pulsed run is not the continuous closed form; cost ≈ 5 min and ≈ 21 GiB summed over 2 ranks (U144's W1: 250 s, 21.25 GiB, 20261109T121856Z_WF-15-s18-W1.log:161; WF-15.md:1669). - "Before you start": the degree=1 bullet gains "(except in "At the Study's default degree")"; the cost bullet gains the section's cost. - "What this does not show": "No degree 2," becomes "Degree 2 from Python only, with no degree-2 record on the page (its test asserts the bands),". The rest of the sentence is unchanged. - "How this page is tested" gains one sentence naming the new module. - New module tests/package/test_wf17_sphere_transient_degree2_tutorial.py, knob FEM_EM_WF17_S37, scratch logs/wf17/s37/, complex build. Imports by name, never copied: - extract_tagged_block, exec_block, _study_calls, LINK_PASS_RE, _checker_stdout from tests.package.test_wf17_first_study_tutorial; run_checker from tests.unit.test_doc_reference_exit_codes; - PAGE, MIN_GUIDE_PAGES, STUDY_FIELDS, SPEC_FIELDS, COOL_FIELDS, EXPECTED_A from tests.package.test_wf17_sphere_transient_tutorial (:85–99); EXPECTED_DUTY from tests.package.test_wf17_sphere_transient_duty_tutorial (:99); - _study, _census, _whole_rel, L_BAND, A_BAND, E_BAND, G, K, H, T_STAR, N_MAIN, MAT10_SUB_CELLS, _space_degree, _on_space, _chi_string, _exact_theta, MAT12_A_T_PRINT, U135_CHI_PRINT, U132_A_T_DEG2_PRINT from tests.package.test_wf15_study_sphere_transient (:76–129, :519–522). - Its own spy and comparator. U143's _mismatches hard-codes _study(degree=1) (test_wf17_sphere_transient_duty_tutorial.py:122) and its _exec_no_solve writes to s36's scratch (:163): write this module's own pair against _study() (the default) and s37; never edit U133's or U143's module.

Gates (asserted; bands imported, none set). - W0, no solve: - (X) Exactly one sphere-transient-degree2 block, with one Study( (_study_calls) whose AST call has no degree keyword, one DutyCycle(, and no probe. - (K) With Study.solve stubbed and Study.temperature spied (recording duty from **kw): the block's Study equals _study() on STUDY_FIELDS (so degree == 2); the cooling equals RobinCooling(K, H, 0.0, source_scale=G) on COOL_FIELDS; call 1's spec equals EXPECTED_A with duty None; call 2's spec equals EXPECTED_A with duty == EXPECTED_DUTY. - (E) The sphere-transient-degree2-output block is exactly the two lines sphere cells = {MAT10_SUB_CELLS} and study degree = 2. - (D) docrefs --docs-root docs/guide --check-links reads dead 0, and MIN_GUIDE_PAGES holds (no new page; 77 pages at item 908's Wdoc-refs). - W1 (knob set; exec the block from logs/wf17/s37/): - (Deg) study.degree == res.degree == 2, and _space_degree(res.fields.e_complex.function_space) == 2 (U144 read 2 / 2 / 2, 20261109T121856Z_WF-15-s18-W1.log:133). - (Once) study.result is res after both calls. (UT) sub cells == MAT10_SUB_CELLS on heating and pulsed. - (χ) Every pulsed.source_multipliers entry is in {0, 1}, and _chi_string equals U135_CHI_PRINT (U144 identical, :135). - (S0) _census(pulsed, dt, 2, T_STAR / 2, …). - (Δ) θ_pulsed against Σ_m (−1)^m θ_{H_m} ≤ L_BAND: ten direct solve_transient_conduction runs on pulsed.mesh with pulsed.q, built test-side exactly as U144's node (test_wf15_study_sphere_transient.py:526–…). U144 read 6.638e-16 (:139). - (A_t) heating's interior relative L2 against _exact_theta at T_STAR, on heating's own submesh, ≤ A_BAND. Its .4e is printed beside U132_A_T_DEG2_PRINT and beside MAT12_A_T_PRINT; no .4e equality is asserted. Predicted 1.6447e-03 (U132's continuous record; U144's D = 1 read the same, :143). - (E) Every run (2 from the block, 10 direct) ≤ E_BAND. On rank 0, both output lines are in the captured stdout.

Controls (asserted). - (Δ-ctl) Dropping m = 9 misses L_BAND. U144 read 0.284784 (:140). - (c-sched) θ_pulsed against the continuous series θ_cf(t*) misses A_BAND. U144 read 5.1677e-01 (:144). Ceiling: a D = 0.5 schedule sits ≈ 0.5 from the continuous series (≈ 4.7× A_BAND 0.11), so the control is asserted as a miss, never as a factor. A Study that dropped duty at degree 2 would read ≈ 1.6e-03 and pass. - (c-deg) At W0, a planted , degree=1 in the block's Study( call makes (K)'s mismatch list exactly the degree field (['study.degree']) and fires (X)'s keyword check. This is the separation the page needs: a degree-1 block passes every W1 identity, and only (Deg) / (c-deg) tell them apart. Printed at W1, not asserted: the degree-2 (A_t) beside degree 1's 3.4708e-02 (≈ 21× apart on U132 / U131's records). - (c-page) A removed or doubled sphere-transient-degree2 tag raises LookupError.

Windows. Complex build. Every window is bare and foreground, Bash timeout 660000 ms. docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 must read 0 before W1. - W0: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-17-s37-W0 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 120 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/package/test_wf17_sphere_transient_degree2_tutorial.py -v -s --tb=short'" (U143's W0: 10 passed / 1 skipped per rank, 20261109T120906Z_WF-17-s36-W0.log.) - W1 (durable capture, as U144's W1): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-17-s37-W1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_WF17_S37=1 PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 600 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/package/test_wf17_sphere_transient_degree2_tutorial.py -v -s --tb=short > /workspace/logs/wf17-s37-w1-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/wf17-s37-w1-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/wf17-s37-w1-raw.log; exit \$rc'" - Price: U144's W1 took 250 s: degree-2 EM 230.0 s, three Study transients 3.1 s, ten direct runs 8.6 s, 21.25 GiB summed (20261109T121856Z_WF-15-s18-W1.log:133, :161; WF-15.md:1669). U142's degree-2 EM read 279.5 s on the same sphere (20261109T122639Z_WF-15-s14c-W1.log). This runs one degree-2 EM, two block transients and ten direct runs. Predicted 250–310 s. A kill parks the item; never raise the ceiling. - Wreg (U133's, U136's and U143's modules, knobs unset; their (X), (K), (E), (c-K), (c-page), (D) must stay green on the edited page): U143's Wreg (20261109T121003Z_WF-17-s36-Wreg.log:12) relabelled, with tests/package/test_wf17_sphere_transient_duty_tutorial.py appended. - Wdoc: tests/package/test_wf14_validation_page.py as 20261109T121016Z_WF-17-s36-Wdoc.log:12, label WF-17-s37-Wdoc; then the docrefs command (20261109T104335Z_WF-17-s32p-Wdoc-refs.log:12), label WF-17-s37-Wdoc-refs, reading 0 dead.

Tier. Heavy by measurement (W1 ≈ 250–310 s), complex, -n 2. Class: chain step (solve). Cost: ≈ 7.4 measured (chain-solve median at the 10:30 review) / 40 predicted min.

Traps already paid for. - The 300 s ceiling has killed a degree-2 node (item 884's Wreg, 20261108T224242Z_WF-15-s14p-Wreg.log:224–228; WF-15.md:1585). W1 runs at -k 30 600. Wreg must never include a W1 knob. - One degree-2 EM solve only. (Once) after both calls; ten direct runs reuse pulsed.q, never a second Study. - Tag collisions. The opener matches the exact line (test_wf17_first_study_tutorial.py:78–90), so sphere-transient-degree2 does not collide with sphere-transient or sphere-transient-duty. U133's and U143's one-Study( / no-probe asserts read their own tags only. - No ```yaml fence. The estimate table's study-fence census is pinned (item 887's trap). - No untested digit on the page: two literal output lines, the bands already on the page (0.11, 1e-12), and the cost with ≈. - The schedule. period = 8 * dt on the page; EXPECTED_DUTY in (K). Check the χ string (study.py:2166–2167). - The MAT-15 time base. Never import MAT-17 step 3's _chi_duty, _heaviside, _transient_s, DT or HALF (item 877). - Late binding in the direct-run lambdas: tm as a default. Each temperature call rebuilds the submesh: compare on pulsed's space; (A_t) on heating's. - T∞ = 0. exec_block runs from the scratch directory. capsys swallows prints: use -s. Count verdicts per rank. Durable capture with the trailing ; exit $rc. A killed compile leaves an orphan .c: sweep (rubric) only when pgrep -c python3 reads 0.

Scope. One page section and its test: the Study's default EM degree 2, thermal P1, one schedule (P = t*/5, D = 0.5) beside the continuous run, Python only. Not claimed: - a pinned degree-2 (A_t) or any degree-2 digit on the page (the weekly's to promote, U132 / U144); - a YAML degree-2 transient or a YAML duty key (item 891's ruling; U134's files stay study.degree: 1); - the D·P1 fraction or the closed-form duty read as gates; - the _study_temperature docstring widening; - a periodic state; probes; perfusion; a new page.

Negative result. - (Δ) or (A_t) red with (K) and (Deg) green: the page's default-degree block does not reproduce U144 / U132's gates. Print every reading beside U144's, park on attempt/WF-17-s37-*, BLOCKED. - (Deg) red: the Study default moved. Stop, write a known-issues entry; the review rules. - Killed at 600 s: report the EM line and elapsed time, and stop. - Wreg red: the page edit hit a U133 / U136 / U143 pin. Revert the prose edit, keep the section, re-run Wreg once. - No PREDICTED RED: line.

Status it can move. - WF-17 gains step 37 (a record on its ✅ row); §10 U145 becomes DONE. - The sphere page's "No degree 2" is answered by a tested section on the Study's default path; the page no longer leaves the default unshown.

Depends on: nothing.

Executor spawn prompt (verbatim, if delegated). "Execute §9 item 927 — WF-17 step 37 / U145 — per docs/planning/chunks/WF-17.md "§9 item 927". Docs + tests only, no src edit. The new block's Study( carries no degree= keyword; the output block is exactly sphere cells = 19496 and study degree = 2; no degree-2 digit on the page and no .4e equality on (A_t). Write this module's own spy and comparator against _study(); never edit U133's or U143's module. Move no band. The harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, repo-relative, nothing chained or piped; foreground, Bash timeout: 660000; pgrep -c python3 reads 0 before W1. Do not spawn agents."

Outcome (12:00 slot 2026-11-09, second item): DONE. Executor: implementer, foreground, complex build, -n 2; no src edit; pgrep -c python3 read 0 before W1. W0 20261109T180732Z_WF-17-s37-W0.log 10 passed / 1 skipped per rank, 7 s: (X) one Study(, degree keywords [], one DutyCycle(, no probe; (K) degree 2, mismatches [] against _study(), duties [None, DutyCycle(27.8667, 0.5)]; (c-deg) planted , degree=1 → mismatches ['study.degree'], (X) keywords ['degree']; (c-page) raises; (E) exactly the two lines; (D) dead 0 over 77 pages. W1 20261109T180747Z_WF-17-s37-W1.log 11 passed per rank, VERDICT PASS on ranks 0 and 1, [capture] rc=0, 287 s (:160–183; predicted 250–310 s), beside U144's W1 (20261109T121856Z_WF-15-s18-W1.log): (Deg) 2 / 2 / 2 (U144 2 / 2 / 2), EM solve 264.4 s (U144 230.0 s); (Once) True; (UT) 19496 on heating and pulsed; (χ) binary, string == U135_CHI_PRINT; (S0) rel 0; (Δ) 6.718e-16 ≤ L_BAND (U144 6.638e-16); (Δ-ctl) 0.284784 (U144 0.284784); (A_t) 1.6447014903e-03 → 1.6447e-03 ≤ A_BAND, printed beside U132's 1.6447e-03 and degree 1's 3.4708e-02 (ratio 21.1), not asserted equal; (c-sched) 5.1677e-01 misses A_BAND (U144 5.1677e-01); (E) ≤ 5.395e-15 on 12 runs; both output lines in rank 0's stdout; ten direct runs 9.0 s (U144 8.6 s). Memory not printed by this module. Wreg 20261109T181244Z_WF-17-s37-Wreg.log 19 passed / 3 skipped per rank (U133's, U136's and U143's modules green on the edited page); Wdoc 20261109T181255Z_WF-17-s37-Wdoc.log 10 passed per rank; docrefs 20261109T181311Z_WF-17-s37-Wdoc-refs.log 1719 links over 77 pages, 0 dead.

docs.text:
Written by the 2026-11-09 10:30 daily review under rule (6): chain U's next step toward 9d (tutorials as tests) and 9a ("gated results reproduced through the API within their unmoved bands"), in the class of U141 / U142 (items 901 / 902: landed nodes with no run on the post-merge tree). Three thermal guide pages' solve nodes have not run since they landed, while the code under them was edited by six merges. Provisional until the weekly ratifies or reverts it. WF-17 step 38. Family U146, attempt 1 of 4. Depends on nothing.

Executes §10 U146: the solve nodes of temperature.md, duty_cycle_and_container_wall.md and gel_sphere_heating_from_yaml.md, plus WF-15 step 3's duty node, re-run unedited on the current tree. Facts verified at this review (log search by module and node name over docs/testing/logs/*.log and *.log.gz): - test_wf17_more_tutorials.py::test_wf17_temperature_block_reproduces_mat10 (temperature.md): one run ever, 10-08 (WF-17-step3-W2-temperature, 85 s, docs/testing/test-results.md:3589). Its log is no longer on disk: the 10-25 housekeeping sweep 601ebe25 removed it; it reads at git show 11fe89de:docs/testing/logs/20261008T202852Z_WF-17-step3-W2-temperature.log.gz, line 158: (A) 3.2464e-02 (3.2463961440e-02), (P) 3.1923e-03, (B) 3.208e-15, (C) 1.031e-13, sub cells 19496, block exec 14.8 s. U133's Wreg deselected it with -k "not reproduces" (20261107T181844Z_WF-17-s33-Wreg.log:12). - test_wf17_duty_wall_tutorial.py duty / wall nodes: one run each, 10-23 (20261023T093957Z_WF-17-s11-Wduty.log.gz:63–65, 37 s; 20261023T094100Z_WF-17-s11-Wwall.log.gz:67–69, 65 s). - test_wf17_sphere_heating_tutorial.py heat / probes nodes: one run each, 10-25 (20261025T003906Z_WF-17-s13-Wheat.log.gz:137–138, 18 s; 20261025T003934Z_WF-17-s13-Wprobes.log.gz:137–139, 20 s). - test_wf15_study_transient.py::test_wf15_duty_cycle_reproduces_mat17 (WF-15 step 3, unknobbed): last run 10-14 (20261014T010524Z_WF-1-s10a-RG12-wf15-transient.log.gz:88–99, leg 54.5 s). Its wall sibling re-ran 11-05 and 11-08 (20261105T210709Z_WF-1-s28-Wreg-r.log, 20261108T150856Z_WF-1-s30-Wreg-r1.log); the duty node did not. - The code moved under them. _study_transient_temperature (both s11 blocks' route, src/fem_em_solver/study.py:2212) was edited by 2f95023f (step 28) and 7250188c (step 30, dose=). _study_temperature's dispatch (:1601–1668; the steady route of temperature.md and of the s13 files) by 1ac87dd4, a94b2bce, 5fa1aa62, 7250188c and b05bdc1d. _parse_thermal (src/fem_em_solver/study_yaml.py:698–735; the s13 files' parse) gained the rod and sphere-transient branches in b05bdc1d and 089e99f3. No page or module named here changed since its run, apart from a link sentence in temperature.md (4516c47e, prose).

Code. None. No src, test, page, envelope or YAML edit; every node runs as committed.

Gates (each node's own, unedited; bands imported there, none set here). - temperature.md: (K) mismatches [], degree 1; (Once); sub cells == MAT10_SUB_CELLS 19496; (A) .4e == MAT10_A_PRINT 3.2464e-02 and ≤ A_BAND; (P) .4e == MAT10_P_PRINT 3.1923e-03 and ≤ P_BAND; (B) ≤ B_BAND; (C) ≤ C_BAND; rank 0's stdout carries sphere cells = 19496 (test_wf17_more_tutorials.py:306–349). - s11 duty: (UT) cells / geometry equal; (G) interior ≤ 1e-2 (prior 4.3869840018e-04), balance ≤ 1e-9; (R) 4.3870e-04 == MAT17_A_PRINT. - s11 wall: cell guard 215 542 ≤ 400 000; (UT) = MAT18_T1_CELLS; (G) prior 8.2066325346e-04; (R) 8.2066e-04 == MAT18_T1_PRINT. - s13 heat: copied file sha256 = tracked; one spy call, degree 1; (H) 19496; (A) 3.2464e-02, (P) 3.1923e-03 at .4e; (B), (C) in band. - s13 probes: (Pr) whole-ball identity ≤ B_BAND (priors 1.359e-15 / 1.221e-15); summary values_k == ball_average exactly. - WF-15 step 3 duty: cases A and B — (UT), (S0), (IT) ≤ L0_BAND (priors 8.146e-15 / 2.542e-14), (G) ≤ 1e-2 and balance ≤ 1e-9, (R) 4.3870e-04 / 1.0683e-03 at .4e.

Negative controls (the nodes', asserted). A blind or mis-wired route reads like these: - s11 (c1) duty dropped: miss 9.7087e-01 against 1e-2 (…s11-Wduty.log.gz:65), and the WF-15 node's (c1) the same (…RG12…log.gz:98). Ceiling: dropping a D = 0.5 schedule roughly doubles the deposited heat, so a miss near 1 is the most this fixture can show (≈ 97× the band). - s11 (c2) wall ρc = RC1: 5.3140e-02 against 1e-2 (…s11-Wwall.log.gz:69). - s13 (c-2G) doubled source: 1.0649e+00 against A_BAND 0.11, 9.7× (…s13-Wheat.log.gz:138). Ceiling: doubling G doubles θ, so the miss saturates near 1 + (A) ≈ 1.03; ≈ 9.7× is the most this band can show. It is the solve-backed control for the shared steady route; the temperature.md node has solve-free controls only (step 3's review ruling (3), WF-17.md:464), so its separation is the .4e equality of (A) / (P). - s13 (c-c₂) +0.1 mm: 7.5333e-03 (…s13-Wprobes.log.gz:139).

Windows. Every window is bare and foreground, -n 2, Bash timeout 660000 ms. docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 must read 0 before each. The s11 knob takes one value per run, so duty and wall are two windows; the s11 / WF-15 step 3 records are real-build digits (test_wf17_duty_wall_tutorial.py:204), the s13 / temperature.md ones complex. - Wr-duty (real; s11's no-solve nodes, its duty block, and the WF-15 duty node; predicted 95–120 s): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-17-s38-Wr-duty "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_WF17_S11=duty timeout -k 30 180 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/package/test_wf17_duty_wall_tutorial.py tests/package/test_wf15_study_transient.py::test_wf15_duty_cycle_reproduces_mat17 -s -v --tb=short'" - Wr-wall (real; prior 65 s): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-17-s38-Wr-wall "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_WF17_S11=wall timeout -k 30 180 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/package/test_wf17_duty_wall_tutorial.py::test_wf17_s11_wall_block_reproduces_mat18_t1 -s -v --tb=short'" - Wc-heat (complex; s13's no-solve nodes, its heat block and the temperature.md block; predicted 40–70 s, from 18 s and the 14.8 s block exec): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-17-s38-Wc-heat "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_WF17_S13=heat timeout -k 30 180 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/package/test_wf17_sphere_heating_tutorial.py tests/package/test_wf17_more_tutorials.py::test_wf17_temperature_block_reproduces_mat10 -s -v --tb=short'" - Wc-probes (complex; prior 20 s): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-17-s38-Wc-probes "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_WF17_S13=probes timeout -k 30 180 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/package/test_wf17_sphere_heating_tutorial.py::test_wf17_s13_probes_block_reproduces_mat19 -s -v --tb=short'"

Tier. Standard (every window ≤ 120 s predicted against 180 s), -n 2, real and complex. Class: chain step (solve). Cost: ≈ 7.4 measured (chain-solve median at the 10:30 review) / 25 predicted min.

docs.title: §9 item 941 — 2026-11-10 (§10 U152, chain U, 9d — rule (4), the 11-09 weekly's step; WF-17 step 43, the implant page's YAML heating section as a test; chain step (solve))
docs.text:
Written by the 2026-11-10 03:00 daily review from the 11-09 weekly's enumerated §10 U152. Not provisional. Family U152, attempt 1 of 4. Depends on nothing: its duty clause is written so that it holds whether or not item 937 (U147) has landed (below).

Executes §10 U152: the rod four-port thermal: file of U127′ (tests/package/wf15/rod_heating.yaml) through run_study_file; (Y) YAML = Study at IDENTITY_BAND on the tip R_Π rows and the global (S2); the check block refuses duty on that route; docrefs 0 dead.

Two premises made exact (returned to the weekly; no target moved). 1. The page already runs the file at t*. Item 908 (U128) put the implant-rod-heating-file block on the page (docs/guide/implant_rod_in_a_study.md:207–213) and asserts (Y) on the tip θ̄(t*) of a 40-step CN run at IDENTITY_BAND (tests/package/test_wf17_implant_rod_heating_tutorial.py:316, :348). The R_Π rows and the global (S2) are one-step backward-Euler readings (item 884: be10 = st.temperature(…, transient=_be(DT_1 / 10.0), …), tests/package/test_wf15_study_rod_heating.py:262–263, :372–392), which the CN file cannot give. So the new section runs the same file with its transient replaced by one BE step of Δt₁/10 (dt_s: 3.135, n_steps: 1, theta: 1.0, startup_half_steps: 0, i.e. _be(DT_1 / 10.0), :101–103). Both readings are at Δt₁/10: the tip R_Π gate's own Δt (884's (S2-tip)), and the global (S2) there (884 printed 4.8365e-07 at Δt₁/10 and gated 4.8353e-06 at Δt₁, 20261108T223537Z_WF-15-s14p-W1.log:5676). A YAML (S2) at Δt₁ would need a second file run (a second EM solve, ≈ 90 s); the weekly may pose it. 2. The check block's refusal does not depend on U147. On the rod route duty is not silently dropped: _parse_thermal_rod refuses thermal.duty as an unknown key (src/fem_em_solver/study_yaml.py:859–860 → _unknown, :274–281: field thermal.duty, reason unknown key (allowed: …)), and the Python rod route refuses duty= with ValueError (src/fem_em_solver/study.py:1649–1650). U147 (item 937) edits only the tuned two-port hook branch (:1653–1656), which neither the rod file nor femem check reaches. So both branches assert the same thing: (Ref) StudyConfigError.field == "thermal.duty" and rc 2 on both ranks. If item 937 has landed, (Ref) still reads the unknown-key refusal (print its reason); if it has not, the same. There is no silent drop on this route to record.

Code (docs + tests only; no src edit). - The page gains a section, "One step from the study file", after the heating section's closing sentence (:224–225) and before "What this does not tell you" (:227): - One ```python implant-rod-heating-step block: from fem_em_solver.study_yaml import run_study_file; run = run_study_file("rod_heating_step.yaml"); t = run.summary["temperature"]; print t["volume_mean_k"][1] and each ball's theta_k[1] at .6e. Exactly one run_study_file(, no Study(, no probe. - One ```bash implant-rod-heating-check block: femem check malformed_rod_heating_duty.yaml. - Prose: rod_heating_step.yaml is the tracked file with source_scale: <1/P> (as above) and its transient: replaced by one backward-Euler step: dt_s: 3.135, n_steps: 1, theta: 1.0, startup_half_steps: 0. The test checks that the step's tip and volume heating slopes equal the Python route's one step to the identity band, and each meets the slope band already on the page. Links the malformed file; says a thermal.duty key is refused on the rod file. - No ```yaml fence; no digit beyond the four transient values (each pinned by W0's (In)). The bands block and the closing sentence stay byte-identical. - "How this page is tested" gains one sentence naming the new module. - New tracked file tests/package/wf15/malformed_rod_heating_duty.yaml: rod_heating.yaml verbatim plus duty: {period_s: 250.8, duty: 0.5} under thermal:, and a header comment naming item 941. (tests/package/ YAMLs are outside the estimate table's discovery, scripts/docs/generate_estimate_page.py:56, :108–115; test_wf1_check_family.py:32 globs wf1/ only.) - New module tests/package/test_wf17_implant_rod_heating_yaml_tutorial.py, knob FEM_EM_WF17_S43 (only unset or 1), scratch logs/wf17/s43/, complex build, comm.size == 2. Imports by name, never copied: - PAGE, _exec_block, _scratch, MIN_GUIDE_PAGES (66, :77) from tests.package.test_wf17_implant_rod_tutorial; extract_tagged_block, LINK_PASS_RE, _checker_stdout from tests.package.test_wf17_first_study_tutorial; run_checker from tests.unit.test_doc_reference_exit_codes; - HEAT_TAG from tests.package.test_wf17_implant_rod_heating_tutorial; - _be, _yaml_mapping, _ball_comparands from tests.package.test_wf15_study_rod_heating (_ball_comparands(d, None) reads d["res"], d["G"], d["be10"] only, :444–462); - _tip_slope_rows from tests.validation.test_geo36_rod_f_clinical_heating; TIPS, IDENTITY_BAND, PHANTOM_CELL_TAG, DT_1, RHO_C, S2_BAND, E_BAND, ROD_EXACT_CELL_RECORD from their sources as item 908's module imports them (test_wf17_implant_rod_heating_tutorial.py:36–68).

The run (W1, FEM_EM_WF17_S43=1). 1. Exec the page's implant-rod-heating block (item 908's way, :267): one EM solve, ns["P"], ns["cooling"] (scale G = 1/P), ns["study"] with cached fields. 2. Study side: be10 = study.temperature(ns["cooling"], transient=_be(DT_1 / 10.0), balls={"mass_g": 1.0, "centres": ns["tips"]}, drive="P1") and be = …_be() (Δt₁; for the control only). No second EM solve. 3. Comparands: comps = _ball_comparands({"res": study.fields_result, "G": 1.0 / ns["P"], "be10": be10}, None); V_sub from the Study's phantom submesh (item 908's lines :276–279). 4. YAML side: rank 0 writes _scratch("step-src")/rod_heating_step.yaml from _yaml_mapping() with thermal.source_scale = 1.0 / float(ns["P"]) and thermal.transient = {dt_s: DT_1 / 10.0, n_steps: 1, rho_c_j_per_m3_k: RHO_C, theta: 1.0, startup_half_steps: 0}; Barrier; exec the step block with its one file name replaced by that path (item 908's form, :289–299). summ = run.summary["temperature"]. 5. Rows: rS = _tip_slope_rows({n: be10.balls[i]["theta_k"][1]}, DT_1 / 10.0, comps, RHO_C) and rY the same on summ["balls"][i]["theta_k"][1]; global ratios sS = ρc·⟨θ¹⟩_V / (Δt₁/10 · P_src / V_sub) on be10.volume_mean_k[1] / be10.source_power_w, sY on summ["volume_mean_k"][1] / summ["source_power_w"].

Gates (asserted; bands imported, none set). - W0, no mesh: - (X) Exactly one implant-rod-heating-step block: one run_study_file(, no Study(, no probe; the file name "rod_heating_step.yaml" appears once. The page has no ```yaml fence beyond implant-rod-file. - (In) The prose's four transient values equal _be(DT_1 / 10.0)'s fields (dt_s within IDENTITY_BAND relative, the others exactly). - (Ref) load_study(malformed_rod_heating_duty.yaml) raises StudyConfigError with .field == "thermal.duty"; cli.main(["check", …]) returns rc 2 on both ranks. Print the reason. - (D) docrefs --docs-root docs/guide --check-links dead 0; MIN_GUIDE_PAGES holds (no new page). - W1: - (Scale) precondition: summ["source_scale"] == ns["cooling"].source_scale exactly, and summ["n_steps"] == 1, summ["theta"] == 1.0. - (Cells) run.summary["cells"] == ROD_EXACT_CELL_RECORD (168 507). - (E) be10.max_balance_residual and summ["max_balance_residual"] ≤ E_BAND. - (Y-Π) the anchor: per tip, |r_Y − r_S| ≤ IDENTITY_BAND, where r = ρc⟨θ¹⟩_B / (Δt⟨Πq⟩_B) is the ratio whose |r − 1| is the R_Π row (_tip_slope_rows), both routes read against the one comparand comps. This is the per-tip θ¹ identity in the row's own form (item 884's (Y) read 1.066e-14 / 2.687e-14 on θ(t*), …s14p-W1.log:5683–5684). - (Y-S2) |s − s_S≤ IDENTITY_BAND on the global ratio. - (Band) R_Π ≤ S2_BAND per tip and |s − 1| ≤ S2_BAND, on both routes (884's gates, unmoved).

Negative control (asserted). (c-dt) the YAML step's r_Y against the Study's Δt₁ step be (same comparand, Δt₁ in the ratio): misses IDENTITY_BAND. Ceiling: R_Π at Δt₁ is 1.3407e-04 / 9.6450e-05 against 1.3394e-05 / 9.6264e-06 at Δt₁/10 (…s14p-W1.log:5677–5678), so the miss is ≈ 1.2e-04 / 8.7e-05, ≈ 1e8 × IDENTITY_BAND, the most a one-step Δt error can show here; asserted as a miss, never as a factor. A file that ignored its transient: and ran the CN default would fail (Scale) / (Y-Π) by the same order. (c-page) a removed or doubled step tag raises LookupError.

Printed (records, no assertion). R_Π per tip on both routes beside 884's 1.3394e-05 / 9.6264e-06 (…s14p-W1.log:5677–5678); |s − 1| on both routes beside 884's 4.8365e-07 (:5676); P beside 1.646387247816e-06 W (:5674); the block's θ(t*) per tip (unchanged from item 908, not re-gated here).

Windows. Complex build. Every window is bare and foreground, Bash timeout 660000 ms. docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T fem-em-solver pgrep -c python3 must read 0 before W1. - W0: scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-17-s43-W0 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 120 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/package/test_wf17_implant_rod_heating_yaml_tutorial.py -v -s --tb=short'" - W1 (durable capture): scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-17-s43-W1 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && source /usr/local/bin/dolfinx-complex-mode && FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1 FEM_EM_WF17_S43=1 PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src:/workspace timeout -k 30 420 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -m pytest tests/environment/test_complex_mode.py tests/package/test_wf17_implant_rod_heating_yaml_tutorial.py -v -s --tb=short > /workspace/logs/wf17-s43-w1-raw.log 2>&1; rc=\$?; echo \"[capture] rc=\$rc\" >> /workspace/logs/wf17-s43-w1-raw.log; cat /workspace/logs/wf17-s43-w1-raw.log; exit \$rc'" - Price: item 908's W1: heating block 100.2 s, BE step 3.3 s, file block (EM + 40-step CN) 92.2 s (20261109T103942Z_WF-17-s32p-W1.log). This window runs the heating block, two BE steps, one projection on ≈ 52 k gel cells, and the file once with one BE step (an EM solve, ≈ 70–90 s). Predicted 180–230 s. A kill parks the item; never raise the ceiling. - Wreg (knobs unset; the page edit must not hit a step-25 / 28 / 32 pin): 20261109T104310Z_WF-17-s32p-Wreg.log:12 relabelled WF-17-s43-Wreg, with tests/package/test_wf17_implant_rod_heating_tutorial.py appended (its W0 nodes; prior 5 passed / 1 skipped, 20261109T103931Z_WF-17-s32p-W0.log). - Wdoc: 20261109T104319Z_WF-17-s32p-Wdoc.log:12 relabelled WF-17-s43-Wdoc; then 20261109T104335Z_WF-17-s32p-Wdoc-refs.log:12 relabelled WF-17-s43-Wdoc-refs, reading dead 0.

Tier. Heavy by measurement (W1 ≈ 180–230 s), complex, -n 2 (posed standard; item 908's same-shape W1 read 199 s). Class: chain step (solve). Cost: ≈ 7.4 measured / 40 predicted min.

Traps already paid for. - _exec_block wipes its scratch (20261109T014948Z_WF-17-s32-W1.log:1910): write the step file under its own _scratch("step-src"), then replace the block's one file name by that path. - No tracked file carries 1/P (the leak hook flags ≥ 8 significant digits); the step YAML lives under the gitignored logs/ only. 3.135 (four digits) is the only new literal on the page. - A unique projection tag: _ball_comparands uses "u127p_R"; never run item 884's W1 in the same process (a reused PETSc prefix collides). - No ```yaml fence (the estimate table's census is pinned, item 887's trap). Tag openers match the exact line, so implant-rod-heating-step / -check do not collide with implant-rod-heating / -file / -bands. - The (N) tokens stay ("No two-port drive", "No 1 g rung", "No published comparand", "No tissue"); no "AED" / "HFSS" on the page (test_wf17_implant_rod_tutorial.py:196–199). - Rank 0 writes, every rank waits at Barrier; yaml.safe_dump round-trips floats by repr ((Scale) checks it). Collect every gate before asserting (a rank-0 raise can hang at a Barrier). Count verdicts per rank; use -s; print no S entry. - The bash guard denies a shell grep whose pattern contains the word pytest; search modules with the Grep tool.

Scope. One page section and its test: the rod file through run_study_file as one BE step at Δt₁/10, its tip R_Π rows and global (S2) equal to the Study's, and the thermal.duty refusal. Degree 1, 64 MHz, P1, gel. Not claimed: a YAML (S2) at Δt₁ (premise 1); a duty cycle on the rod route; the tuned two-port route (item 937); two-port drive, compliance, tissue; any band.

Negative result. - (Y-Π) or (Y-S2) red with (Scale) green: the file route and the Study disagree on one BE step. Print both rows beside 884's, park on attempt/WF-17-s43-*, BLOCKED. - (Band) red on one route only: the same finding. docs.title: §9 item 994 — 2026-11-15 (§10 U164, chain U — rule (4), the 11-14 weekly's step; ops)
docs.text:
The 11-14 weekly's own enumerated step (rule (4); PROJECT_PLAN.md:5264–5273), executing the operator directive of 2026-11-14 (a) (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4721–4728, commit 7c2b7bc2: docs on GitHub Pages, "no AED value or private file ever enters the built site"). WF-17 step N (next free step number; read it from the tail of docs/planning/chunks/WF-17.md). Serial on nothing. No solve, no mesh, -n 1.

Anchor. The three assertions of the weekly text: (B) python3 -m mkdocs build --strict exits 0 with zero WARNING lines; (P) the built site carries no path containing aed_results, COMPARISON_private or private/ (the docs/private tree, which builds to <site>/private/); (L) the site's text passes check_private_leak.py's digit scan against the raw AED exports. The build time is printed as a price and never asserted.

PREDICTED RED: (B), and (P) on the tree as it stands. Mechanism, verified 2026-11-15: - (P) red as is. mkdocs.yml (25 lines) sets no docs_dir and no exclude_docs, so the docs directory is all of docs/. MkDocs copies every file under it into the site, whether or not the file is in nav. On this host docs/private/ holds the gitignored adjudication files (.gitignore:139–140; ls docs/private shows ten-plus files), and docs/references/ holds the operator-provided Jin text, both as markdown (jin-fem-3e/, .gitignore:128) and as an .epub. A plain build therefore publishes the private files and a copyrighted book. - (B) red as is. mkdocs is 1.6.1 in the image (measured: python3 -c "import mkdocs; print(mkdocs.__version__)" in the container prints 1.6.1; PyYAML 6.0.3). In 1.6, validation.links.not_found defaults to warn. docs/guide/ alone carries ≈1 540 relative links of the form ](../../src|scripts|tests|examples/…) that point outside docs/, and docs/ as a whole carries ≈1 545 ](../…) links (grep count, 2026-11-15). Each such link is a WARNING, so --strict aborts. What this step can do: fix (P) mechanically and measure (B).

Negative control (asserted). The control runs in tmp_path on a synthetic docs tree, never on the repo: - (c-P): a scratch docs/ with index.md and private/x.md, plus a scratch mkdocs.yml without exclude_docs. Build it, and the (P) checker must find private/ in the site. Then add the repo's exclude_docs block, rebuild, and the checker must find nothing. - (c-L): one line holding a digit string generated at run time (secrets.randbelow, ≥ 10 digits, ≥ 5 distinct, never written to a tracked file), passed with {that string} as the secret set to check_private_leak.scan. It must return exactly one hit. Then the same scan over the real site lines with the real secret set. - (c-B): a scratch page linking ../outside.py under --strict must exit non-zero and print a WARNING line, which shows the warning counter can count.

Tier / ranks / cost. Standard (180 s ceiling), -n 1 (no MPI; a build is rank-free). Real or complex image mode does not matter. The build reads 632 .md files, including the 1.8 MB docs/testing/test-results.md. Prediction: 30–120 s per build, three builds (repo plus the two scratch controls; the scratch builds are seconds). Class: ops (median ≈ 5.1 min). Cost: ≈ 8 predicted min.

Traps. - Never build into site/ in the repo. Use --site-dir <tmp_path>/site. site/ is gitignored (.gitignore:47), but a built site holding private/ must never sit in the work tree, even an ignored one. - exclude_docs in 1.6 replaces the default exclusions. The default is .* and /templates/. Restate both in the block: .*, /templates/, private/, references/. Prove it with the (c-P) control, not by reading docs. - Excluding references/ is a privacy and copyright exclusion, not a nav choice. docs/references/README.md and birdcage-tuning-literature.md are tracked but go too: the whole directory is excluded so that the gitignored subtree can never slip through. - check_private_leak.py (scripts/testing/, 419 lines) has no scan-a-directory mode. Its CLI modes are staged, --message-file and --audit (:392–405). Import it by path (importlib.util.spec_from_file_location), and feed scan(lines, secrets) (:310–334) (relpath, lineno, text) triples from every text file in the site (.html, .js, .json, .xml, .txt; search/search_index.json holds the full text). Use secret_digits() (:190–194) without published_digits() subtraction (audit semantics: the site is a publication). Report the exit-code meanings of :24–31. - An empty secret set is not a pass (:339–343 prints SKIPPED). In the container the exports exist: examples/ansys_benchmarks/*/aed_results lists 8 directories on this host. Assert len(secrets) > 0 and print the count. Print hit locations only, never the token (:381–383); this output lands in a tracked log. - Count WARNING lines from the build's combined stdout+stderr (subprocess.run(..., capture_output=True, text=True)), with the regex ^WARNING\b per line. In --strict, mkdocs 1.6 prints the warnings and then Aborted with N warnings in strict mode!. Record N and classify the first 20 by message type (link-not-found / nav / other). Never print a private page's content. - docs/guide/api/ pages carry no ::: mkdocstrings directives (grep 2026-11-15), and mkdocs.yml enables only search. Do not add mkdocstrings to plugins: it would import femem, and that is out of scope. - scripts/build_docs.sh runs a bare mkdocs build into site/. Leave it untouched, and do not use it.

Scope. Edits allowed: - mkdocs.yml: the exclude_docs block only. - The new test module tests/package/test_wf17_docs_build.py. - Plan annotations: the WF-17 chunk file outcome, §10 U164 and the §9 row.

Not licensed: - any validation: block or other downgrade of a warning to info. That is loosening the (B) assertion; hard rule. - any rewrite of the ≈1 540 outbound links, or any generator edit. - any nav change. - site_url, which is U165's. - any .github/ edit.

Not claimed: a hosted site, a published URL, a nav that covers the guide.

Negative result. - (B) red after the exclusion, as predicted. The step's result is the measured warning census: N in total, the per-class counts, and the first 20 lines (paths only). Land the exclude_docs edit and the test module with (P), (L) and the three controls asserted. Mark (B) as pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason="U164: N strict warnings, link-not-found; re-posed to the weekly"). A strict xfail flips red the day the warnings reach 0, so it is not a loosening. Write it up in known-issues. The re-pose goes to the 11-16 weekly, and the operator has to choose: - rewrite outbound links to absolute repo_url blob links; - narrow docs_dir to a site-only tree; - or rule a validation policy. - If the review reads the xfail as a loosening, park the test on attempt/* instead and land only the measurement. - (P) or (L) red after the exclusion ⇒ stop, file it in known-issues, commit nothing that builds a site. - mkdocs not importable ⇒ that finding is the result, not a red. It is an operator item: the docs extra in the image. Measured 2026-11-15, mkdocs imports, so this branch is not expected.

Status it can move. WF-17 (✅) gains step N as a record. §10 U164 DONE, either green on all of (B)/(P)/(L) or DONE-with-negative-result as above. The directive's "no private file enters the site" becomes a mechanism.

Facts verified (2026-11-15). - docker/Dockerfile:22–24: mkdocs, mkdocs-material, "mkdocstrings[python]" (pyyaml at :15). The container imports mkdocs, material, mkdocstrings and yaml, at mkdocs 1.6.1 and PyYAML 6.0.3. - pyproject.toml:57–61: docs extra = mkdocs>=1.5.0, mkdocs-material>=9.0.0, mkdocstrings[python]>=0.22.0. - mkdocs.yml: 25 lines; nav has 6 pages (index.md, status/dashboard.md, status.md, validation/helmholtz.md, testing/known-issues.md, testing/test-results.md); plugins: [search]; no site_url, docs_dir or exclude_docs. - docs/: 632 .md files, ≈140 MB on disk; docs/private/ and docs/references/jin-fem-3e/ are present on this host. - .github/workflows/ci.yml:363–385 already has a docs job (mkdocs build --strict, then a peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3 deploy on main). It is U165's concern, but it means the same strict build would be red on a runner too, whenever origin is pushed.

Files. - New: tests/package/test_wf17_docs_build.py. - Edited: mkdocs.yml (the exclude_docs block). - New logs: docs/testing/logs/*_WF-17-u164-*.log, plus test-results.md rows. - Plan: the docs/planning/chunks/WF-17.md outcome; PROJECT_PLAN §10 U164 and the §9 row; known-issues if (B) is red.

Windows (each a bare, whole Bash command, foreground, Bash timeout: 300000): 1. W0, the pre-edit control. The test module first, against the unedited mkdocs.yml. Expected: (P) red on private/ and references/ (the pre-step control, disclosed), (B) red. scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-17-u164-W0 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src timeout -k 30 180 python3 -m pytest tests/package/test_wf17_docs_build.py -v --tb=short -s'" 2. W1. Same command, label WF-17-u164-W1, after the exclude_docs edit. Expected: (P), (L) and the controls green; (B) per the census.

Before W0, docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml ps must show the service Up. After each window, check that no site/ directory exists at the repo root (Glob site/*). git status is no check here, because the directory is ignored.

Depends on. Nothing. U165 is independent, but its workflow's --strict build inherits this step's (B) reading.

Outcome commit. test(WF-17): U164 — docs build as a test; exclude private/ and references/ from the site (plus ; strict build red on N link warnings, re-posed if so). The commit carries the test, the mkdocs.yml edit, the logs, the test-results.md rows and the plan/known-issues annotations together.

Executor spawn prompt (verbatim, if delegated). "Execute §9 item 994 — WF-17 U164 — per docs/planning/chunks/WF-17.md "§9 item 994". Write tests/package/test_wf17_docs_build.py: - It builds the repo docs with python3 -m mkdocs build --strict --site-dir <tmp_path>/site (never site/ in the repo). - It asserts (B) exit 0 and zero ^WARNING lines, (P) no site path containing aed_results, COMPARISON_private or private/, and (L) zero hits from check_private_leak.scan over every text file in the site, with secret_digits() non-empty and no published-digit subtraction. - It carries the three scratch-tree negative controls (c-P), (c-L) and (c-B). The (c-L) secret is generated at run time. - It prints the build time and the warning census. It prints locations only, never tokens or private content.

Run W0 against the unedited mkdocs.yml. Then add only an exclude_docs block (.*, /templates/, private/, references/) to mkdocs.yml, and run W1. Do not add a validation: block, rewrite links, touch nav, site_url, .github/ or scripts/build_docs.sh, or enable mkdocstrings. If (B) stays red, record N, mark (B) xfail(strict=True) with the census in the reason, write it up in known-issues and re-pose it to the weekly. If (P) or (L) is red after the exclusion, stop. The harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, repo-relative, nothing chained or piped; foreground, timeout -k 30 180, Bash timeout: 300000. Do not spawn agents. Never push."

docs.title: §9 item 995 — 2026-11-15 (§10 U165, chain U — rule (4), the 11-14 weekly's step; ops)
docs.text:
The 11-14 weekly's own enumerated step (rule (4); PROJECT_PLAN.md:5274–5281), executing the operator directive of 2026-11-14 (a) (PROJECT_PLAN.md:4721–4728, commit 7c2b7bc2). WF-17 step N+1 (or N if item 994 has not landed; read the chunk file tail). Serial on nothing. No solve. A slot never pushes. The publish waits on the operator's manual push, and origin is stale.

Anchor. The weekly's four assertions, in a test that reads only files and runs offline in the container: - (Y) .github/workflows/docs.yml parses with yaml.safe_load. - (T) it triggers on push to main only: branches == ["main"], and no pull_request, schedule, workflow_dispatch or tag trigger. - (I) the install step installs only the docs extra. - (X) no file under .github/workflows/ mentions aed_results, COMPARISON_private, docs/private or private/.

Plus the config half of the step: - (S) mkdocs.yml's site_url is https://tayebzaidi.github.io/precessem/. That URL is derived from repo_url: https://github.com/tayebzaidi/precessem (mkdocs.yml:3). - (A) the deploy uses only official actions: actions/checkout, actions/setup-python, actions/configure-pages, actions/upload-pages-artifact and actions/deploy-pages. Every uses: matches ^actions/. - (D) exactly one Pages deployer exists across .github/workflows/.

Negative control (asserted). Every checker runs on three in-memory YAML strings that each break one rule. Each must be refused by exactly its own checker: - one with pull_request: added (T); - one with pip install ".[docs,dev]" (I); - one with uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3 (A, and D when merged with the real file set).

A fourth string, with a docs/private/x path in a run: line, must trip (X). The real docs.yml must pass all of them.

Tier / ranks / cost. Smoke (30 s ceiling), -n 1, no MPI, no build. Class: ops (median ≈ 5.1 min). Cost: ≈ 6 predicted min.

Traps. - YAML 1.1 parses the bare key on: as boolean True under PyYAML 6.0.3 (in the image; docker/Dockerfile:15). Read the triggers as doc.get("on", doc.get(True)), and assert that exactly one of the two keys exists. Never quote on in the workflow just to please the test: GitHub accepts both forms, and the test must handle the canonical one. - "Installs only the docs extra" cannot be pip install ".[docs]". That installs the package itself and its core dependencies (pyproject.toml:25–39: fenics-dolfinx>=0.11.0,<0.12, petsc4py, slepc4py, gmsh, …), which are not pip-installable on an ubuntu-latest runner. Read the extra from pyproject.toml instead: python -c "import tomllib; print('\n'.join(tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml','rb'))['project']['optional-dependencies']['docs']))" > docs-requirements.txt pip install -r docs-requirements.txt tomllib needs Python ≥ 3.11, so pin python-version: '3.11' or later. Test (I) as follows: - exactly one step runs pip install, and it is -r on the file generated from optional-dependencies']['docs']; - no other pip, conda or apt install step exists.

Also assert from pyproject.toml (parsed with tomllib in the container) that the docs extra is exactly the three pins at :57–61, so a widened extra is caught. - A Pages deployer already exists. .github/workflows/ci.yml:363–385 has a docs job: pip install "mkdocs<2" mkdocs-material "mkdocstrings[python]" (not the extra), then mkdocs build --strict, then peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3 (third-party, pushing a gh-pages branch) when github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'. That job is triggered by ci.yml's push: [main, develop] and pull_request: [main] (ci.yml:3–8). Two deployers race, and the official route needs the repository's Pages source set to "GitHub Actions" rather than a branch. - Remove the docs job from ci.yml (lines 363–385 only, nothing else in that file). That is the single licensed ci.yml edit, and (D) asserts it. - Operator item: the Pages source setting ("GitHub Actions") is a repository setting no slot can change. It goes on the dashboard's Waiting-on-you list beside the manual push. - The official deploy needs: - permissions: {contents: read, pages: write, id-token: write}; - concurrency: {group: pages, cancel-in-progress: false}; - a deploy job with environment: {name: github-pages, url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}} and needs: build; - upload-pages-artifact path: site.

Assert the permissions and the environment name in (A). The action major versions are not verifiable offline: state the ones used (checkout@v4, setup-python@v5, configure-pages@v5, upload-pages-artifact@v3, deploy-pages@v4), and do not assert them. - The build step runs mkdocs build --strict, the same command as U164. It will be red on the runner for as long as U164's (B) is red, because the ≈1 540 outbound ../../src… links warn. This step does not fix that and does not drop --strict, which would be a loosening. The runner's red, if a push happens first, is the U164 finding seen remotely. - On a runner, docs/private/* and docs/references/jin-fem-3e/ are absent (gitignored). The exclude_docs from item 994 is defence in depth there, not the only net. - The guard denies shell text that is not a bare harness call. Edit the YAML with Edit/Write only, and never printf or redirect from Bash.

Scope. Edits allowed: - New .github/workflows/docs.yml. - .github/workflows/ci.yml: the docs job removed (:363–385), nothing else. - mkdocs.yml: site_url added, nothing else. - The new test module tests/package/test_wf17_pages_workflow.py. - Plan annotations.

Not licensed: - any change to other ci.yml jobs; - workflow_dispatch; - a push, a tag, or a gh call; - touching nav, exclude_docs, links or pyproject.toml.

Not claimed: a published site, a green runner, the Pages repository setting.

Negative result. - PyYAML or tomllib not importable in the container ⇒ stop. It is an image item and goes to known-issues. Measured 2026-11-15: PyYAML imports. tomllib is stdlib on the image's Python; confirm it in W0. - Any checker fails its own negative control ⇒ the checker is wrong. Fix the checker, never the control.

Status it can move. - WF-17 (✅) gains a step as a record, and §10 U165 is DONE. - The dashboard's Waiting-on-you list gains two items: "set Pages source to GitHub Actions" and "manual push". - v0's docs-hosting item is configured but not published.

Facts verified (2026-11-15). - .github/ exists; workflows/ holds only ci.yml. Its docs job is at :363–385, and its triggers at :3–8 are push to main/develop and pull_request to main. - mkdocs.yml has no site_url; repo_url is at :3. - pyproject.toml:57–61: the docs extra is three pins. :25–39: the core dependencies include fenics-dolfinx. - The container has PyYAML 6.0.3 and mkdocs 1.6.1. docker/Dockerfile:15 installs pyyaml; :22–24 installs the mkdocs toolchain.

Files. - New: .github/workflows/docs.yml, tests/package/test_wf17_pages_workflow.py. - Edited: .github/workflows/ci.yml (one job removed), mkdocs.yml (site_url). - New logs: docs/testing/logs/*_WF-17-u165-*.log, plus test-results.md rows. - Plan: the WF-17 chunk outcome, §10 U165 and the §9 row; the dashboard items go to the review.

Windows (bare, whole Bash command, foreground, Bash timeout: 120000): 1. W0. The test module before docs.yml exists. Expected: (Y) red with file absent, and (D) red on the peaceiris job (the pre-step control, disclosed). Also run python3 -c 'import tomllib'. scripts/testing/run_and_log.sh WF-17-u165-W0 "docker compose exec -T fem-em-solver bash -lc 'cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/src timeout -k 30 30 python3 -m pytest tests/package/test_wf17_pages_workflow.py -v --tb=short -s'" 2. W1. Same command, label WF-17-u165-W1, after docs.yml, the ci.yml job removal and site_url. Expected: all green, controls included.

Depends on. Nothing (serial on nothing, per the weekly). If item 994 lands first, its exclude_docs block sits beside site_url in mkdocs.yml. The two edits do not overlap.

Outcome commit. ci(WF-17): U165 — GitHub Pages workflow (official actions, docs extra only), site_url; retire ci.yml's peaceiris docs job. The commit carries the workflow, the test, the logs, the rows and the plan annotations together. Not pushed.

Executor spawn prompt (verbatim, if delegated). "Execute §9 item 995 — WF-17 U165 — per docs/planning/chunks/WF-17.md "§9 item 995".

Write .github/workflows/docs.yml with the Edit/Write tools only: - It triggers on push to main only. - It uses Python 3.11 and installs only the pyproject.toml docs extra, through a tomllib-generated requirements file. docs.title: WF-18 — rename to PrecessEM
docs.text: Item briefs and execution history (operator directive 2026-10-01). The §7 row is the status of record.

docs.title: Origin — operator directive 2026-10-08 (interactive session)
docs.text:
The human operator chose a project name to replace femem / fem-em-solver ahead of Phase 9's v0 and the repository going public:

Surface Today After Brand, README title, docs site FEM-EM Solver PrecessEM Import package fem_em_solver precessem Distribution (pyproject.toml name) fem-em-solver precessem CLI ([project.scripts]) femem precess

Why the name: precession at the Larmor frequency is what every coil here is tuned to; the "EM" suffix says the code solves the RF field, not spin dynamics. In prose always write it capitalised, PrecessEM — lowercase precessem is easy to misread as "process".

Availability checked by the operator 2026-10-09: precess and precessem are free on PyPI; PrecessEM is free on GitHub (unrelated repos named precess exist under other owners — no conflict, repository names are per owner). No fallback needed.

docs.title: Scope
docs.text:
In:

  • src/fem_em_solver/ → src/precessem/ (git mv, history kept), every import in src/, tests/, examples/, scripts/, docs/ code blocks.
  • pyproject.toml: distribution name, [project.scripts] precess = "precessem.cli:main", plus femem as an alias for one release.
  • Compatibility shim: a thin fem_em_solver package that re-exports precessem and its submodules (a meta-path alias, so import fem_em_solver.post.evaluation resolves to the same module object) and emits one DeprecationWarning. Removed one release after v0.
  • WF-14's validation-envelope registry and public-surface snapshot under the new name (node IDs change path; the mapping itself does not).
  • Generated API pages (WF-17 step 2) regenerated; user guide and README prose use PrecessEM.
  • src/sitecustomize.py, environment tests and any string that names the package path.

Out (not this chunk):

  • Docker service / container / image names (fem-em-solver, fem-em-solver-xl, …): the automation launchers, the bash guard, the XL queue files and run_and_log.sh usage in hundreds of plan lines name them. A separate infra chunk if ever wanted.
  • The repo directory and the GitHub repository name (operator).
  • History: PROJECT_PLAN, chunk files, attempts.md, known-issues, harness logs and archives keep fem_em_solver where they record what happened. Only live instructions (CLAUDE.md, START_HERE, protocol docs' command examples) are updated.
  • Private AED scripts under examples/ansys_benchmarks/*/aed/ (untracked; they do not import the package).

Traps already paid for. - The harness call is the whole Bash command: bare, repo-relative, with no cd … && prefix, no | tail and no redirect. bash_guard rule 3 denies anything else. Finding for the review (rule (e): reported, not decided). --estimate cannot price a degree-1 file. - Study.estimate fits a power law per degree and raises ValueError("fewer than two priced rows at degree 1") when fewer than two rows carry both unknowns and a price (src/fem_em_solver/study.py:1340–1344). - PRICE_TABLE has one complete degree-1 row (P1); P3 has unknowns=None and peak_gib=None (:1298–1299). - WF-13 step 4 asserts that refusal: the CLI returns 2 on every rank with the API's message unchanged, under review ruling (1) of 2026-10-08 (tests/package/test_wf13_cli_estimate.py:15–18; outcome 20261008T200148Z_WF-13-s4-W1.log). - Every gated record that fits a standard window is a degree-1 record. The degree-2 records cost 268–282 s, which is the heavy tier: - the degree-2 sphere is 282.4 s at -n 2 (PRICE_TABLE P2); - the degree-2 F-small is 269 s at -n 8 (20261010T125012Z_OPS-70-S2-W4-wf16-four-port-deg2.log). - So the weekly's two clauses cannot both hold at its tier. "Each preset priced by --estimate" needs degree-2 presets (heavy) or a second degree-1 PRICE_TABLE row. That row would flip WF-13 step 4's pinned refusal (X), which is a re-pose of a ✅ record and the weekly's to make.

The banked reading, in one sentence: on the flag-on ×0.0095 mesh the power residual is the terminal form's Cauchy–Schwarz deficit (C/terminal − 1 = 2.15 %, non-monotone in h), two-thirds of its growth is in-plane transverse field, the drive-component part sits on one large, well-shaped, mid-gap lateral-rim facet, and the mechanism is not explained. The field-side reading 4k proposes (the N1curl trace on that facet's adjacent cells) is declined: it could not return ×0.0095 to LADDER on its own, and the row's status does not depend on that rung. What would move WF-6 is the homogeneity / CV subgoal on the two-rung ladder main carries (4g), or a weekly decision to put ×0.0095 back on the ladder with the residual re-registered by measurement under rule (f) — either is a numbered step 5, scoped by the weekly (2026-09-13 02:15), not a 4l. Two new tests: test_step5_the_worst_spread_reproduces_its_4g_record (per rung, rtol 1e-3 against STEP5_RECORDED_SPREADS = 5.2506e-02 / 2.0719e-02, additional to the 10 % ×1 control, which stays) and test_step5_the_ladder_falls_monotonically (on ×0.012 with ×1 read in the same process: spread and C4 covariance both strictly fall). One window, 20260913T170259Z_WF-6-step5.log: tests/environment + the module, -n 4, complex, FEM_EM_REQUIRE_COMPLEX=1, timeout -k 30 590, -v -s — 24 passed / 9 skipped / 0 failed in 154.10 s, Status: 0, harness elapsed 156 s (:3904, :4102–4103); the 9 skips are the opt-in 4h–4j tests and the by-construction record skips. Anchor (i), asserted, green: worst-radius C4 four-copy spread 5.250630 % (rel 5.709e-06) and 2.071886 % (rel 6.912e-06) against 4g's records (:1987, :3831). Anchor (ii), asserted, green: spread 5.2506 → 2.0719 % (ratio 0.3946), covariance 3.6159 → 1.6815 % as resolution 0.015 → 0.012 m (:3836). Anchor (iii): every existing test green in the same window — ×1 116 085 cells at the imported 1 % band, covariance ≤ 5 %, power residuals ≤ 1e-2, cw separation ≥ 5×. Printed, never asserted (rule (e)): the 21-point interior CV of \|B₁⁺\| 8.1710 % (×1) / 6.6430 % (×0.012) beside the free-space filament closed form's (step 4a's function, legs + Kirchhoff rings, no PEC shield) 3.5703 % on the same points (:1988, :3832) — context, not a comparand, since the FEM domain is shielded and the filament is not; and §10's record of the ×1 eleven-point miss against S₁₁ (≈ 3.2 % centre, ≈ 5.3 / 7.9 % at 0.4R / 0.5R, :3837). Not changed: every band (POWER_BALANCE_BAND, C4_COVARIANCE_BAND, CELL_COUNT_BAND, CLOSED_FORM_BAND), LADDER, RECORDED_X1_WORST_SPREAD and its 10 % tolerance; ×0.0095 stays out and its known-issues entry stays OPEN.
